summary: Relates to prohibitions on circus performances; prohibits circuses from conducting shows or other performances in the state for two years where a circus has been found to be in violation or in non-compliance with the Animal Welfare Act of 1966.

short_summary: Abolishes citizens arrests; repealer
summary: Abolishes citizens arrests in New York state.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the state's participation in artificial pheasant propagation activities
summary: Prohibits the state's participation in artificial pheasant propagation activities; closes any state-owned or operated pheasant production facility.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a study to determine the effects that exposure to long range acoustic devices have on an individual's hearing
summary: Requires a study by the department of health to determine the effects that exposure to long range acoustic devices have on an individual's hearing.

short_summary: Prohibits rental car companies and used car companies from renting, selling or leasing vehicles that have been recalled due to safety risks
summary: Prohibits rental car companies and used car companies from renting, selling or leasing vehicles that have been recalled due to safety risks.

short_summary: Increases transparency in ticket reselling marketplaces
summary: Increases transparency in ticket reselling marketplaces by requiring ticket resellers have accounts which show their name and a photo of them.

short_summary: Relates to the menstrual product safety and research act
summary: Relates to the menstrual product safety and research act and its creation of a research program to determine the risks posed from potential toxins in menstrual products.

short_summary: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program
summary: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program in writing in English and in employees' primary languages; requires employers to obtain acknowledgements from employees and keep such acknowledgements for six years.

short_summary: Relates to expanding access to advanced courses to improve educational equity
summary: Relates to expanding access to advanced courses to improve educational equity beginning with notification to parents and students on the benefits and opportunities offered as well as automatic enrollment opportunities.

short_summary: Restricts operation of diesel powered electrical generators in areas failing to meet federal clean air standards for ozone
summary: Restricts operation of diesel powered electrical generation systems in areas identified as not meeting certain federal air quality standards for ozone; provides limited exceptions for use.

short_summary: Provides for rules and regulations for state aid reimbursement for the purchase of opioid antagonists by municipalities
summary: Provides for rules and regulations for state aid reimbursement under article six of the public health law for the purchase of opioid antagonists by municipalities.

short_summary: Prohibits disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions
summary: Prohibits the disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions.

short_summary: Prohibits the possession and transport of certain animals and body parts thereof at airports and port facilities owned or operated by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
summary: Prohibits the possession and transport of certain animals and body parts thereof at airports and port facilities owned or operated by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey; includes the big five African species, species determined to be endangered by the commissioner of the department of environmental conservation, those that appear on the list of nongame species or appear on any federal list of endangered or threatened species, or has been proposed to be included on any such list.

short_summary: Relates to the use of facial recognition and biometric information for determining probable cause
summary: Prohibits the use of facial recognition and biometric information as the sole factor in determining the existence of probable cause to place in custody or arrest an individual.

short_summary: Makes provisions regarding payment by utility customers to authorized payment agents
summary: Makes provisions regarding the payment of utility bills to authorized payment agencies providing that such payment shall be deemed to be a payment to the utility on the date of payment to the agent, requiring written contracts between a utility and its payment agent and review of such contracts by the public service commission.

short_summary: Establishes the disaster preparedness first responder recognition program
summary: Establishes the disaster preparedness first responder recognition program; names the initial first responders to receive recognition.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the "pollution justice act of 2023"
summary: Establishes the "pollution justice act"; implements a plan to replace peaker plant electric generating facilities with renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Relates to requiring gender neutral bathrooms in state-owned buildings

short_summary: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel
summary: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel for a 3 year period after successfully completing the emergency vehicle operator's course as part of their training.

short_summary: Establishes the New York task force on automated vehicle technology
summary: Establishes the New York task force on automated vehicle technology to study and assess the future of automated vehicle technology.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of regional arts, cultural affairs, and parks accessibility and sustainability grants
summary: Establishes regional arts, cultural affairs, and parks accessibility and sustainability grants for ten regions throughout the state.

short_summary: Relates to modifying the penalties associated with passing a stopped school bus to include a mandatory driver education course
summary: Relates to modifying the penalties associated with passing a stopped school bus to include a mandatory driver education course for each offense after a second conviction if recommended by the court.

short_summary: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety
summary: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety; necessitates written notification before a nuisance wildlife control operator undertakes any control measures.

short_summary: Relates to allowing a jury instruction stating biometric evidence shall not be dispositive in the jury's decision
summary: Relates to allowing a jury instruction stating biometric evidence shall not be dispositive in the jury's decision.

summary: Provides that an attorney licensed to practice in the state may serve as a poll watcher in any city or county in the state.

short_summary: Authorizes certain persons confined in institutions operated by the department of corrections and community supervision to apply for a sentence reduction
summary: Authorizes certain persons confined in institutions operated by the department of corrections and community supervision to apply for a sentence reduction.

short_summary: Allows personal caregivers to visit residents of adult care facilities
summary: Allows personal caregivers to visit residents of adult care facilities at any time, in compliance with federal and state laws and regulations.

short_summary: Relates to educating nursing home residents about the role of legal counsel in applying for Medicaid benefits
summary: Relates to educating nursing home residents about the role of legal counsel in applying for Medicaid benefits; requires operators of residential health care facilities to display and provide residents with a notice upon admission regarding such resident's right to hire an attorney to assist with a Medicaid application.

short_summary: Requires all insurance policies to provide a certain amount of coverage for hearing aids
summary: Requires all health insurance policies to provide insurance coverage for the cost of hearing aids; provides that such coverage shall include coverage of at least $3,000 over a four year period; provides that children under the age of sixteen are allowed reimbursement for additional expenses if needed.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the use of wastewater from high-volume hydraulic fracturing for road and land spreading
summary: Prohibits the use of wastewater from high-volume hydraulic fracturing for road and land spreading, for dust control or de-icing.

short_summary: Relates to imposing an additional two percent sales tax on certain retail sales
summary: Imposes an additional two percent sales tax on retail sales of motor vehicles over $70,000, excluding commercial vehicles and electric vehicles, jewelry over $5,000 and articles of clothing, footwear, handbags, luggage, umbrellas, wallets or watches sold for over $1,000; provides that such tax shall be distributed equally to the credit of the state university of New York and the city university of New York.

short_summary: Requires electric companies to provide alternative measures to ensure customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs have access to electricity during power outages
summary: Requires electric companies to provide alternative measures to ensure customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs have access to electricity during power outages; requires electric companies to provide generators or lodging for such individuals and transportation for medical devices.

short_summary: Relates to autonomous vehicle driving
summary: Provides that a person may operate a fully autonomous vehicle on the public roads of this state without a human driver provided that the automated driving system is engaged and the vehicle meets certain conditions; defines terms; requires insurance and that such vehicle is registered as a fully autonomous vehicle; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes an economic grant program for the Second Avenue Subway construction project area
summary: Establishes an economic development grant program for the Second Avenue Subway construction project area; defines micro business.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a toll exemption for certain residents of the central business district
summary: Establishes a toll exemption for residents of the central business district who have a household income less than or equal to one hundred twenty percent of the median income.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for wilful false statements for unemployment purposes
summary: Relates to penalties for wilful false statements by employers to avoid payment of unemployment benefits.

short_summary: Relates to admissibility of statements obtained from persons under the age of eighteen by means of deception
summary: Provides that statements made by minor defendants as a result of deception by law enforcement during custodial interrogation are inadmissible.

short_summary: Relates to calculating foundation aid using the three year average small area income and poverty estimate poverty rate
summary: Relates to calculating foundation aid for school districts using the three year average small area income and poverty estimate poverty rate.

short_summary: Establishes the fibroid study fund
summary: Establishes the fibroid study fund to expend moneys to the department of health to study fibroids, the treatment of fibroids, potential barriers to the access of treatment for fibroids, and differences in symptoms and access to treatment for women of color.

short_summary: Prohibits insurers from limiting payment on claims based on pricing caps and from recommending a particular repair facility
summary: Prohibits insurers from limiting payment on claims for damage to motor vehicles based on pricing caps for labor, parts, paint or repair materials; prohibits insurers from recommending a particular repair facility.

short_summary: Authorizes the commissioner of education to implement a purple star schools program
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of education to implement a purple star schools program to recognize schools and school districts which demonstrate a commitment to assisting military-connected students and their families.

short_summary: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals
summary: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals, including two hours of course work or training encompassing minority healthcare issues; provides an exemption for certain individuals; requires hospitals and facilities to request documentation of the completion of training from employees and prospective employees.

short_summary: Provides for legal assistance for military families
summary: Provides that the attorney general, in consultation with the adjutant general and the chairman of the board of trustees of the New York interest on lawyer account fund, establish a military pro bono program to provide legal assistance without charge to those in active military service of the United States and those military personnel who have been deployed for active duty other than training, and their family members domiciled or stationed in the state; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Designates January 6th as Democracy Day
summary: Designates January 6th as Democracy Day.

short_summary: Relates to reducing the speed for owner liability for failure of operator to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits
summary: Reduces the speed for owner liability for failure of operator to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits to more than seven miles per hour over such posted maximum speed limits.

short_summary: Relates to defining the practice of esthetics to include eyebrow threading services
summary: Relates to defining the practice of esthetics to include eyebrow threading services.

short_summary: Relates to requiring landlords to allow for the estate of a deceased tenant to enter the property for sixty days following the death of the tenant
summary: Requires landlords to allow for the estate of a deceased tenant to enter the property for sixty days following the death of the tenant.

short_summary: Authorizes administrative enforcement of state and local housing maintenance laws
summary: Authorizes localities to establish administrative proceedings for the enforcement of state and local housing maintenance codes; permits administratively imposed penalties to be docketed and enforced in the same manner as a judgment in a civil action without further judicial proceedings.

short_summary: Requires the reporting and monitoring of a minor whose parent, legal guardian or care-giver of a minor is arrested or taken into custody
summary: Requires an arresting authority to notify the local social services district when the parent, legal guardian or care-giver of a minor is arrested or taken into custody; requires the local social services district to monitor the placement of such minor.

short_summary: Relates to changes of membership eligibility in a New York state retirement system
summary: Relates to changes of membership eligibility in a New York state retirement system.

short_summary: Authorizes minors to operate temporary businesses without certain licenses or permits
summary: Authorizes minors to operate temporary businesses operating for less than thirty days and generating less than five thousand dollars in profit per calendar year without certain licenses or permits; permits local government or law enforcement to require such temporary business to move if the location is determined to pose a substantial risk to health and safety.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of an electric vehicle clean energy website
summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles, in cooperation with NYSERDA, to create an electric vehicle clean energy website containing a carbon footprint calculator, a cost-and-mileage calculator, an electric vehicle fueling station locator, and other electric vehicle ownership information.

short_summary: Requires certain training for all retailers, dealers and sellers of firearms in New York state
summary: Requires training on how to identify illegal purchasers of firearms for all retailers, dealers and sellers of firearms in New York state; directs the state police to implement such program; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the downstate New York power authority, and providing for its powers and duties
summary: Establishes the downstate New York power authority to own and operate electricity service and acquire the distribution facilities formerly owned by any downstate utility corporation.

short_summary: Relates to the security of connected devices
summary: Requires manufacturers of connected devices to equip such devices with reasonable security features.

short_summary: Relates to establishing sexual harassment prevention training protocols within the private sector
summary: Relates to establishing sexual harassment prevention training protocols within the private sector including a model management policy and training program and how to properly disseminate information to employers and employees.

short_summary: Relates to licenses for the rental horse business
summary: Relates to licenses for the rental horse business.

short_summary: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system
summary: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system through which state agencies, local governmental entities, including law enforcement agencies, court systems, school districts, and emergency service providers, and other relevant persons are able to share and access information related to individuals who experience chronic homelessness in order to connect or refer such individuals to services including affordable housing opportunities.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns
summary: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns; requires the division of state police to maintain statewide records of individuals who have waived the right to purchase firearms, rifles, or shotguns and any revocations of such waivers.

short_summary: Requires continuing medical education for physicians
summary: Requires physicians who are re-registering for their license to complete fifty hours of continuing medical education.

short_summary: Establishes criteria for the sale of automated employment decision tools
summary: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools; provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

short_summary: Establishes the employee privacy act prohibiting employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant
summary: Prohibits employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant who has not been offered employment and prohibits municipalities from requiring employers to use the federal electronic employment verification system.

short_summary: Relates to adding veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination
summary: Adds veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination regardless of discharge status.

short_summary: Establishes a division of the public administrator within the office of the corporation counsel for the city of New York; repealer
summary: Establishes a division of the public administrator within the office of the corporation counsel for the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to notification in the case of a change to a workers' compensation claims representative
summary: Relates to notification in the case of a change to the workers' compensation claims representative.

short_summary: Prohibits transportation network companies from enacting surge pricing during declared federal, state and local emergencies
summary: Prohibits transportation network companies from enacting surge pricing during declared federal, state and local emergencies; subjects violators to a two hundred fifty dollar fine.

short_summary: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures
summary: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures, with each report covering activity from the prior six months.

short_summary: Requires certain school staff members to be trained in the Heimlich maneuver
summary: Requires certain school staff members to be trained in the Heimlich maneuver and requires at least one such trained person to be present when and where students eat meals.

short_summary: Relates to the prohibition of certain acts in rodeos
summary: Prohibits certain acts in rodeos; imposes penalties for the violation of such acts.

short_summary: Requires assisted living facilities to notify residents of changes to medical and support services 180 days prior to such changes taking effect
summary: Requires assisted living facilities to notify residents of changes to medical and support services 180 days prior to such changes taking effect.

short_summary: Relates to the care and collection of animals on vacant property
summary: Relates to the care and collection of abandoned animals on vacant property; requires notification to the appropriate authorities by anyone authorized to be on vacant land where such person finds an animal which based on its physical appearance or lack of available food or water appears abandoned, within six hours of an encounter.

short_summary: Relates to professional misconduct of medical professionals
summary: Relates to professional misconduct of medical professionals involving felonies committed in the course of the licensee's medical practice; provides for license revocation.

short_summary: Relates to the liability of an employee committing an unlawful discriminatory practice
summary: Relates to the liability of an employee committing an unlawful discriminatory practice; creates joint and several liability for employers and employees responsible for unlawful discriminatory practices.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a prom and graduation safety program
summary: Relates to the creation of a prom and graduation safety program; develops educational materials.

short_summary: Relates to violations of nondisclosure agreements in certain settlement agreements
summary: Prohibits settlement agreements in any claim involving sexual harassment or any other form of discrimination prohibited by law from containing any condition that requires the complainant to pay the defendant liquidated damages in the event that the plaintiff violates any nondisclosure agreement included in such settlement agreement.

short_summary: Relates to the applicability of step therapy to certain medically necessary prescription drugs
summary: Ensures that step therapy shall not apply to medically necessary prescription drugs in the dermatologic, hematology, ophthalmologic, rheumatic, gastrointestinal, neurology, and oncology therapeutic classes, including non-formulary drugs.

short_summary: Relates to mutual companies in N.Y. city
summary: Requires a Mitchell-Lama cooperative seeking to dissolve to offer cooperators who may not be able to afford the increased carrying charges the opportunity to sell.

short_summary: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products
summary: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products.

short_summary: Relates to the disclosure and consideration of gender wage disparity in the awarding of state contracts
summary: Relates to the disclosure and consideration of gender wage disparity in the awarding of state contracts; requires all offerors to provide the percentage of gender wage disparity by job title for all state contracts; requires agencies to compile data received on gender wage disparity and provide data to the office of general services for publication on its website; requires agencies to provide extra credit or weight to offerors with a gender wage disparity of ten percent or less.

short_summary: Relates to the education and experience of members of the state board of parole
summary: Relates to the education and experience of members of the state board of parole; provides that members can have either a degree and at least five years of experience in several fields or at least ten years of experience in such fields.

short_summary: Relates to application and environmental assessment forms
summary: Relates to application and environmental assessment forms and city and village planning commissions.

short_summary: Enacts the healthy, safe and energy efficient outdoor lighting act to reduce harmful outdoor lighting
summary: Enacts the healthy, safe and energy efficient outdoor lighting act to reduce harmful outdoor lighting; sets standards for outdoor lighting; provides for the designation of dark-sky preserves; provides for distribution to customers by electric corporations or municipalities providing electric service of an informational pamphlet relating to outdoor lighting.

short_summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish on its website a database of major capital improvements
summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish on its website a database of building-wide major capital improvements installed by landlords in every city of more than one million inhabitants.

short_summary: Limits a candidate to one authorized committee per election; defines "multi-candidate committee"; provides that such a committee may not be an authorized committee
summary: Limits a candidate for public office to one authorized committee per election; defines the term "multi-candidate committee" and provides that such a committee may not be authorized by a candidate.

short_summary: Requires instruction in anti-gun violence in all schools
summary: Requires instruction in anti-gun violence in all schools.

short_summary: Provides for a transfer fee of 75% of the fair market value in dissolution or sales of a rental project or mutual company
summary: Provides for a transfer fee of 75% of the fair market value in dissolution or sales of a rental project or mutual company.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report.

short_summary: Creates the toxics information clearinghouse
summary: Creates the toxic information clearinghouse; provides substances hazardous to public health, safety or the environment that have been identified or listed as a hazardous waste in regulations promulgated pursuant to section 27-0903 or 37-0103 of the environmental conservation law; provides chemical hazard traits and environmental and toxicological end-point data.

short_summary: Creates a temporary state commission concerning the incidence of asthma in the Bronx
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of asthma in the borough of the Bronx in New York city.

short_summary: Relates to when school personnel may adjust a student's dosage of insulin
summary: Relates to when school personnel may adjust a student's dosage of insulin: under instructions from the prescriber or instructions from the parent or person in parental relationship where explicitly authorized by the prescriber.

short_summary: Restricts sales tax exemptions on fur-bearing articles of clothing or footwear
summary: Restricts sales tax exemptions on fur-bearing articles of clothing or footwear.

short_summary: Requires comprehensive training for school bus drivers and school bus attendants in the discouragement, prevention and detection of harassment, bullying and discrimination
summary: Requires comprehensive training at least one time per year for school bus drivers and school bus attendants in the discouragement, prevention and detection of harassment, bullying and discrimination.

short_summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable New York state taxpayers to electronically file income tax returns free of charge
summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable each New York state taxpayer to prepare and electronically file his or her federal and state income tax returns free of charge.

short_summary: Establishes the residential open green space tax abatement for certain properties in N.Y. city
summary: Establishes the residential open green space tax abatement for certain properties in a city of one million or more; provides an abatement for owners who remove an impermeable surface from a residential yard and replace it with soil and vegetation.

short_summary: Relates to assessment of certain land parcels for the purposes of determining payments to eligible school, fire, fire protection, and ambulance districts
summary: Relates to assessment of certain land parcels for the purposes of determining payments to eligible school, fire, fire protection, and ambulance districts; removes requirement that such assessments be approved by the commissioner of taxation and finance in the same manner as state lands.

short_summary: Relates to the percentage responsibility of the state for federally assisted projects
summary: Relates to the percentage responsibility of the state for federally assisted projects; relates to the state share of municipal projects where the municipality funds a complete street design.

short_summary: Requires notice to members of the legislature and certain local officials relating to certain construction and other projects affecting such members' and officials' districts
summary: Requires notice to members of the legislature and certain local officials relating to certain construction and other projects affecting such members' and officials' districts.

short_summary: Relates to the transfer and use of certain state land to the city of New Rochelle for the construction of municipal fire services and affordable housing
summary: Relates to the transfer and use of certain state land to the city of New Rochelle for the construction of municipal fire services and affordable housing; extends authority to transfer.

short_summary: Relates to the accessibility of congressional, senatorial, assembly and election district maps
summary: Relates to the accessibility of congressional, senatorial, assembly and election district maps in downloadable digital file formats compatible with geographic information (GIS) software.

short_summary: Relates to public awareness and involvement in the thirty by thirty conservation plan
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to post draft strategies and methodology developed no later than July 1, 2024; requires at least one public hearing and posting of the final goal strategies and methodology on such department's website.

short_summary: Directs the department of agriculture and markets, in cooperation with NYSERDA, to produce and distribute guidance and educational materials for farmers on the use of agrivoltaics in farming
summary: Directs the department of agriculture and markets, in cooperation with NYSERDA, to produce and distribute guidance and educational materials for farmers on the use of agrivoltaics in farming no later than one year after chapter 629 of the laws of 2022 takes effect.

short_summary: Relates to pharmacists administering medications approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration
summary: Relates to pharmacists administering medications approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a plan for the delivery of medical supplies and medications to pharmacies, hospitals and nursing homes in affected areas during a state disaster emergency
summary: Clarifies that a plan for the delivery of medical supplies and medications to pharmacies, hospitals and nursing homes in affected areas during a state disaster emergency is required.

short_summary: Prohibits agencies from charging a fee for records where an electronic copy is already available from a previous request made within the past six months
summary: Prohibits agencies from charging a fee for records where an electronic copy is already available from a previous request made within the past six months except for the actual cost of a storage device or media if provided to the requester.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of general services to maintain a list of all state boards and requiring each state board to maintain a publicly accessible website
summary: Requires the commissioner of general services to maintain a list of all state boards; requires each state board to maintain a publicly accessible website; requires each website associated with a state board to include certain information about such state board; changes the effectiveness of chapter 219 to November 1, 2013.

short_summary: Relates to the availability of training for state approved education or training programs required for certification of home health aides, personal care aides, and certified nurse aides
summary: Requires state approved education or training programs required for certification or recertification of home health aides, personal care aides, and certified nurse aides to include training in working with patients of diverse sexual orientations and gender identities or expressions within twelve months; eliminates the requirement of such training for personal care staff.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of the office of mental health to provide monthly status reports of the community investments and the impact on inpatient census
summary: Requires the commissioner of the office of mental health to provide monthly status reports of the community investments and the impact on inpatient census to the chair of the senate finance committee and the chair of the assembly ways and means committee and to post such report on the office's website.

short_summary: Requires written in-person or electronic notifications to be utilized for registration in the donate life registry
summary: Clarifies that registration in the donate life registry takes effect when entry of the individual's enrollment data is made into the registry.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment and priorities of the New York state council on hunger and food policy
summary: Clarifies the provisions relating to the establishment and priorities of the New York state council on hunger and food policy.

short_summary: Relates to the effectiveness of certain curriculum requirements curriculum related to human trafficking awareness to be included in alcohol training awareness programs
summary: Relates to the effectiveness of certain curriculum requirements related to human trafficking awareness to be included in alcohol training awareness programs.

short_summary: Relates to a natural fiber textile development workgroup
summary: Creates a natural fiber textile development workgroup to study and identify methods of advancing the animal and plant based textile industry in this state.

short_summary: Relates to the veterans memorial registry
summary: Authorizes public requests for information from any county, city, town, or village desiring to have a memorial located within their municipality listed within the veterans memorial registry; directs the department of veterans' services to establish a veterans memorial registry.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of cosmetic products containing trace amounts of mercury
summary: Provides that no person shall sell or offer for sale any cosmetic product or personal care product containing mercury, other than in trace amounts allowed by the food and drug administration as unavoidable under conditions of good manufacturing practice or necessary for use as a preservative in the absence of an effective and safe nonmercurial preservative substitute.

short_summary: Relates to awarding a contract for the purchase of rock salt or sodium chloride
summary: Directs that when soliciting a contract for the purchase of rock salt or sodium chloride, any department or agency of the state, any department or agency of a political subdivision, any public authority, or the commissioner of transportation, may award such contract to the responsible and reliable bidder offering to supply rock salt or sodium chloride that is mined or hand harvested in the United States, and which offer is within ten percent of the lowest price or best value offer, rather than to the lowest responsible and reliable bidder.

short_summary: Establishes a threshold for the amount of work needed to be performed by a preferred source which is an approved charitable non-profit-making agency for the blind; provides for the repeal upon expiration thereof
summary: Requires that when the state is purchasing commodities and such commodities are available and purchased from approved charitable non-profit-making agencies for the blind, the preferred source shall perform fifty percent or more of the work.

short_summary: Relates to the applicability of certain labor law requirements to construction projects involving parking facilities with EV charging capability
summary: Exempts certain projects from requirements for providing EV charging capability and from certain labor law provisions for public projects.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for in-service training programs for code enforcement personnel
summary: Modifies the requirements for in-service training programs designed to assist code enforcement personnel in maintaining skills and being informed of technological advances.

short_summary: Relates to the oversight of certain contracts by the comptroller
summary: Relates to the oversight of certain contracts by the comptroller; provides for the oversight of contracts by the comptroller based upon the dollar amounts of such contracts.

short_summary: Exempts hot tubs or spas with safety covers from certain standards of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code
summary: Exempts hot tubs or spas with safety covers from certain standards of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code.

short_summary: Relates to standards for the construction of new buildings and existing buildings that undergo a substantial improvementand which are located wholly or partially in a flood plain
summary: Relates to standards for the construction of all new buildings and for the construction or renovation of existing buildings that undergo a substantial improvement and which are located wholly or partially in an area designated on the applicable Federal Emergency Management Agency ("FEMA") flood insurance rate map, as amended from time to time, as a Special Flood Hazard Area or Moderate Risk Flood Hazard Area.

short_summary: Relates to infection updates and infection control planning in residential health care facilities
summary: Requires nursing homes to follow Federal CDC or medicare and medicaid guidance relating to infectious disease control planning and procedures.

short_summary: Establishes Diwali as a school holiday in public schools in the city of New York
summary: Establishes Diwali as a school holiday in public schools in the city of New York.

short_summary: Clarifies the meaning of the phrase greatest social need for purposes of the administration of programs under the federal Older Americans Act of 1965
summary: Clarifies the meaning of the phrase "greatest social need" for purposes of the administration of programs under the federal Older Americans Act of 1965, defining it to mean the need caused by non-economic factors which shall include, but not be limited to: physical or mental disability; Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia; language barriers including limited English proficiency and low literacy; and cultural, social, or geographic isolation.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of increases in income limiting eligibility under the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage
summary: Limits the calculation of increases in income limiting eligibility under the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage to one subsequent calendar year.

short_summary: Requires residential leases to include information on prior flood damage
summary: Requires residential leases to include information on prior flood damage due to a natural flood event, such as heavy rainfall, coastal storm surge, tidal inundation, or river overflow, that the lessor knows or reasonable should know has occurred to such premises and the nature of any such damage.

short_summary: Relates to training of a forensic evaluator in relation to court ordered forensic evaluations involving child custody and visitation
summary: Relates to mandatory training of a forensic evaluator in relation to court ordered forensic evaluations involving child custody and visitation when the child is living out-of-state and is farther than one hundred miles from the New York state border; relates to training in the prevention and intervention of domestic violence required for forensic investigators.

short_summary: Relates to loan counseling services for a mortgage guaranteed under the "Servicemen's Readjustment Act of 1944"
summary: Provides that a veteran seeking a housing loan under chapter 37 of title 38 of the United States Code be offered loan counseling services by a counselor certified by the United States department of housing and urban development under Part 214 of Title 24 of the Code of Federal Regulations prior to the processing of such application by a banking institution or mortgage lender and that the department of veterans' services shall promulgate regulations to ensure that no conflicts of interest exist between counselors and mortgage companies.

short_summary: Relates to bias related criminal activity
summary: Proscribes conduct constituting a bias related crime, meaning for such purposes, the commission of a designated act that demonstrates a prejudice based on the race, color, religion, national origin, age, ethnicity, disability, gender or sexual orientation of the victim; denies the granting of youthful offender status for any offender committing such a crime.

short_summary: Prohibits a pharmacist from substituting any anti-epileptic drug for a prescribed anti-epileptic drug without the informed consent of the prescriber and patient
summary: Prohibits a pharmacist from substituting any anti-epileptic drug for the prescribed anti-epileptic drug without notification of and the informed consent of the prescriber and patient or such patient's parent, guardian or spouse.

short_summary: Prohibits the disclosure of immigration status for victims of domestic violence
summary: Prohibits disclosure of immigration status for victims of domestic violence.

short_summary: Relates to creating a tax abatement for geothermal well systems
summary: Creates a tax abatement for geothermal well systems up to $62,500.

short_summary: Authorizes a person to petition for expungement of records of arrest, investigation, detention and computer databases in certain instances
summary: Authorizes a person to petition for expungement of records of arrest, investigation, detention and computer databases in certain instances where such person may have been falsely arrested, whose case was dismissed, or where innocent.

short_summary: Provides for a tax abatement for electric energy storage equipment
summary: Provides for a tax abatement for electric energy storage equipment placed in service after January 1, 2026 and before January 1, 2028.

short_summary: Prohibits certain agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature
summary: Prohibits agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature.

short_summary: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act"; repealer
summary: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act" to replace the process for the criminal forfeiture of certain property in certain instances.

short_summary: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi
summary: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi.

short_summary: Precludes local criminal court from issuing a warrant of arrest based on any simplified information when the defendant has not been arraigned
summary: Precludes a local criminal court from issuing a warrant of arrest based on any simplified information when the defendant has not been arraigned and has not come under the control of the court with respect to the charges in the simplified information; provides that this formerly applied only to simplified traffic information.

short_summary: Relates to ovarian cancer research
summary: Relates to ovarian cancer research; includes funding for ovarian cancer research and education programs.

short_summary: Provides for a residency program initiative to service medically underserved areas; appropriation
summary: Directs the department of health to develop and implement a residency program initiative to service medically underserved areas; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions
summary: Requires certain notices in communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions.

short_summary: Clarifies that making a referral of alleged improper conduct of a police officer to district attorney within 48 hours of conduct is not an improper employer practice
summary: Provides that it shall not be an improper practice for a public employer to immediately refer to the appropriate district attorney any issue regarding the alleged improper conduct of a police officer within forty-eight hours of such conduct.

short_summary: Relates to standards for the use of electronic control weapons
summary: Relates to standards for the use of electronic control weapons; defines such weapons as conducted energy devices, such as stun guns; requires an annual report to the governor, assembly and senate.

short_summary: Relating to requiring study abroad organizations to report crime and harm that occurs to participating students
summary: Relates to requiring postsecondary institutions that participate in study abroad programs to report crime and harm that occurs to participating students.

short_summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the installation of broadband conduits and provides for access to such conduits
summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the installation of broadband conduits suitable for fiber optic cables or wireless facilities that support broadband services; provides for access to such conduits on a competitively neutral and nondiscriminatory basis, for a charge not to exceed a cost-based rate.

short_summary: Allows persons participating in certain formal ceremonies to possess a firearm, rifle or shotgun
summary: Allows persons participating in certain formal ceremonies to possess a firearm, rifle or shotgun, provided that such person has received prior approval from the municipality or other appropriate entity.

short_summary: Requires foster care records of incarcerated individual to be sent to a correctional facility
summary: Requires foster care records of incarcerated individuals to be sent to the correctional facility.

short_summary: Relates to criminal history record searches and open warrants
summary: Relates to criminal history record searches and open warrants and when such warrants shall be excluded from reports.

short_summary: Relates to coverage for punitive damages and civil penalties
summary: Permits a liability policy to provide coverage for punitive damages, civil penalties and other non-compensatory damages.

short_summary: Makes it a class B felony to be a straw purchaser for firearms or to allow the use of your firearm in the commission of a class A or B felony
summary: Makes it a class B felony to be a straw purchaser for firearms or to allow the use of your firearm in the commission of a class A or B felony.

short_summary: Requires an automatic recanvass of ballots in certain elections
summary: Relates to requiring an automatic recanvass of votes where the difference between votes cast for two candidates that determines a candidate's nomination or election to office is less than one-half of one percent of total ballots cast in such contest.

short_summary: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system
summary: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system.

short_summary: Enacts the Health Care Nondiscrimination Act of 2023
summary: Enacts the Health Care Nondiscrimination Act.

short_summary: Adds ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions
summary: Relates to adding ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions.

short_summary: Relates to the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways
summary: Relates to the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways.

short_summary: Enacts the state and local government food waste prevention and diversion act
summary: Enacts the state and local government food waste prevention and diversion act; requires facilities generating excess food waste to take measures to minimize such waste.

short_summary: Relates to the exercise of powers and duties of the board of elections of the city of New York and its executive management
summary: Relates to the exercise of powers and duties of the board of elections of the city of New York and its executive management; provides for equal representation among certain employees of the board of elections; relates to qualification and removal of certain employees of the board of elections.

short_summary: Provides representation to veterans for certain civil matters
summary: Provides representation to veterans that are at or below four hundred percent of the federal poverty guidelines for matters involving children, sustenance and real property proceedings.

short_summary: Requires arrests be recorded or else such arrest is void and the defendant is discharged
summary: Requires arrests be recorded or else such arrest is void and the defendant is discharged.

short_summary: Relates to flexible working arrangements
summary: Relates to flexible working arrangements; provides that employees may submit a request for flexible working arrangements in good faith; requires the employer to notify the employee of the decision; prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for exercising rights under the section.

short_summary: Provides that the commissioner of environmental conservation shall place and operate certain air quality monitoring systems in proximity to N.Y. city airports
summary: Provides that the commissioner of environmental conservation shall place and operate certain air quality monitoring systems in proximity to NY city airports.

short_summary: Authorizes the correctional association to inspect residential juvenile detention facilities
summary: Authorizes the correctional association to inspect residential juvenile detention facilities.

short_summary: Establishes a pregnant persons' bill of rights
summary: Establishes a pregnant persons' bill of rights; requires posting and disclosing such bill of rights; establishes a penalty for failure to post or disclose such bill of rights.

short_summary: Authorizes distinctive license plates for recipients of the Bronze or Silver star
summary: Authorizes distinctive license plates for recipients of the Bronze or Silver star.

short_summary: Requires primary care physicians to post information detailing how parents or guardians of children can subscribe to the US consumer product safety commission's e-mail subscription lists
summary: Requires primary care physicians to post certain information detailing how parents or guardians of infants and children can subscribe to the United States consumer product safety commission's e-mail subscription lists.

short_summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented multiple times within a period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications
summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented multiple times within a period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications.

short_summary: Relates to screening for gifted and talented students
summary: Requires school districts to screen for gifted and talented students; provides the parents or guardians of such students the option to opt out of such screening.

short_summary: Relates to permitting party enrollment within 10 days of an election; repealer
summary: Permits party enrollment and change of party enrollment within 10 days of a primary, general, or special election.

short_summary: Relates to the duration of certain tests
summary: Provides that any standardized test or examination shall not be subject to any time limitation when administered by the city district.

short_summary: Relates to mandating greater levels of disclosure by non-fiduciaries that provide investment advice
summary: Relates to mandating greater levels of disclosure by non-fiduciaries that provide investment advice; requires signed acknowledgement of disclosure informing clients that the advisor owes no fiduciary duty.

short_summary: Provides for issuing non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges
summary: Issues non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges due to a driving while intoxicated arrest.

short_summary: Relates to tampering with physical evidence
summary: Includes a police or peace officers turning off his or her body camera or deleting a body camera recording in the crime of tampering with physical evidence.

short_summary: Directs public welfare officials to withhold rent from a landlord for violation of the warranty of habitability
summary: Directs public welfare officials to withhold rent from a landlord for violation of the warranty of habitability; directs public welfare officials to seek a diminution of rent owed based on the duration of such violation.

short_summary: Relates to notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs
summary: Requires certain agencies and individuals to provide notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs to tenants upon the occurrence of certain events.

short_summary: Relates to price gouging
summary: Relates to price gouging; imposes criminal penalties for price gouging; removes language relating to the declaration of a state of emergency; increases civil penalty; authorizes a district attorney to enforce provisions.

short_summary: Prohibits prior peace officers or police officers whose position as such was terminated or vacated due to misconduct from again becoming a peace officer or a police officer
summary: Prohibits prior peace officers or police officers whose position as such was terminated or vacated due to misconduct from again becoming a peace officer or a police officer.

short_summary: Dedicates and designates Jerome Park as parklands of the city of New York and establishes a working group for such park to enhance the use thereof
summary: Dedicates and designates Jerome Park as parkland of the city of New York; establishes a working group for such park to enhance the use thereof.

short_summary: Prohibits mandatory arbitration agreements in consumer and employment contracts; repealer
summary: Prohibits mandatory arbitration agreements in consumer and employment contracts; repeals existing provisions prohibiting mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts.

short_summary: Relates to the disposition of barge canal lands, barge canal terminals or barge canal terminal lands
summary: Requires legislative approval for any change in the state agency or agency subdivision which has management and control, including but not limited to management and control over its maintenance and oversight, of any portion of the barge canal.

short_summary: Relates to requiring high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning
summary: Requires high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning stating that the beverage contains 100% or more of the FDA recommended daily intake of added sugar.

short_summary: Relates to a half fare rate program in the MTA for veterans
summary: Directs the MTA to establish a half fare rate program for veterans.

short_summary: Relates to excusing prospective jurors who are over the age of 75 or have a health condition putting such person at greater risk for severe illness from COVID-19
summary: Excuses prospective jurors who are over the age of 75 or have a health condition putting such person at greater risk for severe illness from COVID-19 from service; establishes provisions expire after two years.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee
summary: Prohibits agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee; allows for a cause of action against employers who engage in such agreements.

short_summary: Relates to surcharges for the installation or use of certain appliances in housing accommodations subject to rent control
summary: Prohibits the imposition of any surcharge for the installation or use of a tenant-installed appliance where the tenant pays for electric utility service.

short_summary: Requires video cameras to be placed on the entrances/exits of all facilities run by the office for people with developmental disabilities
summary: Requires video cameras to be placed on the entrances/exits of all facilities run by the office for people with developmental disabilities.

short_summary: Relates to providing for an initial hearing in every case for a claim of compensation
summary: Provides for an initial hearing in every case for a claim of compensation.

short_summary: Establishes incapacity to consent when a person is a witness to or subject of an investigation under certain circumstances
summary: Establishes incapacity to consent when a person is a witness to or subject of an investigation under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to drivers' license suspensions for traffic fatalities
summary: Requires the suspension of the license to operate a motor vehicle of any person who was operating a motor vehicle at the time of an accident which resulted in a fatality.

short_summary: Modifies the interest rate within the standard nonforfeiture law for annuities
summary: Reduces the minimum nonforfeiture interest rate for annuities from one percent to one half of one percent for annuities during the surrender charge period, and from one percent to fifteen hundredths of one percent during any contract period with no surrender charge.

short_summary: Relates to the approval of contracts awarded to owners of nuclear powered generating facilities
summary: Relates to the approval of contracts awarded to owners of nuclear powered generating facilities; provides that certain exceptions to comptroller approval of contracts do not apply to a contract awarded by a public benefit corporation to the owner of a nuclear powered generating facility or facilities for the provision of zero-emissions attributes of generated electricity.

short_summary: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job
summary: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job.

short_summary: Relates to allowing poll workers to be from any political party
summary: Allows poll workers to be from any political party.

short_summary: Implements escalating penalties for vehicles which have been documented multiple times by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications
summary: Implements escalating penalties for vehicles which have been documented multiple times by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications up to a suspension of a vehicle's registration.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school
summary: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school; defines "flavored smokeless tobacco"; authorizes the commissioner to impose a civil penalty for violations.

short_summary: Prohibits corporations that receive public financing from giving gifts to public officials
summary: Prohibits corporations that receive public financing from giving gifts to public officials.

short_summary: Relates to providing a tax abatement for geothermal well systems in N.Y. city
summary: Provides a tax abatement for geothermal well systems in cities of one million or more.

short_summary: Requires hospitals to provide language assistance services
summary: Requires hospitals to provide language assistance services to a patient or a patient's assistant for communication of clinical and other information, including but not limited to health care, billing and making appointments, to ensure effective communication; provides that such interpreter may be a qualified interpreter, volunteer or medical personnel at such hospital; provides for such services to be available at all locations during all times that patient care is available; provides that translations of frequently used forms essential to a patient's care and treatment be available in all of the hospital's primary languages; provides for training of those providing interpretation services; requires the hospital to submit to the commissioner an annual report assessing compliance; defines primary language and patient visits.

short_summary: Relates to changes in energy service pricing
summary: Relates to requiring certain notices prior to changes in energy service pricing.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the metropolitan transportation authority to create ten-year capital program plans
summary: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to create ten-year capital program plans.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of gasoline powered leaf blowers and lawn mowers
summary: Prohibits the sale of gasoline powered leaf blowers and lawn mowers in the state; requires the commissioner to promulgate rules to enact such prohibition by January 1, 2025.

short_summary: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators, and establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions
summary: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators; establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions; requires disclosure of information by certain arbitrators.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership
summary: Prohibits pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership where over fifty percent of the units are shareholder occupied.

short_summary: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools
summary: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools.

short_summary: Enacts the "gender identity respect, dignity and safety act"
summary: Enacts the "gender identity respect, dignity and safety act"; relates to the treatment and placement of incarcerated individuals based upon gender identity; requires that incarcerated individuals in state and local correctional facilities who have a gender identity different from their assigned sex at birth be addressed and have access to commissary items, clothing and other materials that are consistent with the person's gender identity; establishes that incarcerated individuals shall be presumptively placed in a correctional facility with persons of the gender that most closely aligns with such person's self-attested gender identity unless the person opts out of such placement.

short_summary: Relates to providing a civil action for deprivation of rights
summary: Provides a civil action for deprivation of rights which is caused by any person or public entity.

short_summary: Relates to collection, storage or transmission of personal information collected from smart home systems
summary: Requires express and affirmative consent prior to collection, storage or transmittal of any personal information obtained from the installation or use of a smart home connected system by certain persons.

short_summary: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings; repealer
summary: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings; allows the judge or justice presiding over a proceeding to exercise discretion to prohibit or limit filming or photographing of particular participants; defines terms; provides limitations on audio-visual coverage.

short_summary: Relates to proceedings with respect to designating and nominating petitions
summary: Allows for limited three-day expansion of the statute of limitations where a proceeding to invalidate a designating or nominating petition has been commenced.

short_summary: Provides administrative remedy for persons whose vehicle is wrongfully towed
summary: Provides recourse for a person whose vehicle was wrongfully towed in a city with a population of one million or more against the parking violations bureau in such city or the responsible agent of such bureau by granting such person the right to appear before a panel of administrative law judges which shall be empowered to order the correction of records, the refund of any fee paid to release the wrongfully towed vehicle and the reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses, including lost wages; defines the term "wrongful tow."

short_summary: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies
summary: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of state aid by colleges and universities to fund or provide membership in academic institutions that are boycotting a country or higher education institutions of a country
summary: Prohibits the use of state aid by colleges and universities to fund or provide membership in academic institutions that are boycotting a country or higher education institutions of a country.

short_summary: Empowers the council on the arts to designate East Harlem as a cultural district
summary: Empowers the council on the arts to designate East Harlem as a cultural district.

short_summary: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords
summary: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords and report to the legislature.

short_summary: Provides for a sex offender registry check for youth organization volunteers who have direct contact with youths under the age of 18
summary: Provides for a sex offender registry check for youth organization volunteers who have direct contact with youths under the age of 18.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for personal property replacement as a result of bedbug infestation
summary: Establishes a tax credit for personal property replacement as a result of bedbug infestation; credit of 15% not to exceed $750; certification determined by commissioner.

short_summary: Relates to monetary penalties that a parking violations bureau may impose for illegally idling the engine of a motor vehicle
summary: Relates to monetary penalties that a parking violations bureau may impose for illegally idling the engine of a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Provides for the licensure of lactation consultants and the establishment of a lactation consultant licensing board
summary: Provides for the licensure of lactation consultants and the establishment of a lactation consultant licensing board.

short_summary: Exempts the sale of fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, heat sensors and carbon monoxide detectors from sales and use taxes
summary: Exempts the sale of fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, heat sensors and carbon monoxide detectors for residential use only from state sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to redetermination based on income for a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
summary: Relates to redetermination based on increases in income for a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities.

short_summary: Modifies the order in which candidates appear on the ballot
summary: Modifies the order in which candidates appear on the ballot; requires that offices shall be listed on the ballot in descending order based on the size of the electorate and requires certain federal offices to be listed before state, county or local offices.

short_summary: Provides for the humane removal of downed animals
summary: Provides for the humane treatment and removal of downed animals.

short_summary: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages
summary: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages and of limited English proficiency.

short_summary: Relates to the age requirement for voting in a primary election
summary: Allows a U.S. citizen, who is seventeen years of age, to vote in a primary election, including presidential, if he or she will turn eighteen by the date of the corresponding general election.

short_summary: Relates to reregulating units that were illegally deregulated from rent control or rent stabilization
summary: Reregulates units that were illegally deregulated from rent control or rent stabilization.

short_summary: Establishes a one year moratorium on actions to foreclose a mortgage
summary: Establishes a one year moratorium on actions to foreclose a mortgage.

short_summary: Requires the board of regents to provide a live webcast of their meetings
summary: Requires that each meeting of the Board of Regents be streamed live and be made available to the public.

short_summary: Makes provisions with respect to the manner of selecting judges and justices of the unified court system; repealer
summary: Establishes a system of merit selection of judges of the state's major trial courts instead of elections and for the designation of certain justices of the supreme court; affects certain courts including the supreme court, surrogate's court, the New York city civil court, the New York city criminal court and the district court.

short_summary: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on policy-based exclusions
summary: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on policy-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each health care facility a list of its policy-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

short_summary: Establishes certain persons who have previously provided a DNA sample shall not be required to pay a DNA databank fee for his or her conviction for certain offenses
summary: Establishes that no person who has previously provided a DNA sample shall be required to pay a DNA databank fee for his or her conviction for a subsequent designated offense unless such sample has been expunged.

short_summary: Establishes a program and a fund to assist public service attorneys practicing public service law to repay their student loans
summary: Establishes the "public interest legal services loan assistance fund" of the state of New York (to consist of a portion of bar examination fees and other funds appropriated by the legislature therefor and such other monies as may be credited or otherwise transferred from any other fund or source pursuant to law, including voluntary contributions); provides for administration of such fund to assist public service attorneys practicing public interest law in repaying their student loans; defines certain terms and adds other related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to party committee and constituted committee contribution and receipt limits; repealer
summary: Relates to party committee and constituted committee contribution and receipt limits; reduce the annual contribution limits to political parties or constituted committees from $62,500 to $25,000, which shall include contributions to party housekeeping accounts.

short_summary: Requires employers of retail, food service or cleaning employees to give such employees 7 day notice of their work schedule and a months notice of the minimum hours of work
summary: Requires employers of retail, food service or cleaning employees to give such employees 7 days' notice of their work schedule and a month's notice of the minimum hours of work; provides a private right of action to employees who are aggrieved by certain violations of such provisions.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening for ovarian and prostate cancers
summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening and FDA approved biomarker testing for ovarian and prostate cancers.

short_summary: Requires the termination of any police officer or peace officer who uses physical force which is not justifiable or which is not part of procedure
summary: Requires the termination of any police officer or peace officer who uses physical force which is not justifiable or which is not part of procedure regardless of if harm is done any person or if any complaint is filed against such police officer or peace officer.

short_summary: Grants the attorney general jurisdiction to investigate and prosecute police misconduct
summary: Authorizes the attorney general to investigate and prosecute the alleged commission of any criminal offense or offenses committed by police officers in connection with the performance of their regular duties.

short_summary: Relates to renaming the Queens Midtown tunnel the Jane Matilda Bolin tunnel
summary: Relates to renaming the Queens Midtown tunnel the Jane Matilda Bolin tunnel.

short_summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor
summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor.

short_summary: Requires a criminal court to release a defendant charged with certain offenses involving marihuana on his or her own recognizance upon ordering a case adjourned in contemplation of dismissal
summary: Requires a criminal court to release a defendant charged with certain offenses involving marihuana on his or her own recognizance upon ordering a case adjourned in contemplation of dismissal.

short_summary: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment
summary: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority, and its subsidiary corporations, who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment.

short_summary: Creates the office of the cooperative and condominium ombudsman and authorizes the residential unit fee
summary: Creates the office of the cooperative and condominium ombudsman; authorizes the residential unit tax and establishes the office of the cooperative and condominium ombudsman fund.

short_summary: Requires landlords to furnish each tenant either renewing or entering into a lease with a document describing the rights and duties of landlords and tenants
summary: Requires landlords to furnish each tenant either renewing or entering into a lease with a rider describing the rights and duties of landlords and tenants;  requires the rider to conform to the intent of section 5-702 of the general obligations law.

short_summary: Relates to disputes between a surrogate and a hospital or individual health care provider
summary: Relates to disputes between a surrogate and a hospital or individual health care provider; cites when the requirement of a provider to provide life-sustaining treatment following a surrogate's directive does not apply.

short_summary: Relates to the assault of physicians providing direct patient care
summary: Relates to the assault of physicians providing direct patient care; provides that assault of physicians shall be assault in the second degree, a class D felony.

short_summary: Relates to eligibility of community colleges for state aid
summary: Requires that community colleges provide educational opportunity programs to eligible students in order to qualify for state aid for capital and operating expenditures.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a training program for first responders for responding to victims of suspected drug overdose and the administration of opioid antagonists
summary: Establishes a training program for first responders for responding to victims of suspected drug overdose and the administration of opioid antagonists.
