summary: Provides grants to address food insecurity among students at public institutions for higher education.

short_summary: Requires a doctor to obtain the informed consent of patients prior to prescribing psychiatric drugs notifying the patient of possible adverse effects of the drug
summary: Requires a doctor to obtain the informed consent of patients prior to prescribing psychiatric drugs notifying the patients of possible adverse effects of the drug.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the Educational Rights Transparency for New York Families Act
summary: Enacts the Educational Rights Transparency for New York Families Act, to establish standards for resource based educational rights of students within the state and implement a system of self-assessment and reporting by schools and school districts.

short_summary: Creates and defines the new crime of aggressive driving as a class E felony; establishes minimum one year sentence when court imposes alternative definite sentence
summary: Creates and defines the new crime of aggressive driving as a class E felony; establishes minimum one year sentence when court imposes alternative definite sentence.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to provide certain services on Fishers Island for a limited period of time
summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to provide certain services on Fishers Island for a limited period of time.

short_summary: Enacts the young adult voter registration act
summary: Enacts the young adult voter registration act; requires each public high school within the state to make voter registration forms available to all students.

short_summary: Requires car registration forms to display the label "qualified hybrid vehicle" and the estimated MPG of such vehicle as calculated by the EPA
summary: Requires applicants for registration of hybrid vehicles to submit proof of the make, model and model year of the motor vehicle for which registration is being applied, to the commissioner; establishes that after such proof is submitted, certificates of registration shall display the markings "qualified hybrid vehicle" and such vehicle's US EPA highway fuel economy rating of 45 mpg or more.

short_summary: Establishes a green new deal for New York task force
summary: Establishes a Green New Deal for New York task force; requires such task force to develop a detailed statewide, industrial, economic mobilization plan for the transition of the New York economy to become greenhouse gas emissions neutral by 2030 and to significantly draw down greenhouse gases from the atmosphere and oceans and to promote economic and environmental justice and equality.

short_summary: Allows commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street
summary: Allows commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500
summary: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500; must be in good standing for a minimum of five years and maintain continued eligibility.

short_summary: Establishes energy efficiency measures by the public service commission and NYSERDA
summary: Establishes energy efficiency measures by the public service commission and NYSERDA including requiring utilities to hire and train employees who are from priority populations or living in areas designated as environmental justice communities.

short_summary: Permits pregnant women to enroll in health insurance during a special enrollment period without penalty
summary: Permits pregnant women to enroll in the state health insurance exchange at any time without penalty.

short_summary: Directs the public service commission to modify the objectives of the Clean Energy Fund to include reductions of local combustion-related air pollutants
summary: Directs the Public Service Commission to modify the objectives of the Clean Energy Fund to include reductions of local combustion-related air pollutants.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year
summary: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers at 501(c)(3) organizations or organizations affiliated with NY Cares or NY Service who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year.

short_summary: Prohibits the release of certain records of victims of police violence by a police agency, prosecutorial agency or other law enforcement agency
summary: Prohibits the release of criminal history or any mental health history records by a police agency, prosecutorial agency or other law enforcement agency of individuals who were the subject of the use of force by a police or peace officer.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of class two bicycles with electric assist
summary: Specifies that class two bicycles with electric assist shall be those for which the electric motor cannot provide assistance when such bicycles reach a speed of twenty-eight miles per hour.

short_summary: Establishes the Syd O. Sotillo Sickle Cell Treatment Act
summary: Establishes the "Syd O. Sotillo Sickle Cell Treatment Act" which designates sickle cell centers for excellence and outpatient treatment centers.

short_summary: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced
summary: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced.

short_summary: Requires notification to insureds that an out-of-network physician may be used in their procedure, test or surgery
summary: Requires notification to insureds that an out-of-network physician may be used in their procedure, test or surgery and such physician's services shall not be covered by their insurance policy; such services must be covered if the insured person does not receive notification prior to such services or procedure.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study quantum computing
summary: Establishes a task force to study the creation of a quantum computing project to make recommendations on how to utilize quantum computing for the purposes of developing computers for civilian, business, trade, environmental and security purposes, such as cryptanalysis, in this state.

short_summary: Establishes the "Malcolm X unsolved civil rights crime act of 2023"
summary: Establishes the "Malcom X unsolved civil rights crime act"; requires the assistant attorney of the civil rights bureau to investigate violations of criminal civil rights statutes that occurred not later than December thirty-first, nineteen seventy-nine, and resulted in a death.

short_summary: Prohibits use of safety strobe light to change a traffic signal
summary: Prohibits use of a safety strobe light to change a traffic signal by an unauthorized person.

short_summary: Establishes the reasonable charge for electronic copies of medical records and patient information
summary: Establishes the reasonable charge for electronic copies of medical records and patient information.

short_summary: Relates to increasing credits against taxes imposed on the transfer of the New York estate by every deceased individual who at his or her death was a resident of New York state
summary: Increases credits against taxes imposed on the transfer of the New York estate by every deceased individual who at his or her death was a resident of New York state by setting the basic exclusion amount to $11,200,000.

short_summary: Relates to the confidentiality of the identity of undercover officers
summary: Relates to the confidentiality of the identity of undercover officers.

short_summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to conduct a study documenting the fiscal implications of repealing section 2 of chapter 851 of the laws of 1948
summary: Authorizes and directs the department of taxation and finance to conduct a study documenting the fiscal implications on towns in Nassau county if section 2 of chapter 851 of the laws of 1948 were repealed.

short_summary: Relates to allowing for three forty-five day extensions of necessary and available emergency shelter for victims of domestic violence
summary: Allows for three forty-five day extensions of necessary and available emergency shelter for victims of domestic violence instead of the current two forty-five day extensions.

short_summary: Requires sellers to clearly post the price of a credit card surcharge
summary: Requires sellers to clearly post the credit card price inclusive of any surcharge at the location a sale occurs; does not prohibit merchants from offering a two-tier pricing system; establishes civil penalty not to exceed $500 for each violation.

short_summary: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to engage in cooperative purchasing and authorizes intergovernmental agreements
summary: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to engage in cooperative purchasing; authorizes intergovernmental agreements between public agencies.

short_summary: Creates the teacher training initiative fund for autism; appropriation
summary: Creates the teacher training initiative fund for autism; appropriates funds therefor.

short_summary: Establishes a commission to study and report on the potential implementation of legislation, rules and regulations for an open internet for New Yorkers
summary: Establishes a commission to study and report on the potential implementation of legislation, rules and regulations for an open internet for New Yorkers.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study the potential designation of economic empowerment zones in the state of New York
summary: Establishes a task force to study the potential designation of economic empowerment zones for the mining of cryptocurrencies in the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to a state transportation plan
summary: Relates to a state transportation plan; requires such plan include a minimum twenty-year forecast period at the time of adoption, assessing long-range needs spanning such period, including a forecast of highway pavement and bridge conditions.

short_summary: Permits a potential lottery winner who lost their ticket to claim the winning amount
summary: Permits a potential lottery winner who lost their ticket to claim the winning amount provided that such person shows the lottery agency documentary proof of purchase of the winning ticket within one year of the winning date.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study how to incentivize individuals in the state of New York to become pilots
summary: Establishes a task force to study how to incentivize individuals in the state of New York to become pilots; looks at retirement trends, the effect of high-stress scheduling, and the cost among other things.

short_summary: Authorizes special access to hunting and fishing grounds on state land for handicapped individuals
summary: Authorizes special access to hunting and fishing grounds on state land for handicapped individuals.

short_summary: Authorizes issuance of distinctive number plates to members of the Seneca Nation of Indians
summary: Authorizes issuance of distinctive number plates to members of the Seneca Nation of Indians.

short_summary: Requires mortgage investing institutions or their contracted vendors to be financially responsible for any interest or penalties charged as a result of an erroneous mortgage registration
summary: Requires mortgage investing institutions or their contracted vendors to be financially responsible for any interest or penalties charged as a result of an erroneous mortgage registration filed by such institution or vendor.

short_summary: Increases the age at which a person is considered a child for the purposes of sexual performances by a child
summary: Increases from 16 to 18 years the age at which a sexual performance by a child becomes a crime on the part of anyone using, employing, authorizing, producing, directing or promoting any such sexual performance.

short_summary: Expands juvenile offender status to include certain sex offenses committed by persons 13, 14 or 15 years of age
summary: Expands juvenile offender status to include rape in the first degree, criminal sexual act in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the second degree and aggravated sexual abuse in the third degree if committed by persons thirteen, fourteen or fifteen years of age.

short_summary: Requires cooperative housing corporations provide a prospective purchaser with a written statement of reasons when withholding consent to a purchase
summary: Requires cooperative housing corporations provide a prospective purchaser with a written statement of reasons when withholding consent to a purchase; voids any agreement inconsistent with such requirement.

short_summary: Grants sales and use tax exemption for transportation of used goods to be recycled, reused or remanufactured
summary: Establishes a sales and compensating use tax exemption for the receipts from the provision of transportation of used goods that are going to be recycled, reused or remanufactured.

short_summary: Eases the vehicle registration process for the agricultural industry by extending the length of seasonal permits
summary: Allows the department of transportation to issue seasonal agricultural permits for oversize vehicles.

short_summary: Creates the crime of reckless endangerment of the public health for recklessly transmitting HIV/AIDS
summary: Creates crimes of reckless endangerment of public health with respect to HIV/AIDS transmission; creates crime of filing false instrument with respect to HIV/AIDS; provides for HIV/AIDS testing for alleged sex offenders and public health offenders; provides for contagious disease testing for persons in the custody of the department of corrections; provides that if an incarcerated individual tests positive notice shall be given to all employees that will have contact with such incarcerated individual.

short_summary: Excludes deer management professionals retained by the incorporated village of Lloyd Harbor, or the incorporated village of Upper Brookville from the hunting rifle ban on Long Island
summary: Excludes deer management professionals retained by the incorporated village of Lloyd Harbor, or the incorporated village of Upper Brookville from the hunting rifle ban on Long Island.

short_summary: Prohibits certain children from riding on a motorcycle
summary: Prohibits children under the age of twelve from riding on a motorcycle.

short_summary: Requires the secretary of state to email a copy of all new laws passed to representatives of local governments
summary: Requires the secretary of state to email a copy of all new laws passed to representatives of local governments.

short_summary: Requires gas corporations to file a plan addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory
summary: Requires gas corporations to file a plan with the public service commission addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory; outlines plans for the replacement of such pipelines.

short_summary: Requires public notice and a period for public comment prior to the designation of an access highway
summary: Requires public notice and a ninety-day period for public comment prior to the designation of an access highway by the department of transportation.

short_summary: Provides that no issuer of a credit card shall send unsolicited, blank checks to a card member residing in New York state
summary: Provides that no issuer of a credit card shall send unsolicited, blank checks to a credit card member residing in New York state.

short_summary: Relates to the management of retirement loans
summary: Relates to the management of retirement loans.

short_summary: Authorizes on-site inspections of housing in violation of zoning laws for purposes of enforcing illegal housing laws and regulations
summary: Authorizes on-site inspections of housing in violation of zoning laws for purposes of enforcing illegal housing laws and regulations.

short_summary: Requires public bodies to ensure that proceedings of meetings are audible for individuals in person and via broadcast
summary: Requires public bodies to make reasonable efforts to ensure that proceedings of meetings are audible for individuals in person and via broadcast and to provide audio visual equipment as necessary.

short_summary: Declares October first, China Day, a public holiday
summary: Declares October first, China Day, a public holiday.

short_summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Old Westbury
summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Old Westbury in up to nine school speed zones.

short_summary: Requires public bodies to post video recordings of open meetings
summary: Requires public bodies to post video recordings of open meetings on their websites within five days of such meetings; requires such recordings be maintained for a period of five years.

short_summary: Creates the uniform trade secrets act
summary: Relates to creating the uniform trade secrets act.

short_summary: Provides for protections regarding consumer litigation funding
summary: Establishes that consumer litigation funding transactions should be subject to state regulation and sets forth requirements regarding disclosure, licensing, funding company and attorney responsibilities and limitations, violations and other provisions.

short_summary: Establishes the Charles L. Reason fellowship
summary: Establishes the Charles L. Reason fellowship for the purpose of increasing faculty diversity in higher education.

short_summary: Enacts the "emission tampering act"
summary: Prohibits the disabling, removal or interference with emission control devices and the use of emission tampering devices; provides remedies for the violation of such provisions.

short_summary: Designates Kwanzaa as a public holiday
summary: Designates Kwanzaa as a public holiday in New York.

short_summary: Requires nebulizers on school grounds; appropriation
summary: Requires nebulizers on school grounds; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of coercive control
summary: Relates to establishing the crime of coercive control; provides that a person is guilty of coercive control when he or she engages in a course of conduct against a member of his or her same family or household, without the victim's consent, which results in limiting or restricting, in full or in part, the victim's behavior, movement, associations or access to or use of his or her own finances or financial information; and provides that coercive control is a class E felony.

short_summary: Permits certain funeral service vehicles and other vehicles to use high occupancy vehicle lanes
summary: Permits certain funeral service vehicles and other vehicles to use high occupancy vehicle lanes.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the definition of a sex offense
summary: Relates to expanding the definition of a sex offense.

short_summary: Directs the department of economic development to study methods for keeping small retail businesses within the state and creates pilot program; appropriation
summary: Directs the department of economic development to study methods for keeping small retail businesses within the state and create a pilot program to train and counsel small business owners and potential small business owners; appropriates $210,000 therefor.

short_summary: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment
summary: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment.

short_summary: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts
summary: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts.

short_summary: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation
summary: Relates to subjecting certain state lands to real property taxation.

short_summary: Relates to the department of transportation not requiring surveying in certain situations
summary: Provides that the department of transportation shall not require a survey as part of an agreement with any fiber optic utility for use and occupancy of a state right of way for the purposes of installing, modifying, relocating, repairing, operating, or maintaining fiber optic facilities as part of the department's consolidated application, when such use and occupancy of the state right of way is utilizing existing infrastructure, including but not limited to aerial pole attachments and underground conduits.

short_summary: Establishes a tipped employee minimum wage tax credit
summary: Establishes a tipped employee minimum wage tax credit; provides the amount of the credit shall be equal to the tip allowance for miscellaneous industry workers.

short_summary: Requires insurers to display certain underwriting information on the declarations page to their homeowners and dwelling fire personal lines policies
summary: Requires insurers to display certain underwriting information on the declarations page to their homeowners and dwelling fire personal lines policies.

short_summary: Relates to Eastchester fire district elections
summary: Relates to Eastchester fire district elections; follows provisions of election law instead of town law for elections.

short_summary: Provides for the licensing of pet grooming facilities; establishes standards of care and required record keeping
summary: Provides for the licensing of pet grooming facilities; establishes standards of care and required record keeping.

short_summary: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for a portion of the consideration paid under a contract with a minority or women-owned business
summary: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for a portion of the consideration paid under a contract with a minority or women-owned business.

short_summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study on the formation and control of a state public bank
summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study to evaluate and make recommendations concerning the formation and control of a state public bank; provides if such study finds that the state bank is feasible, the commission may recommend legislation to create a state public bank for New York.

short_summary: Relates to minority and women-owned business enterprises in relation to state contracts
summary: Relates to minority-owned and women-owned business enterprises in relation to state contracts.

short_summary: Relates to motions for resentencing by the people
summary: Allows for motions for resentencing by the people for certain sentences.

short_summary: Relates to paratransit services
summary: Relates to paratransit services; directs that an applicant for recertification submit correspondence from a licensed physician in lieu of an in-person assessment.

short_summary: Requires victims be notified of right to make a victim impact statement and allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement
summary: Requires the district attorney to notify victims by letter of the final disposition of the case within sixty days of such disposition in cases where such final disposition includes a conviction; provides such letter shall also notify victims of their right to make a victim impact statement; allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement.

short_summary: Authorizes the Congregation Beis Medrash of Lawrence to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Congregation Beis Medrash of Lawrence to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information
summary: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information.

short_summary: Prevents unfounded complaints against police officers, peace officers, firefighters, correction officers, and emergency medical service providers from being disclosed or added to personnel records
summary: Prevents unfounded complaints against police officers, peace officers, firefighters, correction officers and emergency medical service providers from being disclosed or added to such police officer, peace officer, firefighter, correction officer or emergency medical service provider's personnel record.

short_summary: Offers installment payment plans as an option for persons with violations of toll collection regulations
summary: Offers installment payment plans as an option for persons with violations of toll collection regulations before having their registration suspended.

short_summary: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease
summary: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease.

short_summary: Relates to an elder court pilot program
summary: Creates an elder court pilot program to study the effectiveness of senior-specific judicial programming especially involving elder abuse and domestic violence.

short_summary: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales call using an automatic dialing-announcing device
summary: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls using an automatic dialing-announcing device to any person in the state during a declared state of emergency or disaster emergency.

short_summary: Provides for dispensing emergency contraception under certain conditions
summary: Provides for dispensing emergency contraception under certain conditions; defines emergency contraception.

short_summary: Requires each certificate of death to also be filed with the board of elections for the county in which the registrar is appointed
summary: Requires each certificate of death to also be filed with the board of elections for the county in which the registrar is appointed and to mail a copy of the death certificate to the department of health and the board of elections in the county in which the person resided at the time of death.

short_summary: Requires hospitals and residential health care facilities to have a three-month supply of personal protective equipment in stock on the premises
summary: Requires hospitals and residential health care facilities to have a three-month supply of personal protective equipment in stock on the premises; requires the department of health to conduct an annual audit of the availability of such personal protective equipment in hospitals and residential health care facilities.

short_summary: Enacts the "donor conceived person protection act"
summary: Enacts the "donor-conceived person protection act" to ensure that reproductive tissue banks, licensed by the department of health, collect and verify medical information from any donor it procures reproductive tissue from and to disseminate such information to a recipient before a recipient purchases or otherwise receives such tissue, and to donor-conceived persons, if any, when such persons turn eighteen years of age or earlier upon consent of the recipient parent or guardian; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for the declination of a designation as a candidate or nomination for a party position under special circumstance
summary: Provides for the declination of a designation as a candidate or nomination for a party position if the person designated or nominated has received a diagnosis of a serious health condition or has resigned the office for which they are nominated or designated to run for re-election.

short_summary: Provides for the applicability of provisions governing referral of certain municipal planning and zoning actions to counties operating under a county charter
summary: Provides for the applicability of provisions governing referral of certain municipal planning and zoning actions to county planning agencies or regional planning councils to all counties, including counties operating under a county charter, except counties wholly contained within a city.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish demonstration projects providing for equity investment in the operation of residential health care facilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish demonstration projects providing for equity investment in the operation of residential health care facilities.

short_summary: Authorizes citizens who are sixteen years of age to vote in school district elections; repealer
summary: Extends the right to vote in school district elections to qualified persons who are sixteen years of age.

short_summary: Relates to state agency contracts with not-for-profit corporations
summary: Defines noncompliant state agency; provides for timelines and procedures for state agency contracts involving not-for-profit corporations.

short_summary: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies
summary: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies which shall include the limits of insurance, the term of the policy, the amount of  premium and the amount of deductibles and a statement.

short_summary: Creates a task force to study and assess the condition of African American men in New York
summary: Establishes a task force to study and assess the condition of African American men in New York; provides such task force shall consist of 17 members and report its findings no later than December 31, 2024.

short_summary: Relates to asset forfeiture
summary: Relates to asset forfeiture.

short_summary: Establishes a Center for Transplantation and Immunology Research at the University at Buffalo and Erie County Medical Center; appropriation
summary: Establishes a Center for Transplantation and Immunology Research at the University at Buffalo and Erie County Medical Center; provides the mission of the Center for Transportation and Immunology Research is to advance the longevity of kidney organ transplants through improved knowledge of immunology, pathology and therapeutics; grants authorization to apply for grants; makes an appropriation of $227,333.34 each year for three years.

short_summary: Requires the board of education in the city of Buffalo to submit the school district budget to the voters for approval prior to adoption
summary: Requires the board of education in the city of Buffalo to submit the school district budget to the voters for approval prior to adoption.

short_summary: Includes correctional facilities and local correctional facilities as publicly-assisted housing accommodations for purposes of the division of human rights
summary: Includes correctional facilities and local correctional facilities as publicly-assisted housing accommodations for purposes of the division of human rights; defines correctional facilities and local correctional facilities.

short_summary: Enacts the "Affordable NY act"
summary: Enacts the "Affordable NY act"; increases the STAR exemptions; adjusts personal income tax rates.

short_summary: Relates to repair reserve funds for municipal corporations, school districts, board of cooperative educational services, district corporations and improvement districts
summary: Relates to repair reserve funds for municipal corporations, school districts, boards of cooperative educational services, district corporations and improvement districts.

short_summary: Prohibits the percentage of disbursements from the state lottery fund that goes towards education aid from falling below 45.15%
summary: Prohibits the percentage of disbursements from the state lottery fund that goes towards education aid from falling below 45.15 percent.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting forensic evaluations in a custody or visitation proceeding; repealer
summary: Prohibits courts from ordering an evaluation of a party or child or allowing into evidence a forensic report created by a forensic evaluator on a party or child to assist such court in a child custody or visitation determination.

short_summary: Relates to school aid computer listings for school districts
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to produce a school aid computer listing based on updated current law where there is no school aid computer listing produced by the commissioner in support of an executive budget request.

short_summary: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative
summary: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative at the same pay rate and amount of time as paid family leave.

short_summary: Authorizes the Bais Tefila of Inwood to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Bais Tefila of Inwood to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use taxes for gift certificates, electronic gift cards and magnetic gift cards
summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use taxes for gift certificates, electronic gift cards and magnetic gift cards.

short_summary: Requires the governor and senior state officers to appear before the legislature
summary: Requires the governor and senior state officers to appear before the legislature as requested by the legislature to publicly explain actions and answer questions.

short_summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from the East Islip Fire District
summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from the East Islip Fire District with respect to a portion of the 2021-2022 assessment roll and the entire 2022-2023 assessment roll.

short_summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to transfer funds of the Kismet street improvement district to a special fund for the collection and removal of trash from the hamlet of Kismet
summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to transfer funds from the Kismet street improvement district to a special fund for the collection and removal of trash from the hamlet of Kismet upon approval of such town board.

short_summary: Provides real property tax relief to certain veterans
summary: Provides real property tax relief to veterans who have at least ten years of service in the U.S. armed forces or in the organized militia of the state of New York.

short_summary: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations
summary: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations.

short_summary: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance
summary: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance.

short_summary: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees
summary: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of health to designate HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 communicable diseases; and relates to the HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 viruses
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of health to designate HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 communicable diseases; requires reporting of HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 cases to the department of health; creates educational materials about the virus.

short_summary: Increases the penalty for certain traffic violations when such violations arise out of the same incident as a conviction for failure to move over and when such violations occurred in a work zone
summary: Doubles the penalties for use of mobile telephones and use of portable electronic devices when such violations arise out of the same incident as a conviction for failure to move over and when such violations occurred in a work zone.

short_summary: Creates a day care assistance program for members of the organized militia serving active duty; appropriation
summary: Creates a day care assistance program for members of the organized militia serving federal active duty outside the United States; appropriates $500,000 therefor.

short_summary: Establishes a retired employee health insurance premium reserve fund for the town of Saranac
summary: Establishes a retired employee health insurance premium reserve fund for the town of Saranac to cover retired town employee health insurance premiums, to stabilize the tax rate, and to ensure transparency for the taxpayers and elected officials.

short_summary: Relates to the operation of vehicles on approach of vehicles displaying a blue light
summary: Relates to the operation of vehicles on approach of vehicles displaying a blue light; requires vehicles to pull over on approach of vehicles displaying a blue light.

short_summary: Authorizes a program for electronic filing for commencement of civil actions and proceedings and service of papers in town and village courts
summary: Authorizes the chief administrator of the courts to promulgate rules authorizing an electronic filing program for commencement of civil actions and proceedings and filing and service of papers in town and village courts.

short_summary: Provides for the appeal of disputes between shareholders and boards of directors of residential cooperative corporations to a hearing officer appointed by the attorney general
summary: Provides for the appeal of disputes between shareholders and boards of directors of residential cooperatives to a hearing officer appointed by the attorney general.

short_summary: Relates to raising the income cap for senior citizens applying for the enhanced STAR property tax exemption
summary: Relates to raising the income cap for senior citizens applying for the enhanced STAR property tax exemption to $120,000.

short_summary: Requires the state athletic commission to promulgate regulations for authorized combined professional and amateur mixed martial arts events
summary: Requires the state athletic commission to promulgate regulations for authorized combined professional and amateur mixed martial arts events no later than June 30, 2023.

short_summary: Enacts the college textbook affordability act
summary: Enacts the college textbook affordability act; establishes the New York state open education resources council and the New York state open source digital library; authorizes SUNY campuses and community colleges to adopt open educational resources adoption incentive program campus plans and apply for grants to implement such plans; provides that settlements with the office of the attorney general shall be used to provide assistance to the state university of New York for the purposes of carrying out the provisions of this act.

short_summary: Requires certain data in reports by the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance "for the COVID-19 Emergency Rental Assistance Program of 2021"
summary: Requires certain data in reports by the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance for the "COVID-19 Emergency Rental Assistance Program of 2021"; requires the inclusion of the breakdown of applications for each zip code including the total number of approved applications; the total number of denied applications; the total number of incomplete applications; and the total number of applications that are awaiting processing or are pending in such report; provides for application information that may be tracked.

short_summary: Protects the identity of witnesses of hate crimes in discovery proceedings
summary: Protects the identity of witnesses of hate crimes in discovery proceedings by requiring identifying information to be redacted, unless the court rules otherwise for good cause shown.

short_summary: Creates stricter fines and criminal penalties for passing a stopped school bus
summary: Increases fines and penalties for passing a stopped school bus.

short_summary: Relates to wireless communications equipment insurance
summary: Relates to wireless communications equipment insurance for wireless communications equipment vendors; describes prerequisites for issuance of a limited license for wireless communications equipment vendors.

short_summary: Establishes the crimes of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees
summary: Establishes the offenses of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees.

short_summary: Establishes the paired testing program, compliance fee and a paired testing program fund
summary: Establishes the paired testing program and compliance fee to determine if any real estate broker, real estate salesperson or employee or agent thereof is using unlawful discriminatory practices; creates the paired testing program fund.

short_summary: Relates to immunity from civil liability for emergency removal of a child from a motor vehicle
summary: Relates to immunity from civil liability for emergency removal of a child from a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance
summary: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance.

short_summary: Establishes a no fare program for emergency responders on September 11th
summary: Establishes a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for emergency responders on September 11th.

short_summary: Relates to reporting requirements of any examination or inquiry prepared with respect to any death or serious injury occurring to a child caused by a children's product or a durable juvenile product
summary: Requires every general hospital to report within seven days to the US consumer product safety commission with any report of any examination or inquiry prepared with respect to any death or serious injury occurring to a child determined to be caused by either a children's product or a durable juvenile product.

short_summary: Provides residency requirements for sex offenders
summary: Provides residency requirements for sex offenders including criminal sanctions for violations; prohibits sex offenders from residing in a residence that is within one thousand five hundred feet of any school grounds.

short_summary: Relates to building aid for approved expenditures for debt service for tax certiorari financing
summary: Relates to building aid for approved expenditures for debt service for tax certiorari financing.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for certain residential parking permit systems
summary: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for certain residential parking permit systems in certain neighborhoods, including but not limited to, Washington Heights, Harlem, Morningside Heights, Upper West Side, East Harlem, and Upper East Side.

short_summary: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses
summary: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses provided that they can furnish proof of proper layout, adequate equipment for the shop, sanitary conditions in the shop and good moral character.

short_summary: Requires that certain motor vehicles shall be equipped with operable carbon monoxide detectors
summary: Requires that for hire vehicles with a chassis which was manufactured and then altered for the purpose of transporting ten or more occupants, including the driver, be equipped with an operable carbon monoxide detector.

short_summary: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature
summary: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature on their websites.

short_summary: Prohibits executive sessions for the appointment of elected office
summary: Prohibits public bodies from conducting an executive session where the subject to be considered relates to the appointment of an elected member or officer to fill a vacancy in an elected office of such public body, including interviews of prospective appointees and related discussions.

short_summary: Relates to annual reporting requirements for farmers markets
summary: Relates to annual reporting requirements for farmers markets.

short_summary: Relates to civil remedies for harm or damage to property of another due to a belief or perception relating to a person's immigration status
summary: Provides a civil remedy for any harm or damage to the property or person of another or for summoning a police officer without reason to suspect a crime has been or is about to be committed due to a belief or perception regarding such person's immigration status.

short_summary: Relates to the business income rate and expanding the small business subtraction modification
summary: Relates to the business income rate and expanding the small business subtraction modification.

short_summary: Establishes the office of Native American affairs
summary: Establishes the office of Native American affairs to act as a centralized office for Native American nations to access information on state programs that are provided to Native Americans.

short_summary: Classifies military monuments and memorials as parkland
summary: Classifies military monuments and memorials as parkland; provides military monuments or memorials erected or constructed on property of a municipal corporation shall require authorization by an act of the legislature prior to any change in status including alienation, development, leasing, transfer, sale or discontinuance.

short_summary: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients
summary: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients.

short_summary: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products
summary: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include purpose-bred animals raised for research, service animals, working dogs or any working animals in service on a farm.

short_summary: Authorizes the fingerprinting of employees of informal child care providers
summary: Authorizes the fingerprinting of employees of informal child care providers; defines terms; provides that an informal child care provider means a program in a facility, other than a residence, in which child care is provided on a regular basis and is not required to be licensed by or registered with the office or licensed by the city of New York.

short_summary: Establishes the statewide kinship navigator program
summary: Establishes the statewide kinship navigator program for kinship caregivers.

short_summary: Relates to a study of the number of children in foster care who have a developmental disability
summary: Relates to a study of the number of children in foster care who have a developmental disability; provides such study shall include, but shall not be limited to, the following: assessing the demographics of the children in foster care with a developmental disability, including, but not limited to, their county of residence, age, race and gender identity, and determining whether the placement of such individuals in foster care was voluntary or court ordered; evaluating the current guidelines and regulations used to oversee the placement and treatment of children with a developmental disability; and analyzing the extent to which such age-appropriate children are prepared for a transition from foster care to an independent living situation.

short_summary: Permits sale of certain food items in liquor stores; repeals certain provisions relating to the ownership of more than one liquor license
summary: Permits the sale of certain food items in liquor stores; repeals certain provisions relating to the ownership of more than one liquor license.

short_summary: Establishes staffing standards for physical therapists and therapist assistants, occupational therapists and therapy assistants, respiratory therapists and therapy technicians and recreational therapists
summary: Includes physical therapists, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, occupational therapy assistants, respiratory therapists, respiratory therapy technicians, and recreational therapists within the existing statutory staffing standards for nursing homes.

short_summary: Establishes the child and family well-being program and fund
summary: Establishes the child and family well-being program and fund for the distribution of grants to eligible nonprofit community-based providers to respond to children's and families' needs in communities.

short_summary: Relates to granting academic credit at city or state operated institutions to veterans
summary: Allows the granting of academic credit at state or city operated institutions to veterans.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York
summary: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York.

short_summary: Establishes an exemption for reservists
summary: Establishes an exemption for members of the federal reserve force of the United States military, whether or not such member was ordered to active duty.

short_summary: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act of 2023
summary: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act; provides a tax credit to homeowners who remove cock loft fire hazards in their homes; provides an insurance discount for the installation of smoke detecting alarm devices in cock lofts; provides that the repair of cock lofts for the purpose of fire prevention and safety shall be qualifying expenditures under state housing programs.

short_summary: Requires certain for-hire vehicles to install and maintain an interior rear-facing video camera
summary: Requires certain for-hire vehicles to install and maintain an interior rear-facing video camera.

short_summary: Increases the state reimbursement rate for preventative child protective services
summary: Increases the state reimbursement rate for preventative child protective services from 65 to 75 percent.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay
summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay; prohibits the filling in of borrow pits with sediment or fill materials.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing a personal income tax deduction for tolls, fees and other related commuting expenses paid by a taxpayer in the course of commuting to and from his or her place of employment
summary: Relates to authorizing a personal income tax deduction for tolls, fees and other related commuting expenses paid by a taxpayer in the course of commuting to and from his or her place of employment.

short_summary: Relates to the manufacturing of portable electronic devices
summary: Requires portable electronic devices manufactured for sale in the state to be equipped with an ATSC 3.0 chip.

short_summary: Repeals section 3403 of the insurance law relating to anti-arson applications
summary: Repeals provisions relating to mandatory anti-arson applications for insurance coverage to insure any building against the peril of fire or explosion.

short_summary: Relates to special districts for ambulance services and to volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing
summary: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services; requires a report on issues of volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing.

short_summary: Classifies emergency medical services as essential services for the purposes of state aid
summary: Classifies emergency medical services as essential services for the purposes of state aid.

short_summary: Establishes state procurement goals for New York state products throughout state agencies and private entities performing state contracts
summary: Establishes state procurement goals for New York state products throughout state agencies and private entities performing state contracts; provides that every year after enactment, a certain percentage of products purchased by state agencies will be New York state products, with such percentage threshold increasing each year up until five years.

short_summary: Relates to electronic delivery of insurance notices
summary: Allows for certain notices related to property/casualty insurance contracts under the workers' compensation law and the vehicle and traffic law to be delivered by electronic means.

short_summary: Amends the constitution to convey land to Debar Pond Institute Inc. in order to facilitate the preservation of historic buildings
summary: Amends the constitution to convey land to Debar Pond Institute, Inc. in order to facilitate the preservation of historic buildings.

short_summary: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans
summary: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans; provides that such tax credit is worth $3,000 per veteran hired or $4,000 for every disabled veteran hired and the total benefit shall not exceed $15,000 annually.

short_summary: Extends provisions which authorize the town of Islip to lease certain lands to a business corporation
summary: Extends provisions which authorize the town of Islip to lease certain lands to a business corporation.

short_summary: Authorizes United States citizens currently residing outside the United States whose last residence was in NY to vote in certain federal elections
summary: Authorizes United States citizens currently residing outside the United States whose last residence in the United States was in the state of New York to vote in certain federal elections.

short_summary: Relates to the role of the department of corrections and community supervision in planning and facilitating the discharge or release of incarcerated individuals to the community
summary: Relates to the role of the department of corrections and community supervision in planning and facilitating the discharge or release of incarcerated individuals to the community.

short_summary: Enacts the Treyvan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act
summary: Enacts the "Trevyan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act"; directs boards of education to create policies, procedures, and guidelines for at-risk children and young teens who have demonstrated suicidal ideation, been victims of harassment or bullying, and/or who have eloped from school property; establishes a commission to evaluate the safety and security of children in primary and secondary public and private schools in this state.

short_summary: Extends rent stabilization to units occupied by tenants of housing accommodations owned by charitable and non-profit institutions
summary: Provides that certain charitable and non-profit institutions shall not have the right to refuse to renew a lease of any current or future tenant occupying housing accommodations owned by such institution except where specifically authorized by law.

short_summary: Relates to insurance coverage for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome
summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover costs for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome rehabilitation treatment.

short_summary: Creates the New York flood insurance association
summary: Creates the New York flood insurance association which will consist of all insurers authorized to write and engaged in writing within this state, on a direct basis, flood coverage insurance.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay
summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay; directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on ecological restoration needs in Jamaica Bay.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs
summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs.

short_summary: Relates to unclaimed lottery prizes
summary: Requires unclaimed lottery prizes to be paid into the state treasury, to the credit of the state lottery fund.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities and districts to enter into cooperative agreements for the provision of centralized public employee administrative and personnel services
summary: Authorizes municipalities and districts to enter into cooperative agreements for the provision of centralized public employee administrative and personnel services; provides for health insurance coverage of municipal employees pursuant to standardized health insurance contracts; authorizes the provision of reduced premiums for municipal health insurance plans which offer wellness programs.

short_summary: Provides respondents the option to repay a court ordered refund in installments of no more than five years
summary: Provides respondents the option to repay a court ordered refund in installments of no more than five years.

short_summary: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipal
summary: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipality.

short_summary: Relates to tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws
summary: Prohibits tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws.

short_summary: Provides an enforcement mechanism for non-public school educational standards
summary: Provides an enforcement mechanism for non-public school educational standards.

short_summary: Relates to procurement requirements for end point device security
summary: Directs that state agencies require that procurement of personal computing goods, services and solutions meet the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework.

short_summary: Relates to law enforcement agencies reporting sex offender changes of address to the division of criminal justice services
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to report sex offender changes of address within five business days to the division of criminal justice services.

short_summary: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies
summary: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies; includes the department of health, office for people with developmental disabilities and the office of mental health.

short_summary: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals
summary: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals who do not maintain an E-Z Pass account.

short_summary: Requires the disclosure of income and expense statements upon a petition for an article 7 proceeding and imposes staggered dates for submissions of appraisal reports
summary: Requires the disclosure of income and expense statements upon a petition for an article 7 proceeding; imposes staggered dates for submissions of appraisal reports.

short_summary: Establishes an employment of New York national guard and reserve members wage tax credit
summary: Establishes a tax credit for companies that employ New York national guard and reserve members in an amount equal to fifteen hundred dollars for each national guard or reserve member employed by such employer and twenty-five hundred dollars for each national guard or reserve member employed by such employer who has completed or returned from a deployment or activation.

short_summary: Relates to affordable housing for persons with a disability or having attained the age of sixty-two
summary: Relates to affordable housing for persons with a disability or having attained the age of sixty-two; establishes a developmentally disabled and elderly adult accessory apartment loan program.

short_summary: Provides for a mandatory ten-year minimum sentence of imprisonment for certain felony convictions of public servants
summary: Relates to providing for a mandatory ten-year minimum sentence of imprisonment for certain felony convictions of public servants.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit to certain landowners who allow snowmobile access on such land
summary: Provides a tax credit to certain landowners who allow snowmobile access on such land.

short_summary: Establishes the water safety instruction working group
summary: Establishes the water safety instruction working group to study appropriate standards for curriculum on water safety instruction for students in grades kindergarten through twelve in the state.

short_summary: Establishes a parking placard review board
summary: Establishes a parking placard review board to undertake a review of the impact of parking placard use within the city of New York.

short_summary: Exempts the sale of cloth face coverings used to prevent the spread of the novel coronavirus, COVID-19 from sales and use taxes
summary: Exempts the sale of cloth face coverings used to prevent the spread of the novel coronavirus, COVID-19 from sales and use taxes; defines "cloth face coverings" as any material manufactured with the intent of covering the nose and mouth that can be secured to the head or ears with ties or straps.

short_summary: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud
summary: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud; allows patients who have undergone assisted reproduction procedures to bring a cause of action if human reproductive material other than that which was consented to by the patient is used in such procedure; allows for compensatory and punitive damages.

short_summary: Requires teachers employed by the Buffalo school district to reside within Buffalo city limits
summary: Requires teachers employed by the Buffalo school district to reside within Buffalo city limits.

short_summary: Establishes the university at Buffalo institute for African American studies; appropriation
summary: Establishes the university at Buffalo institute for African American studies; appropriates $100,000 therefor.

short_summary: Provides an asbestos remediation tax credit
summary: Provides an asbestos remediation tax credit in Erie county; allows for a fifty percent credit of all eligible costs which are incurred as a result of asbestos remediation, not to exceed $1,000,000.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the use of chemical agents by police officers against minors
summary: Prohibits the use of chemical agents by police officers against minors under the age of eighteen.

short_summary: Relates to the disposition of cremated remains
summary: Permits a funeral director with written consent of a regulated cemetery corporation to provide remains which remain unclaimed after one hundred twenty days to such corporation for disposition.

short_summary: Prohibits the approval of a charter school application when such school would operate within the Buffalo city school district
summary: Prohibits the approval of a charter school application when such school would operate within the Buffalo city school district.

short_summary: Requires municipalities to maintain municipal websites
summary: Requires municipalities to maintain municipal websites.

short_summary: Authorizes life insurers to establish wellness programs
summary: Authorizes life insurers to establish wellness programs in conjunction with the issuance of life insurance policies; provides for full or partial reimbursement for the cost of a device and associated subscription that can be used to track activity or biometric data; provides for discounts on life insurance and on products or services intended to incent positive behavioral changes.

short_summary: Creates other post-employment benefit reserve funds; repealer
summary: Creates other post-employment benefit reserve funds; defines terms.

short_summary: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts and increases filing fees
summary: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts; increases filing fees.

short_summary: Enacts the flood mitigation council act
summary: Establishes the flood mitigation and prevention task force to evaluate ways of protecting communities and residents of the state from flooding.

short_summary: Establishes the definition for legislation
summary: Establishes the definition for legislation; provides that such proposed language shall be presented in a clear and concise manner, be limited to 50 pages and use words that have common everyday meanings.

short_summary: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility
summary: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance
summary: Requires the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance programs by posting on the utility company's website.

short_summary: Allows only citizens to vote at elections
summary: Allows only citizens to vote at elections.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of health to include in annual reports information regarding the cost and increase in cost of certain prescription drugs
summary: Requires the commissioner of health to include in annual reports information regarding the cost and increase in cost of the ten prescription drugs on which the state expends the most money and which have had certain costs increased by fifty percent or more over the past five years or by ten percent or more during  the previous calendar year.

short_summary: Relates to the exemption from inspection for certain meat products
summary: Relates to the exemption from inspection for certain meat products.

short_summary: Relates to creating a tax credit for small businesses which are required to have and maintain marine bulkheads
summary: Creates a tax credit for small businesses which are required to have and maintain marine bulkheads for the full cost of such maintenance during the taxable year.

short_summary: Relates to the caseloads of child protective services workers
summary: Establishes standards for caseloads for child protective services workers; requires the state to pay for one hundred percent of the costs associated with compliance of such caseload standard; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to certain jury awards in employment discrimination actions
summary: Provides that the court shall not reduce jury awards as excessive in employment discrimination actions unless the court finds exceptional circumstances which compel the conclusion that the jury was influenced by partiality, prejudice, mistake or corruption.

short_summary: Makes provisions with respect to notices of homeowners deductibles triggers for hurricane windstorms
summary: Provides that the superintendent of financial services shall establish standards for hurricane windstorm deductibles, creating uniformity in the operation of such deductibles with respect to the triggering event.

short_summary: Allows the granting of academic credit at city or state operated institutions to veterans
summary: Allows the granting of academic credit at state or city operated institutions to veterans.

short_summary: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York
summary: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York; creates an automatic right to have a case reassigned to an attorney judge.

short_summary: Requires insurance coverage for the cost of donated breast milk
summary: Requires insurance coverage for the cost of donated breast milk.

short_summary: Relates to maternal depression screenings
summary: Directs the commissioner of health, in consultation with the office of mental health and other relevant stakeholders, to develop guidance and standards for routine maternal depression screenings, referrals, diagnosis and treatment, and to provide training and materials on issues related to maternal depression.

short_summary: Enacts the frontline worker assistance act
summary: Enacts the "frontline worker assistance act" to establish a one thousand dollar tax credit shall apply to such public employees performing their duties while remaining at their worksite or job location during the pandemic and have not received additional compensation pursuant to a federal, state or local award, grant or retention payment.

short_summary: Relates to allowances for the costs of diapers
summary: Relates to authorizing the payment of costs, up to eighty dollars, of diapers for an eligible child two years of age or younger for children receiving safety net assistance.

short_summary: Relates to reporting of digital assets on the annual statement of financial disclosure
summary: Relates to reporting of digital assets on the annual statement of financial disclosure filed with the legislative ethics commission or the joint commission on public ethics.

short_summary: Relates to drivers of buses, taxis and livery vehicles using hands-free mobile telephones
summary: Prohibits drivers of a bus, taxi or livery from using hands-free mobile telephones; provides for certain exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to telecommunications equipment owned by other than a telephone company
summary: Provides that all equipment used for the transmission and switching of radio signals for the provision of commercial mobile radio service or mobile internet access service no longer constitutes real property subject to the real property tax law.

short_summary: Relates to the administration of challenge oaths to voter applicants
summary: Requires persons administering challenge oaths to voter applicants to attest that the challenge is being made in good faith and to provide certain identifying information; requires challenge oaths to be presented to a challenged voter applicant in writing.

short_summary: Relates to strengthening of utility storm response and compliance
summary: Relates to strengthening of utility storm response and compliance by reviewing mitigating factors including but not limited to mitigating factors and the specifics surrounding the violation or violations.

short_summary: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; repealer
summary: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; authorizes filing motions to vacate judgment for a conviction that was subsequently decriminalized; authorizes motions to vacate judgment to be filed at any time after entry of a judgment obtained at trial or by plea.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance of additional orders of protection when reviewing an extreme risk protection order
summary: Authorizes a supreme court judge hearing a petition for an "extreme risk protection order" to also hear a petition for a regular order of protection pursuant to the criminal procedure law, the domestic relations law and/or the family court act.

short_summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth
summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth.

short_summary: Relates to the inspection of certain vacated property for abandoned animals
summary: Relates to the inspection of property that has been vacated for abandoned animals; requires property owners and lessors to inspect such property within three days and to immediately notify the appropriate authorities when such person finds an animal which appears to be abandoned.

short_summary: Relates to warnings to be posted and provided by firearms dealers
summary: Requires firearms dealers to post and provide written warnings to purchasers of dangers posed by access to weapons in the home.

short_summary: Requires a certificate of merit in proceedings to recover possession of real property
summary: Relates to requiring a certificate of merit in proceedings to recover possession of real property; requires the petition shall be accompanied by a certificate, signed by the attorney for the petitioner, certifying that the attorney has reviewed the facts of the case and that, based on consultation with representatives of the petitioner identified in the certificate and the attorney's review of pertinent documents, there is a reasonable basis for the commencement of such action; provides that where a petitioner willfully fails to provide copies of required papers and documents the court may dismiss the petition without prejudice.

short_summary: Provides a liquor license exemption for the Mitzpah Towers property located in Syracuse
summary: Provides a liquor license exemption for the Mitzpah Towers property located in the city of Syracuse in the county of Onondaga.

short_summary: Requires places of public assembly to maintain epinephrine auto-injector devices and to have at least one employee who is trained in its use
summary: Requires that functional epinephrine auto-injector devices be made available in places of public assembly and that at least one employee or volunteer of such place of public assembly be trained in its proper operation and use and be present at each facility function.

short_summary: Relates to the rights of grandparents with respect to visitation rights with minor children
summary: Establishes the intent of the legislature to generally defer to parental choices regarding the care, custody and control of their children; mandates that the death of a parent shall be a factor when considering a grandparent's standing to receive visitation or custody; directs that costs be payable by an unsuccessful petitioner where a contest was brought in bad faith.

short_summary: Extends the provisions of part ZZ of chapter 55 of the laws of 2021
summary: Extends the provisions which established a deer hunting pilot program.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a clean energy outreach and community planning program
summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a clean energy outreach and community planning program.

short_summary: Establishes the white elephant housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program
summary: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program for qualified rehabilitation expenditures totaling fifty million dollars or more with respect to a certified historic structure that has been vacant, as determined by local code enforcement or other reasonable means, for at least ten of fifteen consecutive years preceding the date of the taxpayer's application for the rehabilitation credit.

short_summary: Requires that applications submitted by individuals with developmental disabilities for eligibility determinations and service authorizations be processed in a timely manner
summary: Requires that applications submitted by individuals with developmental disabilities for eligibility determinations and service authorizations be processed in a timely manner; provides that where such application is not reasonably clear or omits required information or where the office reasonably suspects fraud based on specific information available, the office shall notify the applicant in writing requesting the specific information needed to process such application; removes reporting requirements.

short_summary: Relates to guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in nightlife establishments; repealer
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in nightlife establishments; repeals provisions establishing the nightlife opioid antagonist program.

short_summary: Amends the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2022 amending the insurance law relating to the provision of supplemental spousal liability insurance
summary: Amends the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2022 amending the insurance law relating to the provision of supplemental spousal liability insurance to persons who are insured for loss resulting from the ownership, maintenance and use of a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to the provision of and payment for violence prevention programs
summary: Makes community violence prevention services available, to the extent permitted by federal law, to any Medicaid beneficiary who has received medical treatment for an injury sustained as a result of an act of community violence and has been referred by a certified or licensed health care provider or social services provider to receive community violence prevention services from a qualified violence prevention professional.

short_summary: Names a certain state facility after Lawrence "Larry" Jackson
summary: Names an office for people with developmental disabilities facility located in the borough of Manhattan the "Lawrence 'Larry' Jackson Community Facility".

short_summary: Directs payment of certain taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund to be made without appropriation
summary: Directs payment of certain internet sales and use taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund partially dedicated for the MTA to be made without appropriation.

short_summary: Relates to critical energy infrastructure security and responsibility
