summary: Relates to unlawful tenancies under the emergency tenant protection act of 1974; prohibits owners from entering or renewing leases where such owner has reason to know that such tenant will not occupy the housing accommodation as his or her primary residence.

short_summary: Clarifies the definition of floor area
summary: Relates to the definition of floor area and what is excluded in the measurement of floor area.

short_summary: Relates to granting peace officer status to park rangers in Erie county
summary: Grants park rangers in Erie county peace officer status to issue appearance tickets, simplified traffic informations, simplified parks informations and simplified environmental conservation informations; provides that such shall not be deemed to authorize such officer to carry, possess, repair or dispose of a firearm unless the appropriate license has been issued therefor.

short_summary: Requires election for registration for organ, eye and tissue donations to be included upon certain state forms; repealer
summary: Requires that space be provided on applications for a civil service examination, claims for unemployment benefits, applications for the practice of a profession or occupation, state income tax returns, and applications to register a motor vehicle, for the applicant to register in the "donate life registry" for organ, eye and tissue donation established pursuant to section 4310 of the public health law.

short_summary: Establishes the commission on retired racehorses
summary: Establishes the commission on retired racehorses, which shall be responsible for the oversight of retired racehorses including the creation of a registry to track such racehorses.

short_summary: Requires that used oil filters be source-separated and recycled
summary: Requires that used oil filters be source-separated and recycled.

short_summary: Requires a New York state legend on all bell jar tickets sold in New York state
summary: Requires a New York state legend on all bell jar tickets sold in New York state.

short_summary: Requires electronic cigarettes and e-liquid products to be sold in separate specific locations where only persons of at least twenty-one years of age are allowed to enter
summary: Requires electronic cigarettes and e-liquid products to be sold in separate specific locations where only persons of at least twenty-one years of age are allowed to enter.

short_summary: Relates to limits on certain supplementary insurance
summary: Relates to the limits of certain supplementary insurance policies; makes the Supplemental Underinsured Motorist (SUM) Insurance limit equal to the liability limit that each insured acquires.

short_summary: Relates to regulations implementing video lottery gaming in this state
summary: Relates to regulations implementing video lottery gaming in this state.

short_summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies.

short_summary: Relates to requiring all buses manufactured for sale in this state to have the exhaust pipe at the upper right corner of the vehicle
summary: Provides that all buses manufactured for sale in this state after July 1, 2025, shall have an exhaust system whereby the point of emission from the exhaust pipe is at the upper right hand corner of the rear of such vehicle.

short_summary: Provides for an apportionment to the Yonkers city school district based upon universal prekindergarten enrollment
summary: Provides for an apportionment to the Yonkers city school district based upon universal prekindergarten enrollment.

short_summary: Relates to the HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 viruses
summary: Includes the HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 viruses to the public health department's health care and wellness education and outreach program.

short_summary: Expands off-track betting to include the five counties comprising the city of New York; repealer
summary: Expands off-track betting to include the five counties comprising the city of New York which shall now be considered part of the Catskill region.

short_summary: Allows New York states sire stakes eligibility for foals sired by New York state stallions
summary: Allows New York sire stakes eligibility for foals sired by New York state stallions, either in-state or out-of-state.

short_summary: Authorizes certain vehicle registration refunds to be refunded on a prorated monthly basis
summary: Authorizes vehicle registration refunds for the registration period commencing after the first twelve month period of such registration to be refunded on a prorated monthly basis.

short_summary: Expands the definition of adult care facilities for the purposes of protection of people with special needs
summary: Expands the definition of adult care facilities for the purposes of protection of people with special needs.

short_summary: Relates to the designation of workers' compensation coverage for certain employees
summary: Prohibits workers compensation carriers from forcing policyholders to cover individuals who are not their employees.

short_summary: Provides for advance payment of the earned income credit by employers
summary: Provides for advance payment of the earned income credit by employers, the commissioner of the department of taxation and finance and the commissioner of New York City's department of finance.

short_summary: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates and establishes the "blue star mothers and families fund"
summary: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates for parents and family members of active duty service members; establishes the "blue star mothers and families support fund".

short_summary: Relates to the term limit of members of the autism spectrum disorders advisory board
summary: Establishes a three year term limit for members of the autism spectrum disorders advisory board.

short_summary: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York
summary: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York.

short_summary: Eliminates certain will filing fees
summary: Eliminates filing fees for wills filed for safekeeping in the surrogate's court.

short_summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance
summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing orders of protection to provide for home and personal security devices and order the respondent to cover the costs associated with security devices
summary: Authorizes orders of protection to provide for personal security devices; orders the respondent to cover the costs associated with security devices; provides if the payment of such costs is awarded the appropriate social services district shall be contacted and directed to pay the petitioner for such costs upon submission of proof of purchase.

short_summary: Eliminates asset limits in calculating the amount of benefits for any household under any public assistance program
summary: Relates to eliminating asset limits in calculating the amount of benefits for any household under any public assistance program.

short_summary: Disqualifies public officers from holding a public office after a conviction of impeachment
summary: Disqualifies public officers from holding a public office after a conviction of impeachment.

short_summary: Makes provisions to preserve access to health care services by requiring that applications for construction not be approved without preservation
summary: Makes provisions to preserve access to health care services by requiring that applications for construction not be approved unless the commissioner affirmatively finds that access to health care services will be preserved.

short_summary: Relates to the disqualification of certain persons from acting as school bus monitors and drivers
summary: Relates to the disqualification of certain persons from acting as school bus monitors and drivers upon the conviction for certain offenses.

short_summary: Relates to the Catskill off-track betting corporation providing licensing and financing to the Monticello racetrack
summary: Relates to the Catskill off-track betting corporation providing licensing and financing to the Monticello racetrack and the ability to provide capital improvements.

short_summary: Authorizing licensing of bowling establishments to offer video gaming if structure allows for segregated areas from patrons under 21 years of age
summary: Authorizes licensing of bowling establishments to offer video gaming if structure allows for segregated areas from patrons under 21 years of age; entitles the operators of bowling establishments to vendor fees where video lottery terminals are located.

short_summary: Prohibits the administration of psychoactive drugs to an animal in a zoo in certain situations
summary: Prohibits the administration of psychoactive drugs to an animal in a zoo in order to allow another animal to procreate with such animal.

short_summary: Provides for the appointment of 4 more members to the board of the city of Yonkers parking authority
summary: Provides for the appointment of 6 more members to the board of the city of Yonkers parking authority.

short_summary: Relates to assaults on nursing professionals and sanitarians
summary: Relates to assaults on nursing professionals and sanitation workers while such person was performing an assigned duty.

short_summary: Raises tax credits for long-term care insurance from twenty percent to fifty percent
summary: Raises tax credits for long-term care insurance from twenty percent to fifty percent; applies to the corporation tax, franchise tax on business corporations, personal income tax, and franchise tax on insurance corporations.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the New York state innovation voucher program
summary: Establishes the New York state innovation voucher program; provides small businesses with access to research and development by colleges and universities, government laboratories and public research institutes in order to assist such businesses in the creation of innovative products or services.

short_summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to study and report on the impact on localities in the counties of Westchester, Putnam and Dutchess of state owned lands
summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to study and report on the impact on localities in the counties of Westchester, Putnam and Dutchess of state-owned lands, and the methods of compensating such localities for the real property taxes lost as a result of such state-owned lands.

short_summary: Relates to issuing temporary permits to certain fantasy sports operators
summary: Relates to issuing temporary permits to certain fantasy sports operators that were not offering contests to persons located in New York prior to November 10, 2015.

short_summary: Increases fines for selling disabled Equidae
summary: Increases fines for selling disabled Equidae.

short_summary: Relates to permitting security guards and private investigators licensed to possess or carry a firearm to possess and carry such firearm in New York City
summary: Permits security guards and private investigators licensed to possess or carry a firearm to possess and carry such firearm in New York City without a special permit from the police commissioner of the city of New York granting validity to such license.

short_summary: Relates to RFPs for gun violence reduction
summary: Relates to RFPs for gun violence reduction; provides that any state agency that issues an RFP relating to gun violence reduction shall establish a coordination plan including all awardees; requires that such coordination plans shall be in a form as prescribed by the department of state; requires that at a minimum, such coordination plan shall help ensure complete coverage of the area for which such RFP is issued and minimize competition between awardees.

short_summary: Relates to the members of the franchise oversight board and the duties and responsibilities of such board
summary: Relates to the members of the franchise oversight board and the duties and responsibilities of such board with regard to the New York city off-track betting corporation.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; and provides penalties for violations
summary: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; requires manufacturers of products containing PFAS to provide notice of such fact to persons that offer the products for sale or distribution; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to fees charged for the issuance of number plates and to requiring a report on the costs of manufacturing such plates
summary: Relates to fees charged for the issuance of number plates and to requiring a report on the costs of manufacturing such plates; requires the fee for a number plate not to exceed the cost of producing such plate; establishes that no additional fee shall be charged to keep a current number plate due to a design change implemented by the commissioner; requires the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision to report on the costs of manufacturing license plates.

short_summary: Relates to concurrent jurisdiction of criminal and family courts for certain offenses
summary: Adds additional offenses where there is concurrent jurisdiction of criminal and family courts; defines "unreciprocated offensive contact".

short_summary: Relates to video lottery gaming in the counties of Suffolk and Nassau; repealer
summary: Relates to video lottery gaming in the counties of Suffolk and Nassau.

short_summary: Includes within class D felony of assault in the second degree the reckless assault of a child less than 7 years old resulting in serious physical injury
summary: Includes within the provisions of the class D felony of assault in the second degree, the reckless causation of serious physical injury to a child under seven years of age, by a person eighteen years of age or older; provides that "serious physical injury", for the purposes of the penal law, shall include, in the case of a child under 7 years of age, subdural hemorrhage, intercranial hemorrhage and retinal hemorrhages.

short_summary: Permits the electronic filing of papers in local criminal courts in certain instances
summary: Permits the electronic filing of papers in local criminal courts in certain instances.

short_summary: Relates to wagers on certain horse racing events and authorizes agreements between a mobile sports wagering operator and an affiliate
summary: Prohibits wagers on a horse racing event unless such racing event is offered pursuant to a fixed odds sports wagering agreement; authorizes agreements between a mobile sports wagering operator and an affiliate to locate self-service sports betting kiosks upon the premises of the affiliate.

short_summary: Makes provisions relating to loitering in a transportation facility
summary: Provides that a person is guilty of loitering when such person remains in a transportation facility, within twenty-five feet of the token booth or similar location, for more than twenty-five minutes unless authorized to do so or unless the facility's design would make it impossible to maintain a greater distance.

short_summary: Provides that for members of a public pension or retirement system, accrued benefits shall not be diminished or impaired except as authorized and prescribed by the legislature
summary: Provides that for members of a public pension or retirement system, accrued benefits shall not be diminished or impaired except as authorized and prescribed by the legislature.

short_summary: Mandates a fixed percentage for annual harness horse breeders awards and requires that all sire stakes funds generated by a specific racetrack be returned as purses to such track at the same level
summary: Mandates a fixed percentage of annual harness horse breeders awards; requires that all sire stakes funds generated by a specific racetrack be returned as purses to such track at the same level in order to allow New York to compete with states that have stronger awards programs.

short_summary: Relates to the thoroughbred breeding and development fund
summary: Extends the provisions relating to the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund until twelve years after the commencement of the operation of a video lottery terminal facility at Aqueduct racetrack.

short_summary: Provides procedures for cancelling race days at a pari-mutuel harness track
summary: Requires unanimous agreement between management, the gaming commission and the horsemen's association representative before race days can be cancelled, as well as language requiring cancelled race days to be made up.

short_summary: Relates to false representation of affiliation or approval of state or local agencies as false advertising
summary: Provides that a false representation of affiliation or approval, or false implication of such affiliation or approval, of any official, state or local agencies or other official source, shall be false advertising.

short_summary: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats
summary: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats.

short_summary: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child and provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions
summary: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child; increases age from 16 to 18 for application of existing sexual performance crimes; creates crimes of use of a child in a sexual performance in the first degree, promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child in the first degree, and promoting a sexual performance by a child in the first degree; provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions.

short_summary: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS
summary: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS.

short_summary: Authorizes actions and proceedings by unit owners against a condominium board of managers for certain violations of law or of resolutions adopted by such board of managers
summary: Authorizes actions and proceedings by unit owners against a condominium board of managers for certain violations of law or of resolutions adopted by such board of managers.

short_summary: Relates to setting bail for defendants who pose a threat to public safety
summary: Relates to setting bail for dangerous defendants who pose a threat to public safety.

short_summary: Relates to lyme disease and tick-borne infection awareness and prevention in children's summer camps
summary: Relates to lyme disease and tick-borne infection awareness and prevention for children's overnight, summer day and traveling summer day camps; provides guidelines for treatment and notification; provides for the development of materials.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation of street vendors in N.Y. city; repealer
summary: Relates to the regulation of street vendors in cities with a population of one million or more by authorizing such cities to adopt a program to regulate street vendors; requires street vendors to obtain a permit; provides for penalties for failure to comply with such regulations.

short_summary: Relates to plastic carryout bags provided by restaurants
summary: Removes the exemption for restaurants, taverns or similar food service establishments from the New York state bag waste reduction act.

short_summary: Establishes standards and defines the terms biodegradable, degradable, and decomposable
summary: Establishes standards; defines the terms biodegradable, degradable, and decomposable.

short_summary: Enacts the Municipal Oversight Of Natural Systems By Allowing Non-Toxic Options Act
summary: Allows municipalities to regulate pesticides such that they do not conflict with any laws, rules or regulations related thereto.

short_summary: Relates to excluding renewable energy pilot projects and certain payments in lieu of taxes from tax cap calculations, and to the establishment of a distributed generation energy development program
summary: Relates to excluding renewable energy pilot projects and certain energy system-related payments in lieu of taxes from tax cap calculations, and to the establishment of a distributed generation energy development program that provides a single forum for state-level appeals for proposed distributed generation energy facilities.

short_summary: Relates to the subsidies that may be provided to a parent who adopts a disabled or hard to place child
summary: Authorizes the social services department to terminate the subsidies that may be provided to a parent who adopts a disabled or hard to place child under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to medical use of psilocybin; appropriation
summary: Relates to medical use of psilocybin; establishes a psilocybin assisted therapy grant program; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the Justice for Nursing Home Victims act
summary: Relates to enacting the Justice for Nursing Home Victims act; creates a nursing home resident COVID-19 compensation program to provide full compensation to any nursing home resident or their statutory beneficiary when COVID-19 caused or contributed to such resident's death; provides the responsibilities of a nursing home during a pandemic; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Excludes environmental contamination from consideration as a factor for real property assessment
summary: Excludes environmental contamination from consideration as a factor for assessment.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of resisting arrest
summary: Relates to the crime of resisting arrest; provides that a second violation within 5 years shall be a class E felony.

short_summary: Relates to permitting the Immanuel Evangelical Lutheran Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption
summary: Relates to permitting the Immanuel Evangelical Lutheran Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

short_summary: Relates to the practice of veterinary medicine
summary: Excludes the use of equine pulsed electromagnetic field therapy from the practice of veterinary medicine.

short_summary: Relates to requiring department of environmental conservation to establish guidelines for disqualification of stand-by contractors
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to establish guidelines relating to the disqualification of contractors applying to perform stand-by contracts relating to past performance, reasonableness of pricing, acts of negligence and convictions for certain crimes reflecting on honesty, integrity and capability of any contractor.

short_summary: Relates to proceedings regarding destitute children
summary: Expands the list of those able to commence proceedings alleging that a child is a destitute child to include the child in question, if over 14 years of age, and other persons on the court's direction; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the retirement of deputy sheriffs-civil in the county of Monroe
summary: Relates to the retirement of deputy sheriffs-civil in the county of Monroe.

short_summary: Relates to the handling fee paid to a dealer or operator of a redemption center for the redemption of empty beverage containers
summary: Relates to the handling fee paid to a dealer or operator of a redemption center for the redemption of empty beverage containers.

short_summary: In relation to the additional vendor fee for a certain track located within Oneida county
summary: Provides that the additional vendor fee for a vendor track located within Oneida county within fifteen miles of a Native American class III gaming facility shall not be forfeited if the track does not maintain the ninety percent full-time equivalent employee requirement.

short_summary: Provides for funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants
summary: Provides for funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the NY privacy act
summary: Enacts the NY privacy act to require companies to disclose their methods of de-identifying personal information, to place special safeguards around data sharing and to allow consumers to obtain the names of all entities with whom their information is shared.

short_summary: Eases certain restrictions on the conducting of games of chance for charitable purposes
summary: Eases certain restrictions on the conducting of games of chance for charitable purposes; authorizes the payment, out of the net proceeds of games of chance, of reimbursement for reasonable expenses of volunteers working at the games; expands the frequency upon which games of chance may be held; authorizes auxiliary members of authorized organizations to operate games of chance; authorizes persons convicted of crimes to operate games of chance when participating in a rehabilitation program; authorizes conducting of games of chance on Sundays; expands advertising of games of chance.

short_summary: Prohibits political candidates from being nominated by more than one party for any public office
summary: Prohibits political candidates from being nominated by more than one party for any public office.

short_summary: Prohibits unlawful dissemination or publication of intimate images created by digitization and of sexually explicit depictions of an individual; repealer
summary: Includes "deep fake" images created by digitization within the definition of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_summary: Prohibits the governor from inserting policy into appropriations
summary: Prohibits the governor from inserting policy into appropriations.

short_summary: Relates to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers.

short_summary: Relates to video lottery gaming located in Orange county
summary: Relates to video lottery gaming located in Orange county.

short_summary: Relates to noncommercial aviation
summary: Provides that there is no duty to keep premises safe for persons engaging in noncommercial aviation.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the born alive abortion survivors' protection act
summary: Relates to establishing the born alive abortion survivors' protection act.

short_summary: Relates to process servers
summary: Relates to process servers; enacts provisions relating to issuance, renewal, suspension and revocation of a license to do business as a process server.

short_summary: Enacts provisions providing protection to employees from retaliatory actions by employers where such employees report improper business activities
summary: Enacts provisions providing protection to employees from retaliatory actions by employers where such employees report improper business activities; applicable to employees who in good faith reasonably believe that an improper business activity has or will occur, based on information that the employees reasonably believe to be true; provides remedies and relief.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of assault on a pregnant woman
summary: Establishes the crimes of assault on a pregnant woman in the second degree as a class D felony and assault on a pregnant woman in the first degree as a class C felony.

short_summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization
summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization; extends such provisions to 2024.

short_summary: Relates to transportation management brokers
summary: Relates to transportation management brokers; provides that transportation management brokers are no longer required to manage the transportation services for Medicaid beneficiaries.

short_summary: Relates to the brownfield redevelopment tax credit
summary: Relates to the brownfield redevelopment tax credit; provides that in the event that the qualified site is owned by, or was acquired by a taxpayer from, a municipality and such municipality is a volunteer under the brownfield site clean-up agreement with respect to such qualified site, then the amount of the credit shall be reduced; defines "infrastructure work"; makes related amendments.

short_summary: Creates a pilot program to provide for a ranked choice voting method to be used in up to ten local governments for two years and provides for repeal of provisions
summary: Creates a pilot program to provide for an instant runoff voting method to be used in up to ten local governments, selected by the state board of elections, in election years 2026 and 2027; requires report to state legislature.

short_summary: Requires police officers to report the misconduct of a police officer
summary: Requires police officers to report the misconduct of a police officer; requires the division of criminal justice to establish a protocol to be followed by police agencies when handling and recording mandatory reports of misconduct by a police officer; establishes the crime of failure to report misconduct by a police officer.

short_summary: Relates to decreasing the tax rate on gaming revenues from slot machines on certain facilities
summary: Decreases the tax rate on gaming revenues from slot machines in facilities in region 5 of zone 2; requires such facilities to report on the use of the retained funds for the creation of new jobs or rehiring laid-off employees.

short_summary: Relates to handicapping tournaments
summary: Specifies who can operate a handicapping tournament; requires handicapping tournament operators to distribute no less than eighty percent of entry fees as prizes to the winners of a handicapping tournament; requires that five percent of the portion of the gross revenue collected by an operator on handicapping tournament entry fees from New York participants that is not distributed as prizes to the winners of a tournament be distributed quarterly by such operator to the horsemen's organization for welfare and medical plans for regularly employed backstretch employees.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for designation as land used in agricultural production
summary: Expands eligibility for designation as land used in agricultural production by lowering the average gross sale value of the land to $20,000 or more in certain cases.

short_summary: Establishes mandatory training for every high school guidance counselor relating to assisting students with autism spectrum disorder
summary: Establishes mandatory training for every high school guidance counselor relating to assisting students with autism spectrum disorder; requires high school guidance counselors to receive training at least once a year on the special needs of students with autism spectrum disorder and how to assist such students in the transition from high school to higher education or employment.

short_summary: Creates a provision requiring court review of domestic violence bail applications
summary: Requires court review of domestic violence bail applications.

short_summary: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived claims or causes of action
summary: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived causes of action; such notice shall occur within 120 days after the insurer has received actual notice of such revived claim or cause of action.

short_summary: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity
summary: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity.

short_summary: Sets forth additional conditions which may be available in an order of protection
summary: Expands upon conditions which may be included in an order of protection issued for victims of domestic violence and makes other related alterations relative to the jurisdictions of supreme and family court in such situations; provides for payment of housing costs, compensation for incidental losses, possession of specified personal property, and prohibition of alienation of commonly held specified property.

short_summary: Relates to the disposition of net revenues of regional off-track betting corporations to participating counties
summary: Provides that the disposition of net revenues of regional off-track betting corporations to participating counties may be divided on an annual, bi-annual or quarterly basis as determined by such corporations.

short_summary: Relates to the members of the franchise oversight board and the duties and responsibilities of such board
summary: Extends the oversight functions of the board to apply to the New York city off-track betting corporation.

short_summary: Allows off-track betting corporations to set up special reserve funds
summary: Allows off-track betting corporations to set up special reserve funds to use as an alternative to current capital acquisition funds.

short_summary: Relates to refunds of excess long term care insurance credit
summary: Provides for a refund of any excess amount of tax paid after reduction of other credits and the credit for long-term care insurance.

short_summary: Provides for the provision to consumers of information concerning household hazardous products at the point of retail sale by labels and pamphlets
summary: Establishes a program to provide information to consumers concerning household hazardous products; provides such information be available at the point of retail sale by labels and pamphlets; provides such information should disclose hazards and inform people of environmentally safer alternatives; provides for the establishment of a hazardous product list by the department of environmental conservation.

short_summary: Includes chiropractors in health maintenance organizations
summary: Includes chiropractic services within the definition of "comprehensive health services" for purposes of health maintenance organizations; enables a member of a health maintenance organization to request the services of a chiropractor when the member has an ailment, illness, condition or injury, the treatment for which falls within the scope of a licensed chiropractor.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a temporary toll holiday for use of the thruway
summary: Establishes a temporary toll holiday for use of the thruway from June 1, 2024 through August 31, 2024.

short_summary: Provides that health insurance contracts and policies for long term care shall be renewable unless there is nonpayment of premiums
summary: Provides that health insurance contracts and policies for long term care shall be renewable each year at the option of the insured unless there is nonpayment of premiums.

short_summary: Establishes the New York first--shop local program
summary: Establishes the New York first--shop local program to provide immediate assistance to small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 outbreak; defines terms; provides that such program shall identify eligible applicants and projects that promote local products and services by providing marketing and business assistance services; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to requiring lending institutions to supply customers with PINs to be used in conjunction with any chip-embedded credit card
summary: Requires lending institutions to supply customers with PINs to be used in conjunction with any chip-embedded credit card.

short_summary: Relates to excluding patios and other outdoor areas on the premises of any entity licensed to operate a video lottery gaming facility from restrictions of the Clean Indoor Air Act
summary: Relates to excluding patios and other outdoor areas on the premises of any entity licensed to operate a video lottery gaming facility from restrictions of the Clean Indoor Air Act.

short_summary: Provides for the reestablishment of the Westchester parkway commission, to advise the commissioner of transportation
summary: Provides for the reestablishment of the Westchester Parkway Commission, to advise the commissioner of transportation regarding the operation and maintenance of the special parkways within the county of Westchester.

short_summary: Relates to requiring state agencies, public authorities and public benefit corporations to provide annual reports
summary: Requires state agencies, public authorities and public benefit corporations to provide annual reports including information on outstanding total debt for each entity, total annual debt service for each entity, annual debt issuance for each entity, and annual debt to be retired for each entity.

short_summary: Authorizes a statewide toll free hotline run by the state police with reward for information leading to conviction of drunk drivers; imposes an additional surcharge on convicted drivers
summary: Authorizes a statewide toll free hotline run by the state police with reward for reporting conduct of drivers leading to conviction of the crime of driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs; imposes an additional surcharge upon conviction of all criminally drunk or drugged drivers to fund expenses and rewards.

short_summary: Enumerates sanctions imposed against persons who sell alcoholic beverages to minors
summary: Enumerates sanctions; imposes increasingly higher jail terms and civil penalties against persons who sell alcoholic beverages to minors.

short_summary: Imposes a moratorium on increasing gas and electric prices, rates and charges
summary: Imposes a moratorium on increasing gas and electric prices, rates and charges.

short_summary: Authorizes interactive gaming in the state of New York
summary: Authorizes interactive gaming in the state of New York.

short_summary: Prohibits trustees and members of a board of education from having a family member who works for the same board of education or school district as the trustee or member
summary: Prohibits trustees and members of a board of education from having a family member who works for the same board of education or school district as the trustee or member.

short_summary: Relates to operational expenses of certain gaming facilities
summary: Relates to operational expenses of certain gaming facilities.

short_summary: Enacts the Child Sexual Abuse Reform Act; provides for the elimination and extension of certain statutes of limitations relating thereto
summary: Enacts the Child Sexual Abuse Reform Act; provides for the elimination and extension of certain statutes of limitations related to sexual offenses against children, the expansion of reporting requirements in cases of such offenses, and the expansion of the central child abuse and maltreatment register.

short_summary: Authorizes the possession of certain antique rifles and their modern day replicas
summary: Authorizes the possession of certain antique rifles and their modern day replicas.

short_summary: Provides basis for determining primary residency
summary: Provides that non-payment of New York city taxes shall be a prima facie finding that a housing accommodation subject to the emergency housing rent control act is not a person's primary residence as claimed by the delinquent taxpayer and non-payment of NYS taxes shall be a prima facie finding that a housing accommodation subject to the emergency tenant protection act of 1974 is not a person's primary residence.

short_summary: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients
summary: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients.

short_summary: Establishes the universal stop false police reporting act which establishes the crimes of aggravated falsely reporting an incident in the first, second, and third degrees
summary: Establishes the universal stop false police reporting act which establishes the crimes of aggravated falsely reporting an incident in the first, second, and third degrees when a person commits the crime of falsely reporting an incident in the first, second, or third degree and such person intended to harass, annoy, threaten, or alarm another person because of a believe or perception regarding a person's race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or ethnicity; authorizes officers to arrest persons believed to have committed falsely reporting an incident without first obtaining a warrant; includes such falsely reporting as a hate crime; establishes databases of law enforcement officers and persons convicted of falsely reporting; requires notifying persons of the termination of certain criminal actions or proceedings.

short_summary: Prohibits trustees and members of a board of education from voting on matters before the board which affect a family member of the trustee or board member
summary: Prohibits trustees and members of a board of education from voting on matters before the board which affect a family member of the trustee or board member who is either employed by the board of education or school district or who would be financially impacted by such vote.

short_summary: Requires the superintendent of the state police to establish uniform investigatory standards when there is a shooting of a civilian by a police officer
summary: Requires the superintendent of the state police to establish uniform investigatory standards when there is a shooting of a civilian by a police officer.

short_summary: Designates sweet corn as the state vegetable
summary: Designates sweet corn as the state vegetable.

short_summary: Relates to extending the additional one percent sales tax for Wayne county

summary: Directs state aid to be payable to any municipal corporation or special district that contains land in the counties of Cayuga, Seneca and Wayne comprising the northern Montezuma wildlife management area.

short_summary: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine
summary: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine on bodies of freshwater located within the state and within the jurisdiction and control of the state.

short_summary: Requires schools to allow fire departments to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
summary: Requires the principal of any high school to allow any local fire department, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of fire department junior recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

short_summary: Relates to certain payments of the horsemen's organization
summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization; extends such provision to 2024.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the removal, confiscation or destruction of lottery tickets prior to such game's expiration date
summary: Relates to prohibiting the removal, confiscation or destruction of lottery tickets prior to such game's expiration date.

short_summary: Eliminates the cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit
summary: Eliminates the $1500 cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit.

short_summary: Removes the requirement that a public employer continue terms of an expired agreement until a new agreement is negotiated with an employee organization
summary: Removes the requirement that a public employer continue terms of an expired agreement until a new agreement is negotiated with an employee organization.

short_summary: Relates to the length of time that a person on a visa can hold a New York state driver's license or learner's permit
summary: Relates to the length of time that a person on a visa can hold a New York state driver's license or learner's permit; provides that driver's license or learner's permit shall expire upon the expiration of a visa or upon the date the driver's license or learner's permit would normally expire whichever date first occurs.

short_summary: Makes it a ministerial process to amend a license to carry or possess a firearm
summary: Authorizes amendments to a license to carry or possess a firearm to be made by the filing officers or county clerk of each county, unless otherwise specified through resolution of the county's legislative body.

short_summary: Establishes the veterans' memorials preservation act
summary: Establishes the veterans' memorials preservation act.

short_summary: Creates a racing fan advisory board, establishing an I Love NY Racing promotion and awarding the New York State Horse Racing Farm of the Year Award
summary: Relates to creating a racing fan advisory board to provide advice to the state racing and wagering board on issues related to horse racing and wagering; establishes an I Love NY Racing promotion and the New York State Horse Racing Farm of the Year Award.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain establishments which sell liquor to have devices which measure blood alcohol content
summary: Requires a retail licensee for on-premises consumption to maintain and make available to customers, at no charge, a device which measures blood alcohol content.

short_summary: Relates to posting of private property
summary: Permits owners of private property to post such property to prevent trespass by painting purple markings on trees or markers.

short_summary: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments
summary: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments; provides that participants may respond to an emergency or hazardous activity, but shall remain in a designated or marked off area that has been set up by the chief or officer in charge; provides such participant cannot respond to an emergency on a vehicle using lights and/or sirens; provides such participants may not enter a burning structure.

short_summary: Exempts receipts from the services provided by a farrier in shoeing a horse
summary: Exempts receipts from the services provided by a farrier in shoeing a horse including reasonable fees for travel and shoeing a horse in a remote location on a farm.

short_summary: Eliminates certain restrictions on the right to eviction for landlord's personal use
summary: Removes certain restrictions relating to the "immediate and compelling necessity" of the landlord on a landlord's ability in certain New York city apartments which are rent stabilized or rent controlled to recover possession of a housing accommodation for his own personal use and occupancy or for the use and occupancy of his or her immediate family.

short_summary: Enacts "The Domestic Violence Protection Act - Helen's Law" requiring registration of violent felony offenders
summary: Enacts "The Domestic Violence Protection Act - Helen's Law" requiring registration of violent felony offenders; sets forth duties of the division of criminal justice services; establishes a special telephone number; requires the division to maintain a subdirectory of violent predators.

short_summary: Amends the definition of wager and changes the licensing requirements for mobile sports wagering operators
summary: Amends the definition of sports wager to include other things of value; changes the licensing requirement for mobile sports wagering operators; provides the state shall by no later than January 31, 2024 have fourteen operators and by January 31, 2025 have sixteen operators; provides tax rates shall be determined based on the number of operators.

short_summary: Relates to requiring that genetically modified salmon that is sold or offered for sale be labeled
summary: Relates to requiring genetically modified salmon that is sold or offered for sale be labeled.

short_summary: Grants excused leave to civil service employees who are volunteer firefighters or ambulance workers during state of emergency
summary: Grants excused leave to civil service employees during states of emergency as declared by the federal, state or a municipal government, when such employees are members of a volunteer fire department or a volunteer ambulance or rescue squad.

short_summary: Relates to licensed pet breeders and brokers
summary: Relates to licensed pet breeders and brokers; requires a pet dealer to only purchase a dog or cat for resale from a breeder or broker licensed by the United States department of agriculture or exempt from United States department of agriculture licensing per United States department of agriculture regulation, and such breeder or broker shall be in possession of all other licenses required for a breeder or broker by the state in which such breeder or broker is located.

short_summary: Enacts the Come Home to Hunt Act
summary: Relates to enacting the Come Home to Hunt Act, which provides for the purchase of a two-day hunting license for non-residents to hunt domestic game bird, migratory game bird, big game, and small game.

short_summary: Establishes a presumption of shared parenting of minor children in matrimonial and family court proceedings
summary: Establishes a presumption of shared parenting of minor children in matrimonial and family court proceedings.

short_summary: Grants the metropolitan transportation authority the power to suspend vehicle registration in certain cases
summary: Grants the metropolitan transportation authority the power to suspend vehicle registration in certain cases.

short_summary: Limits certain regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent
summary: Limits certain regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent; provides that the department of financial services shall issue a report on the effects that its suitability and best interest in life insurance and annuity transaction regulations have had on the term life insurance market.

short_summary: Requires a consultation prior to the discharge of medically fragile young adults
summary: Relates to medically fragile young adults and pediatric specialized nursing facilities; allows for such young adults to remain in such facilities from age twenty-one until age thirty-six.

short_summary: Authorizes the purchase of construction mortgages by the state of New York mortgage agency
summary: Authorizes the state of New York mortgage agency to purchase construction mortgages from banks within the state during periods when there is an inadequate supply of credit available for new residential mortgages or available for such loans at carrying charges within the financial means of persons and families of low and moderate income.

short_summary: Requires insurance companies to issue joint checks for payment to an insured and a health care provider in certain circumstances
summary: Requires insurance companies to issue joint checks for payment to an insured and a health care provider in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Excludes claims for unemployment insurance arising as a result of an employer closing his or her business because of novel coronavirus COVID-19, from an employer's experience rating charges
summary: Excludes claims for unemployment insurance arising as a result of an employer closing his or her business because of novel coronavirus COVID-19, from an employer's experience rating charges.

short_summary: Exempts from sales and use taxes motor vehicles and rolling stock used by common carriers
summary: Exempts from sales and use taxes certain motor vehicles, parts and services therefor and railroad rolling stock, parts and services therefor.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Wayne to impose a hotel or motel room or seasonal rental occupancy tax
summary: Authorizes the county of Wayne to impose a hotel or motel room or seasonal rental occupancy tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Requires each branch of state government and political subdivision of the state to establish and abide by a code of ethics
summary: Requires each branch of state government and political subdivision of the state to establish and abide by a code of ethics; requires ethics commissions; sets standards for codes.

short_summary: Relates to the transparency and accountability of charter schools
summary: Relates to charter schools; clarifies the transparency and accountability of charter schools and provides fiscal relief to the school districts where charter schools are located.

short_summary: Enacts the omnibus telecommunications reform act
summary: Enacts the "omnibus telecommunications reform act"; reforms the competitive cable service; promotes the wide-spread development of high-capacity broadband internet access; increases the availability and quality of services in this key economic development area; ensures the safety, reliability and affordability of telecommunications services.

short_summary: Relates to complaint procedures and retaining billing records for a certain period of time
summary: Ensures that residential gas, electric and steam service customers will receive a written determination regarding rate related complaints explaining the reasoning for the decision; requires that decisions are made by the public service commission within 90 days of receiving the complaint; requires utility corporations to retain customer billing statements dating back at least eight years.

short_summary: Relates to transfers of cable systems
summary: Relates to transfers of cable systems.

short_summary: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions
summary: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions; requires reporting to the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to cemetery trust funds
summary: Relates to cemetery trust funds and the maintenance and preservation of cemetery grounds.

short_summary: Provides for the administration of the state cemetery vandalism restoration, monument repair or removal and administration fund by the state cemetery board
summary: Provides for the administration of the state cemetery vandalism restoration, monument repair or removal and administration fund by the state cemetery board; removes the state comptroller and commissioner of taxation and finance from administering the fund.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of the term "cremation"
summary: Relates to the definition of the term "cremation".

short_summary: Clarifies the regulation of cemetery corporations
summary: Clarifies that state regulated cemetery operations are under the sole jurisdiction of the state cemetery board.

short_summary: Raises the tax rate on corporate income; increases the state conformity to federal taxation of corporate profit shifting; and imposes an additional tax on individual business income
summary: Raises the tax rate on corporate income; increases the state conformity to federal taxation of corporate profit shifting; imposes an additional tax on individual business income in response to federal tax benefits for pass-through business income.

short_summary: Includes the Shelter Island Public Library Society with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority
summary: Includes the Shelter Island Public Library Society with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

summary: Prohibits a sex offender whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a child care provider, preschool or any facility where pre-kindergarten or kindergarten instruction is provided.

short_summary: Relates to brand-name drugs with and without an AB generic equivalent
summary: Relates to brand-name drugs with and without an AB generic equivalent; amends the effective date from January to July next succeeding the date on which it shall have become a law.

short_summary: Relates to hate crime reporting on college campuses
summary: Requires colleges to post campus crime statistics on their website; requires colleges to implement a plan to provide investigation of hate crimes on campus; requires colleges to inform incoming students about hate crime prevention measures.

short_summary: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases
summary: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.

short_summary: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals
summary: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals.

summary: Relates to orders of adjournment in contemplation of dismissal by mandating that judges seal certain records of defendants rather than giving judge's discretion for such an action; limits the total period of adjournment to 90 days.

short_summary: Relates to reporting the use of force by a police officer or peace officer
summary: Relates to reporting the use of force by a police officer or peace officer; includes pointing a firearm at or in the direction of another person as a use of force which must be reported.

short_summary: Provides for special elections for the offices of comptroller and attorney general for vacancies during a term
summary: Provides for special elections for the offices of comptroller and attorney general for vacancies during a term.

short_summary: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination
summary: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination.

summary: Allows first responders who are diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder to request line of duty sick leave.

summary: Enacts the health care worker peer support program.

summary: Relates to alcohol in certain motion picture theatres; authorizes a person holding a retail on-premises license for a movie theatre to allow the purchase of alcoholic beverages under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Excludes from state income tax unemployment compensation benefits
summary: Excludes from state income tax up to $10,200 of unemployment compensation benefits earned by a resident of the state.

short_summary: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state
summary: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state.

short_summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle
summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to requiring public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service
summary: Requires public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service.

short_summary: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping
summary: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping.

short_summary: Provides employment protections during the performance of state active duty by members of the national guard
summary: Provides employment protections during the performance of state active duty by members of the national guard; makes technical corrections.

short_summary: Requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; repealer
summary: Enacts the "educational equity and choice act"; requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; provides that such costs shall be approved by the commissioner of education and borne by the state; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting facial recognition technology to be used in connection with an officer camera
summary: Prohibits facial recognition technology to be used in connection with an officer camera used by both local and state police including the storage of biometric data.

short_summary: Establishes the aging in place council
summary: Establishes the aging in place council to study and provide recommendations to promote aging in place.

short_summary: Prohibits ear clipping and tail docking of dogs unless deemed medically necessary to protect the life or health of the dog
summary: Prohibits ear clipping and tail docking of dogs unless deemed medically necessary to protect the life or health of the dog.

short_summary: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations
summary: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York
summary: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York; provides such commission shall report on the best practices and legislative recommendations to close the achievement gap and high school graduation rates between multilingual learners and their English proficient peers from prekindergarten through twelfth grade.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of office and the content of notices published in newspapers
summary: Relates to the definition of office and the content of notices published in newspapers.

short_summary: Clarifies the scope of protections against discrimination on the basis of disability
summary: Clarifies the scope of protections against discrimination on the basis of disability under the New York state human rights law in the areas of employment, public accommodations and government services to be consistent with the federal Americans with Disabilities Act and the current policies and practices of the division of human rights.

short_summary: Prohibits idling by heavy duty vehicles
summary: Prohibits idling by heavy duty vehicles.

short_summary: Provides for information concerning services for human trafficking victims
summary: Provides for information concerning services for human trafficking victims in transit facilities operated by the metropolitan transportation authority.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing early parole release for inmates where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense
summary: Relates to authorizing early parole release for inmates where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense.

short_summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

summary: Directs the chancellor of the New York city school district to establish, in consultation with the metropolitan transportation authority, a student fare program to provide three free fares each weekday to New York city students who live a half mile or more from the school they attend.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state independent budget office
summary: Creates the New York state independent budget office with a director to be appointed, upon the recommendations of an independent budget office advisory committee, by the speaker of the assembly and the temporary president of the senate; such office shall provide objective, non-partisan and timely analyses of state revenue, expenditures and management practices to members of the legislature for any legislation with fiscal impact or at the request of a leader or a committee.

short_summary: Directs state agencies to submit reports detailing their telework policies
summary: Directs state agencies to submit reports detailing their telework policies; permits input from employees anonymously; directs the department of civil service to compile reports and submit a single report to the legislature.

short_summary: Prohibits certain inquiries or statements related to the arrest record or conviction record of any person who is in the process of applying for employment or interviewing for employment
summary: Prohibits certain inquiries or statements related to the arrest record or conviction record of any person who is in the process of applying for employment or interviewing for employment.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting members of law enforcement from using tear gas
summary: Prohibits members of law enforcement from using tear gas at any time.

summary: Directs the commissioner of education, in conjunction with the superintendent of state police and the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services, to establish standards for the security and safety of school grounds.

short_summary: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services
summary: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services; directs the commissioner of health to enact regulations imposing certain standards and restrictions.

short_summary: Directs telecommunication and cable corporations to provide call center service assistance from centers located within the state
summary: Directs telecommunications and cable corporations to provide call center service assistance from centers located within the state and such corporations' service areas; includes a list of what services must be provided.

short_summary: Eliminates the MTA's exemption from environmental quality review standards established by article 8 of the environmental conservation law
summary: Eliminates the MTA's exemption from environmental quality review standards established by article 8 of the environmental conservation law.

short_summary: Designates the second Monday in July each year as a public holiday, to be known as Abolition Commemoration day
summary: Designates the second Monday in July each year as a public holiday, to be known as Abolition Commemoration Day.

short_summary: Grants a total exemption from real property taxation for school tax purposes for certain persons seventy-five years of age or over
summary: Grants a total exemption from real property taxation for school tax purposes for certain persons seventy-five years of age or over.

short_summary: Enacts the accessible electronic information act
summary: Enacts the accessible electronic information act for blind and disabled persons; creates a new fund in the state finance law; authorizes a not-for-profit entity to administer the program.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to investigate the position of city marshal in the city of New York
summary: Establishes a task force to investigate the position of city marshal in the city of New York regarding claims of defrauding creditors and the feasibility of abolishing the position.

short_summary: Mandates comprehensive, medically accurate and age appropriate sex education be taught in all public schools, grades one through twelve
summary: Mandates comprehensive, medically accurate and age appropriate sex education be taught in all public schools, grades one through twelve; provides that the commissioner of education will create and establish a curriculum to accomplish such goal within one year of the effective date of this legislation.

short_summary: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive
summary: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive.

summary: Requires the board of elections or a bipartisan committee appointed by such board to conduct a risk-limiting audit of voter verifiable audit records from voting machines or systems within the jurisdiction of such board.

short_summary: Relates to creating a tax credit for taxpayers who purchase and install a water filtration or purification system in their residence or business
summary: Relates to creating a tax credit for taxpayers who purchase and install a water filtration or purification system in their residence or business.

short_summary: Relates to the legislative power of the University of the State of New York
summary: Relates to legislative review of rules and regulations adopted by the board of regents that will increase school district costs.

short_summary: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office
summary: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office; directs such office shall provide information to legislative committees of the senate and assembly with respect to the state budget, appropriation bills and other bills providing budget authority or tax expenditures; requires such office to report to the temporary president of the senate, the senate minority leader, the speaker of the assembly and the assembly minority leader.

short_summary: Relates to the licensing of sign language interpreters and creates a state board for sign language interpreting
summary: Relates to the licensing of sign language interpreters; creates a state board for sign language interpreting.

summary: Authorizes electronic court appearances for criminal matters, excluding jury trials, in all counties in the state; authorizes electronic appearances for criminal matters where the court determines a personal appearance would be impractical, unsafe or excessively burdensome; authorizes sentencing to a period of incarceration to be conducted via electronic appearance for defendants who are already incarcerated.

short_summary: Imposes criminal liability for the failure to obtain medical care for a person in custody displaying medical distress
summary: Imposes criminal liability for the failure to obtain medical care for a person in custody displaying medical distress.

short_summary: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state
summary: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state.

summary: Relates to false material statements related to a public utility.

short_summary: Relates to the number of voting machines required, supplies at polling locations and the number of affidavit ballots to be supplied at polling locations
summary: Relates to the total number of voting machines required at polling sites in cities with populations of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees
summary: Provides procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees not in the service of the city of New York, including the fees to be paid for such hearing officer; provides for suspension, with pay, pending the determination.

short_summary: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers in the town of Montgomery
summary: Grants peace officer status to employees of the town court of the town of Montgomery serving as uniformed court officers at such town court.

short_summary: Grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court
summary: Authorizes courts to hold evidentiary hearings for a temporary order of protection in certain circumstances; grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Establishes the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary
summary: Establishes the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary; establishes uses for the sanctuary, including the limited use of certain boats; repeals provisions prohibiting boating in the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary.

short_summary: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions
summary: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions; removes requirement of service during a time of war for additional points on civil service examinations for veterans.

short_summary: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators
summary: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers
summary: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers; authorizes a pay differential for regional state park police, forest ranger, environmental conservation officer, and university police officer titles when wage rates of police officers in a given location are substantially higher than the wage rates paid by the state.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting retroactive minimum conditions of employment
summary: Relates to prohibiting retroactive minimum conditions of employment; provides that the employment of an employee who met the minimum qualifications or conditions for employment at the time of appointment may not be terminated or separated from service based on any new qualifications or conditions of employment enacted after the date of appointment to such civil service position.

short_summary: Relates to the grounds for which the public employment relations board may seek injunctive relief
summary: Relates to the grounds for which the public employment relations board may seek injunctive relief; defines "irreparable injury, loss or damage".

short_summary: Prohibits public employers from taking disciplinary action against public employees in certain cases
summary: Prohibits public employers from dismissing or taking other disciplinary action against public employees if such employees are elected or appointed to represent the employee organization or its members or communicate or offer commentary on matters of public concern or matters affecting the employee organization or its members.

short_summary: Relates to the payment of costs for line of duty injuries of police officers and firefighters
summary: Relates to the payment of costs for line of duty injuries of police officers and firefighters; requires such costs for retired members of the uniformed forces of the fire or police departments be paid by the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to hazard duty pay for essential work performed in accordance with a state emergency disaster declaration
summary: Provides for hazard duty pay of an additional twenty-five hundred dollars for essential work performed in accordance with a state emergency disaster declaration.

short_summary: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees
summary: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees; provides that the recommendation of a hearing officer in relation to designated managerial and confidential employees shall be considered final and not subject to change or modification.

summary: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system; creates a board to manage such fund and to make payments.

short_summary: Requires the New York state power authority and its employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration
summary: Requires the New York state power authority and its employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration.

short_summary: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correctional officers
summary: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correction officers; provides that the commissioner of correction shall not appoint a person as a correction officer if such person is more than thirty-five years of age as of the date of the applicant's appointment or eligibility to compete in a promotion examination.

short_summary: Relates to the reimbursement for medicare charges
summary: Amends supplementary medical insurance benefits reimbursement amount to include additional charges other than the premium charge; defines health benefit plan of supplementary medical insurance benefits.

short_summary: Relates to the determination of state contributions for certain benefits provided pursuant to collective bargaining agreements
summary: Relates to determination of state contribution for certain benefits provided pursuant to collective bargaining agreements.

short_summary: Relates to employee representation of state employees designated managerial or confidential
summary: Provides notification of employment or promotion of applicable employees to organizations of state employees designated managerial or confidential for purposes of employee representation in determining the terms and conditions of employment.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment and promotion of supervisors of the fire alarm dispatcher service

short_summary: Relates to notification of changes to the model contract with managed care providers under the medical assistance program

summary: Relates to court ordered forensic evaluations and reports in child custody and visitation proceedings.

short_summary: Creates a private right of action for improper debt collection procedures

summary: Establishes the metropolitan commuter transportation district fee tax credit for persons required to pay such fee.

summary: Prohibits insurers from selling policies of insurance which duplicate existing coverage relative to long term health care policies.

summary: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities, or that provide educational services to students from such communities.

summary: Prohibits the governing board of a municipal corporation from adopting any law, ordinance, regulation or policy that prohibits, or has the effect of prohibiting, the connection or reconnection of a utility service to a customer based upon the type or source of energy to be delivered to the customer.

summary: Directs the department of agriculture and markets to establish a grading system for retail food stores, food service establishments and food warehouses.
