summary: Enacts the "Wandering Officers Act" prohibiting provisional or permanent appointment of a person as a police officer if such person has previously been fired as a police officer from any jurisdiction within or without the state, if such person left a position as a police officer either while under an investigation or while being the subject of a disciplinary action which could result in termination from any jurisdiction within or without the state, or if such person resigned while criminal charges were pending stemming from actions committed while on duty as a police officer in any jurisdiction within or without the state.

short_summary: Relates to police staffing at certain parks
summary: Relates to police staffing at certain parks; bases the number of officers deployed to regions upon a percentage of the region's park attendance average.

short_summary: Provides for the authority of the department of health to engage in or support research on the health effects of artificial night light
summary: Provides for authority of the department of health to engage in or support research on the health effects of artificial night light.

short_summary: Relates to the timely cashing of rent checks
summary: Relates to the timely cashing of rent checks; requires a landlord to cash a rent check provided by a tenant in his or her possession within thirty days after the check is postmarked.

short_summary: Includes aggravated harassment in the first degree under a specified offense
summary: Includes aggravated harassment in the first degree under a specified offense.

short_summary: Requires law enforcement agents and peace officers to record information pertaining to the race of persons they have meaningful interactions with in their memo books
summary: Requires law enforcement agents and peace officers to record information in their memo books pertaining to the race of persons with whom they have meaningful interactions.

short_summary: Prohibits public funding to facilities using aversive interventions
summary: Prohibits public funding to facilities or programs using aversive interventions on children; establishes a holistic autism spectrum disorder treatment center.

short_summary: Authorizes the establishment of the home equity protection insurance program
summary: Authorizes the establishment of the home equity protection insurance program directing the agency to issue a commitment to insure and insure the full value of certain residences which are owner-occupied by persons who meet certain income qualifications.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Trooper Joseph J. Gallagher Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system on the Long Island Expressway, county of Suffolk, as the "Trooper Joseph J. Gallagher Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Establishes a spending cap and increases the maximum capacity of the rainy day fund
summary: Establishes a spending cap; increases the maximum capacity of the rainy day fund.

short_summary: Allows schools to provide water safety instruction to students in grades kindergarten through twelve
summary: Allows schools to provide water safety instruction to students in grades kindergarten through twelve; allows for the commissioner of education to provide technical assistance to develop curricula for water safety instruction.

short_summary: Prohibits individuals in certain positions from taking any position with a business or entity doing business with an agency or industrial development authority
summary: Prohibits individuals in certain positions from taking any position with a business or entity doing business with an agency or industrial development authority.

short_summary: Relates to the health and environmental impacts of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, and the manufacturing thereof
summary: Educates the public about the health and environmental impacts of lithium-ion battery use and manufacture on air, water and soil.

short_summary: Establishes the marine electric propulsion health and environmental impact program
summary: Establishes the marine electric propulsion health and environmental impact program to provide education, advocacy and increased awareness of the environmental and health impacts of marine electric propulsion systems.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a statewide study and review of the transportation of individuals with developmental disabilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of transportation, in consultation with the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities, to conduct a statewide study and review of the transportation of individuals with developmental disabilities.

short_summary: Establishes a contraband screening plan which includes a canine at the entrance of each correctional facility
summary: Establishes a contraband screening plan which includes a canine at the entrance of each correctional facility to detect the presence of illegal drugs.

short_summary: Requires abandoned property escheat to the Indian nation or tribe that historically occupied the land or to nearest nation or tribe; repealer
summary: Requires abandoned property escheat to the Indian nation or tribe that historically occupied the land or to the nearest nation or tribe; establishes such land shall be tribal land.

short_summary: Prohibits the mandated use of credit cards at state parks, recreational facilities or historic sites
summary: Prohibits the mandated use of credit cards at state parks, recreational facilities or historic sites.

short_summary: Requires the establishment of an annual employment statistics index for unemployment rate of hamlets and villages of the state
summary: Requires the commissioner of labor to adopt regulations prescribing the methodology for establishing an annual employment statistics index which shows unemployment rates of hamlets and unincorporated villages of the state; directs such commissioner shall prepare and submit an annual report on such index.

short_summary: Relates to the residency requirements of certain public officers of political subdivisions or municipal corporations of the state
summary: Relates to the residency requirements of certain public officers of political subdivisions or municipal corporations of the state; prohibits certain officers from being required to forego or make a payment or satisfy a levy due to him or her becoming a nonresident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of education to provide for the availability of adequate supplies for use by left-handed students
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to provide for the proportionate availability of adequate school supplies for use by left-handed students where adequate supplies are available for use by right-handed students; applies to any school supplies and equipment purchased by the department or schools on or after the effective date of rules and regulations promulgated by the commissioner of education.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a deadbeats most wanted list and worldwide web page
summary: Establishes a deadbeats most wanted list and worldwide web page.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of education to promulgate regulations providing for the decertification of a teacher convicted of a felony
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to promulgate regulations that provide for the immediate decertification of any teacher who is convicted of a felony under NY law or any offense under the laws of another jurisdiction that would be a felony under NY law.

short_summary: Relates to licenses to carry and possess firearms for police officers
summary: Relates to licenses to carry and possess firearms for police officers; authorizes police officers to apply for a firearms license that is valid throughout the state.

short_summary: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
summary: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple participating states, thereby enhancing the portability of a medical license and ensuring the safety of patients.

short_summary: Enacts the New York state senior housing opportunities partnership act and establishes a state senior housing opportunities partnership authority
summary: Enacts the New York state senior housing opportunities partnership act; establishes the New York state senior housing opportunities partnership authority; provides that such authority will finance or collaborate in the financing of senior housing opportunities facility projects.

short_summary: Provides employers with the opportunity to register for emergency alerts from the state of New York public safety alert mass notification system
summary: Provides employers the opportunity to register for emergency alerts from the state of New York public safety alert mass notification system.

short_summary: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals
summary: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals; prohibits a health care professional from engaging, assisting or planning the torture or improper treatment of an incarcerated individual; requires health care professionals to report torture and improper treatment.

short_summary: Prohibits non-disclosure clauses in leases of real property to be used for hydraulic fracturing
summary: Prohibits non-disclosure clauses in leases of real property to be used for hydraulic fracturing.

short_summary: Relates to the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways
summary: Relates to the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways.

short_summary: Enacts the "just energy transition act"
summary: Enacts the "just energy transition act"; creates the just energy transition task force; requires a study of competitive options to facilitate the phase-out, replacement and redevelopment of New York state's oldest and most-polluting fossil-fueled power generation facilities and their sites by the year 2040.

short_summary: Relates to the availability of certain benefits to exonerees; repealer
summary: Relates to claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment and the availability of certain benefits and entitlements to exonerees; allows for sealing of records, payment of awards and payment of attorney's fees; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

short_summary: Provides for corporate franchise tax and personal income tax check-offs for taxpayer gifts for diabetes research and education; establishes diabetes fund
summary: Provides for a corporate franchise tax check-off and a personal income tax check-off for taxpayer gifts for diabetes research and education; establishes the diabetes research and education fund.

short_summary: Enacts the lead pipe right to know act
summary: Enacts the lead pipe right to know act requiring public water systems to take service line inventories and make such information available to the public.

short_summary: Relates to the practice of professional geology
summary: Relates to the practice of professional geology.

short_summary: Requires certain state owned and operated parking facilities to install and maintain charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles
summary: Requires certain state owned and operated parking facilities to install and maintain charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles.

short_summary: Requires landowners to be notified of a petroleum discharge
summary: Provides that upon notification of a petroleum discharge, the department of environmental conservation shall notify the municipal chief executive and landowners or tenants adjacent to or neighboring the site of the discharge whose property or drinking water supply may be potentially impacted by such discharge.

short_summary: Requires licensed or certified school social workers in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school
summary: Requires at least one full-time licensed or certified school social worker to be employed in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high school and senior high school throughout the state.

short_summary: Relates to the money deposited as bail by charitable bail organizations
summary: Relates to the money deposited as bail by charitable bail organizations; removes maximum authorized amount of money allowed to be deposited by such organizations.

short_summary: Provides for the protection of the air quality at day care centers licensed by the state and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law
summary: Provides for the protection of the air quality at licensed day care centers and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law; requires the office of children and family services to consult with the commissioners of environmental conservation and health regarding the air quality and environmental hazards that may be involved with any new day care center or head start day care center; requires such office to consult with the department of health if any new environmental or environmental health hazard arises.

short_summary: Provides for the automated identification of affordability program participants
summary: Provides for the automated identification of affordability program participants to enable such participants to be automatically entered into utility corporation energy affordability programs.

short_summary: Relates to imposing a specific tax on all corporate stock buybacks of issued shares
summary: Relates to imposing a tax of one-half of one percent on all corporate stock buybacks of issued shares.

short_summary: Provides for the development of an environmental health tracking system within the department of health with cooperation from certain other agencies
summary: Provides for the development of an environmental health tracking system within the department of health with cooperation from the departments of environmental conservation and labor; provides that the purpose is to gather various environmental data to correlate with disease data; requires the cooperation of the state university of New York schools of public health at Albany and Buffalo.

short_summary: Requires training for teachers, administrators and instructors in the area of mental health response training
summary: Requires training for teachers, administrators and instructors in the area of mental health response; requires office of mental health to assist in development of curriculum for training.

short_summary: Allows certain members of a public body to be counted as present for quorum purposes at meetings attended remotely
summary: Allows members of a public body who cannot physically attend a meeting due to a disability to be counted as present for quorum purposes at meetings attended remotely.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Warren to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Warren to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into subdivisions
summary: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into two separate subdivisions.

short_summary: Requires the county seat in Herkimer county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
summary: Requires the county seat in Herkimer county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

short_summary: Grants tax credit for downpayment made on residential housing
summary: Grants credit against personal income tax to purchasers of residential housing in the amount of any downpayment made on such housing; provides that the maximum credit shall not exceed 5 percent of the purchase price of the residential housing; requires taxpayers to meet eligibility requirements imposed by the state of New York mortgage agency.

short_summary: Relates to the participation by free association libraries in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes the participation by free association libraries in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

short_summary: Creates the real property regulatory impacts act
summary: Creates the real property regulatory impacts act; provides that the owner of any real property may bring an action against the state whenever the application of any state statute, rule or regulation to such property causes a diminution in value of fifty percent or more.

short_summary: Relates to the remediation and prevention of indoor mold
summary: Relates to the remediation and prevention of indoor mold; requires notification to prospective lessees.

short_summary: Relates to conditional release for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs
summary: Relates to conditional release for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs; provides release twelve months before the completion of the controlling minimum period of imprisonment for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs.

short_summary: Relates to delaying the implementation of class size reduction plans and including additional exemptions to class size targets
summary: Relates to delaying the implementation of class size reduction plans and including additional exemptions to class size targets; provides such plans shall begin in September 2029 and be achieved by September 2034; adds gifted and talented schools and programs, screened admissions schools and programs, portfolio and specialized high schools and advanced placement classes.

short_summary: Limits the potency of cannabis products
summary: Limits the potency of cannabis flower to 15 percent THC in flowers and 25 percent THC in other cannabis or hemp products.

short_summary: Directs a pilot program for the use of digital license plates
summary: Directs a pilot program for the use of digital license plates on motor vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 children scholarship
summary: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 children scholarship; provides that children whose parent, primary caretaker or sibling died or was disabled as a result of contracting COVID-19 shall be eligible for such scholarship.

short_summary: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history
summary: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history; establishes time frames for public agencies to respond to such applications; requires public agencies to report information regarding granting licenses annually.

short_summary: Relates to taking big and small game by crossbow in Wyoming county
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to authorize the use of a crossbow for the taking of big and small game by any licensed person for use during the entirety of the archery-only season within Wyoming county.

short_summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide sixty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide sixty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

short_summary: Implements licensure and eligibility limitations for the cannabis control board's social and economic equity plan
summary: Implements licensure and eligibility limitations for the cannabis control board's social and economic equity plan regarding persons convicted of certain felonies.

short_summary: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature
summary: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to the abandonment of certain town roads in the towns of Pike and Genesee Falls, in the county of Wyoming
summary: Authorizes that the commissioner of transportation is authorized and directed to assume jurisdiction for state highway purposes over the town road described as follows: all of Griffith road from the intersection with state routes 19 and 39 in the town of Pike easterly to its terminus at state route 19A in the town of Genesee Falls.

short_summary: Authorizes the chief administrator of the courts to require and provide annual training regarding bail, recognizance, and commitment procedures and standards
summary: Authorizes the chief administrator of the courts to require and provide at least three hours of annual training regarding bail, recognizance, and commitment procedures and standards for all judges exercising preliminary jurisdiction over any offense.

short_summary: Requires health care providers and practitioners to provide patients with a list of ingredients contained in vaccines
summary: Requires health care providers and practitioners to provide patients with a list of ingredients contained in vaccines, the manufacturer product insert, the vaccines' potential side effects and where to report vaccine-adverse events forty-eight hours prior to immunization.

short_summary: Allows an authorized organization to receive a license to hold a game of chance on Easter Sunday and Christmas Day
summary: Allows an authorized organization to receive a license to hold a game of chance on Easter Sunday and Christmas Day; eliminates time restrictions for such games held on a Sunday.

short_summary: Excludes certain actions from reporting requirements relating to environmental quality reviews
summary: Excludes from reporting requirements relating to environmental quality reviews actions to approve the siting or construction of housing in cities with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to accessing substance use disorder services based on the individual's gender identity or expression and preference
summary: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to assure that persons who suffer from a substance use disorder have the right to seek and receive addiction services, care, treatment and rehabilitation services based on the individual's gender identity, gender expression and/or sexual orientation.

short_summary: Provides for rules and regulations for strip searches in correctional facilities
summary: Directs the state commission of correction to promulgate rules and regulations for strip searches in correctional facilities which at a minimum include a requirement that no fewer than two staff members shall be present for any strip search.

short_summary: Relates to permitting farmers markets in state and local parks
summary: Encourages farmers' markets in state parks by posting related information, identifying opportunities and coordinating with other state agencies.

short_summary: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver before expiration of such license
summary: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver at least 90 days before expiration of such license.

short_summary: Requires racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity
summary: Requires racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity.

short_summary: Relates to the powers and authority of the state commission on judicial conduct
summary: Requires the state commission on judicial conduct to transmit its annual budget request to the governor for inclusion in the executive budget without revision; relates to complaints regarding judges and confidentiality of records; extends the jurisdiction of the state commission on judicial conduct as to judges who resign or retire while under investigation or formal charges.

short_summary: Provides public access to epinephrine auto-injector devices at schools
summary: Provides public access to epinephrine auto-injector devices at schools; establishes public access epinephrine auto-injector device providers.

short_summary: Establishes pricing restrictions for certain contracts involving care package vendors
summary: Establishes requirements for certain contracts involving DOCCS and third-party care package vendors; prohibits vendors from charging more for a product than the price of the same or similar item in the commissary plus actual shipping costs.

short_summary: Establishes an agrivoltaics research program
summary: Establishes an agrivoltaics research program to develop innovative science-based solutions to facilitate the co-location of crops and photovoltaics while promoting the biodiversity of endemic flora and fauna.

short_summary: Relates to increasing access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation
summary: Increases access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation.

short_summary: Relates to the identification of Asian Lunar New Year and the declaration of such day as a public holiday
summary: Directs the secretary of the senate and the clerk of the assembly to identify the date of Asian Lunar New Year; declares such day as a public holiday each year.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Peter Wheeler Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in Tompkins county as the "Peter Wheeler Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates
summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Authorizes Michael Telesca to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the county of Livingston
summary: Authorizes Michael Telesca to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the county of Livingston.

short_summary: Relates to school anti-violence activities
summary: Provides funding for school anti-violence education programs through the omnibus school violence prevention grant program.

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben
summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a New York State Sound Basic Education Commission to study current educational needs and recommend a new foundation aid formula; appropriation
summary: Establishes a New York State Sound Basic Education Commission to study current educational needs and recommend a new foundation aid formula which will provide all students in the state a meaningful opportunity for a sound basic education in a cost efficient manner.

short_summary: Prohibits geofencing by digital advertisers at health care facilities
summary: Prohibits digital advertisers from establishing a virtual "geofence" around a health care facility that enables the advertiser to send targeted advertisements to any cellphones or mobile devices that enter such health care facility; prohibits the delivery of digital advertisements to persons in a health care facility using geofencing technology.

short_summary: Relates to surrogacy programs and agreements
summary: Relates to the requirements of surrogacy programs and criteria for surrogacy arrangements.

short_summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to identify flammable or hazardous materials near above-ground and grade level tracks
summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in conjunction with the Long Island Rail Road, to identify flammable or hazardous materials near above-ground and grade level tracks and make recommendations for removal of such materials.

short_summary: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance
summary: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "SP4 Herman Emil Anders, Jr. Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system constituting the bridge on state route 79, crossing over the Chenango River and connecting the town of Greene, county of Chenango, with the town of Fenton, county of Broome, as the "SP4 Herman Emil Anders, Jr. Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank
summary: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank including injunctions and the conduct of delinquency proceedings against insurers domiciled in this state.

short_summary: Establishes a co-navigation services program for persons who are deaf-blind
summary: Establishes a co-navigation services program for persons who are deaf-blind to provide services to a person who is deaf-blind that assist the person to physically access the person's environment and to make informed decisions, including providing visual and environmental information or sighted guide services and assisting with communication accessibility by communicating in the preferred language and communication mode of the person who is deaf-blind.

short_summary: Establishes a duty to inform maternity patients about the risks associated with cesarean section for patients undergoing a primary cesarean section
summary: Establishes a duty to inform maternity patients about the risks associated with cesarean section for patients undergoing a primary cesarean section; establishes a duty to inform maternity patients about the reason for performing a primary cesarean section delivery.

short_summary: Requires certain waste transported by rail to be covered with hard tarping
summary: Requires putrescible and non-putrescible waste to be covered by a hard tarp when transported by rail.

short_summary: Establishes the volunteer fire departments capital fund; appropriation
summary: Establishes the volunteer fire departments capital fund under the office of fire prevention and control; appropriates funds for such capital fund.

short_summary: Requires that certain school personnel are properly trained in the treatment of severe allergies and anaphylaxis and the administration of glucagon or an emergency epinephrine auto injector
summary: Requires that every licensed nurse, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or physician employed by a school shall have completed proper training in the assessment, management and treatment of severe allergies and anaphylaxis; requires that every school shall have at least two unlicensed school personnel who are trained to administer glucagon or an emergency epinephrine auto injector; requires in elementary schools and other schools where students learn in a single classroom that the teacher of such class be trained in the administration of glucagon or an emergency epinephrine auto injector.

short_summary: Directs state agencies to adopt a sustainability and decarbonization program
summary: Directs state agencies to adopt a sustainability and decarbonization program; establishes a GreenNY council which will develop sustainable procurement specifications, issue operational directives and guidance for construction, issue a waste diversion plan template for agencies and provide agencies with information on reducing use of toxic substances; requires agencies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of any vapor or tobacco products containing the substance ethyl menthane carboxamide
summary: Prohibits the sale of any vapor or tobacco products containing the substance N-Ethyl-p-menthane-3-carboxamide, which creates a cooling sensation similar to menthol.

short_summary: Enacts the sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act
summary: Enacts the "sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act"; exempts or limits environmental review under SEQR for the construction of certain new residential units to avoid creating unnecessary housing sprawl; limits certain rights to action under SEQR; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale or delivery of candy products containing THC in the state
summary: Prohibits the sale or delivery, or agreement of sale or delivery, or giving away of candy products containing THC in the state.

short_summary: Relates to tax lien foreclosure
summary: Relates to tax lien foreclosure; establishes senior, disabled, and veteran homeowner real property tax assistance program; establishes installment plans for certain real property taxes.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems
summary: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems.

short_summary: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons
summary: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons until such prison is reopened, used by another state agency, or is conveyed to a non-governmental entity.

short_summary: Relates to standards for the manufacture and sale of lithium-ion batteries
summary: Prohibits the sale of lithium-ion batteries used in micromobility devices, bicycles with electric assist or limited use motorcycles unless such batteries are manufactured in accordance with certain standards and specifications; provides a civil penalty; authorizes district attorneys, county attorneys, and corporation counsel to have concurrent authority to seek the relief.

short_summary: Authorizes the spouses of certain volunteer firefighters to be issued a distinctive license plate for volunteer firefighters
summary: Authorizes the spouses of certain volunteer firefighters to be issued a distinctive license plate for volunteer firefighters.

short_summary: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth
summary: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the War Dog Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the village of Herkimer, county of Herkimer, as the "War Dog Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Requires the SUNY and CUNY boards of trustees to establish a policy for the awarding of posthumous degrees
summary: Requires the SUNY and CUNY boards of trustees and boards of trustees of community colleges to establish a policy for the awarding of posthumous degrees; requires such policy to waive any remaining credits for enrolled matriculated students who die and would otherwise have been eligible for graduation had they been able to complete their academic career.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or distribution of expanded polystyrene containers that are designed or intended to be used for cold storage
summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or distribution of expanded polystyrene containers that are designed or intended to be used for cold storage beginning January 1, 2026.

short_summary: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches
summary: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches; requires youth league coaches to be trained in adult and child CPR and the use of an automated external defibrillator; provides current coaches have one year from the effective date of the law to receive such training; provides that a person who is unable to complete a training due to a physical disability may coach as long as a person who has completed a training is present at all times.

short_summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for non-opioid treatments utilized for pain management
summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for non-opioid treatments utilized for pain management including, but not limited to a drug or biological product that is indicated to produce analgesia without acting upon the body's opioid receptors that has demonstrated the ability to replace, reduce, or avoid opioid use or the quantity of opioids prescribed; or an implantable, reusable, or disposable medical device for the intended use of managing or treating pain that has demonstrated the ability to replace, reduce, or avoid opioid use or the quantity of opioids prescribed.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Permits the Cleveland Hill union free school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
summary: Permits the Cleveland Hill union free school district to establish an insurance reserve fund.

short_summary: Initiates a five-year moratorium on the dissolution of any urban rental Mitchell-Lama company and establishes a Mitchell-Lama housing program study
summary: Initiates a five-year moratorium on the dissolution of any urban rental Mitchell-Lama company; establishes a Mitchell-Lama housing program study.

short_summary: Relates to the standard of proof for determination of eligibility for public housing based upon remaining family member status
summary: Relates to the standard of proof for determination of eligibility for public housing based upon remaining family member status.

short_summary: Requires testing the radon level of gas produced, sold, purchased, acquired, stored or injected and prohibits certain gas from entering the distribution system
summary: Requires testing the radon level of gas produced, sold, purchased, acquired, stored or injected; prohibits gas with a radon content greater than 2 pCi/L from entering the distribution system.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit for small businesses employing a person previously convicted of a crime
summary: Provides a tax credit for small businesses employing a person previously convicted of a crime; provides a tax credit of one thousand five hundred dollars for each person employed.

short_summary: Provides that the sale of real property owned by the N.Y. city housing authority to a private entity must be approved by the state legislature
summary: Provides that the sale of real property owned by the NYC housing authority to a private entity must be approved by the state legislature.

short_summary: Authorizes school districts to establish an insurance reserve fund
summary: Authorizes school districts to establish an insurance reserve fund in an amount and manner determined by a qualified and independent actuary certified by the American Academy of Actuaries to be reasonable and necessary.

short_summary: Establishes a sales tax exemption for energy storage
summary: Establishes sales tax exemptions for residential and commercial energy storage systems equipment.

short_summary: Defines lease-hold retirement community and proscribes rules and regulations for ownership and operation thereof
summary: Sets up rules and regulations for the operation of lease-hold retirement communities to provide adequate housing for senior citizens wishing to retire and locate in a lease-hold retirement community; grants owners of homes in lease-hold retirement communities the right to sell their homes by methods common to sales of residential property; requires that owners of lease-hold retirement communities offer owners of homes the option to sign a long-term ninety-nine year lease.

short_summary: Establishes an emergency heating energy assistance program benefit
summary: Establishes an emergency heating energy assistance program benefit to provide emergency assistance to certain households where such household is threatened with shut-off or an energy emergency due to nonpayment.

short_summary: Provides incarcerated individuals with access to breast cancer screenings and information about breast self-examinations
summary: Provides incarcerated individuals with access to breast cancer screenings every two years and information about breast self-examinations.

short_summary: Relates to tuition assistance for students completing programs of micro-credentialing
summary: Provides tuition assistance program awards for students completing programs of micro-credentialing; includes micro-credential programs in reports which determine community college funding.

short_summary: Establishes the housing for an equitable reentry and opportunity (HERO) act
summary: Establishes the housing for an equitable reentry and opportunity (HERO) act to prohibit housing discrimination on the basis of criminal legal system involvement; defines criminal legal system involvement.

short_summary: Increases the fines imposed on a corporation for an offense defined within the penal law
summary: Increases the fines imposed on a corporation for an offense defined within the penal law.

short_summary: Enacts the single opportunity for legislative equality (SOLE) act
summary: Entitles each member of the legislature to bring one statewide piece of legislation of his or her choosing to the floor for a vote without a home rule message and committee review during each two-year term.

short_summary: Requires candidates for office to caption their video advertisements
summary: Requires that all candidates for elected local, state or federal office shall be required to caption any video advertisement which is viewed by the general public.

short_summary: Requires that in the event a complaint made to local code enforcement results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order
summary: Requires that when a complaint is made to local code enforcement of a violation of the uniform fire prevention and building code which results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order.

short_summary: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production
summary: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of DNA phenotyping in criminal prosecutions and proceedings
summary: Prohibits the use of DNA phenotyping in criminal prosecutions and proceedings.

short_summary: Provides for reimbursement for schools to transition from native names, logos, and mascots
summary: Provides for reimbursement for schools to transition from native names, logos, and mascots for the actual costs of such transition.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the New York child data privacy and protection act
summary: Enacts the New York child data privacy protection act to prevent the exploitation of children's data; requires data controllers to assess the impact of its products on children for review by the bureau of internet and technology; bans certain data collection and targeted advertising.

short_summary: Relates to services for post-traumatic stress disorder for emergency dispatchers and correction officers
summary: Requires the same benefits and services for post-traumatic stress disorder for emergency dispatchers and correction officers as are afforded police and firefighters.

short_summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation; repeals such commission.

short_summary: Authorizes certain exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters
summary: Authorizes exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters residing in such school district.

short_summary: Provides for mental home health care services for the aging
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of mental health and the director of the state office for the aging shall establish a mental home health services program for the aging to facilitate access to mental home health services to respond to identified mental health needs, including those needs that may have resulted from the COVID-19 pandemic, and for the aging or families that may not have access to mental health professionals in-person; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Extends certain provisions relating to a partial tax abatement for residential real property held in the cooperative or condominium form
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to a partial tax abatement for residential real property held in the cooperative or condominium form of ownership in a city having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Requires the office of victim services to provide notification of potential eligibility for awards following the death of a victim of a crime who died as a direct result of such crime
summary: Requires the office of victim services to provide notification of potential eligibility for crime victims' awards; directs the state police and the municipal police training council to develop procedures for notifying next of kin of available programs and services upon in-person death notifications.

short_summary: Authorizes the acceptance of an application for a retroactive property tax exemption from the Center for Jewish Life of Hewlett Inc.
summary: Authorizes the acceptance of an application for a retroactive property tax exemption from the Center for Jewish Life of Hewlett Inc. for a portion of the 2021--2022 school year taxes and a portion of the 2022 general year assessment roll.

short_summary: Provides for the care of retired law enforcement dogs
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish a program for the care of retired law enforcement dogs which shall cover the cost of veterinary care for retired law enforcement dogs for the remainder of the lifetime of such dogs.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Relates to procedures for certain temporary custody orders
summary: Establishes procedures for temporary custody orders that include a fifty-fifty rebuttable presumption that the parents shall have temporary joint legal and shared physical custody and shall share equal parenting time.

short_summary: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation
summary: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation.

short_summary: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time
summary: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time in connection with the emergency disconnection of utilities.

short_summary: Relates to refunds by public utility companies to overcharged customers
summary: Requires the public service commission to conduct a review within fifteen days when a residential customer of a public utility company alleges that the public utility company has overcharged the customer for service and to refund the overcharge within thirty days; provides for penalties; requires the public service commission to promulgate rules and regulations.

short_summary: Eliminates annual service charge of 25 dollars on issuance of special number plates to veterans of the armed forces
summary: Eliminates the annual service charge on issuance of special number plates to veterans of the armed forces.

short_summary: Establishes Davina's driver accountability law which requires a uniform curriculum for accident prevention courses; repealer
summary: Establishes Davina's driver accountability law which requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a uniform curriculum for accident prevention courses for use by all sponsoring agencies, delivery agencies and instructors in this state; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Provides for the protection of health information
summary: Provides for the protection of health information; establishes requirements for communications to individuals about their health information; requires either written consent or a designated necessary purpose for the processing of an individual's health information.

short_summary: Authorizes an examination of records maintained by the excess line broker by the excess line association; extends the expiration thereof
summary: Authorizes an examination of records maintained by the excess line broker by the excess line association; extends the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Establishes the state all-electric building plan
summary: Establishes the state all-electric building plan to require the office of general services to transition all buildings owned by the state to be all-electric buildings.

short_summary: Relates to child care assistance under the child care block grant
summary: Provides that a caregiver shall be eligible for assistance for child care under the child care block grant regardless of the hours the parent actually works.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a video on the dangers of drowning for infants and young children to be viewed by a parent and/or parents of newborn children
summary: Relates to establishing a video on the dangers of drowning for infants and young children to be viewed by a parent and/or parents of newborn children.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the power authority of the state of New York to post on its website and develop a corresponding mobile application with information on electric vehicle charging stations
summary: Relates to requiring the power authority of the state of New York to post on its website and develop a corresponding mobile application with information on electric vehicle charging stations; requires the website and mobile application include a map with the addresses of each electric vehicle charging station in the state, whether the charging station is located in a parking lot, parking garage or on a street, whether there are fees required to use a charging station, and whether a charging station is out of service or otherwise unavailable.

short_summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

short_summary: Requires certain housing production information to be reported to the department of state
summary: Requires local boards and the division of housing and community renewal to submit certain residential housing and zoning information to the department of state annually; requires such information to be published by the department of state on its website.

short_summary: Requires that the city council appoint members to, designate the chairman of, fill vacancies of and remove members of the rent guidelines board
summary: Requires that the city council appoint members to, designate the chairman of, fill vacancies of and remove members of the rent guidelines board.

short_summary: Allows evidence of a defendant's prior sexual assault to be admissible in a sexual assault proceeding
summary: Allows evidence of a defendant's prior sexual offense to be admissible in a sexual assault proceeding.

short_summary: Relates to adjournments for right to counsel
summary: Provides that in any jurisdiction in which a party is eligible under local law for free legal counsel, if such party has in good faith attempted to secure such counsel and is unable to obtain counsel through no fault of their own, the court shall adjourn the trial of the issue for consecutive periods of not less than fourteen days each until the party is able to secure counsel.

short_summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Jefferson
summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Jefferson.

short_summary: Relates to the New York state dental faculty loan forgiveness incentive program
summary: Relates to the New York state dental faculty loan forgiveness incentive program.

short_summary: Establishes a community gardening grant program to strengthen local food chain resiliency
summary: Establishes the food chain resiliency through community gardening grant program to expand, establish, or maintain community gardens for the purpose of strengthening the resiliency of local food supply chains.

short_summary: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state
summary: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state; requires short-term rental hosts and short-term rental hosting platforms inform nearby property owners when nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders are staying in the unit.

short_summary: Establishes the University of the State of New York environmental sustainability office
summary: Establishes the university of the state of New York environmental sustainability office to lead the coordination, planning and implementation of policies, programs, and processes to fulfill the university's sustainability obligations and targets cohesively, across all university campuses, and at the system level.

short_summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study of the technical and economic feasibility and ratepayer impact of a zero emission electrical system
summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study of the technical and economic feasibility and ratepayer impact of a zero-emission electrical system and a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.

short_summary: Provides grant funding, where available, for broadband services in non-competitive locations
summary: Provides grant funding, where available, for broadband services in non-competitive locations through the ConnectAll deployment program.

short_summary: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal
summary: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal to ensure all vehicular traffic is stopped while pedestrians are crossing in the same intersection.

short_summary: Requires places of public assembly to maintain epinephrine auto-injector devices and to have at least one employee who is trained in its use
summary: Requires that functional epinephrine auto-injector devices be made available in places of public assembly and that at least one employee or volunteer of such place of public assembly be trained in its proper operation and use and be present at each facility function.

short_summary: Extends and enhances the empire state film production credit and the empire state film post production credit
summary: Extends and enhances the empire state film production credit and the empire state film post production credit.

short_summary: Requires information about fentanyl test strips and their uses on information cards or sheets
summary: Provides that when informational cards or sheets about opioid antagonists are distributed, such information shall include information about fentanyl strips and their uses.

short_summary: Establishes the fentanyl and xylazine test strip program
summary: Provides free fentanyl test strips to individuals at specified distribution facilities; requires a public awareness campaign on the dangers of fentanyl and the provision of the test strips.

short_summary: Relates to prevailing wage requirements applicable to public works and certain construction projects performed under private contract
summary: Relates to prevailing wage requirements applicable to public works and certain construction projects performed under private contract and paid for with public funds.

short_summary: Relates to enabling constitutionally-qualified electors to register to vote and to cast a ballot on the same day at a polling location
summary: Enables constitutionally-qualified electors to register to vote and to cast a ballot on the same day at a polling location.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the expiration of the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax for two years.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the penalties for passing a stopped school bus
summary: Requires suspension of a driver's license for a period of 60 days when a driver is convicted of passing a stopped school bus twice in 18 months.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting corporal punishment in schools
summary: Prohibits the use of corporal punishment, as defined by the commissioner of education, in schools.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of corporal punishment in schools
summary: Prohibits the use of corporal punishment in schools; defines corporal punishment to include prohibiting the use of aversive interventions and time out rooms.

short_summary: Provides for the performance of medical services by physician assistants
summary: Permits the performance of medical services by a physician assistant without the supervision of a physician as appropriate to the physician assistant's scope of practice, education and training where such physician assistant has practiced for more than three thousand six hundred hours.

short_summary: Relates to providing state correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan
summary: Relates to providing state correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan.

short_summary: Designates as peace officers certain Ogdensburg Bridge and Port Authority security personnel
summary: Designates as peace officers certain Ogdensburg Bridge and Port Authority security personnel specifically for such airport.

short_summary: Relates hydraulic dredging for commercial purposes in the waters of Mill Neck Creek in the town of Oyster Bay, county of Nassau
summary: Prohibits any new permits, leases or any other agreements authorizing the hydraulic dredging for commercial purposes in the waters of Mill Neck Creek in the town of Oyster Bay, county of Nassau.

short_summary: Relates to adding spina bifida to the definition of developmental disability
summary: Relates to adding spina bifida to the definition of developmental disability in the mental hygiene law.

short_summary: Relates to designating the first Friday in February as the New York statewide school day to help people in need
summary: Relates to designating the first Friday in February as the "New York statewide school day to help people in need".

short_summary: Updates value capture mechanisms for NYC and the MTA
summary: Updates value capture mechanisms for NYC and the MTA, including transparency requirements; makes such provisions permanent.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements
summary: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements when such statements are required for an application for public assistance.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the FreshConnect program
summary: Expands the FreshConnect program, which provides rebates for the purchase of local produce to certain people, to include local produce sold in supermarkets and grocery stores.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Prohibits littering and dumping on state park lands
summary: Prohibits littering and dumping on state park lands and provides for penalties for violations.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of education to require public schools to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements
summary: Directs the state education commissioner to require public school districts to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements.

short_summary: Relates to guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in community centers
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in community centers; defines "community center".

short_summary: Establishes the bureau of the senior tenants' advocate in the state office for the aging
summary: Establishes the bureau of the senior tenants' advocate within the state office for the aging; provides that the senior tenants' advocate shall assist senior citizen tenants in resolving complaints they may have with the New York state division of housing and community renewal, landlord disputes, rent increases, and other housing related matters; provides that the governor shall appoint the senior tenants' advocate.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish a program to provide funding to emergency food providers to purchase prepared meals from New York restaurants and deliver them to families in need
summary: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets, in consultation with the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance, to establish a grant program to provide funding to emergency food providers to purchase prepared meals from New York restaurants and deliver them to families in need.

short_summary: Relates to vaccination of egg-laying hens against salmonella
summary: Relates to vaccination of egg-laying hens against salmonella.

short_summary: Relates to the installation and maintenance of playground equipment by the New York city housing authority
summary: Requires the installation and maintenance of playground equipment by the New York city housing authority to substantially comply with the guidelines and criteria contained in the handbook for public playground safety produced by the United States Consumer Products Safety Commission or any successor thereof.

short_summary: Authorizes the combination of certain petit larceny charges
summary: Provides that a person who has previously been subjected to two or more petit larceny convictions within 18 months immediately preceding the charge and the aggregate value of the property exceeds one thousand dollars, the person is guilty of grand larceny in the fourth degree.

short_summary: Requires social services districts to automatically re-enroll eligible persons or households for the low-income home energy assistance program
summary: Requires social services districts to, every heating season, automatically re-enroll persons or households currently receiving assistance through the low-income home energy assistance program, so long as each person or household maintains eligibility.

short_summary: Limits the amount of rent increases for residential ground lease cooperative apartment buildings and establishes certain rights upon the expiration of such leases
summary: Limits the amount of rent increases for residential ground lease cooperative apartment buildings; establishes certain rights upon the expiration of such leases.

short_summary: Relates to amending the 2022 capital projects budget
summary: Amends the 2022 capital projects budget to allow competitive grants to provide safety and security projects at nonprofit organizations at risk of hate crimes or attacks to be awarded to small businesses as defined by section 131 of the economic development law.

short_summary: Provides for the creation of a drug guide for seniors regarding the drugs commonly used by people over 62 years of age
summary: Provides for the creation of a drug guide for seniors regarding the drugs commonly used by people over 62 years of age; provides that such guide will include functions and drug interactions.

short_summary: Relates to requirements associated with the New York city community school district system
summary: Relates to requirements associated with the New York city community school district system.

short_summary: Includes the Olean Public Library with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority
summary: Includes the Olean Public Library with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of New York to reduce the interest accrued on certain charges assessed on real property located at 1690 60th Street in Brooklyn
summary: Requires the city of New York to reduce the interest accrued on certain charges assessed by the NYC department of health for inspections, clean-ups, examinations and other services performed between 1/21/97 and 11/9/99 on real property located at 1690 60th Street in Brooklyn.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps
summary: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps.

short_summary: Prohibits smoking in private passenger cars, vans or trucks where minors less than 14 years of age are passengers in such vehicles; penalties for violation
summary: Prohibits smoking in private passenger cars, vans and trucks where a minor less than 14 years of age is a passenger in such vehicles; provides for rebuttable presumption; provides that violations of such provisions shall be subject to a fine of not more than $100.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Major General Norbert J. Rappl Memorial Highway
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Major General Norbert J. Rappl Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Enacts the "hope card act"
summary: Enacts the "hope card act" directing the office of court administration to develop a program to issue hope cards containing the information regarding and content of a final order of protection to requesting petitioners who have received final orders of protection at no cost to such petitioner.

short_summary: Relates to access to mental health care services for emergency dispatchers
summary: Provides that a collective bargaining agreement or employment contract shall not require that an emergency dispatcher employed by a municipality obtain approval from, or provide notice to, a supervisor to access mental or behavioral health care services.

short_summary: Relates to newborn screening for duchenne muscular dystrophy
summary: Requires that newborns are tested for duchenne muscular dystrophy using a test validated by the Wadsworth center for laboratories and research; directs the Wadsworth center for laboratories and research to begin the process of testing validation upon the development of a test for duchenne muscular dystrophy.

short_summary: Makes migrant youth under the age of 25 eligible to receive housing vouchers under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program
summary: Makes migrant youth under the age of 25 who are receiving runaway and homeless youth services eligible to receive housing vouchers under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program.

short_summary: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit for travel on certain roadways
summary: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit to 70 mph for travel on roadways that currently have a maximum speed limit of 65 mph.

short_summary: Requires development and implementation of a comprehensive education campaign regarding the dangers of cannabinoid use
summary: Requires development and implementation of a comprehensive education campaign regarding the dangers of cannabinoid use.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to conduct a study of assessments, fees and tax rates, and associated policies of the state of New York relating to providers of telecommunications services
summary: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to conduct a study of assessments, fees and tax rates, and associated policies of the state of New York relating to providers of telecommunications services to ensure a more fair and proportional distribution of the assessments, fees and taxes imposed on telecommunications service providers and their end-use delivery customers.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan
summary: Provides that the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan shall not constitute doing an insurance business in this state; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to enrollment eligibility for federal, state and local court officials and their immediate families in the address confidentiality program
summary: Permits enrollment eligibility for federal, state and local court officials and their immediate families in the address confidentiality program to protect judicial officers.

short_summary: Relates to licensing and other provisions relating to firearms; repealed
summary: Relates to licensing and other provisions relating to firearms.

short_summary: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions
summary: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions; establishes an energy efficiency improvement board to approve the abatements and exemptions.

short_summary: Relates to an engineering technology degree
summary: Provides that an applicant with a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering technology and an applicant with a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering shall have the same number of education and experience credit requirements, shall have the same eligibility for an identification card as "an engineer in training", as well as examination and examination eligibility requirements.

short_summary: Establishes a highway and depot charging needs evaluation
summary: Establishes a highway and depot charging needs evaluation to assist in achieving targets set forth by the climate leadership and community protection act, zero-emissions vehicle sales target and regulations, including the advanced clean truck, advanced clean cars II rules and the zero-emissions school bus mandate.

short_summary: Provides for income access services in the state
summary: Provides for the licensing and regulation of income access services in the state.

short_summary: Enacts the "Lead-Free Homes Act"
summary: Enacts the "Lead Free Homes Act"; requires the department of health to promulgate standards for lead remediation and abatement of exemption; provides tax credits to class A multiple dwelling owners who undertake a successful lead remediation or abatement; requires lead testing on drinking water prior to the sale of residential property; requires owners of class A multiple dwellings to perform lead testing and provides for fines for violations.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing police/fire members of the New York city fire department pension fund to obtain credit for service as an EMT member
summary: Authorizes police/fire members of the New York city fire department pension fund to obtain credit for certain prior service as an EMT member.

short_summary: Relates to extending the exclusion of indebtedness contracted for sewage facilities
summary: Extends the period of time for which a municipality has the power to exclude indebtedness contracted for sewage facilities.

short_summary: Relates to the dates to file a designating petition
summary: Relates to the dates to file a designating petition; provides for the repeal of such provisions.

short_summary: Awards high school diplomas to veterans; repealer
summary: Allows any veteran who has served this nation to be awarded a high school degree based on their knowledge and experience gained while in service.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting sexual harassment by certain individuals
summary: Prohibits officers or employees of a state agency, members of the legislature or legislative employees from committing acts of sexual harassment while serving in his or her official capacity.

short_summary: Requires additional investigation of certain claims of abuse or maltreatment
summary: Requires additional investigation when three or more claims of abuse or maltreatment of a child are made relating to the same person; requires such person to be investigated and evaluated at least once a year for the next five years from the date of the last report.

short_summary: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license
summary: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license.

short_summary: Relates to the quantity of disabled person plates issued to a person with disabilities
summary: Relates to the quantity of disabled person plates issued to a disabled person.

short_summary: Relates to determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial
summary: Provides for the use of restoration services when determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations related to the timeframe for increases to patients' bills
summary: Requires the commissioner of health, in conjunction with the superintendent of financial services, to promulgate rules and regulations requiring that any increase in a bill from a hospital or health system or health care provider shall be sent to a patient no later than ninety days after the original bill was paid in full by such patient and good cause be shown for such increase, unless such increase is the result of any action by such patient.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain fees be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund
summary: Relates to requiring application fees for the issuance of operating certificates be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund.

short_summary: Relates to the justice center for the protection of people with special needs
summary: Relates to special prosecutors and sworn investigators employed by the justice center for the protection of people with special needs.

short_summary: Relates to disability retirement benefits for deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations
summary: Provides accidental disability retirement benefits for deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, and cleanup operations.

short_summary: Relates to undisclosed self-dealing
summary: Prohibits conduct in an official capacity in connection with the award of a public contract or public grant that is intended to confer an undisclosed benefit on a public servant, a person with whom a public servant has a business or other financial relationship.

short_summary: Relates to the processing of health claims
summary: Requires the use of the current edition of American medical association's current procedural terminology (CPT) with respect to claims for evaluation and management codes.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing bail and pre-trial detention for arson felonies
summary: Authorizes bail and pre-trial detention for all arson felonies.

short_summary: Provides definition of integrated pest management
summary: Provides the definition of integrated pest management.

short_summary: Relates to official misconduct for sexual harassment
summary: Creates the crime of official misconduct for sexual harassment by a public servant; makes it a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Prohibits mortgagees from requiring mortgagors of certain real property to purchase flood insurance exceeding certain limits
summary: Prohibits mortgagees from requiring mortgagors of certain residential real property to purchase flood insurance exceeding a coverage amount that exceeds the balance as of the beginning of the year for which the policy shall be in effect, or that includes coverage for contents.

short_summary: Requires written notice to a defendant of his or her right to complete court ordered alcohol or substance use treatment in a nonreligious treatment program
summary: Requires written notice to a defendant of his or her right to complete court ordered alcohol or substance use treatment in a nonreligious treatment program.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing William Schumaker and Mark Hennessy to receive certain service credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
summary: Authorizes William Schumaker and Mark Hennessy to receive certain service credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

short_summary: Statewide disparity study regarding the participation of minority and women-owned business enterprises in state contracts
summary: Requires development of a statewide disparity study regarding the participation of minority and women-owned business enterprises in state contracts.

short_summary: Relates to aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the first degree
summary: Makes it a class E felony to negligently cause the death of another person while operating a motor vehicle with a suspended, revoked or otherwise withdrawn license.

short_summary: Increases reimbursement rates paid by the state to cities for repair and maintenance of state arterials
summary: Increases reimbursement rates paid by the state to cities for repair and maintenance of state arterials; provides rate would be raised to one dollar and eighty cents from eighty-five cents per square yard of the pavement area that is included in the state highway system and an additional twenty cents, up from ten cents, per square yard of such pavement area where such pavement area is located on any elevated bridge.
