short_summary: Provides for minimum registered nurse staffing for intensive care and critical care patients
summary: Requires a minimum registered nurse staffing ratio of one nurse for every two intensive care or critical care patients.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on certain civil service titles
summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on civil service titles which require an appointee to possess a license and current registration as a mental health practitioner in one or more professions under article 163 of the education law.

short_summary: Relates to maintaining bridges over the canal system in a manner to not impede commercial motor vehicles
summary: Requires that bridges over the canal system be maintained in a manner to not impede commercial motor vehicles.

short_summary: Establishes the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund reform act
summary: Establishes the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund reform act; ensures that money deposited into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund is spent on construction purposes and not DOT and DMV operational activities.

short_summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software
summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software.

short_summary: Relates to city reimbursement for state highway construction within such cities
summary: Relates to city reimbursement for state highway construction within such cities; raises such rate from eighty-five cents to one dollar and eighty cents per square yard of the pavement area.

short_summary: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to adopt certain provisions related to student mental health
summary: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to adopt certain provisions related to student mental health such as administering student mental health surveys, establishing a mental health committee, administering mental health training to faculty and staff, and improving university policies regarding mental health.

short_summary: Requires a personal use pharmaceutical disposal system be provided at the time of dispensing an opioid prescription
summary: Requires a personal use pharmaceutical disposal system be provided at the time of dispensing an opioid prescription at no cost to the ultimate user of such prescribed opioid.

short_summary: Requires the county seat in Steuben county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
summary: Requires the county seat in Steuben county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

short_summary: Establishes a task force on missing women and girls who are black, indigenous and people of color
summary: Establishes a task force on missing women and girls who are black, indigenous and people of color (BIPOC) to develop policy changes that will work to address the lack of care and concern for missing and murdered BIPOC women and girls with New York state governmental agencies.

short_summary: Requires the deposit, into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund, of a portion of the sales tax collected on each gallon of motor fuel sold at retail; repealer
summary: Requires the deposit, into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund, of a portion of the sales tax collected on each gallon of motor fuel sold at retail; increases the amount to be deposited over time.

short_summary: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults in certain circumstances
summary: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults when no other facility is available within fifty miles.

short_summary: Includes community centers with a religious affiliation in the definition of public place for purposes of offenses against public order
summary: Includes community centers with a religious affiliation in the definition of public place for purposes of offenses against public order; includes falsely reporting an incident and placing a false bomb or hazardous substance in the definition of specified offense for the purposes of hate crimes.

short_summary: Relates to fees charged for a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver in the county of Westchester
summary: Provides that the legislative body of the county of Westchester shall fix the fee to be charged for a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver and provide for the disposition of such fees.

short_summary: Establishes distinctive "Long Island Sound" license plates
summary: Establishes distinctive "Long Island Sound" license plates; creates the "Long Island Sound environmental fund" for the department of environmental conservation to distribute moneys to not-for-profit corporations, educational organizations or local governments undertaking projects aimed at the beautification of and environmental improvements to the Long Island Sound.

short_summary: Allows for the admission of a defendant's previous declarations or statements when the crime committed is a hate crime
summary: Allows for the admission of a defendant's previous declarations or statements when the crime committed is a hate crime.

short_summary: Authorizes a court to order the division of criminal justice services to compare fingerprints of the defendant against the statewide database
summary: Authorizes a court to order the division of criminal justice services to compare fingerprints of the defendant against the statewide database.

short_summary: Requires full family service restroom facilities in public buildings
summary: Requires full family service restroom facilities in public buildings to permit a caregiver to attend to the sanitary and hygienic needs of any person affected by any combination of physical and/or cognitive disabilities.

short_summary: Relates to giving and/or receiving unlawful benefits
summary: Makes it a felony to give or receive unlawful benefits in excess of $3000.

short_summary: Removes library taxes of the Shelter Rock library district from real property located in that portion of such library district that is located within the Bryant library district
summary: Removes library taxes of the Shelter Rock library district from real property located in that portion of such library district that is located within the Bryant library district.

short_summary: Relates to collective bargaining rights for college athletes and authorizes the public employment relations board to exercise jurisdiction over collective bargaining matters
summary: Relates to collective bargaining rights for college athletes; authorizes the public employment relations board to exercise jurisdiction over institutions of higher education and college student athlete employees of such institutions in relation to all collective bargaining matters.

short_summary: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits
summary: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits which lobby before the government.

short_summary: Enacts the "solar panel collection act"
summary: Enacts the "solar panel collection act" to require manufacturers of solar panels to collect such panels when they are taken out of use; requires educational outreach relating thereto; establishes collection goals therefor; requires reporting of collection efforts.

short_summary: Authorizes the carrying of firearms by military personnel at recruiting centers
summary: Authorizes the carrying of service-issued firearms by military personnel at recruiting centers while on duty.

short_summary: Relates to excise tax on telecommunication services
summary: Relates to excise tax on telecommunication services (Part A); relates to temporary municipal assistance sales and compensating use taxes for cities of one million or more on telecommunication services (Part B).

short_summary: Establishes the public water justice act
summary: Establishes the public water justice act; prohibits sale of waters of the state unless otherwise specifically authorized; establishes a public water justice fund for royalties and fees collected from persons or entities authorized to sell waters of the state.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of official misconduct for sexual harassment
summary: Relates to the crime of official misconduct for sexual harassment for members of the New York state legislature; makes it a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Relates to adding two more members to the Niagara Frontier transportation authority
summary: Relates to adding two more members to the Niagara Frontier transportation authority.

short_summary: Imposes an excise tax on sugary drinks
summary: Imposes an excise tax on sugary drinks; establishes a community health equity fund to utilize the revenues generated by such tax.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
summary: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy; provides the city of Lockport shall notify all owners or known interested parties of record of the placement of the code violations on the city tax levy as uncollected fines and penalties within thirty days of placement.

short_summary: Prohibits the slaughter of horses for human or animal consumption
summary: Prohibits any person, corporation, association, or other entity from slaughtering a horse where such person, corporation, association, or other entity knows or has reason to know that such horse will be used for human or animal consumption; prohibits any person, corporation, association, or other entity from possessing, selling, importing, etc,, a horse or horseflesh if such person, corporation, association, or other entity knows or should have known that any part of such horse or horseflesh will be used for human or animal consumption; provides penalties for violation.

short_summary: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell
summary: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell.

short_summary: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system
summary: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system due to overpayment.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of single-use plastic water bottles in certain port authority facilities
summary: Prohibits the sale of single-use plastic water bottles that hold twenty-one ounces of water or less in port authority facilities in New York; requires such facilities install water fountains within one year.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on rate adequacy of orthotics and prosthetics
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on the rates of reimbursement made through the New York state Medicaid durable medical equipment, orthotics, prosthetics and supplies program for rate adequacy and patient access.

short_summary: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day
summary: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day.

short_summary: Relates to peace officers appointed by The Sea Gate Association
summary: Removes certain restrictions on peace officers appointed by The Sea Gate Association.

short_summary: Relates to a state flag for raising awareness of veteran suicide
summary: Provides that the "Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Flag" shall be the official state flag for the raising of awareness of veteran suicide; directs the commissioner of general services to establish a protocol for the flying of such flag.

short_summary: Establishes a one-stop farming hotline with the Cornell cooperative extension
summary: Establishes a one-stop farming hotline with the Cornell cooperative extension.

short_summary: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law
summary: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law when either the person has substantially prevailed, or if the agency failed to respond within the statutory time.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study aging in place in mental health housing
summary: Establishes a task force to study aging in place in mental health housing; provides for the repeal of such task force upon expiration thereof.

short_summary: Establishes an online insurance verification system for proof of insurance; repealer
summary: Establishes an online insurance verification system for proof of insurance; allows the use of third-party vendors and providers; requires motor vehicle insurers to provide policy information to the online verification system; establishes an online insurance verification advisory council; requires certain information to be confidential and proprietary information which is not subject to disclosure.

short_summary: Relates to the supervision of transfilling of medical oxygen
summary: Relates to supervising the transfilling of medical oxygen; requires registered wholesalers who transfill medical oxygen to ensure any person responsible for supervising such process meets certain qualifications.

short_summary: Relates to implementing automatic enrollment for the tax abatement program for rent-controlled and rent-regulated property occupied by senior citizens
summary: Implements automatic enrollment for the tax abatement program for rent-controlled and rent-regulated property occupied by senior citizens; provides for a check box for a taxpayer to opt-out of data sharing and automatic enrollment on their tax return.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program
summary: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program to provide students with the opportunity to be educated on the agricultural industry and alternative career paths and to provide agricultural work experience and entrepreneurship work experience.

short_summary: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds
summary: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds; provides that for the 2025--2026 school year and thereafter, surplus funds shall mean any operating funds in excess of six percent of the current school year budget, and shall not include funds properly retained under other sections of law.

short_summary: Enacts Retain-NY by implementing tuition tax credits and increasing the amount of an allowable deduction
summary: Relates to a tuition tax credit; increases the amount of an allowable deduction (Part A); reduces income by the amount of interest paid for student loans (Part B).

short_summary: Relates to insurance reimbursement for cost of vaccinations
summary: Requires insurance reimbursement for the total direct and indirect practice expenses associated with vaccinations.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to provide for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to conduct a legal review for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park, in Putnam and Westchester counties to a new name.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Firefighter Peyton L. S. Morse Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Firefighter Peyton L. S. Morse Memorial Highway" in the hamlet of La Fargeville, town of Orleans, Jefferson county.

short_summary: Provides for a right of health maintenance organization enrollees to continue to receive services from a provider who disaffiliates
summary: Extends period during which health maintenance organization enrollees may continue to receive services from a health care provider who disaffiliates from 60 or 90 days to 1 year, or in case of terminal illness, until the time of such insured's death; bars incentives which induce a provider to provide health care to an enrollee in a manner inconsistent with law.

short_summary: Relates to the designation of an independent consumer assistance program
summary: Relates to the designation of an independent consumer assistance program to assist consumers with the filing of complaints and appeals, track problems, educate consumers, assist uninsured, insured, or underinsured consumers in accessing appropriate health care services, assist with enrollment and provide other health insurance assistance.

short_summary: Relates to filing requirements for the annual statement of financial disclosure
summary: Relates to filing requirements for the annual statement of financial disclosure.

short_summary: Creates a citizen advisory panel
summary: Creates a citizen advisory panel consisting of six permanent and three rotating members to prepare a report on any application for certificate of any major electric generating facilities.

short_summary: Establishes a uniform ambulance assessment fee
summary: Establishes a uniform ambulance assessment fee on the annual revenues of certain ambulance services to be expended for increasing medical assistance payment rates for ambulance services.

short_summary: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions
summary: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions; provides that items for sale at a commissary or canteen shall be sold for market value; provides that money placed into an incarcerated individual's commissary or canteen account or fund shall only be used for purchasing items or goods.

short_summary: Provides for mental health screening and creating a presumption that post-traumatic stress disorder is proximately caused by employment for law enforcement officers and emergency medical personnel
summary: Provides for mental health screening; creates a presumption that post-traumatic stress disorder is proximately caused by employment for law enforcement officers and emergency medical services personnel.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of final average salary for certain members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
summary: Provides that certain members of the police and fire retirement system shall have final average salary be calculated as the regular compensation earned during the twelve months of actual service immediately preceding the date of such member's retirement.

short_summary: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts
summary: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts; provides such provisions shall remain in effect for 3 years.

short_summary: Relates to the removal of weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling from the Ogdensburg bridge south to the Port of Ogdensburg
summary: Removes the weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling south on the route from the Ogdensburg bridge to the Port of Ogdensburg.

short_summary: Relates to expenses borne by counties outside of the city of New York for the issuance and maintenance of record books utilized by authorized gunsmiths in the sale and disposition of firearms in the state
summary: Relates to expenses borne by counties outside of the city of New York for the issuance and maintenance of record books utilized by authorized gunsmiths in the sale and disposition of firearms in the state.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital
summary: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital.

short_summary: Relates to the disclosure of monies received by members of the legislature for purposes of legal defense
summary: Provides that contributions made by any person, firm, association or corporation to a member of the state legislature which are intended to be used by such member or on behalf of such member for the payment of legal services and other charges in connection with the legal defense of such member in any past or pending civil or criminal action shall be subject to similar monetary limitations and disclosure requirements set forth in the election law pertaining to campaign contributions.

short_summary: Establishes the power plant tax assessment reserve fund
summary: Establishes the power plant tax assessment reserve fund to reserve against, lessen or prevent increases in the school district's real property tax levy and/or tax rate resulting from decreases in revenue or taxes or a significant shift in tax liability due to a tax certiorari settlement or judgment; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Designates August thirty-first as "Overdose Awareness Day"
summary: Designates August thirty-first of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "Overdose Awareness Day".

short_summary: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete training in the prevention of human trafficking
summary: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete a course in the prevention of human trafficking; directs the commissioners of education and health to develop such training and regulations; directs that certain forfeited funds be used to reimburse actual costs expended for the development of such training.

short_summary: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land; repealer
summary: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land.

short_summary: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment
summary: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of an ATV trail fund
summary: Relates to the creation of an ATV trail fund.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the length of the term of office for members of the legislature
summary: Increases the length of the term of office for members of the legislature from two to four years.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "General Colin Powell Thruway"
summary: Designates a portion of interstate eighty-seven as the "General Colin Powell Thruway".

short_summary: Relates to qualifications for certain appointed positions with the board of trustees for the state university and the city university of New York
summary: Relates to qualifications for certain appointed positions with the board of trustees for the state university and the city university of New York.

short_summary: Relates to extensions of order of protection
summary: Allows family and criminal courts to extend orders of protection for up to two years beyond the expiration date of an issued order of protection if the court finds reason for an extension and places such reasoning on the record.

short_summary: Creates a "purple alert system" for missing victims of domestic violence
summary: Creates a "purple alert system" for missing victims of domestic violence.

short_summary: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act
summary: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act; establishes the New York state nursing recruitment incentive and retention program; defines terms; provides for tuition benefits and the reimbursement of student loans if a person is a registered and licensed nurse; provides that SUNY and CUNY shall pay for a person's education if such person signs a contract stating that he or she shall work in New York state as a registered nurse; makes related provisions; establishes the New York state nursing recruitment incentive and retention account.

short_summary: Requires cable television companies to offer cable television channels on an individual basis
summary: Requires cable television companies to offer cable television channels on an individual basis; provides that the public service commission be responsible for approving rates.

short_summary: Relates to limitations on the granting of custody of a minor
summary: Prohibits a court from granting custody of a minor to anyone who has been convicted of any of the enumerated sex crimes except where a court finds there is no significant risk to the child.

short_summary: Provides for E-ZPass availability and waiving deposit fees for a certain period after a rate increase
summary: Provides for E-ZPass availability and waiving deposit fees for a certain period after a rate increase.

short_summary: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide certain benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
summary: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers; increases the personal income tax deduction after four or more years of service; exempts motor vehicles used in the performance of such volunteers' duties from registration fees, use taxes and special fees for volunteer license plates; authorizes the provision of municipal health insurance coverage to such volunteers; establishes a volunteer recruitment service loan forgiveness program.

short_summary: Modifies the criteria for granting tuition assistance program awards
summary: Modifies the criteria for granting tuition assistance program awards.

short_summary: Relates to consolidated local highway assistance payments
summary: Relates to consolidated local highway assistance payments; increases the amount of the current cost threshold to $750,000 over which local highway and bridge construction work under the CHIPS program must be contracted through a competitive bid.

short_summary: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses
summary: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

short_summary: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program
summary: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program.

short_summary: Modifies the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

short_summary: Establishes civil liability for anyone subjecting another person to the deprivation of any rights, privileges or immunities secured by law
summary: Establishes civil liability for anyone subjecting another person to the deprivation of any rights, privileges or immunities secured by law; establishes that the supreme court shall have jurisdiction over such matters and that the prevailing party shall be awarded reasonable attorney's fees as part of the costs; provides that the state waives sovereign immunity for violations of such law.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing service credit for unpaid or reduced paid child care leave for members of the state police twenty year retirement plan
summary: Relates to authorizing service credit for unpaid or reduced paid child care leave for members of the state police twenty year retirement plan.

short_summary: Expands requirements of sheltering of dogs outside
summary: Enacts stricter requirements for sheltering of dogs outside including protection from wind and loss of body heat.

short_summary: Relates to unfair claim settlements after a natural disaster
summary: Relates to unfair claim settlements after a natural disaster.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax of 25 cents per $100 of principal debt
summary: Authorizes the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax of 25 cents per $100 of principal debt or obligation.

short_summary: Provides for the humane destruction or other disposition of certain animals
summary: Provides for the humane destruction or other disposition of certain animals by shelters; requires animals to be made available for adoption for 90 days unless a veterinarian certifies that such animal should be humanely destroyed for health reasons.

short_summary: Restores judicial discretion relating to bail reform; repealer
summary: Restores judicial discretion relating to bail reform; provides that when the defendant is charged with a felony, the court shall request of the applicable county pre-trial services agency a risk and needs assessment be conducted on the eligible defendant for the purpose of determining whether such defendant should be released on the defendant's own recognizance, released under non-monetary conditions or, where authorized, bail or commit the defendant to the custody of the sheriff; defines risks and needs assessment; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires duly incorporated humane society, pound or shelter to make reasonable efforts to locate the owner of certain animals or provide for the fostering or adoption of such animals
summary: Requires duly incorporated humane society, pound or shelter to make reasonable efforts to locate the owner of certain animals or provide for the fostering or adoption of such animals; provides that such efforts shall include, but not be limited to, checking such animals for identification, social media, placing a photograph and general description, and other identifying information on the internet.

short_summary: Increases the household threshold income cap on tuition assistance
summary: Increases the household threshold income cap on tuition assistance from $80,000 to $100,000.

short_summary: Requires that certain New York state police vehicles be equipped with a dashboard camera
summary: Requires that certain New York state police vehicles be equipped with a dashboard camera.

short_summary: Relates to transfer of sick time
summary: Allows certain employees to transfer or receive sick time from a fellow employee.

short_summary: Establishes a service learning, internship or independent study program for students interested in working with individuals with developmental disabilities
summary: Establishes a service learning, internship or independent study program for students interested in working with individuals with developmental disabilities; mandates such program shall consist of a work component with verifiable activities related to individuals with developmental disabilities as determined by the state university trustees, and an academic component related to such activity that will be completed through either a written report or journal, or other written assignment as determined by the state university trustees.

short_summary: Requires child protective services to document each home visit with photographs
summary: Requires child protective services to document every home visit or contact with the child as part of a treatment plan, supervision and monitoring, with photographs of the child.

short_summary: Relates to public safety communications surcharges
summary: Relates to the amount and deposit of public safety communications surcharges; distributes a portion of such surcharges collected to the municipal first responder grants fund.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal
summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal.

short_summary: Prohibits an employer, licensing agency or employment agency from requesting or requiring that a prospective employee disclose his or her age, date of birth or date of graduation
summary: Prohibits an employer, licensing agency or employment agency from requesting or requiring that a prospective employee disclose his or her age, date of birth or date of graduation from an educational institution on an initial employment application or during an interview, except in the case of a bona fide occupational qualification or need.

short_summary: Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals
summary: Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals.

short_summary: Encourages student voter registration and pre-registration
summary: Requires local boards of education, BOCES, charter schools and non public schools to adopt policies to promote student voter registration and pre-registration, including procedures for providing access to voter registration and pre-registration applications during the school year and assistance with filing such applications and informing students of the state requirements for voter registration and pre-registration.

short_summary: Requires public hearings a minimum of thirty days prior to any vote to extend mayoral control of New York city schools
summary: Requires public hearings to be conducted by the senate education committee and the assembly education committee jointly or separately in Bronx, Kings, New York, Queens and Richmond counties a minimum of thirty days prior to any vote to extend mayoral control of New York city schools.

short_summary: Provides for revocation of drivers' licenses and registrations for multiple driving while intoxicated convictions
summary: Relates to revocation of drivers' licenses and registrations for multiple driving while intoxicated convictions; provides an automatic 10 year license revocation for 3rd offense.

short_summary: Exempts certain paratransit eligible individuals from recertification requirements
summary: Allows for paratransit eligible for paratransit eligible individuals who are at least eighty years old, to be required only to present correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that the paratransit service is still necessary for the individual to make a single application for paratransit services; provides that once approved, such individuals shall be exempt from all certification requirements.

short_summary: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals
summary: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals to include serious physical injuries or the use of a weapon.

short_summary: Requires certain facilities to have a staff member specifically trained in filing assisted outpatient treatment petitions
summary: Requires certain hospitals and correctional facilities to have a staff member specifically trained in filing assisted outpatient treatment petitions.

short_summary: Establishes the crimes of harassment of a law enforcement officer or a member of the officer's family in the first degree and second degree
summary: Establishes the crimes of harassment of a law enforcement officer or a member of the officer's family in the first degree and second degree.

short_summary: Requires two-thirds vote of legislature for any change in tax rates, budget bills and appropriations
summary: Requires approval by 2/3 vote of membership of the senate and assembly voting separately to increase or decrease any tax rate, impose a new state tax, extend or delete existing state tax.

short_summary: Relates to untested sexual offense evidence kit collection reports
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to conduct an inventory of all untested sexual offense evidence collection kits; requires a report to the legislature and the governor.

short_summary: Authorizes the governor to fill vacancy in the office of lieutenant-governor on confirmation of both houses of the legislature
summary: Authorizes the governor to fill vacancy in the office of lieutenant-governor on confirmation of both houses of the legislature; allows the governor to leave the state without transmitting power to lieutenant-governor; establishes the process for lieutenant-governor to act as governor during incapacitation of the governor.

short_summary: Creates the short-term military service guardian
summary: Creates the short-term military service guardian; allows parent without joint custody to appoint service guardian; provides for a maximum appointment of 180 days.

short_summary: Provides for the employment of mental health professionals by school districts
summary: Provides for the employment of mental health professionals by school districts.

short_summary: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal
summary: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal; makes it a class D felony.

short_summary: Enacts "Officer Randolph Holder's law"
summary: Enacts "Officer Randolf Holder's law"; modifies how eligibility is determined for the judicial diversion program for certain felony offenders.

short_summary: Requires the department of health to prepare a report on the inspection of certain health facilities and clinics in the state of New York
summary: Requires the department of health to prepare a report on the inspection of certain health facilities and clinics in the state of New York; provides the commissioner shall deliver such report to the governor and all legislative conference leaders no later than one hundred eighty days after the effective date; provides the report shall include the number of diagnostic treatment centers licensed by the department of health, the number of facilities that are not defined as diagnostic treatment centers, and the date of the most recent inspection.

short_summary: Permits at the discretion of the court certain members of the victim's family to read statements in court during the sentencing of a defendant
summary: Permits at the discretion of the court certain members of the deceased victim's family to read statements in court during the sentencing of a defendant, rather than allowing only a single member of the victim's family to read a statement in court, upon consultation with counsel for the defendant and the people.

short_summary: Provides a one time fee for the registration of historic motor vehicles
summary: Provides a one time fee of one hundred dollars for the registration of historic motor vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of luring a child
summary: Relates to the crime of luring a child; adds additional elements; includes use of electronic communication.

short_summary: Directs a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation
summary: Directs the public service commission in consultation with NYSERDA to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation within nine months after the effective date and every four years thereafter.

short_summary: Relates to an excise tax on the sale of ammunition
summary: Imposes an excise tax on the sale of ammunition to be deposited into the firearm violence intervention fund to help victims of and witnesses to violence.

short_summary: Enacts "Matthew's law"
summary: Enacts Matthew's law which provides for the dispensing of drug adulterant testing supplies by health care professionals or pharmacists to any person.

short_summary: Relates to the effect and rebuttal of certain medical presumptions relating to heart disease
summary: Relates to the effect and rebuttal of certain medical presumptions relating to heart disease; provides that, for certain members, any condition of impairment of health caused by a disease of the heart, resulting in disability, shall be presumptive evidence that such disability was incurred in the performance and discharge of duty and the natural and proximate result of an accident.

short_summary: Provides for the pension benefits for first grade police officers of the city of New York who have served for 25 or 30 years
summary: Provides for the pension benefits for first grade police officers of the city of New York who have served for 25 or 30 years.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting civilian drone use within 1000 ft of a correctional facility
summary: Relates to prohibiting civilian drone use within 1000 feet of a correctional facility except when in use under the Federal Aviation Administration's authorization.

short_summary: Establishes the East of Hudson watershed road salt reduction task force, pilot plan and test program
summary: Establishes the East of Hudson watershed road salt reduction task force, pilot plan and test program to conduct a comprehensive review of road salt contamination and road management best practices within the East of Hudson watershed.

short_summary: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
summary: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

short_summary: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program
summary: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program.

short_summary: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers
summary: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers.

short_summary: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
summary: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

short_summary: Relates to member contribution per centum increases
summary: Increases the salary ranges tied to member contribution requirements; ties salary amount to inflation.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment and promotion of certain personnel of the sanitation department of the city of New York
summary: Authorizes the promotion of personnel to the positions of General Superintendent 2 and General Superintendent 3; provides that such positions shall be filled as far as practicable by promotion from among persons holding competitive class positions in a lower grade in the sanitation department of the city of New York in which the vacancy exists.

short_summary: Relates to community preservation funds for the town of Chester
summary: Authorizes the town of Chester to establish community preservation funds; establishes a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in said community preservation fund.

short_summary: Relates to gender balance in public authorities, industrial development agencies and local development corporations
summary: Relates to gender balance on boards of state and local public authorities; provides that all appointive state and local authorities heretofore or hereafter established by law or resolution shall have recommendations for appointments, or reappointments that are gender balanced.

short_summary: Relates to enabling public employers to offer certain temporary retirement incentives for certain public employees
summary: Enables public employers to offer an age fifty-five with ten years of service or age fifty with twenty-five years of service temporary retirement incentives for certain public employees.

short_summary: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; repealer
summary: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; requires public authorities to send a notice to owners upon incurring an obligation to pay a toll; provides for the adjudication of such liability and defenses to an allegation of liability; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to the purposes and powers of industrial development agencies, local development corporations and certain other not-for-profit corporations and to improving the accountability; repealer
summary: Relates to the purposes and powers of industrial development agencies and to improving the accountability and transparency of such agencies; makes conforming changes to the general municipal law; extends the bond issuance charge to the debt issued by not-for-profit corporations acting on behalf of the state or its political subdivisions; relates to the purposes and powers of local development corporations and certain other not-for-profit corporations thereof.

short_summary: Provides that a sponsoring agency must make a presentation at a public hearing before a residential facility for the disabled may be placed in a municipality
summary: Provides that a sponsoring agency must make a presentation at a public hearing before a residential facility for the disabled may be placed in a municipality.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of the small business child & dependent care savings program
summary: Establishes the small business child and dependent care savings program; provides the basic framework therefor.

short_summary: Relates to designating an individual to be notified in the case of dose or brand change for psychotropic medication
summary: Designates an individual to be notified in the case of dose or brand change for psychotropic medication.

short_summary: Relates to school bus parking on New York City streets
summary: Prohibits school bus parking on city streets on weekdays between the hours of 5 p.m. and 5 a.m. and on weekends from 5 p.m. on Friday to 5 a.m. on Monday.

short_summary: Provides for the release of patient records by the office of mental health
summary: Directs the commissioner to promulgate regulations for the release of certain patient records by the office of mental health.

short_summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to implement permit regulations and guidance regarding shoreline management
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to authorize and encourage the use of nature-based solutions as the preferred alternative for stabilizing tidal shorelines in the state; provides such solutions should be considered when promulgating and implementing rules and regulations relating to such.

short_summary: Provides for eminent domain reform and creates the "home and property protection act"; appropriation
summary: Provides for eminent domain reform; creates the "home and property protection act"; creates a temporary state commission to examine eminent domain laws.

short_summary: Relates to designating the Zone Sergeant James G. Sweeney Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of East Fishkill the "Zone Sergeant James G. Sweeney Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty
summary: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty.

short_summary: Relates to the state board of parole membership, interviews with incarcerated individuals, and determination of parole
summary: Allows for the removal of members of the state board of parole by a majority vote in the senate and the assembly; requires three or more members of such board personally interview potential parolees; requires that the determination to parole an incarcerated individual be unanimous.

short_summary: Requires written notice before changing level of fire service provided in certain cities
summary: Provides that the fire commissioner of any fire department in cities having a population of one million or more shall not substantially alter the boundaries of fire companies, once fixed, or close, remove or relocate a fire company unless at least thirty days prior to the taking effect of such action written notice thereof has been given to each local community board or boards having jurisdiction over that part of the city directly affected by such proposed action or service reduction.

short_summary: Relates to including bodegas and delicatessens in the definition of food service establishment
summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to post the results of its graded inspections of retail food stores on their website and provide information as to where a customer may file a consumer report.

short_summary: Relates to exempting farm laborer internships earning college credit from the definition of employee and employment
summary: Exempts service as a farm laborer where such service is an internship granting college course credit from the definition of employee and employment for the purposes of certain workers' compensation benefits.

short_summary: Provides for unlisted telephone numbers without charge for victims of domestic violence for whose benefit an order of protection has been issued
summary: Provides for unlisted telephone directory numbers without charge, for victims of domestic violence for whose benefit an order of protection has been issued by a court of competent jurisdiction.

short_summary: Relates to the metropolitan commuter transportation authority establishing and implementing a vegetation management policy
summary: Relates to the metropolitan commuter transportation authority establishing and implementing a policy for responsible management of vegetation and other activities that impact neighboring properties in order to preserve the safety and efficiency of commuter rail operations by implementing guidelines for removal and management policies.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for deputy sheriffs transferring between the state and local employees' retirement system to the state and local police and fire retirement system
summary: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for members in the title of deputy sheriff who provided police protection or correction officer service transferring between the New York state and local employees' retirement system to the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

short_summary: Relates to librarians of school libraries; repealer
summary: Relates to librarians of school libraries.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the New York city transit authority to provide a minimum twenty-five percent discount on mass transit for college students
summary: Authorizes the New York city transit authority to contract with mass transit entities including the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company to provide a minimum twenty-five percent discount for college students.

short_summary: Increases the penalties for purposefully obstructed license plates
summary: Increases the penalties for purposefully obstructed license plates including the suspension of a vehicle's registration if the vehicle owner does not remove the artificial or synthetic material or substance that conceals or obscures the license plate or does not purchase new license plates.

short_summary: Makes the first one hundred thousand dollars of an individuals' private pension non-taxable
summary: Makes the first one hundred thousand dollars of an individual's private pension non-taxable.

short_summary: Requires that annual reports be distributed in electronic format only, unless otherwise requested by a member
summary: Requires that annual department reports be distributed in electronic format only, unless otherwise requested by a member.

short_summary: Enacts the "Endoscope Reform Act"
summary: Enacts the "Endoscope Reform Act"; requires the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations to govern the practice of all upper endoscopic procedures and to prescribe an upper endoscopic patient's bill of rights.

short_summary: Requires the installation of trash capture nets on certain point source outlets
summary: Requires the commissioner to promulgate rules and regulations requiring the department to install or cause to be installed at the outlet of any point source that empties into the waters of the state a trash capture net for purposes of collecting garbage, refuse, and other debris; defines "trash capture net" to mean a commercial grade, reusable, open-meshed material designed to capture pollutants as small as five millimeters in diameter.

short_summary: Establishes the work opportunity tax credit for businesses with fifty employees or less for hiring a long term unemployed person
summary: Establishes the work opportunity tax credit for businesses with fifty employees or less for hiring a long term unemployed person; provides a credit shall be allowed of up to $2,400; provides the total amount of credit provided statewide shall not exceed fifteen million dollars.

short_summary: Relates to transferring credits from a CUNY community college to a New York state university
summary: Allows CUNY community college students to transfer all earned credits to a New York state university.

short_summary: Requires a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure
summary: Relates to requiring a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure to his or her tenant or prospective tenant prior to he or she renewing or signing a lease agreement.

short_summary: Relates to expiration date on meat, dairy products and perishable food items
summary: Requires any person, firm or corporation offering any dairy product, meat, meat by-product, meat food product or perishable food item for sale in the state to label such product with an expiration date clearly visible in a conspicuous location; provides that such date shall be the time after which such item is unfit for human consumption as determined by industry standards; provides that no such products shall be allowed to remain on display or offered for sale after such date.

short_summary: Prohibits certain individuals adjudicated as youthful offenders from possessing certain weapons
summary: Prohibits individuals adjudicated as youthful offenders for any offense listed under article one hundred twenty-five of the penal law, from possessing firearms, rifles and shotguns.

short_summary: Requires certain buses and trucks to be equipped with commercial GPS devices
summary: Requires certain buses and trucks to be equipped with commercial GPS devices.

short_summary: Relates to representations by insureds having claims under a life insurance policy
summary: Requires persons having claims under a life insurance policy to provide reasonable assistance to the insurer in obtaining information relating to misrepresentations made by the insured.

short_summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to check the wanted felon status and other information of people applying for public assistance
summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to check the wanted felon status and probation or parole violator status of people applying for public assistance.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier II status in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Lori Cohen
summary: Grants retroactive membership with Tier II status in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Lori Cohen.

short_summary: Relates to including providing onsite child daycare facilities by a project into a uniform tax exemption policy
summary: Includes providing onsite child daycare facilities by a project into a uniform tax exemption policy.

short_summary: Directs the state fire prevention and building code council to update the state fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code
summary: Directs the state fire prevention and building code council to update the state fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code within 18 months of the publication of any updated or revised edition of the international and national codes relating thereto, so as to ensure that the state's codes reflect such revisions and updates.

short_summary: Relates to retaining peace officer status for facilities parole officers
summary: Relates to retaining peace officer status for facilities parole officers.

short_summary: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes
summary: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes; prohibits the use of drones by law enforcement at concerts, protests, demonstrations, or other actions protected by the first amendment.

short_summary: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines for purposes of being exempt from certain taxation
summary: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines to be exempt from certain taxation.

short_summary: Permits a waiver of the diligent effort requirement in limited circumstances for certain insurance coverage to be placed by licensed excess line brokers with unauthorized insurers
summary: Permits a waiver of the diligent effort requirement in limited circumstances for certain insurance coverage to be placed by licensed excess line brokers with unauthorized insurers where a retail producing insurance broker seeks to procure or place commercial lines insurance through an unaffiliated wholesale excess line insurance broker.

short_summary: Reduces the tax on combative sport event ticket sales to three percent
summary: Reduces the tax on combative sport event ticket sales to three percent.

short_summary: Enacts the "STAR credit bill of rights" and establishes the office of STAR ombudsman
summary: Enacts the "STAR credit bill of rights"; establishes the office of STAR ombudsman.

short_summary: Provides technical assistance to any municipality that has had a college or university close within such municipality
summary: Directs the department of state, in cooperation with other departments, to provide technical assistance to any municipality, upon request, that has had a college or university close within such municipality.

short_summary: Relates to including used vehicles in the drive clean rebate program
summary: Relates to including used vehicles in the drive clean rebate program; provides that such rebate for a used vehicle shall not exceed one thousand dollars.

short_summary: Relates to site mapping for emergency response data and school safety plans
summary: Authorizes the provision of site mapping for emergency response data with school safety plans; provides for the funding of such mapping data.

short_summary: Relates to the authority of the city of New York to install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices
summary: Increases the number of traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices that may be installed in New York city to six hundred intersections; extends certain provisions authorizing photo-monitoring devices until December 1, 2027.

short_summary: Relates to assault in the second degree
summary: Elevates an assault of a retail worker to the class D felony of assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Sergeant Elijah A. Briggs Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Fishkill, Dutchess county as the "Sergeant Elijah A. Briggs Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to increasing penalties for public urination or defecation
summary: Increases penalties for public urination or defecation to $500 for any violation.

short_summary: Establishes that guardians ad litem in Westchester county are considered employees under the public officers law
summary: Establishes that guardians ad litem in Westchester county are considered employees for the purposes of representation and indemnification in civil actions resulting from actions taken during the scope of their employment.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting members of certain boards of directors who have been removed from serving on a board for a period of fifteen years
summary: Relates to prohibiting members of certain boards of directors who have been removed from serving on a board for a period of fifteen years; provides that for any housing entity with a board of directors overseen by the department of housing preservation and development, if a member of the board is removed by the department or by court order, such member shall be banned from serving on a board overseen by the department for a period of 15 years.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lubavitch of Old Westbury
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lubavitch of Old Westbury for all of the 2022-2023 school taxes and all of the 2023 general taxes.

short_summary: Sets the number of petitioners necessary to call for a vote on increasing the amount of funding of the annual contribution for the operating budget of a registered public or free association library
summary: Sets the number of petitioners necessary to call for a vote on increasing the amount of funding of the annual contribution for the operating budget of a registered public or free association library at twenty-five qualified voters of a municipality.

short_summary: Enables taxpayers to donate money towards horse retirement and rescue programs; directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to compile a list of approved horse retirement and rescue programs
summary: Enables certain taxpayers to donate money towards horse retirement and rescue programs by providing a tax check-off box; establishes the gift for the New York state horse retirement and rescue fund; directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to compile a list of approved horse retirement and rescue programs.

short_summary: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities
summary: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities and whose income is less than $125,000.

short_summary: Provides for the return of fines, restitution and reparation payments where there was an unjust conviction
summary: Provides for the return of fines, restitution and reparation payments and any interest thereon where a defendant is subsequently pardoned upon the ground of innocence or the conviction is reversed or vacated.

short_summary: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from November 30, 2023 to November 30, 2026.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing public school buildings to reject a designation as a polling place
summary: Authorizes the governing body or agency of a public school building to reject a designation as a polling place or an early polling place.

short_summary: Authorizes child care assistance to be made available to certain victims of domestic violence
summary: Authorizes child care assistance to be made available to certain victims of domestic violence who are in need of assistance in order for a parent or caretaker relative to engage in work or participate in work activities.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Bower
summary: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Bower, provided he files an application with the head of the NYSLRS within one year.

short_summary: Relates to the residential parking system in the village of Cold Spring in the county of Putnam
summary: Adds streets and areas to the residential parking system in the village of Cold Spring in the county of Putnam.

short_summary: Clarifies the application of standardized testing requirements to the general education development exam
summary: Clarifies the application of standardized testing requirements to the general education development exam by explicitly including it in the definition of "standardized test" and "test".

short_summary: Allows for the taxation of state property in the city of Ogdensburg
summary: Allows for the taxation of state property located in the city of Ogdensburg, except the lands controlled and operated on by the Ogdensburg Bridge & Port Authority.

short_summary: Relates to the notification of county boards of elections of an individual's death
summary: Relates to the notification of county boards of elections of an individual's death and the subsequent removal of such voter's name from the applicable registration roll.

short_summary: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services
summary: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county
summary: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county.

short_summary: Authorizes electronic submission of absentee ballots
summary: Authorizes electronic submission of absentee ballots.

short_summary: Relates to certain authorizations for fiscal intermediaries; repealer
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to provide authorizations to all fiscal intermediaries that timely submit a request for authorization prior to January 1, 2024; details information required for such authorizations; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the sharing of revenue from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara
summary: Provides that $1,600,000 of any funds from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara shall be transferred to the Niagara county industrial development agency for use to fund downtown economic development initiatives within the city of Niagara Falls.

short_summary: Relates to annual vehicular access for active duty service members
summary: Relates to annual vehicular access for active duty service members; requires annual passes be issued to active duty service members and their immediate families at state parks or recreational facilities upon presentation of a military identification card.

short_summary: Enhances criminal investigations and prosecutions in relation to the integrity of statements of those accused of crimes
summary: Enhances criminal investigations and prosecutions in relation to the integrity of statements of those accused of crimes and to promote confidence in the criminal justice system.

short_summary: Relates to evidence accepted by the New York state police forensic investigation center
summary: Requires certain evidence or samples for DNA analysis to be accepted by the New York state police forensic investigation center from any firearm, rifle, shotgun, ammunition or magazine loading device when the sole charge is criminal possession of a weapon in the first degree, criminal possession of a weapon in the second degree, criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree, criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree and criminal possession of a firearm.

short_summary: Relates to creating a private education debt registry
summary: Directs the superintendent of financial services to create a private education debt registry which shall contain information and documentation relating to loans issued by creditors including interest rates and copies of the notes and instruments used by such creditors for education loans.

short_summary: Relates to involuntary emergency admission of persons alleged to be mentally ill
summary: Enacts "Jesse's law" to provide that a person subject to involuntary emergency admission for immediate observation, care, and treatment of mental illness shall have the right to select the hospital they are admitted to.

short_summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Orleans
summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Orleans.

short_summary: Repeals provisions of law requiring certain cities pay for certain charter school rents
summary: Repeals provisions of law requiring certain cities pay for certain charter school rents.

short_summary: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies
summary: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies; relates to the inference of an assignee's intent and purpose in taking an assignment of a claim against an obligor that is not an eligible obligor.

short_summary: Repeals the requirement that applicants must pass an examination in order to qualify as a licensed master social worker
summary: Repeals the requirement that applicants must pass an examination in order to qualify as a licensed master social worker.

short_summary: Relates to the number of signatures needed on certain designating petitions and independent nominations
summary: Relates to the number of signatures needed on certain designating petitions and independent nominations for town council districts.

short_summary: Relates to the early voting period for certain elections
summary: Changes the early voting period for general, primary, run-off primary and special elections for public office or party position; maintains the current early voting period for general elections in a year in which electors of president and vice president of the United States are to be elected.

short_summary: Establishes a captive insurance program for commuter vans that are engaged in the business of carrying or transporting eight to twenty-four passengers for hire and establishes a commuter van trust fund
summary: Establishes a captive insurance program for commuter vans that are engaged in the business of carrying or transporting eight to twenty-four passengers for hire; establishes the commuter van trust fund.

short_summary: Provides that employment provisions that require an employee to assign certain inventions shall be unenforceable
summary: Provides that employment provisions that require an employee to assign certain inventions that are made on the employee's own time and which do not use the employer's equipment, supplies, facilities, or trade secret information shall be unenforceable.

short_summary: Creates a computer science course requirement for graduation from high school
summary: Creates a computer science course requirement for graduation from high school; directs the department of education to design and implement such program.

short_summary: Relates to prohibited hospital interference with patient care
summary: Prohibits hospital interference with patient care where the practitioner is acting in good faith and within the scope of their practice.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the World Restoration Center Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the assessor of Nassau county to grant the World Restoration Center Inc. retroactive real property tax exempt status upon an application therefor.

short_summary: Relates to certain notices and guidelines regarding mental health and wellness of employees
summary: Directs the commissioner of labor to create and distribute to employers a poster, pamphlet, or other written materials regarding mental health and wellness of employees to be posted in the workplace; directs voluntary guidelines for employers to put in place strategies and programs to support the mental health and wellness of their employees.

short_summary: Increases the enhanced STAR property tax deduction for tax for final assessment rolls to be completed after two thousand twenty-four and eliminates school taxes for certain persons eighty and older
summary: Increases the enhanced STAR property tax deduction for tax for final assessment rolls to be completed after two thousand twenty-four; provides a total exemption from school taxes for certain persons eighty years of age and older.

short_summary: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern
summary: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern as well as citizens, companies, entities, and members of such countries and entities.

short_summary: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras
summary: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras.

short_summary: Relates to the mandatory age of retirement for judges
summary: Raises the mandatory age of retirement for judges to seventy-six, with the ability of certain judges and justices to serve under a certified appointment until the age of eighty.

short_summary: Relates to the mandatory retirement age of judges and justices
summary: Provides a mandatory retirement age of 76 for judges and justices.

short_summary: Relates to the eligibility of occupants of public housing authorities for rental assistance
summary: Relates to the eligibility of occupants of public housing authorities for rental assistance; authorizes occupants of public housing authorities to receive rental assistance at the same times as all other eligible populations.

short_summary: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia
summary: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia through the NY Connects: Choices for Long Term Care program.

short_summary: Creates an office of healthcare accountability
summary: Creates an office of healthcare accountability to provide recommendations regarding healthcare and hospital costs; audit expenditures for state employees and retirees; and to provide public information relating to hospital costs and the transparency of hospitals with regard to disclosure of costs.

short_summary: Relates to the filing of financial disclosure statements
summary: Relates to the filing of financial disclosure statements; relates to the definition of "filing rate".

short_summary: Requires state units to purchase a product or service that is or contains an algorithmic decision system that adheres to responsible artificial intelligence standards
summary: Requires state units to purchase a product or service that is or contains an algorithmic decision system that adheres to responsible artificial intelligence standards; specifies content included in responsible artificial intelligence standards; requires the commissioner of taxation and finance to adopt certain regulations; alters the definition of unlawful discriminatory practice to include acts performed through algorithmic decision systems.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of second-use lithium-ion batteries
summary: Prohibits the sale of second-use lithium-ion batteries intended for use in a bicycle with electric assist, an electric scooter or a limited use motorcycle;  provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to code enforcement training programs for code enforcement personnel
summary: Requires the secretary of state to offer code enforcement training programs for code enforcement personnel to be completed online, with flexible options for when such training programs may be completed.

short_summary: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2023-2024 school year
summary: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2023--2024 school year.

short_summary: Directs the New York state department of transportation and the New York city department of transportation to conduct a study on parking availability
summary: Directs the New York state department of transportation and the New York city department of transportation to conduct a study on parking availability along the portion of 8th Avenue between 39th street and 73rd street in the borough of Brooklyn in the city of New York.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Chief Daniel Nimham Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Fishkill, Dutchess county as the "Chief Daniel Nimham Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Corporal Derick Franklin Brinckerhoff Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Fishkill, Dutchess county as the "Corporal Derick Franklin Brinckerhoff Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony
summary: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony in certain actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice.

short_summary: Allows for certain disability benefits to continue in the event an individual who is receiving such benefits gets married
summary: Allows for certain disability benefits to continue in the event an individual who is receiving such benefits gets married; provides that the marriage to another individual which would otherwise make an individual ineligible for certain disability benefits shall not be considered if such individual is already receiving disability benefits at the time of becoming married and continues to meet certain criteria.

short_summary: Updates provisions relating to dignity for all students and makes an appropriation therefor
summary: Updates provisions relating to dignity for all students including establishing the student suicide prevention act which includes curriculum and teacher training requirements designed to prevent student suicide with a focus on LGBTQ students; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"
summary: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"; requires health care facilities have policies for suspected victims of domestic abuse.

short_summary: Relates to regulation of consumer reporting agencies
summary: Instructs the department of financial services to regulate consumer reporting agencies by requiring licensing of credit reporting agencies, and allowing the department to examine the books and records of consumer reporting agencies.

short_summary: Establishes a temporary moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature and creates regional mandate relief councils
summary: Establishes a temporary moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature and creates regional mandate relief councils.
