short_summary: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act"
summary: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act" to require companies selling, offering for sale, or distributing packaging materials and products to register with a packaging reduction organization to develop a packaging reduction and recycling plan.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of reduced residential rates for electric and natural gas service to low-income customers
summary: Relates to the establishment of reduced residential rates for electric and natural gas service to low-income customers.

short_summary: Relates to the Crittenden volunteer fire department in the town of Alden, county of Erie
summary: Exempts the Crittenden Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. located in the town of Alden, county of Erie, from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members.

short_summary: Includes assault of a vehicle license examiner to assault in the second degree
summary: Includes assault of a vehicle license examiner to assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Authorizes Vineyard Christian Fellowship South Shore Inc. to file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption
summary: Authorizes Vineyard Christian Fellowship South Shore Inc. to file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption for the 2020-2021 assessment roll for all the 2020-2021 school taxes and all the 2021 general taxes.

short_summary: Authorizes Kim Bowers to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes Kim Bowers to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system for her employment with the town of Orchard Park Zoning Board of Appeals.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the establishment of utility customer arrears reporting
summary: Relates to requiring the establishment of utility customer arrears reporting; requires utilities to report to the public service commission on customers who are in arrears.

short_summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability
summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability; provides that utilities, waterworks corporations, telephone corporations and cable television companies shall create discount programs that provide a 10 percent discount to low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability; defines terms.

short_summary: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation
summary: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation stating the estimated annual cost to the political subdivision affected and the source of such estimate; provides that bills will be invalidated if the funding source is not provided or the fiscal impact results in an annual net additional cost in excess of $10,000.

short_summary: Relates to the imposition of sales tax in the county of Orleans
summary: Extends the period during which the county of Orleans is authorized to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler
summary: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler; defines "animal control officer".

short_summary: Prohibits the use of state funds for non-residents seeking an abortion or related procedures
summary: Prohibits the use of state funds for non-residents seeking an abortion or any other procedure that results in the intentional termination of a pregnancy at any stage of gestation.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites
summary: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites; provides that it shall be unlawful for any person to own, operate, work in or volunteer at a supervised injection site; defines terms and establishes penalties.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of corporal punishment in an educational setting
summary: Prohibits the use of corporal punishment in an educational setting; defines corporal punishment as an act of physical force upon a pupil for the purpose of punishing the pupil.

short_summary: Prohibits the discharge of any radiological agent into the waters of the state
summary: Prohibits the discharge of any radiological agent into the waters of the state.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York accountability in reporting act"
summary: Enacts the "New York accountability in reporting act"; establishes the crimes of offering a false report for filing in the second degree and offering a false report for filing in the first degree; includes falsely reporting an incident as a specified offense for the purposes of hate crimes; requires the creation of public databases for false reporting; provides for a civil remedy for convictions of such crimes.

short_summary: Establishes an accessory dwelling unit incentive program
summary: Establishes an accessory dwelling unit incentive program to encourage the creation of accessory dwelling units; includes accessory dwelling units in the definition of the term housing accommodations in the human rights law; provides for a temporary property tax exemption on the increase in value of property resulting from the addition of an accessory dwelling unit.

short_summary: Relates to the storage of evidence by law enforcement agencies
summary: Requires law enforcement agencies to store physical or other evidence it maintains within fireproof containers or within a fireproof storage area; requires law enforcement agencies to document and photograph evidence before it is stored in a fireproof container or storage area; requires that such documents and photographs be stored in a different location.

short_summary: Adjusts the compensation of formerly incarcerated individuals who were unjustly convicted
summary: Retroactively adjusts the compensation of formerly incarcerated individuals who were unjustly convicted; exempts such adjusted income from state income taxes.

short_summary: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county
summary: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county; extends such authority until November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Provides for a taxpayer assistance authorization for households in the county of Schenectady
summary: Provides for a taxpayer assistance authorization for households in the county of Schenectady; provides for a $250 rebate for property owners in Schenectady county with a qualifying STAR exemption or school tax relief credit.

short_summary: Provides for the distribution of informational materials on economic abuse
summary: Requires the office for the prevention of domestic violence to distribute informational materials on recognizing economic abuse and the support available to victims.

short_summary: Enacts the wage payment integrity act
summary: Amends provisions relating to payment of wages to include compensation that is not payable solely at the employer's discretion; requires certain notices; expands enforcement provisions.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
summary: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property.

short_summary: Relates to limiting the use of a victims DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits
summary: Prohibits the use of a victim's DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits from being added to the state DNA identification index or other databases or being used in certain actions.

short_summary: Relates to special districts for ambulance services
summary: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services in any county, city, town or village located within the Adirondack park.

short_summary: Provides milk dealers and agricultural food product transporters with electronic toll collection devices free of charge
summary: Provides milk dealers and agricultural food product transporters with electronic toll collection devices free of charge; requires the department of transportation to reimburse the thruway authority and the metropolitan transportation authority for costs incurred in providing such toll collection devices.

short_summary: Modifies the date for kindergarten enrollment
summary: Modifies the date for kindergarten enrollment from when a minor who becomes five or six years of age on or before the first of December to the first of September.

short_summary: Relates to limiting certain state aid for universities with large endowments
summary: Limits certain state aid for universities with large endowments except to fund tuition assistance programs.

short_summary: Permits the village justice of the village of Maybrook, Orange county, to reside outside of the Village boundaries
summary: Permits the village justice of the village of Maybrook, Orange county, to reside outside of the Village boundaries but within the town of Montgomery or the town of Hamptonburgh.

short_summary: Provides a tax exemption for certain volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers in Westchester county
summary: Provides a tax exemption for certain volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers in Westchester county.

short_summary: Relates to the award of reasonable attorney's fees in certain proceedings
summary: Provides for the award of reasonable attorneys' fees in FOIL proceedings if the person is successful and in open meeting proceedings to the successful petitioner and against the public body.

short_summary: Requires certain candidates to file a statement attesting to the veracity of statements regarding the candidate's educational history, and service, employment and residency record
summary: Requires certain candidates to file a statement attesting to the veracity of statements regarding the candidate's educational history, and service, employment and residency record; provides for the filing of amended statements; provides penalties.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands
summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the New York city department of transportation and New York city department of housing preservation and development, to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands.

short_summary: Exempts the East Dunkirk Volunteer Fire Company, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
summary: Exempts the East Dunkirk Volunteer Fire Company, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

short_summary: Provides support to refugees from Afghanistan and Ukraine
summary: Provides support to refugees from Afghanistan and Ukraine who have been displaced through no fault of their own.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters
summary: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk to amend a conservation easement
summary: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk to amend an existing conservation easement to allow for rail access and service.

short_summary: Authorizes the legislature to increase the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district
summary: Authorizes the legislature to increase the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district.

short_summary: Directs the department of state and public service commission to study and report upon disclosure by utilities to credit reporting agencies of late payments
summary: Directs the department of state and the public service commission to study and report upon the prevalence of the disclosure by public utilities, cable television companies and cellular telephone service providers to credit reporting agencies of late payments and defaults in payment of fees and charges by consumers.

short_summary: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt
summary: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt; defines consumer debt and replaces consumer credit transaction with such term.

short_summary: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax to 2025.

short_summary: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system
summary: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system, which collects information and statistical data relating to public health emergencies in order to assist the department of health, other government entities, health care providers, and the public in understanding and responding to public health emergencies.

short_summary: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer
summary: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer.

short_summary: Relates to increasing monetary penalties for public health law violations
summary: Increases monetary penalties for public health law violations; provides support for the nursing home quality improvement demonstration program.

short_summary: Provides for licensing of a dental therapist and an advanced dental therapist
summary: Requires individuals who practice the profession of dental therapy or advanced dental therapy to be licensed and registered in the state; provides Medicaid reimbursement for dental therapy services.

short_summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
summary: Provides that for New York city uniformed sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

short_summary: Provides person/entity with authority to operate a hospital shall be subject to approval by public health and health planning council for establishment of hospital
summary: Makes various provisions regarding establishment of a hospital: provides that any person and various other listed entities (i.e., partnership, company, stockholder, member, corporation or other entity) with authority to operate a hospital, shall be subject to approval for establishment by the public health council (unless otherwise authorized to operate a hospital without such establishment approval); provides that any assignment or delegation of any authority to operate a hospital shall be subject to approval for establishment by the council (with certain specified exceptions); specifies circumstances under which a person, partnership, company, etc. shall be deemed to have authority to operate a hospital subject to approval for establishment by the council (with certain specified exceptions); specifies circumstances under which a person, partnership, company, etc. shall be deemed to have authority to operate a hospital (i.e., if it has decision-making authority over listed matters).

short_summary: Regulates the cutting, topping and removal of trees upon rights of way by providers of electric service; requires the planting of replacement trees in certain cases
summary: Regulates the cutting, topping and removal of trees upon rights of way by providers of electric service; requires the planting of replacement trees in certain cases; provides for the enforcement of such provisions.

short_summary: Prohibit weapon promotion and sale on public property
summary: Prohibits the promotion, sale, transfer, exchange, giving or disposing of a weapon on property owned by the state or any political subdivision thereof.

short_summary: Expands coverage of sex offender registration act
summary: Expands coverage of sex offender registration act.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Paul Valentine Jr.
summary: Grants retroactive membership in Tier II of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Paul Valentine Jr.

short_summary: Enacts the "children's weapon accident prevention act"
summary: Enacts the "children's weapon accident prevention act"; creates crimes of failure to store a weapon safely in the first and second degrees, aggravated failure to store a weapon safely, and criminally negligent storage of a weapon in the first and second degrees; provides affirmative defenses; directs the commissioner of education to develop a weapons safety program.

short_summary: Relates to the development and approval of reimbursement rates for managed care providers under medicaid
summary: Requires notice and additional review for managed care providers of the methodologies and fee schedules and other materials used for determining medicaid reimbursement rates.

short_summary: Makes provisions relating to the suspension of licenses
summary: Provides that the owner of a hazard vehicle service or of a taxicab, livery, bus, coach, limousine, van or wheelchair accessible van service, who has permitted an employee to operate such a vehicle when such employee has not been issued a valid state driver's license or whose license has been suspended or revoked shall have his business license suspended for thirty days.

short_summary: Relates to protecting registered security guards in a hospital or health care facility from assault; class D felony
summary: Relates to protecting registered security guards in a hospital or health care facility from assault; makes such assault a class D felony.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of all terrain vehicle or "ATV"
summary: Amends the definition of all terrain vehicles to include certain vehicles of up to seventy inches long and 1500 pounds.

short_summary: Requires a weigh-in to take place the day of a combative sports event
summary: Requires a weigh-in of all participants shall occur on the date of a combative sports event.

short_summary: Creates the "Commission on Battery Fire Safety Practices"
summary: Creates the commission on battery fire safety practices to evaluate the need for resources for police, volunteer fire departments and emergency medical services concerning health and safety best practices when responding to lithium-ion battery incidents.

short_summary: Relates to bills containing provisions requiring appointments to be made by the legislative leaders
summary: Requires certain bills which establish a commission, task force, board, council or any similar body shall have not less than one position appointed by each of the legislative leaders.

short_summary: Relates to contraband screening at correctional facilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish contraband screening at correctional facilities including canines at the entrances and a third-party secure vendor mail program.

short_summary: Creates the division of regulatory review and economic growth
summary: Creates the division of regulatory review and economic growth to review regulatory processes and permit requirements in order to facilitate economic growth.

short_summary: Requires human breast milk banks, companies and cooperatives to comply with certain standards and provides for education and support of certain breastfeeding mothers
summary: Requires human breast milk banks, companies and cooperatives to comply with certain standards; provides for education and support of certain breastfeeding mothers.

short_summary: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance
summary: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance.

short_summary: Requires police commissioner to give thirty days notice of police service reduction to appropriate community board
summary: Provides that the police commissioner of any police department in a city having a population of one million or more shall not substantially alter the boundaries of police precincts, once fixed, or close, remove or relocate a police stationhouse unless at least thirty days prior to the date such action shall take effect, written notice of such action has been given to each local community board or board having jurisdiction over that part of the city directly affected by such proposed alteration, closure, removal or relocation.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for making of policy loans
summary: Requires the terms and conditions of any individual life insurance policy loan to be in writing, be signed by the insured and the agent and contain a signed statement that the agent has explained the terms to the policyholder.

short_summary: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent
summary: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent and for modification of such orders.

short_summary: Relates to repealing the driver's license access and privacy act
summary: Repeals the driver's license access and privacy act.

short_summary: Provides information regarding medicare part B coverage to certain individuals
summary: Provides information regarding termination of medicare part B coverage for the duration of incarceration to individuals committed to the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the imposition of service charges upon certain real property
summary: Authorizes the imposition of service charges upon certain real property.

short_summary: Relates to the collection of supplemental vehicle registration fees for New York City registrants
summary: Relates to the collection of supplemental vehicle registration fees for New York City registrants.

short_summary: Provides an exemption from suspension of driver's license for persons serving on fulltime active military duty
summary: Provides exemption from suspension of a driver's license for persons serving fulltime active military duty who fail to pay fines from traffic or parking violations.

short_summary: Relates to the election by certain counties to withdraw from the metropolitan commuter transportation district, and permits the counties of Orange and Rockland to make such election
summary: Relates to the election by certain counties to withdraw from the metropolitan commuter transportation district; permits the counties of Orange and Rockland to make such election.

short_summary: Relates to limiting the power of the governor to make an executive order or otherwise direct an executive agency to take any action that contradicts state law; repealer

summary: Makes the theft of a package intentionally taken from a porch, driveway, doorway or other area adjacent to the residence of another following delivery of the package to such residence by the postal service or a commercial carrier a felony.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the animal abuse hotline
summary: Establishes the animal abuse hotline.

summary: Provides for the designation by a general hospital of persons to identify infectious disease processes, conduct surveillance and epidemiologic investigations, and develop plans to prevent and control the transmission of infectious agents within general hospitals.

short_summary: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits
summary: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits.

short_summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years and limit the terms of office a member of the legislature may serve.

short_summary: Relates to the solicitation of donations on state highways
summary: Relates to solicitation of donations on state highways.

summary: Prohibits schedule B contributions on campaign finance filings.

short_summary: Relates to creating the proprietary college tuition reimbursement account
summary: Relates to degree-granting proprietary colleges; creates the proprietary college tuition reimbursement account for the refund of tuition paid by eligible students asserting certain violations; establishes an assessment to be paid by proprietary schools to fund the account.

short_summary: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act of 2024" to provide for grants to certain hospitals, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention
summary: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act" to provide for grants from the state commissioner of education to public and not-for-profit hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention costs and activities as described herein.

short_summary: Relates to advertising for bids and offers; letting of contracts
summary: Relates to advertising for bids and offers; letting of contracts; raises the aggregate amount for sealed bids above the current levels for commodities from $20,000 to $80,000 and public works from $35,000 to $125,000.

short_summary: Relates to the powers, functions and duties of the New York state public authorities control board
summary: Provides that minority members of the public authorities control board shall have voting privileges and shall act upon a unanimous vote.

short_summary: Requires the inspection of non-fireproof buildings and compliance with the New York city housing maintenance code and the New York city construction codes
summary: Requires the inspection of non-fireproof buildings every three years; requires compliance with the New York city housing maintenance code and the New York city construction codes; requires those dwellings not in compliance with such code at the time of inspection to make repairs or improvements necessary to comply with such standards within six months of such inspection, or a lien shall be placed upon the dwelling.

short_summary: Relates to party nominations for candidates by county party committees
summary: Relates to party nominations for candidates by county party committees.

short_summary: Provides an itemized deduction for expenses for course-mandated supplies for eligible college students paid by taxpayers
summary: Provides an itemized deduction for expenses for course-mandated supplies for eligible college students paid by taxpayers.

short_summary: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree
summary: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree.

short_summary: Relates to minimum wage order increases
summary: Requires legislative approval of minimum wage increases promulgated through wage orders.

short_summary: Relates to hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
summary: Relates to hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

short_summary: Relates to designating the month of May "Korean American Family Month"
summary: Relates to designating the month of May as "Korean American Family Month".

short_summary: Relates to liability for outside aid
summary: Relates to liability for outside aid.

short_summary: Establishes a senior dental services grant program
summary: Establishes a senior dental services grant program; authorizes the director to establish the program and, upon the availability of appropriations, provide grants to eligible elderly persons who are in need of such services.

short_summary: Relates to the limit upon real property tax levies by local governments
summary: Relates to the limit upon real property tax levies by local governments; exempts real property owned by a city, town or village from taxes for infrastructure, road maintenance, snow removal, capital projects, consent order and smart growth initiative expenses and any extraordinary expenses required to respond to public health emergencies and pandemics.

short_summary: Relates to monies withdrawn from the revenue stabilization fund of the city of New York
summary: Provides that monies may not be withdrawn from the revenue stabilization fund of the city of New York in any fiscal year unless the mayor has certified that there is a compelling fiscal need, including a national or regional recession of at least two quarters of declining real gross city product, a natural or other disaster, including terrorist attacks, or a declared state of emergency in the city of New York or the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to a moratorium on new licensed home care service agency approvals
summary: Relates to a moratorium on new licensed home care service agency approvals.

short_summary: Provides judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders and increases the lengths of certain prison sentences; repealer
summary: Provides judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; increases the lengths of certain prison sentences; repeals certain provisions relating to use of force by law enforcement; repeals certain provisions relating to access to premises for discovery by the defendant and motions to vacate judgments.

short_summary: Prohibits certain surcharges on credit or debit card transactions
summary: Prohibits certain surcharges on certain credit or debit card transactions in the city of New York; provides that no agency or department of the city of New York, or any tribunal located therein, shall be authorized to impose a surcharge on a holder who elects to use a credit or debit card in lieu of payment by cash, check, or similar means to pay any fine, civil penalty, or fee owed.

short_summary: Relates to removing the statute of limitations in criminal and civil actions involving sex offenses committed against a minor
summary: Removes the statute of limitations in criminal and civil actions involving sex offenses committed against a minor.

short_summary: Establishes that instruction in financial education be provided to pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve
summary: Establishes that instruction in financial education be provided to pupils in grades nine through twelve; establishes what should be included in such curriculum including the basics of financial planning, budgeting, borrowing, interest rates, personal insurance policies, etc.

short_summary: Authorizes boards of cooperative educational services to enroll students in career and technical education courses
summary: Authorizes boards of cooperative educational services to enroll students in career and technical education courses.

short_summary: Relates to administering asthma rescue medications and authorizing schools to have asthma rescue medications for emergency situations
summary: Relates to administering asthma rescue medications and authorizing schools to possess and administer asthma rescue medications in emergency situations to pupils with a requirement that the parent or guardian of such pupils are notified in writing of such emergency situation.

short_summary: Relates to the justified use of physical force
summary: Relates to the justified use of physical force; removes requirement that a person facing an imminent physical threat must retreat; provides immunity from civil and criminal liability.

short_summary: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer seizure rescue medication in schools
summary: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer certain seizure rescue medication in schools, on school grounds and at school events; provides that such medicine may be left with a school health official to be used as needed.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state community doula directory for doulas serving Medicaid patients
summary: Requires the department of health to establish and maintain the New York state community doula directory for doulas on such department's website for the purposes of Medicaid reimbursement and promoting doula services to Medicaid recipients; establishes criteria for admittance into the New York state community doula directory; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires insurance companies to provide at least ninety days of rehabilitation services to an insured upon a doctor's prescription
summary: Requires insurance companies to provide at least ninety days of rehabilitation services to an insured upon a doctor's prescription.

short_summary: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card
summary: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card.

short_summary: Relates to the physician loan repayment program and medical malpractice rate relief program in designated physician shortage areas
summary: Relates to funds used for the physician loan repayment program and the regents physicians loan forgiveness program for physicians practicing in designated physician shortage areas and creates the medical malpractice rate relief program within the regents physician loan forgiveness program in designated physician shortage areas.

short_summary: Relates to flood insurance notice in communities bordering Lake Ontario
summary: Relates to flood insurance notice in communities bordering Lake Ontario; requires the department of financial services to publish an annual notice with the department's contact information and a statement about flood insurance and how it relates to standard homeowners insurance policies in local newspapers that serve the communities bordering Lake Ontario.

short_summary: Establishes credits against income tax for a teacher's unreimbursed expenditures for qualified supplies
summary: Establishes credits against income tax for a teacher's unreimbursed expenditures for qualified supplies.

short_summary: Increases the portion of real property taxes that a manufacturer may take as a business franchise or personal income tax credit
summary: Increases from 20% to 100% the portion of real property taxes that a manufacturer may take as a business franchise or personal income tax credit.

short_summary: Relates to calculation of the earned income credit
summary: Relates to calculation of the earned income credit for taxable years beginning in 2024, provides the applicable percentage shall be 45%.

short_summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry
summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry.

short_summary: Authorizes the Schuyler correctional facility to also be used for the detention of persons under arrest and being held for arraignment in any court located in the county of Schuyler
summary: Authorizes the Schuyler correctional facility to also be used for the detention of persons under arrest and being held for arraignment in any court located in the county of Schuyler.

short_summary: Requires insurers offering renewal of Medicare supplemental insurance policies to notify holders of the availability of similar policies
summary: Requires insurers offering renewal of certain Medicare supplemental insurance policies or providing notification of a change in premiums of such policies to notify policyholders of the availability of policies offered by such insurer with similar benefits at a comparable premium or the ability of such policyholder to purchase a different policy without the pre-existing condition waiting period; applies to policies for which such insurers no longer accept new contracts but continue to renew for existing policyholders.

short_summary: Relates to sentencing
summary: Relates to sentencing for youthful offenders.

short_summary: Places a permanent moratorium on unfunded mandates
summary: Places a permanent moratorium on unfunded mandates.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish at least 4 maternal-infant care centers in areas of need for infants suffering from drug withdrawal as a result of in utero exposure
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish at least 4 maternal-infant care centers in areas of need for infants suffering from drug withdrawal as a result of in utero exposure.

short_summary: Provides for personal caregiving visitors for general hospital patients
summary: Provides for regulations to require general hospitals to allow personal caregiving visitors for patients.

short_summary: Establishes a retirement service credit for volunteer fire or emergency service
summary: Establishes a retirement service credit for volunteer fire or emergency service.

short_summary: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations
summary: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations; expands the definition of "veteran" and "non-disabled veteran" to include the spouse and/or children of a member of the armed forces of the United States who served therein in time of war and was subsequently killed in the line of duty.

short_summary: Enacts Caylee's law; establishes the crime of failure to report a child's disappearance or death
summary: Enacts Caylee's law; establishes the crime of failure to report a child's disappearance or death, a class D felony; makes exception where child dies while under the medical care of a licensed physician.

short_summary: Designates black dirt as the state soil and to designate the black dirt region as home to the most fertile soil
summary: Designates black dirt as the state soil; designates the black dirt region as home to the most fertile soil.

short_summary: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
summary: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers in a county with a population of more than 250,000 and less than 500,000 persons.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of Melinda's Law in relation to the basis for removal of children
summary: Protects a parent who is a victim of domestic violence from having children removed from their custody if they reported the abuse.

short_summary: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty
summary: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty.

short_summary: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits
summary: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits.

short_summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative
summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative; establishes the department shall discontinue implementation of the common core state standards.

short_summary: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund
summary: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund; provides that a fine not exceeding two thousand dollars may be imposed on real estate appraisers for certain acts or omissions.

short_summary: Relates to environmental assessment of historic preservation plan
summary: Relates to the environmental assessment of a historic preservation plan; addresses environmental impact statements, dates for filing drafts of such statewide comprehensive historic preservation plan, funds available for historic preservation purposes, and the New York state archaeological survey assistance fund.

short_summary: Relates to conciliation and non-compliance with public assistance employment; repealer
summary: Relates to conciliation and non-compliance with public assistance employment.

short_summary: Allows counties to opt out of providing certain optional Medicaid benefits to prospective beneficiaries
summary: Authorizes the state to allow counties to opt out of the county cost of medical assistance payments to any new enrollees who have either never received such benefits or who have reenrolled after a period of absence; directs the commissioner of health to apply for any and all federal waivers required to implement the provisions of this subdivision.

short_summary: Requires lifetime post-release supervision for certain offenders; prohibits good behavior allowances against certain determinate sentences
summary: Requires lifetime post-release supervision for offenders convicted of rape in the first degree, criminal sexual act in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the first degree, course of sexual conduct against a child in the first and second degrees or sexual abuse in the first degree when the other person is less than eleven years old; prohibits good behavior allowances against a determinate sentence for a person convicted of any such crimes.

short_summary: Relates to the metropolitan transit authority
summary: Relates to the metropolitan transit authority; provides that the members from the counties of Dutchess, Orange, Putnam and Rockland shall each cast one vote apiece, instead of one collective vote.

short_summary: Establishes a work group to set reimbursement rates for doulas in the state Medicaid program and address other criteria related to their practice
summary: Establishes a 14 member doula Medicaid reimbursement work group within the department of health to set reimbursement rates for doulas in the state Medicaid program and address other criteria related to their practice; requires the work group to conduct a study and evaluate the costs, benefits and issues that may be associated with Medicaid reimbursement for doulas and for providing doula care to Medicaid recipients; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service
summary: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities located in the county of Orange and county of Rockland to charge for the cost of providing additional police protection to paid-admission events
summary: Authorizes municipalities located in the county of Orange and county of Rockland to charge for the cost of providing additional police protection to paid-admission events.

short_summary: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products
summary: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and maintain a list of toxins which members of the military may have come into contact with
summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and maintain a list of toxins which members of the military may have come into contact with; requires doctors to ask patients whether they have served in the military.

short_summary: Repeals section 3 of article 16 relating to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein
summary: Relates to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the New York state thruway authority accountability act
summary: Enacts the New York state thruway authority accountability act; names the commissioner of DOT as chair of the thruway authority board; directs the commissioner of DOT to submit a plan to merge the thruway authority into the department of transportation.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of aggravated assault upon a police officer or a peace officer
summary: Relates to the crime of aggravated assault upon a police officer or a peace officer.

short_summary: Requires funeral directors to deliver death certificates
summary: Requires funeral directors to ensure that death certificates are delivered to the state health department and the department of health of the city of New York who shall in turn deliver certain certificates to the state board of elections.

short_summary: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans
summary: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans.

short_summary: Relates to the presumption of intent to sell heroin
summary: Creates the presumption of intent to sell when a person is in possession of forty or more individual packages containing heroin with an aggregate weight of 4.0 grams.

short_summary: Relates to the unlawful wearing of a body vest
summary: Makes it unlawful to wear a body vest while committing any crime while possessing a deadly weapon.

short_summary: Relates to income earned while working at the polls
summary: Exempts income earned working at the polls from the definition of income.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the department of health to prepare a report on the number of surplus ventilators within the state at the conclusion of the COVID-19 state of emergency
summary: Requires the department of health to prepare a report on the number of surplus ventilators within the state at the conclusion of the COVID-19 state of emergency.

short_summary: Relates to providing loan forgiveness for agriculture educators
summary: Relates to providing loan forgiveness for agriculture educators who provide didactic instruction to students about agriculture, food, and natural resources.

short_summary: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for members of the New York city fire department pension fund
summary: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for certain members; provides that in the computation of the normal service retirement benefit of members of the New York city fire department pension fund, there shall be no reduction for the primary social security retirement benefit.

short_summary: Relates to certifying certain professionals as emergency service technicians to service rural areas
summary: Allows certain certified registered nurse anesthetists, nurse practitioners, physician assistants or physicians to be able to be certified as an emergency service technician to service rural areas of the state.

short_summary: Relates to ammunition capacity in firearms; repealer
summary: Removes ammunition capacity set forth in the NY SAFE ACT of 2013; repeals certain provisions relating to the unlawful possession of ammunition or ammunition feeding devices.

short_summary: Establishes a certified transitional tax credit
summary: Establishes a certified transitional tax credit for taxpayers that demonstrate their agricultural products were sold during a period of transition into USDA organic certification, under the Whole Foods Market IP. L.P. "responsibly grown" labelling program, or under the QAI and Hesco, Inc. "certified transitional" label.

short_summary: Establishes a non-trail snowmobile registration for snowmobiles which shall be used solely for the purpose of gaining access to hunting, fishing and trapping areas
summary: Establishes a non-trail snowmobile registration for snowmobiles which shall be used solely for the purpose of gaining access to hunting, fishing and trapping areas.

short_summary: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities
summary: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities; provides penalties for safety violations and operating without a valid license; prohibits reductions in fines in certain circumstances where a patient is endangered or harmed.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the use of project labor agreements for large scale construction projects under the state university construction fund
summary: Relates to requiring the use of project labor agreements for large scale construction projects under the state university construction fund; provides an exception to such requirement may be granted; provides that the fund may require every contractor become party to a project labor agreement.

short_summary: Relates to providing reforms to employee pension contributions; repealer
summary: Relates to providing reforms to employee pension contributions; provides that members of Tier 6 shall contribute three percent of annual wages to their retirement system.

short_summary: Establishes a farm savings account program
summary: Establishes a farm savings account program.

short_summary: Prohibits a member of the legislature from disbursing moneys pursuant to memoranda of understanding regarding certain line item appropriations prior to an election
summary: Prohibits a member of the legislature from disbursing or making public moneys pursuant to a memoranda of understanding regarding certain line item appropriations prior to such member's election.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of non-ambulatory for purposes of non-ambulatory hunting permits
summary: Relates to the definition of non-ambulatory for purposes of non-ambulatory hunting permits.

summary: Prohibits members of the legislature from obtaining funding through state grants or member items and subsequently providing such funding to any business entities or not-for-profit entities in which such officials, members, domestic partners or certain relatives hold official or legal positions.

short_summary: Authorizes NYS power authority to allow certain governments and corporations to bundle electrical services
summary: Authorizes the NYS power authority to allow certain governments and corporations to bundle electrical services.

short_summary: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service
summary: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service.

short_summary: Authorizes the county seat in Delaware county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
summary: Requires the county seat in Delaware county (Delhi) to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

short_summary: Requires subsidiaries of certain transportation authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration
summary: Requires subsidiaries of certain transportation authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration.

short_summary: Relates to registration fees for snowmobiles to be used on frozen bodies of water for sport fishing or for access to hunting or trapping lands solely
summary: Provides registration fees for snowmobiles used on frozen bodies of water solely for sport fishing or for access to hunting or trapping lands.

short_summary: Relates to establishing compulsory voting
summary: Establishes compulsory voting, with some exceptions, for general elections held in this state.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit to taxpayers who grow the base ingredients necessary for the production of beer
summary: Provides a tax credit to taxpayers who grow the base ingredients necessary for the production of beer.

short_summary: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; repealer
summary: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; requires regulations set an amount of no less than $50 a month; clarifies that service dogs do not have to be certified to qualify for such benefits.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance
summary: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance.

short_summary: Relates to determination of public assistance eligibility
summary: Relates to determination of public assistance eligibility; reduces time frame for determinations on safety net assistance.

short_summary: Includes coverage for menstrual products under the supplemental nutrition assistance program
summary: Provides an additional monthly public assistance allowance of $10 for menstrual products, including but not limited to, tampons, sanitary napkins, cups and panty liners.

short_summary: Provides internet access and access to internet-enabled devices to recipients of public assistance and to adults and children in shelters and similar facilities
summary: Provides for internet access and access to internet-enabled devices to recipients of public assistance and to adults and children in shelters, domestic violence residence programs, and other adult and children residence facilities.

short_summary: Relates to services for victims of domestic violence; repealer
summary: Relates to services for victims of domestic violence; provides that the department of social services shall ensure there is sufficient access to domestic violence services in every county; eliminates per diem reimbursement rates for domestic violence programs.

short_summary: Directs the New York state interagency task force on human trafficking to investigate connections between social media and human trafficking
summary: Directs the New York state interagency task force on human trafficking to investigate connections between social media and human trafficking.

short_summary: Relates to establishing transition shelters for individuals released from prison
summary: Establishes transition shelters for individuals released from prison for up to six months to provide housing counseling and prevent the risk of overdose.

short_summary: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance
summary: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance; provides for an increased monthly allowance for persons and families residing in shelters.

short_summary: Exempts IRAs and Roth IRAs in the calculation of household benefits under public assistance programs
summary: Exempts IRAs and Roth IRAs in the calculation of household benefits under public assistance programs.

short_summary: Requires the notification of individuals that certain work-study, internship, externship or other work placements meet the work requirements of title nine-B of the social services law
summary: Requires the notification of individuals that certain work-study, internship, externship or other work placements offered by institutions of higher education meet the work requirements of title nine-B of article five of the social services law.

short_summary: Relates to public assistance applications
summary: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to simplify the application process for public assistance benefits.

short_summary: Requires social service's applications to be made available online
summary: Requires all social service's applications to be made publicly available online on the department's website.

short_summary: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against him or her in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance
summary: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against him or her in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance.

short_summary: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status
summary: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status; provides that local social services districts in a city with a population of five million or more shall be permitted to offer certain housing programs to individuals or families who would be eligible but for a federal law restricting eligibility based on immigration.

short_summary: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid
summary: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid; forgives any outstanding repayment agreements for rent arrears.

short_summary: Defines closed period of eligibility for purposes of certain supplemental security income and includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income
summary: Defines "closed period of eligibility" for purposes of supplemental security income for aged, blind, and disabled persons; includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income.

short_summary: Relates to criteria for the establishment of banking development districts
summary: Provides that a community which is underbanked shall be criteria for the establishment of banking development districts.

short_summary: Relates to safeguarding abortion access through data privacy protection
summary: Prohibits persons or entities headquartered or incorporated in New York that provide electronic communications services to the general public, from producing records that would reveal the identity of the customers using those services, data stored by or on behalf of the customers, the customers' usage of those services, the recipient or destination of communications sent to or from those customers, or the content of those communications, when served with a warrant issued by another state to produce records under certain circumstances, and prohibits geofencing of health care facilities for certain purposes.

short_summary: Extends provisions related to the New York State Rehabilitation Association
summary: Extends provisions related to the New York State Rehabilitation Association from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2028.

short_summary: Authorizes the department of financial services to prescribe by regulation the order of payment of checks and other debts, insufficient funds charges and return deposit item charges
summary: Authorizes the department of financial services to prescribe by regulation the order of payment of checks and other debts, insufficient funds charges and return deposit item charges.

short_summary: Relates to the naturally occurring retirement community supportive service program
summary: Directs the state office for the aging to conduct a study on the number of older adults residing in naturally occurring retirement communities or neighborhood naturally occurring retirement communities who are suffering from social isolation and loneliness; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to minority depository institutions which apply to establish a home or branch office in an unbanked or underbanked community
summary: Relates to minority depository institutions which apply to establish a home or branch office in an unbanked or underbanked community; provides that such institutions shall be entitled to receive deposits from the state comptroller and the commissioner of taxation and finance.

short_summary: Relates to the reporting requirements regarding the residence of a sex offender
summary: Requires that a sex offender must report each address where he or she resides, including any multiple or part-time residences.

short_summary: Allows a suspending authority to condition the early return of a student on such student's voluntary participation in counseling or certain classes
summary: Allows a suspending authority to condition the early return of a student on such student's voluntary participation in counseling or specialized classes, including anger management or dispute resolution, where applicable.

short_summary: Relates to potable water testing at state and local parks
summary: Requires potable water testing at state and local parks at least once every three years and any finding of lead contamination must be abated within ninety days.

short_summary: Requires five percent of affordable housing units to be offered to veterans
summary: Requires five percent of affordable housing units to be offered to veterans.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system the "Trooper Gerard B. Kane and Trooper Arthur B. Reddy Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Deer Park Avenue between Parkdale Drive and Sylvan Road in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, the "Trooper Gerard B. Kane and Trooper Arthur B. Reddy Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Increases the jurisdictional limits for small claims to fifteen thousand dollars
summary: Increases the jurisdictional limits for small claims to fifteen thousand dollars.

short_summary: Relates to designating January 13th as Korean-American Day
summary: Relates to designating January 13th as Korean-American Day.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the New York small business relief fund
summary: Establishes the New York small business relief fund consisting of monetary penalties imposed by the state liquor authority to provide grants to small businesses which have suffered economic hardship as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

short_summary: Prohibits children twelve years old and younger from playing tackle football
summary: Prohibits children twelve years old and younger from playing tackle football.

short_summary: Establishes the Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act
summary: Establishes the "Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act" which provides for a withholding of a certain amount of state funding for a defunding municipality.

short_summary: Establishes the police safety equipment grant program within the division of criminal justice services and makes an appropriation therefor
summary: Creates a police safety equipment grant program to provide for services and expenses related to police safety equipment; directs a sum of $30,000,000 to be appropriated to such program.

short_summary: Provides for certain death benefits to fire marshals employed by Nassau county
summary: Provides for certain death benefits to county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals, chief fire marshals and division supervising fire marshals employed by Nassau county.

short_summary: Relates to the eligibility for awards for victims of a crime
summary: Relates to the eligibility for awards for victims of a crime; includes the commission of suicide within two years after being a victim of a crime as a death that is the direct result of a crime.

short_summary: Establishes the Northport high school peer mentoring pilot program
summary: Establishes the Northport high school peer mentoring pilot program.

short_summary: Imposes a term limit on town supervisors
summary: Imposes a term limit of four years on town supervisors.

short_summary: Requires the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly to provide each member of their respective chamber with any reports issued to them
summary: Requires the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly to provide each member of their respective chamber with any reports issued to them.

short_summary: Exempts certain books, magazines, pamphlets and other related items sold at certain book fairs from sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Exempts books, magazines, pamphlets and other related items sold at a primary or secondary school facility or at a library at a book fair organized, hosted or sponsored by an organization established for educational purposes, including but not limited to a parent-teacher association, booster club, or a similar school-based association which supports school activities, or a friends of the library organization from sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of blood lead levels
summary: Relates to the definition of elevated blood lead levels; provides that elevated lead levels means a blood lead level greater than or equal to 3.5 micrograms of lead per deciliter of whole blood or such lower blood lead level as may be established by the department of health pursuant to rule or regulation.

short_summary: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer
summary: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer.

short_summary: Relates to communications by retail stores attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions
summary: Relates to communications by retail stores attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions.

short_summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a Long Island deer management pilot program
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a Long Island deer management pilot program in the town of Southold.

short_summary: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district
summary: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district.

short_summary: Relates to assault on a member of an auxiliary police program
summary: Includes injury to an on-duty auxiliary police officer within the elements of assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Relates to display of governor's portraits in the state capitol
summary: Requires a concurrent resolution of the legislature to permit the display in the state capitol of a portrait of any governor who does not complete any term for which they were elected; excludes death in office.

short_summary: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the 9-11 Fallen Firefighter Memorial Highway
summary: Designates a portion of the Long Island Expressway as the "9-11 Fallen Firefighter Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to the improvement and operation of sober living homes
summary: Relates to the improvement and operation of sober living homes including the process for certification, inspections, and violations and the establishment of a toll free hotline to respond to complaints.

short_summary: Requires that all victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing
summary: Requires that all victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board and all presiding commissioners for such hearing review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing.

short_summary: Relates to manufactured home parks
summary: Removes certain requirements for prospective purchasers of manufactured home parks.

short_summary: Designates the Montauk Point shoals as an important bird area, and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to designate such area as part of the New York state bird conservation area program
summary: Designates the Montauk Point shoals as an important bird area; directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to designate such area as part of the New York state bird conservation area program.

short_summary: Creates the under-grounding of electrical power or telecommunications lines fund
summary: Creates the under-grounding of electrical power or telecommunications lines fund to provide for the purpose of moving overhead electrical power or telecommunications lines underground from monies appropriated, including, but not limited to, any funds supplied by the Federal Emergency Management Agency for disaster recovery and hazard mitigation which may be used for state infrastructure repair.

short_summary: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's Day
summary: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's day.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to promote education in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
summary: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to promote education in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

short_summary: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the sale of single use plastic and polystyrene foam in state parks
summary: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the sale of single use plastic and polystyrene foam in state parks.

short_summary: Allows certain parties of releases and covenants involving PFAS to seek contribution from other responsible parties
summary: Allows certain parties of releases and covenants involving PFAS to seek contribution from other responsible parties.

short_summary: Establishes the green air travel tax, the green fund, and the state airline community resiliency board
summary: Establishes a green air travel tax for all passengers who fly to or from an airport located in a city having a population of one million or more persons; establishes the green fund to be used for the purpose of providing grants to non-profits, qualified community-based organizations and local governments in communities disproportionally impacted by the health detriments and quality of life issues associated with airline communities; establishes the state airline community resiliency board to make determinations regarding how to spend monies from the green fund.

short_summary: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders; repealer
summary: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders upon conviction of a violent felony offense when such person has previously been subjected to two or more predicate violent felony convictions.

short_summary: Elevates killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony
summary: Elevates the offense of killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony; establishes the class E felony of injuring a police work dog or police work horse for intentionally causing serious physical injury to a police work dog or police work horse while such dog or horse is performing its duties under the supervision of a police officer.

short_summary: Requires a defendant who causes the death of a person with children due to driving while intoxicated or impaired to pay for child support
summary: Requires a defendant who causes the death of a person with children due to driving while intoxicated or impaired to pay for child support of such children until they reach the age of 18 years old.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of composting bags
summary: Requires composting bags sold within the state be made of paper.

short_summary: Requires the state comptroller and the attorney general to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management
summary: Requires the state comptroller, the attorney general and independent certified public accountants to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system the "Trooper Fabio Buttitta Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates the bridge over the Sagtikos Parkway on G Road in the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, the "Trooper Fabio Buttitta Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the use or sale of single use plastic straws and beverage stirrers in state parks
summary: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the use or sale of single use plastic straws and beverage stirrers in state parks.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system the "Senior Investigator Thomas M. O'Neill Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates the bridge over the Sagtikos Parkway constituting the Crooked Hill Road Overpass in the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, the "Senior Investigator Thomas M. O'Neill Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to penalties for promotion of a suicide attempt
summary: Provides that a person may be charged with promoting a suicide or manslaughter if he or she is convicted of endangering the welfare of a vulnerable elderly person, an incompetent or physically disabled person and the conduct was the proximate cause of the victim's suicide.

short_summary: Defines the terms "person", "human", and "human being" in the state constitution
summary: Defines the terms "person", "human", and "human being" to mean a member of the species homo sapiens at any stage of biological development beginning at the moment of fertilization regardless of age, health, level of functioning, or condition of dependency; requires the right to life of all human beings.

short_summary: Requires the establishment of electronics and hazardous waste recycling programs in towns within Nassau and Suffolk counties
summary: Requires the establishment of electronics and hazardous waste recycling programs in towns within Nassau and Suffolk counties for one year.

short_summary: Requires all public buildings and all parks, recreation and historic preservation sites have bins for recyclable and compostable materials
summary: Requires all public buildings and all parks, recreation and historic preservation sites have bins for recyclable and compostable materials.

short_summary: Prohibits point source pollution in the Long Island Sound and Great South Bay
summary: Prohibits certain types of pollution in the Long Island Sound and Great South Bay.

short_summary: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations and provides support for relatives of such missing persons
summary: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations; provides support for relatives of such missing persons.

short_summary: Relates to school property and real property taxes
summary: Relates to school property and real property taxes; establishes the blue ribbon commission on property tax reform; relates to state assistance for local real property reassessment, state assistance to assessing units within a school district, providing a fixed real property assessed value for residential real property owned by certain persons over the age of 65 and providing state reimbursement to municipalities for lost real property tax revenue; requires the state to fund certain programs mandated for municipal corporations or school districts.

short_summary: Relates to dimensions and weights of vehicles
summary: Relates to dimensions and weights of vehicles.

short_summary: Creates the "I love NY outdoors" program; appropriation
summary: Creates the "I love NY outdoors" program; such program shall require the commissioner of economic development to develop a marketing strategy that would promote New York as a premiere destination for hunting and fishing; appropriates $2,500,000 therefor.

short_summary: Requires the use of remote training programs in code enforcement training
summary: Requires the use of remote training programs in code enforcement training to the maximum extent possible.

short_summary: Relates to unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft over a critical infrastructure facility
summary: Provides that it is a class E felony to operate a model or unmanned aircraft over a critical infrastructure facility including an electrical power generating facility, petroleum or natural gas refinery or stage facility, or an aboveground oil, gas or chemical pipeline.

short_summary: Requires certain information about the facility be provided to prospective maternity patients
summary: Requires certain information about the facility and what types of plans and procedures such facility has in place to be provided to prospective maternity patients.

short_summary: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit
summary: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit to qualifying employees.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state familial search policy and the release of information for familial DNA searches
summary: Establishes the New York state familial search policy; relates to the release of certain information for familial DNA searches where a written agreement governing the use and dissemination of such DNA records exists.

short_summary: Relates to establishing an electoral voting system for electing the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller and attorney general
summary: Establishes an electoral voting system for electing the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller and attorney general.

short_summary: Requires certain businesses in which alcohol or cannabis is consumed have opioid antagonists
