summary: Requires retail licensees for on-premises consumption of alcohol and adult-use on-site consumption of cannabis licensees have opioid antagonists to be administered to patrons, staff or individuals on premises of such establishment.

short_summary: Permits municipalities, schools and fire and police departments to display and sell symbols of hope
summary: Permits municipal corporations, fire districts, volunteer fire companies, police departments and school districts to sell and display symbols of hope in support of law enforcement, emergency medical personnel, the military, border patrol, firefighters, conservation officers and others.

short_summary: Requires certain persons attend the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program
summary: Requires certain persons attend the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program.

short_summary: Includes information on if a person previously lived in a nursing home on his or her death certificate
summary: Includes information on if a person previously lived in a nursing home on his or her death certificate.

short_summary: Allows for the denial, suspension or discontinuance of public assistance or care where a person does not participate in three consecutive scheduled interviews with a social services official
summary: Allows for the denial, suspension or discontinuance of public assistance or care where a person does not participate in three consecutive scheduled interviews with a social services official.

short_summary: Requires the MTA to submit an annual report on all contract cost overruns that exceed one million dollars
summary: Requires the MTA to submit an annual report on all minor and major contract cost overruns; establishes such report shall include a list of all contracts where overruns exceed one million dollars, all contracting firms involved, the winning bid amounts, the actual costs incurred, a description of the project, completion delays, and an analysis of why the contract bid amount was exceeded.

short_summary: Provides for parental notification when charter schools receive a corrective action plan or are given a short-term renewal
summary: Provides for parental notification when charter schools receive a corrective action plan or are given a short-term renewal.

short_summary: Establishes the office of hospice and palliative care access and quality
summary: Establishes the office of hospice and palliative care access and quality to provide expertise and input on hospice and palliative care policy development and regulation.

short_summary: Relates to the protection and promotion of the mental health of the residents of New York state
summary: Requires parity in the mental and physical health treatment of the residents of New York state; provides that both mental and physical health "will be matters of public concern and provision therefor shall be made by the state and by such of its subdivisions".

short_summary: Relates to the ability of an individual collecting unemployment to obtain part-time work
summary: Relates to allowing claimants collecting unemployment to obtain part-time work without losing their unemployment benefits.

short_summary: Allows for principals to be remanded into custody for drug treatment where there is a risk of continued substance abuse
summary: Allows for principals to be remanded into custody for drug treatment where there is a risk of continued substance abuse or the use of an opioid antagonist was required.

short_summary: Prohibits certain owner occupancy evictions
summary: Prohibits the owner of a building from declining to renew a lease to a tenant whose lease term started prior to the owner's purchase of the building on the grounds of occupancy by the owner or an immediate family member.

short_summary: Relates to the criminal possession of fentanyl
summary: Provides that criminal possession of fentanyl is a class E felony.

short_summary: Requires all commercial buildings be retrofitted with motion detectors for controlling lighting
summary: Requires all commercial buildings be retrofitted with motion detectors for controlling lighting.

short_summary: Establishes a training wage equal to eighty-five percent of the state minimum wage or one hundred percent of the federal minimum wage
summary: Establishes a training wage equal to eighty-five percent of the state minimum wage or one hundred percent of the federal minimum wage, whichever is greater, that may be paid to a youth who has no prior job experience; provides that no youth may be paid a training wage for more than one hundred eighty days.

short_summary: Requires instruction in owning and operating a business
summary: Requires instruction in owning and operating a business including, but not limited to, basic financial literacy necessary for sound financial decision-making, leadership, management, communication, budgeting, savings, credit, debt, insurance, taxation, and other issues associated with owning and operating a business.

short_summary: Requires propeller guards on all vessels
summary: Requires propeller guards on all vessels.

short_summary: Prohibits unlawful disposal of solid waste on private and state property
summary: Prohibits unlawful disposal of solid waste on private and state property.

short_summary: Requires boating safety courses to be completed once every three years
summary: Requires boating safety courses to be completed once every three years.

short_summary: Relates to exempting certain counties from the metropolitan commuter transportation district supplemental registration fee
summary: Eliminates the obligation for motorists in certain counties to pay the metropolitan commuter transportation district supplemental registration fee.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for financial assistance from industrial development agencies
summary: Requires applicants for financial assistance from industrial development agencies to provide information on the use of material and products manufactured or produced in this state and on the creation of local jobs.

short_summary: Relates to the provision of criminal history background checks free of charge to mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations
summary: Relates to the provision of criminal history background checks free of charge to mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations.

short_summary: Relates to the liability of the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways
summary: Imposes liability on the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways year round.

short_summary: Establishes a pilot program relating to creating the solar panels to school districts on Long Island pilot program
summary: Establishes a pilot program relating to creating the solar panels to the state universities of New York and boards of cooperative educational services located on Long Island in order that such universities and BOCES may conduct a training program for persons interested in learning solar panel installation and operation and then to install such solar panels upon school districts in Long Island.

short_summary: Relates to the display of green lights on the vehicles of members of mobile crisis teams
summary: Relates to the display of green lights on the vehicles of members of mobile crisis teams.

short_summary: Relates to crimes committed against a child
summary: Relates to crimes against a child; makes endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree a crime.

short_summary: Relates to the distribution of fines from speed violation monitoring systems in work zones
summary: Provides that within a county that has established a traffic and parking violations agency and a liability is disposed of by such agency, eighty percent of such fine or penalty shall be paid to the thruway authority, and twenty percent of such fine or penalty shall be paid to the county in which the violation giving rise to the liability occurred; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the distribution of surplus proceeds from a tax foreclosure sale
summary: Provides for the distribution of proceeds from a tax foreclosure sale; requires notice to a former property owner of the existence of a surplus.

short_summary: Enacts the "roadway excavation quality assurance act"
summary: Enacts the "roadway excavation quality assurance act"; relates to workers on excavations; provides that utility companies or their contractors shall use competent workers and shall pay the prevailing wage on projects where a permit to use, excavate, or open a street is required to be issued.

short_summary: Relates to providing language access services
summary: Relates to providing certain language access services for injured employees with limited English proficiency.

short_summary: Relates to establishing restrictions on the sale of over-the-counter diet pills and dietary supplements for weight loss or muscle building
summary: Relates to establishing restrictions on the sale of over-the-counter diet pills and dietary supplements for weight loss or muscle building; prohibits the sale of over-the-counter diet pills or dietary supplements for weight loss or muscle building to people under 18; exempts certain protein powders, protein drinks and foods.

short_summary: Relates to observing Atlantic time
summary: Relates to causing New York to observe Atlantic time.

short_summary: Relates to the office of state inspector general
summary: Provides for increased independence of the office of state inspector general; requires annual reports to the legislature on the activities of the office.

short_summary: Relates to accessing records under the freedom of information law
summary: Provides for accessing records under the freedom of information law including notification procedures and the release of names of natural persons and residential addresses.

short_summary: Enacts the integrity in government act
summary: Enacts the integrity in government act; expands the powers and duties of the committee on open government.

short_summary: Relates to public petitions for rule making
summary: Relates to public petitions for rule making.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for owners of property who fail to file a proper or timely rent registration statement
summary: Relates to penalties for owners of property who fail to file a proper or timely rent registration statement.

short_summary: Expands remedies for violations of New York state uniform fire prevention and building code
summary: Expands remedies for violations of New York state uniform fire prevention and building code.

short_summary: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code
summary: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code by counties.

short_summary: Relates to the provision of regulatory information to small businesses
summary: Relates to the provision of regulatory information to small businesses through the establishment of a small business regulatory nexus by certain agencies.

short_summary: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
summary: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

short_summary: Relates to the withholding of salaries of elected officials who have been indicted on charges of any crimes related to their public office
summary: Relates to the withholding of salaries of elected officials who have been indicted on charges of any crimes related to their public office.

short_summary: Relates to the enforcement of violations
summary: Prohibits state agencies from imposing or suggesting any enforcement quotas or from using quotas as a reward to evaluation method.

short_summary: Provides for the de-regulation of rent-stabilized housing accommodations
summary: Relates to the de-regulation of rent-stabilized housing accommodations; eliminates rent regulation for any regulated housing accommodation that becomes vacant on or after June 16, 2024; makes exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to rent increases in certain cases; repealer
summary: Relates to permitting certain rent increases for capital improvements to rent regulated buildings and apartments.

short_summary: Requires anti-bias training for every medical student, medical resident and physician assistant student in the state
summary: Requires anti-bias training for every medical student, medical resident and physician assistant student in the state; requires the department of health to make an annual report on the implementation and effectiveness of such training.

short_summary: Prohibits members of the state police, police officers, and peace officers from intentionally covering their badges
summary: Prohibits members of the state police, police officers, and peace officers from intentionally covering their badges.

short_summary: Requires the department of health to conduct a public information and outreach campaign on medically unnecessary treatments on persons born with intersex traits or variations in sex characteristics
summary: Requires the department of health to conduct a public information and outreach campaign on medically unnecessary treatments on persons born with intersex traits or variations in sex characteristics.

short_summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk, to accept from Mother and Unborn Baby Care of LI, Inc., an application for exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk, to accept from Mother and Unborn Baby Care of Long Island, Inc., an application for exemption from real property taxes.

short_summary: Relates to forfeiture of a beneficiary's right to benefits upon conviction of domestic violence offense
summary: Permits a retired member to change his or her option election or designate a new beneficiary where the beneficiary has been convicted of a family offense.

short_summary: Allows beneficiaries of certain deceased members to elect to receive death benefits in a lump sum
summary: Allows a beneficiary of a member whose death occurs on or after July 1, 2023 and who would have been entitled to a service credit at the time of such member's death to elect to receive a lump sum payment equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death.

short_summary: Enacts the New York state fashion workers act
summary: Provides for the registration and duties of model management companies; provides complaint procedures and penalties for violations.

short_summary: Enacts the dark skies protection act
summary: Regulates outdoor night lighting to preserve and enhance the state's dark sky.

short_summary: Relates to the utilization of renewable energy at state-owned facilities in Albany
summary: Enacts the "Renewable Capitol act"; requires the office of general services, in consultation with the power authority of the state of New York, to ensure that all operations that power, heat or cool the empire state plaza complex shall entirely use renewable energy systems; requires the office of general services to establish an advisory committee to advise the office of general services on the preparation, design and content of a plan for the use of renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Relates to compensation paid to persons employed in positions requiring foreign language skills
summary: Relates to compensation paid to persons employed in positions requiring foreign language skills; establishes career ladders for persons holding such positions; establishes supervisory positions for persons required to have foreign language skills.

short_summary: Excludes certain judgments, orders or decrees issued in a matrimonial action from a stay of enforcement without a court order
summary: Excludes certain judgments, orders or decrees issued in a matrimonial action from a stay of enforcement without a court order.

short_summary: Expands the health education curriculum to include breast cancer screenings
summary: Expands the health education curriculum to include breast cancer screenings including age appropriate instruction in performing self-examinations.

short_summary: Provides that state departments, offices, agencies, and authorities are prohibited from imposing any fees, surcharges, or taxes that have not been approved
summary: Provides that state departments, offices, agencies, and authorities are prohibited from imposing any fees, surcharges, or taxes that have not been approved by the state legislature.

short_summary: Authorizes the posting by each municipality of turtle crossing signs on local roads located within such municipality
summary: Authorizes the posting by each municipality of turtle crossing signs on local roads located within such municipality; empowers the state commissioner of transportation to develop and implement rules and regulations authorizing municipalities to post turtle crossing signs on local roads located within the municipality.

short_summary: Requires certain trains and locomotives to have a crew size of not less than two persons
summary: Provides that no person operating or controlling any Class I railroad or Class II railroad shall allow the operation of any railroad train or locomotive for the movement of freight unless such railroad train or locomotive has a crew of not less than two individuals; provides exemptions; defines terms; imposes civil penalties.

short_summary: Establishes a third-party secure vendor mail program
summary: Establishes a third-party secure vendor mail program for the delivery of all products to incarcerated individuals housed at correctional facilities.

short_summary: Provides for certain uses of premises for which no duty is owed to keep premises safe
summary: Provides that the owner, lessee or occupant of premises owes no duty to keep the premises safe for entry or use by others engaged generally in recreational activities.

short_summary: Enacts the "standing is tiring (sit) act"
summary: Enacts the "standing is tiring (sit) act"; requires employers to provide suitable seats to all employees where the nature of such employees' work reasonably permits seated work; prohibits employers from artificially designing a work space to require standing; requires the department of labor to determine whether the nature of work reasonably permits seated work; creates a private right of action for employees whose employer does not provide seats.

short_summary: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements
summary: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements; sets such time at one hundred and twenty days.

short_summary: Relates to participation in games of bingo by minors
summary: Permits participation in games of bingo by minors who are accompanied by an adult.

short_summary: Prohibits a court from ordering certain physical examinations of the victim of a sexual assault and relates to the admissibility of evidence of the refusal of such victim to undergo such examinations
summary: Prohibits a court from ordering certain physical examinations of the victim of a sexual assault; relates to the admissibility of evidence of the refusal of such victim to undergo such examinations.

short_summary: Makes provisions relating to the collateral estoppel effect of issues decided by certain arbitrators
summary: Enacts the "fairness for accident victims act"; provides that with respect to a serious personal injury action still permissible under the no-fault insurance system, the award or decision of an arbitrator or master arbitrator rendered in a no-fault arbitration will not constitute a collateral estoppel of the issues arbitrated.

short_summary: Relates to limiting the number of shelters in council districts
summary: Relates to limiting the number of shelters in council districts.

short_summary: Authorizes the urban development corporation to evaluate the geographical coverage of programs overseen by the corporation
summary: Authorizes the urban development corporation to evaluate the geographical coverage of programs overseen by the corporation and to work with not-for-profit corporations to supplement the technical assistance needs for communities.

short_summary: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
summary: Provides "WiFi service" internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

short_summary: Requires the state to pass enabling legislation before entering into any compact, program or other legal agreement with any other state
summary: Requires the state to pass enabling legislation before entering into any compact, program or other legal agreement with any other state.

short_summary: Clarifies certain provisions related to excess use or wear and tear of a vehicle leased for personal use for purposes of service contracts
summary: Clarifies certain provisions related to excess use or wear and tear of a vehicle leased for personal use for purposes of service contracts.

short_summary: Relates to acts of the Legislature having fiscal impacts on local governments
summary: Requires the legislature to provide funding to reimburse localities for the costs associated with expenditures made as a requirement of any law which mandates the undertaking of a new program or increases the level of service of an existing program by a locality; requires the legislature to establish procedures for the allocation of funds among the local governments.

short_summary: Relates to price gouging of medicine
summary: Prohibits selling a drug subject to a shortage for an unconscionably excessive price.

short_summary: Requires the department of buildings to maintain a registry of all deeds containing restrictive covenants
summary: Requires the department of buildings to maintain a registry of all deeds containing restrictive covenants.

short_summary: Authorizes a plea of guilty and the payment of fines or penalties electronically via the internet
summary: Authorizes a plea of guilty and the payment of fines or penalties electronically via the internet.

short_summary: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers
summary: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers.

short_summary: Enacts the "forfeiture of campaign finance accounts and return of contributions act"
summary: Enacts the "forfeiture of campaign finance accounts and return of contributions act".

short_summary: Relates to the use of injurious physical force by public servants
summary: Relates to the use of injurious physical force by public servants; directs the commissioner of criminal justice services and the commissioner of health to prescribe standards for the use of physical force and for devices and substances used in the exercise of physical force.

short_summary: Prohibits the liquor authority from revoking, suspending, or canceling certain liquor licenses without a hearing
summary: Prohibits the liquor authority from revoking, suspending, or canceling a retail licensee's license without a hearing when the holder of the license was issued a summons for a violation that is unrelated to the sale or consumption of alcohol on premises.

short_summary: Relates to the dismissal of members on the panel for educational policy
summary: Prohibits the discharge or dismissal of a member of the panel for educational policy without providing such member with a thirty day notice of such discharge or dismissal.

short_summary: Relates to the city charter referendum process; repeals certain provisions regarding adoption of new or revised city charter proposed by charter commission which limit submission of questions to city's electors
summary: Relates to the city charter referendum process; repeals certain provisions regarding the adoption of a new or revised city charter proposed by a charter commission which limit the submission of questions to a city's qualified electors; eliminates the rule that provides that whenever a city charter commission puts a proposal on the local ballot, all other local referendum proposals are barred from the ballot.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the "Nurse Safety Work Act"
summary: Enacts the "Nurse Safety Work Act," which requires the implementation of safety procedures when hospital staff is alone with a patient.

short_summary: Prohibits injecting a person with any substance, including, but not limited to, ketamine, by emergency medical personnel, law enforcement or any entity without the specific consent
summary: Prohibits injecting a person with any substance, including, but not limited to, ketamine, by emergency medical personnel, law enforcement or any entity without the specific consent of the person or their guardian who is authorized to make medical decisions on their behalf except as a life saving measure.

short_summary: Relates to removing citizenship as a qualification for holding public office
summary: Removes citizenship as a qualification for holding public office in this state.

short_summary: Prohibits employers from asking job applicants about salary expectations and allowing job applicants to request the included benefits for the position they are applying for
summary: Prohibits employers from asking job applicants about salary expectations; allows job applicants to request the included benefits for the position they are applying for.

short_summary: Permits certain previous criminal history information provided to satisfy criminal background checks for certain employees
summary: Permits that when the division of criminal justice services has provided criminal history information within the previous twelve months to any state agency for certain individuals, such information can be used to satisfy the required criminal history check for such employee without having to re-request such information.

short_summary: Prohibits a person from operating a motor vehicle with children under the age of 8 in the front seat in most cases
summary: Prohibits a person from operating a motor vehicle with children under the age of 8 in the front seat in most cases; makes limited exceptions.

short_summary: Provides elderly individuals water relief in N.Y. city
summary: Provides that any qualified homeowner in the city of New York shall be eligible to be exempted from any future increases in water rate fees.

short_summary: Relates to the process and requirements to incorporate as a village; repealer
summary: Revises the process of incorporating a village such as the contents of a petition and the filing process.

short_summary: Allows certain adult care facilities to arrange for limited nursing services
summary: Allows an adult home, enriched housing facility, assisted living residence or special needs assisted living residence to provide for nursing services in the facility that are not continual, either by arrangement with a provider of nursing services or by employment.

short_summary: Restricts automatic renewal of contracts for electronic and life safety alarm services
summary: Restricts automatic renewal of contracts for electronic and life safety alarm services; makes such automatic renewal provisions unenforceable unless: the automatic renewal offer terms or continuous service offer terms are presented to the consumer in a clear and conspicuous manner; the business or person furnishing the electronic and life safety alarm service obtains the consumer's affirmative consent; and such renewal or continuous service offer provides an acknowledgment of the contract cancellation policy, and information regarding how to cancel in a manner that is capable of being retained by the consumer.

short_summary: Repeal paragraph (e) of subdivision 3 of section 2853 and subdivision 6-g of section 3602 of the education law, relating to an aid rollback for charter schools; repealer
summary: Relates to an aid rollback for charter schools.

short_summary: Relates to the designation of the "Catholic war veterans memorial highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in Orange county as the "Catholic War Veterans Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Designates March twenty-first as Down Syndrome Awareness Day
summary: Designates March twenty-first as a day of commemoration to be known as "Down Syndrome Awareness Day".

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dana Kerstanski
summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dana Kerstanski.

short_summary: Authorizes the widow of Howard Mahler to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
summary: Authorizes Robin Garfinkle, the widow of Howard Mahler, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

short_summary: Sets requirements for the sale, lease, and rental of powered bicycles, powered mobility devices, and storage batteries for such devices
summary: Sets requirements for the sale, lease, and rental of powered bicycles, powered mobility devices, and storage batteries for such devices; provides for penalties for the violation thereof.

short_summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system; provides that for New York city uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

short_summary: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
summary: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

short_summary: Includes fuel-flexible linear generators which do not utilize a fossil fuel resource in the process of generating electricity as qualifying as renewable energy systems
summary: Includes fuel-flexible linear generators which do not utilize a fossil fuel resource in the process of generating electricity as qualifying as renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
summary: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve air quality, and reduce noise pollution by promoting the adoption of quieter, zero-emission landscaping equipment; provides for rebates at the point of sale for applicants purchasing or leasing certain equipment; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

short_summary: Enacts the New York tropical deforestation-free procurement act and establishes the supply chain transparency assistance program
summary: Enacts the New York tropical deforestation-free procurement act requiring that companies contracting with the state do not contribute to tropical primary forest degradation or deforestation directly or through their supply chains; establishes the supply chain transparency assistance program to assist small and medium-sized businesses and minority- and women-owned businesses in achieving compliant supply chains.

short_summary: Establishes the commission of the deaf, deafblind and hard of hearing; repealer
summary: Establishes the commission of the deaf, deafblind and hard of hearing; requires the commission of the deaf, deafblind, and hard of hearing to transmit complaints in matters affecting the deaf, deafblind, and hard of hearing communities to the vulnerable persons' central register; repeals provisions relating to the New York state interagency coordinating council for services to persons who are deaf, deaf-blind, or hard of hearing.

short_summary: Relates to state construction and commodity contracts
summary: Relates to amending state construction and commodity contracts to provide equitable relief to contractors who have sustained unanticipated expenses by reason of construction materials price escalations.

short_summary: Enforces fire prevention and building codes and appointing an oversight officer and their duties
summary: Relates to enforcing fire prevention and building codes and allowing the secretary of state to appoint an oversight officer and describes the duties of such oversight officer.

short_summary: Prohibits and regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; repealer
summary: Prohibits and regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; prohibits police officers, peace officers, school resource officers, probation agencies, state entities, state employees, and municipal corporations from questioning individuals regarding their citizenship or immigration status; regulates the disclosure of information relating to immigration status.

short_summary: Requires the New York State energy research and development authority to develop a real-time mobile application with a corresponding map with information on electric vehicle charging stations
summary: Requires the New York State energy research and development authority to develop a real-time mobile application with a corresponding map with information on electric vehicle charging stations and to make such information available on the authority's website; requires the mobile application and website to include an interactive real-time map with the addresses of each electric vehicle charging station in the state and the number of charging stations at each location, the operability of charging stations, whether the charging station is located in a parking lot, parking garage or on a street, whether there are fees required to use a charging station, and where to report operational issues with charging stations.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain land within Flushing Meadows Corona Park
summary: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain land within Flushing Meadows Corona Park.

short_summary: Relates to resource exemptions for applicants for public assistance programs
summary: Relates to resource exemptions for applicants for public assistance programs; amends the Welfare Reform Act in relation to the effectiveness thereof.

short_summary: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to establish a universal benefits form for individuals seeking public assistance
summary: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to establish a universal benefits form for individuals seeking public assistance.

short_summary: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; and makes conforming amendments
summary: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; makes conforming amendments.

short_summary: Relates to rent registration statements to be filed for vacant units
summary: Requires owners of housing accommodations subject to rent registration to file an additional statement at three month intervals, until the unit is occupied.

short_summary: Relates to rent registration statements filed by a limited liability company
summary: Requires that any limited liability company who files a rent registration statement shall include a list of all members of such limited liability company and each member's ownership interest.

short_summary: Relates to the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants
summary: Prohibits landlords from restricting the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants; provides that the landlord is not compelled to change utilities for such installation; prohibits surcharge where tenant pays utilities directly to provider.

short_summary: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area
summary: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area until June 30, 2025.

short_summary: Establishes a 10 day waiting period for the purchase of any firearm
summary: Establishes a 10 day waiting period for the purchase of any firearm; establishes violations of such provisions shall constitute a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Relates to the duty to report incidents
summary: Requires every mandated reporter to make a report to the register unless the register has knowledge of the incident.

short_summary: Relates to zone pricing of gasoline
summary: Relates to zone pricing of gasoline.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation of bus privatization contracts
summary: Requires the state comptroller to approve any attempt to privatize a public bus service by a locality.

short_summary: Limits the authority of cities, villages and towns to impose certain zoning requirements
summary: Limits the authority of cities, villages and towns to impose certain zoning requirements.

short_summary: Creates the crime of stolen valor
summary: Creates the crime of stolen valor.

short_summary: Enacts the New York state money transmission disclosure act
summary: Enacts the New York state money transmission disclosure act; requires each licensee providing a transmission transaction which involves currency of one country into the currency of another country to provide the customer with a written disclosure; authorizes the superintendent of financial services to implement any necessary rules and regulations.

short_summary: Relates to providing notice to the crime victim or victim's representative that a parolee or releasee is being discharged or released
summary: Requires the parole board to provide notice to the crime victim or victim's representative that a parolee or releasee is being discharged or released.

short_summary: Requires manufactured home park owners to provide a written justification for rent increases in excess of three percent of the current rent
summary: Requires manufactured home park owners to provide a written justification for rent increases in excess of three percent of the current rent; provides that increases in costs to justify such rent increase for ordinary maintenance or repair to meet the warranty of habitability obligations must be shown to be necessary.

short_summary: Prohibits the discharge of bilge water into waters of the state
summary: Prohibits the discharge of bilge water into waters of the state from any vessel, watercraft, marina or mooring.

short_summary: Establishes the sustainable communities fund
summary: Establishes the sustainable communities fund; authorizes grants to municipal corporations who meet certain requirements for eligible projects that incorporate smart growth principles or utilize climate resilient and environmentally friendly construction techniques.

short_summary: Provides for the committee on open government to hear FOIL appeals
summary: Provides that FOIL appeals are to be heard by the committee on open government.

short_summary: Establishes the NY food insecurity, farm resiliency and rural poverty initiative; repealer; appropriation
summary: Establishes the NY food insecurity, farm resiliency and rural poverty initiative to provide financial assistance in the form of matching grants, hiring assistance, purchasing assistance, tax credits, tax exemptions, and reimbursements.

short_summary: Increases the number of members on the state commission of correction
summary: Increases the number of members on the state commission of correction; provides for the manner of confirmation of such members.

short_summary: Includes SUNY police officers for purposes of presumption regarding impairment caused by heart disease
summary: Includes SUNY police officers for purposes of presumption regarding impairment caused by heart disease.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory retirement age
summary: Relates to mandatory retirement age; increases the age at which a member must retire to receive an additional pension from sixty-two to sixty-five.

short_summary: Establishes disability retirement benefits for certain members who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by methicillin resistant staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) or Staph/MRSA
summary: Establishes disability retirement benefits for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrols and deputy sheriff patrol supervisors who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by methicillin resistant staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) or Staph/MRSA; provides that such disability benefits shall be three-quarters of a member's final average salary.

short_summary: Implements a presumption of performance of duty disability for post-traumatic stress disorder in certain employees of Suffolk county
summary: Implements a presumption of performance of duty disability for post-traumatic stress disorder in certain employees of Suffolk county.

short_summary: Relates to accidental disability retirement for deputy sheriffs
summary: Relates to accidental disability retirement for deputy sheriffs; provides that deputy sheriffs shall receive a pension of three-quarters of their final average salary.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age of New York state regional park police
summary: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age of New York state regional park police from 62 to 65 years old.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a twenty-five year retirement plan for firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs
summary: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement plan for firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the city of New Rochelle to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the authorization of the city of New Rochelle to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax until 2025.

short_summary: Authorizes certain policies issued by a risk retention group not chartered in this state
summary: Authorizes certain policies issued by a risk retention group not chartered in this state but which is registered with the superintendent of financial services under the federal liability risk retention act of 1986, comprised entirely of organizations to which contributions are eligible for deduction under section 501(c)(3) of the internal revenue code and which qualifies as a charitable risk pool under section 501(n) of the internal revenue code.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the New York no citizen is above the law act
summary: Provides that the period of immunity from prosecution for a criminal or civil action that a defendant is entitled to by virtue of holding the office of president of the United States shall not apply to the calculation of the time limitation applicable to commencement of such actions.

short_summary: Relates to requiring affordable housing projects to calculate and only use the area median income for the specific zip code that the project is located in
summary: Relates to requiring affordable housing projects to calculate and only use the area median income for the specific zip code that the project is located in for determining affordability.

short_summary: Relates to requiring landlords to return security deposits within a reasonable time
summary: Limits security deposits to one month's rent; requires landlords to return the full security deposit and any accrued interest to which the tenant is entitled less any amount retained by the landlord within 21 days of the end of the lease.

short_summary: Relates to home stability support supplement programs
summary: Relates to the creation of home stability support supplement programs.

short_summary: Requires the installation and periodic inspection of water detector alarms in residential dwellings and certain commercial buildings
summary: Requires the installation and periodic inspection of water detector alarms in residential dwellings and certain commercial buildings; defines a "water detector alarm" as an electronic device that detects the presence of water and sets off an audible and visual alarm when its sensors are triggered; defines a "commercial building" as a building in which individuals are employed.

short_summary: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts
summary: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts.

short_summary: Provides for the extension of NYSLRS service credit for any service credit lost due to either furlough or layoff of a member from when executive order 202 was issued through December 31, 2020
summary: Provides for the extension of NYSLRS service credit for any service credit lost due to either furlough or layoff of a member from the period beginning when executive order 202 of 2020 was issued through December 31, 2020.

short_summary: Permits boards of elections to change the date of a primary election if such election conflicts with a religious holiday
summary: Permits boards of elections to change the date of a primary election within fourteen days of an election if such election date conflicts with a religious holiday.

short_summary: Requires instruction on conflict resolution for elementary, middle, and high school students
summary: Requires age-appropriate instruction on conflict resolution for elementary, middle, and high school students; requires the commissioner to develop curricula for schools in the state for such instruction; directs the commissioner to develop resource materials to facilitate such instruction.

short_summary: Excludes unemployment compensation from state income tax
summary: Excludes unemployment compensation from being included in the computation of state income tax.

short_summary: Requires certain insurers to provide coverage for tattooing performed by a physician as part of breast reconstruction surgery
summary: Requires insurers to provide coverage for tattooing of the nipple-areolar complex pursuant to or as part of breast reconstruction surgery if such tattooing is performed by a physician or other health care practitioner working within their scope of practice.

short_summary: Requires the installation of smoke detectors in common places of certain dwellings
summary: Requires the installation of smoke detectors in common places of certain multiple dwellings.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for affidavit ballots and absentee ballots
summary: Requires voters voting by affidavit ballot to produce an identification document to verify residency in the election district; requires absentee ballots to be received by election day, or be post-marked by the first day of early voting.

short_summary: Relates to use of revenues from tolls collected on the Verrazzano-Narrows bridge
summary: Directs revenues from tolls collected on the Verrazzano-Narrows bridge to be applied to expansion of bus rapid transit and high-occupancy vehicle lanes in the borough of Staten Island.

short_summary: Relates to eliminating daylight saving time; repealer
summary: Eliminates daylight saving time.

short_summary: Relates to education and outreach programs for individuals who have suffered a pregnancy loss or infant loss
summary: Includes within the health care and wellness education and outreach program offered by the department of health resources for individuals who have suffered a pregnancy loss or infant loss.

short_summary: Authorizes expedited settlement conference processes for establishing child support orders
summary: Authorizes expedited settlement conference processes for establishing child support orders where both parties voluntarily agree on the process.

short_summary: Establishes the "secure our data act"
summary: Establishes the "secure our data act"; relates to state entities preparing for and protecting against a ransomware attack.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the "State Police Retention act"
summary: Enacts the State Police Retention act; provides a deferred retirement option plan payable to members and officers of the division of state police.

short_summary: Creates an identification card program for local correctional facilities; and relates to issuance of and waiver of fees for identification cards issued pursuant to certain identification card programs
summary: Creates an identification card program for incarcerated individuals in local correctional facilities; requires such identification cards to be identical to non-driver identification cards issued to the general public; waives fees for such identification cards.

short_summary: Requires the promulgation of regulations relating to the commercial trade of human reproductive processes involving semen donation
summary: Requires the promulgation of regulations relating to the commercial trade of human reproductive processes involving semen donation; limits the number of live births from a single semen donor.

short_summary: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers
summary: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers.

short_summary: Provides for annual adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for SCRIE, DRIE, SCHE and DHE by any increase in the consumer price index
summary: Provides for annual adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE), disability rent increase exemption (DRIE), senior citizen homeowners' exemption (SCHE), and disabled homeowners' exemption (DHE) by any increase in the consumer price index (CPI).

short_summary: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of planning, development, and public transportation for Putnam county
summary: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of planning, development, and public transportation for Putnam county, provided that such person resides in Putnam county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

short_summary: Directs the department of veterans' services to establish and operate an electronic database of the number of openings in each of the 4 state veterans' homes and the number of persons on the waiting lists
summary: Directs the department of veterans' services to establish and operate an electronic database of the number of openings in each of the 4 state veterans' homes and the number of persons on the waiting list for each such veterans' home.

short_summary: Provides that a fire company may elect to include call firefighters within its membership who shall receive a stipend for each call that he or she responds to
summary: Provides that a fire company may elect to include call firefighters within its membership who shall receive a stipend for each call that he or she responds to.

short_summary: Relates to claims for mental injury premised upon extraordinary work-related stress incurred at work
summary: Relates to claims for mental injury premised upon extraordinary work-related stress incurred at work; applies to all workers.

short_summary: Provides for paid family leave following pregnancy outcome
summary: Provides for paid family leave following the outcome of a pregnancy, including a stillbirth, miscarriage or abortion.

short_summary: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, and murder in the second degree
summary: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, and murder in the second degree.

short_summary: Allows withdrawals from family tuition accounts to pay for treatment of substance use disorder for the designated beneficiary
summary: Allows withdrawals from family tuition accounts to pay for treatment of substance use disorder, including detoxification and rehabilitation for the designated beneficiary.

short_summary: Enacts the "regulatory fiscal accountability act of 2023"
summary: Enacts the "regulatory fiscal accountability act of 2023"; requires every proposed rule, authorized by law and having a fiscal impact in excess of ten million dollars, to be approved by a two-thirds vote of each of the appropriate legislative committees; requires proposed rules and executive orders affecting political subdivisions to include fiscal notes.

short_summary: Relates to the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies
summary: Provides that the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies shall be done on forms approved by the centers for Medicare and Medicaid services.

short_summary: Imposes restrictions on lead containing products
summary: Imposes restrictions on lead-containing products and provides for a private right of action for violations.

short_summary: Relates to advanced metering infrastructure devices for residential services
summary: Relates to advanced metering infrastructure devices for residential services.

short_summary: Establishes the statewide childcare workforce living wage fund; appropriation
summary: Establishes the statewide childcare workforce living wage fund to improve workforce conditions for employees of childcare services and programs through grants for salary increases, workforce retention bonuses and recruitment bonuses, indirect costs associated with implementing salary increases and bonuses, costs associated with employee health and fringe benefits and provider pay in certain circumstances; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Provides Tier 5 and 6 members of the New York state teachers' retirement system with the same service retirement pension factor as Tier 4
summary: Provides Tier 5 and 6 members of the New York state teachers' retirement system with the same service retirement pension factor as Tier 4.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax
summary: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Relates to lifting mandatory hiring and retirement ages municipal police
summary: Relates to lifting mandatory hiring and retirement ages for municipal police.

short_summary: Relates to appointing a fiscal monitor for the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Appoints a fiscal monitor for five years; defines terms; provides for such appointment; provides for the duties of such fiscal monitor.

short_summary: Relates to state construction and commodity contracts
summary: Relates to amending state construction and commodity contracts to provide equitable relief to contractors who have sustained unanticipated expenses by reason of construction materials price escalations.

short_summary: Exempts correction officers of any penal correctional institution from training requirements for security guards
summary: Exempts correction officers of any penal correctional institution from training requirements for security guards.

short_summary: Establishes a separate states working group to conduct a study on Long Island statehood
summary: Establishes a separate states working group to conduct a study on Long Island statehood which includes a cost benefit analysis on Long Island statehood.

short_summary: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans
summary: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to firefighter Scott Pavlick
summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to firefighter Scott Pavlick.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursing charter schools for leasing certain facilities, and prohibition of non-disclosure agreements; repealer
summary: Prohibits the city school district from reimbursing charter schools for leasing a privately owned or other publicly owned facility, and prohibits charter school employee contracts from including a non-disclosure agreement.

short_summary: Extends the one percent increased county sales tax for Putnam county
summary: Extends the one percent increased county sales tax for Putnam county for two years.

short_summary: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state and extends the length of such re-certification
summary: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state; extends the length of such re-certification from five years to seven years.

short_summary: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners
summary: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners.

short_summary: Relates to state reimbursement for local enforcement of navigation laws on waterways within local jurisdiction
summary: Permits municipalities within certain counties to apply for reimbursement from the state for law enforcement activities on waterways within their jurisdiction.

short_summary: Relates to sales and compensating use taxes in the county of Livingston
summary: Authorizes the county of Livingston to impose an additional one percent sales tax.

short_summary: Establishes the previously owned zero emission vehicles rebate program
summary: Establishes the previously owned zero-emission vehicles rebate program to provide an incentive of an amount up to $2,000 for individuals who purchase used or previously owned zero-emission vehicles.

short_summary: Provides that any special act school districts be held harmless from any reduction in tuition revenue or any tuition rate calculation and/or rate reconciliation
summary: Provides that any special act school districts established pursuant to Chapter 566 of the Laws of 1967 shall be held harmless from any reduction in tuition revenue or any tuition rate calculation and/or rate reconciliation arising out of intake closure or limits on the entry of new student placements.

short_summary: Limits compensation of executives of charter schools where such compensation is provided through state funding
summary: Limits compensation of executives of charter schools to $199,000 where such compensation is provided through state funding.

short_summary: Allows an affirmation by any person, wherever made, in a civil action
summary: Allows an affirmation by any person, wherever made, subscribed and affirmed by that person to be true under the penalties of perjury, to be used in a civil action in New York in lieu of and with the same force and effect as an affidavit.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property from 2023 to 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county
summary: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county.

short_summary: Excludes certain animals from the definition of "wildlife"
summary: Excludes dogs, cats and any other domesticated animals from the definition of "wildlife".

short_summary: Relates to the naturally occurring retirement community supportive service program
summary: Relates to the naturally occurring retirement community supportive service program.

short_summary: Establishes the state flag for raising awareness of neurodiversity
summary: Establishes the "Neurodiversity Flag" as the official state flag for raising awareness of neurodiversity.

short_summary: Relates to the Syracuse regional airport
summary: Provides that the Syracuse regional airport authority may acquire, hold, own, lease, establish, construct, effectuate, operate, maintain, renovate, improve, extend or repair any of its facilities through, and cause any one or more of its powers, duties, functions or activities to be exercised or performed by, no more than two wholly owned subsidiary corporations of the authority for the purposes of operating parking and concessions including food, beverage, and retail services, and airline and aircraft services including ticketing, baggage and fueling services and other services for the operation of the airport.

short_summary: Relates to attendance policies for employees of the metropolitan transportation authority or contractors of Nassau and Suffolk counties providing public transportation
summary: Relates to attendance policies for employees of the metropolitan transportation authority or contractors of Nassau and Suffolk counties providing public transportation regarding time off for medical services and court appearances.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Henrietta, county of Monroe to alienate certain lands used as parkland and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands
summary: Authorizes the town of Henrietta, county of Monroe to alienate certain lands used as parkland to Forest Creek Equity Corp., and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands.

short_summary: Relates to early intervention reimbursement rates
summary: Provides that on and after April first, two thousand twenty-three, the department of health shall reimburse municipalities in an amount of sixty-six percent or more for the costs of early intervention services; directs the commissioner of health to review rates of reimbursement for early intervention services.

short_summary: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have discriminatory laws for access to women's reproductive health services
summary: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have discriminatory laws for access to women's reproductive health services, including but not limited to, limitations on access to abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.

short_summary: Relates to lobbying for the confirmation of persons to state office
summary: Requires registration and the disclosure of information relating to lobbying for the nomination or confirmation of persons to state office.

short_summary: Authorizes Lawrence Ecker to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes Lawrence Ecker to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system for his time as a state supreme court judge from approximately June 2021 through June 2022.

short_summary: Relates to the continuation of death benefits to a surviving spouse regardless of remarriage
summary: Relates to the continuation of death benefits to a surviving spouse regardless of remarriage.

short_summary: Provides for availability of ambulance services and advanced life support first response service to store and distribute blood and initiate and administer blood transfusions
summary: Provides for availability of ambulance services and advanced life support first response service to store and distribute blood and initiate and administer blood transfusions, by expanding current provisions for air transport to apply additionally to motor vehicle based ambulance services.

short_summary: Relates to quality improvement and increased consumer transparency in assisted living residences
summary: Requires reporting and posting by assisted living facilities relating to quality measures and information concerning rates, rent, and service fees; requires a scoring system of the assisted living quality reporting.

short_summary: Defines the term mass shooting for purposes of emergency response measures and access to emergency funding
summary: Defines the term "mass shooting" for purposes of access to emergency funding as a shooting incident involving one or more firearms, rifles or shotguns during which four or more people, other than the individual or individuals alleged to have committed such incident, were injured or killed.

short_summary: Relates to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington
summary: Extends provisions relating to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington for one year.

short_summary: Extends audit authority over industrial development authorities and local development corporations to each county comptroller
summary: Authorizes county comptrollers to audit industrial development authorities and local development corporations and to audit or review an audit prior to the renewal or renegotiation of a PILOT agreement by such entities.

short_summary: Authorizes Seaford Fire District to file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption
summary: Authorizes the Seaford Fire District to file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption.

short_summary: Relates to payment rates for managed long term care plans
summary: Provides for supplemental quality improvement payments for managed long term care plans that meet certain criteria.

short_summary: Grants an exemption for the purchase of certain tangible personal property and services used in the operation of recreational skiing facilities from state sales and compensating use tax
summary: Grants an exemption for the purchase of energy efficient snow making equipment, ski lift equipment, snow grooming equipment, and the production of snow by a recreational ski facility from state sales and compensating use tax.

short_summary: Allows voters age sixty-five or older to request an absentee ballot
summary: Allows voters age sixty-five or older to request an absentee ballot.

short_summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
summary: Provides that for New York city police/fire members, uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan and investigator revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to discontinue as parklands and lease certain lands
summary: Authorizes the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to discontinue as parklands and lease certain lands to J.P. Supreme Caterers, Inc., d/b/a Nicky's on the Bay, or its successors and/or assigns, for operation of a fuel dock and restaurant.

short_summary: Enacts the "MTA board member attendance act"
summary: Enacts the "MTA board member attendance act"; requires members of the metropolitan transportation authority to attend the majority of public hearings on fare hikes in order to cast a vote.

short_summary: Relates to aquatic growth control districts
summary: Includes aquatic invertebrate species and aquatic plants within the meaning of aquatic growth control permitted by towns through improvement districts.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from 786 Muhammadi Masjid, Inc.
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from 786 Muhammadi Masjid, Inc. for certain school and general taxes.

short_summary: Establishes a state Parkinson's disease registry
summary: Establishes a state Parkinson's disease registry; directs certain health professionals and general hospitals to report instances of Parkinson's disease and Parkinsonisms to the department of health; directs the department of health to create and manage the Parkinson's disease registry; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the state university trustees to establish a process to eliminate or reduce duplication of academic degree programs within the state university system
summary: Requires the state university trustees to establish a process to eliminate or reduce duplication of academic degree programs within the state university system.

short_summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

short_summary: Expand the permitted use of proceeds from the lease of lands located at the state university of New York at Purchase
summary: Expands the permitted use of proceeds from the lease of lands located at the state university of New York at Purchase to support current full-time faculty positions.

short_summary: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid settlement fund
summary: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid settlement fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

short_summary: Relates to the name and the management and control of the Bellport Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association and the usage of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by the association
summary: Changes the name of the Bellport Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association to the Bellport Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association; decreases the board of trustees from 7 to 5 members; allows the association to use certain taxes collected and paid in furtherance of its purposes as stated in the association's charter.

short_summary: Establishes an animal abuser statewide registry
summary: Establishes an animal abuser statewide registry with community notification requirements.

short_summary: Authorizes the commissioner of finance of the city of New York to establish a property tax amnesty program
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of finance of the city of New York to establish a property tax amnesty program; provides that such program shall last for 4 months and shall forgive up to $1000 of interest on a delinquent tax bill if 100 percent of the principal bill is paid.

short_summary: Extends wage parity for home care workers in upstate New York
summary: Extends wage parity for home care workers in upstate New York.

short_summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

short_summary: Relates to the setback requirement in the Peconic and Gardiner's Bays for the Suffolk County Lease Program and Sugar Kelp production
summary: Decreases the setback requirement in the Peconic and Gardiner's Bays for the Suffolk County Lease Program and Sugar Kelp production from 1,000 feet to 500 feet.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro as the "John Jay High School Veterans Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro as the "John Jay High School Veterans Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to participation by individuals with disabilities with respect to state employment and state contracts
summary: Relates to participation by individuals with disabilities with respect to state employment and state contracts; requires contractors to report to state agencies regarding the utilization and participation of work on both service and commodity contracts by a person with a disability; requires such state agencies to report to the office of general services and the office of general services to report to the state procurement council, governor, comptroller and the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to the placement of school crossing guards
summary: Relates to the placement of school crossing guards; requires school crossing guards to be placed on each of the corners of streets adjacent to public and private schools in New York City serving students in grades K-8 and on each side of streets with more than four lanes.

short_summary: Requires New York State health benefit plan hospital pricing report
summary: Directs the president of the civil service commission to collect health care claims data relating to the price and utilization of hospital benefits by active employees, retired employees and their dependents and to publish a New York State health benefit plan hospital pricing report.

short_summary: Requires notice be provided to any officer or employee of the department of corrections and community supervision whose personal information is the subject of a subpoena duces tecum
summary: Requires that notice be provided to any officer or employee of the department of corrections and community supervision whose personal information is the subject of a subpoena duces tecum.

short_summary: Relates to the tolling of charges imposed by meter for residential use of the water supply when such charges are disputed
summary: Relates to the tolling of charges imposed by meter for residential use of the water supply when such charges are disputed.

short_summary: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals
summary: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals.

short_summary: Relates to the minimum age for certain lifeguards
summary: Provides that lifeguards at swimming pools, bathing beaches, and children's camps may be a minimum of fifteen years of age if directly supervised.

short_summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept from the Post-Morrow Foundation, Inc. an application for exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept from the Post-Morrow Foundation, Inc. an application for exemption from real property taxes for 2022-2023 for property located at 0 and 25 Orchard Road.

short_summary: Relates to railroad rolling stock
summary: Exempts railroad rolling stock from sales and compensating use taxes; defines "railroad rolling stock" as a device, which is used exclusively upon stationary rails or tracks to transport goods, commodities, or equipment, including, but not limited to, flat cars, box cars, gondolas, hopper cars, or other freight railroad cars.

short_summary: Grants Lawrence Korzeniewski, the statutory beneficiary of Janice Korzeniewski, accidental death benefits
summary: Grants Lawrence Korzeniewski, the statutory beneficiary of Janice Korzeniewski, accidental death benefits because Janice Korzeniewski was directed by her employer to return to work and contracted COVID-19 within 45 days of reporting to work and died from such disease.

short_summary: Relates to underground electrical services in Suffolk and Nassau counties
summary: Requires all new residential and commercial units in Suffolk and Nassau counties, including all structures that have realized repairs or improvements that are equal to or greater than fifty percent of the structure's value, to install underground service drops at such locations.

short_summary: Expands the veterans tuition awards program
summary: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to include all persons who were honorably discharged and were residents of the state before and after serving in the armed forces of the United States; provides veterans an award equal to the in-state tuition paid at a state university for each semester the veteran is engaged in undergraduate, graduate or vocational study.

short_summary: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court
summary: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court.

short_summary: Relates to eligibility for unemployment benefits for certain New York city emergency medical services personnel under quarantine for coronavirus (COVID-19)
summary: Relates to eligibility for unemployment benefits for certain New York city emergency medical services personnel under quarantine for coronavirus (COVID-19); provides that such employees shall not be deprived of benefit payments by reason of COVID-19 quarantine.

short_summary: Requires hotel, motel and inn keepers to offer condoms for sale to registered guests
summary: Requires hotel, motel and inn keepers to offer, in the registration office, condoms or similar prophylactic devices for sale to registered guests of such hotel, motel or inn.

short_summary: Designates that portion of interstate eighty-four that lies within the county of Putnam as the "Putnam County Purple Heart Highway"
summary: Designates that portion of interstate eighty-four that lies within the county of Putnam as the "Putnam County Purple Heart Highway".

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax.

short_summary: Authorizes Kevin Donohue to take the civil service examination for the position of police officer for the town of Goshen
summary: Authorizes Kevin Donohue to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of full-time police officer for the town of Goshen.
