summary: Authorizes the commissioner of environmental conservation to enter into contracts for the lease or use of state lands for the purpose of maple tree tapping and sap production for a term of up to, but not to exceed, ten years.

short_summary: Authorizes big game hunting for deer and bear for the county of Onondaga
summary: Authorizes big game hunting for deer and bear for the county of Onondaga.

short_summary: Withholds funding from certain entities who decline to make available, dispense, distribute, or sell a product approved by the federal government which would block, prevent, or otherwise negate a pregnancy
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of health to withhold reimbursements from medical assistance programs to retail entities who decline to make available, dispense, distribute, or sell a product approved by the federal government which would block, prevent, or otherwise negate a pregnancy in any jurisdiction within and subject to such federal government.

short_summary: Authorizes the governor to appoint a lieutenant-governor subject to confirmation by the legislature
summary: Authorizes the governor to appoint a lieutenant-governor subject to confirmation by the legislature.

short_summary: Requires annual screenings for depression of students in grades seven through twelve
summary: Requires annual screenings for depression of students in grades seven through twelve; requires the department of education and the department of health to review data pertaining to the results of such screenings for local and statewide trends concerning teenage depression.

short_summary: Requires private investigators to notify the state police when they are employed by a foreign government or foreign national and requires the state police to maintain a registry of certain private investigators
summary: Requires private investigators to notify the state police when they are employed by a foreign government or foreign national; requires the state police to maintain a registry of all private investigators who have been employed by a foreign government or foreign national.

short_summary: Requires that digital coupons are made available to consumers in paper form of identical value
summary: Requires that digital coupons are made available to consumers in paper form of identical value; provides for violations and penalties.

short_summary: Empowers the commissioner of education to declare a disaster has substantially impacted a school board or school budget election and to allow school boards to set an additional day for voting
summary: Empowers the commissioner of education to declare a disaster has substantially impacted an annual meeting and election and to allow school boards to set an additional day for voting if less than eight percent of registered voters cast ballots as a direct consequence of a disaster.

short_summary: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; and repeals certain provisions of the education law relating thereto
summary: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; allows boards of education to meet on any date on or before the Monday after July 20th for their annual organizational meeting.

short_summary: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential
summary: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential.

short_summary: Relates to making certain public records available on the internet
summary: Requires governmental and certain nongovernmental entities to publish public records proactively on the internet that are of public interest.

short_summary: Relates to workers' access to treatment
summary: Allows for treatment costing less than $1,500 to be done without prior approval, and more clearly defines the list of "pre-authorized procedures" as a floor on treatment as opposed to its current status as a ceiling; allows non-network providers of testing to be compensated at the provider network rate negotiated by the carrier.

short_summary: Relates to violations of the human rights law by a real estate appraiser
summary: Relates to violations of the human rights law by a real estate appraiser.

short_summary: Relates to military leave for all represented and non-represented persons employed by the port authority of New York and New Jersey
summary: Provides for military leave for all represented and non-represented persons employed by the port authority of New York and New Jersey.

short_summary: Authorizes the dispensing of abortion medication
summary: Authorizes the dispensing of abortion medication under certain conditions; requires insurance policies providing coverage for contraception to provide coverage for abortion medication.

short_summary: Relates to wild or exotic animals
summary: Provides that "wild animal" means indigenous, non-domesticated animals native to the country in which they live and "exotic animal" means a wild animal with an origin of a different continent; adds certain wild or exotic animals to the list of non-companion animals; provides certain owners of wild or exotic animals with a license process.

short_summary: Relates to health care and mental hygiene worker bonuses
summary: Includes fire districts within the definition of "municipal corporation" to include employees of fire districts within the health care and mental hygiene worker bonuses.

short_summary: Establishes the class B felony of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center
summary: Establishes the class B felony of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center.

short_summary: Establishes a multi-agency study group to conduct a study and to make recommendations regarding the optimal pension and retirement plan alternatives which could be made available in this state
summary: Establishes a multi-agency study group to conduct a study and to make recommendations regarding the optimal pension and retirement plan alternatives which could be made available to not-for-profit human services corporations in this state.

short_summary: Details the procedure that certain school districts must follow when dealing with disciplinary actions for bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants
summary: Details the procedure that certain school districts must follow when dealing with disciplinary actions for bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants.

short_summary: Prohibits the elimination of building systems or equipment used for the combustion of fossil fuels in new building construction
summary: Prohibits the elimination of building systems or equipment used for the combustion of fossil fuels, including, natural gas, propane and fuel oil in new building construction.

short_summary: Relates to preclaim review for participating providers of medical assistance program services and items
summary: Requires a verification organization to declare each service or item to be verified or unverified within thirty days of receiving all required supporting documentation from a participating provider.

short_summary: Relates to the information to be included in vacancy rate studies
summary: Relates to the information to be included in vacancy rate studies.

short_summary: Establishes the climate relocation planning and preparation act
summary: Establishes the climate relocation planning and preparation act to prepare state government and regional planning councils for the possibility of increased in-migration to New York state due to climate change.

short_summary: Ensures that color vision requirements for appointment of police officers are tailored to only eliminate individuals with extreme color vision deficiencies from eligibility
summary: Ensures that color vision requirements for appointment of police officers are tailored to only eliminate individuals with extreme color vision deficiencies from eligibility; provides methods under which an individual can meet such requirements after failing to meet an initial color vision standard.

short_summary: Relates to establishing deadlines for finalizing and objecting to nominating petitions for small city school board elections
summary: Requires that nominating petitions for small city school district elections be submitted no later than thirty days prior to the election; provides for a ten-day period for objecting to any nominating petitions; outlines the duties of the clerk of the board of education in finalizing the ballot after the ten-day objection period; provides that certain provisions concerning the date of the drawing for the names on the ballot do not apply to small city school districts.

short_summary: Requires the prosecution to disclose to the defendant certain information relating to jailhouse informants; requires prosecutors to notify victims of the informant's crimes in certain circumstances
summary: Requires the prosecution to disclose to defense counsel certain information relating to jailhouse informants; requires prosecutors to notify victims of the informant's crimes if the prosecutor has offered the informant a benefit in exchange for testimony or other cooperation.

short_summary: Relates to absentee ballots for relating to absentee ballots for school district elections
summary: Clarifies valid reasons to obtain an absentee ballot for elections in school districts which do not utilize poll registration.

short_summary: Relates to the election of school board members after the number of members has been increased
summary: Provides that elections to fill an increased number of seats on a school board will be conducted at the first annual meeting after the meeting during which number of seats was increased.

short_summary: Requires that parents of students at student orientations, back to school nights, or other beginning of year events receive notification of eligibility for free or reduced price meals for students
summary: Requires that parents of students at student orientations, back to school nights, or other beginning of year events, at schools that participate in the national school lunch program or school breakfast program, receive notification of eligibility, and access to application, for free or reduced price meals for students.

short_summary: Requires trucks to utilize commercial GPS
summary: Requires trucks to utilize commercial GPS designed for use by a commercial vehicle which is able to provide audible and visual warnings when the truck is on a route where the height, weight, width, or length of the truck exceeds the limitations of such route when operating on public highways in the state.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of unlawful tampering of the milk supply in the first degree
summary: Establishes the crime of unlawful tampering of the milk supply in the first degree.

short_summary: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt
summary: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt; requires refund of all fees submitted with such application if a determination is not made in a timely manner.

short_summary: Establishes a program to purchase fresh produce from farms in the state for incarcerated individuals
summary: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish a program to purchase fresh produce from farms located in the state and distribute such fresh produce to correctional facilities in the state to be utilized in the provision of wholesome and nutritious food to incarcerated individuals.

short_summary: Provides for additional requirements for issuing civil service examination announcements
summary: Requires civil service examination announcements to be issued to the local board of cooperative educational services (BOCES), high schools, colleges, universities, local social services districts, and job training programs.

short_summary: Relates to the suspension or demotion upon the abolition or reduction of non-competitive or labor class positions in the state service; repealer
summary: Conforms the suspension or demotion upon the abolition or reduction of non-competitive or labor class positions in the state service with such treatment for competitive class positions.

short_summary: Extends, until December 31, 2024, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
summary: Extends, from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2024, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

short_summary: Relates to making housing a policy in the state of New York
summary: Provides that a policy of this state should be to increase housing options and opportunities, including but not limited to affordable, and workforce and senior housing.

short_summary: Prohibits certain surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control
summary: Prohibits surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control when the tenant pays for electric utility service.

short_summary: Relates to claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment
summary: Provides that in order to present the claim for unjust conviction and imprisonment, claimant must establish by documentary evidence that: he or she has been convicted of one or more felonies or misdemeanors against the state and subsequently sentenced to a term of imprisonment, and has served all or any part of the sentence; and he or she has had the one or more felonies and misdemeanors dismissed with prejudice following serving all or part of the sentence; and his or her claim is not time-barred.

short_summary: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of post-traumatic stress disorder for certain dispatcher titles
summary: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of post-traumatic stress disorder for communications technicians, communications specialists, communications operators, radio dispatchers, or emergency dispatchers by any state agency, department, or division, county 911 dispatchers, county 911 dispatcher supervisors, New York city fire alarm dispatchers, supervising fire alarm dispatchers level one and supervising fire alarm dispatchers level two.

short_summary: Relates to increasing benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries
summary: Increases benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of dogs, cats and rabbits by pet dealers; repealer
summary: Relates to the sale of dogs, cats and rabbits by pet dealers in the state and those that sell such animals through an online platform.

short_summary: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service
summary: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service.

short_summary: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years
summary: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years.

short_summary: Relates to court confirmation of arbitration awards for public sector arbitrations
summary: Provides that the court shall confirm an award in a public sector arbitration proceeding upon application of a party made within one year after delivery to the party, unless an application to vacate or modify the award upon certain grounds is made.

short_summary: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds
summary: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers
summary: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers who lease the taxpayer's primary residence during the taxable year and who pay rent with respect to such residence in excess of thirty percent of such taxpayer's gross income for such taxable year whose income is less than fifty percent of the area median income.

short_summary: Grants the department of financial services jurisdiction over the financing of motor vehicles
summary: Grants the department of financial services jurisdiction over the financing of motor vehicles; requires motor vehicle dealer finance managers to be licensed by the department of financial services.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting certain discriminatory peremptory challenges to prospective jurors
summary: Prohibits peremptory challenges of prospective jurors based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, religion, religious practice, age, disability, or sexual orientation.

short_summary: Approves certain employee benefit costs for transportation employees for the Goshen Central school district
summary: Approves certain employee benefit costs for transportation employees for the Goshen Central school district.

short_summary: Criminalizes the harassment of a child; and establishes a private right of action for harassment of a child
summary: Criminalizes the harassment of a child when the perpetrator intentionally or knowingly harasses, annoys or alarms a child or a child's parent or guardian; establishes a private right of action for harassment of a child.

short_summary: Enacts the freedom to read act
summary: Enacts the "freedom to read act"; requires the commissioner of education and school library systems to develop policies to ensure that school libraries and library staff are empowered to curate and develop collections that provide students with access to the widest array of developmentally appropriate materials available.

short_summary: Prohibits speech-based defenses to actions brought against an individual for the unlawful dissemination of publication of an intimate image
summary: Prohibits speech-based defenses to actions brought against an individual for the unlawful dissemination of publication of an intimate image.

short_summary: Implements several programs to improve indoor air quality
summary: Implements several programs to improve indoor air quality, including establishing photo-catalytic air scavenging technology certification centers and a weatherization and energy efficiency training program; establishes the office of workforce development and indoor air quality management training, minimum wage rates for indoor air quality workers, and the indoor air quality fund.

short_summary: Requires assent of two-thirds of the members for any bill that enacts or increases tax revenues
summary: Requires assent of two-thirds of the members for any bill that enacts or increases tax revenues.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for violation of certain wage payment violations
summary: Permits an employee to commence a private action against an employer for violation of frequency of wage payment violations; directs increased penalties.

short_summary: Relates to certain actions against law enforcement officers
summary: Extends the statute of limitations to bring a claim arising out of an alleged sexual offense by a law enforcement officer if the alleged offense occurred while the officer was employed by a law enforcement agency.

short_summary: Requires state agencies to publish certain information in local, community and ethnic media
summary: Requires state agencies to publish certain information in local, community and ethnic media; defines local, community and ethnic media; requires the office of general services to develop and maintain a list of local, community and ethnic media outlets.

short_summary: Allows bars and restaurants to organize and manage sports squares pools
summary: Allows bars and restaurants to organize and manage sports squares pools, provided that they do not take any profit from such pools.

short_summary: Relates to registration requirements applicable to certain sex offenders who are transient
summary: Provides registration requirements applicable to level three sex offenders and sexual predators who are transient.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting certain cannabis related advertisements
summary: Prohibits any cannabis related advertisements in establishments within a certain distance from schools; increases penalties for prohibited advertisement of tobacco and cannabis products; requires enforcement inspections.

short_summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to develop and implement a tree planting pilot program in the ten zip codes in the state with the highest incidence of asthma; appropriation
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to develop and implement a tree planting pilot program in the ten zip codes in the state with the highest incidence of asthma.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to promulgate rules and regulations for providers operating in rural locations
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to promulgate rules and regulations for providers operating in rural locations while taking into account the extra challenges encountered by such providers, including but not limited to, increased and additional expenses.

short_summary: Relates to sentences of imprisonment for the crimes of murder in the first and second degrees
summary: Requires life without parole for the crime of murder in the first degree, and a minimum term of 40 years for murder in the second degree.

short_summary: Requires schools and libraries to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists
summary: Requires school districts, public libraries, boards of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public elementary and secondary schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists.

short_summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a do-not-solicit solar development statewide registry
summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a do-not-solicit solar development statewide registry prohibiting solar solicitors from contacting persons who are included on such registry; establishes requirements for solar solicitors who make solar marketing sales calls, electronic messaging, and on-premises sales appeals to customers in New York state; establishes penalties for violations.

short_summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students
summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students.

short_summary: Relates to arbitration proceedings
summary: Amends provisions of law governing arbitration proceedings; specifies fees and expenses with regard to employment or consumer arbitration proceedings; directs certain sanctions on a party which breaches an arbitration agreement.

short_summary: Allows the legislature to authorize pool-selling without profit
summary: Allows the legislature to authorize pool-selling without profit.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation of live restraint cable devices to take wildlife
summary: Relates to the regulation of live restraint cable devices to take wildlife; authorizes regulations by the department of environmental conservation.

short_summary: Establishes a personal income tax credit for the purchase of a gun safe
summary: Establishes up to a $500 personal income tax credit for the purchase of a gun safe.

short_summary: Requires bills containing an unfunded mandate for a county or municipality to be referred to the state comptroller for opinion before being certified
summary: Requires bills containing an unfunded mandate for a county or municipality to be referred to the state comptroller for opinion before being certified.

short_summary: Clarifies the definition of "tenant" to exclude squatters
summary: Extends the time period for tenancy rights from 30 days to 45 days of possession; adds squatting to the definition of criminal trespass in the third degree.

short_summary: Provides a premium reduction for physicians who complete a training strategies course relating to emergency department visits for individuals with a developmental or intellectual disability
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to approve courses for eligible physicians, nurses and other staff that covers risk management strategies in emergency department visits for individuals with a developmental or intellectual disability; provides a premium reduction for physicians who complete such risk management strategies course.

short_summary: Requires lessors to provide a copy of a lease agreement upon written request of a residential lessee
summary: Requires lessors or their authorized agent to provide a copy of a lease agreement upon written request of a residential lessee within thirty calendar days from the date of such request.

short_summary: Relates to design professional overhead audit recovery
summary: Prohibits any state agency or state authority from demanding any credit, recoupment, rate adjustment or any other payment from a design professional on the basis of such design professional having received forgiveness on a paycheck protection act loan.

short_summary: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services
summary: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services.

short_summary: Relates to the maximum hours for home care aides
summary: Places limits on the maximum amount of hours a home care aide may be required to work without voluntarily consenting to such an assignment.

short_summary: Relates to the composition of the state board of parole
summary: Requires that the state board of parole include a member who is a current or former member of law enforcement, a member who has in the past been a victim of a crime or the representative of a victim of a past crime and a member who is an individual who was formerly incarcerated and has satisfied all conditions of post-incarceration release, including parole.

short_summary: Relates to the green roof tax abatement in N.Y. city
summary: Relates to raising the tax abatement rate and extending certain deadlines for purposes of the green roof tax abatement for certain properties in a city of one million or more persons.

short_summary: Relates to pregnant and postpartum individuals and their children's health coverage and information
summary: Expands coverage for pregnant and postpartum individuals and their children; establishes a health expense account program for pregnant and postpartum individuals; requires the creation of informative pamphlets on maternal depression.

short_summary: Makes technical corrections to a definition for purposes of the excelsior linked deposit program
summary: Makes technical corrections to the definition of "certified service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprise" for purposes of the excelsior linked deposit program.

short_summary: Enacts the New York Santoro provider protection act of 2023 to expand access to abortion, services for the benefit of out-of-state patients
summary: Enacts the New York Santoro provider protection act of 2023; creates the "travel program" to expand access to abortion services for the benefit of out-of-state patients.

short_summary: Provides for lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act
summary: Establishes the lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act.

short_summary: Relates to repealing congestion pricing (Part A); and commissioning an independent audit of the metropolitan transportation authority (Part B)
summary: Repeals congestion pricing (Part A); directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the provision of an independent, comprehensive, forensic audit of the authority (Part B).

short_summary: Authorizes the district attorney in the county of Oneida to appoint five stenographers
summary: Authorizes the district attorney in the county of Oneida to appoint five stenographers to take and transcribe the testimony given before grand juries.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Suffolk and the village of Nissequogue, in the county of Suffolk, to offer the 20-year retirement option to Bridget Topping, a police officer employed by such county and village
summary: Authorizes the county of Suffolk and the village of Nissequogue, in the county of Suffolk, to offer the 20-year retirement option to Bridget Topping, a police officer employed by such county and village.

short_summary: Permits minors to be employed as a referee, umpire or official at a youth sporting event
summary: Permits certain minors to be employed as a referee, umpire or official at a youth sporting event; limits a minor 12 or 13 years of age to one youth sporting event per week.

short_summary: Provides for the establishment, incorporation and certification of addiction and substance abuse facilities in the city of New York
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to ensure persons have accessible healthcare, treatment capacities and harm reduction services.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the intergenerational poverty mitigation act
summary: Relates to enacting the intergenerational poverty mitigation act; creates a commission to study intergenerational poverty and a pilot program to address intergenerational poverty subject to appropriation.

short_summary: Relates to the cost effectiveness of consultant contracts by state agencies
summary: Relates to the cost effectiveness of consultant contracts by state agencies; defines "consultant services".

short_summary: Relates to mandatory health insurance coverage for acupuncture services
summary: Relates to mandatory health insurance coverage for acupuncture services.

short_summary: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed
summary: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed.

short_summary: Makes technical corrections to chapter 638 of the laws of 2022 relating to the authorization of a real property tax exemption for Word of Truth Church, Inc. in Suffolk county
summary: Makes technical corrections relating to the authorization of a real property tax exemption for Word of Truth Church, Inc. in Suffolk county.

short_summary: Authorizes the United Church of God Seventh Day to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the United Church of God Seventh Day to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Relates to adding St. Lawrence county sheriff as an additional firearm licensing officer
summary: Relates to adding St. Lawrence county sheriff as an additional firearms licensing officer as well as judges or justices of a court of record having an office in the county of St. Lawrence.

short_summary: Relates to crimes against public trust by state officers
summary: Relates to crimes against public trust by state officers; requires such state officers' salary to be suspended pending indictment for such crimes; and if convicted requires such state officers to pay back the portion of their salary beginning with the pay period immediately proceeding the date upon which the first convicted offense occurred.

short_summary: Relates to the reinstatement of state recognition and acknowledgement of the Montaukett Indian Nation
summary: Provides for the reinstatement of state recognition and acknowledgement of the Montaukett Indian Nation; provides that the Montaukett Indian nation shall have a chief or sachem, three tribal trustees and a tribal secretary; provides for the qualification of voters; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes the Middletown parking authority and provides for its powers, duties and obligations; and repeals certain provisions of the public authorities law relating thereto
summary: Establishes the Middletown parking authority; provides for its powers, duties and obligations; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

short_summary: Provides for the conversion of condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York
summary: Relates to the conversion to condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York; provides expanded homeownership opportunities from the conversion of certain residential rental buildings to condominium status by property owners that commit to preserve the inventory of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York.

short_summary: Extends the provisions of chapter 3 of the laws of 2020 relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force
summary: Extends provisions relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force; authorizes the stretch limousine passenger safety task force to continue to hold public hearings and meetings to review the actions taken by the state and to publish a report of its findings.

short_summary: Permits schools to allow trade unions to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
summary: Requires the principal of any high school to allow any local trade union, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of trade union recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

short_summary: Requires a study of the utilization of state government payments as an opportunity to transition unbanked and underbanked state residents into the banking system
summary: Requires a study of the utilization of state government payments as an opportunity to transition unbanked and underbanked state residents into the banking system; requires a report shall be compiled and provided on the findings no later than eighteen months after the effective date of this act.

short_summary: Relates to removing cause for absentee ballot voting
summary: Authorizes ballot by mail by removing cause for absentee ballot voting.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of voting power for committee members in districts that have changed or new districts
summary: Relates to the calculation of voting power for committee members in districts that have changed or new districts since the last preceding gubernatorial election.

short_summary: Relates to the substance of training and testing requirements for cosmetologists or natural hair stylists
summary: Requires the secretary of state to promulgate rules and regulations requiring that education and testing for cosmetologists or natural hair stylists include education and testing regarding the provision of services to individuals with all hair types and textures, including, but not limited to, various curl or wave patterns, hair strand thicknesses, and volumes of hair.

short_summary: Prevents relicensing of drivers who have been twice convicted of certain violations relating to driving
summary: Prevents relicensing of drivers who have been twice convicted of certain violations relating to driving where physical injury occurs.

short_summary: Expands the criteria for a hate crime
summary: Expands the criteria for a hate crime to include trespass committed at a house of worship.

short_summary: Establishes the COVID-19 livery vehicle recovery act
summary: Establishes the COVID-19 livery vehicle recovery act; provides any entity issuing for-hire vehicle licenses shall, for a minimum of one year upon the effective date of this act, allow for the renewal of livery vehicle licenses which expired during the COVID-19 pandemic, under the same vehicle type requirement that existed at the time of expiration unless the livery vehicle owner opts to renew at the current requirement; provides that livery vehicle owners seeking a renewal of an expired license during this open window shall not be penalized, such as through additional charges or fees.

short_summary: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements
summary: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements where the municipal governing body finds that the grant encourages tourism or otherwise improves quality of life.

short_summary: Requires warning labels on all containers that contain bisphenol A
summary: Requires warning labels on all containers that contain bisphenol A that states it is harmful to an individual's health to microwave or otherwise heat such container.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home
summary: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home.

short_summary: Expands the scope of practice of psychiatric nurse practitioners
summary: Expands the scope of practice of psychiatric nurse practitioners; makes conforming changes in the mental hygiene law.

short_summary: Grants the commissioner of transportation the authority to increase grant awards for airport improvement and revitalization
summary: Grants the commissioner of transportation the authority to increase grant awards for airport improvement and revitalization when the total funds available for assistance support higher maximum grants.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat
summary: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat; establishes a $100 credit for a maximum of three dogs or cats per taxable year.

short_summary: Relates to downcoding on initial review and audits reversing or altering medical necessity determinations
summary: Ensures the decision to downcode an insurance claim is recognized as an adverse determination; prohibits health plans from reversing or altering medical necessity determinations made by a utilization review agent or external appeals agent as a result of an audit of claims.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state
summary: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state.

short_summary: Authorizes county boards of elections to establish county-wide polling places
summary: Authorizes county boards of elections to establish county-wide polling places where any person entitled to vote in such county by personal appearance may so vote on the day of a primary election or general election, subject to approval by the state board of elections.

short_summary: Authorizes non-membership not-for-profit corporations to classify their boards through their by-laws
summary: Authorizes non-membership not-for-profit corporations to classify boards through the by-laws and not solely through the certificate of incorporation.

short_summary: Permits the sale of beer at retail on Sundays; repealer
summary: Permits the sale of beer at retail on Sundays.

short_summary: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Establishes the "Not on our dime!: Ending New York funding of Israeli settler violence act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from engaging in unauthorized support of Israeli settlement activity
summary: Establishes the "Not on our dime!: Ending New York funding of Israeli settler violence act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from engaging in unauthorized support of Israeli settlement activity; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.

short_summary: Relates to assaults upon certain employees of a transit agency or authority
summary: Includes traffic checkers in the existing 2nd degree assault provisions found in the penal law.

short_summary: Relates to an individual's right to request a hearing regarding an unemployment insurance benefits claim
summary: Relates to an individual's right to request a hearing regarding an unemployment insurance benefits claim; provides such a hearing can be requested if benefits or a written notice of determination denying their claim are not received within thirty days of providing all required information.

short_summary: Expands the offense of unlawfully dealing with a child in the second degree
summary: Expands the offense of unlawfully dealing with a child in the second degree to include allowing a child less than eighteen years old to enter or remain in an establishment that serves alcohol and does not have an on-site kitchen.

short_summary: Relates to strengthening enforcement efforts of the state's anti-slaughter of race horses and race horse breeding stock law
summary: Strengthens enforcement efforts of the state's anti-slaughter of race horses and race horse breeding stock law; requires the posting of signage that states it is illegal to sell or transfer such animals for the purposes of slaughter.

short_summary: Relates to burglary on a premises used as a farm operation
summary: Includes premises used as a farm operation within the crime of burglary in the second degree.

short_summary: Exempts certain geothermal boreholes at depths beyond five hundred feet from certain requirements
summary: Exempts certain geothermal boreholes at depths beyond five hundred feet from certain requirements for wells drilled deeper than five hundred feet below the earth's surface.

short_summary: Provides for early retirement without a pension reduction for certain disabled veterans
summary: Provides that a member of a public retirement system of the state who is a disabled veteran may retire without reduction of their retirement benefit upon their attainment of at least fifty-five years of age and completion of at least thirteen years of credited service in such retirement system.

short_summary: Requires review of all motor vehicle repair shop applicants which includes community input
summary: Requires review of all motor vehicle repair shop applicants which includes community input.

short_summary: Relates to the use of hazard lights when traveling at certain speeds
summary: Requires the use of hazard lights when traveling at a speed slower than or equal to 15 mph below the speed limit.

short_summary: Requires the inspection of buildings where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale, or rental
summary: Requires the periodic inspection of commercial buildings where bicycles with electric assist are repaired, sold, rented, or stored for repair, sale, or rental; requires such inspection quarterly; requires the state fire prevention and building code council to establish a fee for such inspection; requires the inspection of such buildings following a fire-related emergency or other fire-related incident.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of robots by police agencies
summary: Prohibits the use of weaponized robots, non-weaponized robots which may potentially cause injury, or robots being used for surveillance purposes by police agencies.

short_summary: Relates to the reimbursement of certain certification examination fees
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to develop a program and provide for a system whereby teachers may submit examination receipts for any New York state teaching certifications earned after the first permanent teaching certification for reimbursement by the department of education for any additional certifications.

short_summary: Authorizes N.Y. city to remove the cap on the floor area ratio of certain dwellings being converted from non-residential to residential units
summary: Authorizes a city of one million or more to remove the cap on the floor area ratio of certain dwellings being converted from non-residential to residential units; requires that no less than 40% of such units remain affordable for those who are below 60% of the area median income; requires certain labor standards in converting such units; prohibits conversion of floor area ration under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Requires car washes to disclose when promotions expire
summary: Requires car washes to disclose when promotions expire as well as any costs which will be incurred upon the expiration of such promotion and how often such costs will be incurred upon someone taking part in such promotion.

short_summary: Relates to certified registered nurse anesthetists
summary: Defines the practice of certified registered nurse anesthetist; requires collaboration with a licensed physician qualified to determine the need for anesthesia services; requires licensing; defines qualifications.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Warwick, county of Orange to alienate certain lands held in public trust in the town of Warwick, county of Orange
summary: Authorizes the town of Warwick, county of Orange to alienate certain lands held in public trust in the town of Warwick, county of Orange.

short_summary: Establishes a Latina suicide prevention task force; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof
summary: Establishes a Latina suicide prevention task force; provides for the number of members, manner of appointment and the topics to be reviewed.

short_summary: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit
summary: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit which provides a tax credit to property owners who spend money to update a property to adhere to current applicable building and fire codes.

short_summary: Relates to the use of MWBE investments for New York state funds
summary: Relates to the use of MWBE investments for and aspirational goal of at least twenty percent of each New York state fund, to the greatest extent feasible within the bounds of financial and fiduciary prudence.

short_summary: Enacts the automobile insurance consumer information act
summary: Enacts the "automobile insurance consumer information act"; provides for automobile insurance consumer information and complaint ranking; creates office of public insurance consumer advocate and powers and duties therefor; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates and provides that the funding for such be deposited in the Alzheimer's disease assistance fund
summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

short_summary: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services
summary: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the release of consumption data
summary: Prohibits the release of a consumer's electrical or gas consumption data to any police officer, or private, local, state or federal law enforcement entity without a judicial court-ordered subpoena, warrant or the consumer's written consent.

short_summary: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance and the criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree
summary: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance; establishes the offense of criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree; expands the definition of controlled substances with respect to certain offenses; increases the felony classification of certain controlled substance offenses; includes electronic prescriptions and blank prescription forms in the definition of certain controlled substance offenses.

short_summary: Relates to the level of acceptable light transmittance of automobile window tint and film
summary: Relates to the level of acceptable light transmittance of automobile window tint and film.

short_summary: Provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics
summary: Enacts the "beauty justice act"; provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics; prohibits the sale of personal care products and cosmetic products containing certain restricted products.

short_summary: Establishes a right of first refusal in municipalities for state land to be sold at public auction
summary: Establishes a right of first refusal in municipalities for state land to be sold at public auction.

short_summary: Establishes portable polling locations for early voting
summary: Establishes portable polling locations for early voting; provides that a county board of elections may establish one or more portable polling locations.

short_summary: Relates to state agency websites
summary: Requires state agency websites to be mobile friendly.

short_summary: Relates to split shifts for election inspectors or poll clerks
summary: Relates to split shifts for election inspectors or poll clerks.

short_summary: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables and requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles
summary: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables; requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles.

short_summary: Enacts "Vincent Scheppa's law" authorizing, in certain cases, the provision of private duty nursing services to a medical assistance recipient by a relative who is a registered professional nurse
summary: Enacts "Vincent Scheppa's law" authorizing, in certain cases, the provision of private duty nursing services to a medical assistance recipient by a relative who is a registered professional nurse.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an inmate
summary: Relates to the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an inmate; requires any imprisonment imposed by such conviction run consecutively to any undischarged term of imprisonment to which the defendant is subject.

short_summary: Grants police officer status to members of the uniformed correction force of N.Y. city department of correction
summary: Grants police officer status to members of the uniformed correction force of the N.Y. city department of correction who complete a certain training program.

short_summary: Relates to permitting employees of public utilities access to certain restroom facilities without being a paying customer
summary: Permits employees of public utility corporations or public utility companies access to certain restroom facilities without being a paying customer.

short_summary: Directs the education department to study, review and report on the placement of the county of Westchester in the Hudson Valley region for purposes of public school foundation aid
summary: Directs the education department to study, review and report on the geographic cost variation of counties in the Hudson Valley labor force region to determine the appropriateness of the region cost index values for purposes of the public school foundation aid formula.

short_summary: Prohibits publishers from limiting the number of copies of e-books available at public libraries
summary: Prohibits publishers from limiting the number of copies of e-books available at public libraries in New York.

short_summary: Relates to the redomestication of insurance companies
summary: Relates to the redomestication of insurance companies.

short_summary: Relates to the maximum age at which a homeless youth can continue to receive shelter services
summary: Relates to the maximum age at which a homeless youth can continue to receive shelter services; raises the age from twenty-one to twenty-four.

short_summary: Authorizes a personal income tax credit for residential solar energy systems
summary: Authorizes a personal income tax credit for solar energy systems purchased and installed at a residence.

short_summary: Includes in the class E felony of vehicular assault in the second degree, the causing of serious physical injury while operating a vehicle with suspended, revoked or no license
summary: Includes in the class E felony of vehicular assault in the second degree, the causing of serious physical injury while operating a vehicle with suspended, revoked or no license; creates the crime of vehicular homicide.

short_summary: Relates to restrictions on certain flight operations at municipal facilities; relates to the use of certain heliports
summary: Prohibits municipal corporation from permitting the use of publicly owned land for helicopter air transportation operated for the primary purpose of conducting sightseeing tours over New York city or conducting photography, videography, or similar production activities over New York city; and relates to the use of certain heliports in the city of New York.

short_summary: Provides for elder abuse prevention training
summary: Requires the office for the aging to develop and provide elder abuse prevention training to train senior service centers and contractors in the detection and reporting of elder abuse in consultation with the office of children and family services.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York City Training And Comprehension of Trauma in Children (TACTIC) Act"
summary: Enacts the "New York City Training And Comprehension of Trauma in Children (TACTIC) Act"; establishes the TACTIC council; provides for a trauma informed care training program to teachers in schools located in the city of New York; creates a department of child trauma informed care to assist with parenting workshops, to assign trauma informed care specialists to schools and to report to the TACTIC council regarding child trauma informed care provided to schools in the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to the substitution of brand name epinephrine auto-injectors with alternate epinephrine auto-injectors
summary: Relates to the substitution of brand name epinephrine auto-injectors with alternate epinephrine auto-injectors in certain cases.

short_summary: Establishes supermarket wine licenses
summary: Establishes supermarket wine licenses to sell from the licensed premises wine in sealed containers for consumption off such premises.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or manufacture of certain single-use plastic water bottles and single-use plastic beverage containers
summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or manufacture of single-use plastic water bottles not comprised of one hundred percent recycled material; prohibits the sale of single-use plastic beverage containers comprised of less than seventy-five percent recycled materials; establishes penalties for violations; requires food service establishments to provide customers with tap water, beverages and leftovers in reusable beverage containers provided by a customer.

short_summary: Relates to affidavits of the lawful immigration status of certain students; repealer
summary: Removes the affidavit of the lawful immigration status requirement for certain students.

short_summary: Requires the department of veterans' services to provide certain assistance to veterans
summary: Requires the department of veterans' services to provide legal and/or technical support to veterans who want to change such veteran's discharged status to honorable because such person was dishonorably or administratively discharged from the armed services due to sexual orientation.

short_summary: Relates to consideration of gender-affirming health care or gender-affirming mental health care in child custody cases
summary: Relates to consideration of gender-affirming health care or gender-affirming mental health care in child custody cases for purposes of jurisdiction, forum and enforcement of custody orders.

short_summary: Enacts the New York veteran digital navigator program act of 2023
summary: Enacts the "New York veteran digital navigator program act"; requires the state commissioner of the department of veterans' services to establish a program to promote digital citizenship, through which the state commissioner shall award grants to eligible entities.

short_summary: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory
summary: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory unless a reprieve is provided for supply chain issues; provides a fine may be assessed for failure to comply, as determined by the commissioner.

short_summary: Relates to information to be provided by a veterinarian initially prescribing or dispensing a drug to a dog, cat, or rabbit
summary: Relates to information to be provided by a veterinarian initially prescribing or dispensing a drug to a dog, cat, or rabbit; extends the effective date of such provisions.

short_summary: Relates to obtaining jurisdiction over certain defendants in matters relating to a tenancy or lease
summary: Standardizes the language across the relevant court acts to allow tenants statewide to sue in the county where the real property at issue is located in matters relating to a tenancy or lease; requires the Office of Court Administration to develop necessary forms, procedures and deliver a report.

short_summary: Authorizes rate increases for in-person early intervention services
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of health to increase rates by 11 percent for in-person early intervention services commencing July 1, 2024.

short_summary: Increases the allowances provided to trial and grand jurors
summary: Increases the allowances provided to trial and grand jurors to $60 per day for the first ten days and $100 per day every day thereafter of physical attendance.

short_summary: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public
summary: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public; to provide an opportunity for the public to attend, listen to, and observe such meetings; and to broadcast and maintain records of such meetings on each party's website.

short_summary: Relates to payment of the governor's salary
summary: Requires withholding the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs.

short_summary: Relates to withholding the governor and lieutenant governor's salaries until the legislative passage of the budget occurs
summary: Relates to withholding the governor and lieutenant governor's salaries until the legislative passage of the budget occurs.

short_summary: Withholds the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs
summary: Withholds the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs; provides such salary should be withheld if the budget has not passed prior to the first day of the fiscal year and shall not be paid until such passage occurs.

short_summary: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office
summary: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office and state and private websites; requires written materials to be updated.

short_summary: Relates to the use of penalties collected from public utilities
summary: Requires the public service commission to distribute penalty awards received from public utilities to customers aggrieved by the actions of the public utility.

short_summary: Authorizes Congregation RSK to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes Congregation RSK to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Modernizes the metropolitan transportation authority's small business mentoring program
summary: Increases the number of years a small business can participate in the small business mentor program from four years to five years for Tier 1 and from four years to five years for Tier 2; increases cap on awards under MTA's small business mentor program from one million dollars to one million five hundred thousand dollars for Tier 2 contracts; requires a report to the legislature and the governor.

short_summary: Relates to withholding the governor's salary after the April first budget deadline until a state budget has been passed
summary: Relates to withholding the governor's salary after the April first budget deadline until a state budget has been passed.

short_summary: Extends the ability of the county of Albany to impose and collect taxes on occupancy of hotel or motel rooms in Albany county
summary: Extends the ability of the county of Albany to impose and collect taxes on occupancy of hotel or motel rooms in Albany county.

short_summary: Requires prescription containers for opioid medications to have a red cap top and a printed warning
summary: Requires prescription containers for opioid medications to have a red cap top and a printed warning about the risks of overdose and addiction.

short_summary: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings
summary: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings.

short_summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Southold, county of Suffolk, to accept from GKLF II, LLC, grantee, an application for a refund from the town real estate transfer tax
summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Southold, county of Suffolk, to accept from GKLF II, LLC, grantee, an application for a refund from the town real estate transfer tax paid pursuant to section 1449-bb of the tax law for certain real property conveyed on June 22, 2021.

short_summary: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events
summary: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events; requires school districts, boards of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension boards and charter schools to develop and implement a cardiac emergency response plan.

short_summary: Repeals the excise tax on medical cannabis and the medical cannabis trust fund
summary: Repeals the excise tax on medical cannabis and the medical cannabis trust fund.

short_summary: Relates to the capital district transportation district
summary: Permits Warren county to become a member of the capital district transportation district by action of their governing body.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of transportation to report on collisions that have occurred between motor vehicles and bridges or elevated structures on or crossing highways
summary: Requires the commissioner of transportation to report on collisions that have occurred between motor vehicles and bridges or elevated structures on or crossing highways under the jurisdiction of the department of transportation in the annual report to the legislature.

short_summary: Enacts the monarch preservation plan
summary: Enacts the monarch preservation plan requiring the department of environmental conservation to take feasible actions to conserve monarch butterflies and the unique habitats they depend upon for successful migration.

short_summary: Establishes the first responder epinephrine preparedness initiative (EPI) act
summary: Establishes the first responder epinephrine preparedness initiative (EPI) act, creating a first responder epinephrine access program; authorizes the commissioner of health to approve and implement a municipal epinephrine bulk purchase program; authorizes taxpayers to contribute a gift for municipal epinephrine bulk purchases; establishes a municipal epinephrine bulk purchase fund.

short_summary: Increases the number of county court judges in Saratoga county
summary: Increases the number of county court judges in Saratoga county by one justice.

short_summary: Establishes the beginning farmer advisory board on agriculture
summary: Expands the young farmer advisory board on agriculture to become the beginning farmer advisory board on agriculture.

short_summary: Relates to extreme risk protection orders
summary: Relates to extreme risk protection orders; defines "exception"; authorizes a police officer or district attorney to file an application for an extreme risk protection order if found that a person meets the requirements of an exception pursuant to section 6340 of the civil practice law and rules; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Limits reversals for failure of prompt prosecution under certain circumstances
summary: Limits reversals for failure of prompt prosecution where there is no violation of periods of limitations, speedy trial time periods, and no showing of material prejudice resulting from unreasonable delay.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the base benefit amount for computation of pension cost-of-living adjustments
summary: Increases the base benefit amount for computation of pension cost-of-living adjustments.

short_summary: Authorizes fiat-collateralized stablecoins as a form of bail
summary: Authorizes fiat-collateralized stablecoins as a form of bail; directs the commissioner of taxation and finance, in conjunction with the chief justice of the unified court system and the director of the office of information technology services, to promulgate rules and regulations identifying forms of fiat-collateralized stablecoin acceptable for posting bail to establish a system for the administration of the acceptance, recording and processing of stablecoins as a means of securing bail.

short_summary: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers
summary: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Cayuga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Cayuga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to 11/30/2025.

short_summary: Includes an E felony in the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant and to the authority of a public servant other than a police officer to serve an appearance ticket
summary: Includes an E felony in the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant and to the authority of a public servant other than a police officer to serve an appearance ticket.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the authority of the attorney general to investigate violations of the public officers law
summary: Expands the authority of the attorney general to investigate violations of the public officers law.

short_summary: Relates to the residential parking system in the town of Harrison
summary: Relates to the residential parking system in the town of Harrison; extends the area in which such residential parking system can be located.

short_summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Southold, county of Suffolk, to accept from GKLF, LLC, grantee, an application for a refund from the town real estate transfer tax
summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Southold, county of Suffolk, to accept from GKLF, LLC, grantee, an application for a refund from the town real estate transfer tax paid pursuant to section 1449-bb of the tax law for certain real property conveyed on June 22, 2021.

short_summary: Includes certain offenses the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant and to the authority of a public servant to serve an appearance ticket
summary: Includes a class E felony and a class A misdemeanor involving harm to an identifiable person or to identifiable property if the person has been convicted of any felony or class A misdemeanor within the previous three years or of any other misdemeanor within the previous two years in the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant and to the authority of a public servant other than a police officer to serve an appearance ticket.

short_summary: Includes a class E felony and a class A misdemeanor involving harm to an identifiable person in the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant
summary: Includes a class E felony and a class A misdemeanor involving harm to an identifiable person in the exceptions to the authority of a police officer to arrest a person without a warrant and to the authority of a public servant other than a police officer to serve an appearance ticket.

short_summary: Relates to the discovery of material, non-material and impeachment information and the required time frame for such discovery
summary: Relates to the discovery of material, non-material and impeachment information and the required time frame for such discovery; requires the submission of a certificate of compliance upon completion of certain discovery requirements.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions of the criminal procedure law, judiciary law and the executive law and makes conforming changes thereto
summary: Provides judges with more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; establishes new criminal discovery rules.

short_summary: Establishes a special needs assisted living program to serve persons with neurodegenerative diseases
summary: Establishes a special needs assisted living program to serve residents with neurodegenerative diseases, such as dementia or Parkinson's disease, who are experiencing behavior disturbances.

short_summary: Relates to the right to hold race meetings and races at Belmont Park
summary: Relates to the right to hold race meetings and races after sunset at Belmont Park, only at the main track in its current configuration, but only if such races conclude before 10:30 P.M. and only occur on Thursdays, Fridays or Saturdays.

short_summary: Requires schools to provide teachers with written informational material on the use of epinephrine auto-injectors
summary: Requires schools to provide teachers with written informational material on the use of epinephrine auto-injectors.

short_summary: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups
summary: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups.

short_summary: Relates to Medicaid eligibility for striking workers
summary: Relates to automatic Medicaid eligibility for striking workers.

short_summary: Authorizes Chabad of Oceanside to receive a retroactive exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes Chabad of Oceanside to receive a retroactive exemption from real property taxes.

short_summary: Authorizes Saddle Rock Minyan to file an application for retroactive real property tax exemption
summary: Authorizes Saddle Rock Minyan to file an application for retroactive real property tax exemption with respect to the 2021-2022 and 2022-2023 assessment rolls.

short_summary: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
summary: Relates to authorizing a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on-premises, notwithstanding certain restrictions regarding proximity to a school, church, synagogue, or other place of worship, for certain property located in the county of Erie.

short_summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Albany
summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Albany; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2028.

short_summary: Relates to the powers and duties of the Hempstead union free school district monitors
summary: Provides additional powers and duties of the Hempstead union free school district monitors including overriding and proposing resolutions adopted by the school board, requiring the board and school district officers to undergo training, and the approving of the appointment of the superintendent.

short_summary: Requires that thirty percent of state agency property management contracts be awarded to minority and women-owned business enterprises
summary: Requires that each agency letting contracts for the hiring of property managers for residential and commercial buildings structure procurement goals for such contracts that include the award of thirty percent of such contracts to minority and women-owned business enterprises; provides for the promulgation of rules and regulations.

short_summary: Relates to qualifications for holding the offices of city controller and city engineer in the city of Amsterdam
summary: Relates to qualifications for holding the offices of city controller and city engineer in the city of Amsterdam; provides that a person not living in the city of Amsterdam may hold the office of city controller or city engineer for such city provided he or she lives in Montgomery county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to timely release of principals on bail
summary: Requires persons held in custody to be released immediately upon posting bail; requires use and acceptance of electronic signatures and records to effectuate communications relating to posting bail.

short_summary: Relates to recovery of online accounts
summary: Requires that businesses that provide consumers with online accounts to access services permit consumers who have been victims of identity theft to recover such accounts using proper identification if the business has a physical presence in this state.

short_summary: Relates to the contracting of indebtedness by city school districts
summary: Relates to the contracting of indebtedness by city school districts; removes provisions relating thereto.

short_summary: Authorizes not-for-profit corporation inclusion as minority and women-owned enterprises
summary: Authorizes not-for-profit corporation inclusion as minority and women-owned enterprises.

short_summary: Establishes a sea level rise mitigation and adaptation plan for cities with a population of one million or more
summary: Establishes a sea level rise mitigation and adaptation plan for cities with a population of one million or more to be implemented by the department of environmental conservation; requires a sea level rise vulnerability and adaptation report to be submitted.

short_summary: Relates to joining multistate voter list maintenance organizations
summary: Permits the state board of elections to join certain multistate voter list maintenance organizations and provide such organizations with certain voter information; requires the state to join a multistate voter list maintenance organization on or before July 31, 2025.

short_summary: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to offer civic engagement courses to incarcerated individuals prior to their release
summary: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to provide a nonpartisan, peer-led civic engagement program for incarcerated individuals in all correctional facilities in this state which shall be completed by each incarcerated individual within one year prior to their release.

short_summary: Relates to assault in the second degree
summary: Makes the crime of preventing an elected official from performing a lawful duty or essential service a class D felony of assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law
summary: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law and coverage for usual and customary costs for out-of-network health care service.

short_summary: Relates to student class size in public schools
summary: Relates to student class size in public schools in school districts located outside of a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants; requires such districts to develop a plan to reduce actual class sizes beginning September two thousand twenty-three.

short_summary: Enacts the "tenants organizing act"
summary: Enacts the "tenants organizing act"; allows tenants' groups, committees or other tenants' organizations to invite outside guests or visitors including elected officials, services providers, housing lawyers, etc. without being required to pay fees; defines "tenants' organization"; provides for activities that tenants' organizations can take part in; provides for the manner in how a tenants' organization is established.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the membership of the special district operations and development committee
summary: Relates to increasing the membership of the special district operations and development committee; provides that the committee shall consist of no less than nine members and no more than fifteen.

short_summary: Relates to adolescent offenders authorized to be removed to family court
summary: Exempts adolescent offenders who were illegally in possession of a loaded firearm from those authorized to be removed to family court.

short_summary: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county
summary: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county from one judge to two.
