summary: Provides that the weekly benefit which the disabled employee is entitled to receive for disability commencing: on or after January first, two thousand twenty-six shall be fifty percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed fifty percent of the state average weekly wage; on or after January first, two thousand twenty-seven shall be fifty-five percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed fifty-five percent of the state average weekly wage; on or after January first, two thousand twenty-eight shall be sixty percent of the employee's weekly average wage but shall not exceed sixty percent of the state average weekly wage; and on or after January first of each succeeding year, shall be sixty-seven percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed sixty-seven percent of the state average weekly wage.

short_summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative
summary: Extends for two years the requirement for OPWDD to give a 90-day notice to the Senate, Assembly, and labor organizations of any closures or transfer of a state operated individualized residential alternative.

short_summary: Relates to the Suffolk county water quality restoration act
summary: Amends provisions of the Suffolk county water quality restoration act relating to the expenditure of funds for certain water projects.

short_summary: Requires wireless communication method service providers disable services to stolen wireless phones
summary: Enacts "Detective Brian Simonsen's Law"; requires wireless communication method service providers disable services to stolen wireless phones.

short_summary: Establishes light duty during pregnancy and parental leave for railroad employees
summary: Establishes light duty during pregnancy and parental leave for railroad employees.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York state nurse employment, enhancement and dignity act"
summary: Enacts the "New York state nurse employment, enhancement and dignity act" to provide hazard pay to nurses during a state disaster emergency, an annual tax credit for nurses, a student loan forgiveness program for nurses, and preferential school admission for nurses.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of credit history checks in certain cases
summary: Prohibits the use of credit history checks to ascertain the payment status of a student loan of an applicant for employment for the purposes of making hiring decisions except where otherwise mandated by law.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the SIGH act to prohibit the construction of new schools near a major roadway, with exceptions
summary: Enacts the "schools impacted by gross highways (SIGH) act"; prohibits the commissioner of education from approving the plans for the erection of any new schoolhouse within five hundred feet of a controlled-access highway unless the commissioner of education determines that space limitations are so severe that there is no other site to erect such new schoolhouse, and there are adequate engineering controls to address air quality; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a bank relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof
summary: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a banking organization relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof.

short_summary: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent
summary: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent and for modification of such orders.

short_summary: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma
summary: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma after January 1, 2025.

short_summary: Relates to providing a tax credit for the adoption of special needs children
summary: Establishes that a resident taxpayer shall be allowed a credit against the tax in an amount equaling thirty percent of the qualified adoption expenses paid during the taxable year in conjunction with the taxpayer's adoption of a handicapped child or a hard to place child or five thousand dollars whichever is less.

short_summary: Prevents outsourcing during a hiring freeze
summary: Prevents an agency, department, division, commission, bureau or any other entity under the authority of the executive department from contracting, subcontracting or hiring any third party during a hiring freeze.

short_summary: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment
summary: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority, and its subsidiary corporations, who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment.

short_summary: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS
summary: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a department of corrections and community supervision identification form; and relates to the use of such form as proof of identity
summary: Relates to the creation of a department of corrections and community supervision identification form; relates to the use of such form as proof of identity for individuals applying for a non-driver identification card or certain driver's licenses.

short_summary: Provides a limitation on actions to collect overcharges
summary: Provides that an action to recover the amount of an overcharge based upon a mistake or billing error made by an electric, gas or telephone corporation must be commenced within ten years.

short_summary: Establishes a public awareness campaign for maternal depression; appropriation
summary: Establishes a public awareness campaign for maternal depression; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the reimbursement dictated pursuant to standards of payment for care provided foster children by three percent
summary: Relates to increasing the reimbursement dictated pursuant to standards of payment for care provided foster children by three percent.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

short_summary: Establishes a maximum temperature in school buildings and indoor facilities
summary: Establishes a maximum temperature in school buildings and indoor facilities; provides a definition of extreme heat condition days and the standard to measure room temperature.

short_summary: Enacts the Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act
summary: Enacts the "Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act"; relates to the delegation of state enforcement authority to private actors; authorizes an affected employee, whistleblower, representative organization or an organizational deputy to initiate a public enforcement action on behalf of the commissioner for certain provisions of the labor law, or any regulation promulgated thereunder.

short_summary: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers to practice in New York State if they are licensed to practice in another state or territory
summary: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers who are licensed to practice in another state or territory to provide athletic training services to athletes and team personnel at a discrete sanctioned team sporting event or performance in this state.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of special franchise property
summary: Exempts water system property owned by a private water-works corporation located in counties with a population of one million or more that are special assessing units from being included as special franchise property.

short_summary: Reconvenes the New York state sea level rise task force
summary: Reconvenes the New York state sea level rise task force to review the report and recommendations previously issued by the task force, and to determine the progress made in effectuating such recommendations and what recommendations require additional efforts; develop an updated evaluation of ways of protecting New York's remaining coastal ecosystems and natural habitats, and increasing coastal community resilience in the face of sea level rise, applying the best available science as to sea level rise and its anticipated impacts; and updating previous recommendations and, if appropriate, making new recommendations on sea level rise resiliency.

short_summary: Relates to the age of persons eligible for a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
summary: Clarifies that only persons eighteen years of age and older may be sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of certain hazardous inhalants to persons under the age of twenty-one
summary: Prohibits the sale of certain hazardous inhalants to persons under the age of twenty-one.

short_summary: Authorizes licensed creative arts therapists to bill Medicaid directly for their services
summary: Authorizes licensed creative arts therapists to bill Medicaid directly for their services.

short_summary: Relates to required terms for certain insurance contracts
summary: Includes permissible payment methods, advance consent for direct payments, and annually providing the updated rate schedule as required terms for certain insurance contracts.

short_summary: Establishes a blood clot and pulmonary embolism policy workgroup
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish a blood clot and pulmonary embolism policy workgroup.

short_summary: Relates to disabilities or death of sanitation department employees caused by leptospirosis
summary: Relates to evidence that leptospirosis that caused disability or death of a sanitation department employee was incurred in the performance of such sanitation department employee's duties.

short_summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on Brooklyn College constructing a micro-grid
summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on Brooklyn College constructing a micro-grid to study the feasibility, efficiency, and energy saving costs if such a micro-grid was constructed on campus.

short_summary: Relates to reporting requirements for the department of transportation
summary: Requires the department of transportation to submit annual reporting to the minority leader of the senate, the minority leader of the assembly, the ranking minority member of the senate transportation committee, the ranking minority member of the assembly transportation committee, the ranking minority member of the senate finance committee, and the ranking minority member of the assembly ways and means committee.

short_summary: Establishes the commission on public safety, emergency preparedness, and mental health
summary: Establishes the commission on public safety, emergency preparedness, and mental health.

short_summary: Authorizes matching funding for savings achieved for actions between local governments that are later included as part of an approved county-wide shared services plan
summary: Authorizes matching funding for savings achieved for actions between local governments that are later included as part of an approved county-wide shared services plan.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a community doula expansion grant program
summary: Creates a community doula expansion grant program to support community-based doulas and community-based doula organizations; provides funding for recruitment, training, licensing, supporting, and/or mentoring of community-based doulas.

short_summary: Enacts the mental health assessment and record keeping for the coroner's office act
summary: Enacts the mental health assessment and record keeping for the coroner's office act; requires the coroner or coroner and coroner's physician, or the medical examiner, to conduct a mental health assessment when a death occurs in such person's jurisdiction.

short_summary: Relates to the disclosure of political communication produced by artificial intelligence technology
summary: Requires the disclosure of political communication produced by artificial intelligence technology; defines terms; provides that any person who, with intent to damage a candidate or deceive the electorate, creates and disseminates artificial media shall be guilty of a class E felony; establishes the fair use of artificial intelligence code; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on independent neighborhoods and homes in cities constructing micro-grids
summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on independent neighborhoods and homes in cities constructing micro-grids to study the feasibility, efficiency, and energy saving costs if such micro-grids were constructed.

short_summary: Provides a period of probable usefulness for solar arrays and panels
summary: Provides a period of probable usefulness for the acquisition, construction or reconstruction of or addition to a solar array or solar panel system, whether or not including buildings, land or rights in land, original furnishings, equipment, machinery or apparatus, or the replacement of such equipment, machinery or apparatus.

short_summary: Relates to increasing fines for repeated parking violations
summary: Increases fines for more than ten repeated parking violations within a twenty-four month period.

short_summary: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
summary: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the Town and Village of Mount Kisco, County of Westchester.

short_summary: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the chairman of the state liquor authority of certain violations of the labor law
summary: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the chairman of the state liquor authority of certain violations of the labor law relating to wages and hours of labor; provides that the chairman of the state liquor authority shall suspend certain liquor licenses of such employers in violation of such provisions.

short_summary: Relates to complex care assistants and home care services and supplementing
summary: Requires the state Medicaid director to establish a program for specific individuals to become complex care assistants and provide private duty nursing services to certain Medicaid enrollees under increased reimbursement rates.

short_summary: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces
summary: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces; requires a report.

short_summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay; imposes a five-year moratorium on placing sediment or fill in the borrow pits in Jamaica Bay.

short_summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a pilot program to install a microgrid in Glenwood Houses
summary: Directs the New York state energy and research development authority to establish a pilot program to install a microgrid in Glenwood Houses; requires the authority to annually report on the results of such program and any recommendations for expansion.

short_summary: Relates to funding for highway construction and improvements
summary: Relates to funding for highway construction and improvements in New York state from funds appropriated to the MTA; appropriates funds therefor.

short_summary: Establishes a social worker pilot program
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of mental health to establish up to three, three-year pilot programs in community behavioral health organizations for the purposes of creating social worker pilot programs to support the ongoing retention and recruitment of licensed clinical social workers.

short_summary: Enacts the "consumer protection and automotive transparency act"
summary: Enacts the consumer protection and automotive transparency act mandating transparency in automotive labeling relating to materials used in automobiles.

short_summary: Requires vehicles operated by public transit authorities to contain opioid antagonists
summary: Requires vehicles operated by public transit authorities to contain opioid antagonists and for public transit authorities to train employees on the proper use of opioid antagonists.

short_summary: Permits clinicians to be dually licensed under the office of mental health and the office of addiction services and supports
summary: Permits clinicians to be dually licensed under the office of mental health and the office of addiction services and supports.

short_summary: Establishes the native plant seed supply, development and enhancement program
summary: Establishes the native plant seed supply, development and enhancement program.

short_summary: Increases the handling fee paid to dealers or operators of a redemption center
summary: Increases the handling fee paid to dealers or operators of a redemption center for the redemption of empty beverage containers.

short_summary: Relates to creating a feebate program for medium and heavy duty vehicles
summary: Directs the levy of an efficiency fee or an efficiency rebate based on the MPG or MPGe rating of medium and heavy duty vehicles.

short_summary: Replaces the word addict or addicts and the word addiction with the words persons with substance use disorder or a variation thereof
summary: Replaces certain appearances of the words addict, addicts and addiction with the words person with a substance use disorder, person with a mental health disorder, person with co-occurring disorder, person in recovery, or a variation thereof.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation of cannabinoid hemp products
summary: Provides that a retailer licensed by the office of cannabis management shall be permitted to sell any and all forms of cannabinoid hemp.

short_summary: Relates to leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter or bicycle with an electric assist system without reporting in the first and second degrees
summary: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the second degree and leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first degree; provides increased penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a wheeled non-motorized means of conveyance without reporting in the first and second degrees when the vehicle involved is a bicycle with an electric assist system.

short_summary: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a church
summary: Provides for an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a church.

short_summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

short_summary: Directs the chief administrative judge of the New York unified court system to conduct a study on the office of court administration's housing court guardian ad litem program
summary: Directs the chief administrative judge of the New York unified court system to conduct a study on the office of court administration's housing court guardian ad litem program and to publish a report on such study.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Wawayanda in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax
summary: Authorizes the town of Wawayanda in Orange county to impose a five percent hotel and motel tax.

short_summary: Permits the village of Greenwood Lake to impose a hotel and motel tax
summary: Permits the village of Greenwood Lake to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Enacts the Respect Electoral Audiovisual Legitimacy (REAL) Act
summary: Prohibits political communication containing any photo, video or audio depiction of a candidate created in whole or in part through the use of generative artificial intelligence.

short_summary: Relates to prescription drug formulary coverage for interchangeable biologics and biosimilars
summary: Relates to prescription drug formulary coverage for interchangeable biologics and biosimilars.

short_summary: Relates to imposing certain restrictions on catalytic converters
summary: Imposes certain restrictions on catalytic converters; requires all vehicle catalytic converters to be indelibly marked or engraved with a readily observable unique serial number; provides a reduction in premium charges for certain motor vehicle liability, comprehensive and collision insurance rates with respect to automobiles equipped with a catalytic converter which contains such unique marking or engraving.

short_summary: Mandates acceptance of the New York city identity card as a primary form of identification at all banking organizations
summary: Enacts the pro-banking act to mandate acceptance of the New York city identity card as a primary form of identification at all covered entities, including all banking organizations, foreign banking corporations, and interstate branches.

short_summary: Makes graffiti eligible to be charged as a hate crime
summary: Includes making graffiti within the list of offenses eligible to be charged as a hate crime.

short_summary: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
summary: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the commission's recommendation.

short_summary: Allows cooperative agreements by licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises
summary: Allows certain licensees to form cooperative agreements to make joint purchases of alcoholic beverages provided that such agreement and activity conform to certain standards.

short_summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the care demonstration program
summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the care demonstration program from March 31, 2024 until March 31, 2026.

short_summary: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
summary: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

short_summary: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act"
summary: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act" which provides for the certification of an employer to become a recovery ready workplace; defines terms; establishes the recovery-ready workplace program; provides criteria for employers to obtain certification as a recovery ready workplace; provides for employee involvement.

short_summary: Creates substance use prevention and recovery resource materials for schools
summary: Creates substance use prevention and recovery resource materials which include age-appropriate information on the risks of drug use, overdoses, and how to include resources from outside of the school district to improve instruction.

short_summary: Requires a certain percentage of affordable housing funded by the state be used for veterans and people with disabilities
summary: Requires affordable housing funded by the state be used for veterans and people with disabilities, with each group receiving five percent of such affordable housing.

short_summary: Provides for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie
summary: Extends provisions providing for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie.

short_summary: Creates a transportation subsidy to increase access to water safety instruction
summary: Creates a transportation subsidy to increase access to water safety instruction.

short_summary: Limits the sale of chemical hair relaxers and permanent hairstyle kits
summary: Limits the sale of chemical hair relaxers and permanent hairstyle kits to licensed cosmetologists.

short_summary: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act"
summary: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act" (FRESH Communities); provides loans, loan guarantees, interest subsidies and grants to businesses, municipalities, not-for-profit corporations or local development corporations for the purpose of attracting, maintaining or permitting the expansion of food retail establishments in underserved areas.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing certain sales of private label wine
summary: Authorizes certain restaurants to sell sealed bottles of private label wine for off-premises consumption with the purchase of a substantial food item.

short_summary: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol; repealer
summary: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol.

short_summary: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit
summary: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit for all New York state manufactured liquor, spirits, wine, beer, cider and mead for events located in a municipality with a population of less than one million.

short_summary: Relates to studying the adequacy of applied behavioral analysis provider networks
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to make publicly available on the department of health website a report concerning access to applied behavior analysis for enrolled children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder.

short_summary: Relates to ovarian cancer research
summary: Relates to ovarian cancer research; includes funding for ovarian cancer research and education programs.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening for ovarian and prostate cancers
summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening and FDA approved biomarker testing for ovarian and prostate cancers.

short_summary: Expands state aid eligibility for library construction; repealer
summary: Expands state aid eligibility for library construction for public libraries that are located in economically disadvantaged communities.

short_summary: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for child care providers
summary: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for child care providers that have earned an undergraduate or graduate degree from a two or four year college or university in the state.

short_summary: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers
summary: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers on licensed retailers.

short_summary: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law
summary: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law relating to wages and hours of labor; provides that the commissioner of taxation and finance shall suspend certain certificates of authority of such employers in violation of such provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the thoroughbred breeding and development fund
summary: Extends the provisions relating to the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund until fourteen years after the commencement of the operation of a video lottery terminal facility at Aqueduct racetrack.

short_summary: Adds employee-owned enterprises to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state
summary: Adds employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state; authorizes such enterprises and cooperatives to make certain purchases from centralized contracts for commodities, subject to conditions of the office of general services; authorizes the comptroller to conduct certain audits of employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives.

short_summary: Authorizes one percent of mobile sports tax revenue be used for problem gambling
summary: Authorizes one percent of mobile sports tax revenue, but not less than six million dollars, to be used for problem gambling.

short_summary: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and shared use locker technologies
summary: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and facilities that combine multiple deliveries from different suppliers to a central location to be delivered inside the service area, and shared use locker technologies as final delivery locations.

short_summary: Allows beneficiaries of certain deceased members to elect to receive death benefits in a lump sum
summary: Allows a beneficiary of a member whose death occurs on or after July 1, 2024 and who would have been entitled to a service credit at the time of such member's death to elect to receive a lump sum payment equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death.

short_summary: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot
summary: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a referenced rate for prescription drug
summary: Relates to reducing the cost of prescription drugs by establishing maximum wholesale drug prices that are the same as the prices in Canada.

short_summary: Provides for the licensure of dietitian nutritionists and nutritionists; repealer
summary: Provides for the licensure of dietitian nutritionists and nutritionists; defines the practice thereof.

short_summary: Establishes the New York State Social Housing Development Authority
summary: Establishes the New York State social housing development authority as a public benefit corporation to increase the supply of permanently affordable housing in the state through the acquisition of land and renovation or rehabilitation of existing real property, and through the construction of new, permanently affordable housing.

short_summary: Relates to dental laboratories
summary: Relates to dental laboratories; defines terms; requires any dental laboratory operating, doing business, or intending to operate or do business in this state to register with the department of education; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing certain free permits, stamps and privileges for qualified hunting instructors
summary: Authorizes a free bowhunting privilege, muzzle-loading privilege, turkey permit, duck stamp, and doe permit for qualified hunting instructors.

short_summary: Authorizes the Iroquois central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
summary: Authorizes the Iroquois central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund.

short_summary: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered with the department of motor vehicles
summary: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered with the department of motor vehicles and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

short_summary: Increases the minimum wage outside of New York city and the counties of Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester Westchester; repealer
summary: Increases the minimum wage outside of New York city and the counties of Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester; repeals certain provisions of law relating to exceptions to minimum wage increases.

short_summary: Provides for the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor or governor
summary: Provides for the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor by appointment of the governor subject to confirmation by majority vote in the senate and majority vote in the assembly; provides for an extended order of succession for the filling of a vacancy in the office of the governor.

short_summary: Establishes term limits for the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller, and attorney-general
summary: Establishes term limits for the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller, and attorney-general of three terms in such office.

short_summary: Requires the establishment of a legislative child care facility for use by members and staff of the legislature
summary: Requires the establishment of a legislative child care facility for use of members and staff of the legislature to be located in a part of the empire state plaza complex that has legislative offices and to be contracted by a private child care provider; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Renames the state board of parole
summary: Renames the state board of parole the state board of re-entry; makes conforming changes.

short_summary: Relates to contests, competitions, tournaments and derbies to take wildlife; repealer
summary: Removes the ban on contests, competitions, tournaments and derbies to take wildlife.

short_summary: Establishes a captive insurance program for commuter vans, black cars, ambulettes and paratransit vehicles, and small school buses pre-arranged for-hire vehicles, and accessible vehicles
summary: Establishes a captive insurance program for commuter vans, black cars, ambulettes and paratransit vehicles, small school buses, and charter buses that are engaged in the business of carrying or transporting eight to twenty-four passengers for hire; pre-arranged for-hire vehicles and accessible vehicles; defines terms.

short_summary: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid stewardship fund
summary: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid stewardship fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

short_summary: Increases the required number of instructional days in a school year to two hundred
summary: Increases the required number of instructional days in a school year to two hundred.

short_summary: Relates to medicaid reimbursement for treatment in place and transportation to alternative health care settings by ambulance services
summary: Provides for medicaid reimbursement for ambulance services when treatment in place is administered and/or when transportation is provided to alternative health care settings instead of a general hospital.

short_summary: Relates to political communication utilizing artificial intelligence
summary: Requires any political communication, whether made by phone call, email or other message-based communication, that utilizes an artificial intelligence system to engage in human-like conversation with another shall, by reasonable means, apprise the person of the fact that they are communicating with an artificial intelligence system.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated grand larceny
summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated grand larceny as grand larceny in the fourth degree involving a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to advancing grid enhancement technologies
summary: Relates to advancing grid enhancement technologies; allows the department of public service to approve requests from distribution companies to develop grid enhancement technologies; requires distribution companies to submit a compliance filing report every 5 years.

short_summary: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders; establishes procedure for the issuance of such orders; establishes penalties for failure to comply with such orders.

short_summary: Establishes a brand owner's license
summary: Allows a person with a federal basic permit to apply to the liquor authority for a brand owner's license; establishes a fee therefor.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
summary: Establishes the crime of harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; makes such crime a class B misdemeanor.

short_summary: Relates to internet dating service verification standards
summary: Requires internet dating services to utilize license verification for New York members and implement reasonable security features that prohibits usage of the online dating service absent identity verification.

short_summary: Prohibits the storage of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale
summary: Prohibits the keeping of inventory, storage, warehouse, processing, packaging, shipping or distributing of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale.

short_summary: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch
summary: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch; provides such application fee shall be waived.

short_summary: Permits certain retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from certain other retail licensees
summary: Permits on-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from off-premises retail licensees and off-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from on-premises retail licensees.

short_summary: Allows for certain participants in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations to be eligible for disability benefits
summary: Allows for participants in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations who were not members of a New York state retirement system at the time of such participation but who are now currently active members in such retirement systems to be eligible for disability benefits.

short_summary: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered, inspected and insured
summary: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered with the department of motor vehicles, inspected and have liability insurance; and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

short_summary: Provides for money upon release for certain incarcerated individuals; appropriation
summary: Provides for eligible incarcerated individuals to receive a monthly stipend upon release from a state correctional facility.

short_summary: Authorizes the election of qualified transportation fringe benefits
summary: Authorizes the election of qualified transportation fringe benefits; authorizes any employer to offer employees the opportunity to use pre-tax earnings for the purchase of qualified transportation fringe benefits.

short_summary: Facilitates appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern
summary: Relates to facilitating appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern.

short_summary: Authorizes the granting of an additional real property tax exemption for certain redevelopment company projects within the county of Nassau
summary: Authorizes the granting of an additional real property tax exemption for certain redevelopment company projects within the county of Nassau.

short_summary: Establishes the mandatory reporting of child abuse and maltreatment task force
summary: Establishes the mandatory reporting of child abuse and maltreatment task force to examine, evaluate, and make recommendations concerning the child welfare system and the mandatory reporting of child abuse and maltreatment; requires the task force to submit a report to the legislature; sets forth the duties of the members of the task force.

short_summary: Requires educational institutions with an endowment of 10 billion dollars or more to provide a certain percentage of affordable housing units
summary: Requires educational institutions with an endowment of 10 billion dollars or more to incorporate thirty percent affordable housing units in any property owned by such institution that provides any form of housing.

short_summary: Establishes the water resiliency projects fund; appropriation
summary: Establishes the water resiliency projects fund for flood mitigation, stormwater mitigation and other water related resiliency projects; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Requires accurate interpretation of statements made by deponents with limited English proficiency in accusatory instruments and supporting depositions
summary: Provides that an accusatory instrument or supporting deposition consisting of factual allegations by a deponent with limited English proficiency is not sufficient unless accompanied by a sworn statement from an interpreter affirming the accuracy of the English interpretation.

short_summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to develop recommendations regarding the establishment of microgrids
summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to develop recommendations regarding the establishment of microgrids.

short_summary: Relates to the reinstatement of state recognition and acknowledgement of the Montaukett Indian Nation
summary: Provides for the reinstatement of state recognition and acknowledgement of the Montaukett Indian Nation; provides that the Montaukett Indian nation shall have a chief or sachem, three tribal trustees and a tribal secretary; provides for the qualification of voters; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for the incorporation of the Bedford Hills Fire Department Benevolent Association
summary: Provides for the incorporation of the Bedford Hills Fire Department Benevolent Association and for its powers and duties.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of a non-traditional hours model
summary: Relates to the establishment of a non-traditional hours model; provides that the office of children and family services shall: create a non-traditional hours model within a year, publish its findings on its website, and conduct a review of child care providers and centers that use such model.

short_summary: Relates to rental assistance for New York city charter school students; metered in funding
summary: Relates to metered in funding for rental assistance for all New York city charter students.

short_summary: Relates to grants for facilities providing prekindergarten services
summary: Relates to grants for facilities providing prekindergarten services; promotes the financial viability of such facilities.

short_summary: Prohibits the imposition of limits on the length of stay at homeless shelters and emergency congregate housing
summary: Prohibits the imposition of limits on the length of stay at homeless shelters and emergency congregate housing operated by state agencies.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara
summary: Authorizes hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara except within the city of Niagara Falls, the city of Lockport and the city of North Tonawanda.

short_summary: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers that have taken the Neurodiversity Training Pledge
summary: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers entitled the Neurodiversity Training Pledge.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of tennis facilities
summary: Defines the term "tennis facilities" to mean places that provide programming and services related to tennis and other sports which require the use of racquets or paddles to strike balls or objects in relation to authorization for the town of Greenburgh to lease certain park lands for tennis uses.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of the final average salary for purposes of the calculation of a pension benefit
summary: Relates to the calculation of the final average salary for purposes of the calculation of a pension benefit.

short_summary: Requires food distributors that accept SNAP benefits to establish a mechanism to apply coupons to purchases made by eligible recipients of SNAP benefits
summary: Requires food distributors that accept SNAP benefits to establish a mechanism to apply available coupons or discounts to purchases made by eligible recipients of SNAP benefits without such recipient being required to provide a physical coupon.

short_summary: Requires members of a public body to complete a minimum level of training on the state's open meetings law and freedom of information law
summary: Requires members of a public body to complete a minimum of two hours of training on the state's open meetings law and freedom of information law; requires certain local, city, county, town and village public body members to complete such training as well.

short_summary: Extends the enforcement of the collection of delinquent real property taxes and the collection of taxes by banks and enforces the collection of taxes in certain villages
summary: Extends the enforcement of the collection of delinquent real property taxes and the collection of taxes by banks; enforces the collection of taxes in certain villages.

short_summary: Extends the authority of the city of New Rochelle to impose an occupancy tax
summary: Extends the authority of the city of New Rochelle to impose an occupancy tax until September 1, 2027.

short_summary: Extends the city of Rye's occupancy tax
summary: Extends the city of Rye's occupancy tax to September 1, 2027.

short_summary: Relates to taxpayer publicly funded research
summary: Enacts the "taxpayer access to publicly funded research act"; defines terms; requires each agency that provides funding for direct research shall develop a public access policy.

short_summary: Establishes fetal and infant mortality review boards
summary: Establishes fetal and infant mortality review boards to study fetal and infant mortality and morbidity and make recommendations on policies, best practices, and strategies to reduce fetal and infant mortality and morbidity.

short_summary: Authorizes the Church of the Living God Pillar & Ground to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes the Church of the Living God Pillar & Ground to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for the 2022-2023 assessment rolls.

short_summary: Allows an impeachment proceeding to proceed after the resignation of a person from public office and prohibits such person from holding a future public office
summary: Allows an impeachment proceeding to proceed after the resignation of a person from public office; prohibits such person from holding a future public office.

short_summary: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive
summary: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive provided such member is a state-paid judge or justice of the unified court system or a housing judge of the civil court of the city of New York.

short_summary: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers
summary: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers who sell at retail for on-premises consumption in the town of East Hampton, county of Suffolk.

short_summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor
summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor.

short_summary: Requires recommendation of blood lead level screenings when a health care provider finds high lead levels in blood of a child
summary: Requires the recommendation to a parent for blood lead level screenings of his or her child when a health care provider finds high lead levels in the blood of such child; directs the department of health to conduct an environmental investigation when a child is found to have high levels of lead in his or her blood.

short_summary: Relates to requiring qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services
summary: Relates to requiring qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services.

short_summary: Provides for consumer protection and utility meter choice
summary: Establishes certain consumer rights for the protection of consumer health, safety and/or privacy needs related to utility meters.

short_summary: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence for utilization review
summary: Provides for notice requirements where an insurer authorized to write accident and health insurance in this state, a corporation organized pursuant to article forty-three of this chapter, or a health maintenance organization certified pursuant to article forty-four of the public health law uses artificial intelligence-based algorithms in the utilization review process.

short_summary: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund
summary: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund by utilizing a tax surcharge to pay for providing senior services to individuals who have been waitlisted to receive such senior services.

short_summary: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language
summary: Relates to requiring certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language and requiring parties to demonstrate their understanding of the nature and effect of such documents.

short_summary: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities
summary: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities including the benefits and limitations of non-invasive prenatal testing, the difference between non-invasive prenatal testing and prenatal diagnostic testing, and current recommendations from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine, and the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG).

short_summary: Relates to providing for prompt payment by contractors receiving public funds of amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises
summary: Requires contractors receiving public funds to pay amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises within seven days of receipt of payment from state agencies.

short_summary: Relates to eligibility of the Mattituck-Laurel library for financing of projects through the dormitory authority
summary: Includes Mattituck-Laurel library within libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

short_summary: Relates to including red cross vehicles as authorized emergency vehicles
summary: Adds red cross vehicles to the definition of authorized emergency vehicles.

short_summary: Prohibits any governmental entity from outsourcing any function which can be performed by such entity
summary: Prohibits any governmental entity from outsourcing any function which can be performed by such entity except where specifically authorized by law.

short_summary: Relates to requiring landlords of certain properties to furnish New York homes and community renewal with data pertaining to succession rights
summary: Relates to requiring landlords of certain properties to furnish New York homes and community renewal with data pertaining to succession rights.

short_summary: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program
summary: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program to eliminate older mobile and manufactured homes and replace them with new manufactured, modular or site-built homes; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Extends the provisions of chapter 3 of the laws of 2020 relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force
summary: Extends provisions relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force; authorizes the stretch limousine passenger safety task force to continue to hold public hearings and meetings to review the actions taken by the state and to publish a report of its findings.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program
summary: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program; enables municipalities to repair immediately hazardous code violations in buildings where the owner has not undertaken such repairs in a reasonable time.

short_summary: Grants campus peace officers employed by the city university of New York police powers; repealer
summary: Grants campus peace officers employed by the city university of New York police powers on its campuses and other property of the city university, including any portion of a public highway which crosses or abuts such property.

short_summary: Relates to the removal of an election commissioner
summary: Relates to the removal of an election commissioner by the governor or by affirmative vote of a majority of commissioners of the state board of elections for incompetence, misconduct, or other good cause, provided that prior to removal, such election commissioner shall be given a written copy of the charges against them and have an opportunity to be heard in their defense.

short_summary: Establishes "Fred Korematsu Day of Civil Liberties and the Constitution"
summary: Establishes January 30th of each year as a day of commemoration known as "Fred Korematsu Day of Civil Liberties and the Constitution".

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings.

short_summary: Requires quarterly inspections of homeless shelters
summary: Directs the office of temporary and disability assistance to promulgate rules and regulations requiring quarterly inspections of homeless shelters.

short_summary: Extends the time for New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to authorizing New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments of the supreme and family courts of the city of New York; requires New York city marshals to post and electronically file notices of eviction.

short_summary: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; repealer
summary: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency (ICE) when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; adjusts certain maximum sentences for class A misdemeanors and unclassified misdemeanors; requires notification to be made to the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency prior to the release of certain noncitizens; repeals provisions of the "protect our courts act".

short_summary: Establishes a fetal and infant mortality review board
summary: Establishes a fetal and infant mortality review board to study fetal and infant mortality and morbidity and make recommendations on policies, best practices, and strategies to reduce fetal and infant mortality and morbidity within New York city.

short_summary: Relates to establishing an annual heat mitigation plan; and directing the extreme heat action plan work group to analyze the impact of extreme heat on incarcerated individuals and people working in prisons
summary: Directs the commission of corrections and community supervision to establish an annual heat mitigation plan; directs the extreme heat action plan work group of the department of environmental conservation to analyze the impact of extreme heat on incarcerated individuals and people working in prisons.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the green affordable pre-electrification program
summary: Establishes the green affordable pre-electrification program to assist owners and tenants in residential properties in curing structural and building code defects which render the properties ineligible for climate change adaptation and resiliency project grants.

short_summary: Authorizes a study by the department of corrections and community supervision pertaining to the treatment of aging prison populations
summary: Authorizes a study by the department of corrections and community supervision pertaining to the treatment of aging prison populations.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the use of project labor agreements for large scale construction projects under the state university construction fund
summary: Relates to requiring the use of project labor agreements for large scale construction projects under the state university construction fund; provides an exception to such requirement may be granted; provides that the fund may require every contractor become party to a project labor agreement.

short_summary: Requires certain distribution centers to be equipped with electric vehicle charging stations
summary: Requires distribution centers which are 50,000 sq. ft. or more to be equipped with electric vehicle charging stations as determined by the secretary of state and NYSERDA.

short_summary: Requires investor-owned energy utilities to collect and publish data on disadvantaged communities in certain service areas
summary: Enacts the "disadvantaged communities commitment act"; requires investor-owned energy utilities to collect and publish data on disadvantaged communities in certain service areas and file such statistics with the public service commission.

short_summary: Relates to issuing stop work orders for misclassification of employees
summary: Empowers the commissioner of labor to issue stop work orders against employers for misclassification of employees as independent contractors or for providing false, incomplete, or misleading information to an insurance company on the number of employees of such employer.

short_summary: Relates to creating an advisory board to New York's Office of the Chief Disability Officer
summary: Creates an advisory board to New York's office of the chief disability officer to review the office of the chief disability officer's operations and make recommendations relating to the office of the chief disability officer's policies and procedures.

short_summary: Requires the department of civil service to establish an accessible list of persons with disabilities and veterans with disabilities employed by the state
summary: Requires the department of civil service to establish an accessible list of persons with disabilities and veterans with disabilities employed by the state; and to make persons with disabilities and veterans with disabilities employed by the state eligible for the HELP program.

short_summary: Establishes a deferred compensation health insurance premium deduction
summary: Establishes a tax deduction for a taxpayer who is a beneficiary of a deferred compensation plan and who elects to make a distribution of such deferred compensation in order to pay for qualified health insurance premiums, in an amount equal to six thousand dollars.

short_summary: Directs the cannabis control board not to issue any license for dispensaries of cannabis until the cannabis control board reviews and closes businesses which are selling cannabis without a license
summary: Directs the cannabis control board not to issue any license, permit or registration for retail dispensaries of cannabis until the cannabis control board reviews and closes businesses which are selling cannabis without a proper license or permit.

short_summary: Enacts the  New York AI Child Safety Act
summary: Enacts the "New York AI Child Safety Act" relating to the unlawful promotion or possession of a sexual performance of a child created by digitization; defines terms; increases penalties from a class D or E felony to a class C felony.

short_summary: Relates to the removal of unlawful publications of intimate images on social media platforms
summary: Enacts the "Swift Act"; defines terms; requires social media platforms to promptly remove unlawful publications of intimate images within twenty-four hours of the submission of the report; provides for attorney general enforcement; makes unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image a class E felony.

short_summary: Relates to the compensation of certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases
summary: Provides for a hazardous pay differential for certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases.

short_summary: Authorizes school districts to submit an opt-out waiver to the commissioner of education authorizing such districts to opt-out of certain zero-emission school bus requirements
summary: Authorizes school districts to submit an opt-out waiver to the commissioner of education authorizing such districts to opt-out of certain zero-emission school bus requirements.

short_summary: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of N.Y. city
summary: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of a city with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets
summary: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets under the exclusive control and jurisdiction of such village.

short_summary: Provides for the return of any identification materials to an individual upon release from custody
summary: Provides for the return of any identification materials to an individual upon release from custody.

short_summary: Relates to motorcycle profiling
summary: Requires the municipal police training council to ensure that issues related to motorcycle profiling are addressed in basic law enforcement training.

short_summary: Adds tianeptine sodium to the list of Schedule II of controlled substances
summary: Adds tianeptine sodium to list of Schedule II of controlled substances.

short_summary: Relates to the imposition of securing orders for certain crimes committed by individuals without permanent residency status
summary: Relates to the imposition of securing orders for offenses committed on a peace officer, police officer, firefighter, emergency medical services professional or uniformed worker by individuals without permanent residency status; provides such individuals shall be remanded to the custody of the sheriff for the entirety of the judicial proceedings related thereto.

short_summary: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates and establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund"
summary: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates; establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund" to fund POW-MIA public education and awareness campaigns and veteran services by Rolling Thunder New York chapters and upon approval by the state director of veterans' services.

short_summary: Prohibits the removal of children into child protective custody based solely on conditions of poverty
summary: Provides that, conditions of poverty, including but not limited to, the inability to provide or obtain clothing, home or property repair, or childcare, shall not be the sole determining factor when providing notification to the appropriate police authorities or the local child protective service unless there is willful or negligent action or failure to act and a nexus to harm such that the child has suffered or there is a substantial risk the child will suffer serious physical, mental, or emotional impairment.

short_summary: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"
summary: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"; requires clear and conspicuous pricing practices regarding trash junk fees.

short_summary: Relates to verification of voter qualifications
summary: Requires the state board of elections to participate in the systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program, administered by the United States citizenship and immigration services agency, to verify that a person who is either registered or registering to vote is a United States citizen.

short_summary: Relates to pricing changes for online grocery delivery services
summary: Requires the clear and conspicuous disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery services; imposes a fine of not more than one hundred dollars for the first offense and not more than two hundred fifty dollars for a second or subsequent offense for violations.

short_summary: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones, and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application
summary: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application and have the option posted in a clear and conspicuous format.

short_summary: Relates to the reinstatement of certain officers and employees of the city of New York who were dismissed from employment due to a COVID-19 vaccine requirement
summary: Requires the reinstatement of certain officers and employees of the city of New York who were dismissed from employment due to a COVID-19 vaccine requirement including retirees, vested members and members terminated without a one-year limit on return.

short_summary: Relates to transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district
summary: Legalizes, validates, ratifies and confirms certain transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district.

short_summary: Relates to interactive gaming
summary: Authorizes interactive gaming and interactive lottery gaming in the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state
summary: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state.

short_summary: Establishes the SUNY downstate medical support fund
summary: Establishes the SUNY downstate medical support fund to provide financial support for infrastructural upgrades and expansion; facilitates research and development grants in medical and health-related fields; offers scholarships and financial aid; supports community health initiatives and outreach programs.

short_summary: Provides mental telehealth services to children, adolescents, and young adults
summary: Provides mental telehealth services to children, adolescents, and young adults.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of a waiver for child care learning pods
summary: Relates to the establishment of a waiver for child care learning pods; provides that unlicensed and unregulated child care learning pods may operate if there are otherwise no violations of laws or codes, rules, and regulations of New York and such child care learning pod is compliant with the local laws, codes, rules, and regulations of such local municipality in which they are located and operated; provides for civil penalty for violations.

short_summary: Conforms the New York state college choice tuition savings program to the federal qualified tuition program
summary: Conforms the New York state college choice tuition savings program to the federal qualified tuition program so as to include savings for grades kindergarten through 12.

short_summary: Relates to certain requirements for waivers issued under the hospital-home care-physician collaboration program
summary: Provides that health regulations may not be waived under the hospital-home care-physician collaboration program without publication and opportunity for public comment; prohibits waiver of an applicant's obligation to meet public need, character and competence, or financial feasibility requirements.

short_summary: Expands eligibility under the veterans tuition awards program
summary: Expands eligibility under the veterans tuition awards program to all New York resident veterans, regardless of combat service.

short_summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

short_summary: Prohibits smoking or vaping tobacco or marijuana in individual units in all multi-unit housing facilities
summary: Prohibits smoking or vaping tobacco or marijuana in individual units in all multi-unit housing facilities.

short_summary: Relates to assault on certain employees assigned to an airport, while in performance of their assigned duties, or in direct relation thereto
summary: Deems assault on certain employees assigned to an airport, while in performance of their assigned duties, or in direct relation thereto, to be assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization
summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization; extends such provisions to 2025.

short_summary: Establishes standards for the closure of banking accounts in the state of New York
summary: Establishes standards for the closure of bank accounts in the state of New York to include providing notice of closure and the return of funds to account owners.

short_summary: Relates to requests for employee personnel records
summary: Requires agencies and public employers to provide notice and a review period to employees whose personnel records have been provided pursuant to the state's freedom of information law.

short_summary: Relates to protecting MTA workers from harassment
summary: Expands the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree to include harassing any MTA worker while performing their job duties.

short_summary: Relates to financial liability for major facilities, vessels, and railroads
summary: Requires the owner or operator of a vessel to establish and maintain with the department evidence of financial responsibility sufficient to meet the amount of liability.

short_summary: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses
summary: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses; requires the use of a special mark to indicate service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.

short_summary: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care
summary: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care by creating a special proceeding in the supreme court that will hold owners and caretakers liable if such animals under their care are mistreated.

short_summary: Relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages on licensees who sell at retail for on-premises consumption; repealer
summary: Relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages on licensees who sell at retail for on-premises consumption; provides an exemption for 10 Cipriani restaurants; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

short_summary: Provides for the application of the veterans' real property tax exemptions in the city of New York
summary: Provides for the application of veterans' real property tax exemptions in cities having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Permits the Clarence central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
summary: Permits the Clarence central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund.

short_summary: Relates to the contents of a notice of liability issued for a speed camera violation
summary: Permits a violation captured by a speed camera to be dismissed upon the application of the person alleged to be liable for such violation if any information that is required to be inserted in the notice of liability is omitted from such notice of liability, misdescribed or illegible.

short_summary: Requires the office of children and family services implement a regional cost factor analysis for child care subsidies
summary: Requires the office of children and family services implement a regional cost factor analysis for child care subsidies; requires social service districts implement such findings.

short_summary: Reclassifies court officers and court clerks of the unified court system under the definition of police officer; repealer
summary: Reclassifies court officers and court clerks of the unified court system under the definition of police officer.

short_summary: Establishes the kinship legal network program in the office of children and family services
summary: Establishes the kinship legal network program in the office of children and family services to provide legal services to kinship caregivers.

short_summary: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five
summary: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five; adds as members the commissioner of agriculture and markets and a member appointed by the Dean of the Cornell University's College of Agriculture and Life Services.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school
summary: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a public transportation expansion fund
summary: Establishes a public transportation expansion fund for the purpose of ensuring access to public transportation for publicly funded economic development projects.

short_summary: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19
summary: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19 for children, incapacitated persons, or students or staff of employment institutions or day care facilities; prohibits requiring people to carry or present evidence of having received the COVID-19 vaccine.

short_summary: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens
summary: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens as the use of agricultural activities as a means of promoting physical, mental and emotional well-being, rehabilitation and therapy for certain individuals.

short_summary: Requires each town, village, and city to develop a "housing action plan for everyone"
summary: Requires each town, village, and city to develop a "housing action plan for everyone", including consideration of local needs and specific strategies to address those local needs.

short_summary: Relates to the residence of a certain non-voting member of the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Allows the alternate non-voting member of the metropolitan transportation authority who is recommended by the labor organization representing the majority of employees of the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company to be a resident of any state in which the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company operates.

short_summary: Establishes multiple-person accounts; repealer
summary: Provides for multiple-person accounts; requires a signature card; provides that absent indication to the contrary, funds remaining in such an account upon the death of the depositor shall be deemed part of the depositor's estate.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions relating to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board
summary: Relates to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board.

short_summary: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought
summary: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought.

short_summary: Relates to including the illegal conversions of dwelling units in the definition of harassment
summary: Relates to including the illegal conversions of dwelling units in the definition of harassment.

short_summary: Relates to professional employer organization services
summary: Provides that receipts from other services and other business receipts, taxpayers, and combined groups including members, engaged in providing professional employer organization services shall include with such receipts amounts received with respect to wages, benefits, and other employee expenses disbursed to or for the benefit of a client's worksite employees and the related employment taxes if the amounts received are included in the calculation of the business income base or the combined business income base, respectively.

short_summary: Relates to certificates of qualification for clinical laboratories and blood banks and work standards for cytotechnologists
