summary: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration registry; designates frontotemporal degeneration and related dementias as diseases required to be reported in the state; establishes a frontotemporal degeneration registry advisory committee to assist in the development and implementation of the registry; allows a patient to opt out of participation in the registry; requires annual reports to the legislature and governor on the incidents and prevalence of frontotemporal degeneration in the state by county; requires the department of health to create and maintain a webpage.

short_summary: Relates to the offering of installment payment plans for tax delinquent property in the city of Mount Vernon
summary: Relates to the offering of installment payment plans for tax delinquent property in the city of Mount Vernon, subject to a first payment equal to at least ten percent of delinquent taxes, assessments or other legal charges, and subject to specific periods of duration.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment of fire chiefs and assistant chiefs
summary: Permits the appointment of fire chiefs and assistant chiefs who are employees of a fire district.

short_summary: Requires certain health insurance policies to provide coverage for diabetes screening for people of Asian American or Pacific Islander descent if they have a body mass index of 23 or greater
summary: Requires certain health insurance policies to provide coverage for diabetes screening for people of Asian American or Pacific Islander descent if they have a body mass index of 23 or greater.

short_summary: Updates the definition of the term reusable bag
summary: Updates the definition of the term "reusable bag", as used in the environmental conservation law, to specify minimum material and durability standards.

short_summary: Relates to the Peconic Bay region community preservation funds; repealer
summary: Relates to the Peconic Bay region community preservation funds; defines "disadvantaged communities"; provides that funds utilized for water quality improvement projects may be carried forward from year to year for utilization in future budgets and not less than ten percent of the annual proceeds of the fund shall be utilized to benefit disadvantaged communities; provides that management and stewardship funds may only be expended for projects related to lands acquired for open space preservation and historic preservation purposes; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008
summary: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008.

short_summary: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem
summary: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client, in writing, that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem.

short_summary: Provides for the refund of penalties accrued on certain real property taxes in the town of Scarsdale, county of Westchester
summary: Provides for the refund of penalties accrued on 2023-2024 real property taxes due to the specific failure by the USPS to deliver bills to owners in the town of Scarsdale, county of Westchester.

short_summary: Requires certain motion picture theaters to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning
summary: Requires a motion picture theater that offers more than ten motion picture showings per week to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning such that at least one quarter of all showings of a motion picture with four or more showings during a one-week time period shall have open motion picture captioning; provides exceptions and penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to real property tax exemptions for persons with disabilities
summary: Adds a person with a disability who has their primary residence in a special needs trust, or a property owner who has a tenant with a disability whose lease provides them with a life interest in the property as long as the tenant remains in residence as eligible for a real property tax exemption pursuant to section 459-c of the real property tax law.

short_summary: Establishes the freight rail safety task force
summary: Establishes the freight rail safety task force to review the state of freight rail safety in the state and make policy and budgetary recommendations related thereto.

short_summary: Requires notice of risk of deportation of non-citizens, prior to accepting a plea
summary: Requires courts, prior to accepting a plea, to provide notice to the defendant that such plea and the acceptance thereof could result in deportation, removal from the United States, exclusion from the United States or denial of citizenship, if the defendant is not a citizen of the United States.

short_summary: Requires food products using ingredients classified as major food allergens to be labelled or branded as such
summary: Requires food products using ingredients classified as major food allergens to be labelled or branded as such; requires food sellers to provide written notice to stores for food labels containing new ingredients classified as major food allergens; requires such foods are labeled or branded as such by a food seller until such food has appropriately labeled packaging.

short_summary: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools
summary: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools.

short_summary: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; also prohibits such offenders from attending school activities
summary: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; prohibits such offenders from attending or participating in school sponsored activities.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; New Rochelle
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in the city of New Rochelle; extends provisions.

short_summary: Relates to a threat to share an intimate image
summary: Establishes that when an actor threatens to disseminate or publish a still or video image depicting such other person with one or more intimate parts exposed or engaging in sexual conduct with another person, including a still or video image created or altered by digitization, where such person may reasonably be identified from the still or video image itself or from information displayed in connection with the still or video image within the provisions of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; Mt. Vernon
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in the city of Mt. Vernon; extends provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes Mark Barnhart, David Skinner, and James Pappas to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment with the village of Wayland
summary: Authorizes Mark Barnhart, David Skinner, and James Pappas to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as full-time police officers with the village of Wayland.

short_summary: Restricts consecutive hours of work for health care workers
summary: Restricts consecutive hours of work for health care workers except in the case of certain emergencies and surgical procedures.

short_summary: Relates to the retirement of certain members of the Suffolk county fire district
summary: Relates to the retirement of certain members employed as an emergency medical technician, critical care technician, advanced emergency medical technician, paramedic or supervisor of such titles in a participating Suffolk county fire district.

short_summary: Relates to the designation of Mother Language Day as a day of commemoration
summary: Designates February 21st as Mother Language Day, as a day of commemoration.

short_summary: Prohibits correctional facilities from denying entry to peer support advocates based on such advocates' prior history of incarceration
summary: Prohibits correctional facilities from denying entry to peer support advocates who are certified or licensed and are participating in the provision of corrections-based substance use disorder treatment and transition services based on such advocates' prior history of incarceration.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance of retirement service identification cards to auxiliary police officers
summary: Directs local law enforcement agencies in municipalities authorizing an auxiliary police force by local law to provide retirement service identification cards to auxiliary police officers who retire with 10 or more years of service or who are injured in the course of duty and unable to continue duty due to such injury.

short_summary: Implements a residential parking system in the village of Port Chester
summary: Implements a residential parking system in the village of Port Chester.

short_summary: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county
summary: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county.

short_summary: Directs the Department of Transportation to conduct a study of bridges spanning bodies of water connected to deep water ports in the state
summary: Directs the Department of Transportation to conduct a study of certain bridges spanning bodies of water connected to deep water ports in the state to determine whether such bridges have the structural integrity to withstand an impact from large vessels such as cargo ships, oil tankers and cruise ships; requires a report and recommendations; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Extends certain provisions relating to regulatory fines for small businesses
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to regulatory fines for small businesses to 2027.

short_summary: Enables students to receive information from colleges and universities without disclosing their personally identifiable information
summary: Enables students to receive information from colleges and universities without disclosing their personally identifiable information via an opt-in system.

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the health savings account pilot program
summary: Extends provisions relating to the health savings account pilot program to December 31, 2027.

short_summary: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2025
summary: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2025; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

short_summary: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program
summary: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program to represent small businesses on issues relating to state energy policy and the goals of the climate leadership and community protection act.

short_summary: Relates to unlawful strikes by public employees
summary: Relates to unlawful strikes by public employees; provides for the settlement of certain disputes relating to terms and conditions of employment of certain transit and transportation authorities.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues
summary: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues.

short_summary: Relates to the intentional removal of identifying markers from commercial motor vehicles in the city of New York
summary: Prohibits the intentional removal of identification markers from commercial motor vehicles in the city of New York for the purpose of evading a traffic infraction; provides a fine of $200-$1000 for intentional removal of identification markers.

short_summary: Requires background checks prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character
summary: Requires background checks for a person prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character; provides certain penalties for violations.

short_summary: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
summary: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

short_summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to provide safety briefings to passengers aboard Metro-North trains, and train personnel in safety procedures
summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to provide safety briefings to passengers aboard Metro-North trains, and train personnel in safety procedures.

short_summary: Relates to the termination of law enforcement officer benefits for malfeasance or serious misconduct
summary: Provides that any officer terminated who was dismissed for malfeasance or serious misconduct or resigned or retired during an investigation relating to such malfeasance or serious misconduct shall not be entitled to receive any retirement or other benefit or payment of any kind.

short_summary: Prohibits the New York city water board from enacting any rules and regulations less favorable to the consumer
summary: Prohibits the NYC water board from enacting any rules and regulations less favorable to the consumer, including timeframes for appeals and receiving refunds.

short_summary: Relates to allowing for the testing of certain infectious diseases by pharmacists
summary: Allows for the testing of certain infectious diseases by pharmacists.

short_summary: Establishes the advanced initiative in mental health careers program
summary: Establishes the advanced initiative in mental health careers program to increase access by underrepresented or disadvantaged students to certain post-baccalaureate academic programs that prepare students for licensure in mental health professions and employment in mental health fields.

short_summary: Relates to the opioid stewardship fund
summary: Directs that at least ten percent of funds from the opioid stewardship fund shall be invested in recovery services and supports; requires an annual report to the legislature regarding funds distributed from the opioid stewardship fund; makes the opioid stewardship fund permanent.

short_summary: Requires certain locations and venues maintain a supply of opioid antagonists
summary: Requires nightlife establishments, sporting or event centers, theaters, concert venues, and amusement parks maintain a supply of opioid antagonists.

short_summary: Relates to providing parents of school children with information on the safe storage of firearms
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to develop information on the safe storage of firearms to be provided to parents of school children.

short_summary: Requires the workers' compensation board to submit a supplemental report every year
summary: Requires the workers' compensation board to submit a supplemental report every year, including recommendations to modernize such board and certain data regarding claims made and decisions rendered on such claims.

short_summary: Relates to traffic regulations of parking or standing vehicles in cities having a population in excess of one million
summary: Provides that cities having a population in excess of one million shall not supersede state provisions relating to the state law prohibition on individuals standing or parking a vehicle within twenty feet of a cross walk at an intersection.

short_summary: Establishes tenant eligibility for certain housing accommodations
summary: Prohibits persons whose income is greater than one hundred twenty-five percent of the area median income from occupying certain housing accommodations.

short_summary: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports in certain circumstances
summary: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports upon a court order finding that justice requires the information in such reports is necessary for the determination of charges being investigated by a grand jury or for the purposes of prosecuting a violation of the penal law.

short_summary: Expands the training time for local municipalities in relation to the open meetings law
summary: Expands the training time for local municipalities in relation to the open meetings law; requires at least one hour of such training be provided by the committee on open government or an appropriate entity in relation to compliance with the open meetings law and if not provided, a justification shall be given.

short_summary: Enacts the "public university emergency contraception education act"
summary: Enacts the "public university emergency contraception education act" requiring public universities to develop, produce and distribute informational materials related to emergency contraception.

short_summary: Enacts the "bucks for boilers act"
summary: Enacts the bucks for boilers act, which creates a program to aid in transition of housing units to electric heat pumps and other high energy efficiency upgrades.

short_summary: Relates to when a referendum is required when a village has provided that village elections shall occur on the same day as the general election
summary: Relates to when a referendum is required when a village has provided that village elections shall occur on the same day as the general election.

short_summary: Relates to the designation and nomination of candidates for village office in village elections conducted on the day of the general election
summary: Relates to the designation and nomination of candidates for village office in village elections conducted on the day of the general election.

short_summary: Relates to requiring municipalities, authorities and agencies to obtain liability insurance on each duly appointed police officer
summary: Relates to requiring municipalities, authorities and agencies to obtain liability insurance on each duly appointed police officer in an amount not less than $200,000.

short_summary: Establishes an office of the state medical fund ombudsman and a medical indemnity fund advisory panel
summary: Establishes an office of the state medical indemnity fund ombudsman and a medical indemnity fund advisory panel to advocate for, assist and represent the interests of qualified plaintiffs.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of vacancies for elective offices in villages with November elections
summary: Relates to the filling of vacancies for elective offices in villages with November elections; provides such vacancies shall be filled in accordance with subdivision one of section forty-two of the public officers law.

short_summary: Establishes a program of tiered eligibility for services offered by OPWDD for persons with learning disabilities and other complex neurological impairments
summary: Establishes a program of tiered eligibility for services offered by the office for people with developmental disabilities for persons with learning disabilities and other complex neurological impairments.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the MWBE Center within empire state development corporation
summary: Establishes the MWBE Center within the empire state development corporation to make the services of the division of minority and women's business development accessible in-person in cities with a population of one million or more and to provide information assistance and technical support relating to certification.

short_summary: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in N.Y. city
summary: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in cities having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Enacts the  "New York state agency BIPOC asset management and financial institution strategy act"
summary: Enacts the "New York state agency BIPOC asset management and financial institution strategy act" to ensure the promotion of equity, diversity, and inclusion within the state pension system and the New York city pension system's investments by mandating a minimum allocation of assets to BIPOC asset managers, BIPOC financial institutions, and BIPOC financial or professional service firms; addresses disparities in investment opportunities and fosters economic growth within BIPOC communities, aligning with best practices in investment management and bolstering the financial well-being of New York City and state and residents thereof.

short_summary: Relates to persons with a serious mental illness residing in an adult home
summary: Provides for when the department may limit the census of persons with a serious mental illness residing in an adult home.

short_summary: Establishes the endocannabinoid system awareness program
summary: Establishes the endocannabinoid system awareness program and work group.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the reasonable accommodation anti-retaliation act
summary: Relates to prohibiting retaliation against individuals who request a reasonable accommodation.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the display of a notice of responsibilities to protect underground facilities
summary: Provides any entity which leases excavation equipment to the public with the telephone number of the system and a sample or model notice informing lessees of excavation equipment of the system and their responsibilities relating to the protection of underground facilities.

short_summary: Relates to letters of credit for siting permits under the major renewable energy development program
summary: Directs the office of renewable energy siting to develop a procedure to process letters of credit for siting permits under the major renewable energy development program.

short_summary: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"
summary: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"; changes such association's purpose.

short_summary: Provides for tenant responses to applications for a major capital improvement rent increase
summary: Provides for tenant responses to applications for a major capital improvement rent increase; allows tenants to respond within one hundred twenty days from the date of mailing of a notice of a proceeding; requires the state division of housing and community renewal to provide any responding tenant with the reasons for the division's approval or denial of such application.

short_summary: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports in certain circumstances
summary: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports upon a court order finding that justice requires the information in such reports is necessary for the determination of charges being investigated by a grand jury or for the purposes of prosecuting a violation of the penal law or otherwise necessary for the furtherance of justice.

short_summary: Relates to mental health services and resources for child protective services employees
summary: Provides all child protective service employees with supportive mental health services and resources.

short_summary: Enacts the health care professional transparency act
summary: Enacts the health care professional transparency act; prohibits health care professionals from using deceptive or misleading advertising; establishes a public awareness campaign to improve transparency and understanding of information about health care practitioners.

short_summary: Relates to the qualifications for holding the office of assistant county attorney in the county of Herkimer
summary: Relates to the qualifications for holding the office of assistant county attorney in the county of Herkimer; permits holders of such office to reside outside Herkimer county.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; Albany
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in the city of Albany; extends provisions.

short_summary: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act
summary: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act to prohibit any person from selling, offering for sale or use, or distributing within the state, any second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide; prohibits the use of either a first-generation anticoagulant rodenticide or a second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide within five hundred feet of a wildlife habitat area.

short_summary: Relates to the hours adult-use cannabis shall be sold for on-site consumption
summary: Relates to the hours adult-use cannabis shall be sold for on-site consumption; provides cannabis products shall only be sold for on-site consumption between the hours of 11 a.m. and 11 p.m.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Cortland to establish hotel and motel taxes of up to three percent
summary: Authorizes the city of Cortland to establish hotel and motel taxes of up to three percent.

short_summary: Relates to the use of telematics systems by automobile insurers
summary: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates and/or discounts.

short_summary: Permits certain not-for-profit corporations engaged in engineering for certain conservation efforts to do business or provide professional engineering, land surveying or professional geology services in the state
summary: Relates to permitting certain not-for-profit corporations engaged in engineering for certain conservation efforts to do business or provide professional engineering, land surveying, or professional geology services in the state.

short_summary: Provides the village of Ossining, Westchester county, with an exemption from restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption
summary: Exempts the village of Ossining, Westchester county, from restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption.

short_summary: Relates to normal retirement age for police/fire members of the New York city fire department pension fund
summary: Provides that the normal service retirement benefit for police/fire members who are members of the New York city fire department pension fund shall be paid to such members of the New York city fire department pension fund without regard to age upon retirement after twenty years of service.

short_summary: Relates to the disqualification of a surviving spouse
summary: Provides for the disqualification of a surviving spouse if the marriage is annulled or voided after the death of the spouse.

short_summary: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices to set the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
summary: Prohibits landlords from using, or contracting for the use of, algorithmic devices to set the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant; imposes additional disclosure requirements regarding a landlord's collection and use of a tenant's personal information.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Captain Christopher J. Garrow Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Captain Christopher J. Garrow Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Provides for a cap on the credit service charge computed and collected on a retail instalment contract
summary: Provides for a cap on the credit service charge computed and collected on a retail instalment contract.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of tonic water, bitters and maraschino cherries at liquor stores
summary: Provides for the sale of tonic water, bitters and maraschino cherries at liquor stores.

short_summary: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars
summary: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars.

short_summary: Directs a study on establishing a venture capital tax credit for investments to emerging diverse founding member businesses
summary: Directs the comptroller and the commissioner of taxation and finance to undertake a study on the feasibility of establishing a venture capital tax credit for investments to emerging diverse founding member businesses.

short_summary: Enacts the "housing is a human right act"
summary: Enacts the "housing is a human right act"; establishes a New York state affordable housing czar and volunteer task force.

short_summary: Authorizes the Hudson River-Black River Regulating District to transfer certain lands to the village of Northville, town of Northampton, county of Fulton
summary: Authorizes the Hudson River-Black River Regulating District to transfer certain lands to the village of Northville, town of Northampton, county of Fulton, for the use and maintenance of the dam, roadway, and bridge located on such lands, in consideration of $1.

short_summary: Relates to the use of certain residential dwellings by tenants who left the dwelling temporarily due to the health impacts of COVID-19
summary: Provides that a tenant who has left a residential dwelling unit between the dates of March 12, 2020 and January 1, 2022 due to the health impacts of COVID-19 in the city of New York, who is a senior citizen or disabled person, and who asserts an intent to return to the housing accommodation shall be deemed to be occupying the unit as such tenant's residence.

short_summary: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers from using or disclosing certain consumer data
summary: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers from using or disclosing to a third party any data regarding the driving behavior of consumers for use by a motor vehicle insurer.

short_summary: Incorporates the city of Staten Island
summary: Incorporates the city of Staten Island; enacts a city charter; provides for all necessary technical changes for the establishment of such city; provides for a transition period prior to such establishment.

short_summary: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions of the banking law
summary: Extends certain provisions of the banking law from September 10, 2024 until September 10, 2029.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; Suffolk
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in Suffolk County; extends provisions.

short_summary: Establishes a hyperbaric oxygen therapy pilot program
summary: Establishes "The Bart Law"; requires a hyperbaric oxygen therapy pilot program to treat veterans suffering from traumatic brain injuries and post-traumatic stress disorder.

short_summary: Relates to the residential parking system in the village of Dobbs Ferry; makes provisions permanent
summary: Relates to the residential parking system in the village of Dobbs Ferry; makes provisions permanent.

short_summary: Establishes a state seal of financial literacy
summary: Establishes a state seal of financial literacy; provides such seal recognizes high school graduates who have attained a high level of proficiency in personal finance, budget management, and investment.

short_summary: Creates an I Love NY Historic Small Business niche brand
summary: Creates an "I Love NY Historic Small Business" niche brand to highlight small businesses listed on the registry of historic businesses maintained pursuant to section 14.11 of the parks, recreation and historic preservation law.

short_summary: Authorizes the village of Ballston Spa to transfer ownership of the Woods Hollow Nature Preserve to the town of Milton
summary: Authorizes the village of Ballston Spa to transfer ownership of the Woods Hollow Nature Preserve to the town of Milton; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes the offense of defrauding an elderly person
summary: Criminalizes defrauding a person 65 years of age or older by stealing or accessing without proper permission money, property or benefits by means of a deceptive tactic or the purposeful feeding of misinformation, regardless of the monetary value of the money, property or benefits.

short_summary: Exempts individuals sixty-five years of age and older from payment of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
summary: Exempts individuals sixty-five years of age and older from payment of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

short_summary: Relates to interactive fantasy sports
summary: Includes contests wherein participants select whether athletes, in the case of sporting events, shall accumulate more or less than a target score set by an operator, as an interactive fantasy sports contest; provides a definition for interactive fantasy sports gross revenue; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in districts and courts
summary: Directs the legislature to ensure that the number of judges and justices in districts and courts is sufficient; directs the chief administrator of the courts to report on the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in each court and to make recommendations on such numbers.

short_summary: Authorizes the Tuckahoe common school district to submit a proposition to reorganize as a union free school district
summary: Authorizes the trustees of the Tuckahoe Common School district to submit a proposition to reorganize as the Tuckahoe-Shinnecock Union Free School District.

short_summary: Establishes the crimes of deceptive wearing of a mask and aggravated deceptive wearing of a mask
summary: Establishes the crimes of deceptive wearing of a mask and aggravated deceptive wearing of a mask; makes such crimes a class B misdemeanor and a class A misdemeanor, respectively.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Hudson to increase hotel and motel taxes
summary: Authorizes the city of Hudson to increase hotel and motel taxes from four percent to five percent.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish the safer communities grant program; appropriation
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish the safer communities grant program making grants available to investigative or prosecutorial entities involved with cases of homicides, rapes, sexual assaults, kidnappings, and non-fatal shootings; requires a report to the legislature; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Requires each college to make publicly available its policy on notifying the parent, guardian, or emergency contact of a student under twenty-one of certain controlled substance or alcohol violations
summary: Requires each college and institution of higher education to make publicly available its policy on notifying the parent, guardian, or emergency contact of a student under twenty-one of certain controlled substance and alcohol violations, including rule infractions, and controlled substance or alcohol related hospitalizations or overdoses; requires such colleges and institutions to conduct regular training on the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act.

short_summary: Establishes a senior housing task force
summary: Establishes a senior housing task force for the purposes of conducting a state-wide assessment of senior housing needs taking into consideration the various geographical areas and different needs of the seniors in those areas and resources available in those different areas.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a uterine fibroids awareness and education program
summary: Establishes a uterine fibroids awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and the elevated risk for minority women.

short_summary: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court; repealer
summary: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court with regard to the timing of discovery, disclosure prior to certain guilty pleas, DNA evidence, court orders, and the admissibility of discovery.

short_summary: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego and removing the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county and allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner; repealer
summary: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego; removes the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county; allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner; repeals provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Rock Community Church, Inc.
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Rock Community Church, Inc. for all of the 2023 general taxes and all of the 2022-2023 school taxes.

short_summary: Prohibits openly carrying a rifle or shotgun
summary: Prohibits openly carrying a rifle or shotgun; establishes exemptions from such prohibition.

short_summary: Relates to pistol converters
summary: Requires reasonable controls and procedures to be taken to prevent the installation and use of a pistol converter.

short_summary: Provides for requirements for the rental of helmets
summary: Requires every person, corporation, association or partnership who rents helmets or provides helmets to customers as part of their business to ensure that such helmets are undamaged.

short_summary: Creates a temporary state commission concerning the incidence of asthma in Brooklyn
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of asthma in the borough of Brooklyn in New York city.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Columbia to impose a hotel and motel tax
summary: Authorizes the county of Columbia to impose a 4% tax on hotels and motels.

short_summary: Relates to concealment of identity in a lawful or unlawful assembly or riot
summary: Establishes the offense of concealment of identity in a lawful assembly, unlawful assembly or riot.

short_summary: Authorizes a residential parking system in the village of Sleepy Hollow in the county of Westchester
summary: Authorizes a residential parking system in the village of Sleepy Hollow in the county of Westchester.

short_summary: Relates to requiring utility corporations to remove debris attributable to servicing or protection of delivery lines or systems
summary: Requires a utility corporation that trims, prunes or cuts trees, bushes or other vegetation on private property in connection with the servicing or protection of the supply or delivery lines or systems of the utility to arrange for the complete removal from the private property of the debris that results from such actions.

short_summary: Authorizes the discontinuance of parkland and the granting of easements for improvements to the Metro-North railroad
summary: Authorizes the discontinuance of additional parkland and the granting of additional easements for improvements to the Metro-North railroad.

short_summary: Creates a personal income tax credit for taxpayers who pay an excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence
summary: Allows an individual taxpayer to claim a credit against their income tax for excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence; authorizes the commissioner of taxation and finance to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations.

short_summary: Requires braille labeling in dwellings in public housing projects in the state
summary: Requires all dwellings in projects located within the state to include braille labeling on all room numbers, elevator buttons, and directional signage in common areas in such dwellings.

short_summary: Enacts the "pediatric cancer neuropsychological needs assessment act"
summary: Enacts the "pediatric cancer neuropsychological needs assessment act"; requires insurers to provide coverage for neuropsychological assessments for children with pediatric cancers which affect brain development or function.

short_summary: Ensures public safety announcements are accessible to visually impaired individuals
summary: Requires that the state system for warning populations who are or may be endangered includes audible alerts for all announcements to ensure that information in accessible to visually impaired individuals.

short_summary: Establishes a twenty-four hour, toll-free hotline and website for runaway and homeless youth
summary: Establishes a twenty-four hour, toll-free hotline and website for runaway and homeless youth that provides immediate support, referrals, resource lists and other information to such youth.

short_summary: Designates crimes of manslaughter that result in the death of a child class A-1 felonies
summary: Designates crimes of manslaughter as class A-1 felonies when a defendant recklessly or with the intent to cause physical injury causes the death of a child.

short_summary: Provides for transferring control of a defendant's connected devices in a family offense proceeding
summary: Provides that upon motion and after an opportunity to be heard, a court may order the defendant in a family offense proceeding to turn control of a connected device over to a family or household member or, if that is not possible, to have such connected device disabled by the manufacturer.

short_summary: Authorizes the Praise Tabernacle Church of God to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Praise Tabernacle Church of God to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status with respect to the 2021-2022, 2022-2023, and 2023-2024 assessment rolls.

short_summary: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games
summary: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games.

short_summary: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Millwood, New York
summary: Amends the purposes and duties of the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Millwood, New York; makes certain technical corrections.

short_summary: Relates to the Alert Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Great Neck, New York
summary: Relates to the name and the funds of the Alert Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Great Neck, New York.

short_summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks
summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks.

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage deer and bear
summary: Extends provisions relating to the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage deer and bear to December 31, 2027.

short_summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the management of migratory game birds
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the management of migratory game birds to December 31, 2027.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Albany to levy hotel and motel taxes on short-term rentals
summary: Authorizes the county of Albany to levy hotel and motel taxes on short-term rentals; expands the definitions of hotel and motel to include any facility consisting of rentable units that provides lodging on an overnight basis.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to accept electronic signatures on any document
summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to accept electronic signatures on any document.

short_summary: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records
summary: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records provided that such records can be accessed and provided to a requestor during reasonable business hours.

short_summary: Enacts the "electric super highway act"
summary: Enacts the "electric super highway act", requiring alternative fuels to be available for public use along the New York state thruway after November 1, 2024 and providing each recommended alternative fuel at least every one hundred twenty miles on both sides of the thruway; defines "alternative fuel".

short_summary: Adds Fishkill Creek to the definition of inland waterways
summary: Adds Fishkill Creek in Dutchess County to the definition of inland waterways.

short_summary: Relates to net revenue distributed by regional off-track betting corporations
summary: Directs that any net revenue distributed to participating counties or cities by regional off-track betting corporations shall be used exclusively for real property tax relief.

short_summary: Authorizes the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Requires the department of motor vehicles compile a list of veterans who apply for a veteran driver's license
summary: Requires the department of motor vehicles compile a list of veterans who apply for a veteran driver's license and provide such list to the department of veterans' services to aid in outreach efforts by the department of veterans' services.

short_summary: Relates to increasing fines for parking violations
summary: Relates to increasing fines for parking violations from fifty to one hundred dollars.

short_summary: Relates to a net price calculator center for colleges on the website of the higher education services corporation
summary: Directs the higher education services corporation to create a net price calculator center for colleges on its website.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program
summary: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program.

short_summary: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements
summary: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements; defines terms; establishes powers and duties of the department of labor and of licensees with regards to such licenses; establishes penalties; establishes the radon mitigation and control fund.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program
summary: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.

short_summary: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district
summary: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district which shall consist of the counties of Putnam, Dutchess, Orange and Rockland.

short_summary: Authorizes funeral directing apprenticeships as an alternative to licensing examinations
summary: Authorizes funeral directing apprenticeships as an alternative to licensing examinations; requires such apprenticeships to be one- to four-year programs led by licensing funeral directors; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of removing all existing 3-cable guide rails on New York roadways
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of removing all existing 3-cable guide rails on New York roadways and replacing such guide rails with safer alternatives; requires a report to be submitted to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, and the minority leader of the assembly containing the findings and recommendations for legislative or other actions.

short_summary: Exempts the town of Pound Ridge from the establishment of retail dispensary licenses and on-site consumption licenses for cannabis
summary: Exempts the town of Pound Ridge from the establishment of retail dispensary licenses and on-site consumption licenses for cannabis, provided that the town adopts a local law prohibiting the establishment of such licenses.

short_summary: Authorizes a retroactive real property tax exemption for Hicksville United Methodist Church in the county of Nassau
summary: Authorizes a retroactive real property tax exemption for Hicksville United Methodist Church in the county of Nassau for general taxes years 2022 and 2023 and school taxes years 2021-2022 and 2022-2023.

short_summary: Prohibits the importation of live bait fish and provides penalties for failure to comply with such prohibition
summary: Prohibits the importation of live bait fish; provides penalties for failure to comply with such prohibition.

short_summary: Requires the department of transportation to develop an updated New York state bicycle and pedestrian plan
summary: Requires the department of transportation to develop an updated New York state bicycle and pedestrian plan adapted from the department's nineteen hundred ninety-seven New York state bicycle and pedestrian plan, to be re-evaluated and updated every five years.

short_summary: Establishes minimum protocol requirements for gene synthesis providers and manufacturers of gene synthesis equipment
summary: Establishes minimum protocol requirements for gene synthesis providers and manufacturers of gene synthesis equipment; requires such providers and manufacturers to operate in accordance with international gene synthesis consortium protocols.

short_summary: Relates to temporary authorizations for practice as a registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or physician
summary: Relates to temporary authorizations for practice as a registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or physician; extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to hotel and motel tax in Dutchess county
summary: Increases the tax the county of Dutchess can impose and collect on the occupancy of hotels, motels, boarding houses, conference centers and tourist homes from 4 percent to 5 percent.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for reducing emissions from medium and heavy-duty vehicles
summary: Enacts an advanced clean fleets law to reduce vehicle emissions for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles.

short_summary: Establishes the "Mariah N. Lacey-Reid Law" which aids designated hotline centers in developing protocols for terminating calls to the suicide prevention and behavioral health crisis hotline
summary: Develops protocols that designated hotline centers play calming music while callers are on hold, regular "comfort" messages, and if necessary, the hotline center shall provide additional messaging to encourage the caller to stay on the line.

short_summary: Requires arrested individuals to be given a mental health evaluation form
summary: Requires the office of mental health to create a mental health evaluation form to determine whether arrested individuals have the proper mental capacity to make decisions regarding their arrest; requires arrested individuals to be given such mental health evaluation form; directs that if an individual fails such mental health evaluation, a representative will be appointed for such individual regarding arrest proceedings.

short_summary: Establishes the "Hoosock and Jensen law" which increases the designation of certain offenses relating to unlawfully fleeing a police officer
summary: Designates unlawful fleeing a police officer in a motor vehicle in the third degree as a class E felony; designates unlawful fleeing a police officer in a motor vehicle in the second degree as a class D violent felony offense; designates unlawful fleeing a police officer in a motor vehicle in the first degree as a class B violent felony offense.

short_summary: Mandates that purchasers of new vehicles complete a form authorizing or rejecting the placement of a tracking device in such vehicle, to be used by law enforcement if such vehicle is reported stolen
summary: Mandates that purchasers of new vehicles complete a form authorizing or rejecting the placement of a tracking device in such vehicle, to be used by law enforcement if such vehicle is reported stolen; authorizes law enforcement to recover the stolen vehicle through electronic means, physical means, or any other method necessary to recover such vehicle as quickly as possible.

short_summary: Requires warnings on generative artificial intelligence systems
summary: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system to conspicuously display a warning on the system's user interface that is reasonably calculated to consistently apprise the user that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate and/or inappropriate.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Dr. John Flateau Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the county of Kings, the "Dr. John Flateau Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Enacts "Gittel's law"
summary: Expands the definition of mental health care provider to include licensed mental health counselors and licensed marriage and family therapists, for purposes of certain sex offenses committed during a treatment session, consultation, interview, or examination.

short_summary: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments
summary: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments for the purposes of designing and carrying out youth activities organized by the department.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursements practices of pharmacy benefit managers
summary: Ensures reimbursement practices of pharmacy benefit managers do not allow for reimbursement of an amount less than the cost of procuring the drugs.

short_summary: Increases the length of the term of office and imposes term limits for members of the legislature
summary: Increases the length of the term of office of members of the legislature to six years; imposes term limits for members of the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; Nassau
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in Nassau County; extends provisions to 2029.

short_summary: Relates to domestic animal health permits
summary: Provides that it shall be unlawful for any person to purchase, deal in, sell or rescue cattle, swine, horses, cervids, camelids, sheep, goats or poultry or to operate an auction where such animals are sold unless a valid domestic animal health permit is held.

short_summary: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits
summary: Increases certain special accidental death benefits for state and local retirement system members.

short_summary: Repeals section 17 of chapter 7 of the laws of 2024 relating to establishing the village incorporation commission; and repeals section 6 of chapter 10 of the laws of 2024 relating to the incorporation of villages
summary: Repeals provisions relating to establishing the village incorporation commission; repeals provisions relating to the incorporation of villages.

short_summary: Establishes the Long Island transportation account
summary: Establishes the Long Island transportation account within the New York city transportation assistance fund.

short_summary: Authorizes people who transport severely disabled persons as an eligible person to receive disabled person plates
summary: Authorizes people who transport a severely disabled person as an eligible person to receive disabled person plates; defines who qualifies as eligible persons.

short_summary: Establishing a legislative commission on article V conventions of the states
summary: Establishes a legislative commission on article V conventions of the states to represent the state of New York at article V conventions; provides penalties for commissioners who exceed their scope of authority and individuals who interfere with the duties of a commissioner.

short_summary: Protects students from harassment and bullying by school board members and school trustees
summary: Protects students from being bullied, harassed or discriminated against by school board members and school trustees.

short_summary: Prohibits the state from purchasing any product that was made with child labor
summary: Prohibits the state from purchasing any product that was made with child labor or which contains components or parts manufactured or procured using child labor.

short_summary: Clarifies procedures affecting the first annual election of fire district officials to a board of fire commissioners
summary: Clarifies procedures affecting the first annual election of fire district officials to a board of fire commissioners to allow voters to cast one vote for each open position on such board of fire commissioners to be filled in such election.

short_summary: Enacts the "Great Swamp Protection Act"
summary: Creates the "Great Swamp protection act" for lands in Dutchess and Putnam counties.

short_summary: Establishes "Elijah's law"; and directs the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles to conduct a study analyzing the operation and use of certain vehicles
summary: Increases driver safety training course requirements for D, M, and MJ license applicants; directs the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles to study the operation and safety of motorcycles, e-bikes, and scooters.

short_summary: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools
summary: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools.

short_summary: Allows for retail license for on-premises consumption to be granted to establishments located near a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship; repealer
summary: Allows for retail license for on-premises consumption to be granted to establishments located on the same street or avenue and within two hundred feet of a building occupied exclusively as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

short_summary: Relates to reserve funds for pupil transportation costs
summary: Provides that any school district may establish a reserve fund for the payment of unanticipated costs related to pupil transportation in excess of public funds apportioned to districts for such purposes.

short_summary: Provides protections for telecommunications tower technicians
summary: Provides protections for telecommunications tower technicians, including requiring certain trainings during work hours without a loss of pay; requires certain reporting by bidders for telecommunication contracts.

short_summary: Allows direct descendants of a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer to access such patient's clinical records
summary: Allows direct descendants of a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer to access such patient's clinical records.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions of the correction law relating to the transfer of incarcerated individuals from a county jail to a state correctional institution
summary: Repeals provisions relating to the transfer of incarcerated individuals from a county jail to a state correctional institution.

short_summary: Provides for members of certain retirement systems to obtain credit for up to 5 years service rendered as a teacher in a private elementary or secondary school or a private college in New York state
summary: Provides that a member of the New York state teachers' retirement system or the New York city teachers' retirement system, and certain members of the New York state and local employees' retirement system who are employed by teaching institutions, shall be entitled to obtain credit for up to 5 years of service rendered as a teacher employed by a private elementary or secondary school or by a private college in New York state.

short_summary: Commissions a disparity study to determine the level of participation of women and minority businesses in state contracting and requires establishment of programs and goals based on the results of such study
summary: Commissions a disparity study to determine the level of participation of women and minority businesses in state contracting; requires establishment of programs and goals based on the results of such study.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Monroe to provide for an easement across Lehigh Valley Trail Park, for ingress and egress to and from the project site and installation of a medium voltage cable
summary: Authorizes the county of Monroe to convey appropriate instruments to EH Henrietta Solar 1 LLC and EH Henrietta Solar 2 LLC for an easement across Lehigh Valley Trail Park, for ingress and egress to and from the project site and installation of a medium voltage cable; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products
summary: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products.

short_summary: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; repealer
summary: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; authorizes filing motions to vacate judgment for a conviction that was subsequently decriminalized; authorizes motions to vacate judgment to be filed at any time after entry of a judgment obtained at trial or by plea.

short_summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications; White Plains
summary: Relates to traffic-control signal indications in the city of White Plains; extends provisions.

short_summary: Extends the effectiveness of authorizing big game hunting in Albany county
summary: Extends provisions authorizing big game hunting in Albany county until October 1, 2026.

short_summary: Enacts the "bank of Rochester act"
summary: Establishes the bank of Rochester, including provisions related to definitions; sponsors and corporate structure; powers and restrictions; governance; charter requirements; financial and operations frameworks; transparency and financial reporting; insurance; deposits; policy mandates; ethics and financial disclosure; inconsistency with other laws; and owners not to be considered bank holding companies.

short_summary: Relates to semi-annual expenditures and lobbying reports by certain public service utility corporations
summary: Requires every utility corporation to provide an expenditures and lobbying report by March 31, 2025 and every semi-annual period thereafter to the department of public service.

short_summary: Relates to the mandatory age of the chief of the town of Southampton police department
summary: Exempts the chief of police of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, from mandatory age requirements; authorizes such chief of police to remain in service until such member has attained the age of 65.

short_summary: Relates to the name of the Rockland County Solid Waste Authority, subjects such authority to regulation by the department of agriculture and markets
summary: Relates to the name of the Rockland County Solid Waste Authority; subjects such authority to regulation by the department of agriculture and markets; eliminates the ability of the authority to allow a subsidiary to perform certain functions relating to the care of unwanted animals; makes a technical change; relates to public authorities providing shelter services for the care of unwanted animals.

short_summary: Prohibits awarding TAP grants to those enrolled at for-profit universities
summary: Prohibits the awarding of TAP grants to those enrolled at for-profit universities.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Oyster Bay to discontinue as parklands and convey such parkland to the department of environmental conservation
summary: Authorizes the town of Oyster Bay to discontinue as parklands and convey such parkland to the department of environmental conservation.

short_summary: Prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes
summary: Prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes.

short_summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions dealing with tax exemptions for rent regulated properties occupied by certain persons
summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions dealing with tax exemptions for rent regulated properties occupied by senior citizens and persons with disabilities until 2026.

short_summary: Relates to social model adult day services programs
summary: Relates to social model adult day services programs.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York long term care trust act" and establishes the New York long term care trust program
summary: Establishes the New York long term care trust program to provide long term care benefits for eligible residents who have paid the required premium contributions and are in need of assistance with at least two activities of daily living as determined by the department of health.

short_summary: Relates to liability of certain agencies for negligence in the placement of a child; extend jurisdiction of the court of claims
summary: Extends liability of certain agencies for negligence in the placement of a child in the authorized agency's custody, or in the supervision of a foster home or foster parents; extends jurisdiction of the court of claims to certain claims for injuries to a child.

short_summary: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund
summary: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund for the payment of premiums not yet paid; provides for the return of funds if such reserve fund becomes no longer necessary.

short_summary: Relates to an exemption from taxation for capital improvements to residential buildings to reduce carbon emissions
summary: Provides for an exemption from taxation for capital improvements to residential buildings to reduce carbon emissions where the governing board of the applicable county, city, town or village adopts a local law and a school district, other than a school district subject to article fifty-two of the education law, adopts a resolution to grant the exemption.

short_summary: Changes the timing of certain discovery requirements to sixty days prior to trial
summary: Changes the timing of certain discovery requirements to sixty days prior to trial.

short_summary: Imposes term limits on members of the legislature
summary: Imposes term limits on members of the legislature such that no person can serve in a house of the legislature for more than six consecutive terms.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to expand the crimes against revenue program to all counties within the state
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to include in the crimes against revenue program each county within the state and provide funding to each such county.

short_summary: Relates to child care assistance program postcards
summary: Relates to the provision of child care assistance program postcards.

short_summary: Relates to the use of electronic monitoring devices to monitor residents in assisted living residences
summary: Relates to the use of electronic monitoring devices to monitor residents in assisted living residences; requires consent from resident roommates to such electronic monitoring.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands for the purpose of constructing a facility to support research and development of semiconductor chips
summary: Authorizes the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands for the purpose of developing a facility to support research and development to address the national semiconductor chip shortage and related environmental sustainability issues.

short_summary: Relates to the SUNY Maritime admissions program
summary: Increases the number of positions reserved for nomination by the governor and members of the legislature and scholarship under the SUNY Maritime admissions program.

short_summary: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act"
summary: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act" relating to the employment of persons with developmental disabilities by school districts.

short_summary: Increases the federal poverty level requirement for recipients where it concerns the one-time disregard of earned income
summary: Increases the federal poverty level requirement for recipients where it concerns the one-time disregard of earned income following job entry.

short_summary: Relates to floor area ratio requirements for buildings on farms
summary: Requires floor area ratio requirements for buildings on farms to be no more restrictive than state requirements for zoning purposes.

short_summary: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act"
summary: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act" to allow educators to deduct qualified expenses incurred by K-12 educators.

short_summary: In relation to the list of duties of the OCFS office of the ombudsman
summary: Adds to the list of duties of the OCFS office of the ombudsman relating to hearing grievances and complaints.

short_summary: Enacts the "regents modernization act"
summary: Enacts the "regents modernization act" to require the board of regents shall be at all times at least four times more than the number of the then existing judicial districts of the state and shall not be less than fifteen; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to electric generating facility annual reports; and to repeal section 575-b of the real property tax law relating to solar or wind energy) systems
summary: Eliminates the necessity for solar and wind energy systems to supply certain information in electric generating facility annual reports; repeals provisions relating to solar or wind energy systems.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, county of Westchester, to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
summary: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, county of Westchester, to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands.

short_summary: Relates to contracts entered into by the Long Island Power Authority for emergency goods and services
summary: Relates to contracts entered into by the Long Island Power Authority for emergency goods and services.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York saves lives act"
summary: Enacts the "New York saves lives act" to authorize any New York state resident aged sixteen and older to register as an organ, eye and tissue donor through the New York state donate life registry; adds a New York state donate life registry option on admission applications to the state university of New York and the city university of New York.

short_summary: Relates to the Bethpage community park cleanup independent state monitorship
summary: Establishes an independent state monitorship to oversee containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup of the groundwater plume associated with the Northrop Grumman Bethpage Facility and Naval Weapons Industrial Reserve Plant sites in the hamlet of Bethpage within the town of Oyster Bay and compliance by Northrop Grumman and any other parties responsible for such containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup with any operative consent decrees, consent judgments, settlements, or agreements.

short_summary: Improves public service commission oversight of the Long Island power authority; repealer
summary: Improves public service commission oversight of the Long Island power authority.

short_summary: Enacts the "MWBE equality act"
summary: Enacts the "MWBE equality act" to add ethno-religious groups as minority group members for the purposes of MWBE; defines ethno-religious persons as unified by a common religious and ethnic background.

short_summary: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act"
summary: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act" to provide additional credits to the Nassau county law enforcement explorers in competitive civil service examinations; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires certain municipal positions undergo continuing legal education courses in ethics
summary: Requires certain municipal positions undergo continuing legal education courses in ethics and the format in which such courses may be completed.

short_summary: Enacts the "protect our pedestrians (POP) act"
summary: Permits the villages of Upper Brookville, Flower Hill, East Hampton, Westbury, Saddle Rock and Southampton located in Nassau and Suffolk county to adopt local laws to implement a demonstration program imposing monetary liability not to exceed fifty dollars on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator to comply with stop signs; permits such villages to install and operate stop sign photo violation monitoring systems as part of such demonstration program.

short_summary: Requires charges for telephone calls based on duration, whether over lines or by cellular, to be charged and prorated by the second basis
summary: Requires charges for telephone calls based on duration, whether over lines or by cellular, to be charged and prorated by the second; applies to all service providers; authorizes the public service commission to promulgate rules and regulations.

short_summary: Enacts the utility shutoff protection act
summary: Protects residential customers from utility service shutoffs due to non-payment during summer and winter periods of extreme heat or cold; allows such utility services to be discontinued for non-payment outside such periods; requires an annual report to be submitted to the governor and legislature and posted publicly online.

short_summary: Relates to an easement over certain parkland in the town of Brookhaven
summary: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to discontinue a portion of real property currently used as parkland to West Ferry Office, LLC for the construction of sewer facilities.

short_summary: Relates to the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program and the definition of "municipality"
summary: Provides that for the purposes of the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program, the term "municipality" shall mean a county or a city or town with a population of one hundred thousand or more.

short_summary: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use
summary: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use.

short_summary: Relates to a review of reimbursement adequacy for early intervention services
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to do a comprehensive assessment of the existing methodology used to determine payment for early intervention screenings, evaluations, services and service coordination; directs recommendations on reimbursement methodology as well as needs under the program.

short_summary: Relates to certain data required in an annual report on the administration of managed long term care plans
summary: Requires certain data to be included in reports on the administration of managed long term care plans; changes reporting period to annually.

short_summary: Changes the date of designation for election inspectors and poll clerks
summary: Changes the date of designation for election inspectors and poll clerks to January first.

short_summary: Repeals article 8 of the public service law and section 94-c of the executive law
summary: Repeals provisions relating to the RAPID Act.

short_summary: Relates to qualification for and establishment of a building construction, demolition and repair work insurance credit
summary: Authorizes a building construction, demolition and repair work insurance tax credit for certain qualifying insurance premium payments for personal injury liability insurance and property damage liability insurance.

short_summary: Relates to permitting the operation of bicycles with electric assist on certain roadways
summary: Permits the operation of bicycles with electric assist on highways with a maximum speed limit of 55 mph.

short_summary: Relates to ADA or handicapped parking spaces at an arena
summary: Requires all ADA or handicapped parking spaces at an arena, entertainment or sports venue shall be directly outside the entrance door to the building as stated in federal law; provides that failure to comply with the provisions of this section shall result in an automatic suspension of any New York liquor license held by such venue for a period of one week for each day in which such venue is noncompliant; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to telecommunications equipment owned by other than a telephone company
summary: Provides that all equipment used for the transmission and switching of radio signals for the provision of commercial mobile radio service or mobile internet access service no longer constitutes real property subject to the real property tax law.

short_summary: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student from being home schooled in certain circumstances
summary: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student to be home schooled when the superintendent of the school district is notified of a pending child abuse or neglect investigation or if either custodial parent or a person instructing the child has been convicted of domestic violence, child abuse, or neglect.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
summary: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Requires insurers to cover the substitution of a brand name prescription drug when the federal food and drug administration has declared that there is a supply issue with a generic drug
summary: Requires insurers to cover the substitution of a brand name prescription drug when the federal food and drug administration has declared that there is a supply issue with a generic drug.

short_summary: Relates to the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia; repealer
