summary: Relates to failure to obtain an alteration permit or certificate of occupancy for a multiple dwelling; makes such crimes a felony.

short_summary: Relates to a state pre-paid tuition plan
summary: Establishes the New York state pre-paid tuition plan by which a person may contribute to an account for the pre-payment of college tuition, tax free.

short_summary: Relates to requiring merchants to accept cash as payment for goods
summary: Requires merchants to accept cash as payment for goods and services; permits the superintendent of financial services to provide exemptions based on certain criteria.

short_summary: Creates a pedestrian safety rating system for motor vehicles
summary: Creates a pedestrian safety rating system for motor vehicles which shall be posted on the department of motor vehicles' website.

short_summary: Relates to the coordination of no-fault benefits for persons injured in motor vehicle accidents
summary: Requires that insurers providing no-fault coverage reimburse other insurers for the payment of claims to providers which should have been covered by a no-fault insurer.

short_summary: Relates to the statute of limitations for actions based on employment discrimination
summary: Relates to the statute of limitations for actions based on discriminatory practices in employment; establishes action must be commenced within six years.

short_summary: Relates to requiring new employees to be provided certain information relating to student loan repayment information
summary: Directs the development of materials to be provided to new employees relating to student loan repayment information.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the maximum years of study under the tuition assistance program
summary: Increases the maximum time limits for tuition assistance program awards.

short_summary: Enacts the reproductive freedom and equity grant program
summary: Enacts the reproductive freedom and equity grant program to ensure access to abortion care in the state by providing funding to abortion providers and non-profit organizations whose primary function is to facilitate access to abortion care.

short_summary: Relates to the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses
summary: Extends the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses, reviving such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations; grants trial preference to such actions; exempts such actions from certain provisions requiring notice of claims.

short_summary: Relates to legal challenges to the constitutionality of provisions of the election law
summary: Provides that for any legal challenge to the constitutionality of a provision of the election law, venue shall be brought in the following designated court in the judicial department within which at least one plaintiff is located: first judicial department: New York county; second judicial department: Westchester county; third judicial department: Albany county; and fourth judicial department: Erie county.

short_summary: Provides for inclusive instruction and instructional materials
summary: Requires school districts and charter schools to establish a task force to make recommendations on model curriculum or instruction on the political, economic, and social contributions of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, and asexual people, in an appropriate place in the curriculum of middle school and high school students.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the taxes imposed on distributors of beers and to directing revenue generated from such taxes be deposited to the credit of SUNY and CUNY
summary: Relates to increasing the taxes imposed on distributors of beers and to directing revenue generated from such taxes be deposited to the credit of SUNY and CUNY; increases such taxes to thirty cents per gallon.

short_summary: Clarifies the definition of floor area
summary: Clarifies the definition of floor area and what is excluded in the measurement of floor area.

short_summary: Prohibits school buses from parking overnight on a city street
summary: Relates to prohibiting school buses from parking overnight on a city street.

short_summary: Relates to the enrollment of students at charter schools, the suspension of students at charter schools and the administration of charter schools
summary: Relates to the establishment, organization, and administration of charter schools.

short_summary: Provides for the employment of mental health professionals by school districts
summary: Provides for the employment of mental health professionals by school districts.

short_summary: Relates to requiring motor vehicle dealers to search for recalls and make certain repairs prior to selling a used motor vehicle
summary: Requires motor vehicle dealers to search for recalls and make certain repairs prior to selling a used motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the unauthorized installation of certain security devices on residential buildings
summary: Prohibits the installation of certain security devices used to control access to common areas of a residential building without the written permission of the owners, board of managers, board of directors, or authorized party of such property.

short_summary: Establishes certain offenses relating to crypto fraud
summary: Establishes the offenses of virtual token fraud, illegal rug pulls, private key fraud and fraudulent failure to disclose interest in virtual tokens.

short_summary: Requires certain disclosures in advertisements involving virtual tokens
summary: Requires certain disclosures by a developer of virtual tokens in advertisements involving such virtual tokens; provides restrictions concerning advertising.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for violation of certain wage payment violations
summary: Permits an employee to commence a private action against an employer for violation of frequency of wage payment violations; directs increased penalties.

short_summary: Relates to protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners
summary: Enacts protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners; requires certain notifications from creditors and debt collectors; prohibits acceleration; enacts provisions for cosigner release.

short_summary: Provides for a cap on the credit service charge computed and collected on a retail instalment contract
summary: Provides for a cap on the credit service charge computed and collected on a retail instalment contract.

short_summary: Relates to high-volume third-party sellers in the online marketplace
summary: Requires certain high-volume third-party sellers in the online marketplace to provide certain information to the online marketplace; requires verification of such information and technical safeguards for use of such data; requires notifications; preempts local laws.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the NY privacy act
summary: Enacts the New York privacy act to require companies to disclose their methods of de-identifying personal information, to place special safeguards around data sharing and to allow consumers to obtain the names of all entities with whom their information is shared.

short_summary: Relates to optional disability coverage for county probation officers
summary: Provides optional disability coverage for county probation officers.

short_summary: Eliminates the requirement that hunters wear back tags during hunting season in the state; repealer
summary: Eliminates the requirement that hunters wear back tags during hunting season in the state.

short_summary: Provides for the dissolution of the town of Concord industrial development agency
summary: Repeals provisions of law relating to the town of Concord industrial development agency.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursement for studies for districts subject to reorganization
summary: Relates to reimbursement for studies for districts subject to reorganization when appropriated.

short_summary: Establishes a public service commission nominating board to make recommendations of persons qualified for appointment as commissioners of the public service commission
summary: Establishes a public service commission nominating board to make recommendations of persons qualified for appointment as commissioners of the public service commission.

short_summary: Enacts the democracy preservation act
summary: Enacts the democracy preservation act; prohibits contributions by foreign-influenced business entities; requires certification.

short_summary: Relates to providing secondary school pupils and adults in career education programs access to programs/courses sufficient to comprise a career major in electric vehicle maintenance and repair
summary: Relates to providing secondary school pupils and adults in career education programs access to programs/courses sufficient to comprise a career major in electric vehicle maintenance and repair; establishes the working group on electric vehicle career education achievement.

short_summary: Ensures the safe and efficient delivery of materials for the timely construction of major renewable energy facilities in furtherance of the goals mandated by the New York state climate leadership and community
summary: Ensures the safe and efficient delivery of materials for the timely construction of major renewable energy facilities in furtherance of the goals mandated by the New York state climate leadership and community protection act; provides that vehicles carrying materials intended for the construction of any major renewable energy facility, including oversize and superload transport vehicles, shall be permitted to travel on the thruway and state highways, on any day of the week, including Saturday and Sunday.

short_summary: Relates to approval of electric transmission line facilities
summary: Provides that, prior to granting a certificate for the construction of an electric transmission line facility, the public service commission must find that the facility conforms to the most recent state energy plan and consider whether approval of the facility would cause adverse impacts on the state's environmental quality due to electric generation.

short_summary: Relates to emerging technology industrial classifications for clean environment and energy technologies
summary: Relates to emerging technology industrial classifications for clean environment and energy technologies.

short_summary: Authorizes broadband franchises in cities with a population of one million or more
summary: Authorizes broadband franchises in cities with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to the collection of charges for residential utility services deemed to be rent
summary: Relates to the collection of charges for residential utility service deemed to be rent; provides that where it is alleged and established that charges for utility service to any residential tenant are deemed to be rent under the terms of any arrangement or agreement relating to rental of residential property, no recovery of possession shall be had therein.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a renewable hydrogen incentive and financing program
summary: Relates to establishing a renewable hydrogen incentive and financing program to engage stakeholders to design and implement a competitive program for renewable hydrogen production for the purpose of meeting the state's clean energy and greenhouse emissions reductions targets.

short_summary: Offers parental controls for internet services
summary: Offers parental controls for internet services; allows the attorney general to bring a civil action against any internet provider that violates certain requirements.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care
summary: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care.

short_summary: Provides for a right to representation by counsel for certain actions of the parole board
summary: Provides for a right to representation by counsel in any proceeding where an incarcerated individual is under consideration for release on parole and where such incarcerated individual is financially unable to retain counsel.

short_summary: Repeals sections 1 and 1-a of part FFF of chapter 56 of the laws of 2020
summary: Relates to directing the department of health to remove the pharmacy benefit from the managed care benefit package; provides the pharmacy benefit under the fee for service program.

short_summary: Requires gynecological services to be offered to certain incarcerated individuals
summary: Requires gynecological services to be offered to incarcerated individuals with cervixes unless such individuals decline such services in writing.

short_summary: Provides for the establishment, incorporation and certification of addiction and substance abuse facilities in the city of New York
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to collect data on the number of facilities sited and operating within each jurisdiction of each community board; make such data available on the office's website, updated as needed to maintain an accurate dataset; and consider such data in the course of the approval of the establishment, incorporation and certification of providers of substance use disorder services.

short_summary: Relates to designating, as peace officers, public safety officers of the Chautauqua Institution within the grounds of and properties owned by the Chautauqua Institution
summary: Designates, as peace officers, public safety officers of the Chautauqua Institution within the grounds of and properties owned by the Chautauqua Institution.

short_summary: Enacts the voter registration integrity act
summary: Enacts the voter registration integrity act; requires a birth certificate, passport, certificate of naturalization or citizenship, evidence of New York state residency, or any other documentation that the board of elections determines establishes United States citizenship.

short_summary: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation
summary: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation.

short_summary: Relates to flexible working arrangements
summary: Relates to flexible working arrangements; provides that employees may submit a request for flexible working arrangements in good faith; requires the employer to notify the employee of the decision; prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for exercising rights under the section.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to develop a human trafficking interceptors program
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to develop a human trafficking interceptors program including issuing appropriate guidelines; provides such division may adopt, amend or rescind any rules and regulations as may be necessary or convenient to the operation of the program.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish a universal, statewide human trafficking hotline
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services, in consultation with the office of temporary and disability assistance, to establish a universal, statewide human trafficking hotline to provide individuals in the state access to appropriate counselling and services for human trafficking victims.

short_summary: Directs the department of social services of the city of New York to provide shelter to victims of human trafficking at a residential program exclusively for victims of human trafficking
summary: Directs the department of social services of the city of New York, in consultation with the department of housing preservation and development, to provide shelter to victims of human trafficking at a residential program exclusively for victims of human trafficking.

short_summary: Defines the crime of sex trafficking of a child, person who is mentally disabled, or person who is mentally incapacitated
summary: Defines the crime of sex trafficking of a child, person who is mentally disabled, or person who is mentally incapacitated as a class B felony.

short_summary: Provides for priority status to victims of human trafficking for the receipt of certain assistance
summary: Provides for priority for applications and expedited determination of claims for a human trafficking victim who wishes to remove permanent marks that were part of the trafficking of such victim, including but not limited to, tattoos, markings, brandings, or other symbols or insignia.

short_summary: Requires a course of study in the awareness and prevention of human trafficking
summary: Requires a course of study in the awareness and prevention of human trafficking defined by the commissioner of education in regulations after consultation with the division of criminal justice services designed to educate students, parents and school personnel about the signs of human trafficking.

short_summary: Directs the New York state interagency task force on human trafficking to investigate connections between social media and human trafficking
summary: Directs the New York state interagency task force on human trafficking to investigate connections between social media and human trafficking.

short_summary: Expedites the distributions of funds for the supervision and treatment services for juveniles program
summary: Expedites the distributions of funds for the supervision and treatment services for juveniles program; requires that eligible municipalities receive the sum equivalent to at least their last approved supervision and treatment services for juveniles program plan.

short_summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands
summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the New York city department of transportation and New York city department of housing preservation and development, to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a referenced rate for prescription drug
summary: Relates to reducing the cost of prescription drugs by establishing maximum wholesale drug prices that are the same as the prices in Canada.

short_summary: Relates to the enactment of the safer consumption services pilot program act
summary: Enacts the safer consumption services pilot program act which provides for the establishment of a pilot program to provide overdose prevention center pilot programs.

short_summary: Relates to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers.

short_summary: Provides an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals
summary: Relates to providing an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals.

short_summary: Creates a revolving loan fund authority for the purpose of building renewable energy storage systems scaled to function as microgrids to power housing owned by the New York city housing authority
summary: Creates a revolving loan fund through the New York state energy research and development authority for the purpose of building renewable energy storage systems scaled to function as microgrids to power housing owned by the New York city housing authority.

short_summary: Requires the public service commission and the Long Island power authority to establish standards of acceptable performance for gas and electric corporations
summary: Requires the public service commission and the Long Island power authority to establish standards of acceptable performance for gas and electric corporations.

short_summary: Relates to advanced metering infrastructure devices for residential services
summary: Relates to advanced metering infrastructure devices for residential services.

short_summary: Relates to utility intervenor reimbursement
summary: Relates to utility intervenor reimbursement to a participant for its reasonable costs of participation in any proceeding before the Public Service Commission (PSC).

short_summary: Authorizes utility corporations, telegraph and telephone corporations, and cable television corporations to provide notice of bills to third parties
summary: Authorizes utility corporations, telegraph and telephone corporations, and cable television corporations to provide notice of bills to third parties at the request of the customer.

short_summary: Prohibits persons convicted of murder or sentenced to life without parole from being eligible for commutation of sentence
summary: Prohibits persons convicted of murder or sentenced to life without parole or where the defendant acting either alone or with one or more other persons, commits or attempts to commit robbery, burglary, kidnapping, arson, rape in the first degree, criminal sexual act in the first degree, sexual abuse in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse, escape in the first degree, or escape in the second degree, and, in the course of and in furtherance of such crime or of immediate flight therefrom, he or she, or another participant, if there be any, intentionally causes the death of: a police officer; a peace officer; a firefighter; emergency medical technician, ambulance driver, paramedic, physician or registered nurse involved in a first response team, or any other individual who, in the course of official duties, performs emergency response; or an employee of a state correctional institution or was an employee of a local correctional facility, when such person was engaged in the course of performing their official duties, from being eligible for commutation of sentence.

short_summary: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree or second degree and the victim is a police officer, peace officer, first responder or correctional officer
summary: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree or second degree and the victim is a police officer, peace officer, first responder or correctional officer.

short_summary: Relates to the amount of the indemnity bond or insurance required by common carrier ambulettes and paratransit vehicles
summary: Provides for a minimum indemnity bond or insurance policy of $500,000 required by certain common carrier ambulettes and paratransit vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to warranties and protections for purchasers of new and used motor vehicles
summary: Provides certain warranties and protections for purchasers of new and used motor vehicles; includes commercial and business purchasers under the Lemon Law.

short_summary: Relates to the duty of real estate brokers to supervise salespersons and associate brokers
summary: Codifies the duty of real estate brokers to supervise salespersons and associate brokers through regular, frequent and consistent personal guidance, instruction and oversight; lists elements of supervision including the ability to familiarize salespersons with state and federal laws against discrimination.

short_summary: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during certain declared states of emergency
summary: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during a declared state of emergency or disaster emergency where the declaration or proclamation of emergency includes a finding that unsolicited telemarketing sales calls would impair actions taken to limit, control, or mitigate the emergency; explains the basis of such finding; provides that such prohibition may not extend for a period of more than two weeks, subject to renewal for additional two-week periods by further findings of necessity made at the end of each two-week period.

short_summary: Establishes the people with disabilities access to programs commission
summary: Establishes the people with disabilities access to programs commission to examine, evaluate and make recommendations for new laws with respect to how the state should streamline eligibility requirements and processes for its programs and services to assist people with disabilities.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale of sodium nitrate in New York state
summary: Prohibits the sale of sodium nitrate to persons in New York state.

short_summary: Relates to the membership on the Nassau health care corporation board
summary: Relates to the membership on the Nassau health care corporation board; provides that the board of directors shall select the chair and the chief executive officer.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Trooper James M. MacLarnon Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in Nassau county as the "Trooper James M. MacLarnon Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to certain crimes committed by a person acting on behalf of a foreign actor
summary: Provides that acting on behalf of a foreign government shall be an element of certain crimes including coercion in the first degree, kidnapping in the first degree, stalking in the first degree, assault in the first degree, computer trespass, and aggravated harassment in the first degree.

short_summary: Requires serial numbers to be engraved or stamped on all catalytic converters sold in New York state
summary: Requires serial numbers to be engraved or stamped on all catalytic converters sold in New York state.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities to adopt a sales tax exemption for clothing and footwear after March first, two thousand twenty-three; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
summary: Authorizes municipalities to adopt a local law, ordinance or resolution providing for a sales tax exemption for clothing and footwear after March 1, 2023 and no later than August 1, 2023; provides for the repeal of such provisions on January 1, 2024.

short_summary: Relates to providing an additional ten percent credit on qualified labor expenses under the empire state film production and post production credits in Nassau and Suffolk counties
summary: Provides an additional ten percent credit on qualified labor expenses under the empire state film production credit and empire state film post production credit in Nassau and Suffolk counties.

short_summary: Relates to exemptions for potato storage and potato shipping facilities
summary: Exempts potato storage and potato shipping facilities permanently affixed to agricultural lands from taxation, special ad valorem levies and special assessments.

short_summary: Relates to taking big and small game by crossbow in Wyoming county
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to authorize the use of a crossbow for the taking of big and small game by any licensed person for use during the entirety of the archery-only season within Wyoming county.

short_summary: Relates to eligible purchases by school breakfast and lunch service programs receiving additional state subsidies
summary: Permits a school food authority to attribute moneys spent on purchases of food products from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors made for its school breakfast program to the thirty percent of costs for school breakfast and lunch service programs.

short_summary: Directs the New York state thruway authority to establish an electronic toll collection device for motor vehicles used by farms which grants a discount for use of the thruway
summary: Directs the New York state thruway authority to establish an electronic toll collection device for motor vehicles used by farms which grants a discount for use of the thruway.

short_summary: Relates to creating the veterinarians across rural New York state student loan repayment fund
summary: Relates to creating the veterinarians across rural New York state student loan repayment fund for certain veterinarians that make a two year commitment to practice in a tract or county defined by the health resources and services administration as being "rural" or eligible for a rural health grant.

short_summary: Relates to allowing a county to enter into a municipal cooperative agreement to provide joint emergency medical services
summary: Allows a county to enter into a municipal cooperative agreement with any municipal corporation, fire district, fire protection district, fire alarm district, or ambulance district within the county to provide joint emergency medical services.

short_summary: Relates to Medicaid reimbursement rates for rural home health care providers
summary: Increases Medicaid reimbursement rates for rural home health care providers to cover actual costs of delivery.

short_summary: Provides that an employer's unemployment experience rating account shall not be charged for a claimant whose employment was terminated as the result of the return of an employee after family leave
summary: Provides that an employer's unemployment experience rating account shall not be charged for a claimant whose employment was terminated as the result of the return of an employee after family leave.

short_summary: Relates to notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs
summary: Requires certain agencies and individuals to provide notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs to tenants upon the occurrence of certain events.

short_summary: Prohibits the possession and use of live ammunition at a film production facility or a qualified film production facility
summary: Prohibits the possession and use of live ammunition at a film production facility or a qualified film production facility; requires all persons employed or present at a film production facility or a qualified film production facility to receive proper training on the safe use, handling, storage and transportation of firearms.

short_summary: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state land therein
summary: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state lands in such town.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a first permanent payroll employee tax credit
summary: Establishes a first permanent payroll employee tax credit which allows a business to receive a tax credit for the three years following the employment of such business' first permanent payroll employee where such credit equals a portion of the amount it costs to employ such permanent payroll employee.

short_summary: Relates to recurring contributions solicited by a candidate, political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity
summary: Provides that entities soliciting a recurring contribution to a political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity shall receive the affirmative consent of the contributor at the time of arrangement of the recurring contribution; provides for refund of recurring contributions; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy
summary: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

short_summary: Permits union free and central school district boards of education to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections
summary: Authorizes the boards of education in union free school districts and central school districts to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections.

short_summary: Prohibits sex offenders whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a child care provider, preschool or any pre-kindergarten or kindergarten
summary: Prohibits a sex offender whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a child care provider, preschool or any facility where pre-kindergarten or kindergarten instruction is provided.

short_summary: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the same date as the state primaries
summary: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the same date as the state primaries.

short_summary: Relates to requiring electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidate who was nominated by the political party that nominated the presidential elector
summary: Requires electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidate who were nominated by the political party that nominated the presidential elector.

short_summary: Relates to uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage for police agencies
summary: Requires bodily injury be covered under supplementary uninsured/underinsured motorist insurance coverage for police vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to designating the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day"
summary: Designates the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day".

short_summary: Relates to the state and municipal facilities program
summary: Requires state and municipal facilities program grants be issued only with governor, senate or assembly sponsor.

short_summary: Relates to allowing additional or relocated motor vehicle dealers to be located within six or ten miles of one another when separated by the Hudson River
summary: Allows for additional or relocated motor vehicle dealers to be located within six or ten miles of one another when separated by the Hudson River.

short_summary: Permits union free and central school district boards of education to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County
summary: Authorizes the boards of education in union free school districts and central school districts to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of population for purposes of providing substantially equal weight for the population of that local government in the allocation of representation in the local legislative body
summary: Relates to the definition of "population" for purposes of providing substantially equal weight for the population of that local government in the allocation of representation in the local legislative body.

short_summary: Relates to prohibition of certain activities in extreme temperatures
summary: Prohibits a retail business from directing an employee to engage in human billboard activities during extreme temperatures.

short_summary: Enables high school students to use public transportation without charge in order to ride to and from school
summary: Enables high school students to use public transportation without charge in order to ride to and from school.

short_summary: Requires nursing certificate and degree education programs to include clinical education and allows for a portion of such clinical education to be completed through simulation experience
summary: Requires nursing certificate and degree education programs to include clinical education; allows for one-third of such clinical education to be completed through simulation experience.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a review of security of metropolitan transportation authority facilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a review and analysis of the security measures taken at the transportation facilities of the metropolitan transportation authority and its subsidiaries; requires such director to issue confidential reports of his or her findings and recommendations.

short_summary: Relates to detaining persons for longer than twenty-four hours
summary: Relates to detaining persons for longer than twenty-four hours.

short_summary: Prohibits the imposition of different premium rates for disability insurance based on gender
summary: Prohibits the imposition of different premium rates for disability insurance based on gender.

short_summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented five times within a twelve month period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications
summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented five times within a twelve month period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure of an operator thereof to comply with traffic-control indications for a period of six months.

short_summary: Relates to unlawful dealing in real property
summary: Relates to unlawful dealing in real property, when a person uses material governmental information, which he or she knows or has reason to know is non-public, to purchase or sell real property; makes such offense a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Provides that every schedule of rates of gas and electric corporations which is based on operation of over 18 months, shall be reviewed annually
summary: Provides that every gas or electric rate schedule, which is based on projections of revenues, expenditures and utility operations for more than 18 months, shall be annually reviewed by the public service commission; such review proceeding shall include all the parties involved in the proceeding at which such schedule was originally approved.

short_summary: Directs counties and the city of New York to contact a veterans' organization to provide for the disposition of the unclaimed remains of a deceased veteran
summary: Directs counties and the city of New York to contact a veterans' organization to provide for the disposition of the unclaimed remains of a deceased veteran when such veteran has no next of kin or other person designated to provide for the disposition of his or her remains; provides process.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit for qualified caregiving expenses
summary: Provides a tax credit for qualified caregiving expenses.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of a community renewable energy program
summary: Relates to the establishment of a community renewable energy program; directs the public service commission to evaluate a program to allow individuals to choose to receive energy generated from renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Relates to witness testimony before legislative committees via videoconferencing
summary: Relates to witness testimony before legislative committees via videoconferencing.

short_summary: Relates to defining community significant projects and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program
summary: Defines community significant projects as a business creating or retaining current jobs as determined by the commissioner, with particular emphasis on employment and/or training of current public housing residents; currently located or to be located in existing leased space of a building in a public housing development in the state; and which makes significant qualified capital investments to start a business, or improve services and working conditions for an existing business, when located in such public housing space and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program.

short_summary: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board
summary: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program for two years without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board.

short_summary: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions
summary: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions of the agriculture and markets law.

short_summary: Relates to providing for vacation of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated with a party, or has a financial interest in a party or the outcome
summary: Requires disclosure of possible conflicts; provides for the vacating of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated in any way with any party, or has a financial interest directly or indirectly in any party or in the outcome of the arbitration.

short_summary: Requires the department of education to study and report on the self-identified ethnicity and multilingual status of all licensed social workers
summary: Requires the department of education to study and report on the self-identified ethnicity and multilingual status of all licensed social workers and provide such report to the governor and legislature no later than one year after the effective date of this act.

short_summary: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students
summary: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students; requires record keeping and annual reporting; permits districts to jointly establish such programs.

short_summary: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies from requiring or requesting certain consumer information
summary: Relates to prohibiting consumer reporting agencies from requiring or requesting a copy of a consumer's social security card when furnishing consumer reports or investigative consumer reports to third parties.

short_summary: Relates to the removal of incarcerated individuals diagnosed with mental illness to a residential mental health treatment unit
summary: Relates to the removal of incarcerated individuals diagnosed with mental illness to a residential mental health treatment unit.

short_summary: Relates to the use of psychotropic medications in nursing homes and adult care facilities
summary: Relates to the use of antipsychotic medications in nursing homes;  imposes limits as to time and documentation; requires informed consent under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to incarcerated individuals wages
summary: Relates to incarcerated individuals wages; provides that incarcerated individuals shall be compensated at a base rate of $1.20 to $10 per day and shall be given biannual raises for adequate performance; provides that incarcerated individuals not participating in a work or program assignment due to age or frailty shall be paid $1.00 per day, adjusted every 5 years for cost of living.

short_summary: Relates to establishing minimum rules for the treatment of incarcerated individuals
summary: Relates to establishing minimum rules for the treatment of incarcerated individuals; provides that the United Nations standard minimum rules for the treatment of prisoners, also known as the Nelson Mandela rules, are hereby incorporated by reference.

short_summary: Relates to the automatic expungement of records of arrest
summary: Provides for the automatic expungement of records of arrest in certain situations.

short_summary: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public
summary: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public during law enforcement activities.

short_summary: Relates to assistance for burial arrangements
summary: Expands the maximum benefit and eligibility requirements for financial assistance for burial arrangements; provides for expedited assistance during a state disaster emergency.

short_summary: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system
summary: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system through which state agencies, local governmental entities, including law enforcement agencies, court systems, school districts, and emergency service providers, and other relevant persons are able to share and access information related to individuals who experience chronic homelessness in order to connect or refer such individuals to services including affordable housing opportunities.

short_summary: Relates to filing in surrogate's court
summary: Provides that a surrogate court clerk or chief clerk shall refuse to accept for filing papers filed in a proceeding only under certain circumstances or as designated in statute, administrative rule or order of the court; provides such reasons; requires the payment of any applicable statutory fees, or an order of the court waiving payment of such fees, before accepting a paper for filing; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to appeals of parole determination
summary: Relates to appeals of parole determination, including parole release interviews, parole decisions by the board and petitions regarding release decisions.

short_summary: Relates to the recertification process for firearms
summary: Relates to the recertification process for firearms.

short_summary: Requires police to advise persons under 18 years of age to their rights to silence and to any attorney before any custodial interrogation
summary: Requires police to advise persons under 18 years of age of their rights to silence and to an attorney before any custodial interrogation.

short_summary: Relates to certain assault crimes which include the aid or encouragement of additional persons
summary: Relates to certain assault crimes wherein a person is aided or encouraged to strike the victim in the head and cause unconsciousness.

short_summary: Establishes the kinship legal network program in the office of children and family services
summary: Establishes the kinship legal network program in the office of children and family services to provide legal services to kinship caregivers.

short_summary: Prohibits the at large election of any member of the governing or legislative body of a town or village by electors of such town or village; repealer
summary: Prohibits the at large election of any member of the governing or legislative body of a town or village by electors of such town or village; requires the election of such members by wards.

short_summary: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office
summary: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office; directs such office shall provide information to legislative committees of the senate and assembly with respect to the state budget, appropriation bills and other bills providing budget authority or tax expenditures; requires such office to report to the temporary president of the senate, the senate minority leader, the speaker of the assembly and the assembly minority leader.

short_summary: Prevents nonresident race horse owners from avoiding use tax in certain situations; repealer
summary: Repeals certain provisions relating to use tax exemptions for certain race horses; prevents nonresident race horse owners from avoiding use tax in certain situations.

short_summary: Authorizes United States citizens currently residing outside the United States whose last residence was in NY to vote in certain federal elections
summary: Authorizes United States citizens currently residing outside the United States whose last residence in the United States was in the state of New York to vote in certain federal elections.

short_summary: Relates to the limited credit time allowances for certain incarcerated individuals
summary: Increases the limited credit time allowances for certain incarcerated individuals serving indeterminate or determinate sentences imposed for specified offenses up to twenty-four months.

short_summary: Relates to employer liability for on-duty assaults of employees
summary: Provides that if any employee, engaged in the service of any commuter rail service owned or operated by the authority or its subsidiaries, shall suffer a physical and/or mental injury that is caused by a passenger, customer or member of the public while the employee is performing an assigned duty, the employer shall be held liable for any health care costs attributable to such injury; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures
summary: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures, with each report covering activity from the prior six months.

short_summary: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot
summary: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot to include an additional 1,200 users.

short_summary: Directs the New York State Department of Transportation to promulgate rules and regulations for the standardization of public charging stations for electric vehicles
summary: Directs the New York State Department of Transportation, in conjunction with the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority and the New York Power Authority, to promulgate rules and regulations for the standardization of public charging stations for electric vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the New York state kratom consumer protection act
summary: Relates to enacting the New York state kratom consumer protection act; relates to labeling and other requirements for the sale of kratom products.

short_summary: Requires NYSERDA to develop a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan
summary: Establishes a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan; requires the New York state energy and research development authority to further establish a "Fast Charge NY working group" to develop such plan; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the maintenance of abandoned cemeteries
summary: Relates to the maintenance of abandoned cemeteries; authorizes a solvent not-for-profit cemetery corporation that merges with an abandoned cemetery in a city to apply for state funds for the maintenance of an abandoned cemetery.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting illegal dumping on public property
summary: Prohibits illegal dumping on public property; provides a reward for any evidence which leads to a fine for illegal dumping.

short_summary: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; repealer
summary: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; requires public authorities to send a notice to owners upon incurring an obligation to pay a toll; provides for the adjudication of such liability and defenses to an allegation of liability; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to responsibility for cable bills after a disconnection or downgrade in service
summary: Relates to responsibility for cable bills after a disconnection or downgrade in service; provides that customers requesting a disconnection or downgrade in service shall only be liable for services incurred up to the date the disconnection or downgrade is effective.

short_summary: Provides that an elementary or secondary student shall not have capacity to consent to sexual conduct with a school employee
summary: Provides that a full time elementary or secondary school student shall not have capacity to consent to sexual conduct with a school employee at his or her school or a co-located school, including volunteers, when the employee is 18 or older and more than 4 years older than such student at the time of the act and knows or should reasonably have known that the student was a student at the school or a co-located school, and such employee is not a full time student at such school, nor married to such student.

short_summary: Relates to the classification of historical lands and buildings located within the forest preserve
summary: Relates to the classification of historical lands and buildings located within the forest preserve.

short_summary: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home in rural areas
summary: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home and to manage the nursing home benefit in one or more rural areas.

short_summary: Allows an authorized organization to receive a license to hold a game of chance on Easter Sunday and Christmas Day
summary: Allows an authorized organization to receive a license to hold a game of chance on Easter Sunday and Christmas Day; eliminates time restrictions for such games held on a Sunday.

short_summary: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days
summary: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity
summary: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity.

short_summary: Requires public vessels which carry passengers to be covered by insurance or a surety bond covering injury or death to the passengers
summary: Requires public vessels which carry passengers to be covered by insurance or a surety bond covering injury or death to the passengers.

short_summary: Repeals sections of law relating to private roads
summary: Relates to private roads; repeals various provisions relating to the application for the creation of a private road.

short_summary: Provides for the expungement of syringe convictions
summary: Relates to the expungement of syringe convictions of criminally possessing a hypodermic instrument.

short_summary: Provides for coverage for certain prescription drugs in Medicaid managed care programs; repealer
summary: Provides for coverage for certain medically necessary prescription drugs in Medicaid managed care programs.

short_summary: Prohibits cost sharing for insulin
summary: Prohibits cost sharing for insulin; provides that an insured shall not be subject to a deductible, copayment, coinsurance or any other cost sharing requirement for the purchase of insulin.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the health department's review of correctional health services
summary: Expands the health department's review of correctional health services by including a biennial study of health care staffing at facilities operated by the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Enacts "Vincent Scheppa's law" authorizing, in certain cases, the provision of private duty nursing services to a medical assistance recipient by a relative who is a registered professional nurse
summary: Enacts "Vincent Scheppa's law" authorizing, in certain cases, the provision of private duty nursing services to a medical assistance recipient by a relative who is a registered professional nurse.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of the wellness program privacy act
summary: Establishes the wellness program privacy act; requires employers and insurers to take certain measures to protect the security of wellness program participants' private information.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the use or access of the TikTok application on state-issued electronic devices
summary: Prohibits the use or access of the TikTok application on state-issued electronic devices.

short_summary: Requires restaurants that offer online delivery services to post on their website or mobile application a hyperlink to view recent sanitary inspection grades, on their website
summary: Requires restaurants that offer online delivery services via the internet or mobile application to post on their website or mobile application a hyperlink to view recent sanitary inspection grades on their website.

short_summary: Relates to a tax credit for employers who contribute to a college choice tuition savings account on behalf of an employee
summary: Creates a tax credit for employers who contribute to a college choice tuition savings account on behalf of an employee.

short_summary: Requires travel consultants and travel promoters to be registered with the department of state, and provides for the regulation thereof
summary: Requires travel consultants and travel promoters to be registered with the department of state; provides for the regulation thereof.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a housing task force to address affordable housing for millennials
summary: Establishes a housing task force addressing affordable housing for millennials in suburban counties to provide a continuing forum to discuss concerns and issues related to the formulation of state policy designed to help address this issue.

short_summary: Relates to establishing certain cultural and religious observances as school holidays in certain districts
summary: Relates to establishing Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Diwali, Lunar New Year, Tihar, Bandi Chhor Divas and Onam as school holidays.

short_summary: Relates to requiring manufacturers of smart speakers to obtain permission from users before storing recordings
summary: Requires manufacturers of smart speakers to obtain signed written permission from users before storing voice recordings.

short_summary: Relates to requiring additional licensed pharmacists to be on staff during any period in which more than two hundred prescriptions are dispensed
summary: Requires at least two licensed pharmacists to be on staff in a pharmacy during any period in which more than two hundred prescriptions are dispensed.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale or provision of any quantity of electronic liquid used to refill an electronic cigarette or cartridge
summary: Prohibits the sale or provision of any quantity of electronic liquid used to refill an electronic cigarette or cartridge.

short_summary: Relates to allowing semitrailers to register as an agriculture trailer
summary: Allows semitrailers to register as an agriculture trailer.

short_summary: Provides a fine for a person responsible for a trailer or semitrailer parked or left unattended in New York city
summary: Provides a fine of one thousand dollars for a person responsible for a trailer or semitrailer parked or left unattended in a city with a population of one million or more; makes certain exceptions.

short_summary: Increases the fine for tractor-trailer combinations that park on residential streets overnight
summary: Provides for increased fines for overnight parking of tractor-trailer combinations, tractors, truck trailers and semi-trailers on residential streets in the city of New York.

short_summary: Prohibits individuals in certain positions from taking any position with a business or entity doing business with an agency or industrial development authority
summary: Prohibits individuals in certain positions from taking any position with a business or entity doing business with an agency or industrial development authority.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions relating to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board
summary: Relates to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the Metropolitan transportation authority to hold an annual public seminar on new innovations
summary: Requires the Metropolitan transportation authority to hold an annual public seminar on new innovations that provide opportunities to discover new and emerging methods as such relate to the purpose of the Metropolitan transportation authority.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of New York to establish a residential parking system in the postal designation and area of Queens village near the UBS arena
summary: Authorizes the city of New York to establish a residential parking system in the postal designation and area of Queens village near the USB arena.

short_summary: Expands hepatitis C screening testing
summary: Expands hepatitis C screening testing.

short_summary: Authorizes Kim Bowers to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes Kim Bowers to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system for her employment with the town of Orchard Park Zoning Board of Appeals.

short_summary: Requires a recording officer not to record or accept a transfer or assignment of interest in a mortgage unless accompanied with a mortgage ownership assignment
summary: Requires a recording officer not to record or accept a transfer or assignment of interest in a mortgage unless accompanied with a mortgage ownership assignment document.

short_summary: Authorizes political subdivisions to establish demonstration programs implementing railroad grade crossing monitoring systems by means of photo devices
summary: Authorizes political subdivisions to establish demonstration programs implementing railroad grade crossing monitoring systems by means of photo devices.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a cause of action for medical monitoring
summary: Establishes a cause of action for medical monitoring for a person with or without a present injury or disease; establishes a statute of limitation for such cause of action.

short_summary: Requires degree-granting institutions of higher education to make certain biennial disclosures
summary: Requires degree-granting institutions of higher education to make certain biennial disclosures and to conspicuously publish the report on the website of such institution and submit the website address of such report to the department.

short_summary: Relates to the cancellation of a health club contract
summary: Requires health club contracts to allow a buyer to cancel with thirty days' notice; allows a buyer to submit a notice of cancellation by electronic mail in addition to in person, by phone or by mail; requires a health club to accept notice of cancellation via website if such contract was entered into via website; decreases the time necessary for a disability cancellation from six months to three months.

short_summary: Relates to the admissibility into evidence of statements in learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets
summary: Permits the admissibility into evidence of statements in learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets if the statement is called to the attention of an expert witness and the publication is established as a reliable authority by the expert's admission or testimony, by another expert's testimony, or by judicial notice.

short_summary: Relates to enforcement of fair housing
summary: Authorizes the commissioner of human rights to enforce provisions relating to real estate brokers and unlawful discriminatory practices; awards compensatory damages to the aggrieved person; assesses a civil penalty to vindicate the public interest; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the liability of payroll processing companies
summary: Relates to the liability of payroll processing companies; provides that payroll processing companies that intentionally and wrongfully prevent the distribution of payroll shall be liable to employees that failed to receive an expected payment for an amount up to three times the expected amount; provides an action to recover damages may be maintained as a class action.

short_summary: Grants Federal Bureau of Investigation police certain peace officer powers
summary: Grants Federal Bureau of Investigation police certain peace officer powers.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the intergenerational poverty mitigation act
summary: Relates to enacting the intergenerational poverty mitigation act; creates a commission to study intergenerational poverty and a pilot program to address intergenerational poverty subject to appropriation.

short_summary: Relates to research and restricting advertisement and promotion of electronic cigarettes
summary: Prohibits clauses restricting certain research and restricts advertisement and promotion of electronic cigarettes.

short_summary: Relates to falsely reporting an incident and falsifying business records by law enforcement officers
summary: Provides that false reporting and falsifying business records by law enforcement officers shall be felonies.

short_summary: Relates to certain real estate syndication offerings
summary: Exempts certain timesharing plans involving ten or fewer purchasers from certain filing requirements relating to real estate investments; excludes New York City.

short_summary: Increases allowable maximum income of certain persons otherwise eligible for tax abatement in the county of Nassau
summary: Increases allowable maximum income of certain persons otherwise eligible for tax abatement in the county of Nassau.

short_summary: Relates to business protection for point-of-sale equipment leases
summary: Enacts provisions relating to the lease of credit card terminals; requires disclosures; prohibits certain practices.

short_summary: Enacts the Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act
summary: Enacts the "Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act"; relates to the delegation of state enforcement authority to private actors; authorizes an affected employee, whistleblower, representative organization or an organizational deputy to initiate a public enforcement action on behalf of the commissioner for certain provisions of the labor law, or any regulation promulgated thereunder.

short_summary: Establishes the University of the State of New York environmental sustainability office
summary: Establishes the university of the state of New York environmental sustainability office to lead the coordination, planning and implementation of policies, programs, and processes to fulfill the university's sustainability obligations and targets cohesively, across all university campuses, and at the system level.

short_summary: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income
summary: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income; removes exclusion of gains on property in qualified opportunity zones in calculation of income.

short_summary: Prohibits the purchase of more than 1 firearm during any period of 30 days
summary: Establishes the class A misdemeanor of unlawful procurement of a firearm, for the purchase or acquisition of more than 1 firearm during any period of 30 days.

short_summary: Prohibits confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions from inclusion in certain contracts entered into by the state or a municipality
summary: Prohibits confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions from inclusion in contracts pertaining to economic development, entered into by the state or a municipality or any party negotiating on behalf of such governmental entity.

short_summary: Enacts the NYCHA utility accountability act
summary: Enacts the "NYCHA utility accountability act"; requires the NYCHA to provide a rent reduction to tenants who experience a disruption in utility service.

short_summary: Directs the comptroller of the city of New York to conduct annual audits of compliance with the affordable New York housing program
summary: Directs the comptroller of the city of New York to conduct annual audits of compliance with the affordable New York housing program.

short_summary: Provides a deceased tenant's legal representative the option to terminate such tenant's lease upon notice to the landlord
summary: Provides a deceased tenant's legal representative the option to terminate such tenant's lease upon notice to the landlord.

short_summary: Relates to recovery of overpayments of unemployment benefits; repealer
summary: Provides that any claimant who has received certain unemployment benefits to which they were not entitled shall not be held liable for the amounts overpaid provided certain conditions exist; directs the department of labor to provide claimants who have previously been denied waivers with applications for individual waivers; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to the safe operation and maintenance of all elementary and secondary school science laboratories
summary: Relates to the safe operation and maintenance of all elementary and secondary school science laboratories.

short_summary: Relates to the purchase of firearms and firearm ammunition with a credit card
summary: Requires credit card, debit card, or processor service companies to allow for the purchase of firearms and firearm ammunition with such services.

short_summary: Relates to permitting certain federal law enforcement officers and retired officers to possess firearms, rifles and shotguns in restricted and sensitive locations
summary: Permits certain federal law enforcement officers and retired officers to possess firearms, rifles and shotguns in restricted and sensitive locations.

short_summary: Relates to the use of telematics systems by automobile insurers
summary: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates and/or discounts.

short_summary: Relates to the continuation of the empire state stem cell board
summary: Relates to the continuation of the empire state stem cell board.

short_summary: Enacts the New York city department of buildings community accountability act
summary: Enacts the New York city department of buildings community accountability act.

short_summary: Relates to the liability of a person who makes or uses a false record or statement material to an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law
summary: Relates to the liability of a person who makes or uses a false record or statement material to an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law, or who conceals or improperly avoids or decreases an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law.

short_summary: Relates to amending sex offenses and consent involving members of the clergy
summary: Amends provisions about sex offenses and consent involving members of the clergy or other ministers of any religion or duly accredited Christian science practitioners.

short_summary: Increases the dollar value of items that may legally be given or provided to any person, other than poll workers and authorized representatives, at a polling place
summary: Increases the dollar value of items that may legally be given or provided to any person, other than persons who are official representatives of the board of elections or political parties and committees and persons who are engaged as watchers, in a polling place without any identification of the person or entity supplying such provisions.

short_summary: Provides that the Empire Station Complex project and the Empire Penn Expansion shall be subject to and shall comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure
summary: Provides that the Empire Station Complex project and the Empire Penn Expansion shall be subject to and shall comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure.

short_summary: Authorizes oaths to be remotely administered by notaries public to witnesses in legal proceedings
summary: Authorizes oaths to be remotely administered by notaries public to witnesses in legal proceedings, provided that the parties stipulate to such remote administration or the witness can present a photographic identification.

short_summary: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees
summary: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the second degree and leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first degree.

short_summary: Enacts the "all-electric building act"
summary: Enacts the "all-electric building act"; provides that the state energy conservation construction code shall prohibit infrastructure, building systems, or equipment used for the combustion of fossil fuels in new construction statewide no later than December 31, 2023 if the building is less than seven stories and July 1, 2027 if the building is seven stories or more.

short_summary: Repeals paragraph 9 of subdivision a of section 26-405 of the administrative code of the city of New York, relating to hearings regarding biennial maximum base rent adjustments
summary: Relates to hearings regarding biennial maximum base rent adjustments.

short_summary: Relates to mortgage loan servicers
summary: Provides that any person who has been injured by reason of any violation of any such rules, regulations or policies as the superintendent may promulgate may bring an action in his or her own name; assert a counterclaim; or, if an action is commenced by the mortgagee or anyone acting on its behalf, bring a third party claim, against either the mortgagee and/or the mortgage servicer to enjoin any violations thereof; authorizes damages; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to third-party food delivery service charges
summary: Prohibits third-party food delivery services from charging a food service establishment a delivery fee or other fees that total more than a certain percent of the total purchase price of an online order.

short_summary: Establishes the sustainable affordable housing incentive program
summary: Establishes the sustainable affordable housing incentive program to provide assistance in the form of payments, grants and loans for reasonable and necessary expenses to an eligible applicant for sustainable housing activities; defines terms.

short_summary: Allows a person to institute an action for a violation of the provisions of the environmental quality review even if the injury does not affect the public at large
summary: Prevents individuals from being denied standing in private actions alleging violations of the environmental quality review provisions of the environmental conservation law solely on the basis that the injury alleged by such individual does not differ in kind or degree from the injury that would be suffered by the public at large.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program
summary: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program; provides that the commissioner of the division of housing and community renewal shall implement a program of rental assistance in the form of housing vouchers for eligible individuals and families who are homeless or who face an imminent loss of housing; provides that the commissioner shall designate housing access voucher local administrators in the state to administer the program.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a maximum rent of one-third of household income for the senior citizens rent increase exemption and disability rent increase exemption
summary: Relates to establishing a maximum rent of one-third of household income for the senior citizens rent increase exemption and disability rent increase exemption.

short_summary: Prohibits a consumer reporting agency or lender from using an individual's internet viewing history to determine such individual's credit worthiness
summary: Prohibits a consumer reporting agency or lender from using an individual's internet use or internet viewing history to determine such individual's credit worthiness.

short_summary: Relates to restrictions on political contributions by lobbyists
summary: Restricts form, amount and time of political contributions by lobbyists and the acceptance of such contributions by public officials.

short_summary: Provides for establishment of school speed limits by county legislative body
summary: Provides for the establishment of school speed limits of not less than fifteen miles per hour by the legislative body of any county or, if so delegated, by the legislative body of any locality within said county on a portion of a state highway, county or town road passing a school building.

short_summary: Expands the residential-commercial exemption program to include any municipality regardless of the population of the county in which it is located
summary: Expands the residential-commercial exemption program to include any municipality regardless of the population of the county in which it is located.

short_summary: Relates to the appropriation for funds for the training of firefighters
summary: Relates to the appropriation of funds for the training of firefighters.

short_summary: Relates to the powers and duties of the comptroller to correct certain administrative errors
summary: Provides a corrective remedy for certain administrative errors, omissions or inaccuracies relating to membership and benefits under the retirement system.

short_summary: Exempts lemonade stands operated by persons under sixteen years of age from department of health permitting requirements
summary: Exempts lemonade stands operated by persons under sixteen years of age from department of health permitting requirements.

short_summary: Prohibits the knowing and reckless promotion of unlawful or false material and providing remedies for the violation of such prohibition
summary: Prohibits the knowing and reckless promotion of unlawful or false material; provides remedies for the violation of such prohibition.

short_summary: Eliminates the requirement that certain papers, records and documents relating to the misconduct or discipline of attorneys be sealed
summary: Eliminates the requirement that certain papers, records and documents relating to the misconduct or discipline of attorneys be sealed.

short_summary: Provides an exception to qualification for the small business seed funding grant program for independent arts contractors
summary: Provides an exception to qualification for the small business seed funding grant program for independent arts contractors.

short_summary: Relates to the provision of and payment for violence prevention programs
summary: Makes community violence prevention services available, to the extent permitted by federal law, to any Medicaid beneficiary who has received medical treatment for an injury sustained as a result of an act of community violence and has been referred by a certified or licensed health care provider or social services provider to receive community violence prevention services from a qualified violence prevention professional.

short_summary: Requires public housing authorities with housing complexes containing one hundred or more units to provide food and drinking water for all tenants in the affected buildings each day of a water service disruption
