short_summary: Relates to the establishment and priorities of the New York state council on hunger and food policy
summary: Clarifies the provisions relating to the establishment and priorities of the New York state council on hunger and food policy.

short_summary: Relates to window coverings required in child day care centers
summary: Relates to window coverings required in child day care centers; requires child day care centers to ensure that all window and door blind cords, ropes, wires and other strangulation hazards are secured and inaccessible to children in accordance with the regulations of the office of children and family services.

short_summary: Relates to the availability of training for state approved education or training programs required for certification of home health aides, personal care aides, and certified nurse aides
summary: Requires state approved education or training programs required for certification or recertification of home health aides, personal care aides, and certified nurse aides to include training in working with patients of diverse sexual orientations and gender identities or expressions within twelve months; eliminates the requirement of such training for personal care staff.

short_summary: Excludes certain runaway youths from being able to consent to certain medical, dental health and hospital services
summary: Excludes certain runaway youths from being able to consent to certain medical, dental, health and hospital services.

short_summary: Amends the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2022 amending the insurance law relating to the provision of supplemental spousal liability insurance
summary: Amends the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2022 amending the insurance law relating to the provision of supplemental spousal liability insurance to persons who are insured for loss resulting from the ownership, maintenance and use of a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to the carpet collection program
summary: Relates to the carpet collection program; defines "carpet collection program" as a program financed and implemented by producers, either individually, or through a representative organization, that provides for, but is not limited to, the collection, transportation, reuse, recycling, proper end-of-life management, or an appropriate combination thereof, of discarded carpet; extends the deadlines of certain provisions of law; makes technical corrections.

short_summary: Relates to guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in nightlife establishments; repealer
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in nightlife establishments; repeals provisions establishing the nightlife opioid antagonist program.

short_summary: Provides for patient prescription pricing transparency; repealer
summary: Provides for patient prescription pricing transparency; requires certain insurers or pharmacy benefit managers to furnish required cost, benefit and coverage data upon request of the insured, the insured's health care provider or an authorized third party.

short_summary: Protects the confidentiality of vaccine information; repealer
summary: Protects the confidentiality of vaccine information; relates to the sharing of vaccine registry information; provides that anyone requiring an immunization passport shall accept a valid COVID-19 Vaccination Record Card.

short_summary: Clarifies provisions related to a registration system for contractors and subcontractors engaged in public work and covered projects
summary: Clarifies provisions related to a registration system for contractors and subcontractors engaged in public work and covered projects.

short_summary: Relates to requiring space for donate life registration in the initial process setting up an online member service portal with an insurer
summary: Requires space for donate life registration in the initial process setting up an online member service portal with an insurer.

short_summary: Relates to the percentage responsibility of the state for federally assisted projects
summary: Relates to the percentage responsibility of the state for federally assisted projects; relates to the state share of municipal projects where the municipality funds a complete street design.

short_summary: Relates to minority and women-owned business enterprise fraud and the monies of the minority and women-owned business enterprise fund
summary: Relates to minority and women-owned business enterprise fraud and the monies of the minority and women-owned business enterprise fund; and to the effectiveness of certain provisions related thereto.

short_summary: Exempts real property of an applicable battery park city property from payments in lieu of taxes
summary: Makes clarifying changes to the exemption of real property of an applicable battery park city property from payments in lieu of taxes (PILOT).

short_summary: Relates to contracts for excellence in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants
summary: Provides that in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants, a plan developed in collaboration with the collective bargaining units representing teachers and the principals beginning in September 2022 and signed off on by the chancellor and the presidents of each bargaining unit, to reduce class sizes beginning September 2023 and to be achieved by September 2028 for all classes; requires a report on or before November 15, 2023 and on or before November 15th of each year thereafter; further requires the city school district to submit a financial impact statement on November 15, 2025.

short_summary: Authorizes the delivery of liquefied petroleum gas in times of emergency
summary: Requires when delivery is made of liquefied petroleum gas in times of emergency the temporary emergency supplier shall provide written information to the regular supplier; prohibits removing or filling liquefied petroleum gas without consent of the owner.

short_summary: Relates to infection updates and infection control planning in residential health care facilities
summary: Requires nursing homes to follow Federal CDC or medicare and medicaid guidance relating to infectious disease control planning and procedures.

short_summary: Relates to showcasing pets for adoption
summary: Allows reasonable rental fees to be charged by a retail pet shop for showcasing dogs, cats, or rabbits for adoption; adjusts the effectiveness of the prohibition of the sale of dogs, cats and rabbits from pet shops.

short_summary: Relates to a natural fiber textile development workgroup
summary: Creates a natural fiber textile development workgroup to study and identify methods of advancing the animal and plant based textile industry in this state.

short_summary: Relates to the recognition of the establishment of a workplace safety committee by an employer
summary: Requires an employer to recognize the establishment of a workplace safety committee within fifteen business days.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for in-service training programs for code enforcement personnel
summary: Modifies the requirements for in-service training programs designed to assist code enforcement personnel in maintaining skills and being informed of technological advances.

short_summary: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses
summary: Provides for oversight of the use of mandatory overtime during an emergency.

short_summary: Establishes the warehouse worker protection act
summary: Makes clarifications to the provisions of the warehouse worker protection act.

short_summary: Relates to the accessibility of congressional, senatorial, assembly and election district maps
summary: Relates to the accessibility of congressional, senatorial, assembly and election district maps in downloadable digital file formats compatible with geographic information (GIS) software.

short_summary: Relates to pharmacists administering medications approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration
summary: Relates to pharmacists administering medications approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

short_summary: Relates to the veterans memorial registry
summary: Authorizes public requests for information from any county, city, town, or village desiring to have a memorial located within their municipality listed within the veterans memorial registry; directs the department of veterans' services to establish a veterans memorial registry.

short_summary: Clarifies provisions related to a state-level program of all-inclusive care for the elderly
summary: Clarifies provisions related to a state-level program of all-inclusive care for the elderly.

short_summary: Repeals provisions relating to prescription digital therapeutics
summary: Repeals provisions relating to prescription digital therapeutics which are software-based disease treatments.

short_summary: Establishes the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary
summary: Establishes the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary; establishes uses for the sanctuary, including the limited use of certain boats; repeals provisions prohibiting boating in the Flax Pond tidal wetlands sanctuary.

short_summary: Establishes a threshold for the amount of work needed to be performed by a preferred source which is an approved charitable non-profit-making agency for the blind; provides for the repeal upon expiration thereof
summary: Requires that when the state is purchasing commodities and such commodities are available and purchased from approved charitable non-profit-making agencies for the blind, the preferred source shall perform fifty percent or more of the work.

short_summary: Relates to the amount of lottery winnings and prizes which are excluded from of a school district's adjusted gross income
summary: Provides that state lottery and video lottery gaming individual prizes in excess of one million dollars when aggregated exceeds twenty-five percent of a district's adjusted gross income shall be excluded from such district's adjusted gross income for the year.

short_summary: Relates to training of a forensic evaluator in relation to court ordered forensic evaluations involving child custody and visitation
summary: Relates to mandatory training of a forensic evaluator in relation to court ordered forensic evaluations involving child custody and visitation when the child is living out-of-state and is farther than one hundred miles from the New York state border; relates to training in the prevention and intervention of domestic violence required for forensic investigators.

short_summary: Relates to the use of profits from commissaries or canteens in county correctional facilities
summary: Allows county correctional facilities to use the profits from commissaries or canteens within the facilities for the general purposes of the institution.

short_summary: Relates to disallowing sentences of intermittent imprisonment when the court is imposing a sentence for a sex offense
summary: Relates to disallowing sentences of intermittent imprisonment when the court is imposing a sentence for a sex offense.

short_summary: Relates to security and protection of New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers
summary: Relates to security and protection of New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers; provides that personnel be permitted to carry a firearm.

short_summary: Creates a definition of residence under the sex offender registry act
summary: Defines residence under the sex offender registry act.

short_summary: Relates to eliminating certain surcharges for the licensing of service dogs
summary: Allows municipalities to eliminate the surcharge for the licensing of service dogs relating to animal population control efforts.

short_summary: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance
summary: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance.

short_summary: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs
summary: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs.

short_summary: Relates to gun license applications not containing warnings
summary: Requires that no applications, or the literature given therewith, shall be approved, distributed or used in any capacity if they contain an explicit written warning regarding ownership or use of a firearm.

short_summary: Enacts the "red tape reduction act"
summary: Requires that new administrative rules that imposes a new administrative burden on a business shall be offset by the repeal of an existing rule.

short_summary: Relates to a constitutional right to hunt, trap and fish
summary: Relates to the right to hunt, trap and fish; provides for regulation by the state.

short_summary: Establishes the community college merit and mobility scholarship
summary: Establishes the community college merit and mobility scholarship for the purpose of granting merit based scholarships to students who attend a New York state community college; provides for eligibility and awards.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the building inspector in the town of Pendleton, county of Niagara, to reside outside of such town
summary: Relates to authorizing the building inspector in the town of Pendleton, county of Niagara, to reside outside of such town.

short_summary: Relates to reading and posting in public schools excerpts of the writings and documents regarding American heritage
summary: Requires the regents to promulgate rules to allow and encourage the reading and posting in public schools excerpts of the writings and documents regarding American heritage.

short_summary: Relates to county reimbursement for detention costs
summary: Requires the state to reimburse counties for costs incurred when holding parolees in detention facilities for technical parole violations pending a hearing with their parole officer.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
summary: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy; provides the city of Lockport shall notify all owners or known interested parties of record of the placement of the code violations on the city tax levy as uncollected fines and penalties within thirty days of placement.

short_summary: Relates to providing valid government issued photo identification when casting a ballot
summary: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card be presented when casting a ballot; provides for persons eligible for Medicaid to receive identification cards.

short_summary: Relates to the enforcement of a judgment against certain trust and annuities in the case of minor victims of sexual abuse
summary: Permits the enforcement of a judgment against certain trust and annuities in the case of minor victims of sexual abuse.

short_summary: Relates to the adjudication of parking infractions
summary: Relates to the adjudication of parking infractions.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the metropolitan transportation authority from promulgating rules or regulations that penalize a student for using a student MetroCard when school is not in session
summary: Relates to prohibiting the metropolitan transportation authority from promulgating rules or regulations that penalize a student for using a student MetroCard when school is not in session.

short_summary: Relates to culturally responsive teaching
summary: Requires the department of education to establish professional development programs in culturally responsive instruction and provide access to those programs on its website.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the crime of larceny by cyber extortion
summary: Relates to establishing the crime of larceny by cyber extortion which occurs when a person intends to obtain property from another person or entity located in the state of New York through the use of certain malicious software.

short_summary: Relates to the receipt of catalytic converters by junk dealers and scrap dealers
summary: Places limitations on transactions involving the sale of catalytic converters to junk dealers, junk yard owners or operators, or scrap metal processors or scrap metal processing facilities; relates to record keeping relating to transactions involving the sale of catalytic converters.

short_summary: Establishes an Alzheimer's disease outreach and education program
summary: Establishes an Alzheimer's disease outreach and education program for medical and non-medical professionals to promote earlier identification of Alzheimer's and to provide information and other assistance in finding community support for caregivers.

short_summary: Directs the office for the aging and the department of economic development to expand encore entrepreneurship in the state, to empower individuals fifty years of age or older to establish small businesses
summary: Directs the office for the aging and the department of economic development to expand encore entrepreneurship in the state, to empower individuals fifty years of age or older to establish small businesses.

short_summary: Regulates short-term residential rentals
summary: Relates to short-term residential rentals of private dwellings in certain municipalities; requires registration and records.

short_summary: Creates the district long-term care ombudsman council program
summary: Creates the district long-term care ombudsman council program to coordinate volunteer ombudsmen in each assembly district.

short_summary: Establishes a dementia and Alzheimer's disease program database
summary: Establishes a dementia and Alzheimer's disease program database.

short_summary: Enacts the Restrict Insurrectionists from Office Taking (RIOT) Act
summary: Prohibits a person convicted of rebellion or insurrection against the authority of the United States or the laws thereof under 18 U.S.C. Section 2383 from holding civil office in the state.

short_summary: Requires annual reports of legal settlement payments related to law enforcement activity
summary: Requires annual reports of legal settlement payments related to law enforcement activity; provides such report shall include, but not be limited to, monetary amounts, plaintiffs and named parties, and shall be published on the website of the comptroller.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain child passengers in a taxi or livery to be restrained by a child restraint system
summary: Requires that no person under four years of age shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained by a child restraint system; requires that no person four years of age or older but under age eight shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained in an appropriate child restraint system; establishes violations of such provisions shall be punished by a civil fine of up to fifty dollars.

short_summary: Relates to drivers of buses, taxis and livery vehicles using hands-free mobile telephones
summary: Prohibits drivers of a bus, taxi or livery from using hands-free mobile telephones; provides for certain exceptions.

short_summary: Requires that certain motor vehicles shall be equipped with operable carbon monoxide detectors
summary: Requires that for hire vehicles with a chassis which was manufactured and then altered for the purpose of transporting ten or more occupants, including the driver, be equipped with an operable carbon monoxide detector.

short_summary: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment
summary: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment.

short_summary: Prohibits the issuance of a permit for the construction of a new multiple dwelling unless the multiple dwelling contains the minimum number of dwelling units required for the lot
summary: Prohibits the issuance of a permit for the construction of a new multiple dwelling unless the multiple dwelling contains the minimum number of dwelling units required for the lot; defines minimum number of units required.

short_summary: Requires disclosure of certain social media terms of service
summary: Requires social media companies to post terms of service for each social media platform owned or operated by the company in a manner reasonably designed to inform all users of the social media platform of the existence and contents of the terms of service; requires social media companies to submit to the attorney general certain terms of service reports; provides remedies for violations.

short_summary: Relates to the use of campaign funds for attorney's fees
summary: Prohibits the use of campaign funds to pay attorney's fees for certain actions brought against a candidate or public official.

short_summary: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act
summary: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act requiring certain business entities within the state to annually disclose scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 emissions; establishes the climate accountability and emissions disclosure fund.

short_summary: Directs the department of labor to study the impact of long COVID on employees and on the labor market
summary: Directs the department of labor to study the impact of long COVID on employees and on the labor market; directs the department of labor to issue a report of its findings and recommendations to the governor, the speaker of the assembly and the temporary president of the senate and to publish such report on its website within one year.

short_summary: Establishes the teachers' fossil fuel divestment act
summary: Establishes the teachers' fossil fuel divestment act; requires the New York state teachers' retirement system to divest the retirement system of any stocks, securities, equities, assets, or other obligations of corporations or companies included on an exclusion list of coal producers and oil and gas producers.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of aversive conditioning and other certain punishments
summary: Prohibits the use of aversive conditioning which includes any procedure which causes obvious signs of physical pain, including but not limited to hitting, pinching and electric shock; prohibits the use of any procedure or punishment which denies a vulnerable person reasonable sleep, shelter, bedding, bathroom facilities and any other aspect expected of a humane existence; defines terms.

short_summary: Requires child protective services to orally and in writing disclose certain information to parents and caretakers who are the subject of a child protective services investigation
summary: Requires child protective services to orally and in writing disclose certain information to parents and caretakers who are the subject of a child protective services investigation; requires such oral and written disclosure to contain certain information regarding the rights of the person under investigation.

short_summary: Relates to the administration of the statewide central register of child abuse and maltreatment
summary: Requires a caller making a report of suspected child abuse or maltreatment to the central registry to leave their name and contact information; prohibits the office of children and family services from releasing information identifying a person who made such a report.

short_summary: Includes the right to strike as an employee right
summary: Includes the right to strike as an employee right.

short_summary: Requires equal distribution of legislative staff and resources
summary: Requires an equal distribution of legislative staff and appropriations to be made among all members of the legislature; provides for additional funds and staff for members in special capacities as long as such additional staff does not deal with constituent services.

short_summary: Relates to setting bail for defendants who pose a threat to public safety
summary: Relates to setting bail for dangerous defendants who pose a threat to public safety.

short_summary: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund
summary: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund.

short_summary: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register his or her name and address with the division of criminal justice services
summary: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register his or her name and address with the division of criminal justice services.

short_summary: Requires propositions authorizing creation of a state debt to contain an estimate of the debt service payable and publish an explanation thereof
summary: Requires that any ballot proposition creating a state debt shall contain an estimate of the amortization period and the total expected debt service payable thereon until the bonds issued pursuant to such proposition are retired.

short_summary: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law
summary: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law.

short_summary: Relates to emergency intervention for persons impaired by chemical substances
summary: Provides for emergency intervention services for persons impaired by chemical substances.

short_summary: Requires that all special education students attending schools scheduled to be closed or to undergo a significant change be assigned to new schools prior to the implementation of the closing or change
summary: Requires that all special education students attending schools scheduled to be closed or to undergo a significant change be assigned to new schools prior to the implementation of the closing or change.

short_summary: Authorizes certain owners of residential real property in the city of New York to opt out of planned city tree planting
summary: Authorizes certain owners of residential real property in the city of New York to opt out of planned city tree planting.

short_summary: Establishes an essential workers' bill of rights
summary: Establishes an essential workers' bill of rights; provides that all employers shall provide essential workers with personal protective equipment, inform such workers of exposure to any disease related to a state disaster emergency, and not retaliate for any report of an unsafe work environment; provides certain employers shall make hazard payments and cover the costs of any child care or health care needed by such essential workers for the duration of the state disaster emergency.

short_summary: Requires the instruction on the importance of Yu Gwan-Sun and her contribution as a globally recognized human rights activist
summary: Requires the instruction on the importance of Yu Gwan-Sun and her contribution as a globally recognized human rights activist for students in grades 9-12.

short_summary: Relates to requiring sign language interpreters during live broadcast press conferences during a declared state of emergency
summary: Requires sign language interpreters during live broadcast press conferences during a declared state of emergency.

short_summary: Provides for income access services in the state
summary: Provides for the licensing and regulation of income access services in the state.

short_summary: Relates to regional cannabis mentors
summary: Provides for regional cannabis mentors to provide support to persons inquiring about, or participating in, the medical cannabis or adult-use cannabis industries; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to certain pupils
summary: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to pupils in grade eleven; directs that certain topics be covered in such educational program.

short_summary: Authorizes certain emergency medical technicians and paramedics to administer certain vaccines pursuant to non-patient specific orders and under the authority of an emergency medical services director
summary: Authorizes certain emergency medical technicians and paramedics to administer certain vaccines pursuant to non-patient specific orders and under the authority of an emergency medical services director after receiving appropriate training.

short_summary: Requires additional notice prior to commencing an action in certain discrimination cases
summary: Requires that a claimant alleging that the contents of a website or mobile application that describes goods and services provided at a place of public accommodation constitutes an unlawful discriminatory practice against visually and hearing impaired individuals serve written notice on the owner and provide 60 days to cure the alleged violation prior to commencing an action.

short_summary: Relates to the workers' compensation benefit of certain disabled employees
summary: Provides that the weekly benefit which the disabled employee is entitled to receive for disability commencing: on or after January first, two thousand twenty-six shall be fifty percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed fifty percent of the state average weekly wage; on or after January first, two thousand twenty-seven shall be fifty-five percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed fifty-five percent of the state average weekly wage; on or after January first, two thousand twenty-eight shall be sixty percent of the employee's weekly average wage but shall not exceed sixty percent of the state average weekly wage; and on or after January first of each succeeding year, shall be sixty-seven percent of the employee's average weekly wage but shall not exceed sixty-seven percent of the state average weekly wage.

short_summary: Relates to certain payments for the financial support of a foster child
summary: Provides that regulations shall provide for payments for the financial support of a foster child for one week following the termination of their foster care status and that such payments shall be at the same schedule and rate as when such child was in foster care.

short_summary: Relates to guidelines by the state procurement council certain preferences for any business located in a county within the state with a population of less than one million or any small business
summary: Provides that guidelines by the state procurement council shall include certain preferences for any business located in a county within the state with a population of less than one million based on the latest federal decennial census or any small business as such term is defined in section one hundred thirty-one of the economic development law.

short_summary: Relates to the New York state higher education capital matching grant board
summary: Requires the New York state higher education capital matching grant board to award matching capital grants totaling two million dollars for projects to implement, modify, or otherwise enhance cyber security infrastructure; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Enacts the sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act
summary: Enacts the "sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act"; exempts or limits environmental review under SEQR for the construction of certain new residential units to avoid creating unnecessary housing sprawl; limits certain rights to action under SEQR; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission
summary: Provides that the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission shall: evaluate each mandated benefit; investigate current practices of health plans with regard to the mandated benefit; investigate the potential premium impact of repealing and/or modifying the mandated benefits on all segments of the insurance market; hold at least two public hearings; and submit a report to the legislature; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening for ovarian and prostate cancers
summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover comprehensive genetic screening and FDA approved biomarker testing for ovarian and prostate cancers.

short_summary: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order
summary: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order; increases fines from $6,000 to $10,000 for initial violation and $12,000 to $20,000 for subsequent violations.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of ammunition for assault weapons
summary: Relates to limiting ammunition for assault weapons to two times the capacity of an authorized weapon over a one hundred twenty day period.

short_summary: Restricts the sale of ammunition to only individuals authorized to possess such weapon; repealer
summary: Restricts the sale of ammunition to only individuals authorized to possess such weapon; creates the no-gun database under the division of criminal justice services.

short_summary: Prohibits virginity examinations
summary: Prohibits health care practitioners from performing a virginity examination or supervising the performance of a virginity examination on a patient; defines "virginity examination".

short_summary: Relates to the cancellation of a health club contract
summary: Requires health clubs accept cancellation of a membership within ten business days of receiving notice of the cancellation.

short_summary: Enacts the "Endoscope Reform Act"
summary: Enacts the "Endoscope Reform Act"; requires the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations to govern the practice of all upper endoscopic procedures and to prescribe an upper endoscopic patient's bill of rights.

short_summary: Establishes a grant program for the installation of laundry equipment and facilities in certain schools
summary: Establishes a grant program for public K-12 schools which are eligible for support provided under Title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, for the purposes of installing laundry equipment for facilities for use by students and parents or guardians of students.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency
summary: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency to certain graduates of post secondary programs or comparable apprenticeship and workforce training programs for the purchase of certain property.

short_summary: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing
summary: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing.

short_summary: Creates a commission to evaluate the need for community colleges to participate in the educational opportunity program
summary: Creates a commission to evaluate the need for community colleges to participate in the educational opportunity program.

short_summary: Enables appellate review of the fairness and appropriateness of an imposed criminal sentence
summary: Enables appellate review of the fairness and appropriateness of an imposed criminal sentence.

short_summary: Facilitates appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern
summary: Relates to facilitating appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern.

short_summary: Provides that certain entities may not require a person to provide a copy of his or her criminal history record under certain circumstances
summary: Provides that certain entities may not require a person to provide a copy of his or her criminal history record under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Requires landlords to return security deposits within a reasonable time
summary: Requires landlords to return the full security deposit and any accrued interest to which the tenant is entitled less any amount retained by the landlord within 21 days of the end of the lease.

short_summary: Relates to the licensure of athletic trainers; and adds athletic trainers to the list of persons and officials required to report cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment
summary: Relates to the licensure of athletic trainers; adds athletic trainers to the list of persons and officials required to report cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment.

short_summary: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions
summary: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions; establishes an energy efficiency improvement board to approve the abatements and exemptions.

short_summary: Prohibits a court from bifurcating certain primary elections
summary: Prohibits a court from bifurcating the primary elections for members of the state and county committees and assembly district leaders and associate district leaders and all other party positions to be elected and all nominations for public office required to be made at a primary election in such year, except presidential primaries.

short_summary: Amends election law to accurately reflect proper cross reference
summary: Amends election law to accurately reflect proper cross reference relating to the operational failure of a voting machine.

short_summary: Relates to labeling requirements for electric assisted bicycles
summary: Prohibits the sale of electric assisted bicycles unless the packaging contains a notice stating that the operation of such electric assisted bicycle on any public highway, road or sidewalk may be unlawful.

short_summary: Relates to unauthorized use of a mobile telephone or any data contained therein
summary: Relates to unauthorized use of a smart phone or mobile device or any data contained therein.

short_summary: Relates to standards for for-profit higher education institutions
summary: Requires for-profit higher education institutions to spend no less than fifty percent of such institution's annual revenues on expenditures in the areas of student instruction, academic support and advising, or career services.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain disclosures by attorneys performing services in connection with a real property tax grievance procedure
summary: Requires any contract or retainer agreement between a property owner and an attorney for legal services related to the filing and appearance before a board of assessment review regarding complaints in relation to assessments shall include a written disclosure that such complaints in relation to assessments can be completed without the assistance of an attorney.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursements practices of pharmacy benefit managers
summary: Amends provisions governing reimbursement practices of pharmacy benefit managers to ensure that pharmacies are not reimbursed an amount less than the cost of procuring the drugs.

short_summary: Includes gender equality in the social and economic equity plan of the New York state cannabis control board
summary: Includes transgender, gender non-conforming and non-binary individuals in the social and economic equity plan of the New York state cannabis control board relating to the awarding of adult-use cannabis licenses.

short_summary: Relates to the office of special investigation inspecting serious physical injuries that may have resulted in death
summary: Authorizes the office of special investigation to inspect serious physical injuries that may have resulted in death, or did result in paralysis, comatose, brain damage, or any other life threatening grave bodily injury as determined by the attorney general.

short_summary: Enacts the "Excelsior Opportunity Accounts Act"
summary: Enacts the "Excelsior Opportunity Accounts Act"; establishes a special fund for EO accounts within the department of financial services for certain eligible individuals born after December 31, 2025, who reside in the state, are under age 18, with household income not exceeding 700% of the poverty level; provides for contribution and investment of monies of fund.

short_summary: Relates to conducting meetings of public bodies via video conference technology
summary: Allows public bodies to conduct meetings via video conference technology as long as the public is given certain opportunities to view such video conference.

short_summary: Establishes the YMCA distinctive license plate
summary: Establishes the YMCA distinctive license plate; creates the YMCA foundation fund.

short_summary: Establishes the relocated worker grant program
summary: Establishes the relocated worker grant program which requires the empire state development corporation to design and implement the relocated worker grant program which shall include a certification process to certify relocated workers and certify qualifying expenses for a reimbursement grant; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Prohibits the search of certain items when stopping a person under certain vehicle and traffic violations
summary: Prohibits the search of certain items when stopping a person under certain vehicle and traffic violations; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides coverage for remotely connected insulin pens for certain patients with diabetes
summary: Provides coverage of remotely connected insulin pens under the pharmacy benefit of medical assistance for eligible patients with diabetes.

short_summary: Relates to the coverage of air ambulance services in the child health plus program
summary: Provides for the coverage of air ambulance services in the child health plus program.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to study, evaluate, and make recommendations concerning instances of police brutality in the city of Rochester
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to study, evaluate, and make recommendations concerning instances of police brutality in the city of Rochester.

short_summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor
summary: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of a state university-based center for employee ownership; repealer
summary: Relates to the establishment of a state university-based center for employee ownership that provides education and outreach to business owners regarding employee ownership.

short_summary: Relates to grand jury proceedings
summary: Provides that in grand jury proceedings when following submission to a grand jury of a criminal charge or charges, the grand jury dismisses all charges presented or directs the district attorney to dismiss all charges or directs the DA to file in a local criminal court an application for disclosure of certain materials; authorizes the court to limit disclosure of certain items where there is a reasonable likelihood that such disclosure may lead to the identity of a witness who is not a public servant or expert witness; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

short_summary: Provides for program eligibility for plans comparable to Medicare part D
summary: Relates to program eligibility for plans comparable to Medicare part D.

short_summary: Relates to delinquent tax interest rates
summary: Relates to setting a minimum and maximum delinquent tax interest rate for payments due on residential real property.

short_summary: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language
summary: Relates to requiring certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language and requiring parties to demonstrate their understanding of the nature and effect of such documents.

short_summary: Allows municipal commissions to use alternate lists for filling vacancies with resident and non-resident minority group members and women in order to achieve diversity in police departments
summary: Allows municipal commissions to use alternate lists for filling vacancies with resident and non-resident minority group members and women in order to achieve diversity in police departments.

short_summary: Permits the sealing of records of certain nonviolent misdemeanor or nonsexual misdemeanor criminal offenses
summary: Permits the sealing of records of certain nonviolent misdemeanor or non-sexual misdemeanor criminal offenses; defines the term "eligible misdemeanor"; excludes certain misdemeanor offenses as eligible misdemeanors for the purposes of conditional sealing; lists certain eligibility requirements for sealing; provides an order granting sealing under this section shall restore the individual concerned, in the contemplation of the laws, to the status such individual occupied before the arrest or institution of criminal proceedings for the crime that was the subject of the sealing.

short_summary: Relates to confidential informants
summary: Relates to confidential informants; defines terms; requires the law enforcement agencies which use confidential informants to establish policies and procedures to assess the suitability of using a person as a confidential informant; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for accelerated payments to the city school district of the city of Mount Vernon
summary: Provides for accelerated payments to the city school district of the city of Mount Vernon.

short_summary: Relates to the presumption of intent to sell heroin
summary: Creates the presumption of intent to sell when a person is in possession of forty or more individual packages containing heroin with an aggregate weight of 4.0 grams.

short_summary: Relates to being absent from full time day instruction for the purpose of sounding Taps at a military honors funeral held in this state
summary: Provides that a minor from six to sixteen years being absent from full time day instruction for the purpose of sounding "Taps" at a military honors funeral held in this state for a deceased veteran shall be excused from school.

short_summary: Relates to enacting "Todd's Law"
summary: Relates to sentencing and larceny of property of the elderly or disabled.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of Melinda's Law in relation to the basis for removal of children
summary: Protects a parent who is a victim of domestic violence from having children removed from their custody if they reported the abuse.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing bail for certain offenses committed during a riot
summary: Authorizes bail for class A misdemeanors and felonies committed during a riot.

short_summary: Prohibits level three sex offenders from living in college housing
summary: Prohibits level three sex offenders from living in college housing.

short_summary: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature
summary: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature; allows the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature if such public authority files a written notice sixty days prior to the organization of such subsidiary with the governor and the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to sex offender registration of change of address and internet accounts
summary: Requires sex offenders to register information no later than three days after any changes; requires local law enforcement to submit all change of address and internet access provider forms to the registry.

short_summary: Exempts certain electrical supplies from sales and use taxes
summary: Exempts copper wire, romex wire, galvanized rigid conduit, intermediate metal conduit, electrical metal tubing, polyvinyl chloride conduit and metal and plastic electrical boxes from sales and use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to exceptions from registration requirements for nonresident pharmacies in certain cases
summary: Permits an exception from registration for nonresident pharmacies in cases of a specific patient need or a declared public health emergency under certain conditions.

short_summary: Relates to political contributions by certain organizations
summary: Prohibits certain political contributions and loans by certain organizations; provides that loans not repaid by the date of the primary or election shall be considered a contribution.

short_summary: Establishes state and municipal composting programs
summary: Establishes state and municipal composting programs; requires all state and municipal agencies to establish a composting program in buildings owned, occupied or operated by such agencies; allows such agencies to arrange for collection of compostable waste by a private carter, transport such waste itself or process such waste on-site; requires reports on the costs and effectiveness of such programs.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment of the state medicaid director
summary: Provides for the appointment of the state medicaid director by the governor subject to confirmation by the senate.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state business contract database
summary: Establishes the New York state business contract database containing names of persons who have contracts with the state for the procurement of goods, services or construction that are not awarded through a competitive bid process; prohibits candidates or political committees from receiving certain contributions.

short_summary: Prohibits and regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; repealer
summary: Prohibits and regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; prohibits police officers, peace officers, school resource officers, probation agencies, state entities, state employees, and municipal corporations from questioning individuals regarding their citizenship or immigration status; regulates the disclosure of information relating to immigration status.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of person for the purposes of homicide
summary: Designates the definition of person for the purposes of homicide as Mya's law.

short_summary: Relates to overrides of school district tax levies
summary: Permits passage of a school budget that will require a tax levy that exceeds the tax levy limit if approved by a majority of the votes cast.

short_summary: Relates to certain requirements of the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia
summary: Relates to lowering the minimum required course load and permitting application prior to matriculation for the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia.

short_summary: Establishes a biodiesel grant program for the agricultural production of biodiesel
summary: Establishes a biodiesel grant program for the agricultural production of biodiesel fuel; defines biodiesel fuel as a fuel comprised of mono-alkyl esters of long chain fatty acids derived from vegetable oils or animal fats, designated B100, and meeting the requirements of the American Society of Testing and Materials designation of D 6751; establishes the biodiesel grant program fund.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays and wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays and wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to accessing substance use disorder services based on the individual's gender identity or expression and preference
summary: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to assure that persons who suffer from a substance use disorder have the right to seek and receive addiction services, care, treatment and rehabilitation services based on the individual's gender identity, gender expression and/or sexual orientation.

short_summary: Relates to admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress
summary: Prohibits the admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress in civil actions or proceedings; provides limited exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to the disclosure of beneficial owners of limited liability companies
summary: Relates to the disclosure of beneficial owners of limited liability companies and foreign limited liability companies and certain information about such beneficial owners; requires the secretary of state to maintain a public database of all business entities organized in the state and all foreign business entities with authority to do business in the state.

short_summary: Relates to requiring public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service
summary: Requires public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service.

short_summary: Relates to limiting the use of a victim's DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits
summary: Prohibits the use of a victim's DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits from being added to the state DNA identification index or other databases or being used in certain actions.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of a single computerized state DNA identification index and requires municipalities to expunge any DNA record stored in a municipal DNA identification index
summary: Relates to the establishment of a single computerized state DNA identification index; requires municipalities to expunge any DNA record stored in a municipal DNA identification index.

short_summary: Establishes the right to legal counsel in immigration court proceedings and provides for the administration thereof
summary: Establishes the right to legal counsel in immigration court proceedings; provides for the administration thereof.

short_summary: Requires a city with a population of one million or more shall establish a residential composting program for all buildings with residential units
summary: Requires that a city with a population of one million or more shall establish a residential composting program for all buildings with residential units.

short_summary: Prohibits insurers from restricting or imposing delays in the distribution of antiretroviral prescription drugs prescribed to a person for HIV or AIDS
summary: Prohibits insurers from restricting or imposing delays in the distribution of antiretroviral prescription drugs prescribed to a person for the treatment or prevention of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

short_summary: Requires insurance coverage for home test kits for sexually transmitted diseases
summary: Requires health insurance coverage for home test kits for sexually transmitted diseases.

short_summary: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on policy-based exclusions
summary: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on policy-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each health care facility a list of its policy-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

short_summary: Relates to the damage of a building or motor vehicle caused by fire or explosion in the course of the commission of a felony
summary: Establishes that a person is guilty of arson when he damages a building or motor vehicle by fire or explosion in the course of the commission or attempted commission of a felony.

short_summary: Relates to an examination and evaluation of New York state's information technology infrastructure
summary: Directs the office of information technology services to contract with a private entity to conduct an examination and evaluation of New York state's information technology infrastructure, data use and management, policies, procedures and operational processes.

short_summary: Relates to providing an income tax credit for retired disabled police officers
summary: Provides a $750 income tax credit for retired disabled police officers.

short_summary: Establishes the task force on daylight saving time
summary: Establishes the task force on daylight saving time to study the effects of New York state opting out of daylight saving time.

short_summary: Increases the threshold of employer's withheld taxes
summary: Increases the threshold of employer's withheld taxes.

short_summary: Relates to deceptive acts and practices in the conduct of any business, trade or commerce
summary: Provides that it is a deceptive act in the conduct of any business, trade or commerce to threaten civil litigation, where such threat relates to an alleged violation of intellectual property rights unless the person so threatened makes a payment of money.

short_summary: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports
summary: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports.

short_summary: Declares provisions, in snow removal and de-icing service contracts, requiring the service provider to indemnify the recipient of the services to be void
summary: Declares provisions, in snow removal and de-icing service contracts, requiring the service provider to indemnify the recipient of the services for damages arising out of such recipient's acts or omissions, to be null and void.

short_summary: Relates to autonomous vehicle driving
summary: Provides that a person may operate a fully autonomous vehicle on the public roads of this state without a human driver provided that the automated driving system is engaged and the vehicle meets certain conditions; defines terms; requires insurance and that such vehicle is registered as a fully autonomous vehicle; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Designates as peace officers certain employees of the Monroe county sheriff's office serving as court security deputies at Monroe county court facilities
summary: Designates as peace officers certain employees of the Monroe county sheriff's office serving as court security deputies at Monroe county court facilities.

short_summary: Relates to recounts of ballots conducted by the board of elections or a bipartisan committee appointed by the board
summary: Provides that recounts of ballots conducted by the board of elections or a bipartisan committee appointed by the board can be either done manually or via the use of any automated tool authorized for such use by the board of elections, which is independent from the voting system it is being used to recount, of all ballots for a particular contest where the margin of victory is less than or equal to 0.5% but greater than 0.25%; allows for losing candidates to deny a recount before any recount is conducted.

short_summary: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony
summary: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony in certain actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice.

short_summary: Establishes the strategic site readiness fund; appropriation
summary: Establishes the strategic site readiness fund within the department of economic development to cultivate a resource of commercial, industrial sites that are readily available to new businesses, established businesses that are considering moving to the state, or existing businesses within the state that need additional sites to remain or expand within the state; appropriates five hundred million dollars therefor.

short_summary: Exempts certain property and services used in the cultivation of cannabis for adult-use from sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Exempts certain property and services used in the cultivation of cannabis for adult-use from sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to the timing of discovery for the crime of homicide
summary: Provides that evidence of a homicide where the defendant has substantiated affiliation with a criminal enterprise may be withheld from discovery.

short_summary: Establishes limits upon local government tax levies
summary: Establishes limits upon local government tax levies.

short_summary: Provides that a capital tax levy shall not be included within the definition of "tax levy limit"
summary: Provides that a capital tax levy shall not be included within the definition of "tax levy limit"; defines "capital local expenditures" and "capital tax levy".

short_summary: Establishes an online database identifying regional skills and employment gaps and the skills and training needed to fill open and anticipated jobs
summary: Directs the commissioner of labor to establish an online database identifying regional skills and employment gaps and the skills and training needed to fill open and anticipated jobs.

short_summary: Relates to personal cultivation facilities for cannabis
summary: Permits the personal cultivation of cannabis in a licensed personal cultivation facility.

short_summary: Relates to reciprocity agreements with other states for medical cannabis programs
summary: Provides for reciprocity agreements with other states for medical cannabis programs; directs the cannabis control board to promulgate regulations for the approval of pre-roll products in the medical cannabis program.

short_summary: Relates to economic loss
summary: Relates to economic loss and damages for health care costs for medical care, dental care, custodial care, or rehabilitation services.

short_summary: Relates to certain persons engaging in certain firearm safety shooting instruction or persons engaging in wildlife control or management
summary: Exempts certain persons engaging in certain firearm safety shooting instruction or persons engaging in wildlife control or management from the provisions of criminal possession of a firearm, rifle or shotgun in a sensitive location when such person possesses a firearm, rifle or shotgun in or upon a sensitive location, and such person knows or reasonably should know such location is a sensitive location.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers
summary: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers who lease the taxpayer's primary residence during the taxable year and who pay rent with respect to such residence in excess of thirty percent of such taxpayer's gross income for such taxable year.

short_summary: Relates to employment discrimination relating to family leave
summary: Provides that an employee shall not be required to request reinstatement in order to file a discrimination claim regarding paid family medical leave benefits; permits a private right of action for certain violations as an alternative to a workers' compensation claim; provides for attorneys' fees and costs.

short_summary: Removes the board of trustees of the state university of New York as a charter entity; repealer
summary: Removes the board of trustees of the state university of New York as a charter entity.

short_summary: Establishes a common articulation policy at the state of New York and city of New York university systems for granting college credit bearing coursework based upon successful performance on standardized exams
summary: Establishes a common articulation policy at the state of New York and city of New York university systems for granting college credit bearing coursework based upon successful performance on standardized exams completed by high school students.

short_summary: Establishes instruction in financial literacy for students in sixth through eighth grade
summary: Establishes instruction in financial literacy for students in sixth through eighth grade; requires such instruction to include content on budgeting, savings, credit, debt, insurance, investment, and other issues associated with personal financial responsibility as determined by the education department.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of party
summary: Defines the term "party" as any political organization which at the last preceding election for governor polled at least fifty thousand votes for its candidate for governor.

short_summary: Moves the Amistad Commission from the department of state to the state education department
summary: Moves the Amistad Commission from the department of state to the state education department.

short_summary: Establishes the coronavirus pandemic small business and not-for-profit organization loan program
summary: Establishes the coronavirus pandemic small business and not-for-profit organization loan program.

short_summary: Promotes the inclusion of children living in temporary housing in prekindergarten programs
summary: Promotes the inclusion of children living in temporary housing in prekindergarten programs; requires school districts to prioritize homeless children on any pre-K waitlists and provides for the reimbursement to school districts of hiring additional staff to accommodate the enrollment of a homeless child.

short_summary: Relates to persons with a serious mental illness residing in an adult home
summary: Provides for when the department may limit the census of persons with a serious mental illness residing in an adult home.

short_summary: Implements a moratorium on digital billboards and directing the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the impact of digital billboards on motor vehicle accidents
summary: Implements a moratorium on the installation of new digital billboards; directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the impact of digital billboards on motor vehicle accidents.

short_summary: Requires consent prior to sharing certain student information
summary: Requires consent prior to sharing personally identifiable information to a SLISP or data dashboard operator with third party contractors.

short_summary: Establishes interventions for children with dyslexia or other phonological learning differences or disabilities
summary: Requires each school district to provide interventions and special curricula for children with dyslexia or other phonological learning differences or disabilities.

short_summary: Relates to procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees
summary: Provides procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees not in the service of the city of New York, including the fees to be paid for such hearing officer; provides for suspension, with pay, pending the determination.

short_summary: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; and makes conforming amendments
summary: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; makes conforming amendments.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the downstate New York power authority, and providing for its powers and duties
summary: Establishes the downstate New York power authority to own and operate electricity service and acquire the distribution facilities formerly owned by any downstate utility corporation.

short_summary: Prohibits unlawful dissemination or publication of intimate images created by digitization and of sexually explicit depictions of an individual; repealer
summary: Includes "deep fake" images created by digitization within the definition of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_summary: Relates to the dispensing of self-administered hormonal contraceptives
summary: Relates to the dispensing of self-administered hormonal contraceptives; authorizes a licensed physician and a certified nurse practitioner to prescribe and order a non-patient specific order to a pharmacist licensed and located in the state for the dispensing of self-administered hormonal contraceptives.

short_summary: Prohibits the arrest or restraint of a child less than thirteen years of age while effecting the arrest of the parent or guardian of such child
summary: Provides that no police officer shall arrest, restrain, or otherwise subdue a child who is thirteen years of age or less while effecting the arrest of the parent or guardian of such child; provides that all police officers present at the scene of arrest shall have an affirmative duty to keep such child safe, and shall permit the person being arrested to communicate with such child up until such person is removed from the scene.

short_summary: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes
summary: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes.

short_summary: Establishes the Charles L. Reason fellowship
summary: Establishes the Charles L. Reason fellowship for the purpose of increasing faculty diversity in higher education.

short_summary: Relates to sharing information obtained from applicants and licensees
summary: Relates to sharing information obtained from applicants and licensees and requesting financial institutions for the purpose of consideration and compliance.

short_summary: Requires sellers to clearly post the price of a credit card surcharge
summary: Requires sellers to clearly post the credit card price inclusive of any surcharge at the location a sale occurs; does not prohibit merchants from offering a two-tier pricing system; establishes civil penalty not to exceed $500 for each violation.

short_summary: Relates to an engineering technology degree
summary: Provides that an applicant with a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering technology and an applicant with a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering shall have the same number of education and experience credit requirements, shall have the same eligibility for an identification card as "an engineer in training", as well as examination and examination eligibility requirements.

short_summary: Allows pharmacy technicians to practice in any pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist
summary: Allows pharmacy technicians to practice in any pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist.

short_summary: Establishes the New York Asian American and Pacific Islander commission
summary: Establishes the 15 member New York Asian American and Pacific Islander commission to develop policies to improve the community, economic and social well-being, and the health and educational needs important to Asian American and Pacific Islander communities in the state; to develop and coordinate statewide programs, recognizing the continuing contributions of Asian American and Pacific Islander individuals in the state; to create and implement public education campaigns regarding Asian American and Pacific Islander issues and culture; to increase the awareness among Asian American and Pacific Islander individuals of state and local resources that may benefit Asian American and Pacific Islander individuals and communities as a whole; and to undertake any other activities the commission deems necessary and applicable to support Asian American and Pacific Islander communities in the state.

short_summary: Relates to a report on the adequacy, reasonableness and affordability of insurance products designed to pay for the future medical expenses of certain injured plaintiffs
summary: Requires a review and report by the superintendent of financial services, in consultation with the office of court administration, on the adequacy, reasonableness and affordability of insurance products designed to pay for the future medical expenses of injured plaintiffs who receive a judgment or settlement for damages that include future medical expenses.

short_summary: Relates to neurological injuries
summary: Defines "neurological injury" as an injury to the brain or spinal cord of a person occurring in the course of the provision of medical services, that rendered the person with a permanent and substantial motor impairment or with a disability that: results in similar impairment of general intellectual functioning or adaptive behavior to that of intellectually disabled persons; requires treatment and services similar to those required for such person; has continued or can be expected to continue indefinitely; and constitutes a substantial handicap to such person's ability to function normally in society; differentiates a birth-related neurological injury and a neurological injury.

short_summary: Increases the number of cuisine trails in the state
summary: Increases the number of cuisine trails in the state.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program
summary: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program to provide students with the opportunity to be educated on the agricultural industry and alternative career paths and to provide agricultural work experience and entrepreneurship work experience.

short_summary: Relates to land used in agricultural production
summary: Includes certain land that is owned or rented as a farm operation for the production for sale of crops, livestock or livestock products as land used in agricultural production.

short_summary: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act
summary: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act; relates to the licensing and operation of home kitchen operations which store, handle, prepare and package ready-to-eat food for consumers.

short_summary: Establishes the agrivoltaics viability pilot program within the farmland viability program
summary: Establishes the agrivoltaics viability pilot program within the farmland viability program to provide grants to identify the best practices and strategies for dual-use solar energy projects that protect soil health during construction and decommissioning of solar arrays, utilize sustainable agricultural production practices, monitor any benefits solar energy may have on farms and to the state, track economic viability, study the commercialization of dual-use solar energy projects, and encourage equitable engagement of stakeholders.

short_summary: Relates to code enforcement training programs for code enforcement personnel
summary: Requires the secretary of state to offer code enforcement training programs for code enforcement personnel to be completed online, with flexible options for when such training programs may be completed.

short_summary: Requires landlords to ensure rental properties are equipped with utility services prior to renting such properties
summary: Requires landlords to ensure rental properties are equipped with utility services prior to renting such properties; requires landlords to keep utility services connected in between tenants.

short_summary: Relates to required training for school district officers
summary: Relates to school district officers required to complete certain training to acquaint such officer with the powers, functions and duties of boards of education; relates to topics to be included in such training.

short_summary: Establishes the office of the caregiving economy
summary: Establishes the "office of the caregiving economy", for the purpose of promoting and supporting the state's caregiving needs by developing the caregiving economy in the state.

short_summary: Creates the fundamental right of the people to have access to public information
summary: Creates the fundamental right of the people to have access to public information and to be provided notice of and to attend public meetings.

short_summary: Establishes an extended producer responsibility program for packaging
summary: Establishes an extended producer responsibility program for packaging which creates provisions related to improved recycling practices; establishes the packaging responsibility fund.

short_summary: Relates to establishing limitations on bank accounts after such accounts have been closed
summary: Relates to establishing limitations on bank accounts after such accounts have been closed including opening or re-opening such account, requesting a deposit or withdrawal or assessing certain fees.

short_summary: Relates to providing protections to health service providers who perform legally protected health activities
summary: Provides certain legal protections for reproductive health service providers who provide legally protected health activities including protection from extradition, arrest and legal proceedings in other states relating to such services; restricts the use of evidence relating to the involvement of a party in providing legally protected health activity to persons located out-of-state.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment process for state board positions
summary: Relates to the appointment process for state board positions; provides for a 60 day time period to conduct a background check on potential nominees to state board positions before they can officially be appointed.

short_summary: Exempts the East Dunkirk Volunteer Fire Company, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
summary: Exempts the East Dunkirk Volunteer Fire Company, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

short_summary: Permits schools located within the state to purchase certain New York milk
summary: Permits schools located within the state to purchase reduced fat or whole New York milk to provide or sell at such school.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the canine officer health monitoring fund
summary: Establishes the canine officer health monitoring fund which allows for applicants to request reimbursement from the division of criminal justice services for health costs related to regular health or injury associated with canine officers.

short_summary: Prevents the financial exploitation of older and vulnerable adults
summary: Allows for investment advisers and firms to disclose potential financial exploitation of elderly and vulnerable adults to the commissioner of the department of financial services and to halt disbursements from an account if an adviser or firm believes that financial exploitation is occurring.

short_summary: Prevents consideration of an increase in the minimum wage in certain counties until December 31, 2025
