summary: Prevents consideration of an increase in the minimum wage until December 31, 2025 outside of the city of New York and outside the counties of Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester.

short_summary: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general
summary: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general.

short_summary: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts
summary: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts.

short_summary: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents
summary: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents.

short_summary: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service
summary: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on food insecurity at public and private higher education institutions
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on food insecurity at public and private higher education institutions.

short_summary: Requires places of public assembly to maintain epinephrine auto-injector devices and to have at least one employee who is trained in its use
summary: Requires that functional epinephrine auto-injector devices be made available in places of public assembly and that at least one employee or volunteer of such place of public assembly be trained in its proper operation and use and be present at each facility function.

short_summary: Prohibits awarding TAP grants to those enrolled at for-profit universities
summary: Prohibits the awarding of TAP grants to those enrolled at for-profit universities.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the penalties for passing a stopped school bus
summary: Requires suspension of a driver's license for a period of 60 days when a driver is convicted of passing a stopped school bus twice in 18 months.

short_summary: Relates to creating annual reporting obligations by municipal housing authorities to the authorities budget office with respect to state-funded activities of such municipal housing authorities
summary: Relates to creating annual reporting obligations by municipal housing authorities to the authorities budget office with respect to state-funded activities of such municipal housing authorities.

short_summary: Relates to exempting certain non-profit community gardens from payment for water usage and supply
summary: Relates to exempting certain non-profit community gardens from payment for water usage and supply; exempts non-profit community gardens located on property in the city of New York and registered with and licensed by such city's department of parks and recreation from payment for water usage and supply.

short_summary: Establishes Eid-al-Adha and Eid-al-Fitr as school holidays in public school districts
summary: Establishes Eid-al-Adha and Eid-Al-Fitr as school holidays in certain school districts.

short_summary: Requires the city of New York to mitigate property damage caused by environmental issues which are caused by acts or omissions of such municipality
summary: Requires the city of New York to mitigate property damage caused by environmental issues which are caused by acts or omissions of such municipality.

short_summary: Directs the public service commission to conduct a study and report on the feasibility of transferring utility services to an entity owned and operated by the state of New York
summary: Authorizes and directs the public service commission to conduct a comprehensive study and prepare a report on the feasibility of transferring services provided by gas and electric corporations in this state to an entity owned and operated by the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to conducting a study on the feasibility of using the Triboro rail line as a public transit line co-mingling with freight service
summary: Relates to conducting a study on the feasibility of using the Triboro rail line as a public transit line co-mingling with freight services.

short_summary: Relates to written notice to unsuccessful minority- or women-owned business enterprise bidders on state contracts
summary: Requires public corporations and agencies to provide written notice to each minority- or women-owned business enterprise that unsuccessfully bid on a contract of the reason or reasons why the business enterprise was unsuccessful in obtaining the contract.

short_summary: Prohibits the city of New York from increasing property taxes where a property's assessed value has decreased in the previous year
summary: Prohibits the city of New York from increasing property taxes where a property's assessed value has decreased in the previous year; applies only to class one and class two properties.

short_summary: Allows the New York state thruway authority to provide a discounted toll rate to farmers transporting agricultural products
summary: Allows the New York state thruway authority to provide a discounted toll rate to farmers transporting agricultural products.

short_summary: Increases medicaid reimbursement payment aggregate for private duty nursing services and care
summary: Increases medicaid reimbursement payment aggregate for private duty nursing services and care by 15 million dollars for period 7/1/24 to 3/31/25, and by 20 million dollars annually thereafter for each period from April 1 to March 31.

short_summary: Relates to purchasing restrictions and investment of certain public funds in persons that contract to build a border wall
summary: Relates to purchasing restrictions and investment of certain public funds in persons that contract to build a border wall; requires the commissioner to develop and publish, using credible information available to the public, a list of persons determined by the commissioner, that have contracted to build a border wall.

short_summary: Re-defines the term physically helpless
summary: Relates to re-defining the term physically helpless to mean an individual who is physically unable to communicate affirmative consent through words or clear actions that offer permission and a willingness to engage in sexual activity.

short_summary: Enacts the "Omnibus Prevailing Wage Enforcement Act"
summary: Enacts the "Omnibus Prevailing Wage Enforcement Act"; creates the office of the  prevailing wage fraud inspector general for increased vigilance in the effort to achieve prevailing wage enforcement; allows public authorities to require that successful bidders for public works jobs participate in a state-sponsored apprenticeship program; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for compensation for injury or death caused by the negligent entrustment of a firearm
summary: Provides for compensation for injury or death caused by the negligent entrustment of a firearm.

short_summary: Relates to imposing certain conditions on the approval of a charter school application
summary: Imposes certain conditions on the approval of a charter school application for the conversion of an existing public school to a charter school.

short_summary: Establishes a healthy savings pilot program
summary: Establishes a healthy savings pilot program within three cities where those in the program can receive discounts on healthier food choices at grocery stores and supermarkets.

short_summary: Designates the tenth day of March of each year as a public holiday, to be known as Harriet Tubman day
summary: Designates the tenth day of March of each year as a public holiday, to be known as Harriet Tubman day.

short_summary: Establishes the New York college debt repayment program
summary: Establishes the New York college debt repayment program.

short_summary: Relates to procedures required for the custodial interrogation of children
summary: Amends procedures required for the custodial interrogation of children to provide additional protections and for taking juveniles and sixteen and seventeen year olds into custody.

short_summary: Establishes the office of special investigation within the department of law
summary: Establishes the office of special investigation within the department of law to investigate and prosecute any alleged criminal offense or offenses committed by a police officer or peace officer, concerning the death of any person as a result of any encounter with such police officer or peace officer.

short_summary: Prohibits the collection of rent arrearages accruing prior to the date of approval of an application for an adjustment in the legal regulated rent based upon a major capital improvement
summary: Prohibits the collection of rent arrearages accruing prior to the date of approval of an application for an adjustment in the legal regulated rent based upon a major capital improvement.

short_summary: Relates to burglary in the second degree
summary: Relates to burglary in the second degree; adds language where the building is a dwelling which, at the time of the commission of the crime, is occupied by a person who is not a participant in the crime to what constitutes burglary in the second degree.

short_summary: Relates to creating the hospital and multiple dwelling energy loan fund
summary: Relates to creating the hospital and multiple dwelling energy loan program.

short_summary: Relates to the sale or transfer of certain real property by the state or public authorities
summary: Relates to the sale or transfer of certain real property by the state or public authorities; requires mandatory review by the attorney general and comptroller of the sale of certain real property; requires notice to members of the legislature and county executives in districts and counties in which land subject to transfer is located of the proposed transfer of state property between state departments, divisions, bureaus, agencies, state agencies, or to a public authority or public benefit corporation.

short_summary: Establishes certain criteria for the rent guidelines board to use for purposes of determining annual rent adjustments
summary: Establishes certain criteria for the rent guidelines board to use for purposes of determining annual rent adjustments.

short_summary: Requires lithium batteries of less than one inch in diameter and products containing such batteries to be labeled with warnings related thereto
summary: Requires lithium batteries of less than 1 inch in diameter and products containing such batteries to be labeled with warnings that swallowing such batteries has been known to cause death.

short_summary: Relates to the intentional removal of identifying markers from commercial motor vehicles in the city of New York
summary: Prohibits the intentional removal of identification markers from commercial motor vehicles in the city of New York for the purpose of evading a traffic infraction; provides a fine of $200-$1000 for intentional removal of identification markers.

short_summary: Relates to rental-purchase agreement forms
summary: Relates to rental-purchase agreement forms including requirements for font size and how to calculate late charges.

short_summary: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies and lenders from using an individual's late payment of cashless tolls to determine their credit worthiness
summary: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies and lenders from using an individual's late payment of cashless tolls to determine their credit worthiness.

short_summary: Requires an X gender marker to be included in certain documents utilized by state agencies, public authorities and municipalities
summary: Requires an "X" gender marker to be included in documents that request that a person identify their gender or sex utilized by state agencies, public authorities and municipalities.

short_summary: Creates the crime of stolen valor
summary: Creates the crime of stolen valor.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg
summary: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg.

short_summary: Relates to requiring electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidates in a manner representing the plurality of votes in each congressional district
summary: Requires electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidates in a manner representing the plurality of votes in each congressional district.

short_summary: Designates the uniformed court officers of the town of Busti, as peace officers
summary: Designates the uniformed court officers of the town of Busti, in the county of Chautauqua, as peace officers.

short_summary: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer
summary: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting ballot harvesting
summary: Prohibits ballot harvesting; prohibits a person from submitting an application for an absentee ballot on behalf of a voter without notarized consent; permits family members, caregivers and other officials to submit applications.

short_summary: Restores the legislative checks and balances to any emergency declaration that exceeds 45 days and ensures judicial due process rights for any action that impairs fundamental constitutional rights
summary: Restores the legislative checks and balances to any emergency declaration that exceeds forty-five days; ensures judicial due process rights for any action that impairs fundamental constitutional rights by limiting the powers of the governor to suspend laws during a state disaster emergency; requires a specification and explanation of which municipalities are affected by such suspension of laws.

short_summary: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement
summary: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement.

short_summary: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
summary: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

short_summary: Relates to the justified use of physical force
summary: Relates to the justified use of physical force; removes requirement that a person facing an imminent physical threat must retreat; provides immunity from civil and criminal liability.

short_summary: Relates to aid for career education
summary: Authorizes aid for career education to begin in grade nine instead of grade ten; changes the amount per pupil.

short_summary: Relates to student financial aid programs
summary: Relates to student financial aid programs; allows absence because of uniformed service, maternity/paternity, FMLA, or due to compensable injury to be creditable time.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions of the vehicle and traffic law relating to the operation of bicycles with electric assist
summary: Repeals certain provisions relating to the operation of bicycles with electric assist.

short_summary: Directs the department of economic development to conduct a study of public and private museums in the state
summary: Directs the department of economic development, in conjunction with other departments and entities, to conduct a comprehensive study of public and private museums, including taking a census of public and private museums in the state, and to report the findings and recommendations of such study.

short_summary: Establishes goals for participation by individuals with disabilities with respect to state employment, state contracts, legislative employment and judicial employment
summary: Relates to establishing goals for participation by individuals with disabilities with respect to state employment, state contracts, legislative employment and judicial employment; establishes a goal of seven percent employment of individuals with disabilities within state agencies, the state legislature, unified court system and state contractors and subcontractors; defines terms.

short_summary: Relates to referrals of certain annexation petitions
summary: Requires county planning departments to review specific annexation petitions.

short_summary: Relates to the conditional examination of seniors before trial and a senior's participation in grand jury proceedings
summary: Allows for the conditional examination of victims who are at least 75 years of age; amends the definition of larceny to ensure that alleged consent by a victim who is mentally disabled is a not a defense to larceny; permits a caregiver to accompany a vulnerable victim into the grand jury.

short_summary: Prohibits the unauthorized sale of veterans' commemorative property by cemeteries
summary: Prohibits the unauthorized sale, purchase or transfer of any cemetery marker, flag holder, monument, statue or other physical memorabilia that is over 75 years old that commemorates the life or death of a veteran or group of veterans, including but not limited to a military unit, company, battalion or division, if such cemetery marker, flag holder, monument, statue or other physical memorabilia that commemorates the life or death of a veteran or group of veterans has been placed in any cemetery; makes violations a class B misdemeanor; permits cemeteries to make such sales upon application to the state cemetery board and upon certain conditions.

short_summary: Relates to the solicitation of donations on state highways
summary: Relates to solicitation of donations on state highways.

short_summary: Relates to the crimes of commercial bribery and larceny
summary: Removes the $250 economic harm requirement from the felony commercial bribery statutes; expands the crime of larceny to include theft of personal identifying information, computer data, computer programs, and services, to adapt to modern technological realities; provides state jurisdiction and county venue over cases involving larceny of personal identifying information, computer data, and computer programs, where the victim is located in the state or the county.

short_summary: Relates to metropolitan commuter transportation district registration fee exemptions for farm vehicles
summary: Removes the requirement that farm vehicles pay the metropolitan commuter transportation district (MCTD) supplemental registration fee.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting a person required to register under the sex offender registration act from possessing an online gamer account
summary: Relates to prohibiting a person required to register under the sex offender registration act from possessing an online gamer account.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of income in relation to the enhanced STAR exemption
summary: Includes distribution from a thrift savings plan in the definition of income in relation to the enhanced STAR exemption.

short_summary: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit
summary: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit.

short_summary: Establishes March twenty-fifth as "We Care Remembrance Day"
summary: Establishes March twenty-fifth as "We Care Remembrance Day".

short_summary: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by members of volunteer fire companies or voluntary ambulance services in a certain county
summary: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by members of volunteer fire companies or voluntary ambulance services in counties with a population of more than 208,000 but less than 220,000.

short_summary: Relates to including information concerning repayment of outstanding loans in the standard financial aid award letter
summary: Relates to including information concerning repayment of outstanding loans in the standard financial aid award letter.

short_summary: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Lewiston Fire Company No. 1
summary: Expands the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Lewiston Fire Company No. 1.

short_summary: Relates to the Sanborn Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc., in relation to its purpose and the use of fire insurance premiums
summary: Expands the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Sanborn Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.

short_summary: Relates to the cost of maintenance and operation of local veterans' service agencies
summary: Provides that the state shall cover the cost of maintenance and operation of local veterans' service agencies up to certain set limits.

short_summary: Provides grants related to the expansion and support of crisis intervention services and training programs
summary: Relates to providing ten million dollars annually to be used for the provision of grants related to the expansion and support of crisis intervention services and diversion programs.

short_summary: Provides that excess investment tax credit amounts may be refundable to operators of a farm operation
summary: Provides that excess investment tax credit amounts may be refundable to operators of a farm operation.

short_summary: Relates to the eligibility criteria for the excelsior jobs program act
summary: Requires a business entity in violation of worker protection or environmental laws and regulations to surrender all previous state subsidies issued to such business entity.

short_summary: Relates to unregistered and unlicensed mortgage brokers
summary: Relates to unregistered and unlicensed mortgage brokers; establishes additional penalties against unlicensed or unregistered persons or entities engaging in activities after receiving a cease and desist notice.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment and reporting duties of the superintendent of the state police and to the appointment of employees of the state police
summary: Relates to the appointment and reporting duties of the superintendent of the state police and to the appointment of employees of the state police; requires the approval of certain duties of the state police by the superintendent of the state police.

short_summary: Enacts the corporate accountability for tax expenditures act
summary: Enacts the corporate accountability for tax expenditures act; standardizes applications for state development assistance for empire zone assistance and industrial development agency assistance; requires submission of certain development assistance agreements to the department of taxation and finance; requires recipients of certain development assistance to submit progress reports which include certain information and disclosures; makes certain recapture provisions; defines relevant terms.

short_summary: Provides for the adjustment of the minimum amount of tax delinquency for which the driver's license of a taxpayer may be suspended
summary: Provides for the adjustment of the minimum amount of tax delinquency for which the driver's license of a taxpayer may be suspended, based on inflation; prohibits inclusion in the license suspension program of a taxpayer who receives public assistance or supplemental security income, or whose income does not exceed 250% of the poverty level; authorizes the commissioner to grant exemptions to taxpayers whose payment of past due tax liabilities would create a hardship to the taxpayer in meeting necessary living expenses.

short_summary: Relates to designating early polling places
summary: Relates to designating early polling places.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the conversion of campaign funds for personal use
summary: Relates to campaign funds for personal use.

short_summary: Relates to permitting other qualifying members of a household to qualify for the disability rent increase exemption
summary: Permits other qualifying members of a household to qualify the household for the disability rent increase exemption when they are not the head of household.

short_summary: Establishes a task force on ensuring black people today have an equitable position in education, economic development and other fields and disciplines
summary: Establishes a task force on the issues facing black people since the end of slavery in the United States and holistic solutions to ensure that black people have an equitable position in education, economic development and other fields and disciplines.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of income for purposes of the senior citizen rent increase exemptions (SCRIE) program
summary: Excludes social security payments and supplemental security income from the definition of "income" for the purposes of determining eligibility under the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE).

short_summary: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans
summary: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans; provides that such tax credit is worth $3,000 per veteran hired or $4,000 for every disabled veteran hired and the total benefit shall not exceed $15,000 annually.

short_summary: Lowers the qualification amounts of acreage and annual sales for the purposes of agricultural assessments
summary: Lowers the qualification amounts of acreage and annual sales for the purposes of agricultural assessments.

short_summary: Requires certain non-licensed professionals to disclose information regarding risks
summary: Requires self-help practitioners to disclose information to clients regarding risks and to produce a risk management plan.

short_summary: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance
summary: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance.

short_summary: Prohibits operation of any motor vehicle equipped with any device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals
summary: Prohibits the operation of any motor vehicle equipped with a device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals; provides that the possession of such a device shall constitute a traffic infraction, use thereof is a class A misdemeanor, and use which results in personal injury or death shall constitute a class E felony.

short_summary: Sets a 7 year limit to the real property tax exemption for unimproved property of mandatory class nonprofit organizations
summary: Sets a 7-year limit to the real property tax exemption for unimproved property of mandatory class nonprofit organizations.

short_summary: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities
summary: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities including the benefits and limitations of non-invasive prenatal testing, the difference between non-invasive prenatal testing and prenatal diagnostic testing, and current recommendations from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine, and the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG).

short_summary: Relates to the location of the annual school district elections
summary: Provides that school districts may hold elections in any building owned or leased by the district, in addition to any district schoolhouse.

short_summary: Relates to schedule in case of disability
summary: Increases compensation schedule in case of disability; provides that compensation after July 1, 2026 shall not be less than one-fifth of the New York state average weekly wage unless the employee's weekly wage is equal to or less than one-fifth the weekly wage, then they shall receive the entire amount.

short_summary: Provides a religious exemption for the requirement to have a photograph taken for a driver's license or learner's permit
summary: Provides a religious exemption for the requirement to have a photograph taken for a driver's license or learner's permit.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state community commission on reparations remedies
summary: Relates to acknowledging the fundamental injustice, cruelty, brutality and inhumanity of slavery in the city of New York and the state of New York; establishes the New York state community commission on reparations remedies to examine the institution of slavery, subsequently de jure and de facto racial and economic discrimination against African-Americans, the impact of these forces on living African-Americans and to make recommendations on appropriate remedies; provides for the repeal of such provisions.

short_summary: Waives state's sovereign immunity to liability under the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and certain other federal acts
summary: Waives the state's sovereign immunity to liability for violations of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, the Fair Labor Standards Act, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, and the Family and Medical Leave Act; waives the immunity of all instrumentalities and political subdivisions of the state.

short_summary: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official to the class D felony of assault in the second degree
summary: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official in the second degree to a class D felony.

short_summary: Increases the penalty for rape in the first degree
summary: Increases the penalty for rape in the first degree from a class B felony to an class A-II felony.

short_summary: Establishes the rural teacher education loan repayment program in the education department
summary: Establishes the rural teacher education loan repayment program in the education department which provides payment for the undergraduate and graduate education loans of teachers in rural school districts who agree to teach in rural areas for at least 5 years.

short_summary: Relates to posting of private property
summary: Permits owners of private property to post such property to prevent trespass by painting purple markings on trees or markers.

short_summary: Relates to reserve funds to ensure compliance with the tax cap in future school years
summary: Authorizes school districts with low combined wealth ratios to establish a reserve fund to ensure compliance with the tax cap in future school years.

short_summary: Repeals provision of law prohibiting the possession of certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices and the exemption of certain ammunition feeding devices at firing ranges; repealer
summary: Repeals provision of law prohibiting the possession of certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices and the exemption of certain ammunition feeding devices at firing ranges.

short_summary: Eliminates additional application fees and annual fees for special license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United States
summary: Eliminates additional application fees and annual fees for special license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United States.

short_summary: Provides for funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants
summary: Relates to funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants.

short_summary: Includes implantable infusion pumps for chronic non-cancer pain management as standard coverage for medical assistance
summary: Includes implantable infusion pumps for chronic non-cancer pain management as standard coverage for medical assistance.

short_summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester to establish certain speed limits on rural major and minor collector roads at twenty-five miles per hour
summary: Authorizes the town board of the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester to establish certain speed limits on rural major and minor collector roads at twenty-five miles per hour.

short_summary: Designates unlawful discriminatory practices relating to persons recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse
summary: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices by government agencies relating to persons recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse.

short_summary: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters
summary: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters.

short_summary: Mandates commercial insurance coverage of peer support services as part of treatment for substance use disorder
summary: Mandates commercial insurance coverage of peer support services as part of treatment for substance use disorder.

short_summary: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle for more than 3 consecutive minutes
summary: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle, with certain exceptions, for more than 3 consecutive minutes; establishes the first violation is a warning and subsequent violations of such section are traffic infractions punishable by a fine of $150.

short_summary: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for certain renewable energy generating projects
summary: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for renewable energy generating projects with a generating capacity not exceeding two megawatts and which are located above real property currently used for vehicle parking.

short_summary: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries
summary: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries.

short_summary: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration
summary: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration.

short_summary: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
summary: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

short_summary: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital
summary: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital in the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, until an investigation and/or audit by the New York State Department of Health, the New York State Attorney General or the New York State Comptroller has been conducted to ascertain whether there was any impropriety in the handling and management of funds in such pension plan.

short_summary: Requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges
summary: Enacts the "utility ratepayer protection act"; requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges.

short_summary: Requires the estimated cost of mandated expenditures and appropriations within the body of the bill
summary: Requires the estimated cost of mandated expenditures and appropriations within the body of the bill.

short_summary: Relates to school bus parking on New York City streets
summary: Prohibits school bus parking on city streets on weekdays between the hours of 5 p.m. and 5 a.m. and on weekends from 5 p.m. on Friday to 5 a.m. on Monday.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer and requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer
summary: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer; requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer.

short_summary: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty
summary: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty.

short_summary: Relates to jury deliberations
summary: Allows for written instructions regarding elements to be supplied to a jury.

short_summary: Includes doulas as medical services providers for Medicaid recipients
summary: Includes doulas as medical services providers for Medicaid recipients; directs the commissioner of health to submit an application for amendments and waivers to add doulas to such coverage pursuant to section 363-e of the social services law; directs the commissioner of health and the commissioner of the office of children and family services to add, amend and/or repeal any rule or regulation necessary.

short_summary: Requires certain health care providers to disclose certain facts in regards to probation to current and new patients
summary: Requires certain health care providers to disclose certain facts in regards to probation to current and new patients.

short_summary: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program
summary: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program to attract and retain underrepresented certified teachers in schools which have an underrepresentation of underrepresented certified teachers; provides for grants and procedures for applying for such grants and eligibility requirements for fund distribution.

short_summary: Ensures ovarian cancer survivors have the right to access screenings for health conditions
summary: Ensures ovarian cancer survivors have the right to access screenings for health conditions.

short_summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for diagnosis and treatment of fibroids
summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for procedures relating to the diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and related conditions, including pain, discomfort and infertility resulting therefrom.

short_summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to maintain a publicly available database of the results of its graded inspections on its website
summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to maintain a publicly available database of the results of its graded inspections on its website; requires the department to provide information as to where a customer may file a consumer report; requires the department to facilitate and coordinate the planning and implementation of an awareness and educational program to inform the general public on the standards retail food stores shall meet and how consumers may report retail food stores with poor sanitary conditions.

short_summary: Requires health insurance policies and medicaid to cover biomarker testing for certain purposes
summary: Requires health insurance policies and medicaid to cover biomarker testing for diagnosis, treatment, appropriate management, or ongoing monitoring of a covered person's disease or condition when the test is supported by medical and scientific evidence.

short_summary: Provides for primary care investment
summary: Requires health care plans and payors to have a minimum of twelve and one-half percent of their total expenditures on physical and mental health annually be for primary care services.

short_summary: Relates to a review of reimbursement adequacy for early intervention services
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to do a comprehensive assessment of the existing methodology used to determine payment for early intervention screenings, evaluations, services and service coordination; directs recommendations on reimbursement methodology as well as needs under the program.

short_summary: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
summary: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans
summary: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans; requires utility companies headquartered in New York to establish a statewide program to provide eligible participants with affordable payment plans.

short_summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for veterans
summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for veterans; provides that utilities, waterworks corporations, telephone corporations and cable television companies shall create discount programs that provide a 10 percent discount to veterans; defines terms.

short_summary: Establishes a wind siting designation board
summary: Establishes a wind siting designation board consisting of the department of environmental conservation's nine regional planning bodies each of which will consider applications on an individual basis and may consider designating areas within a region where it shall be impermissible to site a wind farm; outlines the nine regions.

short_summary: Establishes a moratorium prohibiting certain broadband terminations and disconnections during a state disaster emergency
summary: Establishes a moratorium prohibiting certain broadband service terminations and disconnections during a state disaster emergency.

short_summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability
summary: Relates to establishing discount programs for low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability; provides that utilities, waterworks corporations, telephone corporations and cable television companies shall create discount programs that provide a 10 percent discount to low-income senior citizens and individuals with a disability; defines terms.

short_summary: Directs payment of certain taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund to be made without appropriation
summary: Directs payment of certain internet sales and use taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund partially dedicated for the MTA to be made without appropriation.

short_summary: Establishes the municipal severe storm relief fund for Rockaway, Queens to be administered by the division of homeland security
summary: Relates to establishing the municipal severe storm relief fund for Rockaway, Queens to be administered by the division of homeland security and emergency services for damages that occurred as a result of Hurricane Sandy which caused damage from October twenty-ninth through November third, two thousand twelve.

short_summary: Relates to exempting certain over the counter family planning supplies from sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Creates a tax exemption for certain over the counter family planning supplies from sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed
summary: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed; provides insurers cannot require access to genetic testing results and cannot take adverse action against someone for not providing genetic testing results.

short_summary: Relates to flexible working arrangements for parents and legal guardians when day care centers and schools are closed during a state or local disaster emergency
summary: Allows parents and legal guardians to work from home; allows flexible working arrangements during a public health emergency or state or local disaster emergency which closes schools or day care centers; defines terms; creates a rebuttable presumption that an employee can work remotely if such employee has done so for two consecutive pay periods or two weeks; creates a civil penalty for violations.

short_summary: Relates to allowances for the costs of diapers
summary: Relates to authorizing the payment of costs, up to eighty dollars, of diapers for an eligible child two years of age or younger for children receiving safety net assistance.

short_summary: Requires the inclusion of diversity and inclusion training in the basic training and pre-employment course curricula for police, firefighters, correction officers and first responders
summary: Requires the inclusion of diversity and inclusion training in the basic training and pre-employment course curricula for state police officers and municipal police officers and sheriffs, members of fire departments and companies, corrections officers, first responders, emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians.

short_summary: Establishes environmental standards for lead in ambient air and lead contamination in soils and lead dust on floors and window sills
summary: Establishes environmental standards for lead in ambient air and lead contamination in soils and lead dust on floors and window sills.

short_summary: Provides access to medication abortion prescription drugs at SUNY and CUNY campuses
summary: Provides access to medication abortion prescription drugs at SUNY and CUNY campuses by employing or contracting with individuals authorized to prescribe such drugs, or by providing referrals.

short_summary: Relates to the special powers of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority
summary: Requires the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, in consultation with the New York city transit authority, the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company, to allow riders travelling within the limits of the city of New York to pay a fare for commuter rail service equal to that of a MetroCard ride and for such riders to make free transfers.

short_summary: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi
summary: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi.

short_summary: Requires that notice be given to the community boards when there is a change in service furnished upon the rapid transit facilities or the omnibus line facilities of the New York city transit authority
summary: Requires that notice be given to the community boards when there is a change in service furnished upon the rapid transit facilities or the omnibus line facilities of the New York city transit authority.

short_summary: Requires food service establishments to make deliveries of food in tamper evident packaging
summary: Requires food service establishments to make deliveries of food in tamper evident packaging.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment for agricultural representation on the state fire prevention and building code council
summary: Relates to the appointment for agricultural representation on the state fire prevention and building code council.

short_summary: Requires the installation of fire extinguishers in all multiple dwellings
summary: Requires the installation of fire extinguishers in all multiple dwellings.

short_summary: Allows the higher education services corporation to consider an applicant's change in income due to the loss of employment in determining eligibility and award amount for the tuition assistance program
summary: Allows the higher education services corporation to consider an applicant's change in income due to the loss of employment in determining eligibility and award amount for the tuition assistance program; provides for the repeal of such provisions on December 31, 2024.

short_summary: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred fifty dollars
summary: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred fifty dollars.

short_summary: Requires instruction in agriculture
summary: Requires instruction in agriculture in every elementary, middle, and high school under state control or supported wholly or partly by the state.

short_summary: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine
summary: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine on bodies of freshwater located within the state and within the jurisdiction and control of the state.

short_summary: Excludes certain real property conveyances from the written notice requirement
summary: Excludes real property conveyances from the written notice requirement when such property is being conveyed by the state of New York or any of its political subdivisions as part of a foreclosure proceeding.

short_summary: Prohibits a government entity, its political subdivisions, agents or assigns from issuing regulations or guidance related to the COVID-19 virus without first getting approval from the state legislature
summary: Prohibits a government entity, its political subdivisions, agents or assigns from issuing regulations or guidance related to the COVID-19 virus without first getting approval from the state legislature.

short_summary: Determines that disability compensation or benefits received by veterans from the VA are not to be treated as income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility for means-tested programs
summary: Determines that disability compensation or benefits received by veterans from the United States department of veterans affairs are not to be treated as income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility for means-tested programs.

short_summary: Relates to business safety plans and liability of businesses for damages associated with a pandemic
summary: Requires each place of employment to develop a business safety plan to provide reasonable and adequate protection from a pandemic disease for all employees and people who lawfully frequent such places; provides that employers who develop and follow safety plans are not liable for damages to employees or patrons due to disease during a pandemic.

short_summary: Adopts the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact model language; adopts the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact model language; and adopts the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact
summary: Adopts the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact model language (Part A); adopts the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact model language (Part B); adopts the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact (Part C).

short_summary: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact, the recognition of emergency medical services personnel licensure interstate compact and the counseling compactmodel legislation
summary: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact (Part A); adopts the recognition of emergency medical services personnel licensure interstate compact (Part B); adopts the counseling compact model legislation, approved on December fourth, two thousand twenty by the advisory group formed by the national center for interstate compacts (Part C).

short_summary: Enacts the interstate nurse licensure compact and the advanced practice registered nurse compact
summary: Adopts the interstate nurse licensure compact (Part A); adopts the advanced practice registered nurse compact (Part B).

short_summary: Relates to background clearances for prospective employees and volunteers of mentoring programs
summary: Permits mentoring programs to conduct background clearances of prospective employees and volunteers to determine whether any such person has been reported for child abuse or maltreatment or is on the sex offender registry.

short_summary: Requires corporations to provide written notice to the municipality in which the canal is located and properties adjacent to such canal prior to commencing work along such canal
summary: Requires corporations to provide written notice to the municipality in which the canal is located and properties adjacent to such canal prior to commencing work along such canal; requires the corporation to hold a public hearing prior to commencing such work; allows for exceptions in certain situations.

short_summary: Increases access to substance abuse programming for incarcerated individuals whose first language is not English
summary: Increases access to substance abuse programming for incarcerated individuals whose first language is not English.

short_summary: Requires certain health insurance policies to include coverage for the cost of certain infant and baby formulas
summary: Requires certain health insurance policies to include coverage for the cost of certain infant and baby formulas.

short_summary: Caps the amount of collectible rent increases due to major capital improvements at six percent of the legal regulated rent
summary: Caps the amount of collectible rent increases due to major capital improvements at six percent of the legal regulated rent.

short_summary: Creates minority and women-owned business enterprise regional advocates
summary: Creates minority and women-owned business enterprise regional advocates; provides that the advocates will help ensure that municipal agencies comply with the provisions of law relating to minority and women-owned business enterprises.

short_summary: Raises the monetary value of damaged property that is considered criminal mischief or securities fraud
summary: Raises the monetary value of damaged property that is considered criminal mischief or securities fraud.

short_summary: Relates to caseload relief
summary: Relates to requiring limits on the number of cases a public defender may be assigned in any given year.

short_summary: Prohibits public officials from releasing sealed juvenile police records
summary: Prohibits public officials from releasing sealed juvenile police records; makes such official misconduct a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting industrial development agencies from incentivizing movements within the state
summary: Prohibits industrial development agencies from incentivizing movements within the state where any plant, facility, or personnel of the project occupant are abandoned or removed.

short_summary: Establishes mandatory minimum medicaid coverage for hospital confinement for childbirth
summary: Requires all insurance policies and health maintenance organization contracts to provide coverage for maternity patients and their newborns for hospital stays of at least 48 hours following childbirth by natural delivery and 96 hours following childbirth by caesarean section; provides such coverage for patients who are recipients of medicaid.

short_summary: Requires notification of impending expiration of vehicle inspection
summary: Establishes that the department of motor vehicles shall notify individuals via postal mail or electronic notification that their vehicle inspection is subject to expiration thirty days before such expiration; provides for a five day grace period after the expiration of the vehicle inspection certificate wherein operators of such vehicle shall not be fined.

short_summary: Provides a limitation on actions to collect overcharges
summary: Provides that an action to recover the amount of an overcharge based upon a mistake or billing error made by an electric, gas or telephone corporation must be commenced within ten years.

short_summary: Creates the middle class circuit breaker tax credit and a tax reform study commission
summary: Creates the middle class circuit breaker tax credit allowing a credit against personal income tax, equal to seventy percent of the amount by which the taxpayer's net real property tax or the taxpayer's real property tax equivalent exceeds the taxpayer's maximum real property tax; establishes a tax reform study commission.

short_summary: Waives pandemic unemployment assistance repayments under certain circumstances
summary: Waives Unemployment Pandemic Benefits repayments in whole or in part if the payment of such pandemic unemployment assistance was without fault on the part of the claimant and such repayment would be contrary to equity and good conscience.

short_summary: Relates to leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter or bicycle with an electric assist system without reporting in the first and second degrees
summary: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the second degree and leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first degree; provides increased penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a wheeled non-motorized means of conveyance without reporting in the first and second degrees when the vehicle involved is a bicycle with an electric assist system.

short_summary: Expands the offense of assault in the second degree to include the causing of injury to a frontline employee enforcing a rule or regulation related to controlling the spread of communicable diseases
summary: Expands the offense of assault in the second degree to include the causing of injury to a frontline employee enforcing a city or state rule or regulation related to controlling the spread of communicable diseases.

short_summary: Exempts a person from a money judgment arising from an action in another state for knowingly engaging in conduct that aids or abets the performance or inducement of an abortion
summary: Exempts a person from a money judgment arising from an action in another state for knowingly engaging in conduct that aids or abets the performance or inducement of an abortion.

short_summary: Increases the penalties for owners of dangerous dogs
summary: Increases the penalties for owners of dangerous dogs and subjects certain dangerous dog owners to further investigation.

short_summary: Establishes an LGBTQ+ youth and young adult suicide prevention task force; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof
summary: Establishes an LGBTQ+ youth and young adult suicide prevention task force; provides for the number of members, manner of appointment and the topics to be reviewed.

short_summary: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
summary: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; eliminates the requirement that an incarcerated individual causes or attempts to cause an employee to come into contact with blood, seminal fluid, urine, feces, or the contents of a toilet bowl by throwing, tossing or expelling such fluid or material.

short_summary: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools
summary: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools.

short_summary: Provides press access to open meetings of an agency or authority and requires notice of such meetings to local governments
summary: Provides press access to open meetings of an agency or authority; requires notice of such meetings to local governments.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of education to develop and implement an expanded curriculum or instruction on the history of the labor movement in the United States
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to develop and implement an expanded curriculum or instruction on the history of the labor movement in the United States.

short_summary: Relates to the membership of the board of trustees of the state university of New York
summary: Relates to the membership of the board of trustees of the state university of New York; reduces the number of trustees appointed by the governor from fifteen to ten; adds one trustee appointment by the speaker of the assembly, one by the temporary president of the senate, one by a majority vote of SUNY and CUNY staff, and two by a majority vote of SUNY alumni.

short_summary: Relates to requiring consumer reporting agencies contact consumers when requests are made for their consumer reports
summary: Requires that consumer reporting agencies contact consumers when a request is made for their consumer reports; requires consumer reporting agencies to provide the consumer with information pertaining to the entity that requested the consumer report.

short_summary: Extends certain provisions of the real property tax law for persons over the age sixty-five and older and for certain persons with disabilities for one year due to the novel coronavirus, COVID-19 pandemic
summary: Authorizes every local municipal assessor to extend the renewal of certain provisions of the real property tax law for persons age sixty-five and older or for certain persons with disabilities and limited income for one year in the interest of public health and safety due to the novel coronavirus, COVID-19 pandemic; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes a cashless tolling amnesty program
summary: Requires the triborough bridge authority to establish a cashless tolling amnesty program; requires the metropolitan transportation authority to post their fee waiver policy on their website.

short_summary: Relates to exempting from the tax on retail sales the portion of a receipt from the purchase of a motor vehicle which is reduced due to a rebate or discount provided by a manufacturer to the purchaser
summary: Exempts from the tax on retail sales the portion of a receipt from the purchase of a motor vehicle which is reduced due to a customer rebate or customer discount provided by a manufacturer to the purchaser, that is applied against the amount due under the sales agreement.

short_summary: Relates to requiring emergency notices be provided to consumers in certain languages
summary: Requires every utility corporation or municipality who sends an emergency notice to consumers to make available and provide such notice in English, Spanish, Haitian-Creole, Mandarin, Cantonese, Arabic, French, Urdu, Hindi and Tagalog.

short_summary: Relates to awards of grants from the beginning farmers NY fund
summary: Changes the eligibility and criteria for awards of grants from the beginning farmers NY fund to enable more farmers to participate; requires that tiers be established for grants less than $15,000.

short_summary: Relates to the bond issuance charge
summary: Relates to the bond issuance charge as applied to the New York city housing development corporation.

short_summary: Prohibits a government entity, its political subdivisions, agents or assigns from requiring individuals to wear face coverings or face masks
summary: Prohibits a government entity, its political subdivisions, agents or assigns from requiring individuals to wear face coverings or face masks.

short_summary: Prohibits a government entity from requiring individuals to receive a COVID-19 vaccine
summary: Prohibits a government entity from requiring individuals to receive a COVID-19 vaccine.

short_summary: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems
summary: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems.

short_summary: Relates to providing judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; repealer
summary: Relates to providing judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders.

short_summary: Requires a utilization review agent to follow certain rules when establishing a step therapy protocol
summary: Requires a utilization review agent to follow certain rules when establishing a step therapy protocol; requires that the protocol accepts any attestation submitted by the insured's health care professional stating that a required drug has failed as prima facie evidence that the required drug has failed.

short_summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Orleans
summary: Permits the electronic appearance of a defendant in the county of Orleans.

short_summary: Relates to a plan to address court calendar congestion upon the expiration of the eviction moratorium
summary: Directs the chief administrator of the courts to develop a plan to address court calendar congestion upon the expiration of the eviction moratorium including additional temporary space for courts, additional hours, appointing additional judges to handle pending proceedings and coordination with OTDA.

short_summary: Prohibits municipal corporations from adopting local laws, ordinances, regulations, or policies that prohibit certain utility services from being delivered based on the type or source of energy
summary: Prohibits the governing board of a municipal corporation from adopting any law, ordinance, regulation or policy that prohibits, or has the effect of prohibiting, the connection or reconnection of a utility service to a customer based upon the type or source of energy to be delivered to the customer.

short_summary: Relates to commission of murder in the first degree; provides that sentence for commission of certain provisions of murder in the first degree is death or life without parole
summary: Includes intentionally selecting a victim based on certain actual or perceived traits in the crime of murder in the first degree; provides that sentence for commission of certain provisions of murder in the first degree is death or life without parole.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state volunteer fire protection emergency reimbursement account
summary: Establishes the New York state volunteer fire protection emergency reimbursement account; provides reimbursement for expenses incurred related to procurement of personal protective equipment and other expenses.

short_summary: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to the "Military Spouse Act of 2023"
summary: Permits a military spouse to practice an occupation upon submission of licensure, certification or registration to practice an equivalent occupation issued by any other state; provided the licensure standards are not lower than those of this state.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
summary: Authorizes the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy.

short_summary: Relates to adding two trustees to the power authority to represent Niagara county and St. Lawrence county
summary: Adds two trustees to the power authority to represent Niagara county and St. Lawrence county.

short_summary: Relates to the manner in which certain provisions of the correction law are enforced
summary: Relates to the manner in which certain provisions of the correction law are enforced.

short_summary: Relates to the age requirement for voting in a primary election
summary: Allows a U.S. citizen, who is seventeen years of age, to vote in a primary election, including presidential, if he or she will turn eighteen by the date of the corresponding general election.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding certain licensures and employment
summary: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding licensures and employment of persons previously convicted of one or more criminal offenses.

short_summary: Relates to conducting a study on various approaches to increasing broadband access within this state
summary: Relates to conducting a study on various approaches to increasing broadband access within this state.

short_summary: Creates a middle income home ownership subsidy program
summary: Creates a middle income home ownership subsidy program to assist persons with an income below the current median income for the city of New York with the purchase of a residence in an urban area.

short_summary: Prohibits warehousing of housing accommodations and harassment of tenants; provides penalties therefor
summary: Provides that penalties may be levied against a person who intentionally withholds a housing accommodation from the market, including for the purpose of future co-operative conversion.

short_summary: Effectuates a Medicaid rate enhancement for Valley Health Services of the Bassett Healthcare Network
summary: Effectuates a Medicaid rate enhancement for Valley Health Services of the Bassett Healthcare Network.

short_summary: Establishes a blue ribbon commission on fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry
summary: Establishes a blue ribbon commission on fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry to examine, evaluate and make recommendations regarding methods to promote fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry; provides such commission shall consist of eleven appointed members; requires a report to the governor and legislature on or before December 31, 2024.

short_summary: Reimbursement for certain lunch meals served during the declared COVID-19 state of emergency
summary: Relates to reimbursement for certain lunch meals served during the declared COVID-19 state of emergency.

short_summary: Provides that component school districts can not impose a tax levy for their share of the board of cooperative educational services capital expenditures
summary: Provides that component school districts cannot impose a tax levy for their share of the board of cooperative educational services capital expenditures.

short_summary: Relates to analysis of data in the prescription monitoring program registry
summary: Requires the department of health analysis of data in the prescription monitoring program registry.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for the New York state excelsior scholarship award to certain applicants enrolled on a part-time basis or in a BOCES or other approved vocational program
summary: Expands eligibility for the New York state excelsior scholarship award to certain applicants enrolled on a part-time basis or in a BOCES or other approved vocational program; provides criteria for eligibility, and limits on amounts and durations for any such awards.

short_summary: Requires the department of health to provide at least one site in each county of the state which offers COVID-19 vaccinations
summary: Requires the department of health to provide at least one site in each county of the state which offers COVID-19 vaccinations and to establish an enrollment portal which shall enable residents to be notified once they become eligible for the vaccine.

short_summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the assessment and repair of water infrastructure and provides for access to such water infrastructure
summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the assessment and repair of water infrastructure; provides for access to such water infrastructure.

short_summary: Relates to a state flag for raising awareness of veteran suicide
summary: Provides that the "Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Flag" shall be the official state flag for the raising of awareness of veteran suicide; directs the commissioner of general services to establish a protocol for the flying of such flag.

short_summary: Relates to a cost of living adjustment for human services programs
summary: Establishes an annual cost of living adjustment for human services programs indexed to inflation.

short_summary: Establishes the clean fuel standard of 2024
summary: Establishes the clean fuel standard of 2024; provides such standard is intended to reduce greenhouse gas intensity from the on-road transportation sector, with further reductions to be implemented based upon advances in technology.

short_summary: Directs the department of public service to prepare a written report on the effect of the COVID-19 state of emergency on certain utilities and on the affordability of services
summary: Directs the department of public service to prepare written reports on the effect the COVID-19 state of emergency has on certain utilities of electric, gas, water, wastewater, and telephone service to commercial and residential customers in the state and on the affordability of services.

short_summary: Establishes the "division of research and analysis" which is a separate division of the legislative library
summary: Establishes the "division of research and analysis" which is a part of the legislative library and assists members of the legislature by providing research and analysis on policy.

short_summary: Relates to the time to file a claim in a toxic tort case
summary: Provides that in toxic tort cases the date of discovery of the injury by the plaintiff or claimant is presumed to be the date of diagnosis and where the specific toxic etiological cause of injury is not known for up to ten years (instead of five years) after the injury itself is discovered a plaintiff shall have three years to file a claim from the time such specific cause is discovered.

short_summary: Relates to informal caregiver training
summary: Relates to informal caregiver training; defines "person in need of assistance"; expands who may serve as an "informal caregiver".

short_summary: Repeals the rebates for stock transfer tax paid; dedicates funds of the stock transfer tax fund and stock transfer incentive fund to various funds
summary: Repeals the rebates for stock transfer tax paid; dedicates funds of the stock transfer tax fund and stock transfer incentive fund to various funds; establishes the safe water and infrastructure action program.

short_summary: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products
summary: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products.

short_summary: Establishes a personal income tax credit for tolls paid by resident taxpayers during the course of commuting to and from their place of employment
summary: Establishes a personal income tax credit for tolls paid by resident taxpayers during the course of commuting to and from their place of employment.

short_summary: Relates to the minimum requirements for a quorum
summary: Relates to the minimum requirements for a quorum; establishes there shall be no less than a majority of the total number of members of the commission in order to transact any business, perform any duty or exercise any power.

short_summary: Requires the MTA to submit an annual report on all contract cost overruns that exceed one million dollars
summary: Requires the MTA to submit an annual report on all minor and major contract cost overruns; establishes such report shall include a list of all contracts where overruns exceed one million dollars, all contracting firms involved, the winning bid amounts, the actual costs incurred, a description of the project, completion delays, and an analysis of why the contract bid amount was exceeded.

short_summary: Directs the New York city housing authority to establish occupant protection plans for projects having lead paint
summary: Directs the New York city housing authority to establish occupant protection plans for projects having lead paint and post and maintain signs in conspicuous locations at the affected projects.

short_summary: Relates to adjustment of electric residential fixed charges
summary: Directs the department of public service to adjust each utility corporation's residential fixed charge upon such corporation's filing with the department of an amendment of rate schedules, to recover only the fixed costs and operation and maintenance expenses directly related to metering, billing, service connections and the provision of customer service.

short_summary: Enacts the adjacent neighbors' bill of rights
summary: Relates to enacting the "adjacent neighbors' bill of rights"; requires the department of buildings to develop a bulletin known as the "adjacent neighbors' bill of rights" advising homeowners who are adjacent to a property under development or construction of their rights and available resources and post such bulletin on the department's website.

short_summary: Relates to access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs
summary: Provides an owner or lessee access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs for certain circumstances.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York city council to approve or deny by a majority vote, any public authority's or public benefit corporation's use of eminent domain
summary: Authorizes the New York city council to approve or deny by a majority vote, any public authority's or public benefit corporation's use of eminent domain.

short_summary: Relates to absentee ballot tracking
summary: Requires the boards of elections to provide a secure website or web portal through which voters can track their absentee application or absentee ballot.

short_summary: Creates a wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard men and women, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel
summary: Creates a wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard men and women, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel.

short_summary: Relates to providing for the recall of a district attorney
summary: Provides for the recall of a district attorney.

short_summary: Creates the crime of reckless endangerment of the public health for recklessly transmitting HIV/AIDS
summary: Creates crimes of reckless endangerment of public health with respect to HIV/AIDS transmission; creates crime of filing false instrument with respect to HIV/AIDS; provides for HIV/AIDS testing for alleged sex offenders and public health offenders; provides for contagious disease testing for persons in the custody of the department of corrections; provides that if an incarcerated individual tests positive notice shall be given to all employees that will have contact with such incarcerated individual.

short_summary: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to certain hospitals
summary: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to hospitals and municipal housing authorities located within Niagara county.

short_summary: Relates to decisions by the state board on electric generation; repealer
summary: Relates to decisions by the state board on electric generation; requires approval through public referendum prior to certification for establishing a major electric generating facility.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting executive orders directing state police to not assist with the enforcement of federal laws
summary: Provides that employees of the state police shall not be directed by executive order or regulations to not assist with the enforcement of federal laws.
