short_summary: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to conduct a study on alternatives to the affordable New York housing program
summary: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to conduct a study on alternatives to the affordable New York housing program by investigating new models and partnerships to provide affordable housing to residents of the state.

short_summary: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system
summary: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York accountability in reporting act"
summary: Enacts the "New York accountability in reporting act"; establishes the crimes of offering a false report for filing in the second degree and offering a false report for filing in the first degree; includes falsely reporting an incident as a specified offense for the purposes of hate crimes; requires the creation of public databases for false reporting; provides for a civil remedy for convictions of such crimes.

short_summary: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in installments
summary: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in six or fewer equal installments.

short_summary: Relates to forensic DNA testing and to requests for certain DNA test comparisons
summary: Establishes the minimum period of time that forensic samples should be retained by investigating authorities; creates the state commission for the integrity of the criminal justice system, as an independent agency, and provides for such commission's powers and duties; relates to special fictitious name indictments; relates to requests for certain DNA test comparisons; relates to forensic DNA testing; relates to claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment; relates to DNA testing, data collection and record keeping; relates to DNA testing in felony cases.

short_summary: Requires landlords to check state sex offender registry when leasing to a new tenant or on notice of sublet, and to notify tenants with children of certain listings
summary: Requires landlords to check the state sex offender registry when leasing to a new tenant, subtenant or adult occupant, and to notify tenants with children under age sixteen of any listing of such tenant, subtenant or adult occupant as a level three sex offender; exempts landlord from any civil or criminal liability for damages for any discretionary decision to release relevant information pursuant to this section or for failing to release such information, unless it is shown the landlord acted with gross negligence or in bad faith.

short_summary: Relates to requiring inspections for Legionnaires' disease in certain locations
summary: Requires annual inspections in certain locations by the department of health for the presence of Legionnaires' disease.

short_summary: Relates to the compensation an attorney shall be entitled to for client representation through the bar association
summary: Provides the amount of compensation an attorney shall receive from representing a client which was assigned to the attorney through the bar association; increases such amount from seventy-five dollars to one hundred fifty dollars per hour; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to restrictions on immigration bonds and disclosures for providers of immigrant assistant services
summary: Places restrictions on immigration bonds and requires certain disclosures for providers of immigrant assistant services.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the FreshConnect program
summary: Expands the FreshConnect program, which provides rebates for the purchase of local produce to certain people, to include local produce sold in supermarkets and grocery stores.

short_summary: Authorizes appointment of alternate rent guidelines board members in the city of New York, counties outside the city, towns, and villages
summary: Provides for the appointment of three alternates on rent guideline boards; one alternate shall represent tenants, one shall represent owners of property and one shall be a public representative; alternates shall be permitted to participate in all proceedings of the board as non-voting members; an alternate shall only participate as a voting member of the board and be paid when a member, representing the same interest as the alternate, is unable to fulfill his or her duties on the board; applies to the city of New York, counties outside the city, towns and villages.

short_summary: Enacts the "health insurance preauthorization disclosure act"
summary: Enacts the "health insurance preauthorization disclosure act"; requires health insurance companies to provide participating health care providers with a list of health care treatments and services that require preauthorization from the health insurance company.

short_summary: Establishes the lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender, and people living with HIV long-term care facility residents' bill of rights
summary: Establishes the lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender, and people living with HIV long-term care facility residents' bill of rights; prohibits a long-term care facility or facility staff from discriminating against any resident on the basis of such resident's actual or perceived sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or HIV status.

short_summary: Relates to the former crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense and expunges criminal records for persons previously convicted of such crime
summary: Relates to the former crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense; expunges criminal records for persons previously convicted of such crime; directs the chief administrator of the courts to provide information regarding such expungement; adds language to identify that the crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense is no longer in law.

short_summary: Relates to removing mandatory retirement age for certain judges and justices
summary: Removes mandatory requirement age for certain judges and justices not otherwise required to retire by the state constitution.

short_summary: Provides for the regulation by the department of environmental conservation of business transaction paper containing bisphenol A
summary: Prohibits the distribution and use of paper containing bisphenol A for the recording of any business transaction.

short_summary: Establishes confirmatory adoptions and allowing courts to grant the custody and support from more than two parents
summary: Establishes confirmatory adoptions allowing adoption and parentage judgements for a child with more than two parents; recognizes functional parents as legal parents; allows "de facto parents" to get a court order confirming their parentage; grants all legal parents standing to seek visitation or custody of their children.

short_summary: Requires human breast milk banks, companies and cooperatives to comply with certain standards and provides for education and support of certain breastfeeding mothers
summary: Requires human breast milk banks, companies and cooperatives to comply with certain standards; provides for education and support of certain breastfeeding mothers.

short_summary: Relates to strategic lawsuits against public participation and makes technical corrections
summary: Relates to strategic lawsuits against public participation; makes technical corrections; relates to the applicability of chapter 250 of the laws of 2020 amending the civil rights law relating to actions involving public petition and participation.

short_summary: Establishes the New York water authority
summary: Establishes the New York water authority for the purposes of purchasing, upgrading, and maintaining small private water companies; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Requires the public service commission and the department of environmental conservation to conduct audits of private water companies
summary: Establishes the "small water utility transparency act"; requires the public service commission and the department of environmental conservation to conduct audits of certain private water companies; requires certain private water companies which are under certain investigations to file public updates on the status of compliance with such orders.

short_summary: Designates March 8th each year as a day of commemoration, to be known as International Women's Day
summary: Designates March 8th each year as a day of commemoration, to be known as International Women's Day.

short_summary: Relates to the design of uniform standards and conditions relating to the construction and operation of major renewable energy facilities
summary: Relates to the design of uniform standards and conditions relating to the construction and operation of major renewable energy facilities and the review of applications for permits to develop such facilities.

short_summary: Relates to the classification of the town of Ulster in the county of Ulster
summary: Relates to the classification of the town of Ulster in the county of Ulster.

short_summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to develop and propose an appropriation to fund the charge New York drive clean rebate program
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to develop and propose an appropriation to fund the charge New York drive clean rebate program.

short_summary: Provides that limited liability for persons held jointly liable shall not apply to parties held liable for failing to provide reasonable security
summary: Provides that limited liability for persons held jointly liable shall not apply to parties held liable for failing to provide reasonable security or failing to provide security required by federal, state or local law, rules or regulations.

short_summary: Relates to unfair claim settlement practices
summary: Relates to claim settlement practices when an insurer refuses to pay or is delaying payment of a settlement; provides a policyholder a private right of action against such insurer doing business in the state who has refused or delayed payment of an insurance claim.

short_summary: Allows certain claimants to be reclassified as permanent total disability or total industrial disability due to extreme hardship
summary: Allows certain claimants to be reclassified as permanent total disability or total industrial disability due to extreme hardship; defines extreme hardship.

short_summary: Relates to eligibility for classification as permanent total disability
summary: Relates to eligibility for classification as permanent total disability; includes inability to perform the full range of sedentary work or approval for federal social security disability benefits as a result of a compensable accident or occupational disease as constituting permanent total disability.

short_summary: Establishes the nail salon minimum standards council act
summary: Establishes the nail salon minimum standards council act; establishes the nail salon minimum standards council which shall investigate wages and standards within the nail salon industry and submit recommendations on minimum wages, regulations and standards for nail salon workers.

short_summary: Requires employers of domestic workers to provide annual sick leave to such workers
summary: Requires employers of domestic workers to provide annual sick leave to such workers.

short_summary: Establishes the employee privacy act prohibiting employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant
summary: Prohibits employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant who has not been offered employment and prohibits municipalities from requiring employers to use the federal electronic employment verification system.

short_summary: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses
summary: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses; requires the use of a special mark to indicate service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.

short_summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide sixty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide sixty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

short_summary: Creates the racing fan advisory council
summary: Creates the racing fan advisory council.

short_summary: Relates to political contribution activities by an intermediary
summary: Regulates political contribution activities by intermediaries; requires that when contributions made by an intermediary to a candidate or a committee are over $1,000, the name, occupation and address of each contributor shall be disclosed.

short_summary: Requires the state to keep state lottery winners identities anonymous
summary: Requires the state to keep state lottery winners' identities anonymous to the general public unless the lottery winner gives their consent.

short_summary: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault
summary: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault for the causation of serious physical injury to or death of, as the case may be, any person, with intent to cause physical injury to such person or a third person.

short_summary: Exempts certain veterans service organizations from taxes on the sales of beer, wine and soda
summary: Exempts certain veterans service organizations from taxes on the sales of beer, wine and soda.

short_summary: Relates to instruction in financial management
summary: Requires instruction in financial management for all students in grades four through eight.

short_summary: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at certain veterans' organization facilities
summary: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at congressionally chartered veterans' organization facilities.

short_summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on the feasibility of constructing a seawall along the coastline of the city of New York
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on the feasibility of constructing a seawall along the coastline of the city of New York and report on such study to the legislature by December 31, 2027.

short_summary: Revokes community supervision for certain conduct
summary: Revokes community supervision for certain conduct involving kidnapping, coercion, firearms, dangerous weapons, and other conduct.

short_summary: Makes reclassification of rent controlled dwelling retroactive to time of decrease in income of members of household of dwelling
summary: Makes reclassification of rent controlled dwelling retroactive to time of decrease in income of members of household of dwelling.

short_summary: Requires victims be notified of right to make a victim impact statement and allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement
summary: Requires the district attorney to notify victims by letter of the final disposition of the case within sixty days of such disposition in cases where such final disposition includes a conviction; provides such letter shall also notify victims of their right to make a victim impact statement; allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement.

short_summary: Provides an exemption to the prohibition on tinted windows in automobiles for emergency ambulance service vehicles
summary: Provides an exemption to the prohibition on tinted windows in automobiles for emergency ambulance service vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to the display of a bus driver's credentials
summary: Requires the display of a bus driver's credentials prominently while he or she is on duty and changes the review of his or her files by the department from every three years to annually.

short_summary: Relates to the practice of professional geology
summary: Relates to the practice of professional geology.

short_summary: Relates to tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by and real property owned by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
summary: Relates to tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by and real property owned by senior citizens or persons with disabilities.

short_summary: Includes assault on a corrections officer as a class C felony
summary: Includes assault on a corrections officer as a class C felony.

short_summary: Relates to screening for gifted and talented students
summary: Requires school districts to screen for gifted and talented students; provides the parents or guardians of such students the option to opt out of such screening.

short_summary: Establishes enhanced penalties for coercive threats to expose immigration status of witnesses and domestic violence victims
summary: Establishes enhanced penalties for coercive threats to expose immigration status of witnesses and domestic violence victims.

short_summary: Relates to designating January 13th as Korean-American Day
summary: Relates to designating January 13th as Korean-American Day.

short_summary: Establishes a matching grant program for certain small businesses receiving funding under the federal small business innovation research program or the small business technology transfer program
summary: Establishes a matching grant program for small businesses receiving phase one or phase two funding under the federal small business innovation research program or the small business technology transfer program to promote commercialization and cover certain expenses.

short_summary: Prohibits the denial of a building permit on the basis that such building will be a mixed-fuel building
summary: Prohibits a municipal corporation from prohibiting the issuing of a permit for the construction of any new commercial, residential, or mixed-use building on the basis that such building will be a mixed-fuel building.

short_summary: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill certain monetary commitments
summary: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill all outstanding monetary commitments made to any local government for a fiscal year prior to allocating any moneys to economic development grant programs for the following fiscal year.

short_summary: Requires certain handicap accessible playground equipment in each playground within each state park
summary: Requires at least one handicap accessible swing set in each state park.

short_summary: Requires that driver's licenses indicate the blood type of the licensee upon the licensee's request
summary: Requires that driver's licenses indicate the blood type of the licensee upon the licensee's request.

short_summary: Establishes the everyone can play grant program
summary: Establishes the everyone can play grant program which allows for grants up to $100,000 to municipalities to cover the costs for the creation of handicap accessible aspects in new or existing recreation facilities.

short_summary: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to certain criminal justice reform in the state of New York; repealer
summary: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to certain criminal justice reform in the state of New York; establishes law enforcement officer grant funds (Part A); provides judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders (Part B); requires affirmative consent for the disclosure of contact information of witnesses to a defendant; provides that denial of such consent shall only be for good cause as determined by the court (Part C); relates to consideration of the death penalty for the commission of certain provisions of murder in the first degree (Part D).

short_summary: Increases the age of eligibility for provisional or permanent appointment of certain police officers from thirty-five to forty
summary: Increases the age of eligibility for provisional or permanent appointment of certain police officers from thirty-five to forty.

short_summary: Authorizes the issuance of distinctive legion of valor license plates
summary: Authorizes the issuance of distinctive legion of valor license plates for individuals who have received the army medal of honor, navy medal of honor, air force medal of honor, army distinguished service cross, navy cross, coast guard cross, or air force cross.

short_summary: Authorizes real property taxing jurisdictions to grant a partial tax exemption for property purchased by a clinician in a clinician shortage area
summary: Authorizes real property taxing jurisdictions to grant a partial tax exemption for property purchased by a clinician in a clinician shortage area, as determined by the commissioner of health, which will be such clinician's primary residence and he or she will practice in such shortage area; provides state aid to taxing jurisdictions which grant the exemption to the extent of the tax savings provided to clinicians.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state independent budget office
summary: Creates the New York state independent budget office with a director to be appointed, upon the recommendations of an independent budget office advisory committee, by the speaker of the assembly and the temporary president of the senate; establishes such office shall provide objective, non-partisan and timely analyses of state revenue, expenditures and management practices to members of the legislature for any legislation with fiscal impact or at the request of a leader or a committee.

short_summary: Eliminates the registration fee for gold star mother and gold star family member distinctive license plates
summary: Provides for distinctive license plates for gold star family members; eliminates the registration fee for gold star mother and gold star family member distinctive license plates.

short_summary: Relates to the maintenance, improvement and repair of certain town highways
summary: Permits the designation of low volume roads and minimum maintenance roads by town boards; enacts provisions relating to the maintenance, improvement and repair of such roads.

short_summary: Relates to tuition scholarship award programs for certain resident and non-resident medical students
summary: Relates to tuition scholarship award programs for certain resident and non-resident medical students attending approved medical programs on a full-time basis.

short_summary: Establishes the commission on public authority reform to study and investigate reducing the number of public authorities and their subsidiaries
summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to be known as the commission on public authority reform to study and investigate reducing the number of public authorities and their subsidiaries in New York state; requires reporting; appropriates $100,000 therefor.

short_summary: Relates to sickle cell disease detection and education
summary: Directs the health equity council to advise the commissioner regarding sickle cell disease.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of the New York state promise program; appropriation
summary: Relates to the establishment of the New York state promise program for community college courses; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to requiring plaintiffs to furnish proof that notice of possible foreclosure was delivered to the defendant
summary: Requires plaintiffs to furnish official proof of delivery demonstrating that notice of possible foreclosure was delivered to the defendant.

short_summary: Requires all bus companies to post on their websites or at the places they sell tickets, certain information
summary: Requires all bus companies to post on their internet websites or at the places they sell tickets, certain information maintained by the federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit for the installation of certain fire sprinkler systems
summary: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems for residential properties.

short_summary: Relates to the adjudication of toll collection violations
summary: Relates to the adjudication of toll collection violations.

short_summary: Relates to a tax on gross income upon every corporation which derives income from the data individuals of this state share with such corporations
summary: Requires a five percent tax on gross income upon every corporation which derives income from the data individuals of this state share with such corporations; establishes the New York data fund to distribute the earnings of the five percent to each taxpayer of the state.

short_summary: Relates to amending the New York City Charter in relation to expanding the investigative scope of the Civilian Complaint Review Board
summary: Expands the investigative powers of the Civilian Complaint Review Board to include complaints alleging bias-based profiling.

short_summary: Relates to processing fees resulting from credit card or other non-cash payments selected by passengers of taxicabs and for-hire transportation
summary: Grants authority for medallion owners and designated agents to pass along credit card processing fees to the customer.

short_summary: Relates to liability of the state for damages caused by reported defects and potholes
summary: Relates to liability of the state for damages caused by reported defects and potholes if the report was made fourteen days or more before the damage occurred; establishes an interactive website for reporting defects and potholes on the state highway system and thruway.

short_summary: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services
summary: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services.

short_summary: Authorizes the comptroller to audit local development corporations
summary: Authorizes the comptroller to audit local development corporations.

short_summary: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances
summary: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances; requires each utility corporation and municipality within six months to submit to the commission a model procedure for the calculation of estimated bills that incorporates best practices and technology and accounts for any barriers to the use of actual meter readings.

short_summary: Establishes the consolidated assistance program for EMS departments which creates a sustainable state financing mechanism for emergency medical services
summary: Establishes the consolidated assistance program for EMS departments which creates a sustainable state financing mechanism for emergency medical services.

short_summary: Establishes the natural carbon sequestration research program
summary: Establishes the natural carbon sequestration research program to develop innovative science-based solutions to facilitate sequestration of carbon in New York's natural and working lands; provides funding for such program.

short_summary: Relates to designating Lactarius peckii as the official state fungus of the state
summary: Designates Lactarius peckii as the official state fungus of the state.

short_summary: Provides for dispensing emergency contraception under certain conditions
summary: Provides for dispensing emergency contraception under certain conditions; defines emergency contraception.

short_summary: Enacts the birds and bees protection act
summary: Enacts the birds and bees protection act; prohibits the sale of certain pesticides or use of seeds coated with such pesticides; requires the department of environmental conservation to review the latest scientific information concerning certain pesticide active ingredients.

short_summary: Enacts the monarch preservation plan
summary: Enacts the monarch preservation plan requiring the department of environmental conservation to take feasible actions to conserve monarch butterflies and the unique habitats they depend upon for successful migration.

short_summary: Replaces each instance of the word accident with the word crash in relation to vehicle and traffic law
summary: Replaces each instance of the word accident with the word crash in relation to the vehicle and traffic law.

short_summary: Prohibits certain devices which enhance a vehicle's capacity to emit soot, smoke or other particulate emissions
summary: Prohibits certain devices which enhance a vehicle's capacity to emit soot, smoke or other particulate emissions.

short_summary: Relates to certain notices and guidelines regarding mental health services and resources available to employees
summary: Directs the commissioner of labor to create and distribute to employers written materials regarding mental health services and resources available to employees to be posted in the workplace; directs voluntary guidance for employers to put in place strategies and programs to support the mental health and wellness of their employees; provides that such guidance be in written and digital resources and in English or translated to an additional primary language or languages as applicable.

short_summary: Establishes a Black youth suicide prevention task force
summary: Establishes a Black youth suicide prevention task force to study the current mental health practices and suicide prevention efforts of Black youth age 5 through 18 years and make recommendations therefor; provides for the number of members, manner of appointment and the topics to be reviewed.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the New York state innovation voucher program
summary: Establishes the New York state innovation voucher program; provides small businesses with access to research and development by colleges and universities, government laboratories and public research institutes in order to assist such businesses in the creation of innovative products or services.

short_summary: Relates to higher education funding opportunities for foster youth
summary: Directs the education department and OCFS to prepare posters and pamphlets with information regarding higher education funding opportunities for foster youth.

short_summary: Relates to the tax deduction for costs associated with organ donation
summary: Allows a taxpayer or the spouse of a taxpayer to deduct costs related to the taxpayer's organ donation; includes child care costs within such allowable costs.

short_summary: Requires an education campaign about the 9-8-8 suicide and crisis lifeline
summary: Requires student identification cards to contain the new national suicide prevention lifeline number, 9-8-8, and the crisis text line.

short_summary: Relates to adding fetal alcohol spectrum disorders to the definition of developmental disability
summary: Adds fetal alcohol spectrum disorders to the definition of developmental disability.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state community doula directory for doulas serving Medicaid patients
summary: Requires the department of health to establish and maintain the New York state community doula directory for doulas on such department's website for the purposes of Medicaid reimbursement and promoting doula services to Medicaid recipients; establishes criteria for admittance into the New York state community doula directory; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires rent concessions to be reported to the division of housing and community renewal
summary: Requires rent concessions to be reported to the division of housing and community renewal; requires the inclusion of a statement of net effective rent for units with concessions; requires annual statements filed for the year 2021 or 2022 to include reporting of rent concessions.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of the department of housing preservation and development to issue an annual report on the tenant interim lease program
summary: Requires the commissioner of the department of housing preservation and development to issue an annual report on the tenant interim lease program.

short_summary: Allows prospective tenants of rent controlled or rent stabilized housing accommodations to request the complete rent history of such housing accommodations
summary: Allows prospective tenants of rent controlled or rent stabilized housing accommodations to request the complete rent history of such housing accommodations.

short_summary: Establishes the public housing fund
summary: Establishes the public housing fund to be used by the division of housing and community renewal to support existing public housing utilizing money from the real property transfer tax.

short_summary: Relates to requiring homeless shelters to keep an opioid antagonist on hand, have at least one trained employee on duty at all times, and develop a training plan for opioid overdoses
summary: Requires homeless shelters to keep an opioid antagonist on hand at all times and trained personnel when required by when applicable law, regulation, code, or operating plan approved by a social services district or the commissioner otherwise requires employees to be at the premises, sets out the requirements for the training of those employees; develops a training plan for opioid overdoses in conjunction with a registered opioid overdose prevention program.

short_summary: Relates to the maximum number of employees that a minority and women-owned business enterprise may have during a declared state disaster emergency or other emergency or critical need
summary: Relates to the maximum number of employees that a minority and women-owned business enterprise may have during a declared state disaster emergency or other emergency or critical need; changes such maximum from three hundred employees to three hundred employees who work thirty or more hours per week over the period of fifty-two weeks for a total of 1,560 hours worked.

short_summary: Relates to determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial
summary: Provides for the use of restoration services when determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursement for early and periodic screening, diagnosis and treatment
summary: Requires the department of health to review claims for expenditures for early and periodic screening, diagnosis and treatment and other health services, care and supplies which are furnished to eligible children and pre-school children regardless of whether such children have handicapping conditions, are suspected of having handicapping conditions or have an individualized education plan; requires the department of health to apply for all necessary federal approvals regarding such expenditures.

short_summary: Establishes a work group to set reimbursement rates for doulas in the state Medicaid program and address other criteria related to their practice
summary: Establishes a 14 member doula Medicaid reimbursement work group within the department of health to set reimbursement rates for doulas in the state Medicaid program and address other criteria related to their practice; requires the work group to conduct a study and evaluate the costs, benefits and issues that may be associated with Medicaid reimbursement for doulas and for providing doula care to Medicaid recipients; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients
summary: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients.

short_summary: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system
summary: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system; permits one in-person visit within twelve months unless such in-person visit causes undue hardship on a patient.

short_summary: Relates to what positions in a school district constitute chief financial officer of such school district
summary: Relates to what positions in a school district constitute chief financial officer of such school district.

short_summary: Relates to allowing for students in postsecondary education experience or transition program to receive awards from the tuition assistance program
summary: Relates to allowing for students in certain postsecondary education experience or transition programs to receive awards from the tuition assistance program.

short_summary: Relates to sex offender residence limitation
summary: Relates to sex offender residence limitation; restricts level two and three sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victims.

short_summary: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation
summary: Relates to subjecting certain state lands to real property taxation.

short_summary: Relates to obligations of members of economic development entities
summary: Relates to obligations of members of economic development entities.

short_summary: Relates to building aid for approved expenditures for debt service for tax certiorari financing
summary: Relates to building aid for approved expenditures for debt service for tax certiorari financing.

short_summary: Relates to establishing hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments
summary: Establishes hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments as a "hospital"; sets out specific standards for operations, staffing and capacity requirements.

short_summary: Creates a state-wide literacy education advocacy program
summary: Creates a state-wide literacy education advocacy program modelled after the Newburgh Armory Unity Center Literacy Education Advocacy Partnership to study the viability of the Newburgh Armory Unity Center Literacy Education Advocacy Partnership.

short_summary: Restricts a registered sex offender from residing within 1000 feet of school grounds or a playground
summary: Restricts a registered sex offender from residing within 1000 feet of school grounds or a playground.

short_summary: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs
summary: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs; defines "pharmacy benefit manager".

short_summary: Enacts "Cariol's Law"
summary: Enacts "Cariol's Law"; provides for a duty to intervene when a police officer observes another police officer using physical force that he or she reasonably believes to be clearly excessive or beyond that which is objectively reasonable under the circumstances.

short_summary: Establishes the Syd O. Sotillo Sickle Cell Treatment Act
summary: Establishes the "Syd O. Sotillo Sickle Cell Treatment Act" which designates sickle cell centers for excellence and outpatient treatment centers.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state cryptocurrency and blockchain study task force
summary: Establishes the New York state cryptocurrency and blockchain study task force to provide the governor and the legislature with information on the effects of the widespread use of cryptocurrencies and other forms of digital currencies and their ancillary systems, including but not limited to blockchain technology, in the state.

short_summary: Adds ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions
summary: Relates to adding ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions.

short_summary: Provides that assessed values of cooperative units and condominiums shall not increase by more than 3% in the two years following resolution of tax certiorari proceedings
summary: Provides that assessed values of cooperative units and condominiums shall not increase by more than 3% in the two years following resolution of tax certiorari proceedings.

short_summary: Relates to adding transmission of unwanted lewd or intimate images to the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree
summary: Relates to adding transmission of unwanted lewd or intimate images to the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree.

short_summary: Exempts certain dry cleaning equipment or machinery certified by the department of environmental conservation from sales and use taxes
summary: Exempts certain dry cleaning equipment or machinery certified by the department of environmental conservation from sales and use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to assault in the third degree
summary: Relates to assault in the third degree by a person against an operator, driver or passenger on a bus, taxicab, aerial tramway, subway or other motor vehicle.

short_summary: Relates to limitations on assessed value for any parcel that is held in cooperative or condominium forms of ownership
summary: Extends the transitional assessed value of parcels held in cooperative or condominium forms of ownership to twelve years.

short_summary: Provides taxpayer gifts for the cure childhood cancer research fund
summary: Requires the commissioner of taxation and finance to include space on the personal income tax return to enable a taxpayer to make a contribution to the cure childhood cancer research fund.

short_summary: Relates to designating the month of May "Korean American Family Month"
summary: Relates to designating the month of May as "Korean American Family Month".

short_summary: Relates to allowing severely disabled individuals to renew parking permits without providing an updated certification or additional medical documents
summary: Allows severely disabled individuals to apply for renewal of a parking permit for a handicapped person without providing an updated certification or additional medical documents.

short_summary: Provides for victim statements at the sentencing of a defendant for a misdemeanor
summary: Enacts Emma's Law, providing for victim statements at the sentencing of a defendant for a misdemeanor.

short_summary: Requires notice to unemployment applicants of the supplemental nutrition assistance program and WIC
summary: Requires notice to unemployment applicants of the supplemental nutrition assistance program and the special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants and children (WIC).

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of housing and community renewal to conduct a study to examine the efficacy of the creation of a statewide affordable housing agency
summary: Directs the commissioner of housing and community renewal, in consultation with the director of the budget and the commissioner of taxation and finance, to conduct a study to examine the efficacy of the creation of a statewide affordable housing agency whose sole mission is to directly build affordable housing utilizing state funds and employing residents of the state to accomplish such construction of affordable housing.

short_summary: Relates to grievance procedures for proceedings involving the New York City Housing Authority
summary: Requires the New York City Housing Authority to create policies regarding administrative procedures that conform with Title 42 Sections 13661-13662 of the United States Code and any relevant guidance developed by the Office of Public and Indian Housing of the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development with respect to proceedings involving decisions of the Authority.

short_summary: Requires that the siting, construction and establishment of methadone program facilities in New York city be proportionately dispersed in the boroughs of such cities
summary: Requires that the siting, construction and establishment of methadone program facilities in cities with a population of one million or more be dispersed in the boroughs of such cities in proportion to the population of each such borough.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish a program to provide funding to emergency food providers to purchase prepared meals from New York restaurants and deliver them to families in need
summary: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets, in consultation with the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance, to establish a grant program to provide funding to emergency food providers to purchase prepared meals from New York restaurants and deliver them to families in need.

short_summary: Relates to posting the names of individuals who are authorized to sign state contracts
summary: Relates to posting the names of individuals who are authorized to sign state contracts; eliminates unfavorable terms in state contracts.

short_summary: Provides for reporting the race, ethnicity and salary ranges of women employed in service of the state
summary: Reports the number of women employed in each office and/or position in the service of the state and the race, ethnicity and salary range of each such employee.

short_summary: Establishes a housing succession rights task force
summary: Establishes a housing succession rights task force to conduct a state-wide assessment of succession rights in rent stabilized, public housing and city or municipal owned buildings.

short_summary: Provides for the operation of a youth services unit within the port authority police department
summary: Provides for the operation of a youth services unit within the port authority police department tasked with aiding youths in danger of exploitation.

short_summary: Establishes a private right of action for tenants alleging a failure to keep and maintain self-closing doors
summary: Establishes a private right of action for tenants alleging a failure to keep and maintain self-closing doors; allows for a court to award compensatory damages, reasonable attorney's fees and court costs and issue an order to the owner of the building to remedy any issue with such doors.

short_summary: Relates to disclosing certain investment managers and investments
summary: Allows any enrollee of the New York State common retirement fund to request a list of investment managers on contract with the office of state comptroller to make investment contracts for the office of state comptroller division of pensions, investment, and cash management and the contents of any contracts and opportunistic investment contracts made by such investment manager.

short_summary: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
summary: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; eliminates the requirement that an incarcerated individual causes or attempts to cause an employee to come into contact with blood, seminal fluid, urine, feces, saliva, or the contents of a toilet bowl by throwing, tossing or expelling such fluid or material.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain employers to provide workforce demographics and equity measurements to the division of human rights annually
summary: Relates to requiring certain employers to provide workforce demographics and equity measurements to the division of human rights annually, including each employee's race, ethnicity, age, and sex or gender identity or expression, as well as the employee's job category, date of hire, salary or wages, training received, raises, promotions, disciplinary actions, terminations and benefits, including but not limited to unpaid benefits or privileges such as flexible scheduling, the ability to work from home, or the ability to bring children to work.

short_summary: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections under certain circumstances
summary: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections upon a court finding of not guilty of larceny in mercantile establishments.

short_summary: Prohibits secondary schools and colleges from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition
summary: Prohibits secondary schools and higher education institutions from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition.

short_summary: Requires the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless
summary: Relates to requiring the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless; requires written notification sixty days before the department enters into a contractual arrangement with a transitional housing provider or otherwise finalizes its decision to use or expand a location as transitional housing.

short_summary: Relates to agreements related to renewable energy development rights on reforestation areas
summary: Relates to agreements, such as leases or easements, related to renewable energy development rights on reforestation areas.

short_summary: Relates to exempting the registration of vintage snowmobiles
summary: Exempts vintage snowmobiles from registration requirements.

short_summary: Relates to the termination of law enforcement officer benefits for malfeasance or serious misconduct
summary: Provides that any officer terminated who was dismissed for malfeasance or serious misconduct or resigned or retired during an investigation relating to such malfeasance or serious misconduct shall not be entitled to receive any retirement or other benefit or payment of any kind.

short_summary: Relates to establishing emergency release protocols during a time of crisis
summary: Relates to establishing emergency release protocols during a time of crisis including during a state disaster emergency which places the lives, health or well-being of people in custody at risk.

short_summary: Relates to parole eligibility for felony offenders; repealer
summary: Requires that all felony offenders shall be eligible for parole after serving no more than twenty-five years of their sentence; eliminates the possibility of serving consecutive terms of imprisonment which exceed a twenty-five year sentence.

short_summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities
summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities including the causes and consequences of such violence with a particular emphasis on changes in levels of violence and the causes of those changes.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues
summary: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues.

short_summary: Relates to communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions
summary: Requires certain notices in communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions.

short_summary: Relates to the security of connected devices
summary: Requires manufacturers of connected devices to equip such devices with reasonable security features.

short_summary: Directs court to establish a period of commitment for persons found not responsible by reason of mental disease or defect
summary: Directs a criminal court to establish a period of commitment for persons found not responsible by reason of mental disease or defect; a person so committed shall not be eligible for release from the custody of the commissioner of mental health or the commissioner of developmental disabilities until completion of the period of commitment.

short_summary: Requires legislative fiscal impact notes to include objective calculations of anticipated economic impacts for next three years on state or subdivisions; repealer
summary: Requires legislative fiscal impact notes to include objective calculations of anticipated economic impacts for next three years on state or political subdivisions.

short_summary: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York
summary: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to issuance of keepsake plates for gold star mothers
summary: Relates to distinctive license plates issued to gold star mothers; permits gold star mothers to retain one keepsake plate as a commemorative item after distinctive plates are surrendered.

short_summary: Prohibits residential and commercial properties from operating digital billboards or signs that use flashing, intermittent or moving lights near certain Mitchell-Lama housing
summary: Prohibits residential and commercial properties from operating digital billboards or signs that use flashing, intermittent or moving lights near certain Mitchell-Lama housing within a city with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to requirements of motor vehicles
summary: Requires certain motor vehicles to have rear passenger detection warning systems.

short_summary: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for all medical professionals as part of their licensing requirements; public ed program; appropriation
summary: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for all medical professionals as part of their licensing requirements; requires biennial training in the non-discriminatory provision of medical services for physicians, physician assistants, dentists, dental hygienists, registered and licensed practical nurses, podiatrists, and optometrists; authorizes the department of education to develop the training in consultation with the department of health and other experts; provides for documentation and exemption from the requirements; provides for a public education program on minority health; appropriates $100,000 therefor.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting denial of entry to a public place or denial of service solely on the basis of wearing a mask in public during an epidemic or a pandemic
summary: Prohibits denial of entry to a public place or denial of service solely on the basis of wearing a mask in public during an epidemic or a pandemic.

short_summary: Provides for the confidentiality, sealing and expungement of juvenile delinquency records; repealer
summary: Provides for the confidentiality, sealing and expungement of juvenile delinquency records including providing notice to the respondent and attorney for the child when such acts of the court are ordered.

short_summary: Relates to disposals and contracts for disposal of property
summary: Provides for requirements for disposals and contracts for disposal of property.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for explanatory statements regarding disposal of property
summary: Requires explanatory statements regarding disposal of property to include the names of all beneficial owners.

short_summary: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption
summary: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption; includes more recent hostilities in the definition of "period of war".

short_summary: Relates to increasing the state code enforcement powers of the secretary of state
summary: Increases the state code enforcement powers of the secretary of state by establishing a state code enforcement office headed by an ombudsperson.

short_summary: Relates to taxpayers affected by a federal government shutdown
summary: Relates to taxpayers affected by a federal government shutdown by granting an extension for those who are furloughed and expediting their tax refunds.

short_summary: Defines blighted properties and areas; repealer
summary: Defines blighted properties and areas.

short_summary: Provides voice communication service to incarcerated people at no cost; repealer
summary: Relates to providing voice communication services to incarcerated individuals in state correctional facilities at no cost.

short_summary: Relates to preventing temporary questioning of person solely because such person is wearing a mask during a state emergency for an epidemic or pandemic
summary: Prevents temporary questioning of person solely because such person is wearing a mask during a state emergency for an epidemic or pandemic.

short_summary: Requires property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation
summary: Requires property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory influenza vaccine for persons attending daycare
summary: Mandates influenza vaccine for children attending licensed daycare.

short_summary: Relates to the publication of immunization information
summary: Relates to the publication of immunization information; requires schools to provide immunization information to the commissioner of health; requires the department of health to make immunization information, including rates of immunization, available on its website.

short_summary: Relates to the practice of pharmacy and administration of immunizations
summary: Relates to the practice of pharmacy and administration of immunizations.

short_summary: Enacts the "emission tampering act"
summary: Prohibits the disabling, removal or interference with emission control devices and the use of emission tampering devices; provides remedies for the violation of such provisions.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale, trade or bartering or possession with intent to sell, trade or barter of certain wild animals or wild animal products and to the penalties imposed therefor
summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale, trade or bartering or possession with intent to sell, trade or barter of certain wild animals or wild animal products and to the penalties imposed therefor.

short_summary: Provides regulatory control of Internet service providers by the public service commission, requires Internet neutrality and relates to the placement of equipment on utility poles
summary: Provides regulatory control of Internet service providers by the public service commission; requires Internet neutrality; relates to the placement of equipment on utility poles.

short_summary: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse
summary: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse.

short_summary: Mandates the use of advanced safety technology in vehicles in the state and requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to promulgate certain rules and regulations
summary: Mandates the use of advanced safety technology in vehicles in the state; requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to promulgate certain rules and regulations.

short_summary: Requires SUNY and CUNY trustees refrain from investing in and subsequently divest from stocks, debt or other securities of certain publicly traded fossil fuel companies
summary: Requires SUNY and CUNY trustees to refrain from investing in and subsequently divest from stocks, debt or other securities of certain publicly traded fossil fuel companies.

short_summary: Prohibits the eviction of small commercial tenants in the city of New York without good cause
summary: Prohibits the eviction of small commercial tenants in the city of New York without good cause.

short_summary: Authorizes Paul O'Brien to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
summary: Authorizes Paul O'Brien, a village of East Aurora police officer, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

short_summary: Mandates a fixed percentage for annual harness horse breeders awards and requires that all sire stakes funds generated by a specific racetrack be returned as purses to such track at the same level
summary: Mandates a fixed percentage of annual harness horse breeders awards; requires that all sire stakes funds generated by a specific racetrack be returned as purses to such track at the same level in order to allow New York to compete with states that have stronger awards programs.

short_summary: Relates to handicapping tournaments
summary: Specifies who can operate a handicapping tournament; requires handicapping tournament operators to distribute no less than eighty percent of entry fees as prizes to the winners of a handicapping tournament; requires that five percent of the portion of the gross revenue collected by an operator on handicapping tournament entry fees from New York participants that is not distributed as prizes to the winners of a tournament be distributed quarterly by such operator to the horsemen's organization for welfare and medical plans for regularly employed backstretch employees.

short_summary: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York
summary: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to electronic bell jar vending machines
summary: Relates to authorizing and regulating the use of electronic bell jar vending machines.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of performance-enhancing drugs in horseracing
summary: Prohibits the use of performance-enhancing drugs in horseracing.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a licensed massage therapist to display his or her license when practicing and the required contents of such license
summary: Relates to requiring a licensed massage therapist to display his or her license when practicing and the required contents of such license, including at a minimum the licensee's name, license number and a non-removable photograph of such licensee.

short_summary: Amends the definition of wager and changes the licensing requirements for mobile sports wagering operators
summary: Amends the definition of sports wager to include other things of value; changes the licensing requirement for mobile sports wagering operators; provides the state shall by no later than January 31, 2024 have fourteen operators and by January 31, 2025 have sixteen operators; provides tax rates shall be determined based on the number of operators.

short_summary: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation
summary: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation.

short_summary: In relation to the additional vendor fee for a certain track located within Oneida county
summary: Provides that the additional vendor fee for a vendor track located within Oneida county within fifteen miles of a Native American class III gaming facility shall not be forfeited if the track does not maintain the ninety percent full-time equivalent employee requirement.

short_summary: Relates to coverage for prenatal vitamins
summary: Requires certain health and casualty insurers to provide coverage for prenatal vitamins.

short_summary: Relates to individuals engaged in prostitution who are victims of or witnesses to a crime
summary: Provides immunity from prosecution for certain individuals engaged in prostitution who are victims of or witnesses to a crime and who report such crime or assist in the investigation or prosecution.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the definition of "infertility" to include same sex couples
summary: Expands the definition of "infertility" to include same sex couples.

short_summary: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats
summary: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

short_summary: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis
summary: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis to those that have a disability and who are at serious risk for death, disease or other harm due to an emergency disaster being declared provided such person has a reasonably stable living situation upon release and does not pose an unreasonable current public safety risk.

short_summary: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control
summary: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the inclusion of suicide prevention resources be provided with a warrant of eviction
summary: Requires the inclusion of suicide prevention resources to be provided with a warrant of eviction, including the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline and the applicable Suicide Crisis telephone number as provided by the Office of Mental Health.

short_summary: Establishes sex offender residency restrictions
summary: Allows a district attorney to file a petition to seek the imposition of residency restrictions for certain sex offenders; allows a sex offender subject to a residency restriction to petition the court which imposed such restriction for an order terminating or modifying such residency restriction.

short_summary: Requires dental insurance plans to automatically carry over a portion of the enrollee's benefit amount for use in the succeeding year
summary: Requires dental insurance plans to automatically carry over a portion of the enrollee's unused benefit amount of up to 25% of the total benefit amount for use in the succeeding year.

short_summary: Relates to contracted network pharmacy use
summary: Relates to contracted network pharmacy use.

short_summary: Relates to cargo bicycles with electric assist
summary: Adds cargo bicycles with electric assist to the types of bicycles with electric assist regulated under the vehicle and traffic law; provides that no person shall operate a cargo bicycle with electric assist unless it is accompanied by proof of financial security unless otherwise authorized by local law, ordinance, order, rule, or regulation or pursuant to an agreement made on behalf of the city, town, or village.

short_summary: Relates to judicial diversion programs; repealer
summary: Relates to judicial diversion programs; establishes a diversion part in each county; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates an employee lien
summary: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates a lien remedy for all employees; provides grounds for attachment; relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft; relates to rights for victims of wage theft to hold the ten members with the largest ownership interests in a company personally liable for wage theft.

short_summary: Increases the minimum wage annually; repealer
summary: Increases the minimum wage annually; provides for the enforcement of the minimum wage; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators
summary: Requires the Empire State Development Corporation, in consultation with the department of agriculture and markets and the office of new Americans to conduct a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators; requires a report to the governor and the legislature.

short_summary: Raises the tax rate on corporate income; increases the state conformity to federal taxation of corporate profit shifting; and imposes an additional tax on individual business income
summary: Raises the tax rate on corporate income; increases the state conformity to federal taxation of corporate profit shifting; imposes an additional tax on individual business income in response to federal tax benefits for pass-through business income.

short_summary: Establishes clean energy goals of reducing the annual total of vehicle miles traveled within the state by 20% by the year 2050
summary: Establishes clean energy goals of reducing the annual total of vehicle miles traveled within the state by 20% by the year 2050; requires state and local highway projects to comply with reductions to vehicle miles traveled targets.

short_summary: Relates to imposing liability on owners of motor vehicles for failure to comply with vehicle sound limits
summary: Imposes liability on owners of motor vehicles for failure to comply with vehicle sound limits in the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to a uniform presentation to students regarding applying for financial aid
summary: Creates a uniform presentation for students regarding applying for financial aid; directs students to complete an affidavit certifying that the student attended the presentation and stating whether the student intends to apply for financial aid.

short_summary: Suspends state assessments during a state disaster emergency
summary: Suspends state assessments during a state disaster emergency; requires the commissioner of education to suspend state assessments during a state disaster emergency and for thirty days after such emergency has ended.

short_summary: Enacts the community gridlock prevention act
summary: Enacts the community gridlock prevention act, which requires all land use actions to include an intersection and response time of emergency services impact study in addition to any existing requirements for an environmental assessment statement or an environmental impact statement.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to allow students attending a school closed due to a viral outbreak to receive instructional time for work completed outside of the school
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to allow students attending a school closed due to a viral outbreak to receive instructional time for work completed outside of the school.

short_summary: Grants immunity to law enforcement employees who intervene against police misconduct
summary: Grants immunity from liability and professional retaliation against a law enforcement employee who intervenes against police misconduct committed by another member of law enforcement.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner to convene statewide and regional conventions to bring together underrepresented educators
summary: Directs the commissioner to convene statewide and regional conventions to bring together underrepresented educators annually to discuss experiences, best practices, and afford for networking, mentorship opportunities, and support.

short_summary: Ensures the payment of overtime due and owing for services rendered to combat the COVID-19 pandemic
summary: Ensures the payment of overtime due and owing for services rendered to combat the COVID-19 pandemic.

short_summary: Relates to tampering with physical evidence
summary: Includes a police or peace officers turning off his or her body camera or deleting a body camera recording in the crime of tampering with physical evidence.

short_summary: Establishes a twenty year retirement plan for members or officers of law enforcement
summary: Relates to establishing a twenty year retirement plan for members or officers of law enforcement; includes every non-seasonally appointed sworn member or officer of the division of law enforcement in the department of environmental conservation, a forest ranger in the service of the department of environmental conservation, a police officer in the department of environmental conservation, the regional state park police, and university police officers in such twenty year plan.

short_summary: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Westchester county
summary: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Westchester county.

short_summary: Provides for determinations of appropriate educational programs for certain students in a school district in a city having a population of one million or more
summary: Relates to determinations of appropriate educational programs for certain students in a school district in a city having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Prohibits certain functions whenever the legislature is in session
summary: Prohibits certain functions within a fifteen mile radius of the New York state Capitol whenever the legislature is in session.

short_summary: Provides vehicular access to state parks and recreational facilities free of charge to military personnel who are residents of this state
summary: Relates to providing vehicular access to state parks and recreational facilities free of charge to military personnel who are residents of this state.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of remote or virtual learning as a form of punishment or disciplinary action
summary: Prohibits the use of remote or virtual learning as a form of punishment or disciplinary action; provides exceptions for failure to comply with COVID-19 health and safety protocols.

short_summary: Enacts the "standing is tiring (sit) act"
summary: Enacts the "standing is tiring (sit) act"; requires employers to provide suitable seats to all employees where the nature of such employees' work reasonably permits seated work; prohibits employers from artificially designing a work space to require standing; requires the department of labor to determine whether the nature of work reasonably permits seated work; creates a private right of action for employees whose employer does not provide seats.

short_summary: Defines closed period of eligibility for purposes of certain supplemental security income and includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income
summary: Defines "closed period of eligibility" for purposes of supplemental security income for aged, blind, and disabled persons; includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income.

short_summary: Relates to direct interstate and intrastate cider shipments
summary: Relates to direct interstate and intrastate cider shipments; establishes requirements regarding age verification and shipping limits.

short_summary: Allows geriatricians to apply for both the physician loan repayment program and the physician practice support program
summary: Allows geriatricians to apply for both the physician loan repayment program and the physician practice support program, provided such geriatrician agrees to practice geriatrics for at least 5 years.

short_summary: Relates to the general powers and duties of the canal corporation
summary: Relates to the general powers and duties of the canal corporation; requires the canal corporation to cause the locks and lift bridges of the canal system to be operated May first through November fifteenth annually; requires the canal corporation to maintain and preserve the Erie Canal's historic resources; permits certain usage of the canal system's state drydocks, travel lifts, and other facilities for commercial boat companies.

short_summary: Relates to imposing a specific tax on all corporate stock buybacks of issued shares
summary: Relates to imposing a tax of one-half of one percent on all corporate stock buybacks of issued shares.

short_summary: Establishes a chief sustainability officer
summary: Establishes a chief sustainability officer to coordinate efforts across state agencies and other state government entities to address climate change mitigation and climate sustainability efforts.

short_summary: Establishes the college of renewable energy and sustainability in the city university of New York
summary: Establishes the college of renewable energy and sustainability in the city university of New York which shall offer majors relating to the field of renewable energy and sustainability.

short_summary: Creates the New York state entrepreneurial training act
summary: Creates the NYS entrepreneurial training act to provide grants to eligible applicants to support and train entrepreneurial candidates.

short_summary: Relates to participation in state contracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements
summary: Relates to increased participation in state contracts and subcontracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; requires quarterly reports from contracting agencies; addresses consequences if contracting agency fails to comply with reporting requirements; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements.

short_summary: Establishes a one hundred percent clean renewable energy system for electricity by two thousand thirty
summary: Relates to establishing a one hundred percent clean renewable energy system for electricity by two thousand thirty-four; such energy system shall include solar, wind, geothermal and tidal sources.

short_summary: Establishes the minority- and women-owned business protection program
summary: Establishes the minority- and women-owned business protection program to provide grants with funding from the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 to qualifying entities that have less than 100 employees per location, was in existence in New York state by the first day the state disaster emergency related to COVID-19 was declared by the governor, can document actual economic harm or revenue shortfall as a direct result of the pandemic, and has filed 2018, 2019 or 2020 tax returns.

short_summary: Requires certain information be made available to elected officials prior to funding reductions for hospitals and nursing homes
summary: Requires any information or data produced internally or by an outside consultant used by the governor, the division of the budget, the department of health or any other relevant state agency to justify such reduction be made available to elected officials prior to funding reductions for hospitals and nursing homes.

short_summary: Prohibits state officers and employees from official involvement with a state project where the officer or employee acted as a consultant on such project
summary: Prohibits state officers and employees from official involvement with a state project where the officer or employee acted as a consultant on such project.

short_summary: Relates to transfer of sick time
summary: Allows certain employees to transfer or receive sick time from a fellow employee.

short_summary: Creates an excise tax on the collection of consumer data by commercial data collectors
summary: Creates an excise tax on the collection of consumer data by commercial data collectors.
