short_summary: Authorizes the independent budget office of the city of New York to obtain certain tax data for purposes of evaluation
summary: Authorizes the independent budget office of the city of New York to obtain certain tax data for purposes of evaluation.

short_summary: Provides for the establishment of a biennial budgeting system for the state of New York replacing the state annual budget process
summary: Provides for the establishment of a biennial budgeting system for the state of New York replacing the state annual budget process.

short_summary: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code
summary: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code; requires the owner of a building to be demolished to prove that he or she has the financial ability to complete demolition of the building.

short_summary: Aligns utility regulation with state climate justice and emission reduction targets; and repeals certain provisions of the public service law relating to gas service and sale
summary: Aligns utility regulation with state climate justice and emission reduction targets; repeals provisions relating to continuation of gas service; repeals provisions relating to the sale of indigenous natural gas for generation of electricity.

short_summary: Requires insurance companies to reimburse all health care practitioners at the same rate for cervical cytology screening
summary: Requires insurance companies to reimburse all health care practitioners at the same rate for cervical cytology screening, including the preparation of a Pap smear; prohibits health care practitioners from refusing to provide a Pap smear during a regular annual checkup if such patient has not had a Pap smear done in the preceding twelve months.

short_summary: Prohibits political contributions by businesses that have been awarded state contracts
summary: Prohibits political contributions by businesses that have been awarded state contracts.

short_summary: Establishes the veterans service organizations fund
summary: Establishes the congressional chartered veterans service organizations fund; provides for gifts made to such fund on an individual's personal income tax return.

short_summary: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer
summary: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer.

short_summary: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists
summary: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists during all school hours and after school activities.

short_summary: Requires certain waste transported by rail to be covered with hard tarping
summary: Requires putrescible and non-putrescible waste to be covered by a hard tarp when transported by rail.

short_summary: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time
summary: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time in connection with the emergency disconnection of utilities.

short_summary: Relates to school session days
summary: Relates to school session days; adds general election day to the list of days when school will not be in session; allows a school district to elect to require staff attendance on a general election day or to schedule a professional development day.

short_summary: Includes the use of a governmental agency to harass a person within the crime of harassment in the first degree
summary: Includes the use of a governmental agency to harass a person within the crime of aggravated harassment in the first degree.

short_summary: Expands the excelsior jobs program and certain incentives for medical equipment projects within such program
summary: Extends the excelsior jobs program and certain incentives for medical equipment projects within such program.

short_summary: Authorizes the district attorney to intervene in a proceeding brought by the owner of a premises upon which the tenant's occupancy is illegal
summary: Authorizes the district attorney to intervene in a proceeding brought by the owner of a premises upon which the tenant's occupancy is illegal.

short_summary: Establishes a real property tax exemption for veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability
summary: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residence of veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability.

short_summary: Grants a waiver to Adirondack Helping Hands for the 2016--2017 school year
summary: Grants a waiver in the amount of $52,000 to Adirondack Helping Hands for services rendered during the 2016--2017 school year; provides such waiver shall be allocated to costs associated with special class in an integrated setting spending for the 2016--2017 school year.

short_summary: Directs a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation
summary: Directs the public service commission in consultation with NYSERDA to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation within nine months after the effective date and every four years thereafter.

short_summary: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts
summary: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts.

short_summary: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch
summary: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch.

short_summary: Authorizes certain electronic court appearances
summary: Authorizes electronic court appearances for criminal matters, excluding jury trials, in all counties in the state; authorizes electronic appearances for criminal matters where the court determines a personal appearance would be impractical, unsafe or excessively burdensome; authorizes sentencing to a period of incarceration to be conducted via electronic appearance for defendants who are already incarcerated.

short_summary: Extends the power of impeachment and trial of impeachment to former office holders for impeachable conduct committed while in office
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to extend the power of impeachment and trial of impeachment to any former office holder for impeachable conduct committed while such person was in office; provides for disqualification of such person from holding public office in the future.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Samuel Trombley Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Ellenburg, county of Clinton as the "Samuel Trombley Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to requiring sex offenders to register authorized internet entities that such offender uses
summary: Requires sex offenders to register authorized internet entities that such offender uses, including social media websites.

short_summary: Includes within the class D felony of assault in the second degree, the causation of serious physical injury to another person while in the course of committing hazing in the first degree
summary: Includes within the class D felony of assault in the second degree, the causation of serious physical injury to another person while in the course of committing hazing in the first degree.

short_summary: Increases from $300 to $725 the monthly rent subsidy payable for housing for a foster child living independently in certain circumstances
summary: Increases from $300 to $725 the monthly rent subsidy payable for housing for a foster child living independently in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to maternal depression screenings
summary: Directs the commissioner of health, in consultation with the office of mental health and other relevant stakeholders, to develop guidance and standards for routine maternal depression screenings, referrals, diagnosis and treatment, and to provide training and materials on issues related to maternal depression.

short_summary: Allows only citizens to vote at elections
summary: Allows only citizens to vote at elections.

short_summary: Establishes a limitation on financial services assessments and appropriation suballocations
summary: Establishes a limitation on financial services assessments and appropriation suballocations; requires that money obtained from assessments shall only be used to defray operating expenses of the department of financial services.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance of distinctive license plates to volunteer firefighters
summary: Eliminates the registration fees charged for the issuance of volunteer firefighter distinctive license plates.

short_summary: Authorizes certain persons to possess and administer epinephrine by use of an epinephrine auto-injector device upon completion of appropriate training; requires the department of health to establish a registry
summary: Authorizes certain persons to possess and administer epinephrine by use of an epinephrine auto-injector device upon completion of appropriate training; requires the department of health to establish a registry of the names of lay persons trained in the use of an epinephrine auto-injector device.

short_summary: Provides for the viewing of footage captured by an interior school bus camera in certain circumstances
summary: Provides for the viewing of photo or video footage captured by a camera installed inside a school bus, by a parent or guardian of a pupil, when such parent, guardian or pupil reports any incident of physical harm, harassment, intimidation or bullying occurring against the pupil while such pupil travelled on such school bus.

short_summary: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board
summary: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year
summary: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers at 501(c)(3) organizations or organizations affiliated with NY Cares or NY Service who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year.

short_summary: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater
summary: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater from $20,000 to $25,000 in 2025, $30,000 in 2026, $35,000 in 2027 and $40,000 for each subsequent year.

short_summary: Increases the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit
summary: Relates to increasing the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; increases the amount of the credit from $200 to $500 for single filers and from $400 to $1,000 for spouses filing jointly.

short_summary: Permits persons 65 years of age to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition
summary: Permits persons 65 years of age or over to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition.

short_summary: Relates to the duration of certain tests
summary: Provides that any standardized test or examination shall not be subject to any time limitation when administered by the city district.

short_summary: Includes bonus in the definition of wages for purposes of the labor law
summary: Includes bonus in the definition of wages for purposes of the labor law when the formula under which a bonus is determined is available to the employer or when the amount of a bonus has been declared; relates to the forfeit of wages.

short_summary: Relates to the employee status of an individual
summary: Relates to the employee status of an individual; establishes criteria for determining whether labor or services performed for remuneration qualify as employment.

short_summary: Relates to split shifts and minimum wage
summary: Authorizes minimum wage to be paid for all time in excess of one hour in which an employee is not at work during a split shift.

short_summary: Establishes integrated community mental health clinics
summary: Relates to establishing integrated community mental health clinics to provide services to address mental health issues, anger management issues, substance abuse issues and isolation issues.

short_summary: Permits a residential tenant to utilize a security deposit to pay rent during a state disaster emergency
summary: Permits a residential tenant to utilize a security deposit to pay rent during a state disaster emergency if such tenant has had a loss of income or loss of employment due to such state disaster emergency; provides a one year period to replenish such security deposit.

short_summary: Exempts certain real property owned or leased by a cooperative corporation or on a condominium basis from certain assessment provisions
summary: Exempts real property owned or leased by a cooperative corporation or on a condominium basis located in a city with a population of one million or more from certain assessment provisions.

short_summary: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation
summary: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation.

short_summary: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature
summary: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature.

short_summary: Imposes a progressive income tax structure; repealer
summary: Imposes a progressive income tax structure for high income taxpayers.

short_summary: Relates to hate crime reporting on college campuses
summary: Requires colleges to post campus crime statistics on their website; requires colleges to implement a plan to provide investigation of hate crimes on campus; requires colleges to inform incoming students about hate crime prevention measures.

short_summary: Prohibits the disclosure of immigration status for victims of domestic violence
summary: Prohibits disclosure of immigration status for victims of domestic violence.

short_summary: Relates to items of appropriation
summary: Relates to items of appropriation.

short_summary: Relates to the preservation of hair during chemotherapy
summary: Provides coverage for scalp cooling systems used to preserve hair during cancer chemotherapy treatment.

short_summary: Prohibits smoking in private passenger cars, vans or trucks where minors less than 14 years of age are passengers in such vehicles; penalties for violation
summary: Prohibits smoking in private passenger cars, vans and trucks where a minor less than 14 years of age is a passenger in such vehicles; provides for rebuttable presumption; provides that violations of such provisions shall be subject to a fine of not more than $100.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the state excise tax on cigarettes
summary: Increases the state excise tax on cigarettes.

short_summary: Authorizes the board of trustees of the state university of New York to offer certain other non-resident tuition rates
summary: Authorizes the board of trustees of the state university of New York to offer certain other non-resident tuition rates.

short_summary: Establishes a clinical preceptorship personal income tax credit for certain health care professionals who provide preceptor instruction to students
summary: Establishes a clinical preceptorship personal income tax credit for certain health care professionals who provide preceptor instruction to students studying to be a health care professional.

short_summary: Relates to allowing for a limited permit to be obtained to practice as a chiropractor
summary: Allows for a limited permit to be obtained to practice as a chiropractor.

short_summary: Requires state office buildings to be in compliance with certain greenhouse gas emissions limits three years before such limits apply statewide
summary: Requires state office buildings to be in compliance with the greenhouse gas emissions limits established by the New York state climate leadership and community protection act three years before such limits apply statewide.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of the New York farm to school and school garden fund
summary: Relates to the creation of the New York farm to school and school garden fund; allows individuals to make a gift on their personal tax form for such fund; provides such fund will be used to establish school gardens and purchase equipment and educational materials to promote students' consumption of local products conducted in cooperation with the department of agriculture and markets.

short_summary: Limits tinted green and brown to compostable plastic bags for the purposes of bag waste reduction
summary: Provides that bags exempt from bag waste reduction shall not be tinted green or brown unless it is a compostable bag.

short_summary: Requires the issuance of certificates of occupancy for rental property damaged by fire
summary: Requires the issuance of certificates of occupancy for rental property damaged by fire.

short_summary: Relates to proceeds from the auction or sale of carbon dioxide emission allowances
summary: Prohibits proceeds from the auction or sale of carbon dioxide emission allowances pursuant to New York's participation in the regional greenhouse gas initiative (RGGI) from being transferred into the state general fund; provides that if such proceeds are transferred to the state general fund, they shall be used for the purposes directed by the RGGI.

short_summary: Relates to disorderly conduct
summary: Modifies the definition of disorderly conduct for family offense proceedings to not require an intent to cause public inconvenience, annoyance or alarm, or recklessly creating a risk thereof, but merely an intent to cause annoyance or alarm, or recklessly creating a risk thereof.

short_summary: Relates to certain school holidays; repealer
summary: Relates to certain school holidays; repeals Anniversary day.

short_summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization
summary: Relates to certain payments to the horsemen's organization; extends such provisions to 2024.

short_summary: Relates to the thoroughbred breeding and development fund
summary: Extends the provisions relating to the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund until twelve years after the commencement of the operation of a video lottery terminal facility at Aqueduct racetrack.

short_summary: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
summary: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

short_summary: Relates to requiring food service establishments to permit the use of reusable beverage and food containers provided by customers
summary: Requires food service establishments to permit the use of reusable beverage and food containers provided by customers when requesting a beverage refill or requesting leftovers from a partially consumed meal to be packaged and post signs to inform customers that they are permitted to do so.

short_summary: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program
summary: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program which shall provide grants within amounts appropriated or otherwise available therefor to affordable independent senior housing properties to establish and operate resident assistance programs.

short_summary: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages
summary: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages and of limited English proficiency.

short_summary: Directs the court to provide notice to the former owners of foreclosed property of the right to file a claim for the excess funds from the sale of the real property
summary: Directs the court to provide notice to the former owners of foreclosed property of the right to file a claim for the excess funds from the sale of the real property.

short_summary: Relates to arbitration organizations
summary: Relates to arbitration organizations; requires private arbitration organizations involved in fifty or more consumer arbitrations per year to collect, publish at least quarterly, and make available to the public in a computer-searchable database certain information relating to such arbitrations; prohibits financial conflicts of interest.

short_summary: Prohibits certain forensic child custody evaluators from appearing as an expert witness in family court
summary: Prohibits forensic child custody evaluators who have been terminated for cause from appearing as an expert witness in family court custody and visitation proceedings.

short_summary: Relates to the closure of hospitals or emergency or maternity departments
summary: Relates to the closure of hospitals; includes general hospitals, emergency or maternity departments or the surrender of an operating certificate.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns
summary: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns; requires the division of state police to maintain statewide records of individuals who have waived the right to purchase firearms, rifles, or shotguns and any revocations of such waivers.

short_summary: Enacts the public benefits for professional facilities act
summary: Enacts the "public benefits for professional facilities act"; defines terms; provides that any state or local authority that grants any benefit, for the purpose of construction, reconstruction, repair or rehabilitation of a professional sports facility, shall, as a condition of such benefit, require that at least seven percent of all tickets for each event be sold at prices affordable to residents of the host community.

short_summary: Makes rent stabilized dwelling units eligible for certain protections
summary: Makes rent stabilized dwelling units eligible for certain protections regarding deposits.

short_summary: Gives justice courts limited equity powers to compel compliance with local zoning, building and fire prevention codes
summary: Gives justice courts limited equity powers to compel compliance with local zoning, building and fire prevention codes; grants justice courts the authority to issue injunctions and temporary restraining orders relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to certain tuition payments by school districts for general education and special students residing in such school districts
summary: Excludes certain tuition payments by school districts for general education and special students residing in such school districts from the calculation of the tax levy limit.

short_summary: Provides motor fuel tax exemption for sales of diesel motor fuel made to commercial fishermen
summary: Eliminates provisions of law that require the payment and subsequent refund of the ten cent diesel excise tax and sales tax on diesel motor fuel when sold to operators of commercial fishing vessels for use in the operation of such vessels.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the monetary jurisdiction of the justice courts from three thousand dollars to fifteen thousand dollars
summary: Increases the monetary jurisdiction of the justice courts from three thousand dollars to fifteen thousand dollars.

short_summary: Increases from twenty-four to sixty months, the time for which reconsideration for parole for a violent felony offense shall be determined
summary: Enacts "Lorraine's Law"; increases from twenty-four to sixty months, the time for which reconsideration for parole for a violent felony offense shall be determined.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, to enact a homestead exemption
summary: Authorizes the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, to enact by local law a homestead exemption; provides that such exemption shall not exceed $50,000 in full assessed value.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency for the 2020-2021 school taxes and the 2021 general taxes for the property located at 118 Terrace Avenue, Hempstead NY.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency for the 2020--2021 school taxes and the 2021 general taxes for the property at 40 Byrd Street.

short_summary: Establishes a retirement benefit review panel
summary: Establishes a retirement benefit review panel.

short_summary: Establishes an energy-related public utility mass real property central assessment program
summary: Establishes an energy-related public utility mass real property central assessment program.

short_summary: Enacts "Matthew's law"
summary: Enacts Matthew's law which provides for the dispensing of drug adulterant testing supplies by health care professionals or pharmacists to any person.

short_summary: Establishes a code of ethics for all board of elections employees
summary: Establishes a code of ethics for all board of election employees so that no employee of a board of election should have any interest, financial or otherwise, direct or indirect, or engage in any business or transaction or professional activity or incur any obligation of any nature, which is in substantial conflict with the proper discharge of his or her duties in the public interest.

short_summary: Provides that the amount of a STAR real property tax savings may not be less than the amount of the STAR real property tax savings from the previous year
summary: Provides that the amount of a STAR real property tax savings may not be less than the amount of the STAR real property tax savings from the previous year.

short_summary: Requires police officers to take temporary custody of firearms when responding to reports of family violence
summary: Requires police officers to take temporary custody of firearms for not less than one hundred twenty hours when responding to reports of family violence.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program
summary: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program and analyze such report showing trends and cumulative impact, as well as notify other relevant agencies if contamination has exceeded EPA standards for maximum amounts of contamination allowed in drinking water or food.

short_summary: Establishes the office of addiction and mental health services
summary: Establishes the office of addiction and mental health services.

short_summary: Creates a tax credit for employment of persons on probation or parole
summary: Creates a tax credit for employment of persons on probation or parole.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting wind turbines from being located in a certain area of the city of New York
summary: Prohibits wind turbines from being located within 1500 feet of a residential area or commercial shopping district within the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma
summary: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma after January 1, 2025.

short_summary: Provides final discipline authority over civilian complaints to the civilian complaint review board
summary: Provides final discipline authority over civilian complaints to the civilian complaint review board; creates a hearing officer and adjudicative body for such complaint review board.

short_summary: Establishes a procedure for the creation of new counties
summary: Establishes a procedure for the creation of new counties; outlines population and area requirements; requires a feasibility study, petition and referendum; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of "immediate family" for the transfer of certain commercial fishing licenses
summary: Removes the provision that an immediate family member needs to be domiciled in the house of the license or permit holder for the purpose of commercial fishing license transfers.

short_summary: Requires all agencies of the city of New York which issue summons to document violations with photographic evidence when feasible
summary: Requires all agencies of the city of New York which issue summons to document violations with photographic evidence when feasible.

short_summary: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York
summary: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to notification requirements for traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices and photo speed violation monitoring systems
summary: Relates to notification requirements for traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices and photo speed violation monitoring systems.

short_summary: Relates to cemetery desecration; repealer
summary: Removes the $250 amount of damage from cemetery desecration in the second degree; makes cemetery desecration in the second degree a class E felony to apply to any damage or theft regardless of value; adds crime of cemetery desecration in the first degree and makes such crime a class D felony.

short_summary: Enacts the "save our stores act"
summary: Waives the assessment of fines or monetary penalties against a not-for-profit organization, school, place of worship or small business located in a city with a population of one million or more by a state or local agency for a violation of law, rule, regulation or executive order during the COVID-19 covered period; provides exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to a privately owned vacant property temporary public benefit use exemption
summary: Relates to a privately owned vacant property temporary public benefit use exemption.

short_summary: Allows an action for unlawful discriminatory practice to be brought within three years after dismissal for administrative convenience
summary: Authorizes the institution of a suit in any court of competent jurisdiction alleging a violation of the human rights law for a period of three years after the dismissal of a complaint for administrative convenience by the division of human rights.

short_summary: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities
summary: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities.

short_summary: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to a spouse, survivor or child
summary: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to a spouse, survivor or child; defines terms.

short_summary: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court; repealer
summary: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court with regard to the timing of discovery, disclosure prior to certain guilty pleas, DNA evidence, court orders, and the admissibility of discovery.

short_summary: Authorizes Michelle Rickard to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
summary: Authorizes Michelle Rickard, a town of Hamburg police officer, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

short_summary: Enacts the "donor-conceived person protection act"
summary: Enacts the "donor-conceived person protection act" to ensure that reproductive tissue banks, licensed by the department of health, collect and verify medical information from any donor it procures reproductive tissue from and to disseminate such information to a recipient before a recipient purchases or otherwise receives such tissue, and to donor-conceived persons, if any, when such persons turn eighteen years of age or earlier upon consent of the recipient parent or guardian; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Makes a technical correction to the designation of the animal shelter regulation fund
summary: Makes a technical correction to the designation of the animal shelter regulation fund.

short_summary: Allows physician assistants to serve as primary care practitioners for purposes of Medicaid managed care plans
summary: Allows physician assistants to serve as primary care practitioners for purposes of Medicaid managed care plans.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of the "look-back period" for the determination of eligibility of an individual for medical assistance benefits
summary: Relates to the definition of the "look-back period" for the determination of eligibility of an individual for medical assistance benefits; exempts certain assets used on the individual's behalf or for care services provided to the individual by a family member or informal caregiver.

short_summary: Relates to the use of fluoroscopy by physician assistants
summary: Relates to the use of fluoroscopy by physician assistants.

short_summary: Establishes an indirect source review for certain warehouse operations
summary: Establishes an indirect source review for heavy distribution warehouse operations; requires the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study regarding zero-emissions zones.

short_summary: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor
summary: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor and any such subsequent violation shall be a class E felony.

short_summary: Establishes the climate change adaptation cost recovery program and the climate change adaptation fund
summary: Establishes the climate change adaptation cost recovery program to require companies that have contributed significantly to the buildup of climate-warming greenhouse gases in the atmosphere to bear a share of the costs of needed infrastructure investments to adapt to climate change; mandates that projects funded by the program require compliance with prevailing wage requirements; requires that contracts for funded projects contain a provision that the structural iron and structural steel used or supplied in the performance of the contract or any subcontract thereto shall be produced or made in whole or substantial part in the United States, its territories or possessions; makes additional provisions; establishes the climate change adaptation fund.

short_summary: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists
summary: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists including: campaign contributions to elected officials; existing business relationships or associations with public officials; and the names of family members of a public official to whom the lobbyist, or his or her employer, paid compensation of over $500 in the preceding calendar year and the amount of compensation paid; provides for the disposition of campaign funds.

short_summary: Relates to the crimes of bribery and abuse of public trust
summary: Relates to the crimes of bribery and abuse of public trust.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the use of gas-powered leaf and lawn blowers during certain months
summary: Prohibits the use of gas-powered leaf and lawn blowers between May 1st and September 30th.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of electronic cigarettes that contains certain toxic metals and requires the department of health to study the long term health effects of using electronic cigarettes
summary: Prohibits the sale of electronic cigarettes that contain certain toxic metals; requires the department of health to establish a list of prohibited toxic metals; requires the department of health to study the long term health effects of using electronic cigarettes.

short_summary: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease
summary: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease.

short_summary: Relates to the placement of school crossing guards
summary: Relates to the placement of school crossing guards; requires school crossing guards to be placed on each of the corners of streets adjacent to public and private schools in New York City serving students in grades K-8 and on each side of streets with more than four lanes.

short_summary: Requires the filing and posting of required ancillary agreements on school district and charter school websites
summary: Requires the filing and posting of required ancillary agreements on school district and charter school websites.

short_summary: Repeal paragraph (e) of subdivision 3 of section 2853 and subdivision 6-g of section 3602 of the education law, relating to an aid rollback for charter schools; repealer
summary: Relates to an aid rollback for charter schools.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of a public employee or employee
summary: Relates to the definition of a public employee or employee.

short_summary: Relates to divestment from the 1033 federal excess property program
summary: Prohibits any local police department, county sheriff's office, the division of the state police or any agency that employs a peace officer in this state from participating in the 1033 federal excess property program for the purposes of receiving lethal or offensive weapons.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of education to issue guidance to school districts for developing programs to attract underrepresented candidates into the teaching profession
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to issue guidance to school districts for developing programs to attract underrepresented candidates into the teaching profession and to identify funding available to school districts for such purposes.

short_summary: Relates to providing that a motor vehicle will be considered to be in motion while stopped at traffic control devices and stop signs for purposes of mobile phones and other portable electronic devices
summary: Provides that a motor vehicle will be considered to be in motion while stopped at traffic control devices, stop signs and certain other situations for purposes of mobile phones and other portable electronic devices violations.

short_summary: Relates to the abandonment of certain town roads in the towns of Pike and Genesee Falls, in the county of Wyoming
summary: Authorizes that the commissioner of transportation is authorized and directed to assume jurisdiction for state highway purposes over the town road described as follows: all of Griffith road from the intersection with state routes 19 and 39 in the town of Pike easterly to its terminus at state route 19A in the town of Genesee Falls.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a self-sufficiency standard study
summary: Relates to the creation of a self-sufficiency standard study regarding how much income is needed for a family of a given composition in a given geographic location to adequately meet its basic needs without public or private assistance.

short_summary: Exempts income earned by persons from certain job training or adult education programs from the determination of need for public assistance programs
summary: Exempts income earned by a head of household or any person in the household from certain job training or adult education programs from the determination of need for public assistance programs.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program
summary: Directs the commissioner of DMV to establish a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program to provide education and awareness literature and educational materials to all drivers with a commercial motor vehicle license.

short_summary: Enacts The New Deal for CUNY
summary: Enacts The New Deal for CUNY; increases the ratio of faculty and mental health counselors to full-time students; requires that certain amounts of tuition be replaced by federal, state, and city funds.

short_summary: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land; repealer
summary: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land.

short_summary: Provides for the pension benefits for first grade police officers of the city of New York who have served for 25 or 30 years
summary: Provides for the pension benefits for first grade police officers of the city of New York who have served for 25 or 30 years.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay
summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay; directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on ecological restoration needs in Jamaica Bay.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay
summary: Relates to the filling of borrow pits in Jamaica Bay; prohibits the filling in of borrow pits with sediment or fill materials.

short_summary: Relates to an economic impact statement prior to the enactment of any rule or regulation affecting the commercial fishing industry
summary: Relates to an economic impact statement prior to the enactment of any rule or regulation affecting the commercial fishing industry; provides for periodic review of such rules and regulations.

short_summary: Grants court officers in the town of Shelter Island in Suffolk county peace officer status
summary: Grants court officers in the town of Shelter Island in Suffolk county peace officer status.

short_summary: Grants fire marshals in the town of Shelter Island in Suffolk county peace officer status
summary: Grants fire marshals in the town of Shelter Island in Suffolk county peace officer status.

short_summary: Requires reduction of a parent's child support obligation by the amount of social security dependent benefits received by the child
summary: Requires reduction of a parent's child support obligation by the amount of social security dependent benefits received by the child.

short_summary: Grants animal control officers in the town of Southampton in Suffolk county peace officer status
summary: Grants animal control officers in the town of Southampton in Suffolk county peace officer status.

short_summary: Relates to the trustees of the Freeholders and the Commonalty of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk
summary: Relates to the trustees of the Freeholders and the Commonalty of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk; provides that the trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton have and shall continue to have the authority to enforce the public's easement and access upon the ocean beaches within the town of Southampton, including all rights of the public with respect to the said ocean beaches which were conferred upon them by the Dongan Patent of 1686; defines "ocean beaches".

short_summary: Relates to restrictions on class DJ and MJ licenses in the counties of Nassau and Suffolk
summary: Relates to restrictions on class DJ and MJ licenses in the counties of Nassau and Suffolk by permitting such licensees to drive to and from school between the hours of five in the morning to nine o'clock in the evening.

short_summary: Relates to the eligibility of enrolled members of Southampton Village Ocean Rescue for the tax exemption on real property authorized by section 466-a of the real property tax law
summary: Provides that enrolled members of Southampton Village Ocean Rescue shall be eligible for the tax exemption on real property authorized by section 466-c of the real property tax law.

short_summary: Relates to the eligibility of enrolled members of the East Hampton Volunteer Ocean Rescue and Auxiliary Squad for the tax exemption on real property authorized by section 466-a of the real property tax law
summary: Relates to the eligibility of enrolled members of the East Hampton Volunteer Ocean Rescue and Auxiliary Squad for the tax exemption on real property authorized by section 466-a of the real property tax law, as added by chapter 670 of the laws of 2022.

short_summary: Provides that where a senior citizen purchases real property after the taxable status date, such person shall be eligible for the enhanced STAR exemption
summary: Provides that where a person who meets the requirements for an enhanced exemption for property owned by senior citizens purchases real property after the levy of taxes, such person may file an application for exemption to the assessor within thirty days of the transfer of title to such person for such exemption.

short_summary: Establishes a special needs assisted living program to serve persons with neurodegenerative diseases
summary: Establishes a special needs assisted living program to serve residents of certified assisted living residences with neurodegenerative diseases, such as dementia or Parkinson's disease, who are experiencing behavior disturbances.

short_summary: Imposes an additional tax on income attributable to long-term capital gain
summary: Imposes an additional tax on income attributable to long-term capital gain.

short_summary: Prohibits the slaughter of horses for human or animal consumption
summary: Prohibits any person, corporation, association, or other entity from slaughtering a horse where such person, corporation, association, or other entity knows or has reason to know that such horse will be used for human or animal consumption; prohibits any person, corporation, association, or other entity from possessing, selling, importing, etc., a horse or horseflesh if such person, corporation, association, or other entity knows or should have known that any part of such horse or horseflesh will be used for human or animal consumption; provides penalties for violation.

short_summary: Authorizes the commission on ethics and lobbying in government to provide a training course concerning anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists and requiring lobbyists to complete the course annually
summary: Authorizes the commission on ethics and lobbying in government to provide a training course concerning anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists; requires lobbyists to complete the course annually.

short_summary: Relates to the transfer of certain funds from the licensed private career schools tuition reimbursement account to the proprietary vocational school supervision account
summary: Provides that if the net balance of the reimbursement account exceeds two million five hundred thousand dollars, any amount over two million five hundred thousand dollars shall be transferred to the proprietary vocational school supervision account.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory student enrollment reporting
summary: Relates to mandatory student enrollment reporting for public schools and charter schools triennially on October thirty-first, January thirty-first, and April thirtieth of each year.

short_summary: Enacts the "sewage flooding prevention act"
summary: Enacts the "sewage flooding prevention act"; authorizes certain homeowners and not-for-profit agencies in New York City to receive an abatement of real property taxes up to two thousand dollars for the cost of installing sewer improvement check valve devices on certain dwellings; directs the New York City department of environmental protection to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations.

short_summary: Establishes the general aviation task force to improve general aviation operations in the state of New York
summary: Establishes the general aviation task force to study measures that may be implemented to improve general aviation operations in the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to the individuals who are required to file New York state income tax returns
summary: Amends the threshold of resident individuals required to file New York state income tax returns.

short_summary: Allows home-schooled children to participate in interscholastic athletic activities and drivers ed in the district where they reside
summary: Allows home-schooled children to participate in interscholastic athletic activities and driver's education in the district where they reside.

short_summary: Requires the appointment of an independent fiduciary upon the dissolution of a charter school
summary: Requires the appointment of an independent fiduciary upon the closing of a charter school to develop and implement the dissolution plan of such charter school, including the distribution of assets.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the use of head-mounted portable electronic devices while driving
summary: Prohibits the use of head-mounted portable electronic devices while driving.

short_summary: Relates to charter schools in cities with a population of one million or more
summary: Requires the state comptroller and the comptroller of the city of New York to coordinate the scheduling and performance of audits of charter schools in the city of New York.

short_summary: Establishes limitations on taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel; authorizes certain local laws limiting taxes on motor fuel
summary: Provides for a phased decrease of excise taxes and sales taxes and petroleum business taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel when the average price of motor fuel in the state exceeds $2.25 per gallon; authorizes cities having a population of one million or more and counties to adopt local laws limiting taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel.

short_summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth
summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth.

short_summary: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver before expiration of such license
summary: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver at least 90 days before expiration of such license.

short_summary: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis
summary: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis.

short_summary: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license
summary: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license.

short_summary: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree
summary: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree.

short_summary: Allows retired state police officers to serve as police officers for local police departments without diminution of retirement benefits
summary: Allows retired state police officers to serve as police officers for local police departments without diminution of retirement benefits; empowers the superintendent of state police to approve such service.

short_summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software
summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to apply for a waiver to implement a work requirement for able-bodied adult recipients of Medicaid
summary: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to apply for a waiver to implement a work requirement for able-bodied adult recipients of Medicaid.

short_summary: Includes reckless operation of a motor vehicle resulting in the death or serious injury of a companion animal in the definition aggravated animal cruelty
summary: Includes reckless operation of a motor vehicle resulting in the death or serious injury of a companion animal in the definition of aggravated animal cruelty.

short_summary: Establishes a home heating tax credit; repealer
summary: Establishes a home heating tax credit for qualified taxpayers with an income of $125,000 or less for single filers, or with a combined income of $250,000 or less for joint filers.

short_summary: Authorizes a correction to an error in the tax assessment rolls of the Bath Central School District; and making an appropriation therefor
summary: Authorizes a correction to an error in the tax assessment rolls of the Bath Central School District; makes an appropriation of $500,000 to address the school district's shortfall that resulted from the error.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation and licensing of on-demand pay providers
summary: Relates to the regulation and licensing of employer-integrated and non-verified on-demand pay providers.

short_summary: Establishes the New York baby opportunity fund
summary: Establishes the New York baby opportunity fund which deposits $1,000 into an account managed by the state comptroller to be available to eligible children when they reach the age of 18; provides such funds be used for education costs, the purchase of real estate, or entrepreneurship.

short_summary: Relates to the role of the department of corrections and community supervision in planning and facilitating the discharge or release of incarcerated individuals to the community
summary: Relates to the role of the department of corrections and community supervision in planning and facilitating the discharge or release of incarcerated individuals to the community.

short_summary: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract
summary: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract.

short_summary: Relates to excused absence of a public employee for mental health purposes
summary: Relates to excused absence of a public employee for mental health purposes.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state lead-safe renovation, repair and painting act
summary: Establishes the "New York state lead-safe renovation, repair and painting act"; establishes standards for lead-safe renovation, repair and painting of residential properties; requires documentation of compliance with such standards.

short_summary: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act"; repealer
summary: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act" to replace the process for the criminal forfeiture of certain property in certain instances.

short_summary: Requires accurate interpretation of statements made by deponents with limited English proficiency in accusatory instruments and supporting depositions
summary: Provides that an accusatory instrument or supporting deposition consisting of factual allegations by a deponent with limited English proficiency is not sufficient unless accompanied by a sworn statement from an interpreter affirming the accuracy of the English interpretation.

short_summary: Creates the office of expungement and automatic sealing
summary: Creates the office of expungement and automatic sealing within the division of criminal justice services to oversee the sealing and expungement of certain convictions.

short_summary: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables and requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles
summary: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables; requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles.

short_summary: Imposes certain penalties related to violations of building and fire code standards within fourteen days and increases certain fine amounts for violations of housing standards
summary: Requires that any penalties for violations of housing standards or building and fire codes be assessed and imposed within fourteen days; increases certain fine amounts for violations of housing standards.

short_summary: Relates to vintage snowmobile registrations
summary: Relates to vintage snowmobile registrations.

short_summary: Relates to a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court
summary: Establishes a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court.

short_summary: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Authorizes New York Kali Mandir, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes New York Kali Mandir, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney Memorial Bridge" in the town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Trooper Theodore A. Dobbs Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Trooper Theodore A. Dobbs Memorial Bridge" in the town of North Hempstead, county of Nassau.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the private employers veterans' preference policy act
summary: Permits private employers to adopt a veterans' hiring preference policy.

short_summary: Relates to recordkeeping requirements for second-hand dealers, scrap processors and pawnbrokers
summary: Relates to recordkeeping requirements for second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers.

short_summary: Relates to classifying properties held in condominium and cooperative form for assessment purposes as class one-a properties; repealer
summary: Classifies properties held in condominium and cooperative form for assessment purposes as class one-a properties; requires that the annual tax rate percentage change for class one-a properties does not exceed the annual tax rate percentage change for class one properties.

short_summary: Relates to clarifying accountability standards, open meetings law and freedom of information requirements to local development corporations
summary: Clarifies the application of the accountability standards, open meetings law and freedom of information requirements to local development corporations as defined in section two of the public authorities law.

short_summary: Relates to the oversight of immigration detention facilities
summary: Relates to the oversight of immigration detention facilities; prohibits municipalities from using funds or resources for the construction of any new detention facility or the expansion of any existing detention facility without approval by the legislature; establishes a committee on immigration detention oversight.

short_summary: Relates to observance of all religious holidays by institutions within the state university and the city university of New York, and includes the Asian Lunar New Year within the definition of such holidays
summary: Relates to observance of all religious holidays by institutions within the state university and the city university of New York; includes the Asian Lunar New Year within the definition of such holidays.

short_summary: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit for travel on certain roadways
summary: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit to 70 mph for travel on roadways that currently have a maximum speed limit of 65 mph.

short_summary: Relates to including the mourning dove within the definition of "migratory game birds" and to allow for their taking
summary: Allows for the taking of Zenaida macroura, commonly known as the mourning dove, as a migratory bird.

short_summary: Includes the throwing, tossing or expelling of saliva at or on an employee of a correctional facility within the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
summary: Includes the throwing, tossing or expelling of saliva at or on an employee of a correctional facility within the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual.

short_summary: Relates to the transportation of liquefied natural and petroleum gas; repealer
summary: Relates to the transportation of liquefied natural and petroleum gas.

short_summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry
summary: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations
summary: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations, including criminal possession of methamphetamine manufacturing materials and unlawful manufacture of methamphetamines.

short_summary: Enacts the "solar panel collection act"
summary: Enacts the "solar panel collection act" to require manufacturers of solar panels to collect such panels when they are taken out of use; requires educational outreach relating thereto; establishes collection goals therefor; requires reporting of collection efforts.

short_summary: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
summary: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple participating states, thereby enhancing the portability of a medical license and ensuring the safety of patients.

short_summary: Relates to the possession and sale of methamphetamine
summary: Makes penalties for the possession and/or sale of methamphetamine similar to that of the penalties for possession and/or sale of heroin and cocaine.

short_summary: Grants peace officer status to officers and members of the security force of Arnot Health, Inc.
summary: Grants peace officer status to officers and members of the security force of Arnot Health, Inc.

short_summary: Relates to the oversight of certain contracts by the comptroller
summary: Relates to the oversight of certain contracts by the comptroller; provides for the oversight of contracts by the comptroller based upon the dollar amounts of such contracts.

short_summary: Prohibits agencies from charging a fee for records where an electronic copy is already available from a previous request made within the past six months
summary: Prohibits agencies from charging a fee for records where an electronic copy is already available from a previous request made within the past six months except for the actual cost of a storage device or media if provided to the requester.

short_summary: Relates to the certain offenses and provisions related to the unlawful dissemination of a personal image; and relates to a private right of action for such offenses; repealer
summary: Provides for the offense of unlawful dissemination of a personal image and a private right of action for such offense.

short_summary: Relates to public awareness and involvement in the thirty by thirty conservation plan
summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation to post draft strategies and methodology developed no later than July 1, 2024; requires at least one public hearing and posting of the final goal strategies and methodology on such department's website.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a plan for the delivery of medical supplies and medications to pharmacies, hospitals and nursing homes in affected areas during a state disaster emergency
summary: Clarifies that a plan for the delivery of medical supplies and medications to pharmacies, hospitals and nursing homes in affected areas during a state disaster emergency is required.

short_summary: Relates to the restoration of electric power services during a widespread outage
summary: Relates to the restoration of electric power services during a widespread outage; requires electric corporations and the Long Island power authority service provider during a widespread prolonged outage that affects at least twenty thousand customers to notify the village, town or city if certain electric power services are not able to be restored; requires the chief executive to coordinate with affected police departments, fire departments, ambulance services and advanced life support first response services prewired with an appropriate transfer switch for using an alternate generated power source for the emergency deployment of alternate generated power sources.

short_summary: Relates to medical needs which require essential electricity
summary: Removes requirements that require any medical equipment or equipment necessary for an individual whose diagnosis is likely to be significantly triggered or significantly exacerbated by a continued loss of power that will adversely impact that individual's health; removes such requirements from an emergency response plan.

short_summary: Relates to a statewide electronic tracking system for evidence collection kits used to collect and preserve evidence of a sexual assault or other sex offense that are submitted to the custody of law enforcement
summary: Relates to the establishment of the statewide electronic tracking system for evidence collection kits used to collect and preserve evidence of a sexual assault or other sex offense that are submitted to the custody of law enforcement; relates to the effectiveness of such provisions.

short_summary: Requires gas corporations to file annual gas safety reports
summary: Requires gas corporations to file annual gas safety reports; authorizes the public service commission to order reasonable improvements to promote public interest, preserve public health and protect those using gas when there is a deficiency in a gas corporation's prioritization or administration of its pipeline replacement projects or operation and maintenance activities related to gas safety.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to promulgate a list of prescription drugs for which an emergency thirty-day supply cannot be obtained
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to promulgate a list of prescription drugs for which an emergency thirty-day supply cannot be obtained during a state emergency.

short_summary: Relates to loan counseling services for a mortgage guaranteed under the "Servicemen's Readjustment Act of 1944"
summary: Provides that a veteran seeking a housing loan under chapter 37 of title 38 of the United States Code be offered loan counseling services by a counselor certified by the United States department of housing and urban development under Part 214 of Title 24 of the Code of Federal Regulations prior to the processing of such application by a banking institution or mortgage lender and that the department of veterans' services shall promulgate regulations to ensure that no conflicts of interest exist between counselors and mortgage companies.

short_summary: Specifies procedures for the closure and/or decertification of assisted living residences
summary: Specifies procedures for the closure and/or decertification of assisted living residences; requires certain review and disclosures to be completed within a certain time frame.

short_summary: Relates to insurance for victims of a hate crime; repealer
summary: Prohibits an insurer from cancelling, refusing to issue, refusing to renew, or increasing the premium of a policy or to exclude, limit, restrict, or reduce coverage under such policy solely on the basis that one or more claims have been made against any policy during the preceding sixty months for a loss that is the result of a hate crime.

short_summary: Authorizes the assessor of the county of Nassau to grant the Mineola Union Free School District an exemption from real property taxes upon approval of the Nassau county legislature
summary: Requires the approval by the Nassau county legislature for the assessor of the county of Nassau to then accept from the Mineola Union Free School District an application for exemption from real property taxes.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the Bais Torah U'tefillah to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Bais Torah U'tefillah to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status upon approval by the Nassau county legislature.

short_summary: Designates lay individuals as one-day marriage officiants in order to solemnize marriages; repealer
summary: Provides for the designation of lay individuals as one-day marriage officiants in order to solemnize marriages by a town or city clerk.

short_summary: Relates to the amount of damages recoverable in a cause of action for unlawful interference with protected rights
summary: Relates to the amount of damages recoverable in a cause of action for unlawful interference with protected rights which is up to three times the amount of compensatory damages.

short_summary: Establishes a one-stop farming hotline with the Cornell cooperative extension
summary: Establishes a one-stop farming hotline with the Cornell cooperative extension.

short_summary: Provides for coverage for certain individuals under the 1332 state innovation program
summary: Provides for coverage for certain individuals under the 1332 state innovation program.

short_summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for certain well water testing
summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction, once every three years up to six hundred dollars, for the testing of potable well water by a certified laboratory.

short_summary: Requires nursing homes and assisted living facilities to provide and maintain automated external defibrillators
summary: Requires nursing homes and assisted living facilities to provide and maintain automated external defibrillators in quantities and types deemed by the commissioner to be adequate to ensure ready and appropriate access for use during emergencies.

short_summary: Establishes the Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act
summary: Establishes the "Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act" which provides for a withholding of a certain amount of state funding for a defunding municipality.

short_summary: Designates March twenty-first as Down Syndrome Awareness Day
summary: Designates March twenty-first as a day of commemoration to be known as "Down Syndrome Awareness Day".

short_summary: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the 9-11 Fallen Firefighter Memorial Highway
summary: Designates a portion of the Long Island Expressway as the "9-11 Fallen Firefighter Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to publishing data on the effects of bail reform
summary: Requires the office of court administration and division of criminal justice services to collect and publish certain data relating to bail reform.

short_summary: Relates to renaming the bridges of the state highway system after New York state's medal of honor recipients
summary: Relates to renaming the bridges of the state highway system after New York state's medal of honor recipients.

short_summary: Relates to the liability of the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways
summary: Imposes liability on the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways year round.

short_summary: Enacts the "opened physician entrance (OPEN) act"
summary: Enacts the "opened physician entrance (OPEN) act"; requires every health care provider's office that provides outpatient services to install at least one automatic entry door; provides income tax credits for providers who install an automatic door if they did not previously have one.

short_summary: Requires hospitals and healthcare facilities providing emergency services to develop plans to provide reasonable accommodations for service animals
summary: Requires hospitals and healthcare facilities which provide emergency services to develop plans to provide reasonable accommodations to house a patient's service animal until such time as they can be picked up.

short_summary: Provides real property tax relief to certain veterans
summary: Provides real property tax relief to veterans who have at least ten years of service in the U.S. armed forces or in the organized militia of the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to a state agency adopting emergency regulations
summary: Requires a state agency to get approval from the senate and the assembly prior to adopting or readopting a rule on an emergency basis unless such rule is necessary on an emergency basis for the preservation of the public health, safety and general welfare of the public.

short_summary: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting
summary: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting.

short_summary: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Bath, in Steuben county; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
summary: Authorizes the village of Bath, in Steuben county to adopt and amend local laws imposing a tax on persons occupying a room for hire in any hotel in an amount not to exceed 2% of the per diem rental rate for each room; provides for the expiration and repeal of such provisions on September 1, 2025.

short_summary: Grants free access and parking at state parks for active-duty military members and veterans
summary: Grants free access and parking at state parks for active-duty military members and veterans upon showing an active-duty military or veteran's ID card.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of the metropolitan commuter transportation district for the purposes of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
summary: Relates to the definition of the metropolitan commuter transportation district for the purposes of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax; requires the metropolitan transportation authority to renegotiate the joint service operating agreement with the state of Connecticut.

short_summary: Relates to apportionments under the shared superintendent program; appropriation
summary: Provides for apportionments to school districts under the shared superintendent program; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Provides that a school district vote on a bond resolution shall take place on the third Tuesday in May in conjunction with the school budget vote
summary: Provides that a school district vote on a bond resolution shall take place on the third Tuesday in May in conjunction with the school budget vote; provides that such bond resolution vote may only be resubmitted to the voters of the school district one time subsequent to such vote.

short_summary: Grants uniformed court officers in the village of Sag Harbor in Suffolk county peace officer status
summary: Grants uniformed court officers in the village of Sag Harbor in Suffolk county peace officer status.

short_summary: Sets forth the manner by which an owner of real property in the town of Southampton which is bisected by a school district boundary shall pay school taxes
summary: Sets forth the manner by which an owner of real property in the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, which is bisected by a school district boundary shall pay real property school taxes.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing media access to certain areas during publicly declared emergencies
summary: Authorizes media members to have access to areas otherwise restricted to the public during public emergencies.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a residential fuel oil storage tank credit
summary: Establishes a residential fuel oil storage tank credit; directs the office of temporary and disability assistance to establish a program to assist eligible households in the replacement of residential fuel oil storage tanks.

short_summary: Relates to certain preliminary injunctions
summary: Provides that the failure of a party challenging a building permit, variance, subdivision or other land use approval to seek a preliminary injunction to prevent construction shall not give rise to the opposing party raising the defense of mootness if such party continues and/or completes construction with knowledge that an action challenging its land use approval has been timely commenced.

short_summary: Provides motor fuel tax exemption for sales of diesel motor fuel used in vessels used directly in a business providing sport fishing opportunities
summary: Provides motor fuel tax exemption for sales of diesel motor fuel used in vessels used directly in a business providing sport fishing opportunities for hire to the general public from the tax on petroleum businesses and from sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the release of certain balloons
summary: Prohibits the release of balloons with exceptions for manned hot air balloons, government-related experiments, and balloons released indoors.

short_summary: Prohibits the eviction of tenants for using medical marihuana for a certified medical use
summary: Prohibits the eviction of tenants for using medical marihuana for a certified medical use.
