short_summary: Relates to establishing a presumption of eligibility for housing and temporary shelter placement for those who lost employment due to a non-essential business shutdown
summary: Relates to establishing a presumption of eligibility for housing and temporary shelter placement for those who lost employment due to a non-essential business shutdown.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 recovery local employment tax credit program
summary: Establishes the COVID-19 recovery local employment tax credit program to provide tax incentives to employers for employing local employees in full-time or part-time positions in the two years following the conclusion of the state disaster emergency declared pursuant to executive order two hundred two.

short_summary: Relates to establishing state disaster emergency requirements for homeless shelters
summary: Relates to establishing state disaster emergency requirements for homeless shelters including placement of individuals and families in shelters and reporting of infections related to the emergency.

short_summary: Ensures that parents and guardians of youth up to age 19 are notified when their child is arrested
summary: Relates to the issuance of arrest warrants upon a youth; provides for the police officer to make a reasonable effort to notify the parent or other person legally responsible for the care of such youth or with whom the youth is domiciled that the youth has been arrested; provides that the police officer need not notify the parent or other person legally responsible when such youth is not also a juvenile offender and the notification would endanger the health and safety of such youth; amends provisions relating to sexually exploited children to include persons under the age of nineteen.

short_summary: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans
summary: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans.

short_summary: Provides for issuing non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges
summary: Issues non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges due to a driving while intoxicated arrest.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the appointment of town assessors
summary: Makes town assessors an appointed position statewide; ends elections for town assessors.

short_summary: Requires background checks prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character
summary: Requires background checks for a person prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character; provides certain penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to adding disability to the equal protection requirement
summary: Relates to adding disability to the equal protection requirement.

short_summary: Relates to abolishing the office of coroner
summary: Abolishes the office of coroner.

short_summary: Relates to the regulation of bus privatization contracts
summary: Requires the state comptroller to approve any attempt to privatize a public bus service by a locality.

short_summary: Makes certain amendments concerning zone pricing of gasoline
summary: Makes certain amendments concerning zone pricing of gasoline.

short_summary: Relates to the rights to contract for the burial of cremains in pet cemeteries and requiring notice relating thereto
summary: Relates to the rights to contract for the burial of cremains in pet cemeteries; requires notice relating thereto.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of "protected consumer"
summary: Defines a "protected consumer" as an individual who is under the age of eighteen years.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of the New York city parks construction authority
summary: Creates the New York city parks construction authority and transfers the powers and duties relating to financing, construction, rehabilitation and maintenance of parks and recreation facilities.

short_summary: Establishes restrictions on consumer and employment contracts
summary: Establishes restrictions on consumer and employment contracts.

short_summary: Requires gas corporations to file a plan addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory
summary: Requires gas corporations to file a plan with the public service commission addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory; outlines plans for the replacement of such pipelines.

short_summary: Creates the New York city transit authority safety advisory panel to study and report on safety from terrorist acts
summary: Creates the New York city transit authority safety advisory panel to study and report on safety from terrorist acts and to provide a moratorium on the closing of token booths and minimum staffing levels on trains operated in passenger service in the NYC transit system.

short_summary: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances
summary: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Requires a phone company to restore service promptly when phone service goes down for someone who uses a medical alert system or a device that transmits medical data
summary: Requires a phone company to restore service promptly when phone service goes down for someone who uses a medical alert system or a device that transmits medical data.

short_summary: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free; repealer
summary: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free.

short_summary: Relates to unlawful possession and sale of cannabis
summary: Relates to unlawful possession and sale of cannabis; provides for a civil penalty for possession of three ounces or less of cannabis or cannabis products by persons under the age of twenty-one; provides for criminal penalties for the possession and sale of preparations, compounds, mixtures or substances containing cannabis and concentrated cannabis of certain aggregate weights.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York
summary: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York; provides enforcement mechanisms and penalties.

short_summary: Relates to assessment and taxation of lessees and users of certain tax exempt property
summary: Subjects to taxation the possessory interest of a private individual or corporation which uses real property owned by the United States or the state, except for real property owned by public authorities, for business purposes; excludes private property where the use is for a concession available to the general public located on property, such as parks, available for the use of the general public.

short_summary: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred
summary: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred to private parties; prohibits the recording of any deeds for lands that have been transferred out of federal ownership to private ownership without giving the state the right of first refusal.

short_summary: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth
summary: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth.

short_summary: Changes the default standard on statutory health proxy forms regarding life-sustaining treatment standards
summary: Relates to life-sustaining treatment standards.

short_summary: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers
summary: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers.

short_summary: Allows New York states sire stakes eligibility for foals sired by New York state stallions
summary: Allows New York sire stakes eligibility for foals sired by New York state stallions, either in-state or out-of-state.

short_summary: Relates to allowing health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid
summary: Allows out of state health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid 2023.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Warren to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Warren to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Establishes separate taxes on inheritance income and on gift income
summary: Relates to creating a separate tax on inheritance income, creating a separate tax on gift income, the computation of the estate tax, and creating a gift tax.

short_summary: Prohibits landlords, lessors, sub-lessors and grantors from demanding brokers' fees from a tenant
summary: Prohibits landlords, lessors, sub-lessors and grantors from demanding brokers' fees from a tenant.

short_summary: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of his or her lifetime
summary: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of his or her lifetime; establishes the kidney donor insurance fund.

short_summary: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards and in-line skates who are under 18 years of age to wear protective headgear
summary: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards, inline skates and scooters who are under eighteen years of age to wear protective headgear; increases the age requirement from fourteen years to eighteen years.

short_summary: Relates to disallowing county industrial development agencies from offering incentives in municipalities which have their own industrial development agency
summary: Disallows county industrial development agencies from offering incentives in municipalities which have their own industrial development agency.

short_summary: Relates to observing Atlantic time
summary: Relates to causing New York to observe Atlantic time.

short_summary: Relates to requiring employers submit an affirmative acknowledgement of implementing a sexual harassment prevention policy which meets or exceeds the minimum standards
summary: Requires employers to submit an affirmative acknowledgement of implementing a sexual harassment prevention policy which meets or exceeds the minimum standards upon the completion of the employer's annual training or the training of a newly hired employee.

short_summary: Relates to creating the crime of aggravated harassment of a survivor of domestic violence or sexual assault
summary: Relates to creating the crime of aggravated harassment of a survivor of domestic violence or sexual assault.

short_summary: Relates to allowing for unlicensed individuals to collect throat or nasopharyngeal swab specimens and to perform certain nursing tasks during a state of disaster emergency
summary: Allows for unlicensed individuals to collect throat or nasopharyngeal swab specimens and to perform certain nursing tasks during a state disaster emergency.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Bower
summary: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Bower, provided he files an application with the head of the NYSLRS within one year.

short_summary: Relates to the redomestication of insurance companies
summary: Relates to the redomestication of insurance companies.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the authority to issue group annuity contracts
summary: Relates to expanding the authority to issue group annuity contracts.

short_summary: Establishes the interstate insurance product regulation compact to regulate certain insurance products among member states
summary: Establishes the "Interstate insurance product regulation compact" to regulate certain insurance products among member states and to promote and protect the interest of consumers of individual and group annuity, life insurance, disability income and long-term care insurance products.

short_summary: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies
summary: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies; provides that certain services shall not be considered to be an inducement or rebate unless the superintendent determines that the offer and sale of such services constituted the sole reason for the purchase of such insurance policy.

short_summary: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance
summary: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance.

short_summary: Relates to non-insurance benefits
summary: Relates to authorizing non-insurance benefits or services to be offered as part of group life or group or blanket accident or health insurance policies.

short_summary: Relates to contractual liability insurance policies
summary: Relates to contractual liability insurance policies; requires the insurer to either discharge the obligations of the provider under the terms of the service contract, or in the event of the provider's nonperformance, cancellation of the service contract.

short_summary: Relates to paintless dent repair rate filing
summary: Relates to paintless dent repair rate filing.

short_summary: Relates to reporting information regarding step therapy override requests and determinations; repealer
summary: Requires disclosure, in such form as the superintendent shall require, of non-confidential information regarding step therapy override requests and determinations on a website that is readily accessible to the public.

short_summary: Allows domestic insurers to make certain records available by electronic means
summary: Allows domestic insurers to make certain records available by electronic means that provides equivalent access to the superintendent.

short_summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance
summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance.

short_summary: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage
summary: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage.

short_summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York
summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a 10 percent discount on New York city water bills to senior citizens and veterans
summary: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a 10 percent discount on NYC water bills to senior citizens and veterans.

short_summary: Exempts certain officers of the departments of correction and sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards
summary: Exempts certain officers of the department of correction and the department of sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards; designates correction officers of New York city as peace officers.

short_summary: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders
summary: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders from every three years to every year.

short_summary: Prohibits disposal of spoils containing toxic pollutants into the waters of the marine district
summary: Prohibits the disposal of any dredged spoils containing toxic pollutants into the waters of the marine district.

short_summary: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal
summary: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal by order of the commissioner.

short_summary: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions
summary: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions.

short_summary: Increases the household threshold income cap on tuition assistance
summary: Increases the household threshold income cap on tuition assistance from $80,000 to $100,000.

short_summary: Relates to the authority of the city of New York to install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices
summary: Increases the number of traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices that may be installed in New York city to six hundred intersections; extends certain provisions authorizing photo-monitoring devices until December 1, 2027.

short_summary: Relates to coverage for certain benefits under comprehensive motor vehicle insurance
summary: Relates to coverage for certain benefits under comprehensive motor vehicle insurance; prohibits assignment of benefits to durable medical equipment providers unless approved.

short_summary: Provides that payment of interest payment and attorney fees to claimant when payment of a claim is overdue shall be exclusive remedy
summary: Provides that payment of interest penalty and attorney fees to claimant when payment of a claim is overdue shall be exclusive remedy when insurer fails to make timely payment; provides such failure of insurer to make timely payment or issue denial within 30 days after proof of claim has been submitted to insurer shall not preclude such insurer from issuing a denial or asserting a defense after the 30 day period has elapsed.

short_summary: Relates to the granting of continuing education credits by the superintendent of financial services
summary: Relates to authorizing the superintendent of financial services to grant three credit hours of continuing education for a licensees' active membership in a statewide professional insurance producer association.

short_summary: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived claims or causes of action
summary: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived causes of action; provides such notice shall occur within 120 days after the insurer has received actual notice of such revived claim or cause of action.

short_summary: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts
summary: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts; amends provisions relating to misrepresentations and misleading statements; requires replacements regulation be consistent with policies of the national association of insurance commissioners.

short_summary: Provides for the indefinite suspension of New York city police officers without pay pending the disposition of charges of incompetence or misconduct in certain cases
summary: Provides for the indefinite suspension of New York city police officers without pay pending the disposition of charges of incompetence or misconduct resulting in death or serious physical injury as defined in section 10.00 of the penal law.

short_summary: Specifies watershed protection improvement districts may work towards the preservation of development rights
summary: Specifies watershed protection improvement districts may work towards the preservation of development rights.

short_summary: Designates portion of the state highway system as the "Detective Brian C. Mulkeen Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Woodbury, county of Orange, as the "Detective Brian C. Mulkeen Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Expands eligibility for temporary disability insurance and paid family leave benefits
summary: Expands eligibility for temporary disability insurance and paid family leave benefits; makes conforming technical changes.

short_summary: Relates to proceedings for appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
summary: Enacts "Karilyn's law"; provides that the court set the date for proceedings relating to family visitation under a guardianship petition for not more than ten days from the signing of the order to show cause; provides that visitation shall be a rebuttable presumption.

short_summary: Relates to the registered weight of tow trucks
summary: Increases, from 8,600 pounds to 10,000 pounds, the gross vehicle weight rating of vehicles engaged in commercial towing that must be registered as tow trucks.

short_summary: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club
summary: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club.

short_summary: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center
summary: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Grants court reporters in the first and second departments peace officer status
summary: Relates to granting certain court reporters peace officer status.

short_summary: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee
summary: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee for the intentional causing of physical injury to a school employee while upon school grounds.

short_summary: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant of the service of an ex parte order of protection
summary: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant, in the manner specified by the complainant, of the service of an ex parte order of protection.

short_summary: Relates to the crime of endangering the welfare of a child
summary: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; converts the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child to a second degree crime.

short_summary: Establishes the Big Apple Transit Authority and the Commuter Transit Authority; repealer
summary: Relates to establishing the big apple transit authority and the commuter transportation authority for the purpose of providing such authorities with municipal control over the New York city subway system (Part A); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority within the New York city transit authority (Part B); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority; repeals provisions relating thereto (Part C); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority (Part D); relates to establishing the commuter transportation authority (Part E).

short_summary: Requires forest management plans for certain lands and forbids clearcutting without, and increases the jurisdiction of the Adirondack park agency over clearcutting
summary: Requires forest management plans, subject to the approval of the department of environmental conservation, for certain lands subject to a conservation easement purchased by the state; forbids clearcutting on such lands without such forest management plan; increases the jurisdiction of the Adirondack park agency over clearcutting.

short_summary: Relates to wage theft
summary: Adds wage theft to the types of activities included in the crime of larceny.

short_summary: Requires legislators and candidates for member of the legislature to provide a link to their financial disclosure statements on their official state and campaign websites
summary: Requires legislators and candidates for members of the legislature to provide a link to their financial disclosure statements on their official state and campaign websites which shall direct website visitors to current and past financial disclosure forms that the legislator has submitted.

short_summary: Relates to the requirement for policyholders to provide 30 days notice to withdraw from the state insurance fund
summary: Relates to the requirement for policyholders to provide notice to withdraw from the state insurance fund.

short_summary: Directs the state insurance fund to compensate licensed insurance producers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund
summary: Directs the state insurance fund to compensate insurance brokers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund; establishes within the existing rate structure a factor to compensate licensed insurance producers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature
summary: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature.

short_summary: Establishes the resilient New York revolving loan program and the resilient New York revolving loan fund
summary: Establishes the resilient New York revolving loan program and the resilient New York revolving loan fund to provide low or no-interest loans to municipalities, not-for-profit organizations, and individual property owners for hazard mitigation and resilience projects; provides funding from federal STORM Act.

short_summary: Relates to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program
summary: Relates to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program.

short_summary: Provides eligibility for state or local public benefits regardless of immigration status
summary: Allows for state agencies, municipalities, and authorities to provide state or local public benefits regardless of immigration status.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York city board for education policy members public responsibility act"
summary: Enacts the "New York city board for education policy members public responsibility act" requiring a quorum of the members of the city board to attend any hearing scheduled for purposes of allowing public comment on changes to educational plans for the school district of the city of New York.

short_summary: Authorizes the commissioner of education to reschedule cancelled regents examinations
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to reschedule cancelled regents examinations within 20 business days of the original date.

short_summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students
summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students.

short_summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative
summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative; establishes the department shall discontinue implementation of the common core state standards.

short_summary: Requires the education department to report the results of English/language arts and mathematics assessments to parents of pupils by the last day of classes
summary: Requires the education department to report the results of English/language arts and mathematics assessments to parents of pupils by the last day of classes.

short_summary: Provides for the issuance of temporary retail permits by the state liquor authority; repealer
summary: Provides for the issuance of temporary retail permits by the state liquor authority if certain conditions are met.

short_summary: Requires agency payroll records be made available
summary: Requires agency payroll records be made available.

short_summary: Exempts hospitals from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
summary: Exempts hospitals from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

short_summary: Exempts clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all sales taxes
summary: Exempts clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all state and local sales taxes including items used or consumed to make or repair such clothing and which becomes a physical component part of such clothing.

short_summary: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts and increases filing fees
summary: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts; increases filing fees.

short_summary: Relates to the purchase of domestically produced personal protective equipment
summary: Relates to the purchase of personal protective equipment and medical supplies produced or manufactured in the state of New York.

short_summary: Relates to passenger registration of pickup trucks
summary: Relates to passenger registration of pickup trucks that are used exclusively for non-commercial purposes.

short_summary: Authorizes the direct intrastate and interstate shipment of alcoholic beverages
summary: Authorizes the direct intrastate and interstate shipment of liquor, cider, mead, and braggot; relates to direct shipments of wine.

short_summary: Permits certain retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from certain other retail licensees
summary: Permits on-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from off-premises retail licensees and off-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from on-premises retail licensees.

short_summary: Relates to the hours during which liquor and/or wine stores may be open on Sunday
summary: Expands the hours during which liquor and/or wine stores may be open on Sunday to 10 A.M. to 10 P.M.

short_summary: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate
summary: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate.

short_summary: Makes it unlawful for a person under the age of 21 to possess tobacco or vaping products
summary: Makes it unlawful for a person under the age of 21 to possess tobacco or vaping products; provides for a fine not exceeding fifty dollars and/or completion of a tobacco awareness program.

short_summary: Relates to the operating permit program from sources subject to the federal Clean Air Act and power plant emissions and performance standards
summary: Relates to the operating permit program from sources subject to the federal Clean Air Act and power plant emissions and performance standards.

short_summary: Imposes a tax related to executive compensation
summary: Requires that certain companies pay an annual tax if the chief executive receives compensation 100 to 250 times greater than the median pay of all their employees.

short_summary: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents
summary: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents by owner, lessee, proprietor or manager of any hotel, motel, steamboat, tourist cabins, camp, resort, tavern, inn, boarding or lodging house.

short_summary: Enacts the "gender identity respect, dignity and safety act"
summary: Enacts the "gender identity respect, dignity and safety act"; relates to the treatment and placement of incarcerated individuals based upon gender identity; requires that incarcerated individuals in state and local correctional facilities who have a gender identity different from their assigned sex at birth be addressed and have access to commissary items, clothing and other materials that are consistent with the person's gender identity; establishes that incarcerated individuals shall be presumptively placed in a correctional facility with persons of the gender that most closely aligns with such person's self-attested gender identity unless the person opts out of such placement.

short_summary: Relates to temporary orders of protection
summary: Provides that the county probation department may apply for a temporary order of protection as part of the adjustment process.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities to offer a real property tax exemption to certain volunteers who live in such municipality but who serve in a neighboring municipality
summary: Authorizes municipalities to offer a real property tax exemption to certain volunteers who live in that municipality but who serve in neighboring municipalities.

short_summary: Relates to the preservation of regionally significant projects with respect to agencies drawing on funds for new building projects
summary: Expands the law to include the preservation of regionally significant projects with respect to agencies drawing on funds for new building projects.

short_summary: Authorizes police agencies to charge fees for searching, copying, and mailing police agency generated records
summary: Authorizes police agencies to charge fees for searching, copying, and mailing police agency generated records except for where the requesting party is a victim to or was charged with the crime related to such documents.

short_summary: Enacts the integrity in government act
summary: Enacts the integrity in government act; expands the powers and duties of the committee on open government.

short_summary: Sets nutrition standards for restaurant meals targeting children
summary: Sets nutrition standards for restaurant meals targeting children.

short_summary: Provides that services to medical assistance recipients suffering from traumatic brain injuries or qualifying for nursing home diversion and transition services shall be provided outside of managed programs
summary: Provides that services to medical assistance recipients suffering from traumatic brain injuries or qualifying for nursing home diversion and transition services shall be provided outside of managed care programs.

short_summary: Adopts the solemn covenant of the states to award prizes for curing diseases interstate compact
summary: Adopts the solemn covenant of the states to award prizes for curing diseases interstate compact.

short_summary: Relates to requiring financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain
summary: Requires financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of education to make recommendations to the board of regents relating to the adoption of instruction in information relating to blood, bone marrow and organ and tissue donations
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to make recommendations to the board of regents relating to the adoption of instruction in information relating to blood, bone marrow and organ and tissue donations in senior high schools.

short_summary: Relates to the time election day workers must be at poll sites to prepare for the opening of polls
summary: Relates to the time election day workers must be at poll sites to prepare for the opening of polls; one hour instead of one-half hour.

short_summary: Relates to exempting the metropolitan transportation authority from bond issuance charges
summary: Exempts the metropolitan transportation authority from bond issuance charges otherwise required to be paid to the state.

short_summary: Relates to courses of study in consumer awareness and financial education
summary: Requires any school district in the state shall provide, to pupils in grades nine through twelve, one full unit of instruction designed to promote consumer awareness and financial education.

short_summary: Establishes protocols for the handling of stillbirths by healthcare facilities and establishing a stillbirth research database
summary: Establishes protocols for stillbirths and a stillbirth research database.

short_summary: Establishes a senior dental services grant program
summary: Establishes a senior dental services grant program; authorizes the director to establish the program and, upon the availability of appropriations, provide grants to eligible elderly persons who are in need of such services.

short_summary: Requires a public hearing for substantial change in transit authority service by the New York city transit authority
summary: Conditions the institution of any substantial change in surface route or rapid transit route service upon approval by the metropolitan transportation authority and committee on operations of the NYC transit authority and upon public hearing; sets allotted individual and aggregate speaking time during such hearings.

short_summary: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements
summary: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements when such statements are required for an application for public assistance.

short_summary: Directs the public service commission to undertake a study of consumer protections adopted by electric corporations and utilities
summary: Directs the public service commission to undertake a study of consumer protections adopted by electric corporations and utilities; includes reporting on the adequacy of the public service commission's assistance to customers facing disconnection of utility service.

short_summary: Requires gas and electric utilities to make available to landlords upon request information concerning gas and electric charges incurred for residential premises
summary: Requires gas and electric utilities to make available to landlords or lessors, upon request of prospective tenants or lessees, information concerning gas and electric charges incurred for residential rental premises.

short_summary: Exempts certain guardianship motions filed under article 81 of the mental hygiene law from the filing fee required to be paid to the county clerk
summary: Exempts guardianship motions filed under article 81 of the mental hygiene law by a fiduciary, court evaluator, guardian ad litem, court-appointed attorney or by the court examiner from the required filing fee.

short_summary: Requires ATM machines to release ATM cards with EVM chips prior to disbursing cash or a receipt
summary: Requires ATM machines to release ATM cards with EVM chips prior to disbursing cash or a receipt; defines EVM chip and related terms.

short_summary: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions
summary: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions; requires reporting to the legislature.

short_summary: Establishes the new American homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency
summary: Establishes the New American homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency to assist first time homebuyers by imposing flexible documentation guidelines that take into account foreign documentation of income and assets.

short_summary: Requires certain department of motor vehicle forms and applications to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi
summary: Requires department of motor vehicle forms, tests and applications for permits and licenses in a city with a population of one million or more to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi.

short_summary: Relates to the recovery of costs for the response costs and damages to natural resources as a result of the illegal disposal of waste
summary: Relates to the recovery of costs for the response costs and damages to natural resources as a result of the illegal disposal of waste; establishes that expenditures made by the department as a result of the illegal disposal of waste shall be a lien against the person who is responsible for such illegal disposal.

short_summary: Establishes additional notice requirements for site selection for community residential facilities
summary: Provides that a sponsoring agency shall give notice to persons owning property within 500 feet of a proposed site of a community residential facility; requires hearings to include evaluation of alternative sites; gives the municipality additional time to respond; gives municipality sixty rather than forty days after such notice to approve or object to the proposed site.

short_summary: Relates to "The Restoring Accountability and Civil Equity Act"
summary: Relates to filling the void left by the expansive and overbroad applicability of the qualified immunity doctrine that operates as a near absolute shield to civil liability for public officials and ensures that state officials are justly held accountable for violating an individual's rights, privileges and immunities under state law.

short_summary: Relates to certain absentee ballots received by a board of elections that do not bear or display a dated postmark
summary: Relates to certain absentee ballots received by a board of elections that do not bear or display a dated postmark.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing early parole release for inmates where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense
summary: Relates to authorizing early parole release for inmates where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense.

short_summary: Requires the board of elections to provide email notifications to voters whenever they change the location of a polling place
summary: Requires the board of elections to provide email notifications to voters whenever they change the location of a polling place.

short_summary: Relates to motions for resentencing by the people
summary: Allows for motions for resentencing by the people for certain sentences.

short_summary: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot
summary: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot.

short_summary: Repeals section 3 of article 16 relating to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein
summary: Relates to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein.

short_summary: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR
summary: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR.

short_summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for student loan payments
summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for student loan payments.

short_summary: Relates to extending certain filing deadlines for the industrial and commercial abatement program
summary: Relates to extending certain filing deadlines for the industrial and commercial abatement program by authorizing the department of finance to accept certain applications for an additional three months.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit an updated waitlist and placement report to the senate and assembly
summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit an updated waitlist and placement report to the senate and assembly.

short_summary: Relates to the Chisholm Chance Act; repealer
summary: Relates to the Chisholm Chance Act; creates centers of maternal and childcare services in Kings county and Bronx county to coordinate community-based organizations and community health workers to combat the maternal health crisis.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of mental health to issue a review and report regarding certain facilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of mental health to review all proposals by an agency to provide new services at a new facility, expand the size of existing facilities or change the type of services that are provided at facilities within a city of one million or more; provides a definition for the types of facilities subject to such review; directs the commissioner of mental health to issue a report regarding such review.

short_summary: Establishes a gang prevention coordination council
summary: Establishes a gang prevention coordination council.

short_summary: Relates to the organization of the Port Authority
summary: Relates to port authority organization, appearance and notice; establishes the port authority transportation advisory committee.

short_summary: Establishes tenants' right to offset rental payments by the cost of certain emergency repairs
summary: Allows a tenant to offset against future rental payments the cost of certain emergency repairs a landlord is either unwilling or unable to correct within twenty-four hours of notice to the landlord of the need for such emergency repair, provided that the tenant provides landlord with itemized cost accounting of all emergency repairs made.

short_summary: Relates to requiring hospitals to provide forms in Punjabi
summary: Requires hospitals to provide medical forms in Punjabi.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Trooper Lawrence P. Gleason Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates the bridge on the portion of Charley Hill Road which crosses interstate route 87 in the town of Schroon, county of Essex as the "Trooper Lawrence P. Gleason Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the "Lance Cpl. Scott Lee Schultz Memorial Bridge"
summary: Designates a bridge on state Route 22, crossing over interstate eighty-seven in the town of Chesterfield, county of Essex as the "Lance Cpl. Scott Lee Schultz Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Requiring the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
summary: Requires the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

short_summary: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists
summary: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists.

short_summary: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation
summary: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation stating the estimated annual cost to the political subdivision affected and the source of such estimate; provides that bills will be invalidated if the funding source is not provided or the fiscal impact results in an annual net additional cost in excess of $10,000.

short_summary: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance
summary: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance.

short_summary: Relates to the period of limitation for the prosecution of sex offenses committed against children; repealer
summary: Relates to the period of limitation for the prosecution of sex offenses committed against children; such actions may be commenced within 15 years after such child has reached the age of 18.

short_summary: Sets forth notification requirements on abortions performed on minors
summary: Requires parental notice prior to the performance of an abortion upon an unemancipated minor; defines unemancipated minor as person less than eighteen years of age; allows for waiver of such notice in limited instances; establishes circumstances and procedures for proceedings to obtain an order waiving such parental notification.

short_summary: Relates to yellow signals at traffic intersections
summary: Relates to yellow signals at traffic intersections; requires traffic-control signals shall be examined and certified as accurate every two years.

short_summary: Establishes the "Hunger-Free Campus Act"
summary: Provides grants to address food insecurity among students at public institutions for higher education.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a gender balance in the port authority
summary: Relates to establishing a gender balance in the port authority; requires members of the board of commissioners and any officers of the port authority be appointed in a manner which will ensure that women comprise approximately fifty percent of the membership of the board or as officers of the port authority.

short_summary: Provides for training and education for sustainable wage jobs and traditional and nontraditional employment in public assistance employment programs
summary: Relates to training and education for sustainable wage jobs and traditional and non-traditional employment in public assistance employment programs.

short_summary: Provides for the number of female directors required to serve on the board of directors of certain publicly traded corporations
summary: Provides for the number of female directors required to serve on the board of directors of publicly traded domestic and authorized foreign corporations whose principal executive office according to the corporation's Form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission is located within New York state; requires any such corporation to have a minimum of one female director on its board no later than December 31, 2024 and sets higher requirements to be implemented no later than December 31, 2027; requires corporations to report certain compliance information to the secretary of state and the secretary of state to disclose certain related information to the public via its website.

short_summary: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be determination of medical necessity for coverage of a breast ultrasound
summary: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be considered a determination of medical necessity for purposes of coverage of breast ultrasounds as recommended by a provider of mammography services.

short_summary: Grants domestic violence victims the same preference as granted to any other class of applicants
summary: Requires the New York city housing authority, in reviewing applicants, to grant domestic violence victims the same preference as granted to any other class of applicants.

short_summary: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund
summary: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund; provides that a fine not exceeding two thousand dollars may be imposed on real estate appraisers for certain acts or omissions.

short_summary: Expands prison work release program eligibility and participation
summary: Expands prison work release program eligibility and participation.

short_summary: Relates to gender balance in public authorities, industrial development agencies and local development corporations
summary: Relates to gender balance on boards of state and local public authorities; provides that all appointive state and local authorities heretofore or hereafter established by law or resolution shall have recommendations for appointments, or reappointments that are gender balanced.

short_summary: Deems a person who engages in sexual conduct during the period of their probation with his or her supervising probation officer as being incapable of consent
summary: Deems a person who engages in sexual conduct during the period of their probation with his or her supervising probation officer as being incapable of consent.

short_summary: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act
summary: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act; creates statewide nursing recruitment incentive and retention pilot initiatives; establishes the New York state nursing recruitment incentive and retention account.

short_summary: Establishes the Marshall plan for moms interagency task force
summary: Establishes the Marshall plan for moms interagency task force to examine, issue proposals and make recommendations on multiple policy areas to address the disproportionate burden mothers have weathered from the economic fallout of the COVID-19 pandemic.

short_summary: Ensures that the offices of mental health and people with developmental disabilities provide materials to individuals in different languages
summary: Ensures that the office of mental health and the office for people with developmental disabilities provide materials to individuals in English and the top six languages spoken in the state.

short_summary: Authorizes reimbursement for testing for familial dysautonomia, Canavan's disease and Tay-Sachs
summary: Provides that every policy which provides coverage for hospital, surgical or medical care or provides reimbursement for laboratory tests or diagnostic X-rays shall provide coverage for testing of familial dysautonomia, Canavan's disease and Tay-Sachs; provides that in order to maintain the confidentiality of persons tested, receipt of acknowledgement from the testing facility shall be deemed sufficient evidence of testing.

short_summary: Establishes the maximum contaminant level goals (MCLGs) for emerging contaminants
summary: Establishes the maximum contaminant level goals (MCLGs) for emerging contaminants; provides that the commissioner of health shall by regulation establish a maximum contaminant level goal (MCLG) for each emerging contaminant for which such commissioner has established; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for payments for personal protective equipment for home and community based long term care services
summary: Provides for insurance reimbursement for expenses related to the provision of personal protective equipment (PPE) for direct care workers, care recipients and an emergency inventory of a ninety-day supply of PPE.

short_summary: Prohibits the establishment, incorporation, construction, or increase in capacity of for-profit nursing homes
summary: Prohibits the public health and health planning council and the commissioner of health from approving the establishment, incorporation, construction, or increase in capacity of for-profit nursing homes.

short_summary: Relates to orders not to resuscitate; repealer
summary: Changes the controlling law for orders not to resuscitate for residents of mental hygiene facilities.

short_summary: Relates to home care services and to rates of reimbursement under medicaid for home care services
summary: Amends provisions to improve accessibility of home care services, develop and maintain a qualified workforce, develop a comprehensive public education program and approve rates of reimbursement under medicaid for home care services that support the provision of those services.

short_summary: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity
summary: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity.

short_summary: Relates to assessments of the need for home health services
summary: Requires that a copy of every assessment or evaluation conducted to determine a recipient's need for home care assistance shall be promptly provided to the recipient or the recipient's designee.

short_summary: Relates to restricting sex offenders from residing in a community residence for the mentally disabled
summary: Relates to restricting sex offenders from residing in a community residence for the mentally disabled.

short_summary: Enacts the "just energy transition act"
summary: Enacts the "just energy transition act"; requires a study of competitive options to facilitate the phase-out, replacement and redevelopment of New York state's oldest and most-polluting fossil fueled generation facilities and their sites by the year 2030.

short_summary: Prohibits certain sex offenders from residing near school grounds
summary: Prohibits certain sex offenders from residing within 1,350 feet of school grounds, except that in cities having a population of one million or more, no such sex offender may reside within 500 feet of school grounds; establishes a violation thereof shall be a class C felony.

short_summary: Makes the failure of a sex offender to register or verify pursuant to sex offender registration act, or working on an ice cream truck or other mobile food establishment a class D felony
summary: Makes the failure of a sex offender to register or verify pursuant to the provisions of the sex offender registration act or violation of the prohibition on sex offenders being employed on a motor vehicle engaged in the retail sale of frozen desserts or another type of mobile food establishment or pushcart a class D felony.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to permanently terminate the conjugal visit program, commonly known as the family reunion program
summary: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to permanently terminate the conjugal visit program, commonly known as the family reunion program; directs such commissioner to prohibit the establishment of any program designed to provide selected inmates and their families the opportunity to privately meet for an extended period of time.

short_summary: Requires state and county inmates to make medical co-payments
summary: Requires inmates in state and county-owned or operated correctional facilities to make medical co-payments of seven dollars upon receipt of medical treatment; provides that an inmate shall not be refused treatment for lack of ability to pay co-payment charges; directs all moneys collected to be made available for the operation of such correctional facility.

short_summary: Relates to contraband screening at correctional facilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish contraband screening at correctional facilities including canines at the entrances and a third-party secure vendor mail program.

short_summary: Relates to creating a contraband and drug information hotline
summary: Creates a contraband and drug information hotline for state correctional facilities; defines terms.

short_summary: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services
summary: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services; directs the commissioner of health to enact regulations imposing certain standards and restrictions.

short_summary: Relates to applying the Housing Stability and Tenant Protection Act of 2019 to rent calculations and rent records maintenance and destruction
summary: Relates to applying the Housing Stability and Tenant Protection Act of 2019 to rent calculations and rent records maintenance and destruction for all rent stabilized apartments.

short_summary: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against him or her in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance
summary: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against him or her in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance.

short_summary: Relates to sanitation services provided to the New York city housing authority
summary: Relates to sanitation services provided to the New York city housing authority; provides notwithstanding the provisions of section 16-114 of the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city housing authority shall not be required to pay for sanitation services provided by the sanitation department of the city of New York.

short_summary: Enacts the "9/11 notice act"
summary: Enacts the "9/11 notice act"; provides for notice to past and present employees of eligibility for the September eleventh victim compensation fund and the World Trade Center health program.

short_summary: Enacts the "childhood lead poisoning prevention and safe housing act of 2023"
summary: Enacts the "childhood lead poisoning prevention and safe housing act of 2023"; requires the reduction and elimination of lead-based paint hazards; defines terms; provides that properties shall be maintained free of conditions conducive to lead paint poisoning.

short_summary: Prevents fraudulent deed transfers
summary: Relates to preventing fraudulent deed transfers; protects home owners from being misled into transferring their home to mortgage servicers.

short_summary: Establishes representative requirements for district leadership teams and school leadership teams
summary: Requires district leadership teams and school leadership teams to include student representatives.

short_summary: Relates to requiring contracts for a commercial lease
summary: Ensures that commercial tenants receive a lease; defines terms within leases; establishes requirements for commercial lease contracts.

short_summary: Places limits on rent adjustments for major capital improvements
summary: Places limits on rent adjustments for major capital improvements.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by persons with disabilities
summary: Expands eligibility for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by persons with disabilities to include individuals who do not meet the non-medical qualifications for SSDI and SSI but, by reason of the individual's disability, the individual is not able to engage in substantial gainful activity as that term is defined by the federal social security administration.

short_summary: Directs the department of labor to post on its internet website and annually update the names of employers who employ 50 or more employees who receive public assistance
summary: Directs the department of labor to post on its internet website and annually update the names of employers who employ 50 or more employees who receive public assistance.

short_summary: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in cities having a population of one million or more
summary: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in cities having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the "pollution justice act"
summary: Establishes the "pollution justice act"; implements a plan to replace peaker plant electric generating facilities with renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a clean energy outreach and community planning program
summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a clean energy outreach and community planning program.

short_summary: Relates to providing for cage-free egg production
summary: Requires a farm owner or operator that produces shell eggs or liquid eggs for human consumption to confine egg-laying hens in a cage-free housing system.

short_summary: Requires certain business recipients of state aid to perform an annual assessment of the business' social and environmental impact as assessed against a third party standard
summary: Requires certain business recipients of state aid to perform an annual assessment of the business' social and environmental impact as assessed against a third party standard.

short_summary: Relates to assessments of residential cooperative, condominium and rental property
summary: Relates to assessments of residential cooperative, condominium and rental property; defines the term "the assessment which would be placed upon such parcel were the parcel not owned or leased by a cooperative corporation or on a condominium basis".

short_summary: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for SCRIE, DRIE, SCHE and DHE by any increase in the consumer price index
summary: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE), disability rent increase exemption (DRIE), senior citizen homeowners' exemption (SCHE), and disabled homeowners' exemption (DHE) by any increase in the consumer price index (CPI).

short_summary: Requires the board of elections or a bipartisan committee to conduct a risk-limiting audit of voter verifiable audit records
summary: Requires the board of elections or a bipartisan committee appointed by such board to conduct a risk-limiting audit of voter verifiable audit records from voting machines or systems within the jurisdiction of such board.

short_summary: Relates to creating the Neighborhood Small Business Rent Increase Exemption
summary: Relates to creating the Neighborhood Small Business Rent Increase Exemption; provides a tax abatement for limiting rent increases on small businesses in a city of one million or more persons.

short_summary: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area
summary: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area; provides for a rebate program; provides for a process for application and certification.

short_summary: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"
summary: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"; regulates the submission and determinations of applications for ownership of cooperative apartments.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state infrastructure development bank; appropriation
summary: Establishes the New York state infrastructure development bank within the department of financial services; makes a $250,000,000 appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Requires certain watercraft, aircraft, and trains to be zero emissions; requires the study of certain clean energy sources; requires certain monetary incentives for clean energy vehicles
summary: Requires certain watercraft, aircrafts, and trains to use clean energy, including ensuring such vehicles are zero-emissions; requires NYSERDA to study zero-emission commercial vehicles, the use of renewable energy in publicly funded airports, and the use of sustainable aviation fuel; requires NYSERDA to administer a grant program to flying schools and clubs that install charging infrastructure.

short_summary: Establishes the citywide leadership team; appropriation
summary: Establishes the citywide leadership team to ensure that parents' and students' voices are represented in all education decision-making, ensure education policies considered or implemented are conducive to promoting student achievement and enhancing the overall quality of education for students attending public schools in the city of New York, and include all stakeholders at all stages of the decision-making process.

short_summary: Relates to discovery restrictions for photographs of minors depicting sexual or other intimate parts
summary: Relates to discovery restrictions for photographs of minors depicting sexual or other intimate parts; provides such photographs shall be subject to in camera review and certain other restrictions.

short_summary: Relates to the metropolitan commuter transportation authority establishing and implementing a vegetation management policy
summary: Relates to the metropolitan commuter transportation authority establishing and implementing a policy for responsible management of vegetation and other activities that impact neighboring properties in order to preserve the safety and efficiency of commuter rail operations by implementing guidelines for removal and management policies.

short_summary: Requires a lighted lamp on the front and rear of every bicycle and a red reflector on the rear
summary: Requires a lighted lamp on the front and rear of every bicycle and a red reflector securely attached to the rear in a size and type as approved by the commissioner.

short_summary: Relates to certain time periods and prospective applicants in adoption proceedings; repealer
summary: Changes the time period for extrajudicial consent; lengthens the time period for payments to a birth mother prior to giving birth; expands the types of unlawful denials of prospective applicants in adoption proceedings; repeals provisions relating to an individual's religious faith when determining placement.

short_summary: Establishes a no fare program for certain police officers on the the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company and the New York City Transit Authority
summary: Requires the Long Island Rail Road, the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company, and the New York City Transit Authority establish a no fare program for the transportation of certain active duty, uniform police officers.

short_summary: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment
summary: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment.

short_summary: Relates to revisions to charter schools
summary: Relates to revisions to charter schools that would expand the grades served at such charter schools.

short_summary: Relates to service credit for unpaid maternity leave for a Westchester county correction officer or deputy commissioner
summary: Relates to service credit for unpaid maternity leave for a Westchester county correction officer or deputy commissioner.

short_summary: Requires that notice of initial determination for unemployment benefits be provided
summary: Requires that notice of initial determinations for unemployment benefits be provided to claimants within 30 days of such claimant furnishing all necessary documentation, and if the commissioner is unable to issue a determination within such time frame they shall inform the claimant of the new estimated time frame for the issuance of a determination.

short_summary: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements
summary: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements; sets such time at one hundred and twenty days.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the possession of certain 50 caliber firearms
summary: Relates to prohibiting the possession of certain 50 caliber firearms; directs the division of state police to embark on a program whereby persons currently in lawful possession of such weapons may be reimbursed for the fair market value thereof upon turning in such weapons to a designated officer.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state service corps, relates to the New York state service corps - health services track; repealer
summary: Establishes the New York state service corps; relates to the New York state service corps - health services track.

short_summary: Relates to rent regulation and tenant protection; repealer
summary: Establishes the legal regulated rent for the combination of two or more vacant apartments; defines permanently vacated; relates to exemptions from rent stabilization on the basis of substantial rehabilitation; relates to public hearings by the city rent agency (Part A); relates to clearly defining the scope of the fraud exception to the pre-HSTPA four-year rule for calculating rents (Part B); relates to the failure of owners to file rent registration statements and the enforcement powers of the commissioner of housing and community renewal (Part C).

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or manufacture of certain single-use plastic water bottles and single-use plastic beverage containers
summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale or manufacture of single-use plastic water bottles not comprised of one hundred percent recycled material; prohibits the sale of single-use plastic beverage containers comprised of less than seventy-five percent recycled materials; establishes penalties for violations; requires food service establishments to provide customers with tap water, beverages and leftovers in reusable beverage containers provided by a customer.

short_summary: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district
summary: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district.

short_summary: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution and sale of children's foam mats containing formamide
summary: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution and sale of children's foam mats containing formamide.

short_summary: Relates to the closure of nursing homes
summary: Relates to the closure of nursing homes.

short_summary: Enacts the "housing affordability, resiliency, and energy efficiency investment act of 2023"
summary: Enacts the "housing affordability, resiliency, and energy efficiency investment act"; relates to the modernization of affordable housing financing authorities that authorize financing for the construction and rehabilitation of affordable housing.

short_summary: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes
summary: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes using monies paid into the code enforcement account.

short_summary: Provides protections against illegal voter purging
summary: Provides protections against illegal voter purging.

short_summary: Requires vine trimming for the maintenance of utility poles
summary: Directs the public service commission to promulgate rules and regulations requiring vine trimming, in addition to other maintenance procedures, for the maintenance of utility poles by the utility company or cable television company that owns such utility pole where such vine growth is likely to disrupt safe and reliable service.

short_summary: Exempts innovative and alternative septic systems from sales and use taxes
summary: Exempts innovative and alternative septic systems that provide for enhanced treatment technologies from sales and use taxes.

short_summary: Relates to additional apportionment of building aid for certain projects
summary: Relates to additional apportionment of building aid for certain projects; defines an eligible school construction project as one that is entirely funded from capital outlays and has a total project cost of two hundred fifty thousand dollars or less.

short_summary: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers
summary: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers.

short_summary: Relates to the protection and promotion of the mental health of the residents of New York state
summary: Requires parity in the mental and physical health treatment of the residents of New York state; provides that both mental and physical health "will be matters of public concern and provision therefor shall be made by the state and by such of its subdivisions".

short_summary: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
summary: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within thirty but no less than seven days before a planned price increase takes effect; requires utility providers to provide contact information and a mechanism to cancel service completely.

short_summary: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state
summary: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state after July 1, 2028.

short_summary: Directs the creation of a document giving certain notice to parents and guardians of school age students who are diagnosed with a life-threatening medical condition or a certain medical condition
summary: Enacts the "Shepherd Patterson law"; requires a physician who treats a minor patient with a medical condition that may cause a disability to provide certain educational information to such patient's parents or guardians indicating such minor is entitled to a free and appropriate public education as defined under section five hundred four of the federal rehabilitation act of nineteen hundred seventy-three; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage
summary: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage.

short_summary: Provides that an affirmation of a health care practitioner may be served or filed in an action in lieu of and with same force and effect as an affidavit
summary: Provides that an affirmation of a health care practitioner may be served or filed in an action in lieu of and with same force and effect as an affidavit (changes the current reference in existing provisions from "physician, osteopath or dentist" to "health care practitioner").

short_summary: Relates to establishing the online consumer protection act
summary: Relates to establishing the online consumer protection act; defines terms; provides that an advertising network shall post clear and conspicuous notice on the home page of its own website about its privacy policy and its data collection and use practices related to its advertising delivery activities; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the state board of elections to fit registration forms to standard paper size
summary: Requires the state board of elections to fit registration forms to 8.5 x 11 inches standard paper size.

short_summary: Provides for the registration of professional nurse anesthetist
summary: Relates to the certification of registered nurse anesthetists; provides that for such certification an applicant shall file an application, be licensed as a registered professional nurse, have satisfactorily completed educational preparation for the administration of anesthesia by an accredited entity and pay a fee.

short_summary: Provides a deduction against adjusted gross income for dues paid by small businesses to chambers of commerce
summary: Provides a deduction against adjusted gross income for dues paid by small businesses to chambers of commerce.

short_summary: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state
summary: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state; requires short-term rental hosts and short-term rental hosting platforms inform nearby property owners when nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders are staying in the unit.

short_summary: Provides for coordination between the department of health and the state long-term care ombudsman regarding residential health care facilities
summary: Provides for coordination between the department of health and the state long-term care ombudsman regarding residential health care facilities, including such facilities' compliance with state and federal law, and histories of complaints.

short_summary: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging
summary: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging to address the needs of older adults regarding the workplace.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel
summary: Creates the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel, to be responsible for expanding pharmaceutical insurance coverage.

short_summary: Relates to creating a nursing home resident quality and safety study
summary: Relates to creating a nursing home resident quality and safety study to study the implementation of a globally recognized frailty index score methodology in nursing homes in New York state.

short_summary: Establishes the Office for an Age-Friendly New York
