summary: Establishes the office for an age-friendly New York; appoints a director of such office to assist and advise New York state agencies in developing age-friendly policies for older New Yorkers.

short_summary: Relates to certain requirements regarding the purchase and sale of a catalytic converter
summary: Requires sellers of catalytic converters to provide certain information to potential buyers; requires buyers to maintain records of such purchases; makes any violations a class A misdemeanor; imposes a fine of up to $5,000

short_summary: Relates to eliminating the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers; repealer
summary: Relates to eliminating the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers.

short_summary: Authorizes George Amendola Tier II status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes George Amendola Tier II status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

short_summary: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study pertaining to a proposed expansion of the Long Island Motor Parkway trail
summary: Authorizes the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation and the office of mental health to conduct a study pertaining to a proposed expansion of the Long Island Motor Parkway trail.

short_summary: Requires certain information to be filed with the department of public service
summary: Requires certain information to be filed with the department of public service.

short_summary: Relates to review and approval of all new facilities
summary: Requires the New York city planning commission to regulate and restrict the new location or continued operation of a social services facility.

short_summary: Relates to applications for the approval and construction of energy-related projects
summary: Relates to applications for the approval and construction of energy-related projects of the New York Power Authority by the public authorities control board.

short_summary: Relates to the payment of restitution by registered and unregistered repair shops
summary: Establishes that if financial loss has been made and a registrant or unregistered repair shop fails to comply with an order to pay restitution, the commissioner shall, by order, increase the amount of the penalty assessed.

short_summary: Relates to requiring local disaster preparedness plans to include a public education component as part of disaster prevention
summary: Requires local disaster preparedness plans to include a public education component as part of disaster prevention, which shall be widely disseminated and shall take into consideration the linguistic and cultural characteristics of the inhabitants.

short_summary: Relates to contractual relationships with minority and women-owned businesses
summary: Relates to contractual relationships with minority-owned and women-owned businesses.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a computerized database containing information relating to the storage and handling of hazardous substances and emergency responses to the release of hazardous substances
summary: Establishes a computerized database containing information relating to the storage and handling of hazardous substances and emergency responses to the release of hazardous substances.

short_summary: Relates to awards of certain contracts to small businesses or businesses certified under article 15-A of the executive law
summary: Relates to awards of certain contracts to small businesses or businesses certified under article 15-A of the executive law.

short_summary: Relates to the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment
summary: Requires the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment to the metropolitan transportation authority capital program review board.

short_summary: Authorizes the secretary of state to appoint a person from the utility intervention unit within the consumer protection division to serve on the state energy planning board
summary: Authorizes the secretary of state to appoint a person from the utility intervention unit within the consumer protection division to serve on the state energy planning board.

short_summary: Requires the mortgage bill of rights pamphlet on residential mortgages
summary: Requires the development of a mortgage bill of rights pamphlet on residential mortgages; provides such pamphlet shall be posted and printed in the 8 most popularly spoken languages in the state.

short_summary: Relates to on site superintendent or maintenance supervisor at city of NY housing authority facilities and repeals section 27-2056 of the NY city administrative code relating to exemption to the housing authority
summary: Relates to establishing an on site supervisor or maintenance supervisor at city of New York housing authority facilities, including janitorial services to maintain workable locks on doors and repeals provisions relating to exemption to the housing authority.

short_summary: Provides for memorial land facilities
summary: Provides a permit for a memorial lands facility.

short_summary: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences
summary: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences; requires board of inspectors to deliver and help complete applications for absentee ballots to residents of such facilities.

short_summary: Creates a commission to plan for the celebration in the year 2025 of New York state's canal system and the bicentennial of the opening of the Erie Canal
summary: Creates a commission to plan for the celebration in the year 2025 of New York state's canal system and the bicentennial of the opening of the Erie Canal.

short_summary: Establishes a retired employee health insurance premium reserve fund for the town of Saranac
summary: Establishes a retired employee health insurance premium reserve fund for the town of Saranac to cover retired town employee health insurance premiums, to stabilize the tax rate, and to ensure transparency for the taxpayers and elected officials.

short_summary: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state
summary: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state; provides such small businesses include independently or privately-owned cafes, restaurants, eateries, bars, pubs, breweries, distilleries, orchards, food trucks, retail stores, farm stands, hotels, or motels.

short_summary: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes
summary: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes; requires the department of health to give significant weight to labor supply shortages in particular regions during any declared statewide disaster emergency.

short_summary: Amends the constitution to convey land to Debar Pond Institute Inc. in order to facilitate the preservation of historic buildings
summary: Amends the constitution to convey land to Debar Pond Institute, Inc. in order to facilitate the preservation of historic buildings.

short_summary: Provides for interest to be recovered upon a sum awarded in certain circumstances
summary: Relates to interest to be recovered upon a sum awarded in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Requires pharmacies to stock emergency contraception
summary: Requires pharmacies to keep in stock emergency contraception.

short_summary: Establishes a temporary state assistance fund to provide legal counsel in certain bankruptcy proceedings and providing for the administration thereof
summary: Establishes a temporary state assistance fund to provide legal counsel for bankruptcy proceedings under chapter eleven of the federal bankruptcy code; provides for the administration thereof.

short_summary: Relates to aquatic plant growth control districts
summary: Allows aquatic plant growth control districts to also control certain invasive species.

short_summary: Relates to segregated confinement; repealer
summary: Relates to segregated confinement; provides that certain incarcerated individuals shall not be placed in a residential rehabilitation unit; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for licensure of school psychology practitioners
summary: Provides for the licensure of school psychology practitioners; authorizes the use of the title "licensed school psychology practitioner" to licensed or exempt individuals; defines practice of licensed school psychology practitioners; sets forth requirements for professional licensure (including educational attainment, experience, exam and fee); provides for issuance of limited permits under specified circumstances; identifies exempt persons.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the War Dog Memorial Highway
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the village of Herkimer, county of Herkimer, as the "War Dog Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to insurance coverage for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome
summary: Requires health insurance policies to cover costs for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome rehabilitation treatment.

short_summary: Relates to special districts for ambulance services and to volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing
summary: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services; requires a report on issues of volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing.

short_summary: Exempts any land located in the state forest preserve in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from certain provisions of law relating to prohibiting firearms in public parks
summary: Exempts any land located in the state forest preserve in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from certain provisions of law relating to prohibiting firearms in public parks.

short_summary: Increases the minimum compensation to be paid to election day workers within the city of New York
summary: Increases the minimum compensation to be paid to election day workers to three hundred dollars and election coordinators to four hundred dollars within the city of New York.

short_summary: Relates to proceedings with respect to designating and nominating petitions
summary: Relates to proceedings with respect to designating and nominating petitions.

short_summary: Eliminates the requirements for publication of detailed election notices within the city of New York
summary: Eliminates the requirements for publication of detailed election notices within the city of New York.

short_summary: Provides for voter requests for an absentee ballot from the board of elections by telephone
summary: Provides for voter requests for an absentee ballot from the board of elections by telephone.

short_summary: Relates to conviction sealing for eligible youth
summary: Provides that eligible youth who were not given youthful offender status by the court be eligible for conviction sealing.

short_summary: Relates to conviction sealing for certain applicants
summary: Provides that certain applicants be eligible for conviction sealing.

short_summary: Clarifies that individuals have the ability to vote by absentee ballot where their maximum sentence of imprisonment has expired
summary: Clarifies that individuals have the ability to vote by absentee ballot in certain elections where their maximum sentence of imprisonment has expired.

short_summary: Changes the time period for the annual national change of address system check for registered voters
summary: Changes the time period for the annual national change of address system check for registered voters to January.

short_summary: Relates to eliminating rent for homeless shelters in N.Y. city; repealer
summary: Relates to eliminating rent for homeless shelters in cities having a population of one million or more; provides that a homeless individual or family applying for or receiving temporary housing assistance shall not be required to pay room and board or contribute any earned or unearned income, available benefits or resources to eliminate their need for temporary housing assistance or as a condition to receive temporary housing assistance from such provider.

short_summary: Establishes a model racial equity, social justice, and implicit bias training program
summary: Establishes a model racial equity, social justice, and implicit bias training program.

short_summary: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into subdivisions
summary: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into two separate subdivisions.

short_summary: Makes provisions with respect to student awards, loans and tuition assistance programs
summary: Requires the higher education services corporation to make a determination of financial eligibility of a student for financial aid, awards and loans within 60 days from the day of the receipt of the financial aid application; where the higher education services corporation fails to make a timely determination the applicant shall be deemed eligible for such aid for the semester for which the application was made; allows for a 30-day extension if notice is given to the educational institution within the initial 60-day period.

short_summary: Relates to the term "income" for purposes of the school tax relief exemption
summary: Relates to the term "income" for purposes of the school tax relief exemption; adds 401(k) and 403(b) accounts to the list of eligible income deductions when determining Enhanced STAR eligibility.

short_summary: Relates to the powers of the commissioner of health in administering the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program
summary: Requires the commissioner of health to create an electronic online system for registration into the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program.

short_summary: Requires all goods, except food, sold at retail in state parks, recreational facilities and historic sites to be produced in the United States
summary: Requires all goods, except food, sold at retail in state parks, recreational facilities and historic sites to be produced in the United States.

short_summary: Relates to requiring a service center for independent living to be located in the county of Ontario
summary: Relates to requiring a service center for independent living to be located in the county of Ontario.

short_summary: Permits schools to allow fire departments to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
summary: Permits the principal of any high school to allow any local fire department, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of fire department junior recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

short_summary: Relates to setting the rate of credit per kilowatt hour for farm waste generating equipment customer-generators, which includes the anaerobic digestion of agricultural waste
summary: Relates to setting the rate of credit per kilowatt hour for farm waste generating equipment customer-generators, which includes the anaerobic digestion of agricultural waste; sets a rate for anaerobic digestion of agricultural waste to at least 12 cents per kilowatt hour.

short_summary: Requires ad hoc members to be appointed in order to constitute a quorum
summary: Requires ad hoc members to be appointed in order to constitute a quorum on the board of electric generating facilities; includes ad hoc members as part of the board.

short_summary: Establishes a reproductive health services training and education grant program
summary: Establishes a reproductive health services training and education grant program to ensure health care providers receive adequate training in abortion care.

short_summary: Establishes the empire state performance commission
summary: Establishes the empire state performance commission in the executive department for the purpose of designing and advising the governor and the legislature on the implementation of a performance-management and performance-budgeting system.

short_summary: Relates to the retention of state records; repealer
summary: Relates to the retention of state records; repeals provisions relating to rules and regulations governing access to state legislative records; repeals provisions relating to executive records; repeals provisions relating to information confidentially disclosed by applicants.

short_summary: Enacts the tobacco product waste reduction act
summary: Enacts the tobacco product waste reduction act prohibiting the sale or offering for sale of cigarettes utilizing single-use filters and single-use electronic cigarettes.

short_summary: Relates to use of monies from the community health care revolving capital fund
summary: Permits the use of monies from the community health care revolving capital fund to enable participating borrowers to operate a financially and operationally sustainable practice.

short_summary: Relates to requiring training to reduce abusive conduct and bullying in the workplace
summary: Requires training to reduce abusive conduct and bullying in the workplace as part of a written workplace violence prevention program.

short_summary: Grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court
summary: Authorizes courts to hold evidentiary hearings for a temporary order of protection in certain circumstances; grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court in certain circumstances.

short_summary: Establishes a commission on hosting the olympic games
summary: Establishes a commission on Lake Placid and a partner municipality hosting the olympic games.

short_summary: Relates to special districts for ambulance services
summary: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services in any county, city, town or village located within the Adirondack park.

short_summary: Enacts into law major components of legislation which are necessary to implement the New York healthy incentive program
summary: Establishes the New York healthy incentive program (Part A); automates SNAP and the New York healthy incentive program (Part B); establishes the New York healthy incentive program outreach program (Part C).

short_summary: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance
summary: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance such that assistance will be equal to one hundred percent of the applicable market-related payment rate established by the department.

short_summary: Enables prosecutors to access orders of protection issued in association with sealed prior domestic violence cases
summary: Enables prosecutors to access orders of protection issued in association with sealed prior domestic violence cases if the offender commits a new domestic violence offense.

short_summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2026 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour
summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2026 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour; eliminates the exemption from provisions, relating to the use of portable electronic devices in motor vehicles, granted to commercial motor vehicles, police, firefighters and emergency vehicle operators.

short_summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year
summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips.

short_summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal
summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal.

short_summary: Defines a real estate team as two or more persons associated with the same real estate brokerage who hold themselves out or operate as a team
summary: Defines a real estate team as two or more persons associated with the same real estate brokerage who hold themselves out or operate as a team.

short_summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more
summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to electronic citation fees
summary: Relates to electronic citation fees or the process of transmitting traffic, misdemeanor, municipal ordinance, conservation, or other citations and law enforcement data via electronic means to a county clerk.

short_summary: Relates to price gouging
summary: Relates to price gouging; defines unconscionably excessive price for the purposes of prohibiting price gouging during abnormal disruption of the market.

short_summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license
summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

short_summary: Requires investigation of school district personnel involved with the care, custody or supervision of a child
summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

short_summary: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

short_summary: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission
summary: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission.

short_summary: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
summary: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

short_summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole or sentenced to probation may not enter public, association or free libraries
summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

short_summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle
summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle.

short_summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

short_summary: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals
summary: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals to include serious physical injuries or the use of a weapon.

short_summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation
summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.

short_summary: Elevates promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child and promoting a sexual performance by a child to be class B felonies
summary: Elevates promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child and promoting a sexual performance by a child to be class B felonies; prohibits pleading to a lesser offense after indictment for either such offense.

short_summary: Requires the county seat in Wayne county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
summary: Requires the county seat in Wayne county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to make recommendations relating to increasing reimbursement rates
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to make recommendations relating to increasing certain ambulatory patient group reimbursement rates and certain reimbursement rates for patient health care services provided by physicians in rural and underserved areas.

short_summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to divide the state into three autonomous regions; repealer
summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment to divide the state into three autonomous regions; the New Amsterdam Region, the New York Region and the Montauk Region; provides regional governors and regional legislators; provides only for a state sales tax; divides various departments and agencies; provides for separate court systems and prison systems.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital
summary: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital.

short_summary: Relates to establishing reporting duties of law enforcement agencies with respect to police misconduct allegations and outcomes
summary: Relates to establishing reporting duties of law enforcement agencies with respect to police misconduct allegations and outcomes; requires the division of criminal justice services to establish and maintain on its official website a public, searchable database of alleged infractions and police misconduct complaints.

short_summary: Relates to the ownership of a professional sports team by a local or state government
summary: Relates to the ownership of a professional sports team by a local or state government.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of robots by police agencies
summary: Prohibits the use of weaponized robots, non-weaponized robots which may potentially cause injury, or robots being used for surveillance purposes by police agencies.

short_summary: Requires the New York city housing authority to provide adequate and reliable internet service for all housing authority residents
summary: Requires the New York city housing authority to provide adequate and reliable internet service for all housing authority residents.

short_summary: Requires individuals and corporations to obtain a sound permit from a municipality in certain situations
summary: Requires individuals and corporations to obtain a sound permit from a municipality in certain situations.

short_summary: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants
summary: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants; authorizes covered individuals to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.

short_summary: Increases salaries for foster care direct care workers; appropriation
summary: Increases salaries for foster care direct care workers; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Establishes the universal basic income for transition-age youth pilot program
summary: Establishes the universal basic income for transition-age youth pilot program to provide regular monthly payments to state residents who age out of foster care.

short_summary: Requires mental health services for incarcerated individuals with mental health issues related to the trauma of incarceration
summary: Requires mental health services for incarcerated individuals with mental health issues related to the trauma of incarceration upon reentry and reintegration into society upon release.

short_summary: Relates to the confidentiality and expungement of records in juvenile delinquency cases in the family court
summary: Relates to the confidentiality and expungement of records in juvenile delinquency cases in the family court; requires certain records to be expunged automatically.

short_summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report on staffing at state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of such office
summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report to assess the staffing and other issues causing the continued displacement of individuals with developmental disabilities from various state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of the office for people with developmental disabilities.

short_summary: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state and extends the length of such re-certification
summary: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state; extends the length of such re-certification from five years to seven years.

short_summary: Relates to aid payable to low spending high need school districts
summary: Provides for supplemental aid payable to low spending high need school districts in the 2024-2025 school year and thereafter.

short_summary: Relates to the duties of the independent developmental disability ombudsman program
summary: Directs the independent developmental disability ombudsman program to establish a service delivery structure based in New York state that includes a toll-free telephone hotline, an interactive website, and availability of in-person, telephone and email access to ombudsman program staff or volunteers; to provide assistance for navigating and completing processes; to assist individuals in filing and preparing appeals; to assist individuals with any problems encountered; and to educate individuals on their rights and responsibilities with respect to access to services provided by the office for people with developmental disabilities and care coordination provided by health homes serving individuals with developmental disabilities or services provided by other providers.

short_summary: Names the wood frog the official amphibian of the state of New York
summary: Names the wood frog the official amphibian of the state of New York.

short_summary: Establishes the office of wastewater surveillance and creates a grant program; appropriation
summary: Establishes the office of wastewater surveillance; creates a grant program; provides such office shall monitor wastewater testing and analyze wastewater test results; provides the grant program shall assist labs in conducting wastewater testing; establishes an advisory council which shall provide advice on: best practices for wastewater sampling, testing and test results analysis; the creation of standards and systems of reporting on wastewater surveillance; the creation of a dashboard; integrate wastewater surveillance for COVID-19 into the office of wastewater surveillance; and any topics deemed essential by the commissioner of health.

short_summary: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays
summary: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays.

short_summary: Requires public institutions and buildings to be equipped with opioid antagonists
summary: Requires public institutions and buildings to be equipped with opioid antagonists; directs the commissioner of general services to promulgate regulations to address the appropriate number of opioid antagonists for such buildings based on the size or occupancy of the buildings, the training of personnel and use of opioid antagonists, and any other matter deemed necessary.

short_summary: Establishes the zero emission industrial trucks grant program
summary: Establishes the zero-emission industrial trucks grant program to be administered by NYSERDA, to encourage the purchase and lease of zero-emission industrial trucks, class I to III.

short_summary: Requires state agencies to conform any of their websites to the most current version of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines adopted by the World Wide Web Consortium for accessibility
summary: Requires state agencies to conform any of their websites to the most current version of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines adopted by the World Wide Web Consortium for accessibility; requires the office of information technology services to provide a report to the governor and legislature every two years.

short_summary: Relates to requiring certain fees be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund
summary: Relates to requiring application fees for the issuance of operating certificates be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund.

short_summary: Provides that persons with a disability shall be eligible to receive a fishing license for a reduced fee
summary: Provides that persons with a disability shall be eligible to receive a fishing license for five dollars.

short_summary: Includes Lyme disease and other tick-borne diseases as occupational diseases for purposes of workers' compensation
summary: Includes Lyme disease and other tick-borne diseases as occupational diseases for purposes of workers' compensation; clarifies that disability includes disability caused by Lyme disease or other tick-borne diseases; requires insurance coverage of long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne diseases.

short_summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to create a staffing plan for workforce emergencies when experiencing staffing shortages
summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to create a staffing plan for workforce emergencies when experiencing staffing shortages.

short_summary: Relates to a study of the number of children in foster care who have a developmental disability
summary: Relates to a study of the number of children in foster care who have a developmental disability; provides such study shall include, but shall not be limited to, the following: assessing the demographics of the children in foster care with a developmental disability, including, but not limited to, their county of residence, age, race and gender identity, and determining whether the placement of such individuals in foster care was voluntary or court ordered; evaluating the current guidelines and regulations used to oversee the placement and treatment of children with a developmental disability; and analyzing the extent to which such age-appropriate children are prepared for a transition from foster care to an independent living situation.

short_summary: Permits certain previous criminal history information provided to satisfy criminal background checks for certain employees
summary: Permits that when the division of criminal justice services has provided criminal history information within the previous twelve months to any state agency for certain individuals, such information can be used to satisfy the required criminal history check for such employee without having to re-request such information.

short_summary: Relates to first responders coming into contact with saliva by spitting, throwing, tossing, or expelling from or by an individual
summary: Relates to first responders, including correction officers, coming into contact with saliva by spitting, throwing, tossing, or expelling from or by an individual.

short_summary: Imposes a tax on out-of-state transfers, dividends, payments, and loans by certain accident and health insurance companies and health maintenance organizations
summary: Imposes a tax on out-of-state transfers, dividends, payments, and loans by certain accident and health insurance companies and health maintenance organizations to be deposited in the New York state agency trust fund, distressed provider assistance account.

short_summary: Provides equal retirement benefits for certain persons who have been appointed to certain titles in the department of corrections and community supervision
summary: Provides equal retirement benefits for persons who have been appointed to the title of correction lieutenant, correction captain, deputy assistant superintendent and superintendent in the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Eliminates state sales and compensating use tax on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels and authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes; establishes various exemptions from sales and use tax
summary: Eliminates state sales and compensating use taxes on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels; authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes at the local level; establishes various exemptions from New York's sales and use tax; provides for a sales tax exemption for housekeeping supplies and for ready-to-eat foods.

short_summary: Establishes procurement goals for New York state food products purchased by state agencies
summary: Establishes procurement goals that certain percentages of all food and food products purchased by state agencies shall be New York state food products.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the "small contractors relief act"; appropriation
summary: Establishes the small contractors relief act; creates the New York small contractor safety group, inc. pilot program; appropriates money therefor.

short_summary: Implements oral fluid tests
summary: Implements oral fluid tests which tests a person's saliva for the presence of cannabis.

short_summary: Requires the state to handle the income verification process for the purposes of the senior citizen tax exemption
summary: Shifts the conducting of the income verification process for the purposes of the senior citizen tax exemption from municipalities to the department of taxation and finance.

short_summary: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer seizure rescue medication in schools
summary: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer certain seizure rescue medication in schools, on school grounds and at school events; provides that such medicine may be left with a school health official to be used as needed.

short_summary: Directs the department of civil service to study certain airport-related titles
summary: Directs the department of civil service to conduct a study on airport-related titles including airports whose hiring procedures are subject to provisions of the civil service law.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on rate adequacy of orthotics and prosthetics
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on the rates of reimbursement made through the New York state Medicaid durable medical equipment, orthotics, prosthetics and supplies program for rate adequacy and patient access.

short_summary: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
summary: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

short_summary: Relates to when the department of transportation may require surveys for fiber optics
summary: Provides that the department of transportation shall not require a survey from any fiber optic utility for permitting or continuance of the use and occupancy of a state right of way for the purposes of installing, modifying, relocating, repairing, operating, or maintaining fiber optic facilities, under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Establishes a tax credit for direct support professionals and direct care workers
summary: Establishes a tax credit for individuals who serve or are employed as a direct support professional, or direct care worker, up to five thousand dollars for taxpayers who make less than fifty thousand dollars and phased out for individuals who make over one hundred thousand dollars.

short_summary: Relates to procedures relating to driving while ability impaired by drugs
summary: Alters the definition of "drug" in the vehicle and traffic law to include any substance or combination of substances that impair, to any extent, physical or mental abilities; defines impairment and intoxication; provides that refusal to submit to a breath test and/or oral/bodily fluid test shall be a traffic infraction; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspend taxes on home heating fuels; appropriation
summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop, implement, administer and operate a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspends certain taxes on home heating fuels; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Requires an independent firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services
summary: Requires the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to work with an independent firm to allow such firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services.

short_summary: Establishes a pilot program to create an assistance hotline for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and complex behavioral needs
summary: Establishes a pilot program to create an assistance hotline for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and complex behavioral needs.

short_summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to provide an annual report on the New York access to home programs
summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to provide an annual report on the New York access to home programs.

short_summary: Relates to the reimbursement of local services provided to persons with a disability
summary: Relates to the reimbursement of local services provided to persons with a disability; provides for retroactive reimbursement if local services were furnished prior to approval.

short_summary: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program
summary: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program to eliminate older mobile and manufactured homes and replace them with new manufactured, modular or site-built homes; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to develop and maintain a community residence opportunities waitlist
summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to develop and maintain a community residence opportunities waitlist which include the names and contact information of all individuals seeking placement in a community residence.

short_summary: Authorizes school districts that provide transition services to allow the delivery of such transition services, including integrated employment, during school hours
summary: Authorizes school districts that provide transition services to allow the delivery of such transition services, including integrated employment, during school hours.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service
summary: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service; increases the earnings limitation from $35,000 to $50,000 in 2024 and thereafter.

short_summary: Relates to vision screening in public schools
summary: Requires vision screening in public schools using examination devices and testing methods as may be authorized in the regulations of the commissioner of education, including but not limited to, the Snellen Eye Test Chart and automated vision screening devices.

short_summary: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers
summary: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers that is distributed based on managed care providers' performance in meeting quality objectives.

short_summary: Makes the provisions of Kendra's law permanent
summary: Amends Kendra's law, in relation to making the provisions thereof permanent.

short_summary: Relates to developing a database for missing domestic animals
summary: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to develop and maintain a searchable database of lost and found domestic animals.

short_summary: Relates to 1,4-Dioxane levels
summary: Relates to 1,4-Dioxane levels; requires the department of health and department of environmental conservation to establish a maximum contaminant level of 0.35 parts per billion for the presence of 1,4-Dioxane in public supplies of potable water, ground water and runoff water from a wastewater treatment plant or water supply treatment plant.

short_summary: Relates to allowing judges more options for when to impose bail or commit the principal to the custody of the sheriff
summary: Allows judges more options for when to impose bail or commit the principal to the custody of the sheriff for burglary in the second degree, robbery in the second degree and crimes which resulted in death or serious physical injury.

short_summary: Repeals the portion of the criminal procedure law dealing with discovery and the ability for a defendant to request access to a crime scene or other relevant premises
summary: Repeals provisions dealing with discovery and the ability for a defendant to request access to a crime scene or other relevant premises.

short_summary: Relates to criminal possession and criminal sale of a controlled substance
summary: Provides that possession or sale of a stimulant weighing 15 grams or more shall be punishable as a class A-I felony.

short_summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention
summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; adds class B felonies under article two hundred twenty of the penal law as qualifying offenses.

short_summary: Relates to assault on a straphanger
summary: Provides that it shall be a class C felony to subject another person to physical contact that results in such person falling onto subway tracks.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state fast food franchisor accountability act
summary: Establishes the New York state fast food franchisor accountability act to hold fast food restaurants jointly liable for violations of certain laws, orders, rules and regulations relating to employment and worker safety.

short_summary: Requires the New York city department of buildings to confirm that there are no tenants living at certain properties prior to approving or issuing permits for demolition or substantial alteration
summary: Requires the New York city department of buildings to confirm that there are no tenants living at certain properties prior to approving or issuing permits for the demolition or the substantial alteration or renovation of such properties.

short_summary: Relates to requiring orders of custody to state whether law enforcement is authorized to remove a child or children
summary: Requires orders of custody to state whether law enforcement is authorized to remove a child or children in order to comply with and enforce such orders.

short_summary: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act
summary: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act; relates to making clergy members required reporters of child abuse or mistreatment.

short_summary: Relates to the prohibition on certain databases and registries
summary: Provides that no state or local agency, or any agent thereof, may use any funds, facilities, property, equipment or personnel of such agency to investigate, enforce or provide assistance in the investigation or enforcement of any federal program requiring registration of individuals, or maintaining a database of individuals, on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, religion or national or ethnic origin.

short_summary: Relates to undisclosed self-dealing
summary: Prohibits conduct in an official capacity in connection with the award of a public contract or public grant that is intended to confer an undisclosed benefit on a public servant, a person with whom a public servant has a business or other financial relationship.

short_summary: Relates to the offenses of rape in the first, second and third degrees; repealer
summary: Relates to the offenses of rape in the first, second and third degrees.

short_summary: Allows consumers the right to request from businesses the categories of personal information a business has sold or disclosed to third parties
summary: Grants a consumer a right to request a business to disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal information that it collects about the consumer, the categories of sources from which that information is collected, the business purposes for collecting or selling the information, and the categories of third parties with which the information is shared.

short_summary: Restricts the disclosure of personal information by businesses
summary: Restricts the disclosure of personal information by businesses; provides that a business that retains a customer's personal information shall make available to the customer free of charge access to, or copies of, all of the customer's personal information retained by the business.

short_summary: Relates to the unlawful use of a New York driver's license or identification card
summary: Relates to the unlawful use of a New York driver's license or identification card.

short_summary: Relates to automatic license plate readers
summary: Relates to automatic license plate readers (ALPRs) and mandatory postings of policies and annual reporting requirements.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to provide for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to conduct a legal review for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park, in Putnam and Westchester counties to a new name.

short_summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to promote participation in Nourish New York program for black indigenous and people of color site controlled farms
summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to promote participation in Nourish New York, including financial and technical support, for black, indigenous and people of color site controlled farms.

short_summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to facilitate and expand an initiative to promote opportunities for farm ownership to farmers who are black, indigenous and people of color
summary: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to facilitate and expand an initiative to promote opportunities for farm ownership to farmers who are black, indigenous and people of color; requires the department to submit an annual report to the governor and the legislature regarding such initiative.

short_summary: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles
summary: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles in New York city.

short_summary: Establishes "Kyra's Law"
summary: Requires the court to consider a child's health and safety when making a decision regarding child custody and visitation; directs the court to review certain information as it relates to allegations of child abuse, domestic violence and child safety; requires the court to appoint an attorney to represent the child when credible allegations of serious risk to the child's safety have been made.

short_summary: Establishes the crimes of sex trafficking of a vulnerable person and predatory sex trafficking
summary: Establishes the crimes of sex trafficking of a vulnerable person and predatory sex trafficking when a person intentionally advances or profits from prostitution of a vulnerable person.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of infant loungers and restricts the use of such infant loungers in certain settings
summary: Prohibits the sale of infant loungers; restricts the use of such infant loungers in certain settings; defines an infant lounger to mean a padded pillow or cushioned product, sometimes with a lower indented region, used to support or hug an infant as it lies face up, primarily intended and marketed for the support of an infant while awake.

short_summary: Relates to the prohibition of the sale of infant inclined sleepers and the restriction of the use of such inclined sleepers in certain settings
summary: Prohibits the sale of infant inclined sleepers; restricts the use of such inclined sleepers in certain settings.

short_summary: Authorizes the transfer of pregnant and postpartum incarcerated individuals to residential treatment facilities
summary: Authorizes the transfer of pregnant and postpartum incarcerated individuals to residential treatment facilities; requires annual reporting on the number of such incarcerated individuals transferred.

short_summary: Provides information regarding medicare part B coverage to certain individuals
summary: Provides information regarding termination of medicare part B coverage for the duration of incarceration to individuals committed to the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Relates to certificates of relief from disabilities
summary: Relates to certificates of relief from disabilities issued by courts or by the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Provides for due process procedures for certain persons who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care
summary: Provides for due process procedures for persons who currently are placed in New York state education department approved out-of-state residential schools pursuant to the education law and the federal individuals with disabilities education act who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care.

short_summary: Requires fare parity for paratransit services operated by certain authorities
summary: Requires fares for paratransit services providing public transportation for eligible individuals with disabilities or health conditions that prevent them from using public buses and subways for some or all of their trips, to be made available at the same fares for individuals with disabilities or health conditions who are able to utilize public buses and subways.

short_summary: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor
summary: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor.

short_summary: Enacts the "nonpublic dignity for all students act"
summary: Prohibits discrimination against and harassment or bullying of students by employees or students on private, religious or denominational school property or at a school function; provides immunity from civil liability for a person making a good faith report of discrimination, harassment or bullying to authorities.

short_summary: Requires the public school curriculum for children in kindergarten through grade twelve to include a minimum of two hours per week instruction in civics lessons
summary: Requires the public school curriculum for children in kindergarten through grade twelve to include a minimum of two hours per week instruction in civics lessons.

short_summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
summary: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

short_summary: Relates to the relocation of a charter school
summary: Relates to the relocation of a charter school.

short_summary: Updates school concussion management and response protocols and increases concussion data collection and reporting
summary: Relates to updating school concussion management and response protocols; increases concussion data collection and reporting.

short_summary: Prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes
summary: Prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes.

short_summary: Relates to prohibitions on single-use plastic straws and stirrers in restaurants
summary: Requires that restaurants only provide single-use plastic straws to customers when explicitly requested by the customer; prohibits single-use plastic stirrers.

short_summary: Directs the NY power authority to oversee mandated energy reduction efforts in state and public authority owned and managed buildings
summary: Directs the NY power authority to oversee mandated energy reduction efforts in state and public authority owned and managed buildings.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the energy performance benchmarking program
summary: Relates to establishing the energy performance benchmarking program.

short_summary: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act"
summary: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act" relating to minimum wages applicable to home care aides; provides for a minimum wage of 150% of the applicable statewide or regional minimum wage.

short_summary: Provides minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters
summary: Provides minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters.

short_summary: Relates to hunting and hunting licenses; repealer
summary: Relates to hunting and hunting licenses.

short_summary: Establishes an unemployment bridge program; establishes digital ad tax act; appropriation
summary: Establishes an unemployment bridge program and an unemployment bridge program fund to provide wage replacement to workers that do not qualify for unemployment insurance or other worker wage assistance programs and who have lost a major source of income due to lost work (Part A); establishes the "Digital Ad Tax Act (DATA)" creating a tax on digital advertising services (Part B).

short_summary: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services
summary: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services.

short_summary: Relates to human trafficking awareness and training for public transportation employees
summary: Relates to human trafficking awareness and training for public transit employees; mandates displaying human trafficking resource materials created by the state public transportation safety board and the department of transportation in all public transit modes of transportation.

short_summary: Allows persons participating in certain formal ceremonies to possess a firearm, rifle or shotgun
summary: Allows persons participating in certain formal ceremonies to possess a firearm, rifle or shotgun, provided that such person has received prior approval from the municipality or other appropriate entity.

short_summary: Relates to housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities
summary: Establishes a curriculum and task force to provide housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

short_summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit a detailed report of proposed savings and investment initiatives within the executive budget
summary: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit a detailed report of proposed savings and investment initiatives within the executive budget.

short_summary: Relates to the authority of the welfare inspector general to conduct investigations
summary: Relates to the authority of the welfare inspector general to conduct investigations.

short_summary: Directs the office of fire prevention and control to conduct a study which evaluates the minimum recommended qualifications to becoming a volunteer firefighter
summary: Directs the office of fire prevention and control to conduct a study, which evaluates the minimum recommended qualifications to becoming a volunteer firefighter; requires such office to provide a report to the governor, temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly within twelve months of the effective date of this act.

short_summary: Relates to allowing the names of peace officers slain in the line of duty in the state of New York to be added to the police officers memorial
summary: Relates to authorizing the division of criminal justice services to add to the police officers memorial the names of peace officers of the state of New York who are slain in the line of duty.

short_summary: Requires appointees of the minority leader of the senate and the minority leader of the assembly to be included in all legislatively enacted workgroups, task forces, commissions, and committees
summary: Requires proportionally equivalent appointees of both the majority and minority houses of the legislature in all legislatively enacted workgroups, task forces, commissions, councils, advisory boards, committees and any other legislatively enacted and appointed groups or workgroups; requires that the number of appointees by the legislature shall be proportionally equivalent to the number of appointees by the governor.

short_summary: Establishes the disaster-related latent damage recovery grant program
summary: Establishes the disaster-related latent damage recovery grant program to repair latent damage to public infrastructure, including publicly-owned roads, bridges, drainage and flood mitigation systems, electrical and mechanical systems and communication systems, and any ancillary infrastructure necessary for the safe operation of the components thereof, where such damage was the result of a natural disaster.

short_summary: Enacts the "American made flag act" to require that American flags purchased for use by the state government be made in the United States
summary: Enacts the "American made flag act" to require that American flags purchased for use by the state government be made in the United States.

short_summary: Relates to the prevention, response and recovery of flooding on Lake Ontario and the St. Lawrence River
summary: Relates to the Lake Ontario-St. Lawrence River flood prevention, response, recovery and mitigation task force; establishes reporting and public hearing requirements for the Lake Ontario-St. Lawrence River flood prevention, response, recovery and mitigation task force.

short_summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

short_summary: Relating to selectively cutting timber
summary: Relates to selectively cutting timber and exclusion of current best management practices from regulated activities.

short_summary: Incorporates art and music into prekindergarten programs
summary: Incorporates art and music into prekindergarten programs.

short_summary: Prohibits waste transfer stations from being located near public housing projects
summary: Prohibits marine solid waste transfer stations from being located near public housing projects.

short_summary: Requires nursing homes that maintain a trust fund or funds into which residents' money is deposited to conduct quarterly audits and to report the findings of such audits to the commissioner of public health
summary: Requires nursing homes that maintain a trust fund or funds into which residents' money is deposited to conduct quarterly audits and to report the findings of such audits to the commissioner of public health.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of residential automatic pesticide misting systems
summary: Prohibits the use of residential automatic pesticide misting systems.

short_summary: Provides for universal newborn nurse home visiting services; requires health insurance coverage for universal newborn nurse home visiting services
summary: Provides for universal newborn nurse home visiting services; requires health insurance coverage for universal newborn nurse home visiting services; authorizes the department of health to apply for certain waivers; directs the superintendent of financial services to require an insurer, health carrier or health benefit plan to notify enrollees annually of universal newborn nurse home visiting services.

short_summary: Provides for implementation of sexual harassment prevention and response policies and procedures by colleges and universities
summary: Relates to implementation of sexual harassment prevention and response policies and procedures by colleges and universities.

short_summary: Establishes a committee to study the feasibility of funding a kindergarten to college/career ready program and a universal college savings account
summary: Establishes a committee to study the feasibility of funding a kindergarten to college/career ready program and a universal college savings account.

short_summary: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for child care providers
summary: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for child care providers that have earned an undergraduate or graduate degree from a two or four year college or university in the state.

short_summary: Requires insurance coverage for the cost of donated breast milk
summary: Requires insurance coverage for the cost of donated breast milk.

short_summary: Provides for insurance and medicaid coverage for standard fertility preservation services provided due to iatrogenic infertility
summary: Provides that Medicaid and policies issued in this state that provide coverage for hospital, surgical or medical care shall provide coverage for standard fertility preservation services when a necessary cancer treatment may directly or indirectly cause iatrogenic infertility to a covered person.

short_summary: Requires exterior cages for air conditioners
summary: Requires exterior cages for air conditioners installed in any multiple dwelling.

short_summary: Provides for diaper changing accommodations in certain buildings
summary: Requires diaper changing accommodations be made available to all persons regardless of gender in certain buildings.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a uterine fibroids awareness and education program
summary: Establishes a uterine fibroids awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and the elevated risk for minority women.

short_summary: Requires information on resources for domestic violence and human trafficking victims to be posted in public restrooms
summary: Requires information on resources for domestic violence and human trafficking victims to be posted in public restrooms and other areas of public buildings which shall be deemed appropriate by the office and task force on human trafficking.

short_summary: Establishes the statewide fibroid study program and statewide fibroid study program fund
summary: Establishes the statewide fibroid study program to study fibroids, the treatment of fibroids, potential barriers to the access of treatment for fibroids, and differences in symptoms and access to treatment for women of color.

short_summary: Establishes an emergency insulin program
summary: Establishes an emergency insulin program and corresponding emergency insulin program trust fund to facilitate emergency access to analog insulins.

short_summary: Allows for reimbursement of transportation costs for emergency care without prior authorization by the social services official
summary: Allows for reimbursement of transportation costs for emergency care without prior authorization by the social services official including emergency medical transportation by an ambulance service certified under article 30 of the public health law; authorizes the commissioner of health to establish a reimbursement methodology to ensure providers are reimbursed.

short_summary: Requires state and municipal agencies to purchase compostable single use tableware
summary: Relates to requiring state and municipal agencies to purchase compostable single use tableware; requires state and municipal agencies purchasing single use tableware to purchase single use tableware made from material that is compostable unless there is no affordable compostable product available.

short_summary: Requires the collection of certain demographic information by certain state agencies, boards and commissions
summary: Requires the collection of certain demographic information about the sexual orientation and gender identity or expression of residents by certain state agencies, boards and commissions.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting facial recognition technology to be used in connection with an officer camera
summary: Prohibits facial recognition technology to be used in connection with an officer camera used by both local and state police including the storage of biometric data.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting health insurers from requiring prior authorization for pre-exposure prophylaxis used to prevent HIV infection
summary: Prohibits health insurers, health care plans and HMOs from requiring prior authorization for pre-exposure prophylaxis used to prevent HIV infection.

short_summary: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals
summary: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals; prohibits a health care professional from engaging, assisting or planning the torture or improper treatment of an incarcerated individual; requires health care professionals to report torture and improper treatment.

short_summary: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises
summary: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises.

short_summary: Relates to factors for consideration for applications for a license to operate a bank or storage facility
summary: Adds additional factors to be considered by the department of health for applications for a license to operate a bank or storage facility.

short_summary: Provides for including uncles, aunts, nephews and nieces in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members
summary: Provides for including uncles, aunts, nephews, and nieces in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members to succeed in certain cases to the rights of certain tenants.

short_summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens
summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens; provides for taxpayer gifts for tick borne illness research, detection and education; establishes the tick borne illness research, detection and education fund.

short_summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services
summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage based upon gender indication on insurance claim forms
summary: Relates to gender indication on insurance claim forms; provides policies shall not exclude coverage if gender indication is different from sex assigned at birth or gender otherwise recorded.

short_summary: Creates a private right of action for the breach of a consumer's identifying information
summary: Relates to creating a private right of action for the breach of a consumer's identifying information such as their social security number, driver's license number, bank account number, credit or debit card number, personal identification number, automated or electronic signature, unique biometric data, account passwords or other information that can be used to access an individual's financial accounts or to obtain goods and services.

short_summary: Relates to defining a victim of a sexual offense
summary: Adds to the definition of a victim of a sexual offense by including a victim of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_summary: Enacts the "community financial services access and modernization act of 2024"
summary: Enacts the "community financial services access and modernization act"; modernizes existing statute to reflect the full scope of financial services available at neighborhood "check cashing" establishments; provides for a comprehensive regulatory framework for the delivery of the expanded financial services currently being offered.

short_summary: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times
summary: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times and to store such kits in an accessible location and to make such kits available for use by any person who enters the premises of the business.

short_summary: Relates to criminal mischief in the third degree and criminal mischief in the second degree
summary: Relates to criminal mischief in the third degree and criminal mischief in the second degree.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of a sex offense
summary: Relates to the definition of a sex offense; provides that if luring a child or the attempt thereto requires an actor to register as a sex offender, then the act is determined to be a sex offense.

short_summary: Relates to mercantile establishments and the defense of lawful detention
summary: Relates to mercantile establishments and the defense of lawful detention; sets requirements that the release from detention shall not be conditioned on signing of any documents or agreements; provides if anything is signed a copy must be provided to the individual or their parent or guardian.

short_summary: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court
summary: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court.

short_summary: Relates to the expiration and repeal of regulations limiting the engines of school vehicles to remain idling while parked or standing on school grounds
summary: Relates to the expiration and repeal of regulations limiting the engines of school vehicles to remain idling while parked or standing on school grounds.

short_summary: Requires dialysis center disaster preparedness plans
summary: Requires facilities offering dialysis services to have an alternate generated power source for use during a general power outage or disaster emergency; provides exemptions.

short_summary: Establishes the universal child care act; repealer; appropriation
summary: Establishes the universal child care act to provide for the establishment and funding of universal child care in the state of New York; relates to the effectiveness of the child care availability taskforce; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to land banks
summary: Authorizes land banks to lend money, to make grants and take and hold real and personal property as security for the payment of funds so loaned or for the performance and enforcement of grant agreements.

short_summary: Relates to access to reports of child abuse and maltreatment by criminal justice agencies; repealer
summary: Relates to access to reports of child abuse and maltreatment by criminal justice agencies; requires the office of children and family services to establish a centralized database of reports of child abuse and maltreatment for criminal justice agencies to access in the performance of their duties; defines criminal justice agencies.

short_summary: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies
summary: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies; includes the department of health, office for people with developmental disabilities and the office of mental health.

short_summary: Requires the installation of smoke detectors in common places of certain multiple dwellings
summary: Requires the installation of smoke detectors in common places of certain multiple dwellings.

short_summary: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history
summary: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history; establishes time frames for public agencies to respond to such applications; requires public agencies to report information regarding granting licenses annually.

short_summary: Establishes the housing for an equitable reentry and opportunity (HERO) act
summary: Establishes the housing for an equitable reentry and opportunity (HERO) act to prohibit housing discrimination on the basis of criminal legal system involvement; defines criminal legal system involvement.

short_summary: Extends certain provisions relating to a partial tax abatement for residential real property held in the cooperative or condominium form
summary: Extends certain provisions relating to a partial tax abatement for residential real property held in the cooperative or condominium form of ownership in a city having a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for certain programs
summary: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for division of minority and women's business development programs by changing the basis from number of employees to annual receipts.

short_summary: Relates to adjournments for right to counsel
