summary: Provides that in any jurisdiction in which a party is eligible under local law for free legal counsel, if such party has in good faith attempted to secure such counsel and is unable to obtain counsel through no fault of their own, the court shall adjourn the trial of the issue for consecutive periods of not less than fourteen days each until the party is able to secure counsel.

short_summary: Extends the statute of limitations for claims resulting from unlawful discriminatory practices to three years
summary: Extends the statute of limitations for claims resulting from unlawful discriminatory practices to three years.

short_summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable New York state taxpayers to electronically file income tax returns free of charge
summary: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable each New York state taxpayer to prepare and electronically file his or her federal and state income tax returns free of charge.

short_summary: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
summary: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting certain conditions or preconditions of employment
summary: Prohibits employers from requiring certain conditions or preconditions of employment.

short_summary: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators, and establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions
summary: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators; establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions; requires disclosure of information by certain arbitrators.

short_summary: Relates to the disqualification of a surviving spouse
summary: Provides for the disqualification of a surviving spouse if the marriage is annulled or voided after the death of the spouse.

short_summary: Repeals section 470 of the judiciary law relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state
summary: Repeals provisions relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state.

short_summary: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job
summary: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job.

short_summary: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law
summary: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee
summary: Prohibits agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee; allows for a cause of action against employers who engage in such agreements.

short_summary: Relates to actions for illegal and improper practices of commercial towing companies
summary: Authorizes a lien against personal and real property of the owner of a commercial towing company for illegal and improper practices; creates personal liability for members of an LLC and certain corporate shareholders.

short_summary: Creates additional remedies for unlawful discharge, penalty, or discrimination due to the exercise of an employee's right to be absent from employment for jury duty
summary: Creates, in addition to the existing sanction of criminal contempt of court, the remedies of labor law civil penalties and employee's right to bring civil action for unlawful discharge, penalty or discrimination on account of the exercise by an employee of a juror's right to be absent from employment by reason of jury service.

short_summary: Allows photographs of one's self and one's own ballot while voting
summary: Allows photographs of one's self and one's own ballot while voting.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of a sexually violent offender and sex offense as applied to out-of-state offenders
summary: Relates to the definition of a sexually violent offender and sex offense as applied to out-of-state offenders.

short_summary: Relates to discharge planning to assist incarcerated individuals in obtaining housing before release to community supervision
summary: Relates to the department of correction and community supervision's role with respect to discharge planning to assist incarcerated individuals in obtaining housing before release to community supervision.

short_summary: Relates to the "driver's license access and privacy act"; repealer
summary: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to issue standard drivers' licenses; restricts what information can be retained and given out on those applying or holding standard drivers' licenses.

short_summary: Prohibits disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions
summary: Prohibits the disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to requiring affirmative consent for the disclosure of contact information of witnesses to a defendant
summary: Requires affirmative consent for the disclosure of contact information of witnesses to a defendant; provides that denial of such consent shall only be for good cause as determined by the court.

short_summary: Authorizes the state board of parole to require a violent felony offender to serve his or her maximum term, if release would pose an imminent threat to society
summary: Authorizes the state board of parole to require a violent felony offender to serve his or her maximum term, if, by clear and convincing evidence, release would pose an imminent threat to society; authorizes the withholding of good behavior allowances of violent felony offenders by the state board of parole upon such a finding.

short_summary: Increases the penalty for robbery of property from a bank; makes the crime a class C felony
summary: Increases the penalty for robbery of property from a bank; makes the crime a class C felony.

short_summary: Relates to protections against anti-Semitism in the human rights law and the hate crimes statute
summary: Provides protections against anti-Semitism in the human rights law and the hate crimes statute.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the offense of aggravated rape and criminal sentencing for defendants convicted of certain sexual offenses
summary: Establishes the offense of aggravated rape; provides criminal sentencing mandates for defendants convicted of certain sexual offenses.

short_summary: Relates to disclosure related to appointments by the governor and senate
summary: Requires that the governor, temporary president of the senate and senate minority leader jointly develop a questionnaire to be filled out and completed by any applicant for appointment to an office by the governor by and with the advice and consent of the senate; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires sex offenders who fail to register or verify twice or more to wear a location-tracking device
summary: Requires sex offenders who fail to register or verify their registration on two or more occasions to wear a location-tracking device while on probation, parole, conditional release or post-release supervision; establishes failure to wear such device shall be a class D felony and grounds for revocation of parole and probation.

short_summary: Relates to prohibitions on fur products
summary: Relates to prohibitions on fur products; prohibits the manufacture, sale, display for sale, trade, giving, donating, or otherwise distributing of a fur product by any means in the state beginning twenty-four months after this act becomes a law.

short_summary: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions
summary: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions; removes requirement of service during a time of war for additional points on civil service examinations for veterans.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the New York child data privacy and protection act
summary: Enacts the New York child data privacy protection act to prevent the exploitation of children's data; requires data controllers to assess the impact of its products on children for review by the bureau of internet and technology; bans certain data collection and targeted advertising.

short_summary: Clarifies provisions regarding health care professional applications and terminations
summary: Clarifies provisions regarding health care professional applications and terminations.

short_summary: Relates to health care agents and proxies, decisions under the family health care decisions act and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate
summary: Makes technical, minor and coordinating amendments regarding health care agents and proxies, decisions under the family health care decisions act, and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate.

short_summary: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day
summary: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day.

short_summary: Relates to children's non-regulated camps
summary: Requires children's non-regulated camps to register annually with the department of health; imposes civil penalties for violations.

short_summary: Restricts certain practices from remote supervision by licensed pharmacists
summary: Prohibits drugs from being dispensed unless a licensed pharmacist has verified that: the package contains the drug to be dispensed, whether the drug is packaged in a child-resistant container, whether a stock container is open and the quantity of the drug to be dispensed.

short_summary: Relates to declaring the goal of the state of New York to source reduce, reuse, recycle, or compost no less than eighty-five percent of the solid waste generated by the year 2033
summary: Relates to declaring the goal of the state of New York to source reduce, reuse, recycle, or compost no less than eighty-five percent of the solid waste generated by the year 2033.

short_summary: Restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides
summary: Restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides unless the purchaser is licensed as a certified commercial pesticide applicator, certified residential pesticide applicator, or certified commercial pesticide technician in the state of New York or the purchaser is licensed in an equivalent manner in a jurisdiction with reciprocity with the state of New York, as determined by the department; restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides in multi-unit dwellings.

short_summary: Authorizes certain inmates serving an indeterminate sentence to receive good time allowances of up to 1/3 of their minimum sentences
summary: Authorizes incarcerated individual's serving indeterminate sentences of imprisonment for offenses involving controlled substances and marihuana to receive good time allowances against the minimum terms of their sentences not to exceed one-third of the minimum term imposed; provides that drug offenders can receive good behavior allowances for progress in assigned treatment programs and willing performance of duties.

short_summary: Repeals certain provisions of law relating to the use of certain body imaging scanning equipment at local correctional facilities
summary: Relates to the use of certain body imaging scanning equipment at local correctional facilities.

short_summary: Relates to county committees meeting no earlier than one day after the June primary is certified
summary: Requires that county committees meet no earlier than one day after the June primary is certified.

short_summary: Provides that any review of apportionment by the legislature shall be brought in the supreme court of Albany county
summary: Provides that any review of apportionment by the legislature shall be brought in the supreme court of Albany county.

short_summary: Authorizes the attorney general to investigate and take action against in response to actions improvident or prejudicial to the certain interests of the public or occupants of nursing homes
summary: Authorizes the attorney general to investigate and take action against in response to actions improvident or prejudicial to the interests of the public or occupants of nursing homes that are under the supervision of the commissioner of public health.

short_summary: Relates to the Emergency Housing Stability and Displacement Prevention Act
summary: Prevents evictions during the COVID-19 covered period.

short_summary: Relates to the establishment of the water-based fire protection licensure act
summary: Establishes the water-based fire protection licensure act, setting forth licensure requirements for contractors engaged in the business of the layout, installing, repairing, inspecting, testing, or maintaining of water-based fire protection systems and components.

short_summary: Prohibits sex offenders who are on parole or probation, or conditionally discharged from being upon the premises of any facility providing child day care
summary: Prohibits sex offenders who are on parole or probation, or conditionally discharged from being upon or within 1,000 feet of the premises of any facility providing child day care, while any person under 18 years of age is present.

short_summary: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis
summary: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting contract provisions that waive certain substantive and procedural rights
summary: Relates to prohibiting contract provisions that waive certain substantive and procedural rights relating to a claim of discrimination, non-payment of wages or benefits, retaliation, harassment or violation of public policy in employment.

short_summary: Relates to the provision of legal representation to certain persons in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings
summary: Requires counties and/or cities to establish a plan for providing legal counsel to persons who are defendants or respondents in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings and who are financially unable to obtain counsel; defines eligible person as one whose gross individual income is not in excess of one hundred twenty-five percent of the federal income official poverty line; requires the state to match dollar for dollar the amount counties appropriate for their plans.

short_summary: Repeals provision of county law relating to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system
summary: Relates to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention team program
summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.

short_summary: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products
summary: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products.

short_summary: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city
summary: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city.

short_summary: Establishes in the city of New York a bicycle lane safety program to enforce certain restrictions on the use of bicycle lanes by means of bicycle lane photo devices
summary: Establishes in the city of New York a bicycle lane safety program to enforce certain restrictions on the use of protected bicycle lanes by means of bicycle lane photo devices.

short_summary: Relates to participation by LGBT, disability and veteran-owned businesses in state contracts
summary: Relates to participation by LGBT, disability and veteran-owned businesses in state contracts.

short_summary: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations
summary: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursement for donor human breast milk
summary: Establishes protocol for financial reimbursement for donor human breast milk.

short_summary: Establishes a supplemental burial allowance for certain first responders
summary: Establishes a supplemental burial allowance for certain first responders.

short_summary: Permits Gold Star families to use any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state free of charge
summary: Permits Gold Star families to use any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state free of charge; defines "veteran".

short_summary: Prohibits certain persons from receiving compensation for legal fees, consulting, or other work performed for an industrial development agency or an economic assistance corporation
summary: Prohibits certain persons from receiving compensation for legal fees, consulting, or other work performed for an industrial development agency, an economic assistance corporation or state or local authority.

short_summary: Relates to tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws
summary: Prohibits tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws.

short_summary: Enacts the New York emergency responder act
summary: Enacts the New York emergency responder act limiting the liability of certain emergency responders.

short_summary: Replaces the terms "mentally retarded", "mental retardation" and variants thereof with "developmentally disabled" and "developmental disability"
summary: Replaces the terms "mentally retarded", "mental retardation" and variants thereof with "developmentally disabled" and "developmental disability".

short_summary: Relates to reporting voting rates for parole commissioners
summary: Requires that annual reports include the voting rates for parole commissioners for persons appearing before them for release.

short_summary: Relates to establishing new fee rates for large estates
summary: Relates to establishing new fee rates for large estates; raises the fee rate for estates with a value over $5,000,000 to $10,000.

short_summary: Authorizes daily visitation at all general confinement correctional facilities
summary: Authorizes visitation at all general confinement correctional facilities seven days a week.

short_summary: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in nursing homes
summary: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in facilities or discrete units within facilities that provide long term nursing or medical services.

short_summary: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated people
summary: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated people, to provide incarcerated people opportunities for personal contact with relatives, friends, clergy, volunteers and other persons to promote better institutional adjustment and better community adjustment upon release.

short_summary: Requires TNC passengers to acknowledge certain legal notices
summary: Requires TNC passengers, prior to using a digital network, to acknowledge a legal notice that states: "IF YOU CLICK HERE, YOU GIVE UP YOUR RIGHT TO SUE US IN COURT".

short_summary: Creates a residential condominium owner bill of rights
summary: Creates a residential condominium owner's bill of rights that includes the right to transparency, the right to timely decisions, voting rights, the right to notice, and the right against extraordinary expenses.

short_summary: Ensures language assistance services by state agencies and requires state agencies to maintain records and to submit an annual report on language services
summary: Ensures language assistance services by state agencies; requires state agencies to maintain records of the primary language spoken by any individual seeking such assistance; requires state agency to submit an annual report on language services.

short_summary: Creates the New York state commission on sex offender supervision and management
summary: Creates the New York state commission on sex offender supervision and management; provides that such commission shall consist of thirteen members; requires the commission to make a report of its findings.

short_summary: Prohibits transportation network companies from including mandatory arbitration clauses in user agreements for certain offenses
summary: Relates to prohibiting transportation network companies from including mandatory arbitration clauses in user agreements for certain offenses including assault and sex offenses; provides all user agreements issued with such clause shall be considered null and void and new agreements without such clause shall be issued within 14 days of the effective date of this legislation.

short_summary: Allows persons who are permanently disabled and require the use of a wheelchair to have free use of any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state
summary: Allows certain persons who are permanently disabled and require the use of a wheelchair to have free use of any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state.

short_summary: Prevents fees from being charged for the issuance of certain license plates
summary: Prevents fees from being charged for the issuance of license plates where the vehicle has legible plates.

short_summary: Creates a moratorium on the annexation of agricultural land by localities for an industrial use
summary: Creates a moratorium on the annexation of agricultural land by certain localities for an industrial use for one year.

short_summary: Relates to tax billing addresses
summary: Provides that local assessor offices no longer must add a code to notification forms for creation of termination of a mortgage escrow account.

short_summary: Relates to emissions of toxic air contaminants
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to promulgate air quality standards for emissions of certain toxic air contaminants.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York Stock Act" prohibiting public officers and employees from using nonpublic information derived from their official positions for personal benefit
summary: Enacts the "New York Stock Act"; prohibits public officers and employees from using nonpublic information derived from their official positions for personal benefit.

short_summary: Establishes authority for early childcare savings accounts
summary: Establishes authority for early childcare savings accounts to provide tax benefits for savings for qualified childcare services; provides for the functions and powers of the comptroller; provides for the program requirements and limitations.

short_summary: Provides for certain limited direct interstate shipments of wine for off-premises consumption
summary: Provides for certain limited direct interstate shipments by retail licensees to sell wine for off-premises consumption.

short_summary: Makes certain exceptions for violations pertaining to certain mufflers and exhaust systems
summary: Excepts violations pertaining to mufflers and exhaust systems for cars, motorcycle exhaust devices without internal baffles and motorcycle exhaust devices that are intentionally designed to allow for the internal baffling to be fully or partially removed or interchangeable from having a summons not issued or having a summons dismissed if the violation is corrected.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations related to the timeframe for increases to patients' bills
summary: Requires the commissioner of health, in conjunction with the superintendent of financial services, to promulgate rules and regulations requiring that any increase in a bill from a hospital or health system or health care provider shall be sent to a patient no later than ninety days after the original bill was paid in full by such patient and good cause be shown for such increase, unless such increase is the result of any action by such patient.

short_summary: Relates to standards for the erection of tents or membrane structures
summary: Relates to standards for the erection of tents or membrane structures; requires standards permitting restaurants and establishments licensed to sell alcoholic beverages at retail for consumption on the premises to erect such structures for more than 180 days provided the local municipality permits such use.

short_summary: Establishes the office of flooding prevention and mitigation
summary: Establishes the office of flooding prevention and mitigation to manage and coordinate the work of task forces, commissions, and other bodies and programs tasked with examining issues related to flooding, to review and assess best practices and make recommendations regarding flood prevention and mitigation, and to assist municipalities in developing strategies and policies to combat flooding.

short_summary: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals with a disability
summary: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals with a disability with special emphasis on the techniques needed to improve interactions with individuals that are blind or deaf or hard of hearing; provides such training shall be created in consultation with the justice center for the protection of people with special needs.

short_summary: Relates to persons designated as auxiliary officers
summary: Relates to persons designated as auxiliary officers; provides certain powers to auxiliary officers; imposes training requirements.

short_summary: Creates the "disaster preparedness and emergency planning act"; local sales tax exemption for emergency preparedness supplies
summary: Creates the "disaster preparedness and emergency planning act"; authorizes a local sales tax exemption for emergency preparedness supplies; requires the division of homeland security and emergency services, in conjunction with the department of taxation and finance, to establish, promote and publish on the web a list of eligible items; requires the division of homeland security and emergency services to create public service announcements regarding such exemption and make available to municipalities for promotion purposes.

short_summary: Relates to citizen review panels
summary: Relates to citizen review panels being established in each region of the state in accordance with section two hundred thirty of the economic development law.

short_summary: Relates to the reporting of extreme risk protection orders
summary: Requires extreme risk protection orders to be reported to the statewide computerized registry of orders of protection and certain warrants of arrest.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the age required to use ultraviolet radiation devices
summary: Increases the age required to use ultraviolet radiation devices to twenty-one years of age.

short_summary: Relates to providing residential and day services to certain individuals with a developmental disability
summary: Provides residential and day services to certain individuals with a developmental disability where such services are provided by a certified integrated residential community program.

short_summary: Restricts automatic renewal of contracts for electronic and life safety alarm services
summary: Restricts automatic renewal of contracts for electronic and life safety alarm services; makes such automatic renewal provisions unenforceable unless: the automatic renewal offer terms or continuous service offer terms are presented to the consumer in a clear and conspicuous manner; the business or person furnishing the electronic and life safety alarm service obtains the consumer's affirmative consent; and such renewal or continuous service offer provides an acknowledgment of the contract cancellation policy, and information regarding how to cancel in a manner that is capable of being retained by the consumer.

short_summary: Requires patient transporters to meet certain minimum requirements
summary: Requires patient transporters to complete a state accredited basic life support course, in which knowledge and skills in cardiopulmonary resuscitation using automated external defibrillators and relieving airway obstructions is taught.

short_summary: Limits the naming of municipalities and subdivisions thereof
summary: Prohibits the name of municipalities and subdivisions thereof to include the word swastika.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Goshen to impose a hotel and motel tax
summary: Authorizes the town of Goshen to impose a hotel and motel tax of up to five percent; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Relates to the availability of buprenorphine in opioid treatment programs
summary: Requires facilities that provide treatment for substance use disorders to have at least one practitioner qualified to administer or prescribe buprenorphine to individuals in their care with substance use disorders related to opioids.

short_summary: Refers individuals to appropriate service providers for substance use disorders
summary: Refers individuals to appropriate service providers that are able to provide services to such individual within seventy-two hours for substance use disorders.

short_summary: Creates a certified recovery residences task force
summary: Creates a certified recovery residences task force to establish best practice guidelines for certified recovery living residences that illustrate the most appropriate and effective environment for persons recovering from a chemical dependency.

short_summary: Requires practitioners who administer naloxone or another overdose reversal agent to a patient to report the administration of the agent to the prescription monitoring program registry
summary: Requires practitioners who administer naloxone or another overdose reversal agent to a patient in the case of a suspected or confirmed overdose to report the administration of the agent to the prescription monitoring program registry.

short_summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
summary: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

short_summary: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults in certain circumstances
summary: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults when no other facility is available within fifty miles.

short_summary: Requires municipalities to maintain municipal websites
summary: Requires municipalities to maintain municipal websites.

short_summary: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code
summary: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code by counties.

short_summary: Implements a cost estimation model for child care
summary: Requires the office of children and family services to utilize a cost estimation model when determining the actual cost providers incur when providing child care; requires the office to prepare a report detailing such.

short_summary: Requires electronic cigarettes and e-liquid products to be sold in separate specific locations where only persons of at least twenty-one years of age are allowed to enter
summary: Requires electronic cigarettes and e-liquid products to be sold in separate specific locations where only persons of at least twenty-one years of age are allowed to enter.

short_summary: Provides for a study on the use of solid antimicrobial materials for touch surfaces in the construction of public buildings
summary: Directs the commissioner of health, in consultation with the commissioner of the office of general services, to conduct a study on the use of solid antimicrobial materials for touch surfaces in the construction of public buildings.

short_summary: Authorizes enforcement officers of city courts in the county of Erie to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs in certain situations
summary: Authorizes enforcement officers of city courts in the county of Erie, designated in lieu of the sheriff, to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments of the supreme and family courts.

short_summary: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits
summary: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits under any program provided under the social security law.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state volunteer first responder loan forgiveness incentive program
summary: Establishes the New York state volunteer first responder loan forgiveness incentive program for the purpose of attracting and retaining volunteer ambulance workers and volunteer firefighters in the state.

short_summary: Removes limits on licensed physical therapists treating patients without a referral
summary: Removes limits on the duration of treatment by a licensed physical therapist when a patient does not have a referral.

short_summary: Provides for transportation accommodation for passengers with disabilities
summary: Relates to transportation accommodations for passengers with disabilities; requires compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and indication for accommodations when requesting a ride; creates an on-demand vehicle accessibility fund.

short_summary: Relates to HIV testing in certain criminal cases
summary: Relates to the time when court ordered HIV testing in certain criminal cases must be conducted.

short_summary: Relates to the utilization of a pressurized mixing and dispensing system
summary: Relates to the utilization of a pressurized mixing and dispensing system; permits a retail licensee for on-premises consumption to prepare and keep drinks containing alcoholic beverages in dispensing machines, having a capacity of not less than a gallon, utilizing a pressurized mixing and dispensing system.

short_summary: Requires the disclosure of insurance information on permit applications for the construction of pipelines upon any freshwater wetlands
summary: Requires the disclosure of insurance information, including the name of the insurance company, the amount of coverage and what is covered under their plan, on permit applications for the construction of pipelines upon any freshwater wetlands.

short_summary: Provides that a student enrolled in an individualized education program during certain school years may continue to receive educational services for a certain period
summary: Provides that a student enrolled in an individualized education program during certain school years may continue to receive educational services until the student completes the services pursuant to the individualized education program or the end of the school year during which the student turns twenty-two years old, whichever is sooner.

short_summary: Relates to benefits for police officers, correction officers, firefighters, and other emergency personnel diagnosed with PTSD
summary: Relates to benefits for police officers, correction officers, firefighters, and other emergency personnel diagnosed with PTSD by making their injury compensable if it cannot be shown, by a preponderance of evidence, that the PTSD was caused by factors unrelated to their occupation.

short_summary: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service
summary: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service; provides that a voice service provider shall not be subject to civil or criminal liability for failure of a call-blocking service to block a call, or mistakenly blocking a call that should not have been blocked.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of plywood, wood composite, wood veneer, or similar wood-based products to secure real property
summary: Prohibits a person, municipality or governmental entity from using plywood, wood composite, wood veneer, or similar wood-based products to secure any real property that is deemed vacant and abandoned.

short_summary: Provides that prescriptions covered by insurance, that would otherwise be required to be filled by mail order, may be filled at a retail pharmacy under certain circumstances
summary: Provides that prescriptions covered by insurance, that would otherwise be required to be filled by mail order, may be filled at a retail pharmacy under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature
summary: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature on their websites.

short_summary: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
summary: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

short_summary: Relates to requiring immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider
summary: Requires immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider.

short_summary: Relates to establishing school election wards in the Washingtonville Central School District
summary: Establishes school election wards in the Washingtonville Central School District.

short_summary: Directs the department of state to study, evaluate, and make recommendations concerning studies directed by the legislature to be completed
summary: Directs the department of state to study, evaluate, and make recommendations concerning studies directed by the legislature to be completed.

short_summary: Establishes the parking protection act
summary: Establishes the parking protection act; provides that parking facilities shall display a sign stating the current applicable price of parking at such facilities; includes provisions on when a motor vehicle may be towed or immobilized; provides a limit to the cost of towing and storage of a vehicle.

short_summary: Provides for the suspension of a vehicle registration after a third violation for overtaking and passing a stopped school bus
summary: Provides for the suspension of a vehicle registration after a third school bus safety camera violation for overtaking and passing a stopped school bus.

short_summary: Requires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses
summary: Requires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses transporting students in kindergarten through sixth grade to or from school or to or from any school related activity.

short_summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens
summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens.

short_summary: Provides business tax credit for employer provided day care
summary: Provides employers with a tax credit in an amount not to exceed 20% of expenses incurred in providing day care services to the children and wards of its employees and in training persons employed by the taxpayer or a third party provider rendering such services; provides that to receive such credit the facility or program rendering day care services must be licensed.

short_summary: Requires certain documents and forms to be provided in multiple languages
summary: Requires certain documents and forms to be provided in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited English proficient immigrants of five years or less according to the American community survey, as published by the United States census bureau.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of mental health to conduct a study on the suicide rates of taxi medallion holders and taxi drivers in the state
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of mental health to conduct a study on the suicide rates of taxi medallion holders and taxi drivers in the state and make a report and recommendations on the findings of such study within one year.

short_summary: Provides for lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act
summary: Establishes the lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the department of transportation to establish a memorial marker program
summary: Authorizes and directs the department of transportation to establish a memorial marker program.

short_summary: Establishes a task force on educator diversity in New York state
summary: Establishes a task force to conduct a comprehensive study on the presence of educator diversity in the state, state actions taken to promote educator diversity, and how the state can encourage new initiatives to enhance and promote educator diversity in New York; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Enacts the wine industry and liquor store revitalization act; repealer
summary: Enacts the wine industry and liquor store revitalization act; authorizes grocery and drug stores to sell wine on their premises for consumption off the premises.

short_summary: Enacts online revenues and expenditures transparency act
summary: Enacts the online revenues and expenditures transparency act to provide for the development of a single, searchable budget database website accessible to the public, at no cost.

short_summary: Relates to certain housing accommodations by tenants over sixty-two years of age or a tenant with a disability
summary: Relates to rent regulated and rent stabilized housing accommodations by tenants over sixty-two years of age or a tenant with a disability.

short_summary: Relates to economic development projects involving the use of fossil fuels; relates to tax on sales of motor fuel and petroleum products; repealer
summary: Limits the use of fossil fuels in the research or production of energy for purposes of the excelsior jobs program; prohibits businesses engaged in the production, transmission, distribution, transportation or storage of fossil fuels from participation in the START-UP NY program; eliminates property that directly produces, transmits, distributes, transports or stores fossil fuels from qualifying tangible property for purposes of the investment tax credit and the Brownfield redevelopment tax credit; relates to tax on sales of motor fuel and petroleum products and makes conforming changes; relates to the definition of qualified rehabilitation expenditures for purposes of the tax credit for rehabilitation of historic properties; relates to the definition of a qualified emerging technology company; relates to the definition of manufacturer for purposes of the calculation of special tax benefits for qualified New York manufacturers; repeals provisions relating to manufacturing gallonage for purposes of the imposition of certain taxes; repeals provisions relating to reimbursement; repeals provisions relating to a utility credit or reimbursement; repeals provisions relating to an aviation fuel business which services four or more cities; repeals provisions relating to services rendered with respect to certain property; repeals provisions relating to fuel sold to an airline for use in its airplanes.

short_summary: Relates to the payment for services at addiction treatment centers operated by the office of addiction services and supports
summary: Requires that services at addiction treatment centers operated by the office of addiction services and supports shall not be refused at such centers if a person is unable to pay.

short_summary: Relates to the penalty for the offense of predatory sexual assault against a child
summary: Relates to the penalty for the offense of predatory sexual assault against a child; provides for lifetime parole for such felons.

short_summary: Relates to the naturally occurring retirement community supportive service program
summary: Relates to the naturally occurring retirement community supportive service program.

short_summary: Establishes school registration and support and assistance for designated schools; repealer
summary: Grants the commissioner of education the power to identify schools for additional support and assistance and establish performance targets for such schools.

short_summary: Relates to establishing school election wards in the Warwick Valley Central School District
summary: Establishes school election wards in the Warwick Valley Central School District.

short_summary: Relates to farm worker meal and lodging minimum wage credits
summary: Relates to farm worker meal, lodging and utilities minimum wage credits.

short_summary: Relates to the water resources planning council
summary: Expands the water resources planning council; directs such council to fulfill certain duties; requires reports from the council.

short_summary: Establishes a maximum temperature in school buildings and indoor facilities
summary: Establishes a maximum temperature in school buildings and indoor facilities; provides a definition of extreme heat condition days and the standard to measure room temperature.

short_summary: Prohibits the provision of licenses for firearms to persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database
summary: Prohibits the provision of licenses for firearms to persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database; authorizes firearms licenses of persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database to be suspended or revoked; requires the superintendent of state police to search the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database each year and report findings to appropriate enforcement agencies in order to suspend or revoke appropriate licenses.

short_summary: Exempts private air ambulance services from insurance licensing and other requirements
summary: Exempts private air ambulance services from insurance licensing and other requirements if the private ambulance service meets certain enumerated qualifications.

short_summary: Relates to utilization review program standards and pre-authorization for certain health care services
summary: Relates to utilization review program standards; requires use of evidence-based and peer reviewed clinical review criteria; relates to prescription drug formulary changes and pre-authorization for certain health care services.

short_summary: Eliminates the cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit
summary: Eliminates the $1500 cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit.

short_summary: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services
summary: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services.

short_summary: Modifies the interest rate within the standard nonforfeiture law for annuities
summary: Reduces the minimum nonforfeiture interest rate for annuities from one percent to one half of one percent for annuities during the surrender charge period, and from one percent to fifteen hundredths of one percent during any contract period with no surrender charge.

short_summary: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax
summary: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax; provides amount received shall be distributed to the fire companies in proportion to the number of active members within each company.

short_summary: Establishes an online insurance verification system for proof of insurance; repealer
summary: Establishes an online insurance verification system for proof of insurance; allows the use of third-party vendors and providers; requires motor vehicle insurers to provide policy information to the online verification system; establishes an online insurance verification advisory council; requires certain information to be confidential and proprietary information which is not subject to disclosure.

short_summary: Relates to expanding the definition of agency
summary: Relates to expanding the definition of agency; includes entities created by an agency or that are governed by a board of directors or similar body a majority of which is designated by one or more state or local government officials in the definition of agency under the public officers law.

short_summary: Imposes regulations for short-term rental units
summary: Provides for the regulation of short-term rental units; authorizes short-term rental units; requires short-term rental hosts to register each unit with the division of housing and community renewal.

short_summary: Establishes the bilingual teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program
summary: Establishes the bilingual teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program to attract and retain bilingual, certified teachers in schools with a bilingual teacher shortage; provides for grants and procedures for applying for such grants and eligibility requirements for fund distribution.

short_summary: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipal
summary: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipality.

short_summary: Relates to the commissioners of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
summary: Relates to the commissioners of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey; requires that at least one of whom shall be a resident voter from either the county of Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Sullivan, Ulster or Westchester and one of whom shall be a resident voter from either the county of Nassau or Suffolk.

short_summary: Enacts tuition-free NY to provide free tuition at SUNY, CUNY and community colleges
summary: Makes tuition free for New York state residents at SUNY and CUNY schools and community colleges; requires state residency and employment for a period of five years after completion of academic program.

short_summary: Relates to the registration of new curricula or programs of study offered by a not-for-profit college or university
summary: Relates to the registration of new curricula or programs of study offered by a not-for-profit college or university; provides for the procedures to have such curricula or programs of study approved by the department of education.

short_summary: Requires schools to accept credits for educational programs at OCFS facilities as transfer credits
summary: Requires schools to accept credits for educational programs at OCFS facilities as transfer credits.

short_summary: Eliminates rent for homeless shelters; repealer
summary: Relates to eliminating rent for homeless shelters; provides that a homeless individual or family applying for or receiving temporary housing assistance shall not be required to pay to any local or state government or agency or any provider, room and board or contribute any earned or unearned income, available benefits or resources to eliminate their need for temporary housing assistance or as a condition to receive temporary housing assistance from such provider.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting colleges from asking about an applicant's prior arrests or convictions during the pre-admissions process
summary: Relates to college admissions for persons previously convicted of one or more criminal offenses.

short_summary: Removes provisions of the election law requiring election inspectors, poll clerks, and election coordinators to be appointed in a bipartisan manner
summary: Removes provisions requiring election inspectors, poll clerks, and election coordinators to be appointed in a bipartisan manner.

short_summary: Provides that certain applicants be eligible for conviction sealing
summary: Provides that certain applicants be eligible for conviction sealing.

short_summary: Requires a weekly update of the prescription drug retail price list
summary: Requires a weekly update of the department of health's prescription drug retail price list.

short_summary: Establishes the bottle redemption fraud task force
summary: Establishes the bottle redemption fraud task force to provide the governor and the legislature with information on the fraud, enforcement, and reporting requirements related to the New York state returnable container act.

short_summary: Relates to stolen firearms, shotguns and rifles; repealer
summary: Relates to criminal penalties for possession, theft, or sale of stolen firearms, shotguns and rifles.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of New York to establish an electronic voter registration transmittal system for New York city residents
summary: Authorizes the city of New York to establish and maintain an electronic voter registration transmittal system for New York city residents.

short_summary: Relates to the releasing of individuals charged with a crime under non-monetary bail conditions in order to receive mental health screening or be admitted to a hospital as a result of a mental illness; repeal
summary: Relates to releasing individuals charged with a crime under non-monetary bail conditions in order to receive mental health screening or be admitted to a hospital as a result of a mental illness which is likely to result in harm to such individual or others.

short_summary: Relates to pre-clearance of voting-related regulations and policies
summary: Relates to pre-clearance of voting-related regulations and policies.

short_summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented multiple times within a period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications
summary: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented multiple times within a period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications.

short_summary: Includes temporarily erected structures in the definition of substandard or insanitary area
summary: Includes temporarily erected structures in the definition of "substandard or insanitary area".

short_summary: Relates to granting certain individuals youthful offender status or young adult offender status; repealer
summary: Relates to granting certain individuals youthful offender status; adds a new category of individuals eligible for young adult offender status; provides for process and sentencing requirements related to such statuses.

short_summary: Exempts from compensating use taxes purchases made outside the state and brought into the state
summary: Exempts from compensating use taxes purchases made outside the state and brought into the state to the extent that the value of the purchase does not exceed $2,500.

short_summary: Prohibits qualified immunity for public officials
summary: Prohibits qualified immunity for public officials; authorizes attorney general enforcement; provides that statutory immunities and statutory limitations on liability, damages or attorney fees do not apply to such claims.

short_summary: Enacts "Lindsey's Law"
summary: Enacts "Lindsey's law" criminalizing the disclosure of confidential government records by a public employer as retaliation for a victim making a sexual harassment complaint or claim.

short_summary: Relates to the representation of newly formed political parties
summary: Relates to the representation of newly formed political parties; relates to the placement of candidates of newly formed political parties on ballots, the representation of such parties within the state and the transmission of the official canvass of votes cast for presidential electors.

short_summary: Relates to promoting animal fighting; and repeals certain provisions of such law relating thereto
summary: Relates to promoting animal fighting and appropriately punishing individuals associated with such activities.

short_summary: Relates to public higher education admissions and standardized testing
summary: Prevents certain public institutions of higher education from using the scholastic aptitude test and ACT assessment in the admissions process on and after the two thousand twenty-four--two thousand twenty-five academic year for New York resident applicants; requires SUNY and CUNY to create a new standardized test by the two thousand twenty-eight--two thousand twenty-nine academic year.

short_summary: Relates to coverage and billing procedures in the Medicaid program for complex rehabilitation technology for patients with complex medical needs
summary: Relates to coverage and billing procedures in the Medicaid program for complex rehabilitation technology for patients with complex medical needs.

short_summary: Relates to the minimum wage for employees with disabilities
summary: Eliminates provisions exempting employees with disabilities from the minimum wage law; provides that laws or minimum wage orders that authorize an employer to pay a wage that is less than the minimum wage are valid provided that under such laws or orders an employee with a disability is paid the same wage as an employee in a comparable position that does not have a disability.

short_summary: Eliminates judicial immunity or quasi-judicial immunity for certain third parties who provide a report or finding to the family court
summary: Eliminates judicial immunity or quasi-judicial immunity for certain third parties, such as special masters, minor's counsel, investigators, therapists, evaluators, receivers, bankruptcy trustees, experts, and factfinders, who provide a report or finding to the family court.

short_summary: Exempts applications for an extreme risk protection order from requiring an index number fee
summary: Exempts applications for an extreme risk protection order from requiring an index number fee.

short_summary: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position and corrects certain gendered language
summary: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position; corrects certain gendered language.

short_summary: Relates to making certain public records available on the internet
summary: Requires governmental and certain nongovernmental entities to publish public records proactively on the internet that are of public interest.

short_summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to prepare a report regarding the replacement of certain electric generating sites with renewable energy development and energy storage
summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to prepare a report regarding the replacement of decommissioned or dormant electric generating sites with renewable energy development and energy storage opportunities.

short_summary: Relates to franchise tax on banking corporations
summary: Reinstates a bank tax based on the highest of four bases: a tax on allocated entire net income, a tax on allocated alternative entire net income, a tax on allocated taxable assets, or a fixed dollar minimum tax; prohibits banks from segregating their income and capital into business and investment varieties.

short_summary: Provides for a credit against personal income tax for volunteer firefighters who complete qualifications to become a training instructor
summary: Provides for a credit against personal income tax for volunteer firefighters who complete qualifications to become a training instructor; provides that such credit shall be equal to the sum of five hundred dollars or the total amount of the tax owed by the taxpayer if less than five hundred dollars, whichever is lower.

short_summary: Relates to exempting computer hardware and software and school supplies from sales tax during a specified period
summary: Exempts computer hardware and software equipment and school supplies from sales tax during the seven day period commencing on the Tuesday immediately preceding the first Monday in September, known as Labor Day, and ending on Labor Day.

short_summary: Extends the statute of limitations for certain sexual harassment complaints
summary: Extends the statute of limitations for complaints alleging cases of sexual harassment in employment, to 3 years or within 1 year of the complainant's employment termination at such employer, whichever is later.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Wayne to impose a hotel or motel room or seasonal rental occupancy tax
summary: Authorizes the county of Wayne to impose a hotel or motel room or seasonal rental occupancy tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Provides for payments to rural hospitals designated as critical access hospitals
summary: Provides for payments to rural hospitals designated as critical access hospitals.

short_summary: Enacts "Averyana's law" to provide a tax credit for the installation of certain smoke alarms
summary: Enacts "Averyana's law"; provides a tax credit for the purchase and installation of certain smoke alarms which incorporate photoelectric technology including but not limited to: photoelectric detectors; dual photoelectric/ionization detectors; and photoelectric/carbon monoxide detectors.

short_summary: Establishes business franchise, personal income and insurance franchise tax credits for the expenses of employer provided or sponsored child care
summary: Establishes business franchise, personal income and insurance franchise tax credits for the expenses of employer provided or sponsored child care.

short_summary: Amends certain definitions relating to tobacco products and changes the minimum pack sizes for tobacco products and the tax amount for tobacco products
summary: Amends certain definitions relating to tobacco products; changes the minimum pack sizes for tobacco products and the tax amount for tobacco products.

short_summary: Grants immunity from liability to organizations which establish physician committees the purpose of which is to refer to treatment physicians who are thought to be suffering from addiction or mental illness
summary: Grants immunity from liability to organizations which establish physician committees the purpose of which is to confront and refer to treatment physicians who are thought to be suffering from addiction or mental illness.

short_summary: Establishes the category of "qualified group practice" for medical, dental and podiatric practices that comply with certain standards
summary: Establishes the category of "qualified group practice" for medical, dental and podiatric practices that comply with certain standards and authorizes such practices to operate a malpractice prevention program.

short_summary: Permits midwives and physician assistants to certify the cause of death on a fetal death certificate
summary: Permits midwives and physician assistants to certify the cause of death on a fetal death certificate if they are in attendance at or after a fetal death.

short_summary: Prohibits lobbyists who are convicted of or plead guilty to class D felonies or higher level crimes from acting as a lobbyist for a period of three years
summary: Prohibits lobbyists who are convicted of or plead guilty to class D felonies or higher level crimes from acting as a lobbyist for a period of three years from the date of the conviction; provides the authority to extend suspensions; entitles such lobbyist to a hearing upon application for suspension extension.

short_summary: Removes cap on funds for teacher resource and computer training centers for city school district for the city of New York
summary: Removes the cap on funds for teacher resource and computer training centers for the city school district for the city of New York.

short_summary: Authorizes the governor to appoint a lieutenant-governor subject to confirmation by the legislature
summary: Authorizes the governor to appoint a lieutenant-governor subject to confirmation by the legislature.

short_summary: Relates to the process and requirements to incorporate as a village; repealer
summary: Revises the process of incorporating a village such as the contents of a petition and the filing process.

short_summary: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office
summary: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office.

short_summary: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers
summary: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers regarding availability of required equipment at retail.

short_summary: Establishes the crimes of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees
summary: Establishes the offenses of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees.

short_summary: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption
summary: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption.

short_summary: Allows cooperative agreements by licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises
summary: Allows certain licensees to form cooperative agreements to make joint purchases of alcoholic beverages provided that such agreement and activity conform to certain standards.

short_summary: Establishes local labor requirements as part of the approval to receive a real property tax business investment exemption
summary: Establishes local labor requirements as part of the approval to receive a real property tax business investment exception; requires eighty-five percent of workers hired by a contractor or developer for a project to be from the same county or an adjoining county or, in certain circumstances, the state of New York.

short_summary: Authorizes the International We Love U Foundation to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes the International We Love U Foundation to file an application for exemption from real property taxes.

short_summary: Relates to fees charged by municipal industrial development agencies
summary: Requires fees charged by municipal industrial development agencies be the same as those charged by the county's industrial development agency.

short_summary: Expands the definition of veteran to include members of the United States public health service
summary: Expands the definition of veteran to include members of the United States public health service to provide such members with access to the same benefits as members of the United States armed forces.

short_summary: Warns voters about New York's closed primary system on voter registration forms
summary: Provides voters with a warning about New York's closed primary system on voter registration forms.

short_summary: Provides for coverage for prescription drugs under Medicaid; repealer
summary: Provides that prescription drugs eligible for reimbursement shall be provided and paid for under the preferred drug program and the clinical drug review program; restores pharmacy benefits under Medicaid managed care.

short_summary: Allows a licensed pharmacist to order and administer certain tests
summary: Allows a licensed pharmacist to order and administer certain tests.

short_summary: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers
summary: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no less than one hundred percent of the medical assistance durable medical equipment and complex rehabilitation technology fee schedule for the same service or item.

short_summary: Expands confidentiality requirements for communicable disease contact tracing
summary: Expands confidentiality requirements to any communicable disease contact tracing.

short_summary: Provides for reimbursement rates for certain services
summary: Expands the individual psychotherapy services provided by licensed social workers, in accordance with licensing criteria set forth in applicable regulations to which the applicable reimbursement rate is based entirely upon the ambulatory patient group methodology.

short_summary: Requires all school districts to have a licensed physical education teacher
summary: Requires all school districts to have a licensed physical education teacher.

short_summary: Provides that health care plan participation by physicians shall be reported, for purposes of physician profiles, by the health care plans
summary: Provides that health care plan participation by physicians shall be reported, for purposes of physician profiles, by the health care plans; requires physicians to periodically submit information for his or her physician profile within 6 months of his or her triennial re-registration to practice; authorizes physicians to designate a designee to submit his or her information for the physician profile.

short_summary: Relates to qualifications for certain appointed positions with the board of trustees for the state university and the city university of New York
summary: Relates to qualifications for certain appointed positions with the board of trustees for the state university and the city university of New York.

short_summary: Increases the income eligibility threshold for the tuition assistance program
summary: Increases the income eligibility threshold for the tuition assistance program.

short_summary: Relates to immigration status of registered students
summary: Mandates that no employee or officer of the university shall determine the specific details of a student's immigration status except when required by federal law, pursuant to a court order or as required in connection with tuition or financial aid eligibility.

short_summary: Requires the department of buildings to maintain a registry of all deeds containing restrictive covenants
summary: Requires the department of buildings to maintain a registry of all deeds containing restrictive covenants.

short_summary: Relates to fingerprinting and background checks of contracted service providers of student support services
summary: Relates to the fingerprinting and background checks of contracted service providers of student support services.

short_summary: Provides elderly individuals water relief in N.Y. city
summary: Provides that any qualified homeowner in the city of New York shall be eligible to be exempted from any future increases in water rate fees.

short_summary: Requires the city of New York to repair any sidewalk damaged by a tree under its exclusive care
summary: Requires the city of New York to repair any sidewalk damaged by a tree under its exclusive care that is adjacent to any class one property, class two condo or coop or any house of religious worship.

short_summary: Enacts the "employment first choice act" to ensure that an individual with developmental disabilities in a nonintegrated setting shall have the right to remain in such a setting under certain circumstances
summary: Enacts the "employment first choice act" to ensure that an individual with developmental disabilities in a nonintegrated setting shall have the right to remain in such a setting under certain circumstances.

short_summary: Relates to the state apprenticeship and training council
summary: Requires the state apprenticeship and training council to meet a certain number of times per year and provide a report.

short_summary: Excludes claims for unemployment insurance arising as a result of an employer closing his or her business because of novel coronavirus COVID-19, from an employer's experience rating charges
summary: Excludes claims for unemployment insurance arising as a result of an employer closing his or her business because of novel coronavirus COVID-19, from an employer's experience rating charges.

short_summary: Enhances the assisted outpatient treatment program and eliminates the expiration and repeal of Kendra's Law
summary: Enhances the assisted outpatient treatment program; eliminates the expiration and repeal of Kendra's Law.

short_summary: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol; repealer
summary: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol.

short_summary: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club
summary: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club from twenty persons to one hundred persons.

short_summary: Provides for the conducting of meetings by public bodies through the use of videoconferencing or other electronic means; repealer
summary: Provides for the conducting of meetings by public bodies through the use of videoconferencing or other electronic means; sets rules and procedures related thereto.

short_summary: Creates a live kidney donor follow-up study
summary: Creates a ten year live kidney donor follow-up study which includes a one thousand dollars per year stipend for participants; provides two thousand dollars for all kidney donors for health-related expenses.

short_summary: Relates to a real property tax relief credit and an enhanced real property tax circuit breaker credit
summary: Provides a real property tax relief credit and an enhanced real property tax circuit breaker credit for certain taxpayers who meet income requirements and other eligibility.

short_summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from the East Islip Fire District
summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from the East Islip Fire District with respect to a portion of the 2021-2022 assessment roll and the entire 2022-2023 assessment roll.

short_summary: Establishes the New York nurse expansion program
summary: Establishes the New York nurse expansion program which provides awards to undergraduate students who are matriculated in an approved undergraduate program leading to a career in nursing at a New York state public or private degree granting institution of higher education.

short_summary: Establishes a home heating oil rebate program
summary: Establishes a home heating oil rebate program for residential home heating oil customers to receive a rebate of one dollar per gallon of grade number two heating oil purchased from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024, of a limit up to five hundred gallons.

short_summary: Relates to accidental disability retirement for uniformed court officers and peace officers employed in the unified court system
summary: Provides that uniformed court officers and peace officers employed in the unified court system shall be entitled to accidental disability retirement if they sustain injuries as the result of physical assault by an assailant suffered while in service.

short_summary: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance
summary: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance.

short_summary: Makes any offense involving the use or possession of a firearm, shotgun or rifle bail eligible
summary: Relates to making any offense involving the use or possession of a firearm, shotgun or rifle bail eligible.

short_summary: Relates to the homeowner tax rebate credit
summary: Relates to the homeowner tax rebate credit by extending the provisions to apply for tax year two thousand twenty-three and every tax year thereafter.

short_summary: Modifies the amount of credit for cider, wine, and liquor under the alcoholic beverage production credit
summary: Relates to the amount of credit for cider, wine, and liquor produced in NYS under the alcoholic beverage production credit; provides parity with beer credit based on the taxes for cider, wine, and liquor.

short_summary: Provides that a landlord may not commence evictions in the city of Syracuse until compliance with the local law requiring registration or licensure of residential rental dwellings is demonstrated
summary: Requires that in order to commence a summary proceeding for eviction in the city of Syracuse pursuant to article 7 of the real property actions and proceedings law, the party must plead and prove compliance with any local law requiring the registration or licensure of residential rental dwellings.

short_summary: Relates to the posting of additional nursing home ratings
summary: Relates to the posting of additional nursing home ratings; provides such posting shall include ratings for health inspections, staffing and quality measures.

short_summary: Establishes a rental assistance loan-to-grant program to assist landlords due to the COVID-19 pandemic
summary: Establishes a rental assistance loan-to-grant program to assist landlords of small rental properties who have lost rental income due to the inability of the landlords' tenants to pay rent during the COVID-19 state disaster emergency; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Excludes certain graduate students from mandatory fees
summary: Excludes certain graduate students from mandatory fees.

short_summary: Imposes a moratorium on increasing gas and electric prices, rates and charges
summary: Imposes a moratorium on increasing gas and electric prices, rates and charges.

short_summary: Requires inter-agency records prepared by an outside consultant on behalf of an agency to be subject to FOIL disclosure
summary: Requires inter-agency records prepared on behalf of an agency to be subject to FOIL disclosure.

short_summary: Relates to requiring principals to notify co-trustees and co-beneficiaries of the signing of a power of attorney
