summary: Requires any person including certified and licensed responsible pesticide applicators and commercial pesticide applicators and operators operating in the state to contact the division of plant industry of the department of agriculture and markets by phone at least forty-eight hours in advance of extermination of honey bees to obtain assistance in trying to relocate nuisance honey bee colonies or hanging swarms of honey bees, in lieu of destroying such honey bees; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Imposes criminal liability for the failure to obtain medical care for a person in custody displaying medical distress
summary: Imposes criminal liability for the failure to obtain medical care for a person in custody displaying medical distress.

short_summary: Allows certificates of marriage from foreign governments and religious institutions as acceptable documentation to change a name on a driver's license or non-driver identification card
summary: Allows valid certificates of marriage from foreign governments and religious institutions as acceptable documentation to change a name on a driver's license, learner's permit, or identification card.

short_summary: Creates a personal income tax credit for taxpayers who pay an excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence
summary: Allows an individual taxpayer to claim a credit against their income tax for excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence; authorizes the commissioner of taxation and finance to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations.

short_summary: Relates to homeowner natural disaster preparedness, home safety and loss prevention courses
summary: Requires the department of financial services to fulfill certain requirements to implement homeowner natural disaster preparedness, home safety and loss prevention courses.

short_summary: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance and the criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree
summary: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance; establishes the offense of criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree; expands the definition of controlled substances with respect to certain offenses; increases the felony classification of certain controlled substance offenses; includes electronic prescriptions and blank prescription forms in the definition of certain controlled substance offenses.

short_summary: Establishes a state commercial fishing industry advocate and a commercial fishing economic development program
summary: Establishes a state commercial fishing industry advocate and a commercial fishing economic development program to promote the state's commercial fishing industry; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes the hire a vet grant program
summary: Establishes the hire a vet grant program; provides grants to municipalities where a veteran is hired and employed, for not less than twelve continuous and uninterrupted months in a full-time or part-time position.

short_summary: Requires that websites providing incarcerated individual information be searchable by the incarcerated individual's name, former name or alias
summary: Requires that websites providing incarcerated individual information be searchable by the incarcerated individual's name, former name or alias.

short_summary: Creates the criminal justice infrastructure investment grant program; appropriation
summary: Creates the criminal justice infrastructure investment grant program which provides grants to municipalities, courts, sheriffs' offices and district attorneys' offices to provide software and hardware to assist with discovery, speedy trial and bail processes.

short_summary: Prohibits publishers from limiting the number of copies of e-books available at public libraries
summary: Prohibits publishers from limiting the number of copies of e-books available at public libraries in New York.

short_summary: Relates to pass-through manufacturers zero percent tax rate
summary: Relates to pass-through manufacturers zero percent tax rate; extends a zero percent franchise tax to all manufacturers.

short_summary: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation
summary: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation.

short_summary: Establishes the home improvement fraud prevention act
summary: Establishes the home improvement fraud prevention act relating to the responsibilities of home improvement contractors and requiring home improvement contractors to register with the secretary of state.

short_summary: Relates to training requirements for members of the board of ethics of a political subdivision or municipality
summary: Provides that each member of the board of ethics of a political subdivision or municipality shall complete, at a minimum, four hours of training each year designed to enable such members to more effectively carry out their duties; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from November 30, 2023 to November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Includes the Olean Public Library with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority
summary: Includes the Olean Public Library with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of the administration of children's services to obtain an order of consent before allowing experimental drug testing on certain children
summary: Requires the New York city commissioner of the administration of children's services to obtain an order of consent from the court before allowing experimental drug testing on children under the care and/or control of the administration of children's services.

short_summary: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer
summary: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer except under exceptional circumstances.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
summary: Authorizes the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a five percent hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

short_summary: Prohibits a person convicted of rebellion or insurrection from state or municipal employment
summary: Prohibits a person convicted of rebellion or insurrection under federal law from state or municipal employment.

short_summary: Establishes the "public higher education quality initiative endowment" fund; repealer
summary: Establishes the "public higher education quality initiative endowment" fund.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the state university of New York and city university of New York endowment fund
summary: Relates to establishing the state university of New York and city university of New York endowment fund.

short_summary: Relates to the caseloads of child protective services workers
summary: Establishes standards for caseloads for child protective services workers; requires the state to pay for one hundred percent of the costs associated with compliance of such caseload standard; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to differential response programs for child protection assessments or investigations
summary: Relates to differential response programs for child protection assessments or investigations; requires social services districts to establish such programs upon authorization from the office of children and family services.

short_summary: Establishes differential payment rates for child care services provided by licensed, registered or enrolled child care providers
summary: Establishes differential payment rates for child care services provided by licensed, registered or enrolled child care providers for providers providing care to children experiencing homelessness, child care providers providing care during nontraditional hours, or in other situations deemed appropriate by a local social services district.

short_summary: Permits New York city voters to sign designating petitions for multiple candidates for the same New York city municipal public office or party position
summary: Permits New York city voters to sign designating petitions for multiple candidates for the same New York City municipal public office or party position.

short_summary: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; repealer
summary: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; requires regulations set an amount of no less than $50 a month; clarifies that service dogs do not have to be certified to qualify for such benefits.

short_summary: Increases the per student rate of empire state after school program and advantage after school program grants
summary: Increases the per student rate of empire state after school program and advantage after school program grants; requires future per student rates to be modified accounting for any minimum wage adjustments.

short_summary: Repeals section 3218 of the civil practice law and rules relating to judgments by confession; repealer
summary: Relates to judgments by confession.

short_summary: Establishes a tort cause of action for the wrongful injury or death of a companion animal
summary: Establishes a tort cause of action for the wrongful injury or death of a companion animal; provides for compensatory and punitive damages and injunctive relief.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro as the "John Jay High School Veterans Memorial Highway"
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro as the "John Jay High School Veterans Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Relates to residency restrictions for sex offenders
summary: Authorizes municipalities to establish residency restrictions for sex offenders.

short_summary: Authorizes Michael Telesca to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the county of Livingston
summary: Authorizes Michael Telesca to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the county of Livingston.

short_summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2025.

short_summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses
summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses.

short_summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation.

short_summary: Relates to visitation and custody rights involving non-U.S. citizens
summary: Prohibits a court from providing for visitation or custody of a minor who is a U.S. citizen to a person who resides outside the U.S. when the other party to such action is a U.S. citizen and objects to such an order.

short_summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs
summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs; requires school districts to create policies, procedures and guidelines to implement education programs for students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to prevent, deter and address incidents of teen dating violence; defines teen dating violence.

short_summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

short_summary: Provides for sentence of life without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person; repealer
summary: Provides for the imposition of a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person.

short_summary: Establishes limitations upon real property tax levies in N.Y. city
summary: Limits, in cities having a population of one million or more, the annual increase in real property taxes.

short_summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriation
summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriates $1,000,000 therefor.

short_summary: Requires New York State health benefit plan hospital pricing report
summary: Directs the president of the civil service commission to collect health care claims data relating to the price and utilization of hospital benefits by active employees, retired employees and their dependents and to publish a New York State health benefit plan hospital pricing report.

short_summary: Authorizes cities and towns, except a city with a population of one million or more, to establish community preservation funds
summary: Authorizes cities and towns, except a city with a population of one million or more, to establish community preservation funds; authorizes such cities and towns to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited in such funds; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Makes contests, competitions, tournaments and derbys to take wildlife unlawful
summary: Provides that it shall be unlawful for any person to organize, sponsor, conduct, promote, or participate in any contest, competition, tournament or derby where the objective of such contest or competition is to take wildlife.

short_summary: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events
summary: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events; requires school districts, boards of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension boards and charter schools to develop and implement a cardiac emergency response plan.

short_summary: Relates to enacting the public education racial equity and diversity act
summary: Establishes the New York state charter school commission to promote equity and diversity in educational leadership and prioritize the issuance of new charters to community-based organizations run by individuals from historically underrepresented communities.

short_summary: Provides for congestion pricing for motorcycles in the central business district
summary: Authorizes the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to impose tolls and fees for congestion pricing for motorcycles in the central business district in the amount of half of the charges for the tolls and fees of other vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in community centers
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish guidelines for onsite opioid overdose response capacity in community centers; defines "community center".

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the issuance of late fees prior to a finding of liability; repealer
summary: Relates to prohibiting the issuance of late fees prior to a finding of liability.

short_summary: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal
summary: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal; makes it a class D felony.

short_summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles
summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles.

short_summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

short_summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

short_summary: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent
summary: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent.

short_summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony
summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony and shall be punishable by life imprisonment without parole.

short_summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds
summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds which occurs when an individual on school grounds coerces, solicits, recruits or induces another person to join or remain a member of a criminal street gang, or conspires to do so.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants
summary: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants.

short_summary: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions
summary: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale
summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale of such goods.

short_summary: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses
summary: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

short_summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county
summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county.

short_summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years
summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years.

short_summary: Establishes an offense for fraud relating to voter registration forms
summary: Establishes fraud relating to voter registration forms as a class B misdemeanor; prohibits individuals and organizations from distributing applications for voter registration forms with marked or checked party affiliation boxes.

short_summary: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders
summary: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders.

short_summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transit authority where previously the split was 50-50.

short_summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection
summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection.

short_summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony
summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

short_summary: Enacts the child custody reform act
summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

short_summary: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $50,000
summary: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2024 and thereafter to $50,000.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state reforest, restore and sustainable agriculture commission
summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to be known as the New York state reforest, restore and sustainable agriculture commission to evaluate and make recommendations concerning the reforestation and restoration of forests and ecological habitats in the state of New York.

short_summary: Requires a purchaser of any firearm, rifle or shotgun to submit to a mental health evaluation
summary: Requires a purchaser of any firearm, rifle or shotgun to submit to a mental health evaluation and provide the seller with his or her approval to purchase such firearm.

short_summary: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities
summary: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities and whose income is less than $125,000.

short_summary: Authorizes a plea of guilty and the payment of fines or penalties electronically via the internet
summary: Authorizes a plea of guilty and the payment of fines or penalties electronically via the internet.

short_summary: Requires nonpublic and private elementary and secondary schools to require their prospective employees to submit fingerprints for the purpose of criminal background checks
summary: Requires nonpublic and private elementary and secondary schools to require their prospective employees to submit fingerprints through the commissioner of education for the purpose of criminal background checks; authorizes conditional appointment of employees by such schools pending determination of the criminal background check.

short_summary: Regulates and requires issuance of raincheck by retailer where advertised merchandise is not available for sale
summary: Mandates that any article of merchandise advertised, and not available throughout advertised period, must be supplied at advertised price by seller within sixty days from the date the purchaser of such article is notified of its availability; specifies terms of raincheck and limited exceptions.

short_summary: Authorizes a personal income tax credit for residential solar energy systems
summary: Authorizes a personal income tax credit for solar energy systems purchased and installed at a residence.

short_summary: Prevents outsourcing during a hiring freeze
summary: Prevents an agency, department, division, commission, bureau or any other entity under the authority of the executive department from contracting, subcontracting or hiring any third party during a hiring freeze.

short_summary: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village and authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of town machinery, tools and equipment
summary: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village; authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of certain services and town machinery, tools and equipment with another municipality, district corporation, school district, community college or any unit of the state university.

short_summary: Implements the "New York State Build Public Renewables Act"
summary: Implements the "New York State Build Public Renewables Act"; requires the New York power authority to provide only renewable energy and power to customers; requires such authority to be the sole provider of energy to all state owned and municipal properties; requires certain New York power authority projects and programs pay a prevailing wage and utilize project labor agreements.

short_summary: Relates to the retirement of deputy sheriffs-civil in the county of Monroe
summary: Relates to the retirement of deputy sheriffs-civil in the county of Monroe.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing service credit for unpaid or reduced paid child care leave for members of the state police twenty year retirement plan
summary: Relates to authorizing service credit for unpaid or reduced paid child care leave for members of the state police twenty year retirement plan.

short_summary: Authorizes James E. McTammany to receive an accidental disability retirement
summary: Authorizes James E. McTammany to receive an accidental disability retirement.

short_summary: Provides the option for candidates for office and petition witnesses not to put their address on designation petitions
summary: Relates to enacting the "Esther Salas candidate privacy act" providing the option for candidates for office and petition witnesses not to put their address on designation petitions but instead file such with the county clerk for a fee.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the manufacturing development zone program and tax credits related thereto
summary: Relates to establishing the manufacturing development zone program and tax credits related thereto.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York state department of financial services to oversee the planned closing of bank branch offices by federally chartered banking organizations
summary: Authorizes the New York state department of financial services to oversee the planned closing of bank branch offices by federally chartered banking organizations.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness
summary: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness; provides such commission shall investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning how to work toward reducing economic inequality, eliminating poverty, achieving equal opportunity and full employment, and boosting economic competitiveness and growth.

short_summary: Relates to updating the driver's manual provided to accepted learner's permit applicants and driver education courses
summary: Relates to updating the driver's manual provided to accepted learner's permit applicants and driver education courses to include a description of law enforcement procedures during traffic stops and the actions a motorist shall take during such stop including appropriate interactions with such officers.

short_summary: Provides for the issuance of summonses to parents of any juvenile who is the subject of a juvenile delinquency petition
summary: Provides for the issuance of summonses to each parent, including a non-custodial parent, of any juvenile who is the subject of a juvenile delinquency petition.

short_summary: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines for purposes of being exempt from certain taxation
summary: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines to be exempt from certain taxation.

short_summary: Authorizes tuition assistance program awards for students enrolled in short-term credential programs offered by certain public institutions
summary: Authorizes tuition assistance program awards for students enrolled in short-term credential programs offered by certain public institutions.

short_summary: Relates to consumer litigation funding
summary: Enacts the consumer litigation funding act to promote consumer protections related to consumer litigation funding transactions; provides for contract requirements, including that the contract contain a no penalty provision for the prepayment of the funded amount prior to the settlement of his or her case; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to fiscal intermediary services under the consumer directed personal assistance program
summary: Extends certain contracts for providing fiscal intermediary services under the consumer directed personal assistance program.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state
summary: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting forensic evaluations in a custody or visitation proceeding; repealer
summary: Prohibits courts from ordering an evaluation of a party or child or allowing into evidence a forensic report created by a forensic evaluator on a party or child to assist such court in a child custody or visitation determination.

short_summary: Relates to limiting the acquisition of a rifle or shotgun to one per ninety-day period
summary: Relates to limiting the acquisition of a rifle or shotgun to one per ninety-day period.

short_summary: Enacts the infant vision information, education and wellness program act
summary: Enacts the infant vision information, education and wellness program act.

short_summary: Relates to lobbying for the confirmation of persons to state office
summary: Requires registration and the disclosure of information relating to lobbying for the nomination or confirmation of persons to state office.

short_summary: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase
summary: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase from three years to ten years.

short_summary: Relates to photographing or recording a law enforcement officer
summary: Relates to permitting the photographing or recording of a law enforcement officer as long as such person isn't under arrest; outlines unlawful retaliatory measures by law enforcement for such photography or recording.

short_summary: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to make efforts to reduce incarcerated individual telephone rates and to place a cap on the cost of outgoing calls
summary: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to make efforts to reduce incarcerated individual telephone rates and to place a cap on the cost of outgoing calls.

short_summary: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations and provides support for relatives of such missing persons
summary: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations; provides support for relatives of such missing persons.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the New York state loan redemption program for certain public school teachers
summary: Relates to establishing the New York state loan redemption program for certain public school teachers.

short_summary: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners
summary: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners.

short_summary: Relates to reporting on swimming education in a public school
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to make a report on the extent of all existing resources and best practices available for swimming instruction classes in public schools and establish a working group on swimming education.

short_summary: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings
summary: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings.

short_summary: Prohibits cases from being closed without a hearing or written stipulation; repealer
summary: Prohibits cases from being closed without a hearing or written stipulation; requires a stenographic record of all hearings held; requires minutes and decisions to be provided to the injured worker in their native language.

short_summary: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes
summary: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes; prohibits the use of drones by law enforcement at concerts, protests, demonstrations, or other actions protected by the first amendment.

short_summary: Prohibits insurers from cancelling renters' insurance based on the ownership of a specific breed of dog
summary: Prohibits insurers issuing policies insuring personal injury and property damage arising out of a lease, from cancelling or refusing to issue or renew such a policy, or charging increased premiums based upon the harboring of a specific breed of dog on the premises.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of glyphosate and products containing glyphosate
summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of glyphosate and products containing glyphosate.

short_summary: Institutes a moratorium on the distribution, sale or use of glyphosate until a task force completes a study regarding the safety, alternatives and use of such compound
summary: Institutes a moratorium on the distribution, sale or use of glyphosate until a task force completes a study regarding the safety, alternatives and use of such compound.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to
summary: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to from two dollars to five dollars.

short_summary: Prohibits using possession of reproductive or sexual health devices as evidence in a trial, hearing or proceeding in certain circumstances
summary: Provides that possession of a condom or other reproductive or sexual health device may not be received in evidence in any trial, hearing or proceeding as evidence of conduct which would constitute an offense defined in article 230 of the penal law.

short_summary: Includes the Shelter Island Public Library Society with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority
summary: Includes the Shelter Island Public Library Society with libraries eligible for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

short_summary: Authorizes local water and sewerage authorities to charge fees for surface runoff
summary: Enacts the water bill fairness act; authorizes local water and sewerage authorities to charge fees for surface runoff.

short_summary: Enacts the "fair college admissions act"
summary: Enacts the "fair college admissions act"; prohibits legacy admissions policies at colleges and universities in New York; declares such policies and practices to be discriminatory and inequitable.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale or offer for sale of any cosmetic product or personal care product containing PFAS substances
summary: Prohibits the sale or offer for sale of any cosmetic product or personal care product containing PFAS substances.

short_summary: Adds "pregnancy outcome" to the list of protected classes
summary: Adds "pregnancy outcome" to the list of protected classes.

short_summary: Directs the department of health to extend the New York state Medicaid doula services pilot program
summary: Directs the department of health to extend the New York state Medicaid doula services pilot program until March 1, 2027.

short_summary: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program
summary: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program for qualified rehabilitation expenditures totaling fifty million dollars or more with respect to a certified historic structure that has been vacant, as determined by local code enforcement or other reasonable means, for at least ten of fifteen consecutive years preceding the date of the taxpayer's application for the rehabilitation credit.

short_summary: Includes extreme winter weather preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans
summary: Includes extreme winter weather preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans; updates the definition of "disaster".

short_summary: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum
summary: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention and identifying signs of depression for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum.

short_summary: Establishes a pilot program authorizing certain nurse aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county
summary: Authorizes nursing home medication aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county.

short_summary: Relates to implementing a shoreline hardening plan
summary: Implements a shoreline hardening plan for all residents with property along Lake Ontario and the St. Lawrence river in order to prevent damage from flooding.

short_summary: Relates to bystander intervention training
summary: Includes information about bystander intervention training in the department of labor's model sexual harassment prevention policy that includes information and practical guidance on how to enable bystanders to recognize potentially problematic behaviors and to motivate bystanders to take action when such bystanders observe problematic behaviors.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of an adult high school workforce development demonstration project
summary: Creates an adult high school workforce development demonstration project in Rochester; defines "adult high school workforce development demonstration project" or "program" to mean a private or independent high school registered by the department which provides adult learners with an appropriate academic environment, career credentialing programs and access to wraparound services provided by the operator or any entity partnered which such operator to address barriers to enable adult learners to pursue and obtain, subject to satisfactory completion of the requirements set forth within this article, a high school diploma.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products; repealer
summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

short_summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance
summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

short_summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training
summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

short_summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights to inform consumers with regard to insuring against catastrophic loss
summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights; directs the superintendent of financial services to issue a consumer guide on insuring against catastrophic losses.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which vehicle occupants' medical information is available in the glove compartment
summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which the medical and emergency contact information of the occupants, aged 55 or older, of a motor vehicle is available to emergency personnel in the glove compartment.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of feticide
summary: Establishes the crime of feticide or the intentional killing of an unborn child at any stage of gestation; makes such crime a class A felony.

short_summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board
summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

short_summary: Transfers certain lands to city of New York to be used as parklands
summary: Transfers certain lands to the city of New York to be used as parklands.

short_summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit
summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

short_summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

short_summary: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods
summary: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods; establishes this shall not apply to vehicles, vessels, or aircrafts that are used by any person as a common carrier in the transaction of business as such common carrier.

short_summary: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on the incidences of cancer clusters in cities and towns having a population of more than ninety thousand
summary: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on the incidences of cancer clusters in cities and towns having a population of more than ninety thousand.

short_summary: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment
summary: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment.

short_summary: Enacts the Kelsey Smith Act to require wireless service providers to provide call location information to law enforcement during an emergency
summary: Enacts the Kelsey Smith Act to require wireless service providers to provide call location information to law enforcement during an emergency.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of consent
summary: Adds the definition of consent to the terms of general use; defines it as a freely given, knowledgeable and informed agreement by a person with the capacity to reason.

short_summary: Increases the state discretionary buying threshold without a formal competitive process for certain commodities from certain businesses
summary: Increases the state discretionary buying threshold without a formal competitive process for certain commodities from certain businesses.

short_summary: Directs the department of transportation and the New York state thruway authority to identify sites along all highways, thruways and parkways in the state for wildlife crossings
summary: Enacts the "New York wildlife crossing act"; directs the department of transportation and the New York state thruway authority to identify sites along all highways, thruways and parkways in the state where wildlife crossings are most needed to increase public safety and improve habitat connectivity and create a priority list of wildlife opportunity areas where federal grant monies may be available to implement the top five projects identified.

short_summary: Makes provisions with respect to notices of homeowners deductibles triggers for hurricane windstorms
summary: Provides that the superintendent of financial services shall establish standards for hurricane windstorm deductibles, creating uniformity in the operation of such deductibles with respect to the triggering event.

short_summary: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage
summary: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage.

short_summary: Establishes the New York Data Protection Act
summary: Establishes the New York Data Protection Act; requires government entities and contractors to disclose certain personal information collected about individuals.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a pre-specialized high schools admissions test and preparation program
summary: Creates a pre-specialized high schools admissions test and preparation program for all sixth grade students in New York city.

short_summary: Allows non-profit national assessment providers to license data for certain purposes
summary: Allows non-profit national assessment providers to license data to accredited colleges, scholarship organizations and non-profit educational programs for the purpose of providing access to employment, scholarship, financial aid, and postsecondary educational opportunities.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state democracy commission
summary: Establishes the New York state democracy commission to report on certain democracy issues and how to prevent attempts to illegitimately overturn a lawful election on a local, state and federal level.

short_summary: Relates to admissibility of statements obtained from persons under the age of eighteen by means of deception
summary: Provides that statements made by minor defendants as a result of deception by law enforcement during custodial interrogation are inadmissible.

short_summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day"
summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day".

short_summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States
summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States; requires upon declaration of intention to run for the office of president of the United States, an individual who is currently holding office at the state or local level must thereafter resign such state or local office.

short_summary: Requires a criminal history report for certain employment or volunteer applicants to the office for people with developmental disabilities
summary: Directs the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to deny employment or volunteer applications based on a criminal history report for such applicant.

short_summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York city
summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York City.

short_summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation
summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation; requires representation on the board from each borough.

short_summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot
summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot.

short_summary: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

short_summary: Modifies the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

short_summary: Relates to increasing fines for certain telemarketing violations
summary: Relates to establishing a fine of $25,000 for knowingly transmitting misleading, inaccurate, or false caller identification information including but not limited to providing copied or incorrect telephone numbers; raises the maximum fine for other related violations.

short_summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

short_summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency
summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to the designated enforcement agency.

short_summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race
summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

short_summary: Relates to the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; repealer
summary: Repeals the provision of law that volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers who receive a real property tax exemption for service may not receive the income tax credit for such service.

short_summary: Provides a tax credit for certain durable medical equipment
summary: Provides a tax credit for certain durable medical equipment.

short_summary: Authorizes municipalities to purchase private residential real property located in a floodplain
summary: Authorizes municipalities to purchase private residential real property located in a floodplain.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of wiretapping
summary: Relates to the definition of wiretapping by requiring the consent of both the sender and receiver for the recording to be legal.

short_summary: Adds employees of the office of children and family services to the list of public employees for which prevention of duties constitutes assault in the second degree
summary: Adds employees of the office of children and family services to the list of public employees for which prevention of duties constitutes assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Expands the START-UP NY program to include medical primary care services
summary: Expands the START-UP NY program to include medical primary care services.

short_summary: Reduces the period of notice required to be given when a written demand for rent is served on a tenant and the period of notice to be given serving a warrant issued pursuant to a final judgment of eviction
summary: Reduces the period of notice required to be given when a written demand for rent is served on a tenant after the tenant has defaulted in the payment of rent and the period of notice to be given serving a warrant issued pursuant to a final judgment of eviction from fourteen days to seven days.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of wiretapping
summary: Relates to the definition of wiretapping by requiring the party recording the conversation to receive the consent of both parties present for the recording to be legal.

short_summary: Provides a filing extension for the "enhanced" STAR exemption to eligible applicants
summary: Provides a filing extension for the "enhanced" STAR exemption to initial applicants provided that such applicants have not been granted such extension before and such applicants are otherwise entitled to the exemption.

short_summary: Increases the maximum amount of individual awards for the physician loan repayment program and physician practice support program
summary: Increases the maximum amount of individual awards for the physician loan repayment program and physician practice support program to encourage physicians to practice in underserved areas.

short_summary: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies
summary: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies which shall include the limits of insurance, the term of the policy, the amount of annual premium and the amount of deductibles and a statement.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York Power Authority Public Renewables Standby Act"
summary: Enacts the "New York Power Authority Public Renewables Standby Act"; authorizes the power authority of the state of New York to support the goal of the climate leadership and community protection act by entering into contracts with companies, not subject to the public service commission's cost-of-service ratemaking, to procure through a competitive process the power and/or renewable energy credits from any renewable energy project in New York state; increases the number of trustees of the power authority to seventeen.

short_summary: Establishes the extreme weather preparedness task force
summary: Establishes the extreme weather preparedness task force to evaluate the state and counties' ability to handle extreme weather across the state.

short_summary: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on certain public roadways
summary: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on East Main Street to forty miles per hour.

short_summary: Relates to redesigning the state flag
summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of the office of general services to commission the flag design committee of the North American Vexillological Association to design a new state flag.

short_summary: Provides for nondisclosure and non-disparagement agreements
summary: Prohibits provisions in any waiver, settlement, agreement or other resolution of any claim where the foundation for which is an alleged violation of the labor law or article fifteen of the executive law, that prevent the disclosure of the employee's workplace experience with the employer.

short_summary: Relates to the finality of certain utility charges and the contents of utility bills
summary: Prohibits utility corporations from charging customers for gas or electric service which was rendered more than two months prior to the mailing of the first bill to the customer; requires utility corporations to provide a two-year history of charges in their bills.

short_summary: Requires state contractors to submit a statement on preventing human trafficking
summary: Requires state contractors to submit a statement on preventing human trafficking in bids to the state and maintain a written policy for preventing human trafficking within its operations, business dealings, and supply chain and provide to the state a copy of such policy when submitting such statement.

short_summary: Relates to business income base and certain small business taxpayers
summary: Relates to business income base and certain small business taxpayers.

short_summary: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide certain benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
summary: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers; increases the personal income tax deduction after four or more years of service; exempts motor vehicles used in the performance of such volunteers' duties from registration fees, use taxes and special fees for volunteer license plates; authorizes the provision of municipal health insurance coverage to such volunteers; establishes a volunteer recruitment service loan forgiveness program.

short_summary: Relates to hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
summary: Permits instruction in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

short_summary: Relates to exempting homeowners from tax increases for certain renewable energy systems
summary: Relates to exempting homeowners from tax increases for certain renewable energy systems.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship
summary: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship; authorizes a scholarship of $500 per year for high school graduates attending a New York state public post-secondary institution who have achieved a Gold Award from the Girl Scouts of the United States of America or an Eagle Scout from the Boy Scouts of America.

short_summary: Permits municipalities, schools and fire and police departments to display and sell symbols of hope
summary: Permits municipal corporations, fire districts, volunteer fire companies, police departments and school districts to sell and display symbols of hope in support of law enforcement, emergency medical personnel, the military, border patrol, firefighters, conservation officers and others.

short_summary: Relates to requiring telephones capable of making local and long-distance telephone calls be in every nursing home patient's room
summary: Relates to requiring telephones capable of making local and long-distance telephone calls be in every nursing home patient's room, either at such patient's bedside or in the patient's room depending on the patient's mobility.

short_summary: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Clarifies the application of standardized testing requirements to the general education development exam
summary: Clarifies the application of standardized testing requirements to the general education development exam by explicitly including it in the definition of "standardized test" and "test".

short_summary: Relates to the participation by free association libraries in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes the participation by free association libraries in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

short_summary: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act"
summary: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act" to require companies selling, offering for sale, or distributing packaging materials and products to register with a packaging reduction organization to develop a packaging reduction and recycling plan.

short_summary: Relates to assistance for SUNY and CUNY students experiencing homelessness
summary: Provides assistance for SUNY and CUNY students experiencing homelessness; designates liaison officers on campuses; creates systems for students experiencing homelessness to access support services and other resources available to the students.

short_summary: Relates to a pilot program to increase enrollment, attendance, and success in college for students experiencing homelessness
summary: Establishes a pilot program under the HESC to increase enrollment, attendance, and success within SUNY/CUNY for students experiencing homelessness.

short_summary: Authorizes the towns of Harmony and North Harmony in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns
summary: Authorizes the towns of Harmony and North Harmony in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns.

short_summary: Relates to allowing farm laborers to decide to work on a day of rest
summary: Relates to allowing farm laborers to decide to work on a day of rest.

short_summary: Relates to the scheduling of a fact finding hearing after the issuance of a temporary order of protection in family court
summary: Relates to the scheduling of a fact finding hearing after the issuance of a temporary order of protection in family court; provides that such hearing shall be scheduled no later than 14 days after the temporary order is issued.

short_summary: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals
summary: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals.

short_summary: Relates to adding veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination
summary: Relates to adding veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination.

short_summary: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination
summary: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination.

short_summary: Allows first responders who are diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder to request line of duty sick leave
summary: Allows first responders who are diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder to request line of duty sick leave.

short_summary: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
summary: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

short_summary: Exempts student organizations from sales taxes on certain prepared foods sold
summary: Exempts student organizations from sales taxes on prepared foods where total revenues from sales are below two hundred fifty dollars.

short_summary: Eliminates ability of legislators to earn certain perks
summary: Eliminates ability of legislators to earn certain perks associated with transportation, including, but not limited to, frequent-flier miles and reward points for hotel stays.

short_summary: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive
summary: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive.

short_summary: Relates to the preservation of electronic mail
summary: Relates to the preservation of electronic mail for a period of seven years.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members
summary: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members.

short_summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Peter Wheeler Memorial Bridge
summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in Tompkins county as the "Peter Wheeler Memorial Bridge".

short_summary: Relates to information concerning services for human trafficking victims in lactation rooms
summary: Relates to information concerning services for human trafficking victims in lactation rooms in Port of New York Authority terminals.

short_summary: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities
summary: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities; establishes a women's health education program; requires HIV and STD testing to be offered to incarcerated individuals; provides pregnant incarcerated individuals with access to prenatal vitamins as well as a specialized diet tailored to pregnancy needs; requires a study and report on women's health in prison.

short_summary: Enacts the "beauty justice act"
summary: Enacts the "beauty justice act"; provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics; prohibits the sale of personal care products and cosmetic products containing certain restricted products.

short_summary: Establishes a task force on missing women and girls who are black, indigenous and people of color
summary: Establishes a task force on missing women and girls who are black, indigenous and people of color (BIPOC) to develop policy changes that will work to address the lack of care and concern for missing and murdered BIPOC women and girls with New York state governmental agencies.

short_summary: Requires information concerning services for human trafficking victims to be provided in lactation rooms in Port Authority bus terminals
summary: Requires information concerning services for human trafficking victims to be provided in lactation rooms in Port Authority bus terminals.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish a cannabis awareness program for youths age eighteen and younger
summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish a cannabis awareness program for youths age eighteen and younger designed to educate about the effects and risks associated with cannabis use, including that it is illegal for persons under the age of twenty-one.

short_summary: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud
summary: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud; allows patients who have undergone assisted reproduction procedures to bring a cause of action if human reproductive material other than that which was consented to by the patient is used in such procedure; allows for compensatory and punitive damages.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a carbon farming tax credit for farmers
summary: Establishes a tax credit for farmers who maximize carbon sequestration potential through a "carbon farming" land management strategy; directs DEC to develop regulations related to certifying the amount of carbon sequestered or emissions reduced.

short_summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention
summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; removes the exception for controlled substances offenses for class A felonies.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention team program
summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.

short_summary: Establishes distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates and provides that the funding for such be deposited in the Alzheimer's disease assistance fund
summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

short_summary: Creates the teen driver safety commission
summary: Creates the teen driver safety commission consisting of 12 members; requires the commission to study, examine and review the issue of teen driver safety; requires the commission to report its findings, conclusions and recommendations.

short_summary: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date during a state disaster emergency
summary: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date upon the declaration of a state disaster emergency; excludes controlled substances.

short_summary: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity
summary: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity.

short_summary: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law
summary: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law.

short_summary: Directs board of standards and appeals in city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to the city and state legislators for the affected land
summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals and the city planning commission in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for and appeal of a variance to the city council member, borough president and state legislators for the affected land.

short_summary: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
summary: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

short_summary: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information
summary: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information.

short_summary: Requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; repealer
summary: Enacts the "educational equity and choice act"; requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; provides that such costs shall be approved by the commissioner of education and borne by the state; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete training in the prevention of human trafficking
summary: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete a course in the prevention of human trafficking; directs the commissioners of education and health to develop such training and regulations; directs that certain forfeited funds be used to reimburse actual costs expended for the development of such training.

short_summary: Relates to falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location
summary: Includes falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location as a felony offense under the crime of falsely reporting an incident in the second degree.

short_summary: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts
summary: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts; provides such provisions shall remain in effect for 3 years.

short_summary: Relates to amending the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote to be called on budget bills
summary: Amends the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote from being called by the governor or acting governor on any budget bills.

short_summary: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals
summary: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals.

short_summary: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers services for transgender, non-binary, and gender expansive people
summary: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers services for transgender, non-binary, and gender expansive people.

short_summary: Allows veterans with a service-connected disability or Purple Heart free use of parks and campsites
summary: Allows veterans with a service-connected disability or Purple Heart free use of parks and campsites; provides that such disability shall be 10 percent service-connected or greater.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax of 25 cents per $100 of principal debt
summary: Authorizes the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax of 25 cents per $100 of principal debt or obligation.

short_summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students
summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students residing in an area containing at least three hundred students within a one-mile radius.

short_summary: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime
summary: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses
summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses; provides that if a person is eligible for the exemption and predeceases his or her spouse, such surviving spouse shall be eligible for the exemption, provided, that all other requirements are satisfied.

short_summary: Clarifies extension of uniform land use review procedures to not-for-profit entities
summary: Clarifies the extension of uniform land use review procedures to any not-for-profit organization or corporation proposing to provide shelters to the homeless irrespective of any declaration of an emergency or a finding of need for immediate action.

short_summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

short_summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement
summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement when such incarcerated individual is in such confinement for a period in excess of twenty-four hours.

short_summary: Requires website providing sex offender registry information to be searchable by the zip code of a registrant's employment
summary: Requires websites providing sex offender registry information to be searchable by the zip code of a registrant's employment.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of larceny of a controlled substance
summary: Establishes the crime of larceny of a controlled substance making it an A-II felony to steal more than 25 dosage units of a schedule II, III, IV, or V controlled substance from a pharmacy.

short_summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to property owners within 1 mile
summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to property owners within 1 mile of the affected property.

short_summary: Relates to recreational therapy
summary: Relates to defining the practice of recreation therapy; establishes procedures for licensure of recreation therapists and requirements for continuing education for recreation therapists.

short_summary: Relates to the disposal of seized perishable or canned foods
summary: Relates to the disposal of seized perishable or canned foods; provide such foods should not be disposed of but should be donated to a food relief organization or homeless shelter.

short_summary: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases
summary: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.

short_summary: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of certain combat veterans until covered by the federal governmen
summary: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of combat veterans on active duty during Operation Enduring Freedom or Operation Iraqi Freedom, until covered by the federal government; directs the division of military and naval affairs to establish a registry of Afghanistan and Iraq veterans.

short_summary: Relates to the authorization of certain municipalities to participate in a community-wide energy aggregation program
summary: Authorizes certain municipalities to participate in a community-wide energy aggregation program where they can request bids, select an energy service provider, install energy efficiency measures and develop local renewable energy facilities to provide electric and/or gas supply services, including gas efficiency and renewable heating technologies to participating customers.

short_summary: Provides that credits for excess electricity generated by customer-generators subject to net energy metering may be carried over and used to offset electricity used
