summary: Establishes a division of early childhood within the office of children and family services to coordinate, consolidate and integrate early childhood programs.

short_summary: Creates the New York state social impact bond initiative
summary: Establishes a statewide pilot program modeled after the NYC social impact bond project to lower recidivism and improve the lives of 16-18 year olds in New York's correctional facilities.

short_summary: Establishes the presumption in matrimonial proceedings of awarding shared parenting of minor children
summary: Establishes the presumption in matrimonial proceedings for awarding shared parenting of minor children in the absence of an allegation that shared parenting would be detrimental to the best interests of the child; establishes an order of preference in awarding custody; defines shared parenting and parenting plan.

short_summary: Requires lending institutions that send unsolicited mail-loan checks to clearly state the interest rate and the total cost of loan in a dollar amount
summary: Requires lending institutions that send unsolicited mail-loan checks to clearly state in solicitation letter the interest rate to be applied to such loan and to demonstrate the total cost of loan in a dollar amount, at interest rate, over periods of six months, one year, and three years.

short_summary: Provides legal assistance to youth ordered by the court into the custody of the office of children and family services and placed or committed to a state operated juvenile detention center
summary: Provides legal assistance to youth ordered by the court into the custody of the office of children and family services and placed or committed to a state operated juvenile detention center.

short_summary: Directs the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations limiting the use of credit scores to determine automobile insurance premiums
summary: Directs the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations limiting the use of credit scores to determine automobile insurance premiums.

short_summary: Prohibits charitable organizations from using charitable donations for confidentiality agreements or closed settlement agreements
summary: Prohibits a charitable organization from using any charitable donations that the charitable organization receives to make any sort of payment that arises as a term of a confidentiality agreement or closed settlement agreement.

short_summary: Extends the authority of NYSARC, Inc., to maintain bonds
summary: Extends the authority of NYSARC, Inc., to maintain bonds until 2028.

short_summary: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers
summary: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers.

short_summary: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for certain deputy sheriffs transferring between the state and local employees' retirement system to the state and local police and fire retirement system
summary: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for members in the title of deputy sheriff who provided police protection or correction officer service transferring between the New York state and local employees' retirement system to the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

short_summary: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell
summary: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dana Kerstanski
summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dana Kerstanski.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of blood lead levels
summary: Relates to the definition of elevated blood lead levels; provides that elevated lead levels means a blood lead level greater than or equal to 3.5 micrograms of lead per deciliter of whole blood or such lower blood lead level as may be established by the department of health pursuant to rule or regulation.

short_summary: Relates to employee or prospective employee testing for the presence of tetrahydrocannabinols or marihuana as a condition of employment
summary: Relates to employee or prospective employee testing for the presence of tetrahydrocannabinols or marihuana as a condition of employment.

short_summary: Requires that certain persons and educators receive training in mental health
summary: Requires that all holders of a professional certificate in the classroom teaching service, holders of a level III teaching assistant certificate and holders of a professional certificate in the educational leadership service receive a minimum of three hours of training in mental health per year.

short_summary: Relates to the extension of an order of protection for aggravating circumstances
summary: Relates to the extension of an order of protection for aggravating circumstances; allows for a lifetime order of protection.

short_summary: Requires paid sick leave does not count against other paid time off
summary: Requires paid sick leave does not count against other paid time off.

short_summary: Relates to the full disclosure of ingredients in certain products
summary: Relates to the full disclosure of ingredients in certain products.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting members of law enforcement from using tear gas
summary: Prohibits members of law enforcement from using tear gas at any time.

short_summary: Requires a list of property owned by a state or local agency, public authority, or other political subdivision to be made publicly available
summary: Requires a list of property owned by a state or local agency, public authority, or other political subdivision to be made publicly available.

short_summary: Relates to behavioral health parity
summary: Relates to behavioral health parity; requires facilities to perform daily clinical review of a patient and consult periodically with the insurer regarding the patient's progress, course of treatment, and discharge plan; requires insurers to actively participate in facility-initiated periodic consultations prior to the patient's discharge; makes related provisions (Part A); provides that no policy shall require prior authorization for an initial or renewal prescription for drugs for the detoxification or maintenance of a substance use disorder; makes related provisions (Part B).

short_summary: Directs a feasibility study on installing solar panels on all public buildings
summary: Directs a feasibility study on installing solar panels on all public buildings.

short_summary: Includes removal or threat of removal of religious clothing as aggravated harassment in the second degree
summary: Includes removal or threat of removal of religious clothing as aggravated harassment in the second degree.

short_summary: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit
summary: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit which provides a tax credit to property owners who spend money to update a property to adhere to current applicable building and fire codes.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of the practice of pharmacy; repealer
summary: Relates to the definition of the practice of pharmacy; provides that the state board of pharmacy shall not adopt any rules authorizing a pharmacist to prescribe a controlled drug; repeals provisions related to the collaborative drug therapy management demonstration program.

short_summary: Requires solar panels on installed light fixtures
summary: Requires solar panels on installed light fixtures on all lands, including state parks and parkways, under the jurisdiction of the office.

short_summary: Relates to directing any moneys derived from new or increased taxes to reduce local real property taxes
summary: Directs any moneys derived from new or increased taxes be used to reduce local real property taxes.

short_summary: Relates to adding aggravated assault in the third degree to the penal law
summary: Provides for the addition of aggravated assault in the third degree to the penal law.

short_summary: Provides that either a person or an unborn child in any stage of gestation may be the victim of an assault

short_summary: Provides employment protections during the performance of state active duty by members of the national guard
summary: Provides employment protections during the performance of state active duty by members of the national guard; makes technical corrections.

short_summary: Relates to a real property tax exemption for property owned by certain persons performing active duty in a combat zone
summary: Authorizes municipalities to offer a real property tax exemption for property owned by certain persons performing active duty in a combat zone in an amount to the extent of fifteen percent of the assessed value of the real property, but shall not exceed twelve thousand dollars.

short_summary: Relates to the exchange or transfer of firearms, rifles and shotguns pursuant to a decedent's will and/or probate order
summary: Authorizes the exchange or transfer of firearms, rifles and shotguns pursuant to a decedent's will and/or probate order; prohibits transfers of large capacity ammunition feeding devices.

short_summary: Relates to permitting employees of public utilities access to certain restroom facilities without being a paying customer
summary: Permits employees of public utility corporations or public utility companies access to certain restroom facilities without being a paying customer.

short_summary: Relates to designating new automotive broker businesses
summary: Requires registration of new automotive broker businesses; enacts various provisions relating to conduct of such businesses; defines certain deceptive practices; establishes rights of action and penalties.

short_summary: Expands family leave eligibility to include participation in remote learning for certain employees who are the parents or guardians of certain children
summary: Expands family leave eligibility to include participation in remote learning for certain employees who are the parents or guardians of certain children.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program
summary: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program by restoring eligibility to graduate students; makes optional semesters, quarters or terms eligible for awards.

short_summary: Requires reporting to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program
summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to report to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program.

short_summary: Requires public schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.
summary: Requires public schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.

short_summary: Provides a tax abatement for facilty-integrated carbon-to-value equipment
summary: Provides a tax abatement for facility-integrated carbon-to-value equipment in a city with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Enacts the "education funding census update act"
summary: Enacts the "education funding census update act"; updates the census numbers used to calculate certain education funding.

short_summary: Prohibits legacy preference as eligible criteria for admission standards
summary: Prohibits legacy preference as eligible criteria for admission standards.

short_summary: Directs a study on the feasibility of adjusting the compulsory attendance age of minors attending full time instruction
summary: Directs a study on the feasibility of adjusting the compulsory attendance age of minors attending full time instruction; requires report and recommendations on or before July 1, 2025.

short_summary: Imposes a special tax on artwork, antique furniture, and antique jewelry sold at auction and establishes the art education fund
summary: Imposes a special tax of three-tenths of one percent or one dollar, whichever is greater, on the receipts from the sale of art, antique furniture or antique jewelry at auction; establishes the art education fund to provide assistance for art education and art supplies at the kindergarten through twelfth grade levels at Title I public schools.

short_summary: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 of a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 for a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes; authorizes local governments to elect such incentives; repeals the hybrid exemption after ten years.

short_summary: Provides for tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness
summary: Expands tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness.

short_summary: Relates to protecting people from civil arrest at certain locations
summary: Protects people from civil arrest while within one thousand feet of a sensitive location, unless such civil arrest is supported by a judicial warrant or judicial order authorizing such civil arrest.

short_summary: Relates to demand delivery accounts
summary: Requires each electric corporation to reclassify demand delivery accounts every one hundred twenty days and reset the demand delivery peak every ninety days whenever demand in kilowatts is equal to or less than twenty-five kilowatts in the immediately preceding three hundred sixty days; directs the public service commission to promulgate rules and regulations regarding demand delivery devices.

short_summary: Enacts the safeguarding employees and accountability for termination act
summary: Establishes certain rights and remedies for employees who are wrongfully discharged; establishes remedies for wrongful discharge; allows an employee or employer to make a written offer to arbitrate a dispute covered under this act; defines terms.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers
summary: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers; authorizes a pay differential for regional state park police, forest ranger, environmental conservation officer, and university police officer titles when wage rates of police officers in a given location are substantially higher than the wage rates paid by the state.

short_summary: Relates to reimbursing charter schools for leasing certain facilities, and prohibition of non-disclosure agreements; repealer
summary: Prohibits the city school district from reimbursing charter schools for leasing a privately owned or other publicly owned facility, and prohibits charter school employee contracts from including a non-disclosure agreement.

short_summary: Relates to compliance with substantially equivalent education by nonpublic schools
summary: Requires compliance with substantially equivalent education by nonpublic schools; outlines new requirements.

short_summary: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that permit discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression
summary: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have enacted a law that voids or repeals, or has the effect of voiding or repealing, existing state or local protections against discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression or have enacted a law that authorizes or requires discrimination against same-sex couples or their families or on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression, including any law that creates an exemption to antidiscrimination laws in order to permit discrimination against same-sex couples or their families or on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression.

short_summary: Provides for increased participation in state contracts and subcontracts by certified minority and women owned business enterprises
summary: Provides for increased participation in state contracts and subcontracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements.

short_summary: Prohibits employers from discriminating against individuals based on such individual's status as a caregiver
summary: Prohibits employers from discriminating against individuals based on such individual's status as a caregiver.

short_summary: Establishes commercial rent regulation
summary: Relates to establishing commercial rent regulation; establishes a right to renew leases and authorizes the rent guidelines board to establish maximum rents.

short_summary: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for members of the New York city fire department pension fund
summary: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for certain members; provides that in the computation of the normal service retirement benefit of members of the New York city fire department pension fund, there shall be no reduction for the primary social security retirement benefit.

short_summary: Provides for the review of policies and practices pertaining to emerging infectious disease outbreaks in correctional facilities
summary: Provides for the review of policies and practices pertaining to infectious disease outbreaks in correctional facilities, including the treatment and prevention of the disease among incarcerated individuals and staff.

short_summary: Requires election for registration for organ, eye and tissue donations to be included upon certain state forms; repealer
summary: Requires that space be provided on applications for the practice of a profession or occupation, state income tax returns, and applications to register a motor vehicle, for the applicant to register in the "donate life registry" for organ, eye and tissue donation established pursuant to section 4310 of the public health law.

short_summary: Provides for eligibility for medical assistance for personal care services for persons with traumatic brain injury, developmental disability, cognitive impairments, blindness or visual impairment
summary: Provides for eligibility for medical assistance for personal care services for persons with traumatic brain injury, developmental disability, cognitive impairments, blindness or visual impairment.

short_summary: Allows certain adult care facilities to arrange for limited nursing services
summary: Allows an adult home, enriched housing facility, assisted living residence or special needs assisted living residence to provide for nursing services in the facility that are not continual, either by arrangement with a provider of nursing services or by employment.

short_summary: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities
summary: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities; provides penalties for safety violations and operating without a valid license; prohibits reductions in fines in certain circumstances where a patient is endangered or harmed.

short_summary: Provides for payments for home and community based long term care services
summary: Provides for payments for home and community based long term care services; provides that funds appropriated to compensate for minimum wage requirements, shall not be subject to managed care risk adjustment on insurers.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing local municipalities to establish tourism improvement districts
summary: Authorizes local municipalities to establish or expand tourism improvement districts and provide services thereto.

short_summary: Relates to the inclusion of certain off-site custom fabrication as public work for the purposes of payment of prevailing wage
summary: Ensures that construction and fabrication done off of a public work site for specific use only in a public work project be compensated at the prevailing wage rate.

short_summary: Imposes an excise tax on the sale of ammunition to be deposited into the gun violence impact fund; establishing the gun violence impact fund
summary: Imposes an excise tax on the sale of ammunition to be deposited into the gun violence impact fund; establishes the gun violence impact fund; authorizes the director of the office of victim services to administer grants from the gun violence impact fund.

short_summary: Relates to the use of accrued vacation time
summary: Allows New York state employees to use accrued vacation time toward student loan payments; defines terms; requires the president of the civil service commission to promulgate necessary rules and regulations.

short_summary: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents
summary: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents.

short_summary: Elevates an assault of a retail worker to the class D felony of assault in the second degree
summary: Elevates an assault of a retail worker to the class D felony of assault in the second degree.

short_summary: Relates to early literacy education
summary: Requires school districts to provide instructional programming and services in reading and literacy which are evidence based and aligned with state standards; requires teachers in grades pre-K through five to attend professional development courses in reading education.

short_summary: Relates to requiring insurance policies to cover neuropsychological exams for dyslexia
summary: Requires insurance policies to cover neuropsychological exams for dyslexia under certain circumstances; caps coverage amount.

short_summary: Relates to the mandatory retirement age of judges and justices
summary: Provides a mandatory retirement age of 76 for judges and justices.

short_summary: Relates to the mandatory age of retirement for judges
summary: Raises the mandatory age of retirement for judges to seventy-six, with the ability of certain judges and justices to serve under a certified appointment until the age of eighty.

short_summary: Establishes the definition for legislation
summary: Establishes the definition for legislation; provides that such proposed language shall be presented in a clear and concise manner, be limited to 50 pages and use words that have common everyday meanings.

short_summary: Replaces the word addict or addicts with the words persons with substance use disorder or a variation thereof
summary: Replaces the words addict or addicts with the words person with substance use disorder or a variation thereof.

short_summary: Provides for additional requirements for issuing civil service examination announcements
summary: Requires civil service examination announcements to be issued to the local board of cooperative educational services (BOCES), high schools, colleges, universities, local social services districts, and job training programs.

short_summary: Relates to the suspension or demotion upon the abolition or reduction of non-competitive or labor class positions in the state service; repealer
summary: Conforms the suspension or demotion upon the abolition or reduction of non-competitive or labor class positions in the state service with such treatment for competitive class positions.

short_summary: Establishes Eid Ul-Fitr and Eid Ul-Adha as public holidays
summary: Establishes Eid Ul-Fitr and Eid Ul-Adha as public holidays, with dates established by religious law and tradition.

short_summary: Requires panic alarm systems in schools
summary: Provides that each public elementary and secondary school building shall be equipped with at least one panic alarm for use in a school security emergency including, but not limited to, a non-fire evacuation, lockdown, or active shooter situation; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Creates a pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee
summary: Creates a pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee; requires an annual report on the results of such program.

short_summary: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correctional officers
summary: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correction officers; provides that the commissioner of correction shall not appoint a person as a correction officer if such person is more than thirty-five years of age as of the date of the applicant's appointment or eligibility to compete in a promotion examination.

short_summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
summary: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system; provides that for New York city uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
summary: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system; creates a board to manage such fund and to make payments.

short_summary: Provides for crediting of probationary service
summary: Provides for crediting of probationary service when a person appointed provisionally in accordance with section sixty-five of the civil service law receives a permanent appointment to the same title.

short_summary: Provides for the continuation of state health benefit plans for certain survivors of employees of the state and/or of a political subdivision or of a public authority
summary: Provides for the continuation of state health benefit plans for certain survivors of employees of the state and/or of a political subdivision or of a public authority.

short_summary: Authorizes NYC to impose a fee on motor vehicles from states which do not cooperate with the enforcement of certain traffic laws
summary: Authorizes the imposition of a fifty dollar fee on vehicles entering NYC which are registered in states which do not cooperate with New York in the enforcement of traffic infractions through the use of photo-monitoring devices or signal monitoring systems.

short_summary: Relates to universal pre-K school bus transportation
summary: Relates to universal pre-K school bus transportation.

short_summary: Provides that dogs engaged in hunting and training as authorized by the environmental conservation law, shall not be deemed to be running at large
summary: Provides that dogs engaged in hunting and training as authorized by the environmental conservation law, shall not be deemed to be running at large in violation of any local law or ordinance.

short_summary: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits
summary: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits which lobby before the government.

short_summary: Relates to the disclosure of public employee disciplinary records
summary: Requires an agency responding to a request for public employee disciplinary records to develop a policy to notify the public employee whose personal information is subject to the request.

short_summary: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan
summary: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan.

short_summary: Relates to victims assistance
summary: Provides additional crime victims' rights; requires certain notifications.

short_summary: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate
summary: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate to represent interests of residential utility customers.

short_summary: Relates to certain promotions to lieutenant or sergeant in the detective bureau in the city of New York
summary: Relates to certain promotions to lieutenant or sergeant in the detective bureau in the city of New York.

short_summary: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree
summary: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree to include the use of certain devices or computers to gain access to, record, track or report the movement or location of a person or their property without the person's permission or authority to do so.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of forcible touching of a correction officer and increases criminal penalties for certain sexual offenses committed against correction officers
summary: Establishes the crime of forcible touching of a correction officer; increases criminal penalties for certain sexual offenses committed against correction officers when such correction officer is acting in the course of their employment.

short_summary: Exempts Staten Island residents from Verrazzano-Narrows bridge tolls
summary: Exempts Staten Island residents from Verrazzano-Narrows bridge tolls; directs the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to create applications for such exemptions.

short_summary: Relates to clarifying the standards for involuntary in-patient care and treatment
summary: Relates to involuntary in-patient mental health treatment where care and treatment in a hospital is essential to a person's welfare if, in the absence of such care and treatment, the person's mental illness is likely to result in serious harm.

short_summary: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain police officers
summary: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for police officers employed in a police force of a city with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to peace officers appointed by The Sea Gate Association
summary: Removes certain restrictions on peace officers appointed by The Sea Gate Association.

short_summary: Relates to offenses committed while in or upon a building, facility, property, vehicle or train owned, leased or operated by the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Relates to sexual abuse in the first degree where a person is incapable of consent while a passenger on public transportation and the contact was intentional and with the sole purpose of sexual gratification; relates to public lewdness while a passenger on public transportation; establishes enhanced penalties for offenses committed while in or upon a building, facility, property, vehicle or train owned, leased or operated by the metropolitan transportation authority; provides for the suspension or revocation of the use of a building, facility, property, vehicle or train owned, leased or operated by the metropolitan transportation authority.

short_summary: Enacts the lead pipe right to know act
summary: Enacts the lead pipe right to know act requiring public water systems to take service line inventories and make such information available to the public.

short_summary: Grants retroactive eligibility to apply for enhanced Tier 3 status to former New York City police officer Mark Rivera
summary: Grants retroactive eligibility to apply for enhanced Tier 3 status to former New York City police officer Mark Rivera.

short_summary: Relates to the reimbursement of certain certification examination fees
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to develop a program and provide for a system whereby teachers may submit examination receipts for any New York state teaching certifications earned after the first permanent teaching certification for reimbursement by the department of education for any additional certifications.

short_summary: Prohibits an individual convicted of a crime involving elder abuse from inheriting from the elder's estate as a distributee
summary: Prohibits an individual convicted of a crime involving elder abuse from inheriting from the elder's estate as a distributee.

short_summary: Relates to the geriatric demonstration program
summary: Relates to the geriatric demonstration program to promote mental health and home care collaboration; authorizes the commissioner of mental health to waive rules and regulations to address barriers to participation in the program.

short_summary: Requires the advisory council on maternal mortality and morbidity to undertake a review of the cesarean births at hospitals in the state
summary: Requires the advisory council on maternal mortality and morbidity to undertake a review of the cesarean births at hospitals in the state; requires two licensed midwives to be on the advisory council.

short_summary: Relates to continuing education requirements for the profession of psychology
summary: Requires coursework in the area of diversity, equity and inclusion as part of continuing education requirements for the profession of psychology.

short_summary: Relates to the placement of a discreet disability designation on non-driver identification cards, drivers' licenses and learners' permits and making technical and conforming changes
summary: Provides for the placement of a discreet disability designation on non-driver identification cards, drivers' licenses and learners' permits; makes technical and conforming changes.

short_summary: Provides for the performance of medical services by physician assistants
summary: Permits the performance of medical services by a physician assistant without the supervision of a physician as appropriate to the physician assistant's scope of practice, education and training where such physician assistant has practiced for more than three thousand six hundred hours.

short_summary: Relates to distinctive license plates issued to congressional medal of honor recipients
summary: Provides for the issuance of distinctive license plates to the spouse of a congressional medal of honor recipient, and the transfer of distinctive license plates issued to congressional medal of honor recipients who are now deceased to their surviving spouse.

short_summary: Relates to increasing the retention percentage for certain motor vehicle service fees
summary: Relates to increasing the retention percentage for certain motor vehicle service fees.

short_summary: Grants an exemption for the purchase of certain tangible personal property and services used in the operation of recreational skiing facilities from state sales and compensating use tax
summary: Grants an exemption for the purchase of energy efficient snow making equipment, ski lift equipment, snow grooming equipment, and the production of snow by a recreational ski facility from state sales and compensating use tax.

short_summary: Exempts from sales and use tax zero-emission school buses
summary: Exempts from sales and use tax zero-emission school buses and any and all parts and pieces of equipment used in their operation.

short_summary: Requires policies for the use of automatic license plate reader systems
summary: Requires the consumer protection division to promulgate a policy governing the use of automatic license plate reader systems by non-law enforcement agencies; requires such non-law enforcement agencies to conspicuously post such policy on their website or in their place of business.

short_summary: Lowers the threshold for eligibility for the appropriation of moneys for the promotion of agriculture and domestic arts
summary: Lowers the threshold for eligibility for the appropriation of moneys for the promotion of agriculture and domestic arts from five thousand dollars to two thousand five hundred dollars.

short_summary: Provides for information concerning services for human trafficking victims
summary: Provides for information concerning services for human trafficking victims in transit facilities operated by the metropolitan transportation authority.

short_summary: Relates to the description of the arms of the state and the state flag
summary: Removes the phrase E pluribus unum from the arms of the state and the state flag.

short_summary: Relates to enabling public employers to offer certain temporary retirement incentives for certain public employees
summary: Enables public employers to offer an age fifty-five with ten years of service or age fifty with twenty-five years of service temporary retirement incentives for certain public employees.

short_summary: Authorizes a veteran's close friend or family member who is reasonably familiar with such veteran's wishes to request that such veteran be buried in a state veterans' cemetery
summary: Authorizes a veteran's close friend or family who is reasonably familiar with such veteran's wishes to request that such veteran be buried in a state veterans' cemetery.

short_summary: Relates to registration of non-bank automated teller machines
summary: Requires the registration and regulation of non-bank automated teller machines.

short_summary: Establishes the LGBTQ+ advisory board
summary: Establishes the LGBTQ+ advisory board to make recommendations, conduct research, and more regarding the LGBTQ+ community in New York state.

short_summary: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board, and to oversight of registered cannabis organizations
summary: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board; relates to seed-to-sale tracking and reporting for registered cannabis organizations; relates to state and local inspections of registered cannabis organizations.

short_summary: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region
summary: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region for the 2023-2024 school year and thereafter.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.

short_summary: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county
summary: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county.

short_summary: Authorizes county boards of elections to establish county-wide polling places
summary: Authorizes county boards of elections to establish county-wide polling places where any person entitled to vote in such county by personal appearance may so vote on the day of a primary election or general election, subject to approval by the state board of elections.

short_summary: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance
summary: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing William Schumaker and Mark Hennessy to receive certain service credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
summary: Authorizes William Schumaker and Mark Hennessy to receive certain service credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

short_summary: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County
summary: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County.

short_summary: Names a portion of route 202 in the town of Yorktown the  Captain Kenneth Sgroi Memorial Highway
summary: Names a portion of route 202 in the town of Yorktown the "Captain Kenneth Sgroi Memorial Highway".

short_summary: Provides for restructuring unsustainable sovereign and subnational debt
summary: Provides for restructuring unsustainable sovereign and subnational debt; provides a voluntary petition for relief may be filed with the state.

short_summary: Relates to excluding from state income tax unemployment benefits received during the COVID-19 pandemic
summary: Relates to excluding from state income tax unemployment benefits received during the COVID-19 pandemic; issues a refund for any such taxes paid by a taxpayer.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the chair of the state liquor authority to make certain quarterly reports
summary: Requires the chair of the state liquor authority to make quarterly reports to the governor and the legislature of the authority's enforcement activities for the preceding quarter.

short_summary: Requires health and motor vehicle insurance policies to notify policyholders of cancellation, discontinuance or major changes to their policy via email
summary: Requires health and motor vehicle insurance policies to notify policyholders of cancellation, discontinuance or major changes to their policy via email and to offer paperless notification upon the issuance of such policies.

short_summary: Provides that the police commissioner of the city of New York and all other cities with a population of one hundred thousand or more shall be an elected office
summary: Provides that the police commissioner of the city of New York and all other cities with a population of one hundred thousand or more shall be an elected office with a four-year term; provides that such office shall be subject to term limits of two terms.

short_summary: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots
summary: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots in order to have their votes counted.

short_summary: Relates to requiring free internet service in households with students who live at or below the poverty level
summary: Requires free internet service in households with students who live at or below the poverty level; directs broadband companies to install and/or upgrade broadband services in educational facilities.

short_summary: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to certain associates of the corporation
summary: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to any board member, officer, or employee of the corporation, any contractor, subcontractor, consultant, or other agent of the corporation, or any spouse, child, sibling or parent of such persons; adds reporting requirements for regional off-track betting corporations.

short_summary: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles
summary: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles by board members, officers, employees, contractors, subcontractors, consultants, or agents of such corporation or by certain family members of such individuals; provides an exception therefor.

short_summary: Establishes a tax on digital ads
summary: Establishes a tax on annual gross revenue derived from digital ads.

short_summary: Relates to the membership of the board of directors of the western regional off-track betting corporation
summary: Relates to the membership of the board of directors of the western regional off-track betting corporation.

short_summary: Relates to political contributions by corporations
summary: Prohibits schedule B contributions on campaign finance filings.

short_summary: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments
summary: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments for the purposes of designing and carrying out youth activities organized by the department.

short_summary: Establishes the "It's Your Data Act"
summary: Establishes the "It's Your Data Act" for the purposes of providing protections and transparency in the collection, use, retention, and sharing of personal information.

short_summary: Requires SUNY and CUNY schools to refund students for housing credits and boarding charges used or charged for the period of time when such schools are closed or shut down due to the coronavirus pandemic
summary: Requires SUNY and CUNY schools to refund students for housing credits and boarding charges used or charged for the period of time when such schools are closed or shut down due to the coronavirus pandemic.

short_summary: Places a moratorium on selling property tax warrants for the period of the COVID-19 state of emergency
summary: Places a moratorium on municipalities selling property tax warrants to private companies for the period of the COVID-19 state of emergency.

short_summary: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between hearing-impaired persons and law enforcement personnel
summary: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between deaf and hard of hearing individuals and law enforcement personnel.

short_summary: Provides for a two percent cap on rate increases imposed by utilities
summary: Provides for a two percent cap on rate increases imposed by utilities.

short_summary: Relates to the submission of environmental impact statements by entities proposing construction of a new building development within one mile of a transit facility
summary: Requires the commissioner to promulgate rules and regulations requiring entities proposing construction of a new building development within one mile of a transit facility to submit environmental impact statements; defines transit facility.

short_summary: Creates a pilot program to encourage homeownership among persons and groups who are currently underrepresented and/or have seen a marked decline in rates of homeownership
summary: Creates a pilot program to encourage homeownership among persons and groups who are currently underrepresented in homeownership and/or have seen a marked decline in rates of homeownership over the last decade; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_summary: Relates to suspending the registration of a vehicle for evading cashless tolls
summary: Provides that no suspension of a registration shall occur for a violation regarding cashless tolls absent clear evidence of an owner's intent to repeatedly evade paying such tolls.

short_summary: Requires the New York city department of sanitation to remove any snow or ice accumulation in front of any fire hydrants
summary: Amends the provision requiring owners, lessees or tenants to remove any obstructions in front of fire hydrants to require the New York city department of sanitation to remove any snow or ice accumulation in front of any such fire hydrants.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a task force to study and report on the potential implementation of blockchain technology in state record keeping, information storage, and service delivery
summary: Relates to establishing a task force to study and report on the potential implementation of blockchain technology in state record keeping, information storage, and service delivery.

short_summary: Provides a one hundred dollar per day credit to customers of electric and gas corporations for power outages of twenty-four hours or more
summary: Provides a one hundred dollar per day credit to customers of electric and gas corporations for power outages of twenty-four hours or more.

short_summary: Relates to creating NYCHA-based health centers
summary: Relates to creating NYCHA-based health centers to provide basic health services for residents living on NYCHA campuses, specifically specialty care and testing for lead poisoning and mold exposure and specifically respiratory related illnesses.

short_summary: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers
summary: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers.

short_summary: Relates to including comprehensive climate change risk analysis as part of every environmental assessment statement and requiring updates to rules and regulations regarding the state environmental quality review
summary: Includes comprehensive climate change risk analysis as part of every environmental assessment statement; requires updates to rules and regulations regarding the state environmental quality review no less than every five years.

short_summary: Relates to the timeframe for filing pre-trial motions in criminal cases
summary: Relates to the timeframe for filing pre-trial motions in criminal cases.

short_summary: Relates to judicial compensation
summary: Decreases the membership and removes judicial compensation from the purview of the commission on legislative, judicial and executive compensation; provides for determination of and a cost of living adjustment for judges and justices of the unified court system.

short_summary: Relates to determination of salary base for members of the city of New York fire department pension fund
summary: Relates to determination of salary base for members of the city of New York fire department pension fund.

short_summary: Relates to the payment of wages for certain persons employed in a bona fide executive, administrative, or professional capacity
summary: Increases the threshold for applicability of wage payment protections for certain persons employed in a bona fide executive, administrative, or professional capacity, from $900 to $1,300 per week.

short_summary: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit
summary: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit to qualifying employees.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting certain discriminatory peremptory challenges to prospective jurors
summary: Prohibits peremptory challenges of prospective jurors based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, religion, religious practice, age, disability, or sexual orientation.

short_summary: Relates to presumptions for injured workers who have not refused an offer of reemployment
summary: Relates to the presumption that an injured worker who has not refused an offer of reemployment from his or her employer has not voluntarily withdrawn from the labor market for compensation purposes.

short_summary: Establishes contingency management services for certain persons with substance use disorders
summary: Requires the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to provide contingency management services, including financial incentives, for persons with addiction disorders who abstain from substance abuse and comply with treatment objectives.

short_summary: Establishes the fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention task force
summary: Establishes the fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention task force to conduct a comprehensive study on fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention and to report on the findings and recommendations of the task force.

short_summary: Increases the offense classification for certain assault offenses regarding police officers and peace officers
summary: Increases the offense classification for certain assault offenses regarding police officers and peace officers.

short_summary: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for transvaginal ultrasounds during pregnancy
summary: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for transvaginal ultrasounds during pregnancy.

short_summary: Prohibits sex offenders whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a facility where pre-kindergarten or kindergarten instruction is provided
summary: Prohibits a sex offender whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a facility where pre-kindergarten or kindergarten instruction is provided.

short_summary: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies
summary: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies.

short_summary: Relates to safe staffing for public employees of institutional settings
summary: Relates to safe staffing for public employees of institutional settings by setting maximum overtime levels.

short_summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment by means of electronic or digital communication and provides for a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination or publication of deep fakes
summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment by means of electronic or digital communication; provides for a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination or publication of deep fakes, which are digitized images which are altered to incorporate a person's face or their identifiable body part onto an image and such image depicts a pornographic or lewd sex act or graphic violence.

short_summary: Provides an incarcerated individual time for mental health services
summary: Provides that, to the extent practicable, any incarcerated individual who is receiving mental health services or participating in a mental health program shall not have the time spent participating in such mental health services or programs deducted from any other activity time such incarcerated individual receives.

short_summary: Provides for reimbursement of unused one-way, round trip, or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company
summary: Provides for the reimbursement of the ticket price of unused one-way, round trip or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company if returned within one year.

short_summary: Restricts the use of advanced metering infrastructure devices by electric, gas and water-works corporations
summary: Restricts the use of advanced metering infrastructure devices by electric, gas and water-works corporations; requires utilities to provide notice to customers before installation of a two-way smart meter; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the indemnification of directors, officers and key persons; and to repeal sections 721, 722 and 723 of the not-for-profit corporation law; repealer
summary: Relates to the indemnification of directors, officers and key persons; ensures the survival of indemnification in case of a merger or consolidation of a corporation; provides that once a right to indemnification arises, it continues to benefit a former director, officer or key person's and her or his heirs and estate; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a "yellow alert system" for law enforcement to publicize vehicle information in instances of hit-and-run accidents
summary: Establishes a "yellow alert system" for law enforcement to publicize vehicle information in instances of hit-and-run accidents in which a person has been killed.

short_summary: Requires insurers which issue contracts providing long term care benefits to maintain records of policies cancelled due to increased premiums
summary: Requires insurers which issue contracts providing long term care benefits to maintain records of policies cancelled during each year and requires that such records indicate which policies were cancelled due to, or within thirty days after, an increase in policy premiums.

short_summary: Requires all public authorities owning, leasing, and controlling critical infrastructure to study the potential consequences of privatization
summary: Requires all public authorities owning, leasing, and controlling critical infrastructure to study the potential consequences of privatization.

short_summary: Makes provisions relating to the collateral estoppel effect of issues decided by certain arbitrators
summary: Enacts the "fairness for accident victims act"; provides that with respect to a serious personal injury action still permissible under the no-fault insurance system, the award or decision of an arbitrator or master arbitrator rendered in a no-fault arbitration will not constitute a collateral estoppel of the issues arbitrated.

short_summary: Requires insurer to respond within thirty days of a request from an insured for his or her health plan documents
summary: Requires insurer to respond within thirty days of a written request from an insured for his or her health plan documents, including copies of most recent group or individual contracts.

short_summary: Mandates budget expenditures by gas and electric corporations to improve power outage response and to stormproof power lines
summary: Relates to mandating budget expenditures by gas and electric corporations to improve power outage response and to stormproof power lines.

short_summary: Enacts the statewide transportation authority reinvestment (STAR) act of 2023
summary: Enacts the statewide transportation authority reinvestment (STAR) act; exempts mass transit authorities from bond issuance charges.

short_summary: Requires gas corporations and electric corporations in this state to file quarterly reports with the legislature regarding infrastructure upgrades
summary: Requires gas corporations and electric corporations in this state to file quarterly reports with the legislature regarding infrastructure upgrades.

short_summary: Relates to requiring the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least one hundred percent
summary: Requires the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least one hundred percent by posting on the utility company's website.

short_summary: Requires what mortgage applicants need to know pamphlet on residential mortgages
summary: Requires the development of a "what mortgage applicants need to know" pamphlet on residential mortgages; provides such pamphlet shall be posted and printed in the 6 most common non-English languages spoken by individuals with limited English proficiency in New York state.

short_summary: Requires the educational and vocational credits earned by incarcerated individuals are transferable upon release
summary: Requires that curricula and educational programs provide incarcerated individuals the opportunity to earn educational or vocational credits which shall be transferable to an educational institution upon the release of the incarcerated individual.

short_summary: Relates to an annual report of department statistics
summary: Relates to an annual report of department statistics.

short_summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

short_summary: Provides for a 5% automobile insurance premium reduction for non-commercial passenger motor vehicles equipped with an operating dashboard camera
summary: Provides for a 5% automobile insurance premium reduction for non-commercial passenger motor vehicles equipped with an operating dashboard camera; establishes means for certification of the installation of such camera; establishes civil penalties for false certification of such installation; provides for insurer review during claims settlement of the images from dashboard cameras; provides for the certification of the installation of operating dashboard cameras during the annual motor vehicle inspection; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish standards for dashboard cameras; provides for the introduction as evidence of dashboard camera images into evidence in civil and criminal proceedings.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of an advisory board within the department of agriculture and markets on food safety and inspection programs
summary: Requires the creation of a thirteen member advisory board within the department of agriculture and markets on food safety and inspection programs; establishes such board is to advise, counsel and confer with the commissioner of agriculture and markets on matters dealing with enforcement of laws and regulations regarding food safety and protection and shall make recommendations regarding any necessary statutory or regulatory changes.

short_summary: Provides the New York city water board shall not establish a limit of less than six years to challenge any service charges for the use of or services furnished by the water board
summary: Provides the NYC water board shall not establish a limit of less than six years to challenge any fee, rate, rent or other service charges for the use of or services furnished by the water board and/or sewerage systems.

short_summary: Grants peace officer status to the reserve deputies of the Erie county sheriff's office
summary: Grants peace officer status to the reserve deputies of the Erie county sheriff's office.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to firefighter Scott Pavlick
summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to firefighter Scott Pavlick.

short_summary: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county
summary: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county; extends such authority until November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Provides for a taxpayer assistance authorization for households in the county of Schenectady
summary: Provides for a taxpayer assistance authorization for households in the county of Schenectady; provides for a $250 rebate for property owners in Schenectady county with a qualifying STAR exemption or school tax relief credit.

short_summary: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Essex county
summary: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Essex county including assistant public defender.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben
summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates
summary: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates until December 1, 2025.

short_summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
summary: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2025.

short_summary: Relates to building permits
summary: Authorizes a city, town or village to establish a program whereby a building permit may be issued based upon certification by a registered architect or professional engineer.

short_summary: Relates to procurement requirements for end point device security
summary: Directs that state agencies require that procurement of personal computing goods, services and solutions meet the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework.

short_summary: Relates to tuition assistance program awards for dual or concurrent enrollment coursework
summary: Relates to tuition assistance program awards for dual or concurrent enrollment coursework; awards dual or concurrent enrollment program awards for payment annually to school districts in which dual or concurrent enrollment programs are located.

short_summary: Relates to providing reforms to the New York state worker adjustment and retraining notification act; repealer
summary: Removes the exclusion of part-time employees from certain definitions relating to employment and expanding the definition of employer; removes certain exclusions for employer notice requirements for the closing of a facility; removes the discretionary reduction of penalties for employers for certain acts or omissions concerning notice requirements for mass layoffs, relocations or employment loss; removes the maximum time period for determining back pay and other liabilities for certain employees who experience employment loss; allows the attorney general to take certain action to assist certain employees in receiving back pay and other liabilities; requires employers to pay severance to employees when there is a plant closing, relocation, or mass layoff.

short_summary: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase
summary: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase from three years to four years; provides that the provisions of such act shall not be subject to the requirement that the state shall make an equal payment to the retirement system.

short_summary: Relates to restricting advertisements for alcoholic beverages
summary: Restricts advertisements for alcoholic beverages; requires an alcoholism hotline number on each advertisement; requires the State Liquor Authority to promulgate rules that require licensees to implement responsible drinking programs that include comprehensive employee trainings on responding to circumstances in which individuals present signs of alcohol abuse or suffering from the disease of alcoholism and requirements for such licensee or permit holder to assess, prevent, and address alcohol abuse by users under the age of thirty.

short_summary: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program
summary: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program.

short_summary: Relates to reporting of digital assets on the annual statement of financial disclosure
summary: Relates to reporting of digital assets on the annual statement of financial disclosure filed with the legislative ethics commission or the joint commission on public ethics.

short_summary: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax
summary: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax to 2025.

short_summary: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies
summary: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies; relates to the inference of an assignee's intent and purpose in taking an assignment of a claim against an obligor that is not an eligible obligor.

short_summary: Establishes the New York state local emergency services account
summary: Establishes the New York state local emergency services account; provides reimbursement for expenses incurred related to procurement of any equipment including radio and communication items, apparatus, vehicles including snowmobiles, all terrain vehicles, and boats, goods or services related to the renovation of any buildings, and personal protective equipment.

short_summary: Relates to pregnant and postpartum individuals and their children's health coverage and information
summary: Expands coverage for pregnant and postpartum individuals and their children; establishes a health expense account program for pregnant and postpartum individuals; requires the creation of informative pamphlets on maternal depression.

short_summary: Provides that a dealer-controlled electronic table game shall not be considered a slot machine
summary: Provides that a dealer-controlled electronic table game shall not be considered a slot machine.

short_summary: Enacts the "New York City Training And Comprehension of Trauma in Children (TACTIC) Act"
summary: Enacts the "New York City Training And Comprehension of Trauma in Children (TACTIC) Act"; establishes the TACTIC council; provides for a trauma informed care training program to teachers in schools located in the city of New York; creates a department of child trauma informed care to assist with parenting workshops, to assign trauma informed care specialists to schools and to report to the TACTIC council regarding child trauma informed care provided to schools in the city of New York.

short_summary: Establishes a private cause of action for certain violations regarding machine-guns, assault weapons, disguised guns, ghost guns, and unfinished frames or receivers
summary: Establishes a private cause of action for certain violations regarding machine-guns, assault weapons, disguised guns, ghost guns, and unfinished frames or receivers.

short_summary: Authorizes Michael V. Layman to receive state police retirement credit for services performed as a SUNY police officer
summary: Authorizes Michael V. Layman to receive state police retirement credit for services performed as a SUNY police officer.

short_summary: Requires discrimination, bias, and harassment prevention training for members of state boards and commissions
summary: Requires discrimination, bias, and harassment prevention training for members of state boards and commissions.

short_summary: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof
summary: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof.

short_summary: Provides for consumer protection and utility meter choice
summary: Establishes certain consumer rights for the protection of consumer health, safety and/or privacy needs related to utility meters.

short_summary: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
summary: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

short_summary: Relates to establishing a remote maternal health services pilot program for Medicaid recipients
summary: Relates to establishing a remote maternal health services pilot program for Medicaid recipients; provides that such program shall be established during fiscal years 2024-2025, 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 to provide: remote maternal health services to eligible Medicaid recipients, medically necessary remote maternal health services to such eligible recipients for up to 12 months postpartum and payment to healthcare providers who provide remote maternal health services.

short_summary: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use
summary: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use.

short_summary: Provides an exception from professional misconduct for reproductive health care services or gender-affirming care
summary: Provides an exception from professional misconduct for the performance, recommendation, or provision of any reproductive health services or gender-affirming care by a health care practitioner performing in the scope of their duties.

short_summary: Makes permanent certain provisions of chapter 22 of the laws of 2014, relating to expanding opportunities for service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises
summary: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to expanding opportunities for service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises.

short_summary: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process
summary: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process.

short_summary: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law
summary: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law and coverage for usual and customary costs for out-of-network health care service.

short_summary: Provides that employment provisions that require an employee to assign certain inventions shall be unenforceable
summary: Provides that employment provisions that require an employee to assign certain inventions that are made on the employee's own time and which do not use the employer's equipment, supplies, facilities, or trade secret information shall be unenforceable.

short_summary: Establishes criteria for the sale of automated employment decision tools
summary: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools; provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

short_summary: Relating to notice of a tax exemption for persons with disabilities and limited incomes
summary: Requires an assessor to send a second copy of the application and notice for a real property tax exemption to persons with disabilities and limited incomes thirty days prior to the appropriate taxable status date.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting the sale of infant walkers and restricting the use of such infant walkers in certain settings
summary: Prohibits the sale of infant walkers; restricts the use of such infant walkers in certain settings.

short_summary: Relates to the transparency and quality of care of operators of adult care facilities
summary: Relates to the transparency and quality of care of operators of adult care facilities; requires certain applicants for adult care facilities to provide an opportunity for public comment on the application.

short_summary: Relates to the certification of dietitians and nutritionists
summary: Allows certified dietitians and nutritionists to order therapeutic diets.

short_summary: Enacts the Critical Infrastructure Standards and Procedures Act
summary: Enacts the "critical infrastructure standards and procedures (CRISP) act".

short_summary: Relates to disqualification from receiving unemployment benefits when the claimant's employer maintained, refused or failed to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable
summary: Relates to disqualification from receiving benefits for separation from employment in cases where the claimant's employer maintained or refused to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable.

short_summary: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; and provides penalties for violations
summary: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; requires manufacturers of products containing PFAS to provide notice of such fact to persons that offer the products for sale or distribution; provides penalties for violations.

short_summary: Relates to preclaim review for participating providers of medical assistance program services and items
summary: Requires a verification organization to declare each service or item to be verified or unverified within thirty days of receiving all required supporting documentation from a participating provider.

short_summary: Relates to expanding access to advanced courses to improve educational equity
summary: Relates to expanding access to advanced courses to improve educational equity beginning with notification to parents and students on the benefits and opportunities offered as well as automatic enrollment opportunities.

short_summary: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and shared use locker technologies
summary: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and facilities that combine multiple deliveries from different suppliers to a central location to be delivered inside the service area, and shared use locker technologies as final delivery locations.

short_summary: Repeals section 926-o of the general municipal law relating to the Town of Niagara industrial development agency
summary: Repeals provisions relating to the Town of Niagara industrial development agency.

short_summary: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
summary: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

short_summary: Relates to the delivery of the good faith deposit following award of the bonds to the successful bidder
summary: Relates to the delivery of the good faith deposit following award of the bonds to the successful bidder; provides that a municipality, school district or district corporation may require that such deposit be made as a condition precedent to the consideration of a bid for the bonds.

short_summary: Removes the requirement that where a municipal corporation, school district or district corporation issues indebtedness to finance certain costs of preparation of plans and specifications
summary: Removes the requirement that where a municipal corporation, school district or district corporation issues indebtedness to finance certain costs of preparation of plans and specifications for a proposed capital improvement there must be a waiting period of at least one year authorizing the undertaking of the capital improvement.

short_summary: Relates to installments of bonds; repealer
summary: Permanently requires that the first installment of serial bonds mature not later than two years after the date of such bonds; provides that principal installments remaining unpaid on bonds may be called for redemption prior to their date of maturity in such amounts, at such times in such manner and pursuant to such terms as may be determined by the finance board of a municipality, school district or corporation at the time of the issuance thereof; repeals provisions that permanently eliminate the requirement that municipalities provide from current funds an amount equal to at least 5% of the estimated cost of each capital improvement (excluding from such cost state or federal grant funding and certain benefited area assessments) prior to the issuance of bonds or bond anticipation notes to finance such capital improvement.

short_summary: Creates a distinctive license plate for veterans honoring Borinqueneers
summary: Creates a distinctive license plate for veterans honoring Borinqueneers; defines "veteran" as a person who is a resident of this state, who served in the armed forces of the United States, and was honorably discharged from the armed forces, or has a qualifying condition, as defined in section one of the veterans' services law, and has received a discharge other than bad conduct or dishonorable from such service, or is a discharged LGBT veteran, as defined in section one of the veterans' services law, and has received a discharge other than bad conduct or dishonorable from such service.

short_summary: Relates to the health care transformation fund
