summary: Relates to parametric insurance; requires insurers providing parametric insurance include certain disclosures in the application for the policy; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to anti-concurrent causation clauses
summary: Requires insurance policies which cover certain water or water-borne material damage also cover certain damage caused directly or indirectly by an excluded peril contributing concurrently or in any sequence.

short_summary: Authorizes temporary retail permit holders to purchase alcoholic beverages on credit terms
summary: Authorizes temporary retail permit holders to purchase alcoholic beverages on credit terms.

short_summary: Relates to service by former housing court judges of the New York city civil court as judicial hearing officers
summary: Provides that any person who has served as a state-paid judge or justice of a court of the unified court system or as a housing judge of the housing portion of the civil court of the city of New York, but who no longer holds any of such offices, may apply to be designated as a judicial hearing officer.

short_summary: Relates to name changes of children
summary: Authorizes an application to be made in family court for the name change of a child under eighteen as part of a pending, related proceeding; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes Kolel Rachmistrivka to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
summary: Authorizes Kolel Rachmistrivka to file an application for exemption from real property taxes.

short_summary: Requires the board of directors of a cooperative apartment corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request
summary: Requires the board of directors of a cooperative apartment corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request.

short_summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth
summary: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth.

short_summary: Relates to an exemption for certain property located in the county of Tompkins from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
summary: Relates to an exemption for certain property located in the county of Tompkins from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school or church.

short_summary: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act
summary: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act to provide for policies, guidelines and training opportunities to effectively and appropriately prevent student suicide, intervene in crisis situations, and support college communities in postvention.

short_summary: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements
summary: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements; defines terms; establishes powers and duties of the department of labor and of licensees with regards to such licenses; establishes penalties; establishes the radon mitigation and control fund.

short_summary: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters
summary: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters due to their increased risk for cancer and cancer-related diseases.

short_summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to establish hotel and motel taxes of up to five percent
summary: Authorizes the city of Binghamton to establish hotel and motel taxes of up to five percent.

short_summary: Relates to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington
summary: Extends provisions relating to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington for one year.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
summary: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant; declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

short_summary: Establishes the climate protection insurance act
summary: Establishes the climate protection insurance act to implement climate leadership and community protection act targets for insurers and establishes reporting requirements related to such targets; defines communities vulnerable to bluelining and identifies and protects such communities.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees
summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study to examine and update the requirements of safety inspections conducted to ensure the operational safety of all motor vehicles; requires a report; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Requires persons driving on a state expressway or thruway to pull over and seek assistance if their vehicle is unable to exceed thirty-five miles per hour
summary: Requires persons driving on a state expressway route, state interstate route, or state thruway route to pull over and seek assistance if their vehicle is unable to exceed thirty-five miles per hour.

short_summary: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game
summary: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game that are dead, wounded or injured.

short_summary: Prohibits robots and uncrewed aircraft equipped or mounted with weapons
summary: Prohibits the manufacture, modification, sale, transfer, equipping, use, or operation of a robotic device or an uncrewed aircraft equipped or mounted with a weapon within the state.

short_summary: Repeals article 21 of the tax law relating to imposition of a highway use tax for the privilege of operating any vehicular unit upon the public highways
summary: Repeals provisions relating to imposition of a highway use tax for the privilege of operating any vehicular unit upon the public highways of the state.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing qui tam proceedings for civil violations of the cannabis law
summary: Authorizes qui tam proceedings for civil violations of the cannabis law.

short_summary: Enacts the cannabis adult-use cultivator fairness act
summary: Enacts the "cannabis adult-use cultivator fairness act"; establishes any adult-use cultivator licensee that was formerly a conditional adult-use cultivator licensee may, in its sole discretion and within ninety days of the effective date of this subdivision, elect to cultivate up to twenty-five thousand square feet of flowering canopy in a greenhouse or aquaponics facility with immediate authorization to use unlimited artificial lighting.

short_summary: Relates to coroner qualifications
summary: Requires any elected or appointed coroner who is not a licensed physician to be a certified nurse practitioner or licensed physician assistant authorized to practice medicine in this state.

short_summary: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Erie and a supreme court library at Erie
summary: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Erie and a supreme court library at Erie.

short_summary: Relates to admitting evidence of similar crimes in sexual offense cases
summary: Permits admission into evidence of similar crimes in sexual offense cases.

short_summary: Relates to environmental quality reviews of certain housing development projects
summary: Relates to environmental quality reviews of housing development projects that propose to build twenty or more units; provides that municipalities shall not be prohibited from performing their own environmental reviews.

short_summary: Relates to the sale of a mortgaged premises after a judgment of sale has been entered
summary: Provides that a judgment of sale as a result of an action to foreclose a mortgage shall direct the mortgaged premises to be sold within forty-five days of the date of the judgment.

short_summary: Exempts minority depository institutions from certain filing requirements
summary: Exempts minority depository institutions which are subject to the Community Reinvestment Act of 1977 from report and document filing requirements with the superintendent of financial services for a period of ten years from commencement of business.

short_summary: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for certain sites
summary: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located within the Renaissance Commerce Park situate within the city of Lackawanna, Erie county.

short_summary: Requires warnings on generative artificial intelligence systems
summary: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system to conspicuously display a warning on the system's user interface that is reasonably calculated to consistently apprise the user that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate and/or inappropriate.

short_summary: Relates to disability retirement benefits for deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations
summary: Provides accidental disability retirement benefits for deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, and cleanup operations.

short_summary: Relates to the waiver of certain court costs, fees, and expenses for persons of insufficient means
summary: Relates to the waiver of costs, fees, and expenses for persons of insufficient means; removes the phrase "poor persons" from article 11 of the civil practice law and rules and the criminal procedure law.

short_summary: Extends provisions of law related to buildings that are part of urban development action area projects and are rehabilitated with municipal loans
summary: Extends provisions of law related to buildings that are part of urban development action area projects and are rehabilitated with municipal loans.

short_summary: Extends the provisions of chapter 777 of the laws of 1986 relating to small loans to owners of multiple dwellings to remove substandard or insanitary conditions
summary: Extends the provisions relating to small loans to owners of multiple dwellings to remove substandard or insanitary conditions.

short_summary: Relates to license requirements for professional geologists; repealer
summary: Provides that the education requirements to be licensed as a professional geologist may be partially substituted by practical experience; relates to the issuance of an identification card as a geologist in training.

short_summary: Authorizes the New York city council to determine annual rental payments charged to the New York city water board
summary: Authorizes the New York city council to determine annual rental payments charged to the New York city water board no later than February first of each year.

short_summary: Makes the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE) permanent
summary: Makes the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE) permanent.

short_summary: Establishes the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program
summary: Creates the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program for applicants who agree to engage in employment in the child care field; establishes the eligibility for such awards; establishes the amount and duration of such awards.

short_summary: Provides business tax credit for employer provided day care
summary: Provides employers with a tax credit in an amount not to exceed 20% of expenses incurred in providing day care services to the children and wards of its employees and in training persons employed by the taxpayer or a third party provider rendering such services; provides that to receive such credit the facility or program rendering day care services must be licensed.

short_summary: Relates to decreasing the length of the suspension period applicable to certain striking workers who seek to obtain unemployment insurance benefits
summary: Relates to decreasing the length of the suspension period applicable to certain individuals who lose their jobs due to a labor dispute, such as a strike, and who seek to obtain unemployment insurance benefits; decreases the suspension period from two consecutive weeks to one week; provides that the waiting period and suspension period shall be served concurrently.

short_summary: Provides for transportation accommodation for passengers with disabilities
summary: Provides for transportation accommodations for passengers with disabilities; requires compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and indication for accommodations when requesting a ride; creates an on-demand vehicle accessibility fund.

short_summary: Authorizes treatment of workers' compensation injuries by an occupational therapy assistant and a physical therapist assistant
summary: Authorizes treatment of workers' compensation injuries by an occupational therapy assistant and a physical therapy assistant; directs certain records to be retained.

short_summary: Enacts Josh's law, requires training plans be approved prior to implementation in modified and high school football
summary: Enacts Josh's law; requires training plans be approved annually prior to implementation in modified and high school football by either the PSLA or NYSPHSAA, whichever is applicable; requires certain information regarding injuries be reported that occur during such practices.

short_summary: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol
summary: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol for consumption on premises; establishes a private membership establishment must include one hundred or more members.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of education to develop guidelines to encourage participation in apprenticeships
summary: Requires the commissioner of education to develop guidelines to encourage those in high school to participate in apprenticeships and to raise awareness in apprenticeship opportunities.

short_summary: Establishes a rebuttable presumption of a hate crime when certain crimes are committed on, in or upon a house of worship
summary: Establishes a rebuttable presumption of a hate crime when certain crimes are committed on, in or upon a house of worship.

short_summary: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans
summary: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans.

short_summary: Waives certain licensure fees for seniors
summary: Relates to licensure fees for seniors.

short_summary: Establishes a Native nation consultation policy
summary: Directs the secretary of state to establish a Native nation consultation policy used by state agencies in instances where a proposal by such agency that would affect indigenous communities is under consideration.

short_summary: Relates to academic credit for veterans
summary: Relates to academic credit for veterans with regard to credit for SUNY and CUNY college credits for courses that were part of the student veterans' military training.

short_summary: Relates to participation in games of bingo by minors
summary: Permits participation in games of bingo by minors who are accompanied by an adult.

short_summary: Establishes the office of Native American affairs
summary: Establishes the office of Native American affairs to act as a centralized office for Native American nations to access information on state programs that are provided to Native Americans.

short_summary: Provides that impersonation of a disabled veteran vendor is a class A misdemeanor
summary: Provides that impersonation of a disabled veteran vendor, by carrying or possessing a specialized vending license without authority or any form of insignia or by words or actions is a class A misdemeanor.

short_summary: Provides free use of state parks for members or citizens of state or federally recognized Native American nations
summary: Provides free use of public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state for members or citizens of state or federally recognized Native American nations.

short_summary: Relates to the membership of the Republic airport commission
summary: Relates to the membership of the Republic airport commission; removes certain provisions of law requiring the commission to conduct a study on payments in lieu of taxes and improvement district taxes and charges with respect to aviation facilities which locate at Republic airport and existing aviation facilities whose leases were renewed.

short_summary: Relates to paratransit services
summary: Relates to paratransit services; directs that an applicant for recertification submit correspondence from a licensed physician in lieu of an in-person assessment.

short_summary: Establishes joint and survivorship accounts
summary: Provides for joint and survivorship accounts; provides that absent indication to the contrary, funds remaining in such an account upon the death of the depositor shall be deemed part of the depositor's estate.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to adopt rules and regulations requiring the issuance of special stickers identifying alternative fuel vehicles
summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to adopt rules and regulations requiring the issuance and placement of special stickers identifying alternative fuel vehicles having a gross vehicle weight of ten thousand pounds or less; requires such stickers to be easily identifiable to first responders as alternative fuel vehicles; defines alternative fuel.

short_summary: Requires state police at certain work zones
summary: Requires state police presence at certain work zones.

short_summary: Requires certain notices to be provided when selling a helicopter
summary: Requires a notice to be provided when selling a helicopter which contains all incidents reported within the past ten years by the national transportation safety bureau or the federal aviation administration involving the make and model, or a substantially similar make and model, of such helicopter.

short_summary: Relates to business interruption insurance
summary: Authorizes stand-alone business interruption insurance.

short_summary: Relates to gratuities received by third-party food delivery workers
summary: Requires third-party food delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands to construct multi-purpose facilities to support housing needs and supporting amenities
summary: Authorizes the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands on the Southampton campus to construct multi-purpose facilities to support housing needs and supporting amenities; requires compliance with certain state labor and contracting laws.

short_summary: Requires the department of social services to issue EMV-compliant or similar electronic benefit transfer cards and process all electronic benefit transfer system transactions using dynamic data authentication
summary: Requires the department of social services to issue EMV-compliant or similar electronic benefit transfer cards and process all electronic benefit transfer system transactions using dynamic data authentication.

short_summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to rescind any approved general project plan for non-compliance
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to rescind any approved general project plan for non-compliance with any agreements made as part of such general project plan, including, but not limited to, community benefits agreements.

short_summary: Relates to base proportions in Nassau and Suffolk counties
summary: Relates to base proportions in assessing units in Nassau and Suffolk counties for 2024--2025.

short_summary: Relates to cannabinoid hemp and hemp extract
summary: Relates to cannabinoid hemp and hemp extract; defines terms; provides that any orally consumed product in the form of a beverage and containing cannabinoids derived only from hemp, including cannabinoid hemp or hemp extract, with .5 milligrams or greater of total THC per container may not be sold to individuals under twenty-one years of age.

short_summary: Relates to certain safety features required on stretch limousines
summary: Requires stretch limousines to be equipped with roll-over protection devices such as cages or pillars and anti-intrusion bars for the purpose of protecting rear compartment passengers.

short_summary: Requires helicopter pilots to have completed certain training before operating a helicopter within the state
summary: Requires helicopter pilots to have completed a helicopter safety and risk management training course utilizing a flight simulator training device certified by either the federal aviation administration or the European aviation safety agency before operating a helicopter within the state.

short_summary: Increases penalties for endangerment of a highway worker, promote work zone safety awareness, and establish a fund for additional work zone safety enforcement
summary: Increases penalties for endangerment of a highway worker; promotes work zone safety awareness; establishes a fund for additional work zone safety enforcement.

short_summary: Exempts new clean fuel vehicles and vehicles that meet the clean vehicle standards from first year of registration fees
summary: Exempts new clean fuel vehicles and vehicles that meet the clean vehicle standards from the first year of registration fees.

short_summary: Provides for the electronic transmission of certain documents
summary: Provides for the electronic transmission of vehicle certificate of titles.

short_summary: Provides for state liability for potholes on state highways
summary: Provides for liability of the state to any person who suffers damage as a result of a defect in a state highway.

short_summary: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses
summary: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses.

short_summary: Enacts the "vehicular violence accountability act"
summary: Enacts the vehicular violence accountability act defining vehicular violence and establishing related offenses.

short_summary: Provides for the sale of salvaged airbags; repealer
summary: Provides for the sale of salvaged airbags; allows for the sale of non-deployed recycled airbags in New York, provided that such airbags meet required safety standards.

short_summary: Relates to the creation of a toll-free hotline and a website where motorists can report potholes
summary: Requires the department of transportation to maintain a website or webpage where users may report defects on state highways and bridges.

short_summary: Provides for dealer sale rescission or cancelation for any vehicle
summary: Provides for dealer sale rescission or cancelation for any vehicle not later than the thirtieth day following the date of sale; requires return by the dealer to the rightful parties all fees, taxes, and other monies provided to the dealer as part of the sale.

short_summary: Requires the deactivation of transportation network company drivers upon a substantiated report of a covered incident
summary: Requires the deactivation of transportation network company drivers upon a substantiated report of a covered incident; relates to additional safety requirements for vehicles engaged in the transportation of passengers; requires companies that provide digital networks for prearranged transportation services to provide a system of interactive electronic match verification for passengers; establishes the crimes of impersonation of a transportation network company driver in the first and second degrees.

short_summary: Rquires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses
summary: Requires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses transporting students in kindergarten through sixth grade to or from school or to or from any school related activity.

short_summary: Authorizes and directs the department of transportation to establish a memorial marker program
summary: Authorizes and directs the department of transportation to establish a memorial marker program.

short_summary: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program
summary: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program.

short_summary: Authorizes the creation and issuance of a distinctive 4-H member license plate
summary: Authorizes the creation and issuance of a distinctive 4-H member license plate; sets up a 4-H foundation fund for excess monies to be deposited.

short_summary: Increases penalties for violation of overtaking and passing a school bus
summary: Increases penalties for violation of overtaking and passing a school bus.

short_summary: Relates to applications and state aid for snowmobile trail development and maintenance
summary: Requires local governments applying for a snowmobile trail development and maintenance grant to file an application in September, rather than an estimate of the expenditures; changes the allocation formula for the snowmobile trail maintenance and development fund; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Designates a health condition or disability that may impede communication on a vehicle registration
summary: Provides for an applicant to voluntarily indicate that such applicant has a health condition or disability that may impede effective communication with a law enforcement officer when registering a motor vehicle, and that such information shall be provided to a law enforcement officer who makes a traffic stop of such vehicle.

short_summary: Establishes a state disaster emergency grant and loan program
summary: Establishes a state disaster emergency grant and loan program administered by industrial development agencies for certain small businesses.

short_summary: Provides that family members of paid professional firefighters who died in the line-of-duty may obtain a "Survivor of the Bravest" license plate
summary: Provides that family members of paid professional firefighters who died in the line-of-duty may obtain a "Survivor of the Bravest" license plate; provides for the annual service charge collected to be deposited into the department of motor vehicles distinctive license plate development fund.

short_summary: Provides for lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act
summary: Establishes the lactation accommodation in public transportation facilities act.

short_summary: Provides for indexing of certain appropriations
summary: Provides for indexing of certain appropriations; provides that on and after January first, two thousand twenty-five and on each following January first, the commissioner shall index the level of such appropriations for subsequent state fiscal years based on the national highway construction cost index for the most recent twelve month period; provides that the commissioner shall increase appropriations by the rate of inflation for the most recent twelve month period that is available at the time the adjusted rate is calculated and announced using the national highway construction cost index, or a successor index as calculated by the United States federal highway administration, if such rate of inflation is greater than zero percent.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to install notification of the thirty foot requirement on every stop sign
summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to install notification of the thirty-foot requirement on every stop sign; ensures that the required distance established by the law will be posted on any stop sign to forewarn motorists upon approaching a stop sign.

short_summary: Relates to including red cross vehicles as authorized emergency vehicles
summary: Adds red cross vehicles to the definition of authorized emergency vehicles.

short_summary: Relates to regulating the use of unmanned aircraft in the state
summary: Regulates the use of unmanned aircrafts in the state; defines terms; authorizes permitted uses of unmanned aircrafts; restricts use of unmanned aircrafts; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Provides for the seizure and redemption of unlawfully operated and unsafe commercial motor vehicles
summary: Provides for a fine of not less than ten thousand dollars for each offense committed, or by imprisonment for not more than one hundred eighty days or by both such fine and imprisonment for a class A misdemeanor where a stretch limousine has failed an inspection but an operator still operates such vehicle; provides for the seizure and redemption of unlawfully operated and unsafe commercial motor vehicles by an officer; requires such vehicle information to be entered into the New York statewide police information network as an impounded vehicle; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the purchase of zero-emission buses and the procurement of electric-powered buses, vehicles or other related equipment
summary: Relates to the purchase of zero-emission buses and the procurement of electric-powered buses, vehicles or other related equipment and infrastructure; requires public utilities to have infrastructure, capacity, facilities, and transmission and distribution systems needed to supply power for the charging of zero-emission buses; provides a tariff for charging of electric buses.

short_summary: Relates to risk retention groups and commuter vans, pre-arranged for-hire vehicles, or accessible vehicles
summary: Relates to risk retention groups and commuter vans, pre-arranged for-hire vehicles, or accessible vehicles; defines terms; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Permits the town of Tuxedo to file liens on real property related to the towns sewage-works corporation
summary: Permits the town of Tuxedo to file liens on real property related to the towns sewage-works corporation.

short_summary: Relates to prohibiting a court from denying class certification solely because the action involves governmental operations
summary: Prohibits a court from denying class certification for purposes of class action lawsuits solely because the action involves governmental operations.

short_summary: Establishes an advanced residential health care for aging adults with medical fragility demonstration program
summary: Establishes an advanced residential health care for aging adults medical fragility demonstration program to construct a new facility or repurpose part of an existing facility to operate as an adult residential health care facility for the purpose of improving the quality of care for aging adults with medical fragility.

short_summary: Raises the exclusion of certain indebtedness of school districts other than school districts in a city with one hundred twenty-five thousand inhabitants or more
summary: Raises the exclusion of certain indebtedness of school districts other than school districts in a city with one hundred twenty-five thousand inhabitants or more according to the latest federal census.

short_summary: Relates to absentee ballots for school district elections due to a religious commitment
summary: Relates to absentee ballots for school district elections due to a religious commitment or following such applicant's religious teaching or tenet that forbids secular activity on that day.

short_summary: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights
summary: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights to be implemented by various agencies.

short_summary: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights; appropriation
summary: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights to be implemented by various agencies; requires a five-year plan for implementing such bill of rights.

short_summary: Relates to itemized deductions for New York residents
summary: Prohibits certain itemized deductions for charitable contributions for New York residents.

short_summary: Requires that pharmacies that are discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance
summary: Requires pharmacies that are discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance and provide information including locations of other nearby pharmacies.

short_summary: Requires search engines and social media networks to include a consumer notice on limited services pregnancy center listings and posts
summary: Requires search engines such as Google, Yahoo or Bing to include a notice to users when searching limited services pregnancy center listings that such limited services pregnancy centers provide limited medical and abortion care and may not have medical professionals onsite; requires social media networks such as Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, Tumblr and Flickr to include such consumer notice on any posts or advertisements by such centers.

short_summary: Requires labels on certain foods and beverages containing harmful ingredients
summary: Requires harmful ingredient labels on certain foods and beverages containing harmful ingredients; requires the creation of rules and regulations regarding the content and placement of harmful ingredient labels.

short_summary: Establishes the green transition authority and establishes a for-hire vehicle improvement surcharge; appropriation
summary: Establishes the green transition authority to promote the transition of the for-hire vehicle and other state industries to environmentally sustainable practices and increase universal accessibility of for-hire vehicles, paratransit services, and taxi services statewide; establishes a for-hire vehicle improvement surcharge for each for-hire transportation trip conducted in a transportation network company vehicle or by a high-volume for-hire service; makes an appropriation therefor.

short_summary: Relates to the employment of veterans with disabilities
summary: Relates to the employment of veterans with disabilities program.

short_summary: Relates to the name of the Rockland County Solid Waste Authority, subjects such authority to regulation by the department of agriculture and markets
summary: Relates to the name of the Rockland County Solid Waste Authority; subjects such authority to regulation by the department of agriculture and markets; eliminates the ability of the authority to allow a subsidiary to perform certain functions relating to the care of unwanted animals; makes a technical change; relates to public authorities providing shelter services for the care of unwanted animals.

short_summary: Increases Rockland county's annual minimum allocation through the MTA Dutchess-Orange-Rockland Fund (DORF)
summary: Increases Rockland county's annual minimum allocation through the MTA Dutchess-Orange-Rockland Fund (DORF) from two million dollars to ten million dollars.

short_summary: Requires that for-hire vehicles have New York state issued license plates to receive a New York state inspection
summary: Prohibits the New York state inspection of vehicles used for a for-hire service if such vehicles have out-of-state license plates.

short_summary: Authorizes existing building projects to continue when the fossil fuel ban takes effect
summary: Authorizes existing building projects to continue when the fossil fuel ban takes effect.

short_summary: Relates to establishing the Hudson Valley power authority, and providing for its powers and duties
summary: Establishes the Hudson Valley power authority to own and operate electricity service and to create or acquire one or more wholly owned subsidiaries or membership interests in subsidiaries; establishes energy observatory corporations for studying and enabling effective community governance of power authorities; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Expands insurance coverage for in vitro fertilization to include three complete oocyte retrievals and in vitro fertilization with unlimited embryo transfers; includes coverage under individual policies
summary: Expands insurance coverage for in vitro fertilization; includes coverage under individual policies; provides coverage for three complete oocyte retrievals and in vitro fertilization with unlimited embryo transfers.

short_summary: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease
summary: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

short_summary: Authorizing the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law; requires contractors in violation of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law to retain independent monitors to oversee compliance.

short_summary: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department
summary: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department.

short_summary: Allows individuals to request a notation on their driver's license indicating that they have autism spectrum disorder, or any other medical, mental, or behavioral condition that may alter or impair their behavior
summary: Allows individuals to request a notation on their driver's license indicating that they have autism spectrum disorder, or any other medical, mental, or behavioral condition that may alter or impair their behavior; requires medical documentation to be submitted as proof upon such a request; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to consult with the commissioner of health and the commissioner of mental health to determine a list of such conditions and disorders that may be indicated on an individual's driver's license.

short_summary: Prohibits data brokers from selling the personal information of current and former military servicemembers
summary: Prohibits data brokers from selling the personal information of current and former military servicemembers or their households without consent.

short_summary: Relates to the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor or governor and the powers and duties of such offices
summary: Relates to the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor or governor and the powers and duties of such offices; establishes the committee on gubernatorial disability.

short_summary: Prohibits the publication of newspaper, magazine, or periodical which was wholly or partially produced or edited through the use of artificial intelligence without significant human oversight
summary: Prohibits the publication of a digital or physical newspaper, magazine, or periodical which was wholly or partially produced or edited through the use of artificial intelligence without significant human oversight.

short_summary: Grants David M. Sturtz retroactive retirement service credit
summary: Grants David M. Sturtz retroactive retirement service credit.

short_summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to pause, toll or temporarily halt the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to pause, toll or temporarily halt the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008 until such time that the attorney general has reviewed all aspects of the plan for compliance.

short_summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to create funds to compensate communities that have been harmed by land use plans
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to create funds to compensate communities that have been harmed by land use plans.

short_summary: Relates to the purposes and duties of the Mount Kisco firefighter's benevolent association and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
summary: Relates to the purposes and duties of the Mount Kisco firefighter's benevolent association and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

short_summary: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for certain renewable energy generating projects in the county of Westchester
summary: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for renewable energy generating projects in the county of Westchester with a generating capacity not exceeding two megawatts and which are located above real property that was established and used for vehicle parking.

short_summary: Removes the citizenship requirement for police officers and firefighters
summary: Removes the citizenship requirement for police officers and firefighters; extends eligibility to those legally authorized to work in the United States under federal law.

short_summary: Prohibits ticket sales that exceed the capacity of a place of entertainment, and requires original sellers of tickets to be licensed by the secretary of state
summary: Prohibits ticket sales that exceed the capacity of a place of entertainment; requires original sellers of tickets to be licensed by the secretary of state; exempts ticket sales by governmental or not-for-profit organizations.

short_summary: Increases the eligibility of admitted persons age 50 or older in general hospitals to receive immunizations against influenza virus
summary: Increases the eligibility of admitted persons age 50 or older in general hospitals to receive immunizations against influenza virus.

short_summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the installation of broadband conduits and provides for access to such conduits
summary: Requires highway projects that receive state funding to include the installation of broadband conduits suitable for fiber optic cables or wireless facilities that support broadband services; provides for access to such conduits on a competitively neutral and nondiscriminatory basis, for a charge not to exceed a cost-based rate.

short_summary: Requires subsidiaries of certain transportation authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration
summary: Requires subsidiaries of certain authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration.

short_summary: Relates to the not-for-profit contracting advisory committee
summary: Restructures the not-for-profit contracting advisory committee; provides for the issuance of additional reports.

short_summary: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program
summary: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program.

short_summary: Relates to the powers and duties of the monitor of the Rochester city school district
summary: Authorizes the monitor of the Rochester city school district to recommend the removal of any member of such board of education to the commissioner of education.

short_summary: Relates to restrictions on certain homeowners associations
summary: Imposes restrictions on the usage of pesticides and outdoor sprinkler systems on certain homeowners associations.

short_summary: Relates to rules and regulations for advertising and marketing of cannabis
summary: Requires the promulgation of rules and regulations for advertising and marketing of cannabis that include, but are not limited to, signage on the exterior walls or windows of licensed retail dispensaries; signage in languages other than English; lighting in colors other than white; other such advertising measures.

short_summary: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records
summary: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records provided that such records can be accessed and provided to a requestor during reasonable business hours.

short_summary: Relates to drivers of school buses using hands-free mobile telephones
summary: Prohibits drivers of school buses that are carrying students from using hands-free mobile telephones and provides for certain exceptions.

short_summary: Relates to insurance in certain public construction contracts
summary: Relates to an exemption for the city of New York from certain insurance requirements in connection with public construction contracts.

short_summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to accept electronic signatures on any document
summary: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to accept electronic signatures on any document.

short_summary: Provides for service of parking tickets by mail
summary: Provides for service of parking tickets by mail; provides additional time to respond to a parking ticket so served.

short_summary: Repeals section 901 of the real property tax law relating to unpaid housing code violation penalties in the city of Syracuse
summary: Repeals provisions relating to unpaid housing code violation penalties in the city of Syracuse.

short_summary: Authorizes the use of closed-circuit television for vulnerable sexual assault witnesses
summary: Authorizes the use of closed-circuit television for vulnerable sexual assault witnesses; establishes a procedure for determining who qualifies as a vulnerable sexual assault witness.

short_summary: Extends confidentiality privileges to certain communications to or from a licensed mental health counselor
summary: Extends confidentiality privileges to certain communications to or from a licensed mental health counselor in the course of his or her professional employment, and to certain employees of such licensed mental health counselor; provides exceptions thereto.

short_summary: Relates to semi-annual expenditures and lobbying reports by certain public service utility corporations
summary: Requires every utility corporation to provide an expenditures and lobbying report by March 31, 2025 and every semi-annual period thereafter to the department of public service.

short_summary: Relates to the authority of the capital district regional off-track betting corporation to retain and disburse certain uncashed tickets
summary: Relates to the authority of the capital district regional off-track betting corporation to retain and disburse certain uncashed tickets to the corporations' participating counties.

short_summary: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the operating component of rates of payment made by governmental agencies for certain services
summary: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the operating component of rates of payment made by governmental agencies for facilities that provide extensive nursing, medical, psychological and counseling support services solely to children.

short_summary: Creates the Albany county pine hills land authority
summary: Creates the Albany county pine hills land authority to transition the future use of facilities of the College of Saint Rose in a way to promote and stimulate economic development in the county of Albany and city of Albany; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to payments by a pharmacy benefit manager to in-network pharmacies
summary: Requires a pharmacy benefit manager to pay an in-network pharmacy at minimum at the national average drug acquisition cost (NADAC) rate, or at the pharmacy acquisition cost rate if greater or there is not a NADAC rate, plus a professional dispensing fee that is at minimum the professional dispensing fee paid under the state medical assistance program.

short_summary: Directs the empire state development corporation to issue reports on all active land use projects that used the process of eminent domain
summary: Directs the empire state development corporation to issue reports on all active land use projects that used the process of eminent domain quarterly until five years after the project is fully completed and shall be made available on the public website of the corporation.

short_summary: Requires the empire state development corporation to establish an office of accountability and compliance
summary: Requires the empire state development corporation to establish an office of accountability and compliance, the sole mission of which is to monitor projects for compliance to terms of general project plans and other related agreements.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town
summary: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town.

short_summary: Imposes a tax on out-of-state transfers, dividends, payments, and loans by certain accident and health insurance companies and health maintenance organizations
summary: Imposes a tax on out-of-state transfers, dividends, payments, and loans by certain accident and health insurance companies and health maintenance organizations to be deposited in the New York state agency trust fund, distressed provider assistance account.

short_summary: Relates to the appointment of a lieutenant-governor and the line of succession; repealer
summary: Relates to the appointment of a lieutenant-governor and the line of succession; creates the committee on gubernatorial disability.

short_summary: Establishes registered medical assistants
summary: Establishes registered medical assistants; outlines what such persons can do with such title.

short_summary: Permits the state and local municipalities to purchase from sources other than the correctional industries program of the department of corrections and community supervision
summary: Permits the state and local municipalities to purchase from sources other than the correctional industries program of the department of corrections and community supervision.

short_summary: Relates to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies
summary: Requires 30 hours of mandatory continuing education every three years for coroners and coroner's deputies.

short_summary: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones, and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application
summary: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application and have the option posted in a clear and conspicuous format.

short_summary: Establishes staffing standards for physical therapists and therapist assistants, occupational therapists and therapy assistants, respiratory therapists and therapy technicians and recreational therapists
summary: Includes physical therapists, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, occupational therapy assistants, respiratory therapists, respiratory therapy technicians, and recreational therapists within the existing statutory staffing standards for nursing homes.

short_summary: Grants Rockland county residents who are charged the central business district toll a rebate
summary: Grants Rockland county residents a rebate who are charged the central business district toll; establishes the "Rockland county central business district toll account".

short_summary: Designates building inspectors in the city of New York as peace officers
summary: Designates building inspectors in the city of New York as peace officers.

short_summary: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists
summary: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists for emergency treatment of a person appearing to experience an opioid-related overdose.

short_summary: Relates to access to prescription drugs for chronic weight management
summary: Requires managed care providers and the medical assistance program shall cover prescription drugs approved by the federal food and drug administration for chronic weight management in adults with obesity with at least one weight-related condition.

short_summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a composting symbol
summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a composting symbol to denote composting-acceptable materials.

short_summary: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the bathrooms of private universities
summary: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the commonly used bathrooms of private universities.

short_summary: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties
summary: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties having a population of more than three hundred thirty-eight thousand and less than three hundred forty thousand, determined in accordance with the latest federal decennial census.

short_summary: Requires training for police officers on discharging a firearm at a moving vehicle
summary: Requires training for police officers on discharging a firearm at a moving vehicle; requires the municipal police training council to develop and disseminate written policies and procedures regarding such force.

short_summary: Requires consultation with tribal nations as part of the state budget process
summary: Directs the division of the budget to consult tribal nations, relevant state agencies, and other stakeholders regarding budget proposals that would impact such tribal nations.

short_summary: Requires certain public schools in any city with a population over one million to offer Halal food options during lunch
summary: Requires public schools in any city with a population over one million to offer Halal food options during lunch.

short_summary: Affords certain police/fire members who are members of the fire department pension fund to continue in service past normal retirement age with an additional pension benefit for each year of additional service
summary: Affords certain police/fire members who are members of the fire department pension fund to continue in service past normal retirement age with an additional pension benefit for each year of additional service; provides an additional amount computed at the rate of one-fortieth of his or her final salary for each year of such additional service.

short_summary: Permits New York city correction officers to borrow from accumulated contributions; repealer
summary: Permits NYC correction officers to borrow from accumulated contributions.

short_summary: Affords certain uniformed members of the fire department pension fund with an increased pension benefit for each year of additional service beyond their required minimum service
summary: Affords certain uniformed members of the fire department pension fund with an increased pension benefit of one-fortieth of their average annual earnings for each year of additional service beyond his or her required minimum service.

short_summary: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more
summary: Provides a performance of duty presumption for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more.

short_summary: Relates to submission requirements for reports of independent medical examinations
summary: Requires reports of independent medical examinations to be submitted by electronic filing; requires such report to additionally be mailed to the claimant unless the claimant opts out.

short_summary: Enacts the  ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act
summary: Enacts the "ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act"; provides for the issuance of anti-stalking orders.

short_summary: Enables students to receive information from colleges and universities without disclosing their personally identifiable information
summary: Enables students to receive information from colleges and universities without disclosing their personally identifiable information via an opt-in system.

short_summary: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission
summary: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission.

short_summary: Authorizes increased equity withdrawals by certain non-public residential health care facilities
summary: Authorizes increased equity withdrawals by certain non-public residential health care facilities; establishes the nursing home worker recruitment and safety fund.

short_summary: Prohibits state funding of any college if instructional staff advocates or engages in activities on campus in support of a terrorist organization
summary: Prohibits state funding of any college if instructional staff promotes, encourages, advocates or engages in activities on campus in support of a terrorist organization as defined in federal statute.

short_summary: Relates to recusal by a court of appeals judge
summary: Provides that when a court of appeals judge recuses themselves from sitting in or taking part in the decision, action, claim, matter, motion or proceeding, a replacement shall be chosen on a rotating basis, based on seniority, of the next available appellate division judge.

short_summary: Requires all medical facilities to have immediate access to every single-occupancy bathroom where a patient could be in an emergency
summary: Requires all medical facilities to have immediate access to every single-occupancy bathroom where a patient could be in an emergency.

short_summary: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail
summary: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail.

short_summary: Exempts vehicles owned and/or operated by certain persons, vendors, organizations or not-for-profit corporations from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
summary: Exempts vehicles owned and/or operated by a not-for-profit corporation, any private vehicle operated by a worker or volunteer, first responders, military personnel, veterans, healthcare workers, critical infrastructure workers acting on behalf of such organization or public employees traveling in an official capacity, wholesale food distributors or wholesale or retail delivery vehicles from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

short_summary: Authorizes the acceptance of an application for a retroactive property tax exemption from the Center for Jewish Life of Hewlett Inc.
summary: Authorizes the acceptance of an application for a retroactive property tax exemption from the Center for Jewish Life of Hewlett Inc. for a portion of the 2021--2022 school year taxes and a portion of the 2022 general year assessment roll.

short_summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lighthouse International Christian Gathering
summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lighthouse International Christian Gathering.

short_summary: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of Lido Beach
summary: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of Lido Beach.

short_summary: Relates to installation and maintenance of automated external defibrillators on trains operated by the metropolitan transportation authority
summary: Requires the installation and maintenance of automated external defibrillators on trains operated by the metropolitan transportation authority.

short_summary: Prohibits the use of algorithmic systems to artificially inflate the price or reduce the supply of leased or rented residential dwelling units
summary: Prohibits the collecting of information of historical or contemporaneous prices, supply levels, or lease or rental contract termination and renewal dates of residential dwelling units from two or more rental property owners for purposes of analyzing or processing of such information using an algorithm and of recommending rental prices, lease renewal terms, or ideal occupancy levels to a rental property owner.

short_summary: Relates to the enforcement of liens by sale of the occupant's goods that remain in a self-storage facility
summary: Permits the sale of goods that remain in a self-storage facility to enforce a lien by the facility through a public website, pursuant to notice requirements.

short_summary: Relates to the payment of prevailing wage for work involving the delivery and hauling of aggregate supply construction materials in certain municipalities
summary: Relates to the payment of prevailing wage for work in Nassau, Putnam, Suffolk and Westchester counties and in the city of New York involving the delivery and hauling of aggregate supply construction materials which shall include concrete and asphalt in addition to sand, gravel, stone, crushed stone, dirt, soil, millings, and fill.

short_summary: Provides for the conveyance or lease of sewer system properties and responsibilities by cities, towns and villages in the county of Westchester when determined to be in the public interest
summary: Provides for the conveyance or lease of sewer system properties and responsibilities by cities, towns and villages in the county of Westchester and the establishment of certain county sewer districts, extensions or special transitional zones of assessment in the county of Westchester when determined to be in the public interest.

short_summary: Regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status
summary: Regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; limits state officers, employees and law enforcement inquiring about an individual's immigration status.

short_summary: Relates to authorizing the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands for the purpose of constructing a facility to support research and development of semiconductor chips
summary: Authorizes the state university of New York at Stony Brook to lease certain lands for the purpose of developing a facility to support research and development to address the national semiconductor chip shortage and related environmental sustainability issues.

short_summary: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act"
summary: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act" relating to the employment of persons with developmental disabilities by school districts.

short_summary: Relates to the Bethpage community park cleanup independent state monitorship
summary: Establishes an independent state monitorship to oversee containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup of the groundwater plume associated with the Northrop Grumman Bethpage Facility and Naval Weapons Industrial Reserve Plant sites in the hamlet of Bethpage within the town of Oyster Bay and compliance by Northrop Grumman and any other parties responsible for such containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup with any operative consent decrees, consent judgments, settlements, or agreements.

short_summary: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act"
summary: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act" to provide additional credits to the Nassau county law enforcement explorers in competitive civil service examinations; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act"
summary: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act" to allow educators to deduct qualified expenses incurred by K-12 educators.

short_summary: Relates to assaults on medical providers and employees and volunteers of hospitals
summary: Relates to assaults on medical providers and employees and volunteers of hospitals.

short_summary: Establishes the distributed generation for community solar siting commission
summary: Establishes the nine member distributed generation for community solar siting commission to examine the reasons for delays in the siting of community solar projects, identify those causes and examine solutions to accelerate development; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the use of virtual credit cards by insurers and certain health care plans
summary: Authorizes an insurer to pay a claim for reimbursement made by a provider using a credit card, virtual credit card or electronic funds transfer payment method that imposes on the provider a free or similar charge to process the payment; defines "virtual credit card" as a single-use series of numbers linked to a fixed dollar amount and provided by an insurer to a provider for the purpose of paying a claim for health care services performed by the provider; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to Medicaid accountable care organizations
summary: Allows for Medicaid accountable care organizations to purchase experience-rated health insurance for their members.

short_summary: Relates to the discretionary buying threshold
summary: Increases the discretionary buying threshold for state agencies purchasing commodities from small business concerns, certified minority and women-owned businesses and certified veteran companies.

short_summary: Requires a minimum operator age for amusement devices
summary: Requires the commissioner of labor to promulgate rules and regulations to authorize competent operators at least sixteen years of age to operate all amusement devices.

short_summary: Authorizes Scott Hoag to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
summary: Authorizes Scott Hoag, a city of Rome police officer, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

short_summary: Relates to the definition of construction contracts
summary: Removes residential dwelling units that must be affordable to residents at a specific income level from the definition of "construction contracts" for the purposes of certain provisions of the General Business Law.

short_summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Calvin Rice
summary: Grants retroactive membership with tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Calvin Rice.

short_summary: Provides for accidental disability retirement for deputy sheriffs in Orange county
summary: Provides for accidental disability retirement for deputy sheriffs in Orange county.

short_summary: Establishes the housing people and animals together grant program
summary: Establishes the housing people and animals together grant program to expand access for co-sheltering people experiencing homelessness and victims of domestic violence with companion animals.

short_summary: Relates to limited-scope radiographers
summary: Authorizes a holder of a license to perform limited-scope radiography to practice radiography at urgent care centers under the supervision of a licensed practitioner or licensed registered radiologic technologist; defines limited-scope radiographer as a person licensed to practice radiography limited to chest, extremities, skull/sinus, and spine/sacrum at urgent care centers; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
summary: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of his deceased wife with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

short_summary: Enacts the "limited equity cooperative insurance captive authorization and county cap act"
summary: Enacts the "limited equity cooperative insurance captive authorization and county cap act" to enable limited equity cooperatives in the state of New York to establish insurance captives to enhance their ability to manage risks, improve insurance coverage, and promote financial stability.

short_summary: Relates to recovery of alleged overpayment of wages
summary: Establishes a minimum threshold of five hundred dollars for recovery of overpayment of wages; provides an employee who is alleged to have been overpaid notice and an opportunity to respond to such allegation prior to the state seeking such recovery.

short_summary: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for certain members
summary: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for New York city enhanced plan members in active service who are not eligible for a normal retirement benefit and have completed five years or more of service.

short_summary: Grants the legislature to have an equal role with the governor in the budget process
summary: Provides that the Governor's annual budget proposal to the Legislature shall include statements of any new legislation, amendment to legislation, or limitation on the effect of any legislation contained in the budget; makes related provisions granting the legislature an equal role with the governor in the budget process.

short_summary: Requires a review of school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues
summary: Requires a local transportation regulatory agency to review school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues prior to the issuance of a building permit for a new school facility or the expansion or renovation of an existing school facility.

short_summary: Requires a traffic study as part of an application to establish a charter school
summary: Requires a traffic study that evaluates the potential impact of the proposed charter school on traffic patterns, safety and congestion in the surrounding area as part of an application to establish a charter school.

short_summary: Relates to providing pension benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd
summary: Provides New York city fire pension fund benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd.

short_summary: Relates to complaints concerning the moral character of individuals who hold or who are applicants for New York State teaching certificates
summary: Relates to complaints concerning the moral character of individuals who hold or who are applicants for New York State teaching certificates.

short_summary: Relates to requiring disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence in a civil action
summary: Requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

short_summary: Relates to the role of the commissioner of veterans' services in regards to the veterans' home assistance fund and the military family relief fund
summary: Directs that moneys in the veterans' home services fund shall be payable on vouchers certified by the commissioner of veterans' services; directs a report to be submitted by such commissioner; directs that moneys in the military family relief fund shall be payable on vouchers certified by the commissioner of veterans' services.

short_summary: Provides insurance coverage for cranial prostheses
summary: Provides insurance coverage for cranial prostheses for a diagnosed health condition, chronic illness, or injury.

short_summary: Relates to licensing restrictions for on-premises alcohol consumption for certain manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages
summary: Relates to licensing restrictions for on-premises alcohol consumption for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages at specific locations.

short_summary: Establishes a course of study in financial education for certain students
summary: Establishes a half-credit course in financial education delivered by means of a comprehensive financial literacy program for all pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve.

short_summary: Relates to first aid instruction for students in grades nine through twelve
summary: Requires high schools to teach first aid instruction to students in grades nine through twelve.

short_summary: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act of 2024" to provide for grants to certain hospitals, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention
summary: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act" to provide for grants from the state commissioner of education to public and not-for-profit hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention costs and activities as described herein.

short_summary: Directs the education department to conduct a study to evaluate services provided by public library systems of the state
summary: Directs the education department to conduct a study to evaluate services provided by public library systems of the state to determine if the current funding standards are adequate and equitably enable libraries to meet community needs across the state; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Establishes a registry for historic libraries and museums
summary: Directs the department of education to establish and maintain a registry of historic libraries and museums in the state that have operated for over fifty years; lays out criteria; makes related provisions.

short_summary: Relates to the study of the current prevalence of SNAP/EBT benefit fraud
summary: Directs the commissioner of social services to study and report of the prevalence and threat of SNAP/EBT benefit fraud.

short_summary: Relates to community health assessment reporting
summary: Requires every municipality to submit to the department of health a community health assessment in alignment with the state health improvement plan cycle and no more frequently than every six years; removes requirement of a community health assessment no more frequently that every two years.

short_summary: Expands the definition of wellness programs
summary: Expands the definition of wellness programs to include a program to address the impacts of technology use on the mental and physical well-being of youth.

short_summary: Relates to comprehensive psychiatric emergency programs
summary: Requires a report by December 1, 2026 to the governor, temporary president of the senate and speaker of the assembly on comprehensive psychiatric emergency programs in the state.

short_summary: Provides for the licensure of dietitian nutritionists and nutritionists; repealer
summary: Provides for the licensure of dietitian nutritionists and nutritionists; defines the practice thereof.

short_summary: Directs the commissioner of the New York state division of housing and community renewal to promulgate rules and regulations relating to the low-income housing tax credit
summary: Directs the commissioner of the New York state division of housing and community renewal to promulgate rules and regulations to provide a taxpayer or entity having applied for the low-income housing tax credit and certified by the division of housing and community renewal with a notice of placement on a waiting list upon the submission of a completed application.

short_summary: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way
summary: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way.

short_summary: Requires the establishment of a plant-based agriculture grant program
summary: Requires the establishment of a plant-based agriculture grant program to assist small and medium-sized farms transition to plant-based agriculture.

short_summary: Prohibits the transportation of dogs in the back of a motor vehicle intended for any load
summary: Prohibits the transportation of dogs in the back of a motor vehicle intended for any load unless such space is enclosed or has side and tail racks to a height of not less than forty-six inches extending vertically from the floor; the motor vehicle has installed means of preventing the dog from being ejected; or the dog is cross-tethered to the vehicle or is protected by a secured container or cage, in a manner which will prevent the dog from being ejected from the motor vehicle; imposes fines for violations.

short_summary: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee
summary: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee to provide a mechanism for interagency cooperation and coordination to implement the recommendations of the report of the Adirondack road salt reduction task force.

short_summary: Establishes a local government salt brine equipment grant program; appropriation
summary: Establishes a local government salt brine equipment grant program under which the secretary of state may award matching grants to municipalities to cover costs associated with purchasing salt brine equipment.

short_summary: Authorizes funding that would include services and expenses intended to result in improved compliance with fair housing laws
summary: Authorizes funding that would include services and expenses intended to result in improved compliance with fair housing laws such as intake and assessment of cases in which fair housing rights may have been violated and enforcement action.

short_summary: Establishes maximum contaminant levels in drinking water for certain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
